title: REPTILES: Repeated Tiles of Sargantana, a RISC-V multicore based on OpenPiton
summary: Chip industry continues advancing and expanding modern computing systems, resulting in more complex multi-core processors. Conversely, academic projects face scalability challenges due to limited resources, highlighting the need for open-source frameworks that enable innovation and knowledge sharing. Recently, several open-source proposals have emerged, offering flexible and scalable designs, but fail to meet the performance demands of modern High-Performance Computing (HPC) applications. In this project, we present REPTILES, an open-source RISC-V multicore framework based on OpenPiton\thanks. REPTILES interconnects multiple Sargantana cores with the memory hierarchy of OpenPiton. Moreover, we present the new features incorporated in Sargantana and OpenPiton designs to improve the performance of HPC applications. We demonstrate that REPTILES presents suitable scalability, achieving a speedup of 3.1x on average with 4 cores. Additionally, we show that Sargantana's new features increase the performance of vector addition benchmark in a 9.3x.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了REPTILES，一个基于OpenPiton的开源RISC-V多核框架，通过互联Sargantana核心与OpenPiton存储层次结构，实现了良好的可扩展性和性能提升，平均加速比达到3.1倍（4核），新特性使向量加法基准测试性能提升9.3倍。
AI.motivation: 随着芯片行业发展，多核处理器日益复杂，而学术项目因资源有限面临可扩展性挑战。现有的开源框架虽然灵活可扩展，但无法满足现代高性能计算（HPC）应用的性能需求，因此需要开发既能支持创新共享又能满足HPC性能要求的开源框架。
AI.method: 提出REPTILES开源RISC-V多核框架，基于OpenPiton平台，将多个Sargantana核心与OpenPiton的存储层次结构互联；同时在Sargantana和OpenPiton设计中引入新特性以提升HPC应用性能。
AI.result: REPTILES展现出良好的可扩展性，在4核配置下平均实现3.1倍加速；Sargantana的新特性使向量加法基准测试性能提升9.3倍。
AI.conclusion: REPTILES成功填补了开源框架在HPC应用性能方面的空白，为学术研究和创新提供了既具备良好可扩展性又满足高性能需求的开源RISC-V多核解决方案。

title: FLARE: One-Shot PE-Level Fault Localization in Systolic Arrays via Algebraic Test Vectors
summary:
Systolic arrays are the dominant compute fabric for neural network inference. Prior work has addressed column-level fault detection efficiently with uniform test patterns, but row-level (PE-level) fault localization within a faulty column remains open without resorting to hardware redundancy. The fundamental obstacle is that uniform test inputs destroy per-row signatures: any test that activates every row equally cannot distinguish which row is the source of an observed deviation.
  In this paper, we propose a lightweight, purely algorithmic remedy based on coprime test vectors. By assigning pairwise coprime integers as test-input entries, a permanent weight-register fault produces a deviation whose divisibility signature uniquely identifies the faulty row. Under a general bounded error model, a single test pass localizes the faulty row with high probability. This error model covers a broader class of faults than what prior dataflow-aware testing work has primarily emphasized. When one round is insufficient, a second pass using a ratio computation achieves exact localization; for the special case of single-bit errors, odd coprime entries guarantee exact localization in one round.
  For INT16 arithmetic, a single test pass covers array sizes up to $256{\times}256$ with localization probability above $0.98$, at a test cost under $1\%$ of one inference GEMM tile.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于互质测试向量的轻量级算法方法，用于在没有硬件冗余的情况下实现脉动阵列中行级（PE级）故障定位。对于INT16运算，单次测试可在256×256阵列上以超过0.98的概率定位故障行，测试成本低于一次推理GEMM分块的1%。
AI.motivation: 脉动阵列是神经网络推理的主流计算架构。现有工作已利用统一测试模式高效解决了列级故障检测，但在不依赖硬件冗余的情况下，故障列内的行级（PE级）故障定位仍是未解决的问题。其根本障碍在于统一测试输入会破坏每行的特征签名——任何平等激活每行的测试都无法区分偏差来源于哪一行。
AI.method: 提出一种基于互质测试向量的轻量级纯算法解决方案。通过分配两两互质的整数作为测试输入条目，当权重寄存器发生永久性故障时，产生的偏差具有可除性特征，能够唯一标识故障行。在一般有界误差模型下，单次测试即可高概率定位故障行；若一轮不足，第二轮通过比率计算实现精确定位；对于单比特错误的特殊情况，使用奇互质条目可保证一轮内精确定位。
AI.result: 对于INT16算术，单次测试可覆盖高达256×256的阵列规模，故障行定位概率超过0.98，测试成本低于一次推理GEMM分块的1%。所采用的有界误差模型覆盖了比现有数据流感知测试工作所强调的更广泛的故障类别。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功解决了脉动阵列行级故障定位的开放性问题，无需硬件冗余即可实现高效、低成本的精确定位，为神经网络推理硬件的可靠性测试提供了有效的算法解决方案。

title: DSPE: An Energy-Efficient Edge Processor for DeepSeek Inference with MerkleTree-based Incremental Pruning, Multi-Stage Boothing Lookup and Dynamic Adaptive Posit Processing
comment: Accepted by DAC 2026, Long Beach, CA, USA. 7 pages, 8 figures. Corresponding author: Zhou Wang. †These authors contributed equally to this work: Yuhan Zhang and Zhou Wang
summary: In recent years, DeepSeek has achieved strong inference performance but remains hard to deploy on energy-constrained edge devices. This paper presents the DeepSeek Processing Element (DSPE), an edge-oriented architecture that alleviates the model's heavy computational and energy demands. DSPE introduces three techniques: the MerkleTree-based Incremental Pruning Scheme (MIPS) for secure redundant-vector reduction, the Multi-Stage Boothing Lookup Method (MBLM) for bit-flip-aware approximate multiplication, and the Dynamic Adaptive Posit Processing Mechanism (DAPPM), which introduces a new DA-Posit format and its corresponding hardware multiplication architecture. Implemented in TSMC 28nm CMOS, DSPE achieves 109.4 TFLOPS/W energy efficiency compared with state-of-the-art designs and offers a scalable foundation for edge deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DSPE，一种面向边缘设备的DeepSeek处理器架构，通过引入三种优化技术，在TSMC 28nm工艺下实现了109.4 TFLOPS/W的能效，解决了DeepSeek模型在资源受限设备上的部署难题。
AI.motivation: DeepSeek模型虽然推理性能优异，但其巨大的计算量和能耗使其难以部署在能源受限的边缘设备上。现有的硬件平台难以满足该模型对计算密度和能效的严苛要求。
AI.method: 提出DeepSeek处理单元（DSPE），包含三项关键技术：1）基于MerkleTree的增量剪枝方案（MIPS），用于安全的冗余向量减少；2）多阶段布斯查找法（MBLM），实现位翻转感知的近似乘法；3）动态自适应Posit处理机制（DAPPM），引入新型DA-Posit数据格式及对应的硬件乘法架构。基于TSMC 28nm CMOS工艺实现。
AI.result: DSPE在TSMC 28nm工艺下实现了109.4 TFLOPS/W的能效，相较于现有最先进的设计具有显著优势，为边缘部署提供了可扩展的硬件基础。
AI.conclusion: DSPE架构成功解决了DeepSeek模型在边缘设备上的部署挑战，通过创新的剪枝、近似计算和数据格式优化技术，实现了高能效的硬件加速器设计。

title: KV-RM: Regularizing KV-Cache Movement for Static-Graph LLM Serving
summary: Static-graph LLM decoders provide predictable launches, fixed tensor shapes, and low submission overhead, but online decoding exposes highly irregular KV-cache behavior: request lengths differ, EOS events arrive asynchronously, and logical histories fragment over time. Dynamic runtimes recover flexibility through paged KV management and step-level scheduling, while static-graph executors often over-reserve memory and suffer burst-time latency outliers. This paper studies whether much of this variability can be absorbed below a fixed decode interface. We present KV-RM, a runtime design that regularizes KV-cache movement beneath a static-graph LLM decoder. KV-RM decouples logical KV histories from physical storage, tracks active KV state through a block pager, and materializes each decode step through a single committed descriptor. A merge-staged transport path coalesces non-contiguous KV mappings into a small number of large transfer groups before a fixed-shape attention kernel consumes them. Optional bounded far-history summaries can be enabled under the same interface, but the core design does not depend on them. On a 2-GPU NVIDIA A100 node, KV-RM improves mixed-length decoding throughput and tail latency relative to a static-graph baseline, reduces reserved KV memory across workload families, and removes severe burst-time latency spikes under production-trace replay. These results suggest that KV-cache movement, rather than kernel shape, can be an effective boundary for recovering runtime flexibility in static-graph LLM serving.

AI.tldr: KV-RM通过解耦逻辑KV历史与物理存储，在静态图LLM解码器接口下吸收KV缓存的不规则性，提升吞吐量和尾延迟性能，同时降低内存预留。
AI.motivation: 静态图LLM解码器提供可预测的启动和低提交开销，但在在线解码中面临高度不规则的KV缓存行为：请求长度差异、EOS事件异步到达、逻辑历史随时间碎片化。动态运行时通过分页KV管理和步骤级调度恢复灵活性，而静态图执行器往往过度预留内存并在突发时出现延迟异常值。研究是否可以将这种变异性吸收到固定解码接口之下。
AI.method: 提出KV-RM运行时设计，将KV缓存移动规范化到静态图LLM解码器之下。KV-RM将逻辑KV历史与物理存储解耦，通过块页管理器跟踪活动KV状态，并通过单个提交描述符实例化每个解码步骤。合并阶段传输路径将非连续KV映射合并为少量大型传输组，然后由固定形状注意力内核消费。可选的有限远历史摘要可在相同接口下启用，但核心设计不依赖于此。
AI.result: 在2-GPU NVIDIA A100节点上，KV-RM相对于静态图基线提升了混合长度解码吞吐量和尾延迟性能，减少了跨工作负载族的预留KV内存，并在生产轨迹重放下消除了严重的突发时延迟峰值。
AI.conclusion: KV缓存移动而非内核形状，可以成为静态图LLM服务中恢复运行时灵活性的有效边界。

title: Single 32-bit Sub-Channel DDR5 DIMMs: Architecture, Performance Bounds, and Standardisation
summary: DDR5 SDRAM partitions each 64-bit memory channel into two independent 32-bit sub-channels. A DIMM populating only one sub-channel halves the die count required for a given module, enabling 8 GB modules with current 16 Gbit dies that the standard topology cannot achieve. The configuration has been used by the enthusiast overclocking community since 2021 to set DDR5 frequency world records on three successive Intel platform generations, and has recently received attention as a candidate for cost-reduced volume modules under the contemporaneous DRAM supply constraints. We derive the transaction-width identity grounding the JEDEC sub-channel design: 32-bit x BL16 transfers exactly one 64-byte x86 cache line per burst. Using a roofline model we quantify performance impact across workload classes (40-60% throughput degradation in bandwidth-bound workloads, < 10% in latency-dominated workloads), and identify a bandwidth inversion at DDR5-4800 below DDR4-3200. Platform analysis shows architectural incompatibility with AMD AM5 as a consequence of the unified 64-bit UMC training model. We further show that the JEDEC SPD specification (JESD400-5D.01) already encodes single sub-channel modules natively in Byte 235, and identify the surrounding ecosystem standardisation gap.

AI.tldr: DDR5 SDRAM采用双32位子通道设计，单子通道DIMM可减少一半芯片需求，但会导致带宽受限工作负载40-60%的性能下降。该配置在超频领域已获成功，但在AMD AM5平台存在兼容性问题，且生态系统标准化存在缺口。
AI.motivation: DDR5 SDRAM将64位内存通道划分为两个独立32位子通道，单子通道DIMM配置可使给定模组所需芯片数量减半，实现标准拓扑无法达到的8GB模组容量。该配置自2021年起被超频社区用于创造DDR5频率世界纪录，并在DRAM供应紧缺背景下作为降低成本方案受到关注。
AI.method: 推导了支撑JEDEC子通道设计的事务宽度恒等式：32位×BL16传输在每个突发周期精确传输一个64字节x86缓存行。采用roofline模型量化不同工作负载类别的性能影响，分析平台架构兼容性，并检查JEDEC SPD规范（JESD400-5D.01）中的相关编码。
AI.result: 带宽受限工作负载的吞吐量下降40-60%，延迟主导型工作负载性能下降< 10%。发现DDR5-4800在特定条件下存在低于DDR4-3200的带宽反转现象。AMD AM5平台因其统一的64位UMC训练模型而与该配置架构不兼容。JEDEC SPD规范的Byte 235已原生编码单子通道模组信息，但周边生态系统存在标准化缺口。
AI.conclusion: DDR5单子通道配置在成本优化方面具有潜力，但需权衡性能损失和平台兼容性问题。当前生态系统标准化不完善，需要进一步完善规范以支持该配置的广泛应用。

title: Designing Intelligent Enterprise Agents: A Capability-Aligned Multi-Agent Architecture
summary: Enterprise interest in multi-agent systems has shifted from generic software agents to large-language-model (LLM) based intelligent agents that plan, use tools, maintain contextual memory, inspect intermediate results, collaborate with other agents, and sometimes act in systems of record. This paper revises the enterprise architecture thesis around a design-first claim: governance is necessary, but it cannot be the primary organizing abstraction. The primary abstraction must be agent design - capability boundaries, autonomy allocation, interaction protocols, tool and data authority, state and memory design, verification design, and human interaction design. We propose CEAD (Capability-Aligned Enterprise Agent Design), a reference architecture for intelligent agents that uses service-oriented architecture (SOA) as an exemplar for contracts, registries, loose coupling, and policy-aware integration, while explicitly rejecting the idea that services are agents. It treats microservices as a cautionary precedent: decomposition without design discipline produces distributed complexity, cost, operational fragility, and agent proliferation. We evaluate CEAD over 10,000 enterprise tasks, comparing five architectures: a prompt-first mono-agent, a role-based micro-agent swarm, SOA-brokered agents, a governance-first but design-poor agent grid, and the proposed CEAD architecture. CEAD achieves 70.6% safe success, versus 45.2% for the mono-agent baseline, 23.1% for the ungoverned micro-agent swarm, 58.8% for SOA-brokered agents, and 50.8% for the control-heavy, design-poor grid. The results support the conclusion that design quality is the first-order enterprise concern; governance, security, policy, audit, and assurance should support and enforce good design rather than substitute for it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CEAD（能力对齐的企业智能体设计）参考架构，主张设计优先于治理。在10,000个企业任务评估中，CEAD实现70.6%安全成功率，显著优于其他四种架构，证明设计质量是企业首要关注点。
AI.motivation: 企业对多智能体系统的关注已从通用软件智能体转向基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能智能体。现有企业架构过度强调治理而忽视设计，导致类似微服务的分解问题：无设计约束的分解产生分布式复杂性、成本增加、运营脆弱性和智能体泛滥。研究旨在解决"治理优先"范式的根本缺陷。
AI.method: 提出CEAD参考架构，以面向服务架构（SOA）为范例，采用契约、注册、松耦合和策略感知集成，但明确否定"服务即智能体"的观点。CEAD以智能体设计为核心抽象，涵盖能力边界、自主性分配、交互协议、工具与数据权限、状态与记忆设计、验证设计以及人机交互设计七个维度。在10,000个企业任务上对比评估五种架构：提示优先的单体智能体、基于角色的微智能体集群、SOA代理智能体、治理优先但设计贫乏的智能体网格，以及CEAD架构。
AI.result: CEAD实现70.6%安全成功率，显著优于：单体智能体基线（45.2%）、无治理微智能体集群（23.1%）、SOA代理智能体（58.8%）、治理优先设计贫乏网格（50.8%）。结果表明，将微服务作为警示先例具有重要价值——无设计约束的分解会导致严重问题。
AI.conclusion: 设计质量是企业首要关注事项，治理、安全、策略、审计和保障应支持和执行良好设计，而非替代设计。治理虽必要但不应成为主要组织抽象，主要抽象必须是智能体设计。CEAD为企业在LLM智能体时代提供了可操作的设计框架。

title: Performance and Energy Trade-Off Analysis of Hierarchical Federated Learning for Plant Disease Classification
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 ERAS Conference
summary: Early detection of plant diseases is critical for improving crop productivity, while it also facilitates the foundations of precision agriculture. Recent advances in distributed deep learning have enabled plant disease classification models to be trained across geographically distributed agricultural sensing infrastructures. However, deploying such systems in large-scale Internet of Things (IoT) environments, introduces significant challenges related to computational cost, energy consumption, and system efficiency. In this paper, we present a design-space exploration of hierarchical federated learning architectures for plant disease classification, with a particular focus on the trade-offs between predictive performance and energy efficiency. We further introduce a power- and energy-aware optimization framework that enables the systematic evaluation and selection of model-aggregator configurations under varying deployment constraints. The hierarchical federated architecture organizes distributed clients through intermediate aggregation layers, reducing communication and computational overhead. We evaluate multiple convolutional neural network architectures, including EfficientNet-B0, ResNet-50, and MobileNetV3-Large, in combination with different federated aggregation strategies such as FedAvg, FedProx, and FedAvgM. Experimental results demonstrate that different model-aggregator combinations exhibit distinct performance-energy trade-offs. Consequently, we highlight configurations that achieve competitive diagnostic accuracy and significantly reduce system resource requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文针对物联网环境下植物病害分类任务，提出了分层联邦学习架构的探索与能效优化框架，在保持诊断准确率的同时显著降低了系统资源消耗。
AI.motivation: 植物病害早期检测对提高作物产量至关重要，分布式深度学习虽已应用于农业传感基础设施，但在大规模物联网环境中部署面临着计算成本高、能耗大和系统效率低等严峻挑战。
AI.method: 提出分层联邦学习架构设计空间探索方法，通过中间聚合层组织分布式客户端以降低通信和计算开销；引入功率与能量感知优化框架，系统评估并选择适应不同部署约束的模型-聚合器配置；测试了EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-50和MobileNetV3-Large等卷积神经网络架构，结合FedAvg、FedProx和FedAvgM等联邦聚合策略。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，不同模型-聚合器组合展现出独特的性能-能耗权衡特性，所提配置在获得具有竞争力的诊断准确率的同时，能够显著降低系统能源需求。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为大规模物联网农业环境中的植物病害分类系统提供了有效的分层联邦学习解决方案，通过合理配置模型架构与聚合策略，实现了预测性能与能效之间的最优平衡。

title: Technical Report: A Hierarchical Dynamically Weighting Deep Reinforcement Learning Method for Multi-UAV Multi-Task Coordination
summary: This paper investigates the multi-UAV multi-task coordination problem in infrastructure-less emergency scenarios, where UAVs collaboratively are required to jointly perform aerial image acquisition and ground-user communication. To tackle the challenge of balancing heterogeneous tasks within dynamic environments, we propose a hierarchical dynamic weighting Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) framework. Specifically, an episode-level module is introduced to capture global task preferences, while a step-level module adaptively adjusts the objective weights according to real-time system conditions. By integrating global and instantaneous weights, the proposed framework improves decision stability and responsiveness during task execution. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves faster convergence, more stable training, and higher task completion efficiency than conventional works.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分层动态权重深度强化学习框架，用于解决无基础设施紧急场景下的多无人机多任务协同问题，实现了图像采集与通信任务的平衡优化。
AI.motivation: 在无基础设施的紧急场景中，多无人机需协同执行空中图像采集和地面用户通信等异构任务，而在动态环境下平衡这些任务面临巨大挑战，传统方法难以适应实时变化的系统条件。
AI.method: 提出分层动态权重深度强化学习框架：引入回合级模块捕捉全局任务偏好，同时设计步级模块根据实时系统状态自适应调整目标权重，通过融合全局权重与瞬时权重提升决策稳定性与响应能力。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，该方法相比传统工作具有更快的收敛速度、更稳定的训练过程以及更高的任务完成效率。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架有效解决了动态环境下多无人机异构任务协同的平衡问题，提升了系统的决策稳定性与任务执行效率。

title: Where Reliability Lives in Vision-Language Models: A Mechanistic Study of Attention, Hidden States, and Causal Circuits
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Multimodal Reasoning. Code and probe-training pipelines: https://github.com/itsloganmann/VLM-Reliability-Probe
summary: A pervasive intuition holds that vision-language models (VLMs) are most trustworthy when their attention maps look sharp: concentrated attention on the queried region should imply a confident, calibrated answer. We test this Attention-Confidence Assumption directly. We instrument three open-weight VLM families (LLaVA-1.5, PaliGemma, Qwen2-VL; 3-7B parameters) with a unified mechanistic pipeline -- the VLM Reliability Probe (VRP) -- that compares attention structure, generation dynamics, and hidden-state geometry against a single correctness label. Three results emerge. (i) Attention structure is a near-zero predictor of correctness (R_pb(C_k,y)=0.001, 95% CI [-0.034,0.036]; R_pb(H_s,y)=-0.012, [-0.047,0.024] on a pooled n=3,090 split), even though attention remains causally necessary for feature extraction (top-30% patch masking drops accuracy by 8.2-11.3 pp, p<0.001). (ii) Reliability becomes legible later in the computation: a single hidden-state linear probe reaches AUROC>0.95 on POPE for two of three families, and self-consistency at K=10 is the strongest behavioral predictor we measure at 10x inference cost (R_pb=0.43). (iii) Causal neuron-level ablations expose a sharp architectural split with direct monitor-design implications: late-fusion LLaVA concentrates reliability in a fragile late bottleneck (-8.3 pp object-identification accuracy after top-5 probe-neuron ablation), whereas early-fusion PaliGemma and Qwen2-VL distribute it widely and absorb destruction of ~50% of their peak-layer hidden dimension with <=1 pp degradation. The takeaway is narrow but consequential: in 3-7B VLMs, reliability is read more reliably off hidden-state geometry, layer-wise margin formation, and sparse late-layer circuits than off attention-map sharpness.

AI.tldr: 视觉语言模型的注意力图锐度与模型可靠性无关，可靠性应从隐藏状态几何和晚期层电路中读取。
AI.motivation: 挑战广泛存在的“注意力-置信度假设”，即认为注意力图越锐利（集中于查询区域），模型的回答越可信和校准。作者旨在直接验证注意力结构与模型正确性之间是否存在真实的关联。
AI.method: 提出VLM可靠性探针（VRP）这一统一的机制分析流水线，对三个开源VLM家族（LLaVA-1.5、PaliGemma、Qwen2-VL，3-7B参数）进行实验。通过对比注意力结构、生成动力学和隐藏状态几何与正确性标签的关系，并进行因果神经元消融实验。
AI.result: 发现三个关键结果：（i）注意力结构对正确性的预测能力接近于零（点二列相关系数≈0），尽管注意力对特征提取具有因果必要性；（ii）可靠性在计算后期变得可读，单隐藏状态线性探针AUROC>0.95，自一致性是最强的行为预测器；（iii）晚期融合架构的可靠性集中在脆弱瓶颈，而早期融合架构分布广泛且更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 在3-7B参数的VLM中，可靠性不能通过注意力图锐度来判断，而应从隐藏状态几何、层级边际形成和稀疏晚期层电路中更可靠地读取。这为VLM可靠性监控提供了明确的设计指导。

title: Reinforcement learning for inverse structural design and rapid laser cutting of kirigami prototypes
summary: Kirigami is an increasingly useful fabrication method to produce shape-programmable metamaterial structures. However, inverse design remains difficult because deployment is nonlinear, and feasible cut layouts must satisfy discrete compatibility rules, avoid overlap, and map one target shape to valid designs. We present RL-Kirigami, an inverse design framework that combines optimal-transport conditional flow matching (OT-CFM) with reinforcement learning to generate compatible ratio fields for compact reconfigurable parallelogram quad kirigami. A marching decoder enforces global geometric compatibility, and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) aligns the generator with nondifferentiable rewards for silhouette matching, feasibility, and ratio-field regularity. Across procedurally generated target shape instances, a single sample from the pretrained OT-CFM prior reached $94.2%$ sIoU and outperformed solver baselines while reducing forward simulator evaluations from hundreds to 1. GRPO improved accuracy to $94.91%$ sIoU and, with regularity included, reduced $\mathrm{TV}(\mathbf{x})$ from 0.95 to 0.81 while maintaining $94.83%$ sIoU. Generated layouts were exported to DXF and laser-cut in $50~μ\mathrm{m}$ polymeric sheets to produce deployable prototypes in $8.0 \pm 1.0$ minutes per part. These results support a manufacturing-aware inverse design workflow for deployable kirigami metamaterials under hard geometric feasibility constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RL-Kirigami框架，结合最优传输条件流匹配与强化学习，实现了平行四边形kirigami结构的逆向设计，在几何可行性约束下达到94.91%的轮廓匹配精度，并完成了物理原型制造验证。
AI.motivation: Kirigami作为一种形状可编程超材料的制造方法日益重要，但其逆向设计面临重大挑战：展开过程具有非线性特性，可行的切割布局必须满足离散兼容性规则、避免重叠，并将目标形状映射到有效设计。这些复杂的几何约束使得传统方法难以高效求解。
AI.method: 提出了RL-Kirigami逆向设计框架：1）采用最优传输条件流匹配（OT-CFM）结合强化学习生成兼容比率场；2）使用marching decoder强制执行全局几何兼容性；3）引入Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）将生成器与不可微奖励对齐，包括轮廓匹配、可行性和比率场正则性。该方法将前向模拟器评估次数从数百次减少到1次。
AI.result: 在程序化生成的目标形状实例上：单次OT-CFM先验采样达到94.2% sIoU，超越求解器基线；GRPO将精度提升至94.91% sIoU；引入正则性后，TV(x)从0.95降至0.81，同时保持94.83% sIoU。生成的布局导出为DXF格式并在50μm聚合物薄片上激光切割，每个零件制造时间为8.0±1.0分钟。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了制造感知的kirigami超材料逆向设计工作流程，在硬几何可行性约束下实现了有效设计。实验结果表明该方法在精度、效率和可制造性方面均表现优异，为可展开kirigami超材料的设计提供了有效解决方案。

title: A Reconfigurable Multiplier Architecture for Error-Resilient Applications in RISC-V Core
summary: Neural Networks (NNs) have been widely adopted due to their outstanding efficacy and adaptability across computer vision and deep learning applications. The optimization of NNs is necessary to enable their deployment on energy constrained embedded devices, where the limited available energy poses a significant challenge for efficient inference. This paper presents a runtime reconfigurable multiplier architecture integrated into the RISC-V core, targeting energy efficient neural network inference and edge AI applications. The proposed multiplier supports adaptability for exact and approximate computation with multiple configurable accuracy levels via a dedicated mulscr, enabling fine-grained energy accuracy control within a standard processor pipeline. The proposed design achieves 44%-52% and 62%-68% power reduction in exact and approximate modes respectively, while maintaining the computational performance of 1.89 DMIPS/MHz. Evaluations on error-tolerant workloads including 2d convolution and matrix multiplication demonstrate up to 63% reduction in energy consumption, with the proposed design achieving 1.21 pJ/instruction for matrix multiplication, confirming its effectiveness for energy-constrained edge AI deployments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种集成于RISC-V核心的运行时可重配置乘法器架构，支持精确与近似计算切换，在保持性能的同时显著降低能耗，适用于边缘AI部署。
AI.motivation: 神经网络在计算机视觉和深度学习领域应用广泛，但在能量受限的嵌入式设备上部署时，有限的能源供应对高效推理构成重大挑战，因此需要对神经网络进行优化以实现节能推理。
AI.method: 设计一种运行时可重配置的乘法器架构并集成到RISC-V处理器核心中，通过专用指令mulscr支持精确和近似计算的自适应切换，提供多种可配置精度级别，实现标准处理器流水线内的细粒度能效控制。
AI.result: 在精确模式下实现44%-52%的功耗降低，近似模式下实现62%-68%的功耗降低，同时保持1.89 DMIPS/MHz的计算性能；在容错工作负载（包括2D卷积和矩阵乘法）上实现高达63%的能耗降低，矩阵乘法运算能耗达到1.21 pJ/instruction。
AI.conclusion: 该设计有效解决了能量受限边缘AI部署中的能效问题，通过精确与近似计算的灵活配置实现了性能与能耗的最佳平衡，为边缘AI应用提供了可行的硬件优化方案。

title: Insider Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Consensus Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems where agents communicate in natural language to solve tasks jointly. A key capability in such systems is consensus formation, where agents iteratively exchange messages and update decisions to reach a shared outcome. However, most existing multi-agent LLM frameworks assume that all participating agents are aligned with the system objective. In practice, a malicious insider may participate as a legitimate member of the group while pursuing a hidden adversarial goal. In this work, we study insider manipulation in multi-agent LLM consensus systems. We formalize the problem as a sequential decision-making task in which a malicious agent seeks to delay or prevent agreement among benign agents. To make attack optimization tractable, we propose a world-model-based framework that learns surrogate dynamics over the latent behavioral states of benign agents and then trains an attacker using reinforcement learning based on this learned model. Preliminary results show that the trained attacker reduces the benign consensus rate and prolongs disagreement more effectively than the direct malicious-prompt baseline. These results suggest that combining latent world models with reinforcement learning is a promising direction for adaptive insider attacks in language-based multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体LLM系统中的内部威胁问题，提出了一种基于世界模型和强化学习的攻击框架，能够有效降低良性智能体达成共识的速率。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体LLM框架假设所有参与者都与系统目标一致，但在实际应用中，恶意内部人员可能伪装成合法成员追求隐藏的对抗目标。需要研究此类内部操纵对共识形成过程的威胁。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为序列决策任务，提出基于世界模型的框架：首先学习良性智能体潜在行为状态的代理动力学模型，然后基于该学习模型使用强化学习训练攻击者，优化攻击策略以延迟或阻止良性智能体达成协议。
AI.result: 训练后的攻击者比直接恶意提示基线更有效地降低了良性共识率并延长了分歧时间，初步结果验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将潜在世界模型与强化学习相结合是语言多智能体系统中自适应内部攻击的一个有前景的研究方向，揭示了多智能体LLM系统的安全脆弱性。

title: Scaling Mobile Agent Systems: From Capability Density to Collective Intelligence
summary: Mobile agent systems are emerging as a key paradigm for enabling intelligent applications on edge devices and in AIoT ecosystems. However, their scalability is fundamentally constrained by limited on-device computation and fragmented intelligence across devices. In this work, we propose a unified research agenda for scaling mobile agent systems along two complementary dimensions: (1) improving capability density of individual agents through compact foundation model design and compression, and (2) enabling collective intelligence via communication-rich multi-agent collaboration. Building on recent model and infrastructure advances, this vision aims to transform isolated mobile agents into a distributed intelligent system that is efficient and scalable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的移动智能体系统扩展研究议程，通过提升单智能体能力密度和促进多智能体协作来实现规模化。
AI.motivation: 移动智能体系统作为边缘设备和AIoT生态中智能应用的关键范式，其可扩展性受到设备端计算能力有限和设备间智能碎片化问题的根本性制约。
AI.method: 提出沿两个互补维度扩展移动智能体系统的统一研究议程：(1)通过紧凑的基础模型设计和压缩技术提升单个智能体的能力密度；(2)通过富通信的多智能体协作实现集体智能。
AI.result: 基于最近的模型和基础设施进展，提出了一种将孤立移动智能体转变为高效、可扩展的分布式智能系统的愿景。
AI.conclusion: 该研究议程旨在突破移动智能体系统的可扩展性瓶颈，实现从孤立智能体到分布式智能系统的转变，为AIoT生态系统提供高效且可扩展的智能解决方案。

title: LUDB++: Enabling LUDB for the Analysis of Shaped Feedforward FIFO Networks using Network Calculus
comment: Submitted to IEEE/ACM Transactions on Networking
summary: This paper discusses how latency guarantees for non-cyclic (feedforward) First-In-First-Out (FIFO) networks with shapers can be computed within the Network Calculus (NC) framework. Shapers are methods implemented in software or hardware and may reside inside the network and at the endpoint which constrain the rate and maximum packet sizes for the transmission of specific data streams (flows) or groups thereof. Shaping can improve latencies and is an important aspect of Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN). Several methods in NC exist to analyze FIFO networks. Among them is the Least Upper Delay Bound (LUDB) methodology. So far, LUDB does not incorporate shaping assumptions into its analysis. This paper addresses this gap resulting in the new methodology called LUDB++. The evaluation on a set of different line topologies and a tree topology with a total of 130 configurations shows that LUDB++ delivers more accurate latency bounds compared to LUDB. Moreover, the Exponential Linear Program (ELP) method, which considers FIFO and shaping inside the network, yields the most accurate bounds to this date. ELP is superseded by LUDB++ for most of cases by a margin of up to 9.13%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LUDB++方法，将整形器假设纳入网络演算中的最小上界延迟界限分析，在多数情况下比现有最准确的ELP方法精度提升高达9.13%。
AI.motivation: 现有最小上界延迟界限（LUDB）方法未将整形器假设纳入分析，而整形是时间敏感网络中改善延迟的重要手段。尽管ELP方法已考虑FIFO和整形，但仍存在提升空间，需要一种新的方法来获得更准确的延迟界限。
AI.method: 提出LUDB++方法，将整形器假设集成到网络演算框架中的LUDB分析中，用于分析带有整形器的非循环（前馈）FIFO网络。通过在130个配置（包括不同线路拓扑和树形拓扑）上进行评估，与LUDB和ELP方法进行比较。
AI.result: LUDB++相比LUDB提供更准确的延迟界限；在大多数情况下，LUDB++超越现有最准确的ELP方法，精度提升幅度高达9.13%。
AI.conclusion: LUDB++成功填补了LUDB方法在整形器分析方面的空白，为时间敏感网络中的延迟界限计算提供了更准确的工具，在多数实际场景中成为新的最优方法。

title: Spatial Priming Outperforms Semantic Prompting: A Grid-Based Approach to Improving LLM Accuracy on Chart Data Extraction
comment: his is the version of the article accepted for publication in SUMMA 2025 after peer review. The final, published version is available at IEEE Xplore: https://doi.org/10.1109/SUMMA68668.2025.11302248
summary: The automated extraction of data from scientific charts is a critical task for large-scale literature analysis. While multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise, their accuracy on non-standardized charts remains a challenge. This raises a key research question: what is the most effective strategy to improve model performance (high-level semantic priming) or low-level spatial priming? This paper presents a comparative investigation into these two distinct strategies. We describe our exploratory experiments with semantic methods, such as a two-stage metadata-first framework and Chain-of-Thought, which failed to produce a statistically significant improvement. In contrast, we present a simple but highly effective spatial priming method: overlaying a coordinate grid onto the chart image before analysis. Our quantitative experiment on a synthetic dataset demonstrates that this grid-based approach provides a statistically significant reduction in data extraction error (SMAPE reduced from 25.5% to 19.5%, p < 0.05) compared to a baseline. We conclude that for the current generation of multimodal models, providing explicit spatial context is a more effective and reliable strategy than high-level semantic guidance for this class of tasks.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态大语言模型从非标准化科学图表中提取数据的任务，本文通过对比研究发现：高层语义引导策略未能显著提升性能，而简单的空间引导策略（在图表上叠加坐标网格）能显著降低数据提取误差（SMAPE从25.5%降至19.5%），证明提供显式空间上下文是当前更有效的方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态大语言模型在科学图表数据自动提取方面展现出潜力，但在处理非标准化图表时准确性仍面临挑战。核心研究动机在于探究提升模型性能的最有效策略：究竟是采用高层语义引导还是低层空间引导。
AI.method: 本文采用对比研究方法，系统比较了两种不同的性能提升策略：1）语义方法，包括两阶段元数据优先框架和思维链技术；2）空间引导方法，即在图表图像分析前叠加坐标网格。研究使用合成数据集进行定量实验，并通过统计分析评估各种策略的效果。
AI.result: 实验结果显示：语义引导方法（两阶段框架和思维链）未能产生统计学上显著的性能改进。相反，基于网格的空间引导方法实现了统计学上显著的数据提取误差降低，对称平均绝对百分比误差（SMAPE）从基线的25.5%降至19.5%（p < 0.05），证明该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 对于当前一代多模态模型，在科学图表数据提取这类任务中，提供显式空间上下文（如坐标网格）是比高层语义引导更有效、更可靠的策略。这一发现为改进多模态模型在视觉数据分析任务中的表现提供了重要的实践指导。

title: Path-Based Gradient Boosting for Graph-Level Prediction
summary: We propose PathBoost, a gradient tree boosting method for graph-level classification and regression that learns discriminative path-based features directly from the input graph structure. Building on a previous work, which was tailored to a specific chemistry application, PathBoost introduces three key extensions: (i) adaptation to binary classification through gradient boosting with a logistic loss, (ii) incorporation of multiple node and edge attributes into the path feature space via a prefix-based decomposition, and (iii) automatic anchor node selection based on categorical attribute diversity, eliminating the need for the user to specify the starting point of the considered path features. We compared PathBoost to graph neural networks and graph kernel approaches on several benchmark datasets, obtaining better results in half of them, and comparable results in the rest. PathBoost shows better performances on graphs with larger average node counts. Overall, the results demonstrate that path-based boosting methods can be competitive with more complex black-box approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出PathBoost方法，通过学习基于路径的特征进行图级别分类和回归，在基准数据集上表现优异，尤其在节点数较多的图上性能更佳。
AI.motivation: 基于先前针对特定化学应用的工作，PathBoost旨在扩展其适用范围，解决图级别分类和回归任务中的特征学习问题，提供一种能与传统图神经网络和图核方法竞争的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出PathBoost梯度树提升方法，引入三个关键扩展：(i) 通过逻辑损失的梯度提升适应二分类；(ii) 通过基于前缀的分解将多种节点和边属性纳入路径特征空间；(iii) 基于分类属性多样性的自动锚节点选择，消除用户指定路径特征起始点的需求。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上与图神经网络和图核方法进行比较，PathBoost在一半数据集上获得更优结果，其余数据集上表现相当。在平均节点数较多的图上表现更佳，证明了基于路径的提升方法可以与复杂的黑盒方法竞争。
AI.conclusion: 基于路径的提升方法能够与更复杂的黑盒方法（如图神经网络）竞争，为图级别分类和回归任务提供了一种有效的替代方案，尤其在处理较大规模图时具有优势。

title: HyDRA: Deadline and Reuse-Aware Cacheability for Hardware Accelerators
comment: 21 pages, 20 figures, Accepted for publication to IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems (IEEE TCAD)
summary: The system-level cache is a critical resource shared by processor cores and domain-specific accelerators in heterogeneous systems on chips (SoCs). The strict QoS requirements of accelerators, such as deadlines, can lead to severe performance degradation of processor cores. Thus, managing the shared cache efficiently between cores and accelerators becomes crucial. State-of-the-art cache management techniques perform reuse-aware bypassing of accesses from cores with the help of reuse predictors to improve performance. However, architectural differences between accelerators and processor cores (often associated with deep cache hierarchies) can lead to significantly different reuse patterns at the shared cache. We propose a novel clustering-based methodology, LERN, for learning and predicting the reuse behavior of hardware accelerators at the shared cache. We then propose a deadline and reuse-aware cache management strategy, HyDRA, which explores a novel tradeoff between reuse and deadline awareness for performance efficiency. It uses LERN to dynamically predict the reuse behavior of the accelerator accesses and make bypass decisions to maximize the system throughput while meeting accelerator deadlines. We evaluate HyDRA across different workloads and varied accelerator configurations. It significantly improves the system performance and reduces the accelerator deadline miss rate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LERN预测方法和HyDRA管理策略，通过学习硬件加速器的重用行为模式，在共享缓存中实现性能与截止期限的平衡优化。
AI.motivation: 在异构SoC中，共享系统级缓存的处理器核心与加速器之间存在资源竞争。加速器严格的QoS要求（如截止期限）会导致处理器核心性能严重下降。现有的缓存管理技术利用重用预测器进行核心访问的旁路处理，但加速器与处理器核心的架构差异导致在共享缓存处表现出显著不同的重用模式，使得现有技术难以有效适用。
AI.method: 提出了两个核心技术：1）LERN（Learning-based Reuse predictioN），一种基于聚类的方法，用于学习和预测硬件加速器在共享缓存处的重用行为；2）HyDRA（Deadline and Reuse-Aware cache management），一种截止期限与重用感知的缓存管理策略，探索重用与截止期限感知之间的新颖权衡，利用LERN动态预测加速器访问的重用行为并做出旁路决策。
AI.result: HyDRA在不同工作负载和各种加速器配置下进行了评估，实验结果表明其显著提升了系统性能，同时降低了加速器的截止期限缺失率。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习加速器特有的重用行为模式并结合截止期限感知，HyDRA成功实现了共享缓存资源在处理器核心与加速器之间的优化分配，在保证加速器实时性要求的同时最大化系统吞吐量。

title: SceneFactory: GPU-Accelerated Multi-Agent Driving Simulation with Physics-Based Vehicle Dynamics
summary: Autonomous-driving simulators typically trade physical fidelity for scalable parallelism. Physics-based platforms such as CARLA and MetaDrive provide articulated vehicle dynamics and contact, but their non-vectorized interfaces make batched training difficult. GPU-batched systems such as Waymax and GPUDrive scale to hundreds of scenarios by replacing rigid-body physics with simplified kinematic models, omitting tire--road interaction, suspension, contact dynamics, and road-condition-dependent friction. We introduce SceneFactory, a GPU-vectorized platform for procedural scene construction, physics-based multi-agent simulation, and RL in autonomous-driving environments. Built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim + Isaac Lab, SceneFactory represents worlds and agents as batched tensors: control, observations, rewards, resets, and policy inference run as GPU tensor operations over the Isaac Lab tensor API. SceneFactory converts Waymo Open Motion Dataset road topologies into simulation-ready USD worlds, runs many worlds concurrently on one GPU, populates each with multiple articulated PhysX vehicles, and maps precipitation and road-surface type to PhysX material friction coefficients. With GPU vectorization, SceneFactory achieves up to 127$\times$ higher throughput than a non-vectorized PhysX baseline on the same GPU and physics solver, reaching 19,250 controlled-agent simulation steps per second at 256 worlds $\times$ 16 agents. Cross-simulator transfer reveals an asymmetric dynamics gap: physics-grounded RL policies transfer to a simplified kinematic bicycle model with 99.5% success, whereas reverse transfer drops to 47.3%. Under wet-road friction, friction-aware policies reduce mean peak DRAC from 58.7 to 27.8,m/s$^2$ without sacrificing goal reach. SceneFactory shows that scalable autonomous-driving training need not discard articulated rigid-body dynamics or physically grounded road-condition variation.

AI.tldr: SceneFactory是一个GPU向量化的自动驾驶仿真平台，在保持物理真实性的同时实现了127倍的吞吐量提升，证明了可扩展训练不需要牺牲刚体动力学或道路条件物理变化。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶仿真器存在权衡：基于物理的平台（如CARLA）提供精确的车辆动力学但难以批量化训练；GPU批处理系统（如Waymax）可扩展但简化了物理模型，忽略了轮胎-道路交互、悬架、接触动力学和道路摩擦等关键因素。
AI.method: 基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim和Isaac Lab构建GPU向量化平台，将世界和智能体表示为批处理张量；将Waymo开放运动数据集的道路拓扑转换为仿真就绪的USD世界；在单个GPU上并发运行多个世界，每个世界包含多个铰接式PhysX车辆；将降水和路面类型映射到PhysX材料摩擦系数。
AI.result: 相比非向量化PhysX基线实现127倍吞吐量提升，在256个世界×16个智能体配置下达到每秒19,250个受控智能体仿真步；跨仿真器迁移实验显示不对称动力学差距：基于物理的RL策略迁移到简化运动学自行车模型成功率达99.5%，而反向迁移仅47.3%；湿滑路面条件下，摩擦感知策略将平均峰值DRAC从58.7降至27.8 m/s²。
AI.conclusion: SceneFactory证明了可扩展的自动驾驶训练不需要放弃铰接刚体动力学或物理基础的道路条件变化，实现了物理真实性和可扩展性的统一。

title: OrbitBFT: Enabling Scalable and Robust BFT Consensus in LEO Constellations
summary: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations are evolving from communication relays into autonomous platforms operating in increasingly congested and contested environments. Since uplinks to ground stations can be severed or jammed, ensuring reliable coordination among satellites requires autonomous Byzantine Fault-Tolerant (BFT) consensus. However, applying conventional BFT protocols to LEO constellations is challenging due to their dynamic topology, sparse connectivity, and limited communication bandwidth. In this paper, we present OrbitBFT, a novel two-stage hierarchical BFT consensus protocol tailored to the unique characteristics of LEO constellations. First, OrbitBFT exploits the topological stability within orbital planes to partition the constellation and perform localized intra-plane consensus, which reduces communication overhead. Second, we design a Byzantine-resilient bypass mechanism and a hop-by-hop transmission protocol to ensure reliable message delivery and mitigate congestion, even in the presence of adversarial behavior. Third, we adapt and optimize PBFT and HotStuff to the LEO context, achieving linear message complexity while preserving safety and liveness. Extensive evaluations in a realistic Starlink-based simulation demonstrate that OrbitBFT significantly improves scalability, throughput, and latency compared to its original designs, making it a practical and efficient BFT solution for large-scale satellite networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OrbitBFT，一种面向大规模低地球轨道(LEO)卫星星座的两阶段分层拜占庭容错共识协议，通过利用轨道路面内的拓扑稳定性进行局部共识，并结合抗拜占庭旁路机制，在动态拓扑和有限带宽环境下显著提升了可扩展性、吞吐量和延迟性能。
AI.motivation: LEO卫星星座正从通信中继演变为在日益拥挤和对抗环境中运行的自主平台。由于上行链路可能被切断或干扰，需要自主的拜占庭容错(BFT)共识来确保卫星间可靠协调。然而，传统的BFT协议难以应用于LEO星座，因为其具有动态拓扑、稀疏连接和有限通信带宽等独特特征。
AI.method: 提出OrbitBFT两阶段分层BFT共识协议：1) 利用轨道路面内的拓扑稳定性对星座进行分区，执行局部化路面内共识以减少通信开销；2) 设计抗拜占庭旁路机制和逐跳传输协议，确保可靠的消息传递并缓解拥塞，即使在对抗行为存在的情况下；3) 改进和优化PBFT和HotStuff以适应LEO环境，在保持安全性和活跃性的同时实现线性消息复杂度。
AI.result: 在基于Starlink的真实仿真环境中进行了广泛评估，结果表明OrbitBFT相比原始设计在可扩展性、吞吐量和延迟方面均有显著改善，证明了其作为大规模卫星网络实用高效BFT解决方案的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OrbitBFT成功解决了LEO卫星星座中传统BFT协议的适用性挑战，通过分层设计和抗拜占庭机制实现了高效可靠的共识，为大规模自主卫星网络提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Locational Pricing for Generative-AI Services via Token-Flow Market Clearing
summary: GenAI services are in an early yet fast expanding phase. Providers compete on model capability and service quality, while the underlying infrastructure remains expensive and heterogeneous across regions, workloads, and compute assets. If these services diffuse into routine daily use, the relevant engineering problem becomes not only better models but also efficient dispatch on a geographically distributed AI service infrastructure. To address this, we formulate a network-constrained token-flow market that clears AI workloads across compute nodes and communication links. The baseline model is a linear program that co-optimizes routing and processing subject to compute-capacity and bandwidth constraints; its dual variables define location- and workload-specific marginal service prices. We further introduce a transfer-aware extension that prices data movement in physical units and isolates bandwidth congestion rents. In a 5-node U.S. case study, the transfer-aware model uncovers four saturated backbone links and raises total operating cost by 2.7\% relative to the token-equivalent baseline, while tightening the chatbot latency limit from 100~ms to 15~ms increases one locational price by 117\%. A 20-node scale-up exhibits the same merit-order dispatch logic and becomes infeasible once demand exceeds aggregate capacity. These results suggest that locational pricing is a useful organizing principle for operating an emerging AI service infrastructure and, over time, for designing competitive markets around it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种网络约束的Token流市场模型，用于解决地理分布式AI服务基础设施的高效调度与定价问题，发现位置定价可有效指导基础设施运营。
AI.motivation: GenAI服务正处于快速扩张期，但底层基础设施在区域、工作负载和计算资产间存在异构性且成本高昂。随着服务日常化，核心工程问题从单纯提升模型能力扩展到如何在地理分布式AI服务基础设施上实现高效调度。
AI.method: 构建网络约束的Token流市场模型。基础模型是一个线性规划，在计算容量和带宽约束下联合优化路由与处理；其对偶变量定义了位置和工作负载特定的边际服务价格。进一步引入转移感知扩展模型，对数据移动定价并隔离带宽拥堵租金。
AI.result: 在5节点美国案例中，转移感知模型发现4条骨干链路饱和，总运营成本比Token等效基准高2.7%；将聊天机器人延迟限制从100ms收紧至15ms会使某位置价格上涨117%。20节点扩展实验验证了相同的边际顺序调度逻辑，且需求超过总容量时模型不可行。
AI.conclusion: 位置定价可作为运营新兴AI服务基础设施的有益组织原则，并长期为设计竞争性市场提供基础。

title: Auto-Rubric as Reward: From Implicit Preferences to Explicit Multimodal Generative Criteria
summary: Aligning multimodal generative models with human preferences demands reward signals that respect the compositional, multi-dimensional structure of human judgment. Prevailing RLHF approaches reduce this structure to scalar or pairwise labels, collapsing nuanced preferences into opaque parametric proxies and exposing vulnerabilities to reward hacking. While recent Rubrics-as-Reward (RaR) methods attempt to recover this structure through explicit criteria, generating rubrics that are simultaneously reliable, scalable, and data-efficient remains an open problem. We introduce Auto-Rubric as Reward (ARR), a framework that reframes reward modeling from implicit weight optimization to explicit, criteria-based decomposition. Before any pairwise comparison, ARR externalizes a VLM's internalized preference knowledge as prompt-specific rubrics, translating holistic intent into independently verifiable quality dimensions. This conversion of implicit preference structure into inspectable, interpretable constraints substantially suppresses evaluation biases including positional bias, enabling both zero-shot deployment and few-shot conditioning on minimal supervision. To extend these gains into generative training, we propose Rubric Policy Optimization (RPO), which distills ARR's structured multi-dimensional evaluation into a robust binary reward, replacing opaque scalar regression with rubric-conditioned preference decisions that stabilize policy gradients. On text-to-image generation and image editing benchmarks, ARR-RPO outperforms pairwise reward models and VLM judges, demonstrating that explicitly externalizing implicit preference knowledge into structured rubrics achieves more reliable, data-efficient multimodal alignment, revealing that the bottleneck is the absence of a factorized interface, not a deficit of knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出Auto-Rubric as Reward (ARR)框架，将VLM内隐的偏好知识外显化为可检验的评分细则，并联合Rubric Policy Optimization (RPO)进行训练，在文本生成图像与图像编辑任务上优于成对奖励模型与VLM评判器。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态生成模型对齐方法（如RLHF）将复杂多维的人类偏好简化为标量或成对标签，导致偏好结构坍塌、易受奖励黑客攻击；虽有基于准则的方法尝试恢复结构，但难以兼顾可靠性、可扩展性与数据效率。
AI.method: ARR框架在成对比较前，先将VLM内隐的偏好知识外显化为针对提示的评分细则，将整体意图分解为独立可验证的质量维度；RPO进一步将结构化多维评估蒸馏为鲁棒的二元奖励，以评分细则条件化的偏好决策替代不透明的标量回归。
AI.result: 在文本生成图像与图像编辑基准上，ARR-RPO优于成对奖励模型与VLM评判器；实验表明，瓶颈在于缺乏可分解的接口而非知识缺失。
AI.conclusion: 通过将内隐偏好知识外显为结构化评分细则，可实现对齐更可靠、数据效率更高的多模态生成模型，显著抑制位置偏差等评估偏差，并支持零样本部署与小样本条件化。

title: Distributional Reinforcement Learning via the Cramér Distance
summary: This paper explores the application of the Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) algorithm within a Distributional Reinforcement Learning setting and introduces an implementation of such algorithm named Cramér-based Distributional Soft Actor-Critic (C-DSAC). The novel approach employs distributional reinforcement learning to represent state-action values, and minimizes the squared Cramér distance for learning the distribution. Empirical results across various robotic benchmarks indicate that our algorithm surpasses the performance of baseline SAC and contemporary distributional methods, with the performance advantage becoming increasingly pronounced in high-complexity environments. To explain the efficiency of the new approach, we conduct an analysis showing that its superior performance is partly due to \textit{confidence-driven} Q-value updates: High-variance target distributions (low confidence in target) lead to more conservative model updates, thereby attenuating the impact of overestimated values. This work deepens the understanding of distributional reinforcement learning, offering insights into the algorithmic mechanisms governing convergence and value estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出了C-DSAC算法，将SAC扩展到分布强化学习框架，通过最小化Cramér距离学习价值分布，性能优于基线SAC和现有分布方法，在高复杂环境中优势更明显。
AI.motivation: 探索Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）算法在分布强化学习中的应用潜力，通过分布表示状态-动作价值以提升性能。
AI.method: 提出了Cramér-based Distributional Soft Actor-Critic（C-DSAC）算法，使用分布强化学习表示状态-动作价值，并通过最小化平方Cramér距离来学习分布。
AI.result: 在多个机器人基准测试中，C-DSAC的性能超越了基线SAC和现有的分布强化学习方法，且在高复杂度环境中优势更加显著。算法性能优越的部分原因在于"置信度驱动"的Q值更新机制：高方差目标分布（低置信度）会导致更保守的模型更新，从而缓解过估计值的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该研究加深了对分布强化学习的理解，揭示了影响算法收敛和价值估计的机制，为算法设计提供了新见解。

title: 31.1 A 14.08-to-135.69Token/s ReRAM-on-Logic Stacked Outlier-Free Large-Language-Model Accelerator with Block-Clustered Weight-Compression and Adaptive Parallel-Speculative-Decoding
summary: This work presents a 55nm speculative decoding-based LLM accelerator with bumping-based face-to-face ReRAM-on-logic stacking technology. It features a local rotation unit for outlier-free low-bit quantization, a stacking-aware PNM architecture co-designed with blockwise vector quantization to reduce weight EMA overheads, and an adaptive parallel speculative decoding scheme with an out-of-order scheduler for high resource and bandwidth utilization. Our chip achieves 14.08-to-135.69token/s and 4.46-to-7.17x speedup over vanilla speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一款基于55nm工艺的推测解码LLM加速器，采用基于凸块的面对面ReRAM-on-逻辑堆叠技术，实现了14.08-135.69 token/s的吞吐量和相比普通推测解码4.46-7.17倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）规模的增长，推理速度和能效成为关键瓶颈。现有方案在量化精度、权重访问开销以及推测解码的资源利用率方面存在不足，亟需一种能够同时解决低比特量化、存储墙限制和并行解码效率问题的硬件加速方案。
AI.method: 该加速器集成了三项核心技术：1）局部旋转单元，用于实现无异常值的低比特量化；2）与块向量量化协同设计的堆叠感知PNM（Processing-near-Memory）架构，以降低权重的EMA（指数移动平均）开销；3）结合乱序调度器的自适应并行推测解码方案，以提高资源和带宽利用率。硬件上采用基于凸块的面对面ReRAM-on-逻辑堆叠技术实现高密度集成。
AI.result: 在55nm工艺下成功流片，实现了14.08至135.69 token/s的推理吞吐量。与普通推测解码方案相比，该加速器达到了4.46倍至7.17倍的加速比，验证了所提架构在性能提升方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过ReRAM-on-逻辑堆叠技术、量化优化和推测解码硬件协同设计，该工作有效解决了LLM推理中的关键瓶颈，为大模型高效部署提供了一种高性能、高能效的硬件加速解决方案。

title: Too Many Specialists: Emergent Inefficiencies and Bottlenecks for Multi-agent Ad-hoc Collaboration
comment: Published in Proceedings of Proc. of the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026)
summary: Computational models of collaboration without prior coordination often overlook how heterogeneous agent traits and complex task structures jointly produce systemic bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and contribution inequalities. We address this by using an agent-based model of ad-hoc teamwork in a kitchen environment. Our model integrates diverse agent personas with tasks that combine serial and parallel dependencies. We identify a specialist's dilemma, where rigid role assertion generates system-level bottlenecks, amplifies workload inequality, and fosters fragmented, homophilous networks. We also find that team size and communication overhead interact with problem structure to generate diminishing returns and redundant collaboration. Linking micro-level behavior to macro-level outcomes provides insights into emergent collaboration and design principles for effective multi-agent teamwork.

AI.tldr: 本文通过基于智能体的模型研究无预先协调的协作，发现“专家困境”导致系统瓶颈、工作不平等和同质化网络，团队规模和沟通开销会引发收益递减。
AI.motivation: 现有的无预先协调协作计算模型往往忽视了异质化智能体特征与复杂任务结构如何共同产生系统瓶颈、低效和贡献不平等问题。
AI.method: 构建一个厨房环境下临时团队合作的基于智能体的模型，整合多样化的智能体角色与串并行依赖相结合的任务结构。
AI.result: 识别出“专家困境”，即僵化的角色坚持会导致系统级瓶颈、加剧工作负载不平等并形成碎片化的同质网络；同时发现团队规模和沟通开销与问题结构相互作用，产生收益递减和冗余协作。
AI.conclusion: 将微观行为与宏观结果联系起来，为涌现性协作提供了深入见解，并为有效的多智能体协作提供了设计原则。

title: Intelligent Autonomous Orchestration for Distributed Cloud Resources using Complex-Stability Analysis
summary: In modern distributed cloud environments, efficient resource allocation is required as traditional scaling mechanisms are often subject to cloud thrashing due to network-induced latencies. In this paper, we propose C-SAS (Complex-Stability Aware Scaling), an intelligent autonomous orchestration framework that leverages complex analytic methods to achieve system-wide equilibrium. In contrast to heuristic-based models, C-SAS acts as a stability-aware agent, converting telemetry noise into a deterministic "Safety Envelope" on the $s$-plane using the Argument Principle and Rouché's Theorem. The algorithm smartly suppresses oscillatory scaling operations that would otherwise degrade performance, by computing a real-time Analytic Stability Index (ASI). The experimental results show that C-SAS reduces VM flapping by 94\%, and achieves 96\% resource efficiency, significantly outperforming standard PID and ML-based autonomous agents. Our results suggest that future resilient autonomous cloud infrastructures will require AI-driven orchestrators with built-in formal stability constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了C-SAS框架，一种基于复分析的智能自主编排方法，通过将遥测噪声转化为确定性的安全包络，有效解决了云环境中的资源振荡问题，显著降低了虚拟机抖动并提高了资源效率。
AI.motivation: 现代分布式云环境中，传统的扩展机制由于网络延迟常常导致云抖动（cloud thrashing）现象，启发式模型难以有效控制系统稳定性，因此需要一种具备形式化稳定性约束的智能资源分配方法。
AI.method: 提出C-SAS（Complex-Stability Aware Scaling）框架，利用复分析方法（Argument Principle和Rouché定理）将遥测噪声转化为s平面上的确定性"安全包络"（Safety Envelope）；通过计算实时解析稳定性指标（ASI），智能抑制振荡性扩展操作，实现系统级平衡。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：C-SAS将虚拟机抖动（VM flapping）降低94%，资源效率达到96%，显著优于标准PID控制器和基于机器学习的自主代理方法。
AI.conclusion: 未来具有弹性的自主云基础设施需要具备内置形式化稳定性约束的AI驱动编排器，C-SAS为构建稳定可靠的云资源管理系统提供了新思路。

title: Semantics-Aware Communication:A Differentiated Allocation Perspective
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: We study the joint optimization of timeliness and reliability in semantics-aware Wireless Networked Control Systems (WNCS) under computation resource constraints. The sampled data are categorized into regular and critical tasks based on the semantic states, facilitating differentiated resource allocation. Task-aware Age of Actuation (AoA) and Cost of Missing Actuation (CoMA), are used to characterize the task-level freshness and the reliability penalty of missed actuations, respectively. By modeling the controller as a discrete-time multi-rate Geo/D/C/C queue, we evaluate the performance of regular and critical tasks, the latter imposing higher computational demands. Results confirm that differentiated resource allocation across heterogeneous tasks effectively guarantees the actuation reliability of critical tasks in severely constrained environments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语义感知无线网络控制系统（WNCS）在计算资源受限条件下的时效性与可靠性联合优化，通过区分常规与关键任务实现差异化资源分配，有效保障了关键任务的执行可靠性。
AI.motivation: 在计算资源严重受限的无线网络控制系统中，如何在保证时效性的同时确保关键任务的可靠性是一个重要挑战。传统的无差别资源分配策略难以满足异构任务的差异化需求，因此需要设计一种能够根据语义状态区分任务优先级的资源分配机制。
AI.method: 首先基于语义状态将采样数据分类为常规任务和关键任务，实现差异化资源分配；其次，提出任务感知的执行年龄（AoA）和执行缺失代价（CoMA）两个指标，分别表征任务级新鲜度和执行缺失的可靠性惩罚；最后，将控制器建模为离散时间多速率Geo/D/C/C排队系统，评估不同类型任务的性能表现。
AI.result: 实验结果证实，在计算资源严重受限的环境下，针对异构任务的差异化资源分配策略能够有效保障关键任务的执行可靠性，证明了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，基于语义感知的任务分类与差异化资源分配机制能够在资源受限的无线网络控制系统中实现时效性与可靠性的联合优化，为保障关键任务的可靠执行提供了有效解决方案。

title: Embeddings for Preferences, Not Semantics
summary: Modern AI is opening the door to collective decision-making in which participants express their views as free-form text rather than voting on a fixed set of candidates. A natural idea is to embed these opinions in a vector space so that the substantial literature on facility location problems and fair clustering can be brought to bear. But standard text embeddings measure semantic similarity, whereas distances in facility location problems and fair clustering require what we call \textit{preferential similarity}: a participant's agreement with a piece of text should be inversely related to their distance from it. Off-the-shelf embeddings inherit a coarse preference signal through a correlation between semantic and preferential similarity, but fail to capture preferences when the correlation breaks. We formalize this as an invariance problem: text embedding models encode both a preference-relevant signal (stance and values) and semantic nuisance (style and wording), and the two are observationally correlated, so a geometry that relies on nuisance can appear preference-correct even when it is not. We show that synthetic training data designed to break this correlation provably shifts the optimal scorer away from nuisance-dominated cosine and significantly improves preference prediction across 11 online deliberation datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种利用合成训练数据解耦语义干扰与偏好信号的新方法，显著提升了基于文本嵌入的集体决策中偏好预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现代AI使集体决策可以基于自由文本而非固定选项，一个自然的想法是将文本嵌入向量空间以利用设施选址和公平聚类的理论。然而，标准文本嵌入测量的是语义相似性，而集体决策需要的是“偏好相似性”（参与者对文本的认同度应与距离成反比）。现有嵌入因语义与偏好的相关性而包含粗略的偏好信号，但当相关性失效时则无法准确捕捉偏好。
AI.method: 将此问题形式化为不变性问题：文本嵌入模型同时编码了偏好相关信号（立场与价值观）和语义干扰（风格与措辞），两者观测相关，导致依赖干扰的几何结构可能错误地看起来符合偏好。作者构建了专门设计以打破这种相关性的合成训练数据，迫使模型学习更纯粹的偏好表示，从而将最优评分器从受干扰主导的余弦相似度转移。
AI.result: 该方法在11个在线协商数据集上显著提升了偏好预测的准确性。研究表明合成数据能证明性地将最优评分器从受语义干扰主导的度量转向更准确的偏好度量。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦语义干扰与偏好信号，能够构建更适合集体决策的文本嵌入空间。这为基于自由文本表达的集体决策系统奠定了更可靠的技术基础。

title: Geometry-free prediction of inertial lift forces in microfluidic devices using deep learning
summary: Inertial microfluidic devices (IMDs) offer low-cost, high-throughput alternative techniques for many traditional particle- (or cell-) manipulation tasks, but simulating them requires being able to predict particle migration, and thus particle lift forces, under a variety of possible channel geometries. Recent work has demonstrated that machine learning models can be used to drastically speed up these numerical simulations, but doing so required training individual models for every unique channel cross-section type (e.g., rectangular, triangular) -- shifting the burden from the simulation step to the training step. In this paper, we develop a novel approach for predicting particle lift forces that contains no explicit geometric parameters. We train a neural network model using a new parameter set and show that while it performs comparably to existing models on channel geometries in the training set, it is able to generalize to unseen channel geometries far more effectively. We show that the lift force model developed herein can be easily transferred to particle tracing simulation software, where it is capable of predicting particle migration patterns consistent with the literature across a variety of channel designs.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种不依赖显式几何参数的神经网络模型，用于预测惯性微流控器件中的粒子升力，能够有效泛化到训练集中未见过的通道几何形状。
AI.motivation: 现有的惯性微流控器件数值模拟需要针对每种独特的通道截面类型（如矩形、三角形）训练单独的机器学习模型，这使得计算负担从模拟步骤转移到了训练步骤，缺乏泛化能力。
AI.method: 开发了一种新的神经网络方法，使用不包含显式几何参数的新参数集来预测粒子升力，并将其集成到粒子追踪模拟软件中。
AI.result: 新模型在训练集内的通道几何形状上性能与现有模型相当，但在未见过的通道几何形状上泛化能力显著更强；模拟预测的粒子迁移模式与文献结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 该不依赖显式几何参数的升力模型实现了对多种通道设计的有效泛化，为惯性微流控器件的低成本、高通量模拟提供了更通用的解决方案。

title: Emerging 2D Materials for Beyond von Neumann Computing: A Perspective
summary: The end of conventional Dennard scaling and the widening gap between memory bandwidth and arithmetic throughput have made the von Neumann partition a structural bottleneck rather than a transient one. Two-dimensional (2D) materials, with atomically thin geometries, electrically tunable carrier densities, and large optical responses, offer a unified platform on which to build devices that compute where they store, process events rather than clock cycles, and shift workload into the optical domain. This perspective surveys progress along three converging thrusts, graphene and graphene nanoribbon transistors as scalable channel materials, oxide and 2D-integrated memristors for in-memory analog compute, and silicon-compatible 2D photonic and thermal-emitter structures for optical computing primitives. Our central argument is that the 2D-materials community has spent a decade producing record devices, and the next decade will be decided by who first integrates three of them on a single semiconductor wafer.

AI.tldr: 二维材料为突破冯·诺依曼瓶颈提供了统一平台，未来十年的关键在于谁能率先在单一半导体晶圆上集成晶体管、忆阻器和光子器件这三种核心器件。
AI.motivation: 传统Dennard缩放的终结以及存储带宽与算术吞吐量之间日益扩大的差距，使得冯·诺依曼架构成为计算系统的结构性瓶颈，亟需新的材料与架构方案来突破这一限制。
AI.method: 综述了三个汇聚方向的研究进展：1) 石墨烯和石墨烯纳米带晶体管作为可扩展沟道材料；2) 氧化物和二维集成忆阻器用于存内模拟计算；3) 硅兼容的二维光子和热发射结构用于光学计算基元。
AI.result: 二维材料凭借原子级薄几何结构、可电调控载流子密度和巨大光学响应特性，构建了一个统一平台，能够实现"存储即计算"、事件驱动而非时钟周期驱动，以及将工作负载转移至光学域。
AI.conclusion: 二维材料领域在过去十年创造了众多记录级器件，下一个十年的竞争焦点将取决于谁能率先在单个半导体晶圆上集成上述三种核心器件，实现真正的系统级突破。

title: Slipstream: Trajectory-Grounded Compaction Validation for Long-Horizon Agents
comment: 9 pages (16 pages counting references, appendix), 6 figures, 2 tables
summary: To cope with the large contexts that long-horizon LLM agents produce, modern frameworks increasingly rely on compaction -- invoking an LLM to rewrite the accumulated trajectory into a shorter summary that the agent resumes from. Today, compaction runs synchronously on the critical path of agent execution but this can unpredictably degrade accuracy due to a structural validation gap: the compactor must condense context but is fundamentally unaware of precisely what information the agent will need later. Further, because post-compaction agent steps are conditioned on the new summary, targeted validation criteria do not exist and errors silently propagate through coherent but incorrect behavior. Our key insight is that asynchronous compaction efficiently addresses this gap: by running the compactor in parallel with continued agent execution on the original context, the candidate summary and the agent's next steps are generated independently from the same pre-compaction state, yielding a validation signal independent of the summary itself. We build Slipstream, a trajectory-grounded compaction system that uses a judge to validate the candidate summary against the agent's continued reasoning, checking that it preserves both the agent's forward intent and the key facts and constraints it depends on. Across long-horizon coding (SWE-bench Verified) and web-browsing (BrowseComp) workloads, Slipstream improves task accuracy by up to 8.8 percentage points while reducing end-to-end latency by up to 39.7%.

AI.tldr: 提出Slipstream系统，通过异步压缩解决长视野LLM代理中同步压缩导致的信息丢失问题，在提升任务准确率的同时显著降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现代长视野LLM代理框架依赖压缩来处理大上下文，但同步压缩在关键路径上运行，压缩器无法预知代理后续所需信息，存在结构性验证缺口；压缩后的错误会通过连贯但错误的行为静默传播。
AI.method: 提出异步压缩机制：压缩器与代理执行并行运行，从相同的压缩前状态独立生成候选摘要和代理后续步骤，产生独立于摘要本身的验证信号。构建Slipstream系统，使用评判器根据代理的持续推理验证候选摘要，检查其是否保留代理的前向意图及关键事实和约束。
AI.result: 在长视野编码任务（SWE-bench Verified）和网页浏览任务（BrowseComp）上，任务准确率提升最高达8.8个百分点，端到端延迟降低最高达39.7%。
AI.conclusion: 异步压缩通过并行执行和轨迹引导验证有效解决了同步压缩的验证缺口问题，在保证压缩效率的同时提升了代理任务的准确性和可靠性。

title: On defining and modeling context-awareness
summary:
Purpose - This paper presents a methodology for defining and modeling context-awareness and describing efficiently the interactions between systems, applications and their context. Also the relation of modern context-aware systems with distributed computation is investigated.
  Design/methodology/approach - On this purpose, definitions of context and context-awareness are developed based on the theory of computation and especially on a computational model for interactive computation which extends the classical Turing Machine model. The computational model proposed here, encloses interaction and networking capabilities for computational machines.
  Findings - The definition of context presented here develop a mathematical framework for working with context. Also the modeling approach of distributed computing enables us to build robust, scalable and detailed models for systems and application with context-aware capabilities. Also enables us to map the procedures that support context-aware operations providing detailed descriptions about the interactions of applications with their context as well as with other external sources.
  Practical implications - A case study of a cloud based context-aware application is examined using the modeling methodology described in the paper so as to demonstrate the practical usage of the theoretical framework that is presented
  Originality/value - The originality on the framework presented here relies on the connection of context-awareness with the theory of computation and distributed computing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于计算理论和分布式计算的方法论，用于定义和建模上下文感知系统，并描述系统、应用程序与其上下文之间的交互。
AI.motivation: 为了有效定义和建模上下文感知系统，并描述系统、应用程序与其上下文之间的交互，同时探究现代上下文感知系统与分布式计算的关系。
AI.method: 基于计算理论，特别是扩展经典图灵机模型的交互计算模型，开发了上下文和上下文感知的定义。所提出的计算模型封装了计算机器的交互和网络能力。
AI.result: 提出的上下文定义构建了一个用于处理上下文的数学框架。分布式计算建模方法能够为具有上下文感知能力的系统和应用程序构建健壮、可扩展且详细的模型，并映射支持上下文感知操作的流程，详细描述应用程序与其上下文及其他外部源的交互。
AI.conclusion: 通过一个基于云的上下文感知应用程序案例研究，展示了所提出的理论框架的实际应用价值，验证了该框架的有效性和实用性。

title: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Enhances In-Context Learning for LLM-Based Mobile Traffic Prediction
summary: Accurate short-term mobile traffic prediction is important for proactive resource allocation and low-latency network management in fifth generation (5G) and sixth generation (6G). While large language models (LLMs) can perform in-context learning (ICL) without task-specific retraining, naive ICL prompting may suffer from numerical instability and limited temporal reasoning when traffic dynamics fluctuate rapidly. In this paper, we propose a chain-of-thought (CoT)-enabled LLM-based mobile traffic prediction framework that operates in two phases: (i) an offline phase that constructs structured CoT demonstrations by generating rationales via a plan-based CoT (PCoT) pipeline (lecture, plan, and rationale), and (ii) an online phase that performs close to real-time prediction by retrieving the most relevant demonstrations using a similarity policy that considers both the historical throughput pattern and its short-term changes. We evaluate the proposed framework using a real-world 5G measurement dataset that includes both driving and static scenarios across diverse applications. Our numerical results reveal that the proposed 2-shot CoT-LLM can improve mean absolute error (MAE), root mean square error (RMSE) and R2-score by up to 14.88%, 15.03%, and 22.41%, respectively, compared to the 2-shot ICL-LLM and classical baselines. Furthermore, by optimizing the number of in-context examples, we achieve additional improvements of 4.58%, 5.70%, and 4.85% in MAE, RMSE, and R2-score, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于思维链（CoT）的大语言模型移动流量预测框架，通过离线构建结构化演示和在线相似性检索，在5G真实数据集上相比传统ICL方法，MAE、RMSE和R²分数分别提升高达14.88%、15.03%和22.41%。
AI.motivation: 准确的短期移动流量预测对于5G/6G网络中的主动资源分配和低延迟网络管理至关重要。虽然大语言模型具备上下文学习能力，但传统的ICL提示方法在流量动态快速波动时存在数值不稳定性和时间推理能力受限的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于CoT的LLM移动流量预测框架，分为两个阶段：（1）离线阶段：通过计划式CoT（PCoT）流水线（包括讲座、计划和推理）构建结构化CoT演示；（2）在线阶段：使用考虑历史吞吐量模式及其短期变化的相似性策略检索最相关的演示，进行近实时预测。
AI.result: 在包含驾驶和静态场景的真实5G测量数据集上进行评估，2-shot CoT-LLM相比2-shot ICL-LLM和传统基线，MAE、RMSE和R²分数分别提升高达14.88%、15.03%和22.41%。通过优化上下文示例数量，MAE、RMSE和R²分数分别获得额外提升4.58%、5.70%和4.85%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的CoT-LLM框架有效解决了传统ICL方法在移动流量预测中的数值稳定性和时间推理问题，通过结构化推理演示和相似性检索策略显著提升了预测准确性，为5G/6G网络的智能流量管理提供了有效解决方案。

title: On Distinguishing Capability Elicitation from Capability Creation in Post-Training: A Free-Energy Perspective
summary: Debates about large language model post-training often treat supervised fine-tuning (SFT) as imitation and reinforcement learning (RL) as discovery. But this distinction is too coarse. What matters is whether a training procedure increases the probability of behaviors the pretrained model could already produce, or whether it changes what the model can practically reach. We argue that post-training research should distinguish between capability elicitation and capability creation. We make this distinction operational by introducing the notion of accessible support: the set of behaviors that a model can practically produce under finite budgets. Post-training that reweights behaviors within this support is capability elicitation; whereas changing the support itself corresponds to capability creation. We develop this argument through a free-energy view of post-training. SFT and RL can both be seen as reweighting a pretrained reference distribution, only with different external signals. Demonstration signals define low-energy behavior for SFT, and reward signals define low-energy behavior for RL. When the update remains close to the base model, the main effect is local reweighting, not capability creation. Within this framework, the central question is no longer whether post-training is framed as SFT or RL, but whether it reweights behaviors already within reach, or instead expands the model's reachable behavioral space through search, interaction, tool use, or the incorporation of new information.

AI.tldr: 论文提出后训练应区分为能力激发和能力创造，关键在于是否改变了模型在有限资源下可访问的行为集合，而非SFT与RL的传统划分。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将监督微调（SFT）视为模仿、强化学习（RL）视为发现的区分过于粗糙。作者认为应从根本上区分：训练过程是增加了预训练模型已能产生的行为的概率，还是改变了模型实际可达的行为范围。
AI.method: 引入"可访问支持集"概念，即模型在有限资源下实际能产生的行为集合。从自由能视角统一分析SFT和RL：两者本质上都是在重加权预训练参考分布，只是外部信号不同——SFT使用示范信号定义低能量行为，RL使用奖励信号定义低能量行为。
AI.result: 建立了能力激发与能力创造的严格区分框架：在后训练过程中，若更新保持接近基础模型，主要效应是局部重加权（能力激发）；若改变支持集本身，则对应能力创造。核心区分标准转变为：是重加权已达行为，还是通过搜索、交互、工具使用或新信息整合扩展模型可达行为空间。
AI.conclusion: 后训练研究的核心问题不应是采用SFT还是RL框架，而应关注其是重加权已达行为，还是扩展模型可达行为空间。这一区分对理解和设计后训练方法具有重要指导意义。

title: BaLoRA: Bayesian Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Scale Models
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become the standard for fine-tuning large pre-trained models at reduced computational cost. However, its low-rank point-estimate updates limit expressiveness, leave a persistent gap relative to full fine-tuning accuracy, and provide no built-in uncertainty quantification, limiting its applicability in settings where reliability matters as much as accuracy. We introduce BaLoRA, a Bayesian extension of LoRA with a novel input-adaptive Bayesian parameterization of LoRA matrices that adds minimal parameters and compute. Surprisingly, not only does the Bayesian extension yield well-calibrated uncertainty estimates, but the adaptive noise injection underlying our approach also significantly improves prediction accuracy, narrowing the gap with full fine-tuning across both natural language reasoning and vision tasks. When applied to band gap prediction in metal-organic frameworks, BaLoRA produces zero-shot test-time uncertainty estimates that correlate more strongly with model error than a trained ensemble of LoRA models, and improve monotonically with compute without sacrificing accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出了BaLoRA，一种LoRA的贝叶斯扩展方法，通过新颖的输入自适应贝叶斯参数化，在增加极少参数和计算量的情况下，不仅提供了校准良好的不确定性估计，还显著提升了预测精度，缩小了与全量微调的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 标准的LoRA方法存在三个关键局限性：(1)低秩点估计更新限制了表达能力；(2)与全量微调相比存在持续的性能差距；(3)缺乏内置的不确定性量化机制，限制了其在可靠性要求高的场景中的应用。
AI.method: 提出BaLoRA方法，这是一种LoRA的贝叶斯扩展，采用新颖的输入自适应贝叶斯参数化策略来建模LoRA矩阵。该方法在保持最小参数和计算开销增加的前提下，通过自适应噪声注入机制实现贝叶斯推断。
AI.result: 在自然语言推理和视觉任务上，BaLoRA不仅产生了校准良好的不确定性估计，还显著提升了预测精度，缩小了与全量微调的性能差距。在金属有机框架带隙预测任务中，BaLoRA产生的零样本测试时不确定性估计与模型误差的相关性比训练好的LoRA模型集成更强，且随计算量增加单调改善而不牺牲精度。
AI.conclusion: BaLoRA成功将贝叶斯方法引入LoRA框架，通过输入自适应噪声注入机制同时实现了不确定性量化和性能提升，为可靠性要求高的应用场景提供了有效的参数高效微调解决方案，证明了贝叶斯扩展不仅能提供不确定性估计，还能意外地改善模型精度。

title: Modeling Decision-Making with Will for Cooperation in Social Dilemmas
summary: Standard rational actor models often attribute cooperation failures in social dilemmas to insufficient incentives, overlooking the destabilizing effects of continuous utility maximization. To address this, we propose a framework of ``will" defined as a mechanism that persistently pursues goals while ignoring local cost-benefit fluctuations. We formalize the Willed Agents as potential minimizers, distinguishing them from cumulative utility maximization. Dynamical analysis of infinite population demonstrates that willed agents shrink the feasible state space, acting as boundary constraints that accelerate convergence in canonical social dilemmas. Through multi-agent simulations in a spatiotemporal Stag Hunt Game, we show that willed agents function as ``cooperation catalysts", enabling groups to surmount high-risk thresholds where purely utility maximization fails. We find that heterogeneous will strength promotes cooperation, and that agents who autonomously suspend rational re-evaluation can significantly outperform continuous optimizers. These findings suggest that successful cooperation relies on the cognitive capacity to strategically constrain calculation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“意志代理”概念，通过持续追求目标而忽略局部成本收益波动，在社会困境中起到“合作催化剂”作用，使群体能够跨越高风险阈值，而纯粹的效用最大化则无法实现。
AI.motivation: 标准理性行动者模型常将社会困境中的合作失败归因于激励不足，忽视了持续效用最大化的不稳定效应，因此需要一种新框架来解释和促进合作。
AI.method: 提出“意志”框架，将其形式化为势能最小化者，区别于累积效用最大化；通过无限群体的动力学分析以及时空猎鹿博弈的多代理模拟进行验证。
AI.result: 意志代理缩小可行状态空间，作为边界约束加速规范社会困境中的收敛；异质意志强度促进合作；自主暂停理性重新评估的代理显著优于持续优化者。
AI.conclusion: 成功的合作依赖于战略性地约束计算的认知能力，而非纯粹的效用最大化。

title: SPECTRE: Hybrid Ordinary-Parallel Speculative Serving for Resource-Efficient LLM Inference
summary: LLM serving platforms are increasingly deployed as multi-model cloud systems, where user demand is often long-tailed: a few popular large models receive most requests, while many smaller tail models remain underutilized. We propose \textbf{SPECTRE} (Parallel \textbf{SPEC}ulative Decoding with a Multi-\textbf{T}enant \textbf{RE}mote Drafter), a serving framework that reuses underutilized tail-model services as remote drafters for heavily loaded large-model services through speculative decoding. SPECTRE enables draft generation and target-side verification to run in parallel, and makes such parallelism effective through three techniques: a hybrid ordinary-parallel speculative decoding strategy guided by a threshold derived from throughput analysis, speculative priority scheduling to preserve draft--target overlap under multi-tenant traffic, and draft-side prompt compression to reduce draft latency. We implement SPECTRE in \texttt{SGLang} and evaluate it across multiple draft--target model pairs, reasoning benchmarks, real-world long-context workloads, and a wide range of batch sizes. Results show that SPECTRE consistently improves large-model serving throughput while causing only minor interference to the native workloads of tail-model services. In large-model deployments, including Qwen3-235B-A22B with TP=8, SPECTRE achieves up to \textbf{2.28$\times$ speedup} over autoregressive decoding and up to an additional \textbf{66\% relative improvement} over the strongest speculative decoding baselines. Talk is cheap, we show you the code: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/22272.

AI.tldr: 提出SPECTRE框架，利用多模型云平台中被低估的小模型作为远程推测解码草稿器，实现大模型服务吞吐量最高2.28倍加速。
AI.motivation: 多模型云服务中用户需求呈长尾分布：少数热门大模型负载过重，而多数尾部小模型资源利用率低下。现有资源分配不均，亟需一种机制来复用闲置的小模型资源以加速大模型推理。
AI.method: 提出SPECTRE框架，将闲置的小模型服务作为远程草稿器辅助大模型进行推测解码。核心包含三项技术：1) 基于吞吐量分析阈值的混合并行推测解码策略；2) 推测优先级调度，在多租户流量下保持草稿-目标重叠；3) 草稿端提示压缩以降低草稿延迟。在SGLang中实现并开源。
AI.result: 在多种草稿-目标模型对、推理基准、真实长上下文负载及不同批量大小下进行评估。SPECTRE持续提升大模型服务吞吐量，同时对小模型原生负载干扰极小。在Qwen3-235B-A22B (TP=8)部署中，相比自回归解码实现最高2.28倍加速，相比最强推测解码基线额外提升66%。
AI.conclusion: SPECTRE有效解决了多模型云平台中的资源利用不均问题，通过复用闲置小模型加速大模型推理，显著提升了系统整体吞吐量，为大模型服务提供了一种高效的资源优化方案。

title: The Carrier Pigeon Internet Protocol: An Algorithmic (and Lighthearted) Perspective
summary:
The theoretical model behind the pigeon post as a link layer in a communication network was introduced by Shannon (under the guise of studying One-Time Pads for cryptography). That is, to send a one-hop message to $v$, a node $u$ needs a mail pigeon bred and raised at $v$. When sending a message using a pigeon to $v$, node $u$ loses the pigeon. To send another message to $v$, node $u$ needs another pigeon of $v$. It has been demonstrated that the communication bandwidth achievable with pigeon post can exceed that of networks using other media. This has already motivated the introduction of Internet standards that allow the use of pigeons as Internet link-layer media.
  In this paper, we begin to fill in the missing piece: designing algorithms for breeding and scheduling pigeons to meet a given communication demand efficiently, minimizing the number of pigeons required. We consider singlehop, 2-hop, and multihop pigeon use. While the singlehop variant admits a simple characterization, both the 2-hop and the multihop variants are NP-hard. For the latter variants, we present a polynomial-time algorithm based on demand aggregation that achieves a 2-approximation for the number of pigeons used. We believe that this pigeon-based perspective offers both amusing and instructive insights into network design and hopefully, into ornithology.

AI.tldr: 本文针对鸽邮网络的算法设计问题进行研究，证明了单跳情况存在简单解法，而2跳和多跳情况为NP难问题，并提出了一个基于需求聚合的2-近似多项式时间算法。
AI.motivation: Shannon曾建立了鸽邮作为通信网络链路层的理论模型，证明了鸽邮带宽可超越其他媒介，甚至催生了相关互联网标准，但一直缺乏高效满足通信需求的鸽子培育与调度算法设计，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 研究单跳、2跳和多跳三种鸽子使用场景；对于NP难的2跳和多跳变体，提出基于需求聚合的多项式时间近似算法。
AI.result: 单跳变体可简单刻画；2跳和多跳变体被证明为NP难；提出的算法在鸽子使用数量上达到2-近似比。
AI.conclusion: 本文为鸽邮网络提供了首个系统的算法设计方案，该基于鸽子的视角既有趣又为网络设计提供了启发性的见解。

title: MemQ: Integrating Q-Learning into Self-Evolving Memory Agents over Provenance DAGs
comment: 22 pages, 11 figures (containing 43 individual image panels total)
summary: Episodic memory allows LLM agents to accumulate and retrieve experience, but current methods treat each memory independently, i.e., evaluating retrieval quality in isolation without accounting for the dependency chains through which memories enable the creation of future memories. We introduce MemQ, which applies TD($λ$) eligibility traces to memory Q-values, propagating credit backward through a provenance DAG that records which memories were retrieved when each new memory was created. Credit weight decays as $(γλ)^d$ with DAG depth $d$, replacing temporal distance with structural proximity. We formalize the setting as an Exogenous-Context MDP, whose factored transition decouples the exogenous task stream from the endogenous memory store. Across six benchmarks, spanning OS interaction, function calling, code generation, multimodal reasoning, embodied reasoning, and expert-level QA, MemQ achieves the highest success rate on all six in generalization evaluation and runtime learning, with gains largest on multi-step tasks that produce deep and relevant provenance chains (up to +5.7~pp) and smallest on single-step classification (+0.77~pp) where single-step updates already suffice. We further study how $γ$ and $λ$ interact with the EC-MDP structure, providing principled guidance for parameter selection and future research. Code will be available soon.

AI.tldr: 提出MemQ方法，利用TD(λ)资格迹和溯源DAG传播记忆信用，解决了现有LLM智能体记忆检索忽略记忆间依赖链的问题，在六个基准测试上均取得最高成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体记忆检索方法将每个记忆视为独立个体，仅在隔离状态下评估检索质量，忽略了记忆之间存在的依赖链条——即某些记忆的检索会促成新记忆的创建这一关联关系。
AI.method: 将场景形式化为外生上下文MDP（EC-MDP），其分解转移解耦了外生任务流和内生记忆存储；提出MemQ方法，将TD(λ)资格迹应用于记忆Q值，通过溯源DAG反向传播信用，信用权重随DAG深度d按(γλ)^d衰减，用结构邻近性替代时间距离。
AI.result: 在涵盖OS交互、函数调用、代码生成、多模态推理、具身推理和专家级问答的六个基准测试中，MemQ在泛化评估和运行时学习上均取得最高成功率；在产生深层相关溯源链的多步任务上增益最大（高达+5.7pp），在单步分类任务上增益最小（+0.77pp）。还研究了γ和λ与EC-MDP结构的交互关系，为参数选择提供原则性指导。
AI.conclusion: MemQ通过考虑记忆间的依赖关系，有效提升了LLM智能体的记忆检索质量，尤其在多步任务上表现显著，证明了考虑记忆信用传播的重要性。

title: TTCD:Transformer Integrated Temporal Causal Discovery from Non-Stationary Time Series Data
summary: The widespread availability of complex time series data in various domains such as environmental science, epidemiology, and economics demands robust causal discovery methods that can identify intricate contemporaneous and lagged relationships in non-stationary, nonlinear, and noisy settings. Existing constraint-based methods often rely heavily on conditional independence tests that degrade for limited data samples and complex distributions, while score-based methods impose strong statistical assumptions. Recent methods address special cases such as change point detection or distribution shifts, but struggle to provide a unified solution. We propose the Transformer Integrated Temporal Causal Discovery (TTCD) Framework, a novel end-to-end approach that learns contemporaneous and lagged causal relations from non-stationary time series. TTCD introduces a Non-Stationary Feature Learner integrating temporal and frequency-domain attention with dynamic non-stationarity profiling, and a custom Causal Structure Learner. A key innovation is reconstruction-guided causal signal distillation, to distill essential causal signals through the reconstruction process of the transformer decoder, which mitigates noise and spurious correlations while preserving meaningful dependencies. The Causal Structure Learner operates on distilled reconstructed signals to infer the underlying causal graph without restrictive assumptions on noise distributions or data generation processes. Experiments on synthetic, benchmark, and real world datasets show that TTCD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both accuracy and consistency with domain knowledge, demonstrating the approach's effectiveness for causal discovery in challenging real world contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TTCD框架，一个端到端的模型，用于从非平稳时间序列中发现同期和滞后的因果关系，在合成、基准和真实数据集上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 环境科学、流行病学和经济学等领域产生了大量复杂的时间序列数据，迫切需要能够在非平稳、非线性和噪声环境中识别同期与滞后因果关系的鲁棒方法。现有的基于约束的方法依赖条件独立性测试，在小样本和复杂分布下性能下降；基于分数的方法则施加了过强的统计假设；近期方法虽处理了变点检测或分布偏移等特例，但缺乏统一解决方案。
AI.method: 提出了Transformer集成时间因果发现（TTCD）框架。该框架包含两个核心组件：1）非平稳特征学习器，融合时域和频域注意力机制与动态非平稳性分析；2）因果结构学习器。核心创新在于重构引导的因果信号蒸馏，通过Transformer解码器的重构过程提取关键因果信号，有效缓解噪声和虚假相关性，保留有意义的依赖关系。因果结构学习器基于蒸馏后的重构信号推断因果图，无需对噪声分布或数据生成过程做限制性假设。
AI.result: 在合成数据、基准数据集和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，TTCD在准确性和与领域知识的一致性方面均持续优于现有的最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: TTCD框架为复杂现实场景下的因果发现提供了有效的解决方案，证明了其在处理非平稳、非线性时间序列数据时的优越性和鲁棒性。

title: RFAmpDesigner: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Automated Radio Frequency Amplifier Design
summary: Automating radio frequency (RF) amplifier design remains challenging because existing methods suffer from the curse of dimensionality, weak use of domain knowledge, and poor transferability, leading to low data efficiency. Meanwhile, although large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in many scientific domains, applying them directly to RF sizing is nontrivial due to the numerical nature of circuit optimization and the reliance on domain-specific design flows. To address this, this paper proposes RFAmpDesigner, a multi-agent framework that automates RF amplifier sizing. It introduces a resource-allocation middleware that reframes high-dimensional parameter tuning as a low-dimensional resource distribution problem, making it easier to inject sizing knowledge into general-purpose LLMs. The framework also follows standard design practice, enabling LLMs to distinguish between high- and low-cost actions and search in parallel. To realize a self-evolving optimization process, the framework employs retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to reuse past knowledge and experience from memory base. As a proof of concept, we apply RFAmpDesigner to low noise amplifiers of varying complexity. The experimental results show that it can automatically synthesize designs with fractional bandwidths ranging from 10\% to 80\% and center frequencies from 10 GHz to 50 GHz. To the best of our knowledge, this work develops the first LLM-driven approach for RF amplifier sizing that operates on design concepts instead of treating netlists as text, offering a novel solution to mitigate data scarcity in RF design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RFAmpDesigner，这是首个基于大语言模型（LLM）的射频（RF）放大器自动尺寸设计框架。通过资源分配中间件将高维参数调优重构为低维资源分配问题，并结合检索增强生成（RAG）技术，实现了数据高效的RF放大器自动综合。
AI.motivation: 现有的射频放大器自动化设计方法面临维度灾难、领域知识利用不足和可迁移性差等问题，导致数据效率低下。同时，虽然大语言模型在多个科学领域表现出潜力，但由于电路优化的数值本质和对特定领域设计流程的依赖，将其直接应用于RF尺寸设计并非易事。
AI.method: 提出RFAmpDesigner多智能体框架：1）引入资源分配中间件，将高维参数调优重构为低维资源分配问题，便于将尺寸设计知识注入通用LLM；2）遵循标准设计实践，使LLM能够区分高/低成本动作并实现并行搜索；3）采用检索增强生成（RAG）技术重用记忆库中的历史知识和经验，实现自演化优化过程。
