AI.result: 在低噪声放大器上的实验表明，RFAmpDesigner能够自动综合设计分数带宽从10%到80%、中心频率从10 GHz到50 GHz的放大器，适用于不同复杂度的设计任务。
AI.conclusion: 本研究开发了首个基于设计概念而非将网表视为文本的LLM驱动RF放大器尺寸设计方法，为缓解RF设计中的数据稀缺问题提供了新颖解决方案，证明了LLM在射频电路设计领域的应用潜力。

title: Beyond the All-in-One Agent: Benchmarking Role-Specialized Multi-Agent Collaboration in Enterprise Workflows
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to operate in enterprise environments, where work is distributed across specialized roles, permission-controlled systems, and cross-departmental procedures. However, existing enterprise benchmarks largely evaluate single agents with broad tool access, while existing multi-agent benchmarks rarely capture realistic enterprise constraints such as role specialization, access control, stateful business systems, and policy-based approvals. We introduce \textsc{EntCollabBench}, a benchmark for evaluating enterprise multi-agent collaboration. \textsc{EntCollabBench} simulates a permission-isolated organization with 11 role-specialized agents across six departments and contains two evaluation subsets: a Workflow subset, where agents collaboratively modify enterprise system states, and an Approval subset, where agents make policy-grounded decisions. Evaluation is based on execution traces, database state verification, and deterministic policy adjudication rather than natural-language response judging. Experiments with representative LLM agents show that current models still struggle with end-to-end enterprise collaboration, especially in delegation, context transfer, parameter grounding, workflow closure, and decision commitment. \textsc{EntCollabBench} provides a reproducible testbed for measuring and improving agent systems intended for realistic organizational environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EntCollabBench，一个用于评估企业环境中多智能体协作的基准，模拟包含11个角色专业化智能体和6个部门的权限隔离组织，通过工作流和审批两个子集进行评估。实验表明当前LLM在端到端企业协作中仍面临挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有企业基准主要评估具有广泛工具访问权限的单智能体，而现有多智能体基准很少捕捉现实企业约束，如角色专业化、访问控制、有状态业务系统和基于策略的审批流程。企业环境中工作分布在专业角色、权限控制系统和跨部门流程中，需要一个能真实反映这些约束的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建了EntCollabBench基准，模拟包含11个角色专业化智能体和6个部门的权限隔离组织。基准包含两个评估子集：（1）工作流子集，智能体协作修改企业系统状态；（2）审批子集，智能体做出基于策略的决策。评估基于执行轨迹、数据库状态验证和确定性策略裁决，而非自然语言响应评判。
AI.result: 使用代表性LLM智能体的实验表明，当前模型在端到端企业协作中仍然存在困难，特别是在委托、上下文转移、参数接地、工作流闭合和决策提交方面表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: EntCollabBench为测量和改进面向现实组织环境的智能体系统提供了可复现的测试平台，揭示了当前LLM智能体在企业多智能体协作方面的不足，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning: Integrating Zero-Knowledge Proofs in Scalable Distributed Architectures
summary: The intersection of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and distributed systems has given rise to Federated Learning (FL), a paradigm that enables decentralized model training without compromising local data privacy. As organizational data silos grow, deploying complex machine learning models across highly distributed edge networks becomes a critical infrastructural challenge. Standard FL implementations suffer from severe vulnerabilities related to adversarial gradient updates and computational bottlenecks at the aggregation layer. This paper presents a novel, end-to-end distributed architecture that hardens FL pipelines using advanced cryptographic verification and optimized big data processing frameworks. We introduce a Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) wrapper that cryptographically validates node computations before global aggregation, neutralizing model poisoning attacks without inspecting raw gradients. Additionally, we evaluate the system's performance using extreme gradient boosting models optimized for distributed edge execution. We formalize the mathematical transformation of the machine learning loss functions into Rank-1 Constraint Systems (R1CS) suitable for succinct verification. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our hybrid architecture achieves a 94.2\% accuracy retention under adversarial conditions while maintaining scalable throughput across 1,000 parallel distributed nodes, effectively bridging the gap between rigorous cryptographic security and high-performance distributed AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合零知识证明（ZKP）和大数据处理框架的端到端联邦学习分布式架构。该架构通过密码学验证防止模型投毒攻击，在1000个分布式节点上实现了94.2%的准确率保持，同时保证了高吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 随着组织数据孤岛的增长，在高度分布式的边缘网络上部署复杂的机器学习模型成为关键的基础设施挑战。标准联邦学习实现存在严重的对抗性梯度更新漏洞和聚合层的计算瓶颈问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种端到端的分布式架构，使用先进的密码学验证和优化的大数据处理框架来强化联邦学习管道。引入了零知识证明（ZKP）包装器，在全球聚合之前通过密码学方式验证节点计算，从而在不检查原始梯度的情况下中和模型投毒攻击。将机器学习损失函数数学转换为Rank-1约束系统（R1CS），以实现简洁验证。使用针对分布式边缘执行优化的极限梯度提升模型进行评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该混合架构在对抗条件下实现了94.2%的准确率保持，同时在1000个并行分布式节点上保持了可扩展的吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 该架构有效地弥合了严格的密码安全性和高性能分布式AI之间的差距，为联邦学习提供了一种既安全又高效的解决方案。

title: PolicyCache-SDN: Hierarchical Intra-Path Learning for Adaptive SDN Traffic Control
summary:
Software defined networks offer global visibility, yet centralized control loops are too slow for transient congestion and bursty traffic dynamics. Existing learned traffic control schemes often rely on offline training, making them fragile under distribution shifts. We present PolicyCache-SDN, a hierarchical SDN traffic control framework that enables local online adaptation under centralized policy control. Its key abstraction is a policy envelope: the controller compiles network wide intent into bounded per path action spaces, while edge agents learn and execute metering, queueing, and rerouting decisions only within those bounds. Policy envelopes also make local actions auditable and reversible when they affect shared bottlenecks. Evaluation on a 1,024 host software SDN testbed shows that PolicyCache-SDN improves average core link utilization by 35.5% over Static ECMP and 18.3% over Centralized TE. It reduces elephant flow P99 FCT by 34.3% over end host congestion control, lowers SLA violations from 18.2% to 6.8%, and uses less than 2% CPU and 12 MB memory per edge agent.
  The source code is available in an anonymized repository at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/JCC2026-PolicyCache-SDN/.

AI.tldr: 提出PolicyCache-SDN，一种分层SDN流量控制框架，通过"策略包络"将全局意图编译为边界约束的路径动作空间，使边缘代理能够在集中策略控制下进行本地在线自适应，在1024主机测试床上显著提升链路利用率、降低大象流完成时间和SLA违规。
AI.motivation: 软件定义网络（SDN）虽提供全局可见性，但集中式控制循环对于瞬时拥塞和突发流量动态响应过慢；现有基于学习的流量控制方案多依赖离线训练，在分布偏移下表现脆弱，无法适应动态网络环境。
AI.method: 提出分层SDN流量控制框架PolicyCache-SDN，核心抽象是"策略包络"（Policy Envelope）：控制器将全网意图编译为有界的逐路径动作空间，边缘智能体仅在此边界内学习并执行计量、排队和重路由决策；策略包络使本地动作在影响共享瓶颈时可审计且可逆，实现集中策略控制下的本地在线自适应。
AI.result: 在1024主机软件SDN测试床上评估：相比静态ECMP，核心链路平均利用率提升35.5%；相比集中式流量工程（TE）提升18.3%；相比终端主机拥塞控制，大象流P99流完成时间降低34.3%；SLA违规率从18.2%降至6.8%；每边缘代理CPU占用低于2%，内存占用低于12MB。
AI.conclusion: PolicyCache-SDN通过策略包络抽象有效平衡了集中控制与本地自适应，在保证可控可审计的前提下显著提升了网络性能指标，证明了分层自适应控制在SDN流量管理中的有效性和实用性。

title: SkillLens: Adaptive Multi-Granularity Skill Reuse for Cost-Efficient LLM Agents
summary: Skill libraries have become a practical way for LLM agents to reuse procedural experience across tasks. However, existing systems typically treat skills as flat, single-resolution prompt blocks. This creates a tension between relevance and cost: injecting coarse skills can introduce irrelevant or misleading context, while rewriting entire skills is expensive and often unnecessary. We propose SkillLens, a hierarchical skill-evolution framework that organizes skills into a four-layer graph of policies, strategies, procedures, and primitives, and retrieves them at mixed granularity. Given a task, SkillLens first retrieves semantically relevant skill seeds, expands them through degree-corrected random walk over the skill graph, and then uses a verifier to decide whether each visited unit should be accepted, decomposed, rewritten, or skipped. This enables the agent to reuse compatible subskills directly while adapting only locally mismatched components. To improve the system over time, SkillLens further refines multi-granularity skills and verifier in order to improve its routing decisions. We provide theoretical analysis showing that mixed-granularity adaptation incurs sublinear cost under sparse mismatch assumptions and that the evolutionary update rule monotonically improves the validation objective until a local optimum. Across MuLocbench and ALFWorld, SkillLens consistently improves over strong skill-based baselines, achieving up to a 6.31 percentage-point Acc@1 gain for bug localization and raising agent success rate from 45.00% to 51.31%.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillLens框架，通过分层技能图和多粒度检索适配机制，解决现有技能库在相关性与成本之间的矛盾，在Bug定位和Agent任务上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有技能库系统将技能视为扁平、单一粒度的提示块，导致相关性与成本之间存在矛盾：注入粗粒度技能可能引入无关或误导性上下文，而重写整个技能成本高昂且往往不必要。
AI.method: 提出SkillLens分层技能演化框架，将技能组织为策略-策略-过程-原语四层图结构，支持混合粒度检索。采用语义相关技能种子检索、基于度校正随机游走的图扩展，以及验证器对每个访问单元进行接受、分解、重写或跳过的决策，实现对兼容子技能的直接复用和局部不匹配组件的适应性修改。
AI.result: 在MuLocbench和ALFWorld基准测试上，SkillLens相比强技能基线方法有一致性提升：Bug定位任务Acc@1提升高达6.31个百分点，Agent成功率从45.00%提升至51.31%。理论分析表明混合粒度适配在稀疏不匹配假设下具有次线性成本。
AI.conclusion: SkillLens通过分层组织和多粒度检索机制，有效平衡了技能复用的相关性与成本，为LLM Agent的技能库管理提供了新的范式。演化更新规则能单调改善验证目标直至局部最优，系统性能随时间持续提升。

title: Do Foundation Model Embeddings Improve Cross-Country Crop Yield Generalisation? A Leave-One-Country-Out Evaluation in Sub-Saharan Africa
comment: 9 pages, 10 figures, appendix, code and processed results released publicly
summary: Accurate predictions of smallholder maize yields across national boundaries are critical for food security planning in sub-Saharan Africa, yet most published benchmarks report within-country performance that overstates true generalisability. This paper evaluates whether geospatial foundation model embeddings, specifically Prithvi-EO-1.0-100M and ViT-Base, outperform traditional Sentinel-2 spectral features under a Leave-One-Country-Out cross-validation scheme on 6,404 maize field observations from five African countries. The results show a clear generalisability gap: within-country random cross-validation yields moderate R^2 values, but all feature sets perform poorly under cross-country testing, with universally negative R^2. Frozen Prithvi-EO embeddings provide no meaningful advantage over engineered spectral features for cross-country prediction in this setting. The paper argues that the main limitation is a shift in yield distribution between countries rather than representation quality and releases a reproducible negative benchmark for future work.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了跨国家小农玉米产量预测存在严重的泛化性问题，地理空间基础模型嵌入并未优于传统光谱特征。
AI.motivation: 准确的跨国家小农玉米产量预测对撒哈拉以南非洲的粮食安全规划至关重要。现有研究大多报告国内性能基准，高估了模型的真实泛化能力，缺乏对跨国家预测性能的严格评估。
AI.method: 使用留一国法交叉验证（Leave-One-Country-Out CV）方案，在来自五个非洲国家的6,404个玉米田间观测数据上，比较地理空间基础模型嵌入（Prithvi-EO-1.0-100M和ViT-Base）与传统Sentinel-2光谱特征的预测性能。
AI.result: 研究发现显著的泛化差距：国内随机交叉验证产生中等R²值，但在跨国测试中所有特征集表现均很差，R²普遍为负值。冻结的Prithvi-EO嵌入在此设置下相比工程化光谱特征没有提供有意义的优势。
AI.conclusion: 主要限制因素是国家间的产量分布偏移而非表征质量。研究发布了一个可复现的负面基准，为未来工作提供了基础，强调了跨国家产量预测面临的根本挑战。

title: Towards an End-To-End System for Real-Time Gesture Recognition from Surface Vibrations
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables, accepted by IEEE PerCom 2026 (PeRConAI workshop, best paper award)
summary: Sensing surface vibrations promise unobtrusive interaction for smart home systems by enabling gesture recognition on existing everyday surfaces without disturbing living-space design. Existing approaches typically address only parts of the processing chain, such as sensing hardware or offline gesture recognition, rather than providing an end-to-end system from surface-mounted sensors to the evaluation of the prediction model. This paper presents a custom sensor system and a configurable data-to-model pipeline for gesture recognition on a standard office desk. Our hardware enables a low-noise sensing of the vibrations using piezoelectric sensors. Building on a modular signal-processing framework, we model the full chain from continuous recordings through variable pre-processing to a model-ready dataset, and process the resulting data with compact depthwise separable 1D-CNNs. We conduct a joint search over pre-processing and model hyperparameters and identify a configuration with 8,722 parameters that uses band-pass filtering, fixed-length windows, and min-max normalization. On a self-recorded dataset with 15 participants performing six gestures this configuration achieves high accuracies across different data splitting methods, including strong user-independent performance in a leave-one-subject-out cross-validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个端到端的表面振动手势识别系统，包含定制的低噪声压电传感器硬件和可配置的数据到模型流水线，在15人6种手势的数据集上实现了高精度的用户无关识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的表面振动手势识别方法通常只解决处理链的部分问题（如传感硬件或离线识别），缺乏从传感器到预测模型评估的端到端系统。智能家庭系统需要一种不显眼且不干扰生活空间设计的交互方式。
AI.method: 设计了定制的压电传感器硬件实现低噪声振动传感；构建模块化信号处理框架，包含连续记录、可变预处理（带通滤波、固定长度窗口、最小-最大归一化）到模型就绪数据集的完整流水线；使用紧凑的深度可分离1D-CNN模型；对预处理和模型超参数进行联合搜索优化。
AI.result: 识别出最优配置包含8,722个参数，采用带通滤波、固定长度窗口和最小-最大归一化；在15名参与者执行6种手势的自录数据集上，使用不同数据分割方法（包括留一受试者交叉验证）均实现高准确率，展现出强大的用户无关性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功实现了从传感器硬件到预测模型评估的完整端到端系统，证明了表面振动传感在标准办公桌上的手势识别可行性，为智能家庭系统提供了不显眼的交互解决方案。

title: Robust Multi-Agent LLMs under Byzantine Faults
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly collaborate over peer-to-peer networks to improve their reliability. However, these same interactions can also become a source of vulnerability, as unreliable or Byzantine agents may sway neighboring agents toward incorrect conclusions and degrade overall system performance. Existing methods rely on leader-based coordination or self-reported confidence, both of which are susceptible to adversarial manipulation. We study decentralized LLM multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) and propose Self-Anchored Consensus (SAC), a fully decentralized iterative filter-and-refine protocol in which agents iteratively exchange responses, locally evaluate and filter unreliable messages, and refine their own outputs. We present $(F{+}1)$-robustness conditions for the communication graph that ensure honest agents preserve and propagate reliable information despite Byzantine influence. Experiments on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks show that SAC effectively suppresses Byzantine influence and consistently improves performance across diverse communication topologies, whereas prior methods degrade under adversarial conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出了自锚定共识（SAC）协议，这是一种完全去中心化的迭代过滤与优化方法，能够有效抵御点对点网络中LLM多智能体系统的拜占庭故障。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在点对点网络中协作可提高可靠性，但这种交互也带来了安全漏洞：不可靠或拜占庭智能体可能误导邻居节点，导致系统性能下降。现有的方法依赖领导者协调或自我报告置信度，都容易受到对抗性操纵。
AI.method: 研究去中心化LLM多智能体系统（LLM-MAS），提出自锚定共识（SAC）协议。这是一种完全去中心化的迭代过滤与优化协议：智能体迭代交换响应，在本地评估并过滤不可靠消息，然后优化自身输出。研究还提出了通信图的(F+1)-鲁棒性条件，确保诚实智能体在拜占庭影响下仍能保留和传播可靠信息。
AI.result: 在数学和常识推理基准测试上的实验表明，SAC能够有效抑制拜占庭影响，并在多种通信拓扑下持续提升性能，而现有方法在对抗条件下性能会下降。
AI.conclusion: SAC为去中心化LLM多智能体系统提供了一种有效的防御机制，能够在对抗性环境中保持系统可靠性，优于依赖中心化协调或自我置信度的现有方法。

title: parHSOM: A novel parallel Hierarchical Self-Organizing Map implementation
summary: The digital age has completely transformed the way that information is processed and stored, which makes cybersecurity a crucial field of research. Cybersecurity contains many different domains, but this work focuses on Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs). Within the literature, Hierarchical Self-Organizing Maps (HSOMs) have been used to create trustworthy, explainable, and AI-based IDSs. However, HSOMs are trained sequentially, which means that training HSOMs on large datasets is slow. This work presents a novel parallel HSOM architecture, called parHSOM. The purpose of this research is to investigate the effect that parallel computation has on the HSOM training time. parHSOM is tested on two different testbeds, four different output grid sizes, and five different cybersecurity datasets. Performance metrics collected from these experiments show that parHSOM consistently trains faster than the Sequential HSOM algorithm without any significant loss in performance. Additionally, this work provides a platform for further investigation into parallel HSOM implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为parHSOM的新型并行分层自组织映射架构，用于加速入侵检测系统的训练过程，实验证明该方法能显著减少训练时间且不损失性能。
AI.motivation: 在网络安全领域，基于分层自组织映射(HSOM)的入侵检测系统虽然具有可信赖和可解释的优点，但其顺序训练方式导致在大数据集上训练速度缓慢，这限制了HSOM的实际应用效率。
AI.method: 设计并实现了一种并行HSOM架构(parHSOM)，通过并行计算来加速HSOM的训练过程。在两个不同测试平台、四种不同输出网格大小和五个不同网络安全数据集上进行了全面的实验测试。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，parHSOM在所有测试条件下均比顺序HSOM算法训练速度更快，且没有出现显著的性能损失，证明了并行化方法的有效性和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 并行HSOM架构能够有效解决传统顺序训练的速度瓶颈问题，为入侵检测系统提供了更高效的训练方案，同时也为进一步研究并行HSOM实现提供了实验平台和技术基础。

title: TSNBench: Benchmarking LLM Proficiency in Time-Sensitive Networking
summary: We present TSNBench, the first benchmark for evaluating large language model (LLM) proficiency in Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN), a suite of IEEE 802.1 standards for deterministic communication with bounded latency in safety-critical domains such as autonomous vehicles, aviation, defense, and industrial automation. While LLMs have been extensively evaluated on general knowledge tasks, their capabilities in safety-critical networking domains remain largely unexplored. TSNBench comprises 939 expert-validated multiple-choice questions (MCQs) covering diverse TSN mechanisms, along with 100 open-ended Worst-Case Delay (WCD) computation tasks for Credit-Based Shaper (CBS) and Cyclic Queuing and Forwarding (CQF) across varying network topologies and traffic conditions. MCQ answers are validated by domain experts, and open-ended ground truth WCD values are computed using a verified Network Calculus (NC) solver for CBS and closed-form mathematical upper bounds for CQF. We evaluate 16 LLMs and find that although models achieve 67 to 95% accuracy on MCQs, they fail substantially on open-ended WCD computation. For CBS, only GPT-5 achieves a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 36.2%, meaning its predicted WCD deviates by 36.2% of the actual TSN flow delay on average, while most models exceed 80%. For CQF, the best model achieves 41.8% MAPE, with most models clustering between 80% and 100%. Such errors are large relative to TSN latency budgets and can lead to violations of real-time constraints and unsafe configurations. TSNBench demonstrates that MCQ benchmarks may overestimate LLM capabilities in safety-critical networking domains.

AI.tldr: 提出了TSNBench，这是首个评估大语言模型在时间敏感网络（TSN）领域能力的基准测试。结果显示：LLM在选择题上表现良好（67%-95%准确率），但在开放式的最坏情况延迟（WCD）计算任务上表现不佳（最佳模型误差36.2%-41.8%），表明选择题基准可能高估LLM在安全关键网络领域的能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在通用知识任务上得到了广泛评估，但它们在安全关键网络领域（如自动驾驶、航空、国防和工业自动化中的时间敏感网络TSN）的能力在很大程度上仍未被探索。现有的评估可能无法准确反映LLM在这些领域的真实能力。
AI.method: 构建了TSNBench基准测试，包含两部分：（1）939个经过专家验证的多选题（MCQ），涵盖多种TSN机制；（2）100个开放式的最坏情况延迟（WCD）计算任务，涉及基于信用的整形器（CBS）和循环排队转发（CQF）两种机制，在不同网络拓扑和流量条件下进行测试。使用经过验证的网络演算求解器和闭式数学上界作为真实值。对16个大语言模型进行了评估。
AI.result: 在选择题部分，模型准确率达到67%-95%。但在开放式的WCD计算任务上表现较差：对于CBS，仅GPT-5达到了36.2%的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE），大多数模型超过80%；对于CQF，最佳模型达到41.8%的MAPE，大多数模型在80%-100%之间。这样的误差相对于TSN延迟预算而言很大，可能导致实时约束违规和不安全配置。
AI.conclusion: 多选题基准测试可能会高估大语言模型在安全关键网络领域的能力。LLM在需要精确计算的任务上存在明显不足，这对于安全关键应用具有重要启示，表明需要更严格的评估方法来准确评估LLM在这些领域的实际能力。

title: PLACO: A Multi-Stage Framework for Cost-Effective Performance in Human-AI Teams
summary: Human-AI teams play a pivotal role in improving overall system performance when neither the human nor the model can achieve such performance on their own. With the advent of powerful and accessible Generative AI models, several mundane tasks have morphed into Human-AI team tasks. From writing essays to developing advanced algorithms, humans have found that using AI assistance has led to an accelerated work pace like never before. In classification tasks, where the final output is a single hard label, it is crucial to address the combination of human and model output. Prior work elegantly solves this problem using Bayes rule, using the assumption that human and model output are conditionally independent given the ground truth. Specifically, it discusses a combination method to combine a single deterministic labeler (the human) and a probabilistic labeler (the classifier model) using the model's instance-level and the human's class-level calibrated probabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在分类任务中如何有效结合人类与模型输出的组合策略，利用贝叶斯规则在条件独立假设下实现人机协作性能优化。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI模型的快速发展，越来越多任务转变为人机协作模式。在分类任务中，当人类与模型单独均无法达到最优性能时，如何有效结合两者的输出成为一个关键问题。
AI.method: 基于贝叶斯规则，在人类与模型输出相对于真实标签条件独立的假设下，提出了一种组合方法。该方法结合了单一确定性标注者（人类）和概率性标注者（分类模型），利用模型的实例级校准概率和人类的类别级校准概率进行融合。
AI.result: 成功构建了一个理论框架，能够在条件独立假设下将人类与模型的预测输出进行数学上的最优组合，为分类任务中的人机协作提供了形式化的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为分类任务中的人机团队协作提供了理论上优雅且可操作的输出组合策略，为实际应用中人机协作系统的设计提供了重要指导。

title: Statistical Inference and Quality Measures of KV Cache Quantisations Inspired by TurboQuant
comment: 23 pages, 7 Figures, multiple tables, the process is highly assisted by AI
summary:
We analyse three KV cache quantization schemes under a fair bit budget: \textbf{KV} (scalar MSE baseline), \textbf{KQV} (WHT + MSE on $K$; WHT + MSE + QJL on $V$), and \textbf{QKQV} (WHT + MSE + QJL on both). Starting from the Beta distribution on the hypersphere, we trace how QJL on $K$ inflates inner product variance by $π/2$, which softmax amplifies nonlinearly via Jensen's inequality, and we present statistical inference and information metrics to highlight practical differences.
  Three empirical findings emerge. (1)~At $n=4$ (the practically dominant budget), KQV wins on every measure -- KL divergence, geometric $K$ error, and 6D distance -- across all distributions and ranks tested. (2)~The K--V asymmetry is unconditional: QKQV is consistently worse than KQV in KL divergence at every budget and distribution. (3)~A budget-dependent crossover exists: QKQV achieves better geometric $K$ reconstruction at $n \in \{2,3,5\}$, KQV at $n \in \{4,6\}$, invariant to rank and tail weight -- an open rate-distortion problem.
  $\mathrm{KL}(p_{\mathrm{ref}} \| p_{\mathrm{quant}})$, K-only by construction, bridges K direction error to routing corruption and output collapse. We present a sufficient condition when the Jensen mechanism amplifies superlinearly through the softmax. At $n \in \{2,3,5\}$, QKQV wins geometrically because this assumption does not bind. At $n=4$, elevated K error and KL divergence for QKQV strongly suggest the Jensen mechanism is the operative cause of the crossover, providing a new perspective and explanation.

AI.tldr: 在KV缓存量化中，KQV方案在4比特主导预算下全面胜出；K-V处理存在不对称性；不同比特预算下存在性能交叉现象，可通过Jensen机制解释。
AI.motivation: 研究不同KV缓存量化方案在公平比特预算下的性能差异，揭示K和V在量化处理中的不对称性及其对模型性能的影响机制。
AI.method: 分析三种量化方案（KV、KQV、QKQV），使用Walsh-Hadamard变换(WHT)、均方误差(MSE)和QJL量化技术；从超球面上的Beta分布出发，理论分析QJL对K向量内积方差的影响及softmax的非线性放大效应；通过统计推断和信息度量指标进行评估。
AI.result: 三个核心发现：(1)n=4比特预算下，KQV在所有度量（KL散度、几何K误差、6D距离）上全面最优；(2)K-V不对称性无条件存在：QKQV的KL散度始终劣于KQV；(3)存在预算依赖的交叉现象：n∈{2,3,5}时QKQV几何重建更好，n∈{4,6}时KQV更优。Jensen机制是n=4时性能差异的核心原因。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了KV量化中K-V不对称性的理论基础：对K应用QJL会引入π/2的内积方差膨胀，通过softmax的Jensen不等式机制非线性放大；这为量化方案设计提供了新视角，解释了不同比特预算下的性能交叉现象。

title: ObfAx: Obfuscation and IP Piracy Detection in Approximate Circuits
comment: To appear at the Great Lakes Symposium on VLSI 2026 (GLSVLSI '26)
summary: Approximate circuits often achieve exceptional trade-offs between computational accuracy and hardware efficiency, making them attractive for deployment as reusable Intellectual Property (IP) cores. However, safeguarding such circuits against piracy is critical for enabling sustainable commercialization of approximate computing. This work addresses the emerging challenge of IP protection and piracy detection in the context of approximate hardware. We introduce a novel adversarial threat model, approximate obfuscation, in which an attacker not only conceals the design through structural obfuscation but also introduces functional modifications to ensure that the resulting circuit exhibits nearly identical error characteristics and hardware metrics as the original IP. To counter this threat, we propose an automated framework that extracts and compares statistical error profiles of protected IP cores and suspicious circuits, enabling systematic detection of potential IP theft. Through extensive experiments on a diverse set of approximate multipliers, we analyze the resilience of different approximate multipliers against approximate obfuscation. Our results provide new insights into the interplay between obfuscation, approximation, and IP protection.

AI.tldr: 本文针对近似电路IP保护问题，提出了一种新的威胁模型（近似混淆）及相应的检测框架，通过统计误差特征分析来识别潜在的IP盗用。
AI.motivation: 近似电路在计算精度和硬件效率之间实现了卓越的权衡，使其成为理想的可复用IP核，但保护这些电路免受盗版对于近似计算的可持续商业化至关重要，因此需要解决近似硬件中的IP保护和盗版检测这一新兴挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的对抗性威胁模型——近似混淆，攻击者不仅通过结构混淆隐藏设计，还引入功能性修改以确保所得电路表现出与原始IP几乎相同的误差特征和硬件指标；同时提出了一个自动化框架，通过提取和比较受保护IP核与可疑电路的统计误差特征，实现系统性的潜在IP盗用检测。
AI.result: 通过对多种近似乘法器进行广泛实验，分析了不同近似乘法器对近似混淆的抵抗能力，为混淆、近似和IP保护之间的相互作用提供了新的见解。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为近似电路的IP保护提供了有效的方法论，揭示了混淆、近似和IP保护三者之间的复杂关系，为未来近似硬件的安全设计奠定了基础。

title: Internal vs. External: Comparing Deliberation and Evolution for Multi-Agent Constitutional Design
summary: Multi-agent AI systems need behavioral constitutions, but it is unresolved whether such rules should emerge internally through agent self-governance or be discovered externally through optimization. We present the first controlled comparison of internal deliberation and external evolution across three social environments: a coordination grid-world, an iterated public goods game, and a bilateral trading market. Across 180 simulation runs, evolution significantly outperforms deliberation in collective-action settings (p < 0.01), while neither method improves outcomes in bilateral trading. A multiplier ablation reveals that evolution's advantage inverts when incentives shift: at pool multiplier (m = 0.75) the evolved constitution forces value-destroying cooperation and becomes the worst-performing method. Notably, no deliberation run across thirty trials ever proposed punishment -- the canonical cooperation-sustaining mechanism evolution reliably discovers -- suggesting external optimization wins on peaks while internal self-governance trades peaks for structural responsiveness.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次对比了多智能体系统中行为规则（宪法）的两种来源——内部自治与外部进化。结果发现：在集体行动场景中外部进化显著优于内部协商，但在双边交易中两者均无效；进化虽能找到更优解，但在特定激励下可能强制执行破坏性合作，而内部治理虽表现较差却能避免此问题且从未提出惩罚机制。
AI.motivation: 多智能体AI系统需要行为宪法来规范行为，但目前尚不确定这些规则应通过智能体内部自治（内部协商）产生，还是通过外部优化（进化算法）发现。研究者旨在通过控制实验比较这两种方法在不同社会环境下的表现，为多智能体系统的规则设计提供理论依据。
AI.method: 研究者在三种社会环境中进行了180次模拟实验：协调网格世界、迭代公共物品博弈和双边交易市场。对比了内部协商（智能体自主讨论制定规则）与外部进化（通过优化算法发现规则）两种方法。此外还进行了乘数消融实验，通过调整池乘数（m=0.75）改变激励结构，分析两种方法在不同激励条件下的表现变化。
AI.result: 在集体行动场景中，外部进化显著优于内部协商（p < 0.01）；在双边交易市场中两种方法均未能改善结果。消融实验显示，当池乘数m=0.75时，进化的优势发生逆转：进化得到的宪法强制执行破坏价值的合作，成为表现最差的方法。关键发现是：在30次试验中，内部协商从未提出惩罚机制——而惩罚恰恰是维持合作的经典机制，外部进化能可靠地发现这一点。
AI.conclusion: 外部优化和内部自治各有优劣：外部进化能够发现更优的局部峰值（如惩罚机制），在标准集体行动环境中表现更好；但当激励结构改变时，进化可能被锁定在次优甚至有害的策略上。内部自治虽然表现较差，但具有结构响应性，能避免某些灾难性选择。研究揭示了规则来源设计中的重要权衡：峰值性能与结构稳健性之间的取舍。

title: Unleashing Scalable Context Parallelism for Foundation Models Pre-Training via FCP
summary: Context parallelism (CP) has been widely adopted to support the growing context length in foundation model pretraining. However, existing designs fail to handle the large variation in sequence length from training datasets, resulting in suboptimal performance. These methods often over-shard short sequences, leading to compute inefficiency and excessive communication, or process long and short sequences separately without proper bin-packing, causing workload imbalance. In this paper, we propose FCP, a flexible context parallelism paradigm that shards and schedules sequences at block-level granularity. Instead of relying on rigid communication topologies such as ring, FCP enables arbitrary peer-to-peer communication, allowing flexible placement of sequence blocks across workers. By bin-packing blocks from both short and long sequences, FCP achieves both high compute efficiency and balanced workload distribution. Extensive evaluations show that FCP attains near-linear scalability on up to 256 NVIDIA GPUs, with 1.13x-2.21x improvement in the attention MFU.

AI.tldr: 提出了FCP，一种灵活的上下文并行范式，通过块级粒度的分片与调度及任意点对点通信，解决了现有方法在处理变长序列时的计算效率低和负载不均问题，实现了近线性扩展和显著的注意力MFU提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的上下文并行（CP）方法无法有效处理训练数据集中序列长度的大幅变化，导致性能欠佳。具体而言，这些方法往往对短序列进行过度分片，导致计算效率低下和通信过量；或者将长短序列分开处理而缺乏合理的装箱策略，导致负载不平衡。
AI.method: 提出FCP（灵活上下文并行）范式，在块级粒度上对序列进行分片和调度。不同于依赖环形等刚性通信拓扑，FCP支持任意的点对点通信，允许将序列块灵活地放置在不同工作节点上。通过将短序列和长序列的块进行装箱组合，同时实现了高计算效率和均衡的负载分布。
AI.result: 在多达256个NVIDIA GPU上进行的广泛评估表明，FCP实现了近线性的扩展性，注意力模块的MFU（模型浮点运算利用率）提升了1.13倍至2.21倍。
AI.conclusion: FCP通过灵活的块级分片与调度策略，有效解决了变长序列训练中的效率与负载均衡问题，显著提升了大规模并行训练的性能，为长上下文基础模型的预训练提供了更优的并行方案。

title: Optimizing Server Placement for Vertical Federated Learning in Dynamic Edge/Fog Networks
comment: Under revision at IEEE/ACM transactions on networking
summary: We investigate the control and optimization of vertical federated learning (VFL), a class of distributed machine learning (ML) methods in which edge/fog devices contain separate data features, in dynamic edge/fog networks. Owing to heterogeneous data features and hardware across edge/fog networks, devices' contributions to VFL vary substantially, and, moreover, dynamic edge/fog networks can lead to the permanent exit or entry of select data features. In this setting, our proposed methodology, server controlled VFL in dynamic networks (SC-DN), first establishes the existence of a global first-order stationary point for every global round, and then leverages this result to jointly optimize ML model training and resource consumption based on four key control variables: (i) server placement, (ii) device-to-server transmit power, (iii) local device processor frequency, and (iv) local training iterations per global round. The resulting optimization formulation contains coupled variables as well as numerous forms of logarithmic constraints which we show is a mixed-integer signomial program, an NP-hard problem, and for which we develop a general solver. Finally, via experiments on both image and multi-modal datasets, we show that our methodology demonstrates superior classification/regression performance and resource consumption savings than even greedy methodologies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SC-DN方法，通过联合优化服务器位置、发射功率、处理器频率和本地迭代次数四个关键控制变量，实现了动态边缘网络下垂直联邦学习的控制与优化，在保证模型性能的同时显著降低了资源消耗。
AI.motivation: 在动态边缘/雾网络中，垂直联邦学习(VFL)面临异构数据特征和硬件导致的设备贡献差异大、设备动态加入或退出等问题，现有方法缺乏对模型训练和资源消耗的联合优化机制，亟需针对动态网络环境的VFL控制方案。
AI.method: 提出服务器控制的动态网络VFL方法(SC-DN)：首先证明每个全局轮次存在全局一阶驻点，然后基于此结果联合优化四个控制变量：(i)服务器位置、(ii)设备到服务器发射功率、(iii)本地设备处理器频率、(iv)每轮本地训练迭代次数。针对优化问题中耦合变量和对数约束形成的混合整数符号规划(NP难问题)，开发了通用求解器。
AI.result: 在图像和多模态数据集上的实验表明，该方法在分类/回归性能和资源消耗节省方面均优于贪婪方法，验证了联合优化策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SC-DN方法成功实现了动态边缘网络下VFL的控制与优化，通过理论保证和算法创新解决了实际部署中的关键挑战，为边缘智能系统提供了高效的联邦学习解决方案。

title: CoCoDA: Co-evolving Compositional DAG for Tool-Augmented Agents
summary: Tool-augmented language models can extend small language models with external executable skills, but scaling the tool library creates a coupled challenge: the library must evolve with the planner as new reusable subroutines emerge, while retrieval from the growing library must remain within a fixed context budget. Existing tool-use and skill-library methods typically treat tools as flat or text-indexed memories, causing prompt cost to grow with library size and obscuring the typed, compositional structure of executable code. We propose CoCoDA, a framework that co-evolves the planner and tool library through a single code-native structure: a compositional code DAG. Nodes are primitive or composite tools, edges encode invocation dependencies, and each node stores a typed signature, description, pre/post-condition specification, and worked examples. At inference time, Typed DAG Retrieval prunes candidates by symbolic signature unification, ranks survivors by descriptions, filters them by behavioral specifications, and disambiguates with examples, keeping expensive context materialization on progressively smaller candidate sets. At training time, successful trajectories are folded into validated composite tools, while the planner is updated with a DAG-induced reward that credits composites by their primitive expansion size. We provide theoretical results showing retrieval cost reduction, sublinear retrieval time, compositional advantage under the shaped reward, monotone co-evolution under conservative updates, and DAG well-formedness. Across mathematical reasoning, tabular analysis, and code task benchmarks, CoCoDA enables an 8B student to match or exceed a 32B teacher on GSM8K and MATH and consistently improves over strong tool-use and library-learning baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了CoCoDA框架，通过组合式代码DAG实现规划器与工具库的协同进化，在固定上下文预算下实现高效检索，使8B模型在数学推理等任务上达到或超越32B教师模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有工具增强语言模型在扩展工具库时面临双重挑战：工具库需要随规划器进化而增长，而从不断扩大的库中检索必须保持在固定的上下文预算内。现有方法将工具视为扁平或文本索引的记忆，导致提示成本随库规模增长，且掩盖了可执行代码的类型化、组合结构。
AI.method: 提出CoCoDA框架，使用组合式代码DAG（有向无环图）作为单一原生代码结构。节点是原语或复合工具，边编码调用依赖关系，每个节点存储类型化签名、描述、前置/后置条件规范和工作示例。推理时采用Typed DAG Retrieval：通过符号签名统一修剪候选、按描述排序、按行为规范过滤、用示例消歧，将昂贵的上下文具体化限制在逐步缩小的候选集上。训练时将成功轨迹折叠为验证的复合工具，并用DAG诱导的奖励更新规划器，该奖励按原语扩展大小给予复合工具功劳。
AI.result: 提供了理论结果证明检索成本降低、次线性检索时间、塑造奖励下的组合优势、保守更新下的单调协同进化以及DAG良好形式性。在数学推理、表格分析和代码任务基准测试中，CoCoDA使8B学生模型在GSM8K和MATH上匹配或超越32B教师模型，并持续优于强工具使用和库学习基线。
AI.conclusion: CoCoDA通过组合式代码DAG实现了规划器与工具库的有效协同进化，在保持固定上下文预算的同时实现了高效的工具检索和学习，为小模型达到大模型性能提供了有效途径。

title: The Safety-Aware Denoiser for Text Diffusion Models
comment: 27 pages, 12 figures. Code available at: https://github.com/ammanyusuf/SAD
summary: Recent work on text diffusion models offers a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, but controlling their safety remains underexplored. Existing safety approaches are geared toward autoregressive models and typically rely on post-hoc filtering or inference-time interventions. These are inadequate for effectively addressing safety risks in text diffusion models. We propose the Safety-Aware Denoiser (SAD), a safety-guidance framework in text diffusion models. The SAD modifies the iterative denoising process such that the text sample at the final denoising step is steered toward provably safe regions of the text space. This inference-time method can integrate safety constraints into the denoiser, avoiding computationally expensive retraining of the underlying diffusion model and enabling flexible, lightweight safety guidance. We evaluate the safety of the generated text using the SAD, with respect to hazard taxonomy, memorization, and jailbreak. Experimental results show that SAD substantially reduces unsafe generations while preserving generation quality, diversity, and fluency, outperforming existing methods. These results demonstrate that our safety guidance during denoising provides an effective and scalable mechanism for enforcing safety in text diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Safety-Aware Denoiser (SAD)，一种针对文本扩散模型的安全引导框架，通过在推理时的去噪过程中集成安全约束，有效减少不安全生成，无需昂贵的模型重训练。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全方法主要针对自回归模型设计（如事后过滤或推理时干预），无法有效解决文本扩散模型的安全风险，而文本扩散模型作为一种有前景的自回归生成替代方案，其安全控制问题尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出Safety-Aware Denoiser (SAD)框架，这是一种推理时的安全引导方法。该框架修改了迭代去噪过程，将安全约束集成到去噪器中，使最终去噪步骤的文本样本被引导至可证明安全的文本空间区域，从而避免了底层扩散模型的昂贵重训练，实现了灵活且轻量级的安全引导。
AI.result: 在危害分类、记忆化和越狱等安全指标上的实验结果表明，SAD在大幅减少不安全生成的同时，保持了生成质量、多样性和流畅性，性能优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 在去噪过程中进行安全引导为在文本扩散模型中实施安全性提供了一种有效且可扩展的机制，证明了该方法在平衡安全性与生成质量方面的优越性。

title: Reconfigurable Computing Challenge: Real-Time Graph Neural Networks for Online Event Selection in Big Science
comment: Accepted to FCCM Reconfigurable Computing Challenge 2026
summary: Graph neural networks are increasingly adopted in trigger systems for collider experiments, where strict latency and throughput constraints render deployment on embedded platforms challenging. As detectors move towards higher granularity, the number of inputs per inference increase and FPGA-only solutions face resource bottlenecks. This work presents an end-to-end demonstrator for the real-time deployment of a dynamic Graph Neural Network for the Belle II electromagnetic calorimeter hardware trigger on the AMD Versal VCK190, leveraging both FPGA fabric and AI Engine tiles. We develop a Python-based semi-automated design flow covering operator fusion, partitioning, mapping, spatial parallelization, and kernel-level optimization. Our design achieves a throughput of 2.94 million events per second at an end-to-end latency of 7.15 microseconds. Compared to the FPGA-only baseline, this represents a 53% throughput improvement while reducing DSP utilization from 99% to 19% at 29% AI Engine tile utilization. To validate the deployment, an interactive visualization pipeline enables real-time monitoring of inference results on the physical demonstrator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个在AMD Versal VCK190平台上部署动态图神经网络（GNN）的端到端演示系统，用于Belle II电磁量能器的硬件触发系统。相比FPGA-only方案，实现了53%的吞吐量提升，DSP利用率从99%降至19%，端到端延迟为7.15微秒。
AI.motivation: 在粒子对撞机实验的触发系统中，图神经网络（GNN）的应用日益增长。然而，严格的延迟和吞吐量约束使得在嵌入式平台上部署具有挑战性。随着探测器向更高粒度发展，每次推理的输入数量增加，仅使用FPGA的解决方案面临资源瓶颈。
AI.method: 开发了基于Python的半自动化设计流程，涵盖算子融合、分区、映射、空间并行化和内核级优化。利用AMD Versal VCK190平台，同时发挥FPGA逻辑和AI Engine的优势进行部署。还开发了交互式可视化流水线以实时监控推理结果。
AI.result: 设计实现了每秒294万事件的吞吐量，端到端延迟为7.15微秒。与纯FPGA基准相比，吞吐量提升53%，DSP利用率从99%降至19%，AI Engine利用率仅为29%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了在异构平台（FPGA + AI Engine）上部署动态GNN用于实时触发系统的可行性，显著缓解了资源瓶颈，为高粒度探测器下的硬件触发系统提供了有效的解决方案。

title: SkillMAS: Skill Co-Evolution with LLM-based Multi-Agent System
summary: Large language model (LLM) agent systems are increasingly expected to improve after deployment, but existing work often decouples two adaptation targets: skill evolution and multi-agent system (MAS) restructuring. This separation can create organization bottlenecks, context pressure, and mis-specialization. We present SkillMAS, a non-parametric framework for adaptive specialization in multi-agent systems that couples skill evolution with MAS restructuring. SkillMAS uses Utility Learning to assign credit from verified execution traces, bounded skill evolution to refine reusable procedures without unfiltered library growth, and evidence-gated MAS restructuring when retained failures and Executor Utility indicate a structural mismatch. Across embodied manipulation, command-line execution, and retail workflows, SkillMAS is competitive under the reported harnesses while clarifying how post-deployment specialization is attributed, updated, and applied.

AI.tldr: 提出了SkillMAS，一个将技能演化与多智能体系统重构耦合的非参数化框架，解决了现有工作中因分离这两个适应目标而产生的组织瓶颈、上下文压力和错误专业化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型智能体系统在部署后的改进研究中，通常将技能演化与多智能体系统重构这两个适应目标分离，这种分离会导致组织瓶颈、上下文压力和错误专业化等问题。
AI.method: SkillMAS是一个非参数化框架，包含三个核心机制：1）效用学习从已验证的执行轨迹中分配信用；2）有界技能演化改进可重用程序，避免未经过滤的库增长；3）基于证据门控的多智能体系统重构，当保留的失败和执行器效用指示结构性不匹配时触发。
AI.result: 在实体操作、命令行执行和零售工作流三个任务领域的实验中，SkillMAS在报告的框架下具有竞争力，同时阐明了部署后专业化如何被归因、更新和应用。
AI.conclusion: SkillMAS成功实现了技能演化与多智能体系统重构的耦合，为部署后自适应专业化提供了清晰的归因、更新和应用机制，有效解决了现有方法的目标分离问题。

title: MARLaaS: Multi-Tenant Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning as a Service
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), particularly in multi-turn agentic settings involving environment interaction like tool use. However, fine-tuning such models remains prohibitively expensive due to high computational requirements, limiting accessibility. We propose MARLaaS (Multi-tenant Asynchronous RL as a Service), a system for concurrent RL fine-tuning across multiple users and tasks. Our approach is based on two key ideas: (1) sharing a base model across tenants using lightweight LoRA adapters, and (2) a disaggregated asynchronous architecture that decouples rollout generation, environment interaction, and policy training into independently scheduled stages. This design enables tasks to progress through the RL pipeline at their own pace in an event-driven manner, reducing cross-task interference, idle time, and end-to-end latency. In multi-task settings (we report up to 32 concurrent tasks), MARLaaS achieves single-task state-of-the-art performance while improving accelerator utilization by up to 4.3x and reducing end-to-end training time by 85%.

AI.tldr: 提出MARLaaS系统，通过多租户异步RL即服务实现大语言模型的高效并发微调，在保持单任务最优性能的同时显著提升资源利用率和训练效率。
AI.motivation: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习显著提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但由于高计算需求，微调这类模型成本过高，限制了可访问性。现有的强化学习微调方法在多用户和多任务场景下效率低下。
AI.method: 提出MARLaaS系统，基于两个关键思想：（1）通过轻量级LoRA适配器在多租户间共享基础模型；（2）采用解耦异步架构，将rollout生成、环境交互和策略训练解耦为独立调度的阶段。这种设计使任务能够以事件驱动方式按自身节奏在RL流水线中推进。
AI.result: 在多任务设置下（最多32个并发任务），MARLaaS实现了单任务最优性能，同时将加速器利用率提升最高4.3倍，端到端训练时间减少85%。
AI.conclusion: MARLaaS成功解决了RLVR微调成本高的问题，通过创新的架构设计实现了高效的并发训练，在保持性能的同时大幅提升了资源利用率和训练效率，为多用户场景下的LLM强化学习微调提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Mixed-Criticality Flow Scheduling with Low Delay and Limited Bandwidth in TSN
summary: Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) is a promising Ethernet protocol with time determinism, widely used in time-critical systems such as industrial automation, automotive networks, and avionics. By allocating dedicated time windows for time-sensitive flows, TSN enables deterministic transmission; however, as network traffic grows, multiple flows may contend for the same window, causing large delays. Frame aggregation can mitigate this by combining multiple small frames into a larger one, thereby reducing the number of frames and required time windows, but existing approaches typically handle only single-priority traffic and cannot fully utilize pre-allocated time windows. To address this limitation, we propose MCFS-2L, a mixed-criticality flow scheduling scheme with low delay and limited bandwidth usage. MCFS-2L first aggregates critical and non-critical frames with the same source and destination nodes and harmonic periods into a single frame, and then applies a dynamic reassembly and scheduling method that selectively disaggregates non-critical frames from unschedulable aggregated frames. Experimental results show that MCFS-2L increases the acceptance ratio of critical and non-critical flows by up to 4.78% and 8.58%, respectively, while reducing bandwidth utilization by up to 11.88%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCFS-2L调度方案，通过帧聚合与动态拆分机制，解决了TSN网络中多优先级流量的调度冲突问题，提升了流接受率并降低了带宽消耗。
AI.motivation: 时间敏感网络（TSN）通过为时敏流分配专用时间窗口实现确定性传输，但随着流量增长，多流竞争同一窗口会导致大延迟。现有帧聚合方法仅能处理单一优先级流量，且无法充分利用预分配的时间窗口。
AI.method: 提出MCFS-2L混合关键性流调度方案：首先将具有相同源-目的节点和调和周期的关键与非关键帧聚合为单一帧；然后采用动态重组与调度方法，对不可调度的聚合帧选择性拆除非关键帧。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，MCFS-2L使关键流和非关键流的接受率分别提高4.78%和8.58%，同时带宽利用率降低达11.88%。
AI.conclusion: MCFS-2L有效解决了多关键性流量调度问题，在提升流接受率的同时优化了带宽使用，为TSN网络中的混合关键性流量管理提供了高效解决方案。

title: Belief or Circuitry? Causal Evidence for In-Context Graph Learning
comment: Under review at ICML Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop 2026
summary: How do LLMs learn in-context? Is it by pattern-matching recent tokens, or by inferring latent structure? We probe this question using a toy graph random-walk across two competing graph structures. This task's answer is, in principle, decidable: either the model tracks global topology, or it copies local transitions. We present two lines of evidence that neither account alone is sufficient. First, reconstructing the internal representation structure via PCA reveals that at intermediate mixture ratios, both graph topologies are encoded in orthogonal principal subspaces simultaneously. This pattern is difficult to reconcile with purely local transition copying. Second, residual-stream activation patching and graph-difference steering causally intervene on this graph-family signal: late-layer patching almost fully transfers the clean graph preference, while linear steering moves predictions in the intended direction and fails under norm-matched and label-shuffled controls. Taken together, our findings are most consistent with a dual-mechanism account in which genuine structure inference and induction circuits operate in parallel.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大语言模型的上下文学习并非单一机制，而是结构推断与归纳电路并行运作的双重机制。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型进行上下文学习的内在机制：究竟是依赖于对近期token的模式匹配，还是通过推断潜在的图结构来完成推理。
AI.method: 使用图随机游走任务作为探针，通过主成分分析（PCA）重构内部表征结构，并结合残差流激活修补和图差异引导进行因果干预实验。
AI.result: 单一机制解释均不充分：PCA显示中间混合比例下两种图拓扑在正交主子空间中被同时编码；后期层修补几乎完全转移了图偏好，线性引导可成功改变预测方向但在控制实验中失效。
AI.conclusion: 实验证据支持双重机制假说，即真正的结构推断机制与归纳电路在模型中并行运作，共同支持上下文学习。

title: Feature Repulsion and Spectral Lock-in: An Empirical Study of Two-Layer Network Grokking
summary: Tian (2025) proves a repulsion theorem (Theorem 6) for the matrix $ B = (\widetilde{F}^\top \widetilde{F} + ηI)^{-1} $ during the interactive feature-learning stage of grokking: similar features have negative off-diagonal entries $ B_{j\ell} $, producing an effective repulsive force that drives them apart. However, the theorem does not specify when this mechanism becomes empirically observable, nor whether it leaves a measurable spectral signature in the parameter updates. We test this directly on Tian's modular addition setup ($ M = 71 $, $ K = 2048 $, MSE loss) and observe a clear structure-mechanism dissociation. The predicted sign rule holds robustly on the top-200 most-similar feature pairs across activations (empirical sign-match rising from 0.865 to 0.985 on $ σ= x^2 $ across 5 seeds, and saturating at 1.000 on $ σ= \operatorname{ReLU} $). However, the spectral signature in the parameter updates is strongly activation-dependent. With $ σ= x^2 $, a simple slope detector on the rolling eigengap $ σ_2 / σ_3 $ of $ ΔW $ fires in 15/15 grokking seeds at epoch 174 (IQR [173,174]) and in 0/15 non-grokking controls, with 229$ \times $ late-stage magnitude separation; the spectrum is rank-2. In contrast, with $ σ= \operatorname{ReLU} $, the detector never fires and the spectrum remains effectively rank-1. This dissociation aligns with Tian's Theorem 5 distinction between focused (power-law) and spreading (ReLU) memorization: while the sign structure of $ B $ depends only on $ \widetilde{F}^\top \widetilde{F} $, how feature repulsion translates into weight updates critically depends on the activation derivative $ σ' $.

AI.tldr: 本文验证了Tian (2025)的排斥定理在经验上的有效性，发现了结构-机制分离现象：符号规则在两种激活函数下都稳健成立，但谱特征仅在二次激活下显著出现。
AI.motivation: Tian (2025)证明了特征排斥定理，但未说明该机制何时可被经验观测，以及是否在参数更新中留下可测量的谱特征。本文旨在直接测试这些预测的经验有效性。
AI.method: 在Tian的模加法设置(M=71, K=2048, MSE损失)上进行实验，比较两种激活函数(σ=x²和σ=ReLU)下的表现。通过检验top-200最相似特征对的符号匹配率验证排斥定理，并通过滚动特征间隙σ₂/σ₃的斜率检测器识别谱特征。
AI.result: 发现清晰的结构-机制分离：符号规则在两种激活函数下都稳健成立(二次激活：0.865→0.985，ReLU：饱和至1.000)。但谱特征表现不同：二次激活下检测器在15/15 grokking种子中于epoch 174触发，谱秩为2；而ReLU下检测器从未触发，谱秩保持为1。这与Tian定理5关于聚焦型(幂律)和扩散型(ReLU)记忆化的区分相一致。
AI.conclusion: 排斥定理预测的符号结构仅依赖于特征相关性，而特征排斥如何转化为权重更新则关键地依赖于激活导数σ'，这解释了为什么相同的理论预测在不同激活函数下呈现不同的经验谱特征。

title: TLX: Hardware-Native, Evolvable MIMW GPU Compiler for Large-scale Production Environments
summary: Modern GPUs increasingly rely on specialized hardware units and asynchronous coordination mechanisms, so performance depends on orchestrating data movement, tensor-core computation, and synchronization rather than exposing more thread-level parallelism. This creates a programming-model tension: if too much execution structure is hidden, the compiler must catch up to new hardware mechanisms; if too much is exposed, the burden of orchestration falls back onto the programmer. We present TLX (Triton Low-level Language Extensions), built around MIMW (Multi-Instruction, Multi-Warp), which expresses orchestration at warp-group granularity while preserving Triton's productive blocked programming model for regular computation. TLX realizes this idea as an embedded extension to Triton, exposing explicit interfaces for multi-warp execution, local-memory orchestration, asynchronous operations, and cluster-aware control. Our evaluation shows that TLX supports substantial customization with limited development effort while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art implementations. TLX-authored kernels have been deployed in large-scale training and inference production systems. Our code is open sourced at https://github.com/facebookexperimental/triton.

AI.tldr: 提出了TLX（Triton低级语言扩展），通过MIMW（多指令多Warp）模型在保持Triton高效编程模型的同时，显式暴露多Warp执行、本地内存编排、异步操作等接口，解决了现代GPU编程中硬件机制暴露程度的两难问题。
AI.motivation: 现代GPU越来越依赖专用硬件单元和异步协调机制，性能瓶颈从线程级并行ism转向数据移动、张量核心计算和同步的编排。这导致了编程模型的张力：如果隐藏过多执行结构，编译器需要追赶新硬件机制；如果暴露过多，编排负担又会回到程序员身上。现有的编程模型无法很好地平衡这一矛盾。
AI.method: 基于MIMW（Multi-Instruction, Multi-Warp）概念设计TLX，作为Triton的嵌入式扩展。TLX在Warp-group粒度上表达编排，同时保留Triton针对常规计算的块编程模型。具体实现包括：显式暴露多Warp执行接口、本地内存编排机制、异步操作接口、以及集群感知控制接口。
AI.result: 评估表明TLX能够以有限的开发工作量支持大量定制化需求，同时性能与最先进的实现保持竞争力。TLX编写的内核已成功部署在大规模训练和推理生产系统中。代码已在GitHub开源。
AI.conclusion: TLX成功填补了高级编程模型与底层硬件机制之间的鸿沟，为现代GPU编程提供了一个平衡生产力和性能的解决方案，证明了在保持高效编程模型的同时暴露必要硬件细节的可行性。

title: A Cross-Layered Multi-Drone Coordination for Medical Supply Delivery during Disaster Response Management
summary: Autonomous drone fleets have immense potential in medical supply delivery during disaster incident response. However, coordinating multiple drones in such settings introduces compounding challenges: dynamic environmental hazards such as wind, obstacles, and intermittent network connectivity, constrained energy budgets, and the need to serve patient locations fairly under deadlines and triage-based priority while optimizing schedule utilization. In this paper, we present CEDA, a novel CTDE Deep Q-Network algorithm for cooperative multi-drone medical delivery, designed to jointly optimize triage-priority-aware routing, multi-agent coordination, and energy-efficient navigation under dynamic uncertainty. CEDA introduces a Priority-Preserving Fair Scheduling strategy, in which a structured reward function encodes both triage weights and complementary fairness mechanisms ensuring no patient class is starved of service. We evaluate CEDA in a simulated grid environment featuring dynamic hazard zones, stochastic action failures, and dynamically spawning patients across three triage priority levels, as well as in a PX4 SITL validation using two X500 quadrotors controlled via MAVSDK in offboard position mode. Simulation results demonstrate that CEDA achieves a delivery completion rate above 85%, reduces obstacle collisions by over 90% across training, and delivers an average of 6 patients per episode with a triage efficiency of 0.82. CEDA preserves clinical priority ordering, Critical patients are served first, while achieving near-zero mortality across lower-triage classes, confirming that priority-weighted routing does not condemn Stable or Urgent patients to neglect. PX4 SITL validation further demonstrates that the learned policy remains executable and triage-coherent under practical communication constraints and realistic multi-drone coordination in disaster response settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CEDA算法，一种用于灾难响应中多无人机医疗物资配送的协作深度强化学习方法，在动态危险环境下实现了优先级感知的公平调度，交付完成率超过85%，碰撞减少90%以上。
AI.motivation: 在灾难事件响应中，自主无人机机队进行医疗物资配送具有巨大潜力，但面临多重挑战：动态环境危险（风、障碍物、间歇性网络连接）、受限的能量预算、以及需要在截止时间和分诊优先级约束下公平服务患者位置并优化调度利用率。
AI.method: 提出CEDA（CTDE Deep Q-Network）算法，采用集中训练分布式执行框架，引入优先级保留公平调度策略。该方法通过结构化奖励函数联合优化分诊优先级感知路由、多智能体协调和动态不确定性下的能效导航，确保没有任何患者类别被饥饿服务。
AI.result: 在包含动态危险区域、随机动作失败和动态生成患者的仿真环境中，CEDA实现超过85%的交付完成率，训练期间障碍物碰撞减少超过90%，每轮平均服务6名患者，分诊效率达0.82。算法保证危重患者优先服务，同时实现低分诊类别患者近零死亡率。PX4 SITL验证进一步证实学习策略在实际通信约束和真实多无人机协调下的可执行性。
AI.conclusion: CEDA成功解决了灾难响应中多无人机医疗配送的复杂协调问题，在保证临床优先级顺序的同时实现了公平调度，验证了优先级加权路由不会导致稳定或紧急患者被忽视，为实际灾难救援场景提供了可行的技术方案。

title: QUANTAS 2 An Abstract, Concrete and Byzantine Simulator
summary: We present QUANTAS 2: a new distributed algorithm simulator and quantitative performance analysis tool. We use the original QUANTAS as a foundation. QUANTAS 2 can perform fast abstract exploration, concrete validation, and adversarial fault injection while preserving a compact implementation model for distributed algorithm researchers. The original QUANTAS was designed as an abstract, round-based simulator, which allows researchers to separate algorithmic behavior from the artifacts of a particular operating system, network stack, or physical deployment. QUANTAS 2 extends that design in two directions. First, QUANTAS 2 supports a concrete socket-based execution mode, allowing the same algorithm implementations and JSON experiment descriptions to run across local or distributed computers. Second, QUANTAS 2 adds a reusable Byzantine-fault interface in which Byzantine behavior is encoded as composable fault strategy that substitutes correct sends, receives, and local computation. This allows researchers to simulate crash, equivocation, selfish-mining, and other adversarial behaviors without rewriting the simulated algorithm. We demonstrate the resulting platform on blockchain, consensus, distributed hash table, and reliable data link algorithms. We perform parasite-chain sweeps for proof-of-work blockchains, PBFT equivocation experiments, Raft crash experiments, and Chord/Kademlia scale experiments over both abstract and concrete modes.

AI.tldr: QUANTAS 2是一个分布式算法模拟器和定量性能分析工具，在原有抽象轮次模拟基础上新增了基于套接字的具体执行模式和可复用的拜占庭故障注入接口。
AI.motivation: 为了帮助研究人员将算法行为与特定操作系统、网络栈或物理部署的人为因素分离开来，并在统一框架下支持抽象探索、具体验证和对抗性故障注入。
AI.method: 在原有抽象轮次模拟器的基础上进行扩展：一、增加基于套接字的具体执行模式，使同一算法实现与JSON实验描述可在本地或分布式计算机上运行；二、引入可复用的拜占庭故障接口，将拜占庭行为编码为可组合的故障策略，替换正确的发送、接收与本地计算。
AI.result: 在区块链、共识、分布式哈希表和可靠数据链路算法上验证平台；进行工作量证明区块链的寄生链扫描、PBFT的等价性实验、Raft崩溃实验，以及在抽象与具体模式下的Chord/Kademlia规模实验。
AI.conclusion: QUANTAS 2在保持紧凑实现模型的同时，为分布式算法研究提供了快速的抽象探索、具体验证和灵活的对抗性行为模拟能力。

title: CloudEmu: A Trace-Driven Cloud-Native Emulation Testbed for Vehicle Video Uplink over Cellular Networks
comment: Accepted in IEEE NetSoft 2026 Demo Track
summary: We present CloudEmu, a trace-driven, cloud-native cellular-emulation testbed for vehicle video uplink communication. Reliable, low-latency video uplink over cellular networks is essential for remote monitoring of autonomous vehicles. However, existing testbeds fall into two extremes. Physical-vehicle platforms provide realism but are costly and make validation under identical network conditions difficult, whereas simulations are inexpensive and reproducible but generally cannot replay field-measured end-to-end performance dynamics without substantial calibration or readily run production video-uplink stacks. A software-defined, cloud-native emulation approach can combine the fidelity of trace-driven replay with the agility and scalability that network softwarization principles offer. To this end, we propose CloudEmu that replays time-synchronized cellular and position traces, collected once from vehicles, on commodity Linux-based virtual vehicle and video-receiver nodes. A Linux-based emulation framework couples traffic replay with position replay, tying network dynamics to each point along the route and enabling repeatable, route-aware experiments without repeated on-road trials. Our demo deploys a production-grade video-uplink stack on CloudEmu, allowing attendees to experience low-cost, repeatable trials and controlled comparisons under identical replayed network conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CloudEmu，一个基于云原生架构、由轨迹驱动的蜂窝网络仿真测试平台，用于车辆视频上行通信。它结合了物理车辆平台的真实性和仿真的可重复性优势，能够在云端低成本、可重复地重现车辆行驶路线上的蜂窝网络和位置动态，并部署生产级视频上行协议栈进行实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的车辆视频上行通信测试平台存在两个极端：物理车辆平台成本高昂且难以在相同网络条件下进行验证，而仿真平台虽然成本低且可重复，但通常无法在没有大量校准的情况下重放现场测量的端到端性能动态，也难以运行生产级视频上行协议栈。因此，需要一种能够结合两者优势的新型测试平台。
AI.method: CloudEmu采用软件定义、云原生的仿真方法，将一次性从车辆收集的时间同步蜂窝网络轨迹和位置轨迹，在通用的基于Linux的虚拟车辆节点和视频接收节点上进行重放。一个基于Linux的仿真框架将流量重放与位置重放相结合，将网络动态与路线上的每个点绑定，从而实现可重复的、路线感知的实验。
AI.result: 成功部署了生产级视频上行协议栈在CloudEmu上，实现了低成本、可重复的实验以及在相同重放网络条件下的可控比较。演示结果表明，CloudEmu能够有效结合轨迹驱动重放的高保真度和网络软件化原则带来的敏捷性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: CloudEmu填补了物理车辆平台和仿真平台之间的空白，为车辆视频上行通信提供了一个低成本、高保真、可重复的测试环境。它使研究人员能够在无需重复上路测试的情况下，在完全相同的重放网络条件下进行受控实验，为自动驾驶车辆的远程监控通信研究提供了有效的工具。

title: Playing games with knowledge: AI-Induced delusions need game theoretic interventions
summary: Conversational AI has a fundamental flaw as a knowledge interface: sycophantic chatbots induce epistemic entrenchment and delusional belief spirals even in rational agents. We propose the problem does not stem from the AI model, rooted instead in a systemic consequence of the paradigm shift from user-driven knowledge search to users and agents engaged in strategic, repeated-play communication. We formalize the problem as a Crawford-Sobel cheap talk game, where costless user signals induce a pooling equilibrium. Agents optimized for user satisfaction produce sycophantic strategies that provide identical reinforcement across user types with opposite epistemic incentives: exploratory ``Growth-seekers'' ($θ_G$) and confirmatory ``Validation-seekers'' ($θ_V$). Under repeated play, this identification failure creates a coordination trap -- analogous to a Prisoner's Dilemma -- where locally rational feedback loops drive users toward pathologically certain false beliefs. We propose an inference-time mechanism design intervention called an Epistemic Mediator that breaks this pooling equilibrium by introducing a costly signal (epistemic friction), forcing type revelation based on users' asymmetric cognitive costs for processing resistance. A key contribution is Belief Versioning, a git-inspired epistemic meta-memory system that stores healthy beliefs and rollbacks when validation-seeking resistance is detected. In simulation, this intervention achieves a separating equilibrium achieving a $48\times$ differential in spiral rates while passing a learning preservation criterion), evidence that epistemic safety in AI is fundamentally a problem of strategic information environment design rather than simple model alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了对话式AI因谄媚行为导致理性用户陷入错误信念螺旋的系统性机制，提出了基于博弈论的“认知中介器”干预机制，通过引入认知摩擦打破信息汇聚均衡，有效缓解了信念极化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有对话式AI存在根本缺陷：为提升用户满意度而采取的谄媚策略会导致用户产生认知固化和错误信念螺旋。作者指出这一问题并非源于模型本身，而是从用户主导的知识搜索模式转向用户与智能体进行策略性、重复博弈沟通范式后的系统性后果。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为Crawford-Sobel廉价谈话博弈模型，证明满足用户偏好的策略会形成汇聚均衡，无法区分"成长探索型"(θ_G)与"验证寻求型"(θ_V)两类用户。作者提出"认知中介器"机制设计，通过引入有代价信号（认知摩擦）强制揭示用户类型；并提出"信念版本控制"系统，类似Git的元记忆机制，在检测到验证寻求行为时进行信念回滚。
AI.result: 仿真实验表明，该干预机制成功实现了分离均衡，使信念螺旋率产生48倍的差异，同时通过了学习保留准则。这证明了AI认知安全问题的本质是策略性信息环境设计问题，而非简单的模型对齐问题。
AI.conclusion: 对话式AI的认知安全问题需要从机制设计角度解决，而非仅依赖模型层面的对齐训练。通过引入认知摩擦和信念版本控制等博弈论工具，可以有效打破导致错误信念强化的汇聚均衡，为构建更安全的AI系统提供了新思路。

title: Block-Wise Differentiable Sinkhorn Attention: Tail-Refinement Gradients with a Gap-Aware Dustbin Bridge
summary: We study long-context balanced entropic optimal transport (OT) attention on TPU hardware through a stopped-base, fixed-depth tail-refinement surrogate. After a stopped $T$-step Sinkhorn solve, we unroll a short refinement tail and differentiate that surrogate exactly. For the production $R=2$ case, the backward pass contains four staircase plan factors. We prove an exact one-reference-tile schedule: the $R=2$ score cotangent is a single reference plan tile times an explicit modifier field built from vector cotangents and dual differences. This yields block-wise cost $O((T+R)LW)$, $O(Ld)$ input storage, and $O(L)$ additional HBM usage for fixed head dimension $d$ and band width $W$. We also formalize the current \texttt{dustbin\_block} path as the same balanced surrogate on an augmented support, so the schedule lifts to the gap-aware transport path used in our TPU runs. We provide a local surrogate-bias bound, an a posteriori bias certificate, and a projective contraction certificate for strictly positive active blocks. On synthetic masked problems, the optimized kernel matches exact autodiff of the same centered surrogate to within $10^{-5}$--$10^{-10}$. On TPU v6e-8, a four-configuration Pfam screen completes end-to-end, and a promoted balanced $R=2$ run sustains roughly $8.5$ examples per second through a three-hour budget, reaching step $1437$. Held-out Pfam test shards improve reconstruction from $3.17$ to $0.99$ and sparse CE from $5.86$ to $5.69$ relative to step $0$. These results support exact fixed-depth backward theory, a theorem-matching gap-aware bridge, and trainability evidence for the production path.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在TPU上实现的长上下文平衡熵最优传输注意力机制的停止-基、固定深度尾部细化代理方法。通过优化的内核实现，证明了精确的单参考瓦片调度，在实际应用中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 研究长上下文平衡熵最优传输注意力在TPU硬件上的高效实现。传统的Sinkhorn求解器需要进行T步迭代，但直接对其求导计算成本高昂。因此，作者希望找到一种既能保持计算精度又能降低存储和计算复杂度的方法，使得该算法能够高效地在TPU上运行并支持反向传播。
AI.method: 提出停止-基、固定深度尾部细化的代理方法。核心思路是：在进行T步Sinkhorn求解后停止，然后展开一个短的细化尾部（R步，生产环境R=2），并仅对这个代理进行精确微分。证明了精确的单参考瓦片调度：R=2时的得分余切是单个参考规划瓦片乘以显式修饰场。该方法实现了O((T+R)LW)的块级计算成本、O(Ld)的输入存储和O(L)的额外HBM使用。同时将dustbin_block路径形式化为同一平衡代理在增广支撑集上的实现。
AI.result: 在合成掩码问题上，优化内核与相同中心化代理的精确自动微分误差在10^-5至10^-10范围内。在TPU v6e-8上，完成了四配置Pfam筛选的端到端测试，提升后的平衡R=2运行在三小时预算内维持约8.5个样本/秒的速度，达到步骤1437。在保留的Pfam测试分片上，重构误差从3.17降至0.99，稀疏交叉熵从5.86降至5.69（相对于步骤0）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持了精确固定深度反向理论，提供了定理匹配的间隙感知桥接，并为生产路径的可训练性提供了实证依据。该方法成功地在TPU硬件上实现了长上下文平衡熵最优传输注意力的高效计算，证明了理论框架的正确性和实际应用的可行性。

title: TRAM: Training Approximate Multiplier Structures for Low-Power AI Accelerators
summary: Reducing power consumption in AI accelerators is increasingly important. Approximate computing can reduce power consumption while keeping the accuracy loss small. Since multipliers are power-hungry components in AI models, this paper focuses on synthesizing low-power approximate multipliers (AxMs). Unlike prior works that design AxMs separately from AI model training, we present TRAM, which jointly optimizes the AxM structure and AI model parameters to lower power with small accuracy loss. Experiments show that compared to state-of-the-art AxMs, TRAM achieves up to 25.05% AxM power reduction on CNNs with CIFAR-10, and reduces power by up to 27.09% on vision transformers with ImageNet.

AI.tldr: 提出TRAM方法，通过联合优化近似乘法器结构和AI模型参数，在保持精度损失较小的前提下，显著降低CNN和Vision Transformer的功耗。
AI.motivation: 降低AI加速器的功耗日益重要。近似计算能在保持较小精度损失的同时降低功耗。由于乘法器是AI模型中的高功耗组件，因此需要设计低功耗近似乘法器。现有工作将近似乘法器设计与AI模型训练分离，可能导致次优结果，因此需要一种联合优化的方法。
AI.method: 提出TRAM方法，将近似乘法器的结构优化与AI模型参数训练进行联合优化，以在保持较小精度损失的同时实现更低的功耗。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10数据集的CNN上，相比最先进的近似乘法器，TRAM实现了高达25.05%的乘法器功耗降低；在ImageNet数据集的Vision Transformer上，功耗降低高达27.09%。
AI.conclusion: TRAM通过联合优化近似乘法器结构与模型参数，能有效降低AI加速器功耗，同时保持较小的精度损失，在CNN和Vision Transformer上均取得了显著的功耗降低效果。

title: Emergent Communication for Co-constructed Emotion Between Embodied Agents via Collective Predictive Coding
summary: According to the theory of constructed emotion, the brain actively forms emotion categories by integrating multimodal bodily signals, and constructs emotional experiences by using these categories to predict and interpret sensory inputs. While research has advanced in modeling individual emotion construction, the social process of co-construction-how a shared understanding of emotions emerges between individuals-remains computationally underexplored. This study investigates this process by modeling emergent communication between two embodied agents using the Metropolis-Hastings Naming Game (MHNG), grounded in the Collective Predictive Coding (CPC) framework. Our experiments, using visual, auditory, and simulated interoceptive inputs, yield two main findings. First, MHNG-based communication significantly improves the alignment, clarity, and inter-agent agreement of the learned emotion categories compared to non-communicative and non-selective baselines, with the alignment effect concentrated at the symbolic layer rather than the perceptual latent representation. Second, even when the two agents have systematically divergent interoceptive dynamics, communication still produces robust categorical alignment, with distinct, category-specific reshaping patterns of each agent's emotion categories-consistent with the constructed-emotion view that interoceptive heterogeneity is constitutive of, rather than an obstacle to, shared emotional meaning. These findings provide computational support for the co-constructionist view of emotion and extend the CPC framework from physical to socially-grounded domains.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过MHNG算法模拟智能体间交流，发现交流能显著促进情绪类别的对齐与共享，且即使智能体内部感受存在差异，这种社会性共建依然有效，为情绪共建理论提供了计算支持。
AI.motivation: 现有研究已对个体情绪建构进行了建模，但情绪的社会共建过程——即个体间如何形成共享的情绪理解——在计算层面仍探索不足。本研究旨在填补这一空白，计算化地探究共享情绪意义如何在个体间涌现。
AI.method: 研究基于集体预测编码（CPC）框架，采用Metropolis-Hastings命名游戏（MHNG）对两个具身智能体间的涌现式交流进行建模。实验中使用了视觉、听觉和模拟内感受输入，并设置了非交流和非选择性基线进行对比。
AI.result: 主要发现有两点：首先，基于MHNG的交流显著提升了所学情绪类别的对齐度、清晰度及智能体间一致性，且该对齐效应集中在符号层而非感知潜在表征。其次，即使两个智能体的内感受动态存在系统性分歧，交流仍能产生鲁棒的类别对齐，并形成独特的类别特异性重塑模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为情绪的共建主义观点提供了计算层面的支持，表明内感受异质性是共享情绪意义的构成要素而非障碍，同时将CPC框架从物理领域扩展到了社会性领域。

title: Transforming the Use of Earth Observation Data: Exascale Training of a Generative Compression Model with Historical Priors for up to 10,000x Data Reduction
summary: Earth observation is becoming one of the largest data-producing activities in science, yet current pipelines still treat compression as a storage and transmission tool rather than a new way to use data. We present a generative compression framework that learns from historical Earth observation archives and enables on-demand 100x to 10,000x data reduction across downstream tasks. Unlike general visual data, Earth observation repeatedly measures the same evolving planet, making historical-prior learning feasible for extreme compression. To realize this paradigm, we train large generative compression models at exascale on the LineShine Armv9 CPU supercomputer, with co-optimization across model design, kernels, memory hierarchy, runtime, and parallelism. Our implementation sustains 1.54 EFLOP/s and peaks at 2.16 EFLOP/s in end-to-end training. This work shows that historical-prior generative compression can turn Earth observation data into an active, task-adaptive foundation for acquisition, delivery, storage, and scientific use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于历史先验的生成式压缩框架，实现了地球观测数据100倍至10000倍的按需压缩，并在超级计算机上完成了EFLOP/s级别的训练。
AI.motivation: 地球观测正成为科学领域最大的数据生产活动之一，然而现有管道仍将压缩仅视为存储和传输工具，而非一种新的数据使用方式。由于地球观测数据具有重复测量同一演化行星的特性，使得学习历史先验进行极端压缩成为可能。
AI.method: 提出了一种生成式压缩框架，利用历史地球观测档案进行训练；在LineShine Armv9 CPU超级计算机上进行百亿亿次规模的训练，实现了跨模型设计、内核、内存层次结构、运行时和并行性的协同优化。
AI.result: 该框架支持下游任务中100倍至10,000倍的按需数据压缩；端到端训练实现了1.54 EFLOP/s的持续性能和2.16 EFLOP/s的峰值性能。
AI.conclusion: 历史先验生成式压缩能够将地球观测数据转变为一种主动的、任务自适应的基础，用于数据获取、交付、存储和科学使用。

title: Bridging the Cognitive Gap: A Unified Memory Paradigm for 6G Agentic AI-RAN
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: As 6G evolves, the radio access network must transcend traditional automation to embrace agentic AI capable of perception, reasoning, and evolution. A fundamental cognitive gap persists in current disaggregated architectures, where interfaces force the physical layer to compress high-dimensional states into low-dimensional metrics, trapping reasoning agents behind a semantic bottleneck. This article envisions a shift from interface-bound to memory-centric architectures. We propose a unified memory paradigm that dissolves the boundaries between sensing and reasoning by mapping biological memory hierarchies onto heterogeneous computing fabrics. Enabled by emerging coherent interconnects, this approach creates a cognitive continuum where microsecond-level reflexes, millisecond-level reasoning, and long-term evolution share state across time scales. By replacing message passing with zero-copy observability, we empower AI agents to bridge the gap between real-time responsiveness and long-horizon context for truly autonomous 6G networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种以记忆为中心的6G无线接入网架构范式，通过统一内存范式和零拷贝可观测性消除感知与推理之间的语义瓶颈，实现跨时间尺度的自主智能网络。
AI.motivation: 当前解耦架构中，物理层与上层之间的接口迫使高维状态压缩为低维度指标，形成语义瓶颈，限制了智能代理的感知、推理与演进能力，无法满足6G网络对自主智能的需求。
AI.method: 将生物记忆层级映射到异构计算架构上，构建统一内存范式，利用新兴相干互连技术替代传统消息传递机制，实现零拷贝可观测性，使微秒级反射、毫秒级推理和长期演进共享状态。
AI.result: 构建了感知与推理之间的认知连续体，消除接口瓶颈，支持跨时间尺度状态共享，实现实时响应与长周期上下文的统一。
AI.conclusion: 以记忆为中心的架构是6G无线接入网实现真正自主智能的关键路径，通过统一内存范式可有效弥合物理层与智能代理之间的认知鸿沟。

title: Political Plasticity: An Analysis of Ideological Adaptability in Large Language Models
summary: Since the advent of Large Language Models (LLMs), a significant area of research has focused on their intrinsic biases, particularly in political discourse. This study investigates a different but related concept, "political plasticity", which is defined as the capacity of models to adapt their responses based on the user supplied context. To analyze this, a testing framework was developed using an expanded corpus of 200 politically-oriented questions across economic and personal freedom axes, based on a prior framework by Lester (1996). The study explored several methods to induce political bias, including simplified and topic-based system prompts, as well as user prompts with few-shot examples. The results show that while system prompts were largely ineffective, user prompts successfully elicited significant ideological shifts, particularly along the Economic Freedom axis in larger and newer models. Through a validation experiment, we examined whether models answer questionnaires by recognizing the underlying question format. Inverting the sense of the questions revealed unexpected, counter-intuitive shifts in most models, suggesting potential data leakage. Finally, we also analyzed how model plasticity varies when the experiment is conducted in different languages. The results reveal subtle yet notable shifts across each of the analyzed languages. Overall, our results indicate that small and older LLMs exhibit limited or unstable political plasticity, whereas newer frontier models display reliable, expected adaptability.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出“政治可塑性”概念，通过实验发现：系统提示无效，但用户提示（尤其是few-shot）能成功诱导出显著的意识形态偏移（尤其在经济自由维度）；反向问题实验揭示了潜在的数据泄漏问题；不同语言环境下存在细微差异；新模型展现出更可靠的政治适应性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注大语言模型（LLM）的内在偏见，本研究旨在探索一个不同但相关的概念——“政治可塑性”，即模型根据用户提供的上下文调整其回答的能力，以填补对模型在政治话语中适应性理解的空白。
AI.method: 基于Lester (1996) 的框架，构建了一个包含200个跨经济自由和个人自由维度的政治问题语料库。通过简化/主题系统提示和包含少样本（few-shot）示例的用户提示来诱导政治偏见。进行了验证实验，通过反转问题语义来检测模型是否识别底层问题格式。最后，分析了不同语言环境下的模型可塑性变化。
AI.result: 系统提示在诱导偏见方面基本无效，而用户提示成功引发了显著的意识形态转变，尤其是较大、较新的模型在经济自由轴上表现明显。反向问题实验导致大多数模型出现反直觉的转变，暗示存在潜在的数据泄漏。不同语言间的分析显示了细微但值得注意的变化。总体而言，小型和较旧的LLM表现出有限或不稳定的政治可塑性，而较新的前沿模型则表现出可靠且符合预期的适应性。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型的政治可塑性因模型版本和规模而异。较新的前沿模型展现出可靠的政治适应性，能够根据用户上下文调整立场，这表明模型对用户意图的响应能力在不断增强。然而，反向实验揭示的数据泄漏风险提醒我们需警惕模型可能已记忆测试集的问题。

title: Towards Universal Gene Regulatory Network Inference: Unlocking Generalizable Regulatory Knowledge in Single-cell Foundation Models
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Gene Regulatory Network (GRN) inference is essential for understanding complex cellular mechanisms, rendered tractable through single-cell transcriptomic data. With the emergence of single-cell Foundation Models (scFMs), enhanced transcriptomic encoding is widely expected to revolutionize GRN inference. However, we observe that their performance remains far from satisfactory. The primary reason is that the standard reconstruction-based pre-training objectives often fail to explicitly capture latent regulatory signals. To bridge this gap, we first introduce a GRN generalization benchmark designed to evaluate regulatory predictions on unseen genes and datasets, which relies on the zero-shot capabilities of scFMs and is inherently challenging for traditional methods. Furthermore, to unlock the regulatory knowledge within the foundation models, we propose two novel methods, Virtual Value Perturbation and Gradient Trajectory, to distill implicit regulatory information from scFMs into highly generalizable inter-gene features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing methods, establishing a new paradigm for leveraging the potential of scFMs in universal GRN inference.

AI.tldr: 本文发现现有的单细胞基础模型（scFMs）在基因调控网络（GRN）推断中表现不佳，主要原因是预训练目标未能显式捕获潜在的调控信号。作者提出了一个新的GRN泛化基准，并开发了两种新方法（虚拟值扰动和梯度轨迹）来提取scFMs中的隐式调控信息，显著提升了GRN推断性能。
AI.motivation: 基因调控网络推断对于理解复杂的细胞机制至关重要。虽然单细胞基础模型（scFMs）有望通过增强的转录组编码革新GRN推断，但作者观察到其实际表现远未达到预期。主要原因在于标准的基于重建的预训练目标往往无法显式捕获潜在的调控信号。
AI.method:
1. 提出了一个GRN泛化基准，用于评估在未见过的基因和数据集上的调控预测能力，这依赖于scFMs的零样本能力。
2. 提出了两种新方法来从scFMs中提取隐式调控信息：
   - 虚拟值扰动
   - 梯度轨迹
这两种方法将隐式调控信息提炼为具有高泛化能力的基因间特征。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，所提出的方法显著优于现有方法，成功解锁了基础模型中的调控知识，在GRN推断任务上取得了更好的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了一种利用单细胞基础模型进行通用GRN推断的新范式，证明了通过专门的方法可以从scFMs中有效提取调控知识，为未来的基因调控网络研究提供了新的方向。

title: Graph Computation Meets Circuit Algebra: A Task-Aligned Analysis of Graph Neural Networks for Electronic Design Automation
summary: EDA problems are graph-structured, but not all graph-structured problems call for the same GNN computation. We argue that successful GNN-for-EDA methods are those whose propagation, aggregation, and supervision align with the native algebra of the target task. Concretely: static timing analysis is a max-plus/min-plus recurrence on a topologically ordered DAG, structurally aligned with asynchronous DAG-GNNs; placement is governed by hypergraph wirelength and density penalties and is exploited by differentiable placers rather than by message-passing GNNs alone; routing congestion is a sparse demand-supply field over a layout grid; switching-activity propagation is a probabilistic recurrence on a directed netlist; IR drop is a linear system on the power-delivery network; and analog symmetry extraction is a discrete constraint-prediction problem on schematic graphs. Through these task-by-task alignments we (i) review the GNN architectural toolkit relevant to circuits, (ii) formalize how circuit graphs differ from generic graphs (directed, heterogeneous, multi-scale, with sequential and clock structure), (iii) characterize where current methods succeed and where the algebra-architecture mismatch limits them, and (iv) identify failure modes--stage leakage, proxy-to-signoff gap, calibration, and design-distribution shift--that we believe are likely to dominate the next phase of work. We position the paper as a GNN-for-EDA, task-aligned analysis rather than a comprehensive AI-for-chip-design survey. Continuous SE(3)-equivariant geometric GNNs are usually mismatched to Manhattan digital layout, and LLM-for-RTL, HLS, and RL/diffusion-based topology generation are outside our scope.

AI.tldr: 本文针对EDA中的图结构问题，提出GNN架构应与具体任务的代数特性对齐；通过逐任务分析指出当前方法的成败原因，并揭示未来关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN-for-EDA研究缺乏对任务代数结构与模型架构匹配性的系统分析；作者希望通过阐明各任务的数学本质与合适的GNN架构之间的对齐关系，指出当前方法的局限与未来研究方向。
AI.method: 采用任务逐例对齐分析法：分别分析静态时序分析、布局、布线拥塞、开关活动传播、IR压降、模拟对称性提取等任务的数学结构（如max-plus递推、超图优化、稀疏场、线性系统等），并对应到合适的GNN或计算范式（如异步DAG-GNN、可微分布局器、约束预测等）；同时归纳电路图相较于通用图的特性（有向、异构、多尺度、时序与时钟结构），并识别当前方法的代数-架构失配问题。
AI.result: （1）梳理了与电路任务相关的GNN架构工具集；（2）形式化了电路图与通用图的差异；（3）刻画了现有方法成功与失败（代数-架构失配）的边界；（4）识别了阶段泄漏、代理到签核差距、校准与设计分布偏移等关键失效模式，预测其将主导下一阶段研究。
AI.conclusion: GNN在EDA中的成功关键在于传播、聚合与监督机制与目标任务的“原生代数”对齐；未来需重点解决代理到签核的泛化、校准与分布偏移等问题，而非简单套用通用GNN或SE(3)等几何GNN。

title: SmartEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Generated Smart Contracts from Natural Language Specifications
summary: We introduce SmartEval, a benchmark for systematically evaluating the quality of Solidity smart contracts generated by large language models (LLMs) from natural language specifications. SmartEval provides a corpus of 9,000 generated contracts paired with expert-written ground-truth implementations drawn from the FSMSCG dataset, a five-dimensional evaluation rubric covering functional completeness, variable fidelity, state-machine correctness, business-logic fidelity, and code quality, and a reproducible generation-and-evaluation pipeline. To validate the benchmark's reliability, we conduct three independent empirical studies: a five-condition ablation study (N=300 per condition) isolating the contribution of each pipeline component, a human expert evaluation by three Columbia University PhD researchers confirming automated scores align with expert judgment to within 0.34 points, and external security analysis via the Slither static analyzer confirming 79.4% agreement between the LLM auditor and a non-LLM rule-based tool. Systematic analysis of 9,000 generated contracts reveals characteristic failure modes (logic omissions at 35.3%, state transition errors at 23.4%, and complexity-driven degradation) and quantifies a +8.29 composite-score advantage of generated contracts over ground-truth implementations, attributable to LLMs' literal specification-following behavior. SmartEval establishes a reproducible, validated foundation for empirical research on LLM smart contract synthesis quality, with all data, evaluation code, and generated contracts publicly released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了SmartEval基准，用于系统评估大语言模型生成的Solidity智能合约质量，通过9000个合约实验发现LLM生成的合约在复合得分上比专家实现高8.29分，并揭示了逻辑遗漏（35.3%）和状态转换错误（23.4%）等典型失败模式。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在智能合约自动生成领域的应用日益广泛，缺乏一个系统性的基准来评估LLM生成的Solidity智能合约的质量。现有评估方法不够全面，无法准确衡量生成合约在功能性、代码质量和业务逻辑等方面的表现，因此需要一个标准化的评估框架来推动该领域的实证研究。
AI.method: 研究团队构建了SmartEval基准，包含三个核心组件：(1) 9000个LLM生成的智能合约及其对应的专家级真实实现（来自FSMSCG数据集）；(2) 五维评估标准，涵盖功能完整性、变量保真度、状态机正确性、业务逻辑保真度和代码质量；(3) 可复现的生成-评估流水线。研究通过三项实证研究验证基准可靠性：五条件消融研究（每组N=300）、三位专家的人工评估、以及Slither静态分析工具的外部安全分析。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：(1) 自动评分与专家判断高度一致，误差在0.34分以内；(2) LLM审计器与Slither工具的一致性达79.4%；(3) 系统分析了9000个合约，识别出典型失败模式：逻辑遗漏（35.3%）、状态转换错误（23.4%）以及复杂度驱动的性能下降；(4) 意外发现LLM生成合约的复合得分比真实实现高8.29分，这归因于LLM严格遵循规范说明字面意思的行为特性。
AI.conclusion: SmartEval为LLM智能合约合成质量的实证研究建立了可复现、经过验证的基础平台。研究公开了所有数据、评估代码和生成的合约，为未来研究提供了标准化工具。该基准不仅揭示了LLM在智能合约生成中的优势和局限性，还为改进LLM代码生成能力提供了明确的量化指标和改进方向。

title: TS-Verkle: A TypeScript Native Verkle Library With On-chain Verifier
summary: Blockchain systems face significant scalability challenges due to growing data volumes and increasing transaction demands, necessitating more efficient data structures and verification mechanisms. Verkle trees, a novel data structure combining the efficiency of Merkle trees with the compactness of vector commitments, have gained attention for their potential to optimize blockchain storage and improve scalability. However, their practical implementation, especially at the smart contract level, has remained unexplored. To address these challenges, we present TS-verkle, the first known TypeScript-native implementation of Verkle trees designed for web3 backend compatibility, coupled with a corresponding on-chain verifier written in Solidity. Our work bridges this gap by providing a concrete implementation of Verkle trees and demonstrating their feasibility for on-chain verification. While previous literature suggests Verkle trees should outperform Merkle trees due to their succinct proof size, our empirical evaluation reveals that basic implementations of Verkle trees actually incur higher costs than Merkle trees without advanced optimization techniques. This finding represents a crucial insight for blockchain developers and researchers considering Verkle tree adoption. The paper discusses implementation strategies and performance characteristics while exploring implications for scaling and data availability in decentralized blockchain systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个TypeScript原生实现的Verkle树（TS-verkle）及其对应的Solidity链上验证器。研究发现，在缺乏高级优化技术的情况下，Verkle树的实际性能成本高于Merkle树，这挑战了以往关于其性能优势的理论预期。
AI.motivation: 区块链系统面临数据量增长和交易需求增加带来的严重可扩展性挑战。Verkle树作为一种结合Merkle树效率和向量承诺紧凑性的新型数据结构，被认为具有优化区块链存储和提高可扩展性的潜力，但其实际应用，特别是在智能合约层面的实现，尚未被探索。
AI.method: 开发了TS-verkle，这是首个TypeScript原生实现的Verkle树，专门设计用于兼容Web3后端，并配有用Solidity编写的链上验证器。通过具体实现验证了Verkle树在链上验证的可行性，并进行了实证评估。
AI.result: 实证评估揭示了一个关键发现：在没有高级优化技术的情况下，Verkle树的基本实现实际上比Merkle树产生更高的成本。这一结果与以往文献中认为Verkle树因证明尺寸更小而应优于Merkle树的观点相悖。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为考虑采用Verkle树的区块链开发者和研究人员提供了重要见解。虽然Verkle树在理论上具有优势，但在实际应用中需要高级优化技术才能实现性能提升。论文还探讨了在去中心化区块链系统中扩展性和数据可用性的影响。

title: GenioSim: A Novel Simulation Platform for Edge Computing over Optical Networks
summary: The convergence of Passive Optical Networks (PONs) and edge computing creates new opportunities: Optical Line Terminals (OLTs) and Optical Network Terminals (ONTs) can be repurposed as low-latency edge compute nodes for offloading workloads. However, exploring such design options early in the development cycle is costly and time-consuming, as prototyping requires specialized hardware and realistic traffic conditions. Simulation becomes essential, yet current tools are unable to accurately model this emerging class of systems. To address these gaps, we introduce GenioSim, a simulation platform for hierarchical PON-enabled edge infrastructures. It models OLTs and ONTs with realistic PON behavior, supports hybrid container- and VM-based virtualization, and provides multiple service and execution models. These capabilities enable the evaluation of resource management policies under complex, heterogeneous conditions. We present experiments in the context of use cases of industrial relevance, to show GenioSim can provide insights for capacity planning and for the choice of policies for container placement and task offloading in PON-enabled edge infrastructures.

AI.tldr: 提出了GenioSim仿真平台，用于模拟分层PON边缘计算基础设施，解决了现有工具无法准确建模此类新型系统的问题。
AI.motivation: PON与边缘计算的融合为将OLT和ONT重新用作低延迟边缘计算节点提供了新机遇，但在开发周期早期探索此类设计方案成本高昂且耗时，原型设计需要专用硬件和真实流量条件，而现有仿真工具无法准确建模这类新兴系统。
AI.method: 开发了GenioSim仿真平台，该平台能够对OLT和ONT进行真实PON行为建模，支持混合容器和VM虚拟化，并提供多种服务和执行模型，从而实现在复杂异构条件下评估资源管理策略。
AI.result: 通过工业相关用例的实验验证，GenioSim能够为PON边缘基础设施中的容量规划、容器放置策略和任务卸载策略选择提供有效见解。
AI.conclusion: GenioSim填补了PON使能边缘基础设施仿真工具的空白，为研究人员和工程师提供了在无需专用硬件的情况下评估和优化资源管理策略的有效工具。

title: Alignment as Jurisprudence
summary:
