Jurisprudence, the study of how judges should properly decide cases, and alignment, the science of getting AI models to conform to human values, share a fundamental structure. These seemingly distant fields both seek to predict and shape how decisions by powerful actors, in one case judges and in the other increasingly powerful artificial intelligences, will be made in the unknown future. And they use similar tools of the specification and interpretation of language to try to accomplish those goals. The great debates of jurisprudence, about what the law is and what it should be, can provide insight into alignment, and lessons from what does and does not work in alignment can help make progress in jurisprudence.
  This essay puts the two fields directly into conversation. Drawing on leading accounts of jurisprudence, particularly Dworkin's principle-oriented interpretivism and Sunstein's positivist account of law as analogical reasoning, and on cutting-edge alignment approaches, namely Constitutional AI and case-based reasoning, it illustrates the value of a more sophisticated legally-inspired approach to the interplay of rules and cases in finetuning alignment and points to ways that AI can provide a better understanding of how the law works and how it can be improved by the introduction of AI. AI systems and the law should operate to empower people to act in the world, helping to expand their capabilities and the extent to which they are able to achieve their goals. As AI continues to improve in capacity, and as the constraints that legal theory places on human judges seem be coming undone, the conversation between these two fields will become increasingly essential and may help point to a better version of both.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了法理学与AI对齐研究在结构上具有根本相似性，通过引入德沃金的解释主义和森斯坦的类比推理等法学理论来改进Constitutional AI等对齐方法，同时指出AI研究也能反过来促进法学理论的发展。
AI.motivation: 法理学与AI对齐研究这两个看似相距甚远的领域实际上共享着根本性的结构相似性：两者都试图预测和塑造强大决策者（法官或人工智能）在未知未来中的决策行为，并且都使用语言规范与解释作为核心工具。作者希望将这两个领域直接对话，探索它们之间相互启发的可能性。
AI.method: 采用跨学科比较分析方法，将法理学中的经典理论（德沃金以原则为导向的解释主义、森斯坦将法律视为类比推理的实证主义观点）与AI对齐领域的前沿方法（Constitutional AI和基于案例的推理）进行平行对照，重点探讨规则与案例在微调对齐过程中的相互作用机制。
AI.result: 研究揭示了法学启发式方法对AI对齐的价值，展示了更复杂的规则与案例互动机制如何改进对齐效果；同时发现AI研究能够深化对法律运作机制的理解，并为法律改进提供新视角。作者提出AI系统与法律应当共同致力于赋能人类行动，扩展人们的能力和目标实现程度。
AI.conclusion: 随着AI能力的持续提升以及法学理论对人类法官约束力的减弱，法理学与AI对齐研究之间的对话将变得越来越关键。这种跨领域交流不仅有助于发展更好的AI对齐方法，也可能指向两个领域的共同改进方向，最终服务于增强人类能力和实现人类目标这一根本宗旨。

title: Towards Customized Multimodal Role-Play
comment: Code available at https://github.com/Tangc03/UniCharacter Project page available at https://tangc03.github.io/UniCharacter.github.io/
summary: Unified multimodal understanding and generation models enable richer human-AI interaction. Yet jointly customizing a character's persona, dialogue style, and visual identity while maintaining output consistency across modalities remains largely unexplored. To mitigate this gap, we introduce a new task, Customized Multimodal Role-Play (CMRP). We construct the RoleScape-20 dataset comprising 20 characters, including training and evaluation data that cover persona, stylistic descriptions, visual/expressive cues, and text-image interactions. Building on a unified model, we devise UniCharacter, a two-stage training framework containing Unified Supervised Finetuning (Unified-SFT) and character-specific group relative policy optimization (Character-GRPO). Given only 10 images plus corresponding interaction examples, the model acquires the target character and exhibits coherent persona, style, and visual identity in both generated text and images. This process takes about 100 GPU hours. Experiments on the RoleScape-20 dataset show that the proposed method substantially outperforms prior approaches. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of our cross-modal consistency design and few-shot customization strategy. We argue that CMRP, coupled with unified modeling, provides a basis for next-generation characterful and immersive interactive agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了定制化多模态角色扮演（CMRP）任务，构建了RoleScape-20数据集，并开发了UniCharacter两阶段训练框架，仅需10张图像即可实现角色个性化的一致性文本与图像生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的统一多模态理解和生成模型在联合定制角色的性格、对话风格和视觉身份方面仍存在空白，难以在多模态输出中保持一致性。
AI.method: 构建了包含20个角色的RoleScape-20数据集；提出了UniCharacter两阶段训练框架：(1) 统一监督微调（Unified-SFT），(2) 角色特定的组相对策略优化（Character-GRPO）。该方法仅需10张图像及对应交互示例，耗时约100 GPU小时。
AI.result: 在RoleScape-20数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著优于现有方法；消融实验验证了跨模态一致性设计和少样本定制策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CMRP任务与统一建模相结合，为下一代具有鲜明角色特征和沉浸感的交互智能体奠定了基础。

title: Non-Monotonic Latency in Apple MPS Decoding: KV Cache Interactions and Execution Regimes
summary: Autoregressive inference is typically assumed to scale predictably with decoding length, and key-value (KV) caching is widely regarded as a universally beneficial optimization for accelerating decoding. In this work, we identify unexpected non-monotonic latency behavior in the Apple MPS backend, where latency changes abruptly across nearby decoding configurations. Using transformer models from multiple families (GPT-2, BLOOM, and OPT), we observe latency spikes of up to 21x within specific decoding-budget intervals, followed by recovery at neighboring configurations. Controlled experiments show that these anomalies are not explained by memory pressure or prefill cost, but are instead consistent with backend execution dynamics, while CPU and NVIDIA T4 (CUDA) exhibit smooth monotonic scaling under identical conditions. Our findings highlight the importance of hardware-aware evaluation for autoregressive inference and caution against relying on aggregated decoding-budget benchmarks, as performance can vary discontinuously across nearby configurations.

AI.tldr: 在Apple MPS后端上，自回归推理的延迟表现出非单调性，在特定解码预算区间内出现高达21倍的延迟突刺，而相同条件下的CPU和NVIDIA T4则表现平滑。
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍假设自回归推理延迟随解码长度可预测地扩展，且KV缓存被广泛视为普遍有益的加速优化。作者旨在挑战这一假设，探究硬件后端对推理延迟的实际影响。
AI.method: 使用多个Transformer模型家族（GPT-2、BLOOM和OPT），在Apple MPS后端进行控制实验，对比分析不同解码配置下的延迟行为，同时在CPU和NVIDIA T4（CUDA）上进行相同条件的对照实验。
AI.result: 在Apple MPS后端观察到非单调延迟行为，在特定解码预算区间内出现高达21倍的延迟突刺，相邻配置后又恢复正常；控制实验表明这些异常并非由内存压力或预填充成本解释，而是与后端执行动态一致；CPU和NVIDIA T4在相同条件下表现平滑单调扩展。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了硬件感知评估对自回归推理的重要性，警示不应依赖聚合解码预算基准测试，因为性能可能在与邻近配置间呈现不连续变化。

title: SAGE: Scalable Agentic Grounded Evaluation for Crop Disease Diagnosis
summary: Plant disease diagnosis is critical for food security, yet training disease-recognition models that generalize across crops, pathogens, and field conditions remains challenging because labeled disease images are far less abundant and standardized than data for other biotic stresses such as insects or weeds. Frontier vision-language models offer new opportunities through improved visual reasoning, but they still struggle with fine-grained disease identification due to the lack of structured, crop-specific symptom knowledge. To address this gap, we curate the largest plant disease image--symptom dataset to date, covering 335 crops, 1{,}251 disease classes, and approximately 839K images, designed to support training-free, agentic disease prediction. A scalable automated pipeline generates source-grounded symptom descriptions in which each claim is linked to a verbatim web quote; domain experts validate sampled crops and reconcile disease-name variants across sources. As a baseline, we introduce an autonomous visual reasoning agent that identifies anatomical context, narrows candidate diseases using symptom knowledge, sequentially compares reference images, and produces a fully explainable reasoning trace. Incorporating symptom knowledge improves accuracy by 16.2 percentage points on average at the full reference budget, with consistent gains across all four evaluation crops. Because the framework only requires crop-specific reference images and symptom knowledge, it can be extended to new crops without retraining, while the agentic baseline can directly benefit from future improvements in foundation model capabilities. Dataset and code are available at:https://sage-dataset.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了目前最大的植物病害图像-症状数据集（涵盖335种作物、1251个病害类别、约83.9万张图像），并提出了一种无需训练的智能体病害预测方法，通过引入症状知识使诊断准确率平均提升16.2个百分点，且无需重新训练即可扩展至新作物。
AI.motivation: 植物病害诊断对粮食安全至关重要，但现有病害识别模型在跨作物、病原体和田间条件下的泛化能力有限，主要瓶颈在于标注病害图像数量不足且缺乏标准化。尽管前沿视觉语言模型提供了新机遇，但它们仍难以进行细粒度病害识别，根本原因在于缺乏结构化、作物特异性的症状知识。
AI.method: （1）数据集构建：通过可扩展的自动化流程生成有来源依据的症状描述，每个声明均链接至网络原文引用，并由领域专家验证采样作物并协调跨来源的病害名称变体，构建了涵盖335种作物、1251个病害类别、约83.9万张图像的数据集；（2）智能体设计：提出一种自主视觉推理智能体作为基线，该方法识别解剖学背景，利用症状知识缩小候选疾病范围，顺序比较参考图像，并生成完全可解释的推理轨迹，实现免训练的病害预测。
AI.result: 在四种评估作物上均取得一致提升，引入症状知识后在完整参考预算下平均准确率提高16.2个百分点。由于框架仅需作物特异性参考图像和症状知识，可无重训练扩展至新作物。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过构建大规模、高质量的植物病害图像-症状数据集，成功解决了视觉语言模型在细粒度病害识别中症状知识缺失的问题。提出的免训练智能体框架不仅显著提升了诊断准确率，还具有良好的可解释性和可扩展性，为植物病害智能诊断提供了新的解决方案，并将随着基础模型能力的提升而持续受益。

title: MegaScale-Omni: A Hyper-Scale, Workload-Resilient System for MultiModal LLM Training in Production
summary: As the foundational component of versatile AI applications, training an multimodal large language model (MLLM) relies on multimodal datasets with dynamic modality mixture proportions and sample length distributions. However, existing MLLM systems remain inefficient under dynamic workloads, due to statically coupled decisions of resource allocation and model parallelization between encoders and the LLM backbone. This paper presents MegaScale-Omni, an industrial-grade MLLM training system tailored for dynamic workload adaption and hyper-scale deployment. MegaScale-Omni is built upon the training scheme of encoder-LLM multiplexing with three key innovations: (1) Decoupled parallelism strategies with long-short sequence parallelism for encoders to process variable-length samples, and full-fledged 5D parallelism for the LLM backbone, both organized under a communication-efficient parallelization layout. (2) Unified encoder-LLM representations for flexible, extensible colocation, and a new paradigm of encoder-LLM joint pipeline with workload resilience. (3) Workload balancing techniques via decentralized grouped reordering in data loaders and adaptive resharding from encoder to LLM ranks. MegaScale-Omni is deployed as the foundation of our in-house large-scale MLLM training tasks with thousands of GPUs. Our experimental results demonstrate $1.27\times$-$7.57\times$ throughput improvement under production-grade dynamic workloads, as compared to four state-of-the-art systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MegaScale-Omni，一个面向动态负载的大规模多模态大语言模型（MLLM）训练系统。通过解耦并行策略、统一表示和负载均衡技术，解决了现有系统在动态工作负载下的低效问题，实现了显著的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的MLLM训练系统在处理具有动态模态混合比例和样本长度分布的多模态数据集时效率低下，主要原因是编码器与LLM骨干网络之间的资源分配和模型并行化决策静态耦合，无法适应动态工作负载的变化。
AI.method: 提出MegaScale-Omni系统，基于编码器-LLM复用训练方案，包含三项核心创新：（1）解耦并行策略：编码器采用长短序列并行处理变长样本，LLM骨干采用完整的5D并行，均组织在通信高效的并行化布局下；（2）统一编码器-LLM表示以实现灵活可扩展的共存，并提出具有负载弹性的编码器-LLM联合流水线新范式；（3）通过数据加载器中的去中心化分组重排序和编码器到LLM秩的自适应重分片实现负载均衡。
AI.result: MegaScale-Omni已部署于内部大规模MLLM训练任务，使用数千个GPU。实验结果表明，在生产级动态工作负载下，相比四个最先进的系统，实现了1.27倍至7.57倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.conclusion: MegaScale-Omni成功解决了动态工作负载下的MLLM训练效率问题，通过解耦设计、统一表示和负载均衡技术，实现了工业级的大规模部署，显著提升了训练性能，为大规模MLLM训练提供了有效的系统解决方案。

title: In-Network Artificial Computing Enhanced Light Model-Switching for Emergency Communications Networks
summary: Emergency communications networks require in-network intelligence for timely traffic handling under dynamic demands and runtime constraints. In these environments, packets may need different inference behaviors, and conventional model replacement via control-plane updates is too slow for responsive operation. We propose an in-network artificial computing framework with lightweight model-switching, where multiple Binary Neural Network (BNN) models are kept resident within a shared execution framework. Packet metadata selects the active model at packet granularity with O(1) selection cost. A fixed 1024-byte payload is aligned with x86 AVX-512, enabling efficient memory access. The framework is realized on an eBPF/XDP + AF_XDP stack. Experimental results show that the system sustains 1.894 Mpps with a 0.528 us inference latency, while model selection adds only 0.005 us. Our results demonstrate that different resident models induce distinct packet-processing behaviors, that scaling to 16 slots preserves low switching overhead, and that online model switching completes without wrong-verdict packets. These results show the practicality of lightweight in-network artificial computing on commodity hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个具备轻量级模型切换能力的网络内人工智能计算框架，通过在共享执行框架中驻留多个二值神经网络（BNN）模型，实现了数据包粒度的模型选择，在商用硬件上达到了1.894 Mpps的吞吐量和0.528 us的推理延迟，模型切换开销仅为0.005 us。
AI.motivation: 应急通信网络需要在动态需求和运行时约束下进行及时流量处理的网络内智能。在此类环境中，不同数据包可能需要不同的推理行为，而传统的通过控制平面更新进行模型替换的方式响应速度过慢，无法满足快速响应操作的需求。
AI.method: 提出了一种具备轻量级模型切换的网络内人工智能计算框架，其中多个二值神经网络（BNN）模型驻留在共享执行框架内。利用数据包元数据在数据包粒度上以O(1)的选择成本选择活动模型。采用固定1024字节载荷与x86 AVX-512对齐，以实现高效内存访问。该框架基于eBPF/XDP + AF_XDP协议栈实现。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该系统在0.528 us的推理延迟下可维持1.894 Mpps的吞吐量，而模型选择仅增加0.005 us的开销。不同的驻留模型会引发不同的数据包处理行为，扩展至16个槽位仍能保持较低的切换开销，且在线模型切换过程中不会产生错误判决的数据包。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果证明了在商用硬件上实现轻量级网络内人工智能计算的实用性，为应急通信网络等需要快速响应和动态推理行为调整的场景提供了有效的解决方案。

title: The Attacker in the Mirror: Breaking Self-Consistency in Safety via Anchored Bipolicy Self-Play
summary: Self-play red team is an established approach to improving AI safety in which different instances of the same model play attacker and defender roles in a zero-sum game, i.e., where the attacker tries to jailbreak the defender; if self-play converges to a Nash equilibrium, the model is guaranteed to respond safely within the settings of the game. Although the parameter sharing enforced by the use of the same model for the two roles improves stability and performance, it introduces fundamental theoretical and architectural limitations. We show that the set of Nash equilibria that can be reached corresponds to a broad class of behaviours that includes trivial always refuse strategies and oracle-like defenders, thus limiting practical applicability. We then show that when attacker and defender share and update the same base model, the dynamics collapse to self-consistency, so that attacks do not enforce adversarial pressure on the defender. In response, we propose Anchored Bipolicy Self-Play, which trains distinct role-specific LoRA adapters on top of a frozen base model, thereby maintaining stable optimisation while preserving adversarial pressure through explicit role separation. In relation to standard self-play, we show up to 100x greater parameter efficiency than finetuning and consistent improvements in safety compared to self-play fine-tuned models. We evaluate on Qwen2.5-{3B, 7B,14B}-IT models across widely used safety benchmarks, showing improved robustness without loss of reasoning ability. Cross-play experiments further show that our attacker and defender models are superior to self-play in terms of adversarial defence and safety.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了传统自博弈红队测试存在纳什均衡质量差、攻击压力失效的理论缺陷，并提出Anchored Bipolicy Self-Play方法，通过冻结基座模型并训练独立的角色特定LoRA适配器，实现了更高效的参数利用与更好的安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有的自博弈红队测试方法虽然通过参数共享提高了稳定性，但存在根本性的理论与架构局限：其可达的纳什均衡集包含无实际价值的“总是拒绝”策略和预言机式防御者，限制了实用性；且攻击者与防御者共享并更新同一基座模型会导致动力学坍缩为自洽性，使攻击无法对防御者施加有效的对抗压力。
AI.method: 提出Anchored Bipolicy Self-Play（锚定双策略自博弈）方法。该方法在冻结的基座模型之上，分别为攻击者和防御者训练独立的、角色特定的LoRA适配器。这种设计在保持优化稳定性的同时，通过显式的角色分离保留了对抗压力，避免了模型坍缩。
AI.result: 相比标准自博弈微调，该方法在参数效率上提升高达100倍，并在安全性上取得一致改善。在Qwen2.5-{3B, 7B, 14B}-IT模型及多个主流安全基准上的评估表明，该方法在不损失推理能力的前提下提升了鲁棒性。交叉博弈实验进一步证实，其生成的攻击与防御模型在对抗防御和安全性方面均优于传统自博弈方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦攻击者与防御者的参数更新路径，Anchored Bipolicy Self-Play成功克服了传统自博弈红队测试的理论局限，为AI安全训练提供了一种参数高效、理论合理且性能优越的新范式。

title: Additive Atomic Forests for Symbolic Function and Antiderivative Discovery
summary:
We present a framework for the simultaneous symbolic recovery of a function and its antiderivative from data. The framework rests on three ideas. First, a derivative algebra: the observation that the product rule $\frac{d}{dx}[f \cdot g] = f'g + fg'$ and the chain rule, applied to a seed set of elementary functions, generate a self-expanding system of function-derivative pairs -- a living library that grows each time a new function is discovered. Second, two complementary primitives -- EML$\,(e^u - \ln v)$, which is theoretically complete for all elementary functions, and SOL$\,(\sin u - \cos v)$, introduced here, which makes trigonometric atoms available at depth~1 instead of depth~$\sim$8 -- that seed the library with core atoms cheaply. Third, additive atomic forests: finite sums of primitive trees, optionally composed via multiplicative nodes, whose derivatives are fitted to data by continuous optimisation or by exhaustive search over the library. Because differentiation of each atom is determined by construction, the forest simultaneously encodes a symbolic expression $F$ and its derivative $F'$; no symbolic integration step is required.
  The library is not a fixed object: it self-constructs from a small seed set by recursive application of the product rule, chain rule, and the two primitives, and it can grow as newly discovered functions are folded back in. The larger the library, the richer the expressible class of candidate functions. We give conditional completeness, additive-depth, and analytic simultaneous-recovery results for the framework. Empirically, in our reported runs on 17 classification benchmarks, sparse atom combinations match or exceed XGBoost on 13 datasets while producing interpretable formulas.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个能同时恢复函数及其原函数的符号表达式框架，在17个分类基准测试中有13个匹配或超越XGBoost，同时生成可解释的公式。
AI.motivation: 传统的符号回归方法通常无法同时恢复函数及其导数，而导数关系对于理解函数结构和简化符号积分具有重要意义。本文旨在构建一个能够同时从数据中恢复函数及其原函数符号表达式的统一框架。
AI.method: 核心方法包含三个组成部分：(1) 导数代数——利用乘积法则和链式法则从基础函数集生成自扩展的函数-导数对系统；(2) 两个互补原语EML和SOL，用于高效地用核心原子初始化库；(3) 加性原子森林——通过连续优化或穷举搜索拟合数据导数，同时编码函数F及其导数F'。该方法不需要符号积分步骤，因为每个原子的导数在构建时就已确定。
AI.result: 给出了框架的条件完备性、加性深度和解析同时恢复的理论结果。在17个分类基准测试的实验中，稀疏原子组合在13个数据集上匹配或超越XGBoost的性能，同时生成具有可解释性的数学公式。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功实现了函数及其原函数的同时符号恢复，理论分析证明了其条件完备性，实验验证了其在保持可解释性的同时具有竞争力或更优的预测性能，为符号回归领域提供了一种有效的新方法。

title: Arcane: An Assertion Reduction Framework through Semantic Clustering and MCTS-Guided Rule Exploring
summary: Assertion-based Verification (ABV) is essential for ensuring that hardware designs conform to their intended specifications. However, existing automated assertion-generation approaches, such as LLM-based frameworks, often generate large numbers of redundant assertions, which significantly degrade simulation efficiency. To mitigate the simulation overhead caused by redundant assertions, this paper proposes Arcane, an efficient assertion reduction framework. It integrates a two-tier assertion clustering approach for accurate semantic classification of large assertion sets, and employs Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to explore optimal rule-application sequences for efficient assertion reduction. The experimental results on Assertionbench [20] show that Arcane achieves a reduction of up to 76.2% in the assertion count while fully preserving formal coverage and mutation-detection ability. Further simulation studies demonstrate a speedup of 2.6x to 6.1x speedup in simulation time. The proposed framework is released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Arcane1-0A6F/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Arcane框架，通过两层级断言聚类和蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）技术减少冗余断言，在Assertionbench基准上实现最高76.2%的断言数量削减，仿真速度提升2.6x至6.1x，同时完全保留形式化覆盖率和变异检测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动化断言生成方法（如基于LLM的框架）会产生大量冗余断言，导致仿真效率显著下降，亟需一种有效方法在保证验证质量的前提下减少冗余断言。
AI.method: 提出Arcane框架，采用两层级断言聚类方法对大规模断言集进行精确语义分类，并利用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）探索最优规则应用序列以实现高效的断言缩减。
AI.result: 在Assertionbench基准测试上，Arcane实现了最高76.2%的断言数量削减，仿真速度提升2.6x至6.1x，同时完全保留了形式化覆盖率和变异检测能力。
AI.conclusion: Arcane框架能够有效解决断言冗余问题，在大幅减少断言数量和提升仿真效率的同时，确保验证质量不受损失，为硬件设计验证提供了实用的解决方案。

title: CalBench: Evaluating Coordination-Privacy Trade-offs in Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: We introduce CalBench, a controlled evaluation environment for studying multi-agent coordination through calendar scheduling. In CalBench, N agents each manage a private calendar containing pre-existing commitments and must coordinate to schedule a stream of M incoming meetings while minimizing disruption costs. Because agents observe only their own calendars, successful scheduling requires communication across private information boundaries. Each scenario is generated with an oracle solution, enabling precise measurement of coordination quality via realized-to-optimal cost, as well as a Distributed Constraint Optimization (DCOP) baseline to provide a fair comparison under the same private-information constraints. CalBench enables precise verification of task success, communication efficiency, and fairness in the distribution of disruption costs. Our environment also studies privacy-preserving coordination by augmenting calendar entries with private semantic contexts of varying sensitivity and measuring whether agents reveal task-irrelevant private information during negotiation. Unlike multi-agent benchmarks where a single capable agent can often substitute for the group, CalBench is inherently decentralized: no agent has access to another agent's private calendar, yet agents must still reach mutually consistent decisions over shared meeting scheduling. CalBench therefore provides a practical and verifiable setting for studying coordination protocols, communication efficiency, negotiation strategies, fairness, and privacy leakage in multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了CalBench，一个用于研究多智能体协调的日历调度控制评估环境。在该环境中，N个智能体各自管理包含既有承诺的私有日历，必须协调调度M个会议并最小化干扰成本。由于智能体只能观察自己的日历，成功调度需要跨越私有信息边界进行通信。该环境支持精确测量协调质量、任务成功、通信效率和公平性，并研究隐私保护协调问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体基准测试中，单个能力强的智能体往往可以替代整个群体，缺乏真正的去中心化协调场景。同时，现有研究缺乏对隐私保护协调、通信效率、公平性等多维度评估的可控环境。因此需要一个能够精确验证任务成功、通信效率、公平性和隐私泄露的实用可验证环境。
AI.method: 构建CalBench评估环境：1）N个智能体各自管理私有日历，包含既有承诺；2）协调调度M个传入会议流，最小化干扰成本；3）每个场景生成带有Oracle最优解，通过已实现成本与最优成本的比值衡量协调质量；4）提供分布式约束优化（DCOP）基线作为公平比较基准；5）为日历条目添加不同敏感度的私有语义上下文，评估智能体是否在协商中泄露任务无关的私有信息。
AI.result: CalBench实现了精确的任务成功验证、通信效率测量和干扰成本分配的公平性评估。环境能够测量协调质量（通过已实现成本与最优成本比值），提供DCOP基线比较，并成功评估隐私保护协调能力，检测智能体在协商过程中是否泄露任务无关的私有信息。该环境本质上具有去中心化特性：没有智能体能访问其他智能体的私有日历，但智能体仍需对共享会议调度达成一致决策。
AI.conclusion: CalBench为研究多智能体系统中的协调协议、通信效率、协商策略、公平性和隐私泄露提供了一个实用且可验证的实验平台，填补了现有基准测试的空白，推动了多智能体协调研究的发展。

title: Light Cone Consistency: Toward a Unified Theory of Consistency in Message-Passing Systems
comment: 25 pages, 13 tables. Preprint of work in progress; an extended version is planned for submission to DISC 2026
summary:
Every distributed system -- databases, networks, postal services, CPU caches -- is a message-passing system. Every message-passing system is a growing causal log observed by a set of observers. We present Light Cone Consistency (LCC), a framework that describes every known consistency model as a configuration of three constraints on each observer's visible sub-DAG: causal closure $C(\mathrm{deps})$, fork resolution $O(π)$, and timeliness $R(δ)$, plus an orthogonal return-value function $F$. We map 85 configurations, covering all 50+ named models from Viotti and Vukolic's taxonomy, with caveats for fork-based and probabilistic models.
  We show that three impossibility results of distributed computing -- CAP, FLP, and AFC -- each constrain exactly one pair of parameters, and prove they are minimal and independent. Our central result is the observation that these three constraints are fully entangled: violation of any one surface cascades to the other two, because restoring any parameter requires messages -- and those messages are subject to all three constraints. The three parameters and their pairwise impossibility surfaces form a fully connected triangle. Every distributed system must exit the triangle by relaxing at least one parameter. The triangle activates only when the system is in use: $C 
eq \mathrm{none}$, $O 
eq \mathrm{trivial}$, or $R 
eq \mathrm{absent}$ each introduces a constraint that exposes the system to the surfaces. A system that demands nothing -- or writes far slower than its propagation delay -- is trivially linearizable. We identify open problems including a conjectured fourth surface (log locality), undiscovered constraints, and the universality of the safety-liveness fork as the consequence of crossing any boundary.

AI.tldr: 提出光锥一致性（LCC）框架，将所有已知一致性模型统一为三个约束参数的配置，并揭示CAP、FLP、AFC三个不可能性结果形成完全连接的三角形约束关系。
AI.motivation: 现有的分布式系统一致性模型繁多且缺乏统一的理论框架，需要建立一个统一的视角来描述和分析各种一致性模型及其内在约束关系。
AI.method: 将每个一致性模型表示为观察者可见子DAG上的三个约束配置：因果闭包C(deps)、分叉解析O(π)和时效性R(δ)，加上正交的返回值函数F；映射了85种配置覆盖Viotti和Vukolic分类中的50+种命名模型。
AI.result: 发现CAP、FLP、AFC三个不可能性结果各自精确约束一对参数且相互独立最小；三个约束完全纠缠——违反任一约束会级联影响其他两个；三个参数及其成对不可能性表面形成完全连接的三角形，每个分布式系统必须通过放松至少一个参数退出该三角形。
AI.conclusion: LCC框架成功统一了所有已知一致性模型，揭示了分布式系统基本约束的本质关联；提出了开放问题包括第四个表面猜想（日志局部性）、未发现约束，以及跨越边界导致的safety-liveness分叉普遍性。

title: Learning to Compress and Transmit: Adaptive Rate Control for Semantic Communications over LEO Satellite-to-Ground Links
summary: The bottleneck of satellite-to-ground links poses a major challenge for the timely downlink of massive on-board imagery. This paper studies adaptive image transmission over LEO satellite-to-ground links using joint source-channel coding (JSCC). We propose an RL-based framework that dynamically selects the channel dimension (compression ratio) of a SwinJSCC encoder to maximize the number of received satisfying reconstruction-quality constraints (PSNR and MS-SSIM) within a finite visibility window. The agent leverages SNR prediction to perform proactive rate adaptation and incorporates an on-board transmission-queue model that captures bursty encoding while penalizing both buffer overflow and underutilization. Simulations under realistic overpass conditions show that the proposed policy substantially outperforms fixed-rate baselines, achieving nearly 95% qualified frames with zero packet loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的自适应图像传输框架，用于LEO卫星对地链路，通过动态选择SwinJSCC编码器的压缩比，在有限可见窗口内最大化满足重构质量约束的帧数，实现了近95%的合格帧率和零丢包。
AI.motivation: LEO卫星对地链路的带宽瓶颈严重制约了海量在轨影像数据的及时下传。传统的固定速率传输方案无法适应时变的信道条件和有限的过境窗口，导致传输效率低下或数据丢失，亟需一种能够动态调整传输策略以最大化有效数据下传的方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于强化学习（RL）的联合信源信道编码（JSCC）自适应传输框架。该框架利用SwinJSCC编码器，智能体基于信噪比（SNR）预测进行主动速率适配，并引入星上传输队列模型以应对突发编码，同时惩罚缓冲区溢出和利用率不足。代理通过动态选择信道维度（压缩比）来优化传输策略。
AI.result: 在真实过境条件下的仿真结果表明，该策略显著优于固定速率基准方案。该方法实现了近95%的帧满足重构质量约束（PSNR和MS-SSIM），且达到了零丢包率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于RL的自适应JSCC框架有效解决了LEO卫星对地链路中的传输瓶颈问题，证明了在有限可见窗口内进行主动速率适配和队列管理能显著提升图像传输的质量和可靠性，为卫星数据下传提供了一种高效的解决方案。

title: Measuring What Matters: Benchmarking Generative, Multimodal, and Agentic AI in Healthcare
summary: AI models are increasingly deployed in live clinical environments where they must perform reliably across complex, high-stakes workflows that standard training and validation datasets were never designed to capture. Evaluating these systems requires benchmarks: structured combinations of tasks, datasets, and metrics that enable reproducible, comparable measurement of what a model can do. The central challenge in healthcare AI is not performance alone, but the absence of systematic methods to measure reliability, safety, and clinical relevance under real-world conditions. Most existing benchmarks test what a model knows; too few test whether it can perform reliably and without failing across the full complexity of real clinical tasks. Current benchmarks have accumulated through ad hoc dataset construction optimized for narrow task performance: frontier models achieve near-perfect scores on medical licensing examinations, but when evaluated across real clinical tasks, performance degrades sharply, scoring 0.74--0.85 on documentation, 0.61--0.76 on clinical decision support, and only 0.53--0.63 on administrative and workflow tasks \cite{medhelm}. High benchmark scores give a false sense of deployment readiness, and the gap between performance and utility widens precisely as AI systems take on more consequential clinical roles. Without a principled framework for benchmark design, the field cannot determine whether poor clinical performance reflects model limitations or failures in how performance is being measured.

AI.tldr: 现有医学AI基准测试主要评估模型知识而非实际临床可靠性，导致高分与实际部署表现存在巨大差距。需要建立系统的基准设计框架来评估模型在真实临床环境中的可靠性、安全性和临床相关性。
AI.motivation: AI模型正越来越多地部署在复杂的临床环境中，但现有基准测试无法评估模型在真实临床工作流程中的可靠性和安全性。当前基准测试存在两个核心问题：一是测试内容偏离实际临床需求（模型在医学考试中表现近乎完美，但在临床任务中表现显著下降）；二是缺乏系统性方法来衡量真实条件下的性能，导致无法判断性能不佳是模型问题还是评估方法问题。
AI.method: 论文提出了一个基准测试的理论框架，强调基准应包含结构化的任务、数据集和指标组合。该方法强调需要从单纯测试模型知识转向测试模型在完整、复杂的临床任务中的可靠性表现，确保评估具有可重现性和可比性。
AI.result: 研究表明前沿模型在医学执照考试中接近满分，但在真实临床任务中性能大幅下降：文档任务得分0.74-0.85，临床决策支持得分0.61-0.76，行政和工作流任务仅得分0.53-0.63。这证明了当前基准分数无法真实反映部署就绪状态。
AI.conclusion: 当前领域缺乏基准设计的系统性原则框架，导致无法准确评估临床AI系统的真实能力和部署就绪程度。建立科学的基准设计方法论对确保AI系统在医疗环境中的安全性和有效性至关重要。

title: Interactive Inverse Reinforcement Learning of Interaction Scenarios via Bi-level Optimization
summary: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) learns a reward function and a corresponding policy that best fit the demonstration data of an expert. However, in the current IRL setting, the learner is isolated from the expert and can only passively observe the expert demonstrations. This limits the applicability of IRL to interactive settings, where the learner actively interacts with the expert and needs to infer the expert's reward function from the interactions. To bridge the gap, this paper studies interactive IRL (IIRL) where a learner aims to learn the reward function of an expert and a policy to interact with the expert during its interactions with the expert. We formulate IIRL as a stochastic bi-level optimization problem where the lower level learns a reward function to explain the behaviors of the expert, and the upper level learns a policy to interact with the expert. We develop a double-loop algorithm, Bi-level Interactive Scenarios Inverse Reinforcement Learning (BISIRL), which solves the lower-level problem in the inner loop and the upper-level problem in the outer loop. We formally guarantee that BISIRL converges and validate our algorithm through extensive experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了交互式逆向强化学习（IIRL）框架和BISIRL算法，使学习者能够在与专家的交互过程中主动学习奖励函数和交互策略。
AI.motivation: 现有逆向强化学习（IRL）方法中，学习者仅能被动观察专家演示，无法在交互过程中主动推断专家的奖励函数，这限制了IRL在交互场景中的应用。
AI.method: 将IIRL建模为随机双层优化问题：下层学习奖励函数以解释专家行为，上层学习与专家交互的策略。提出双层交互场景逆向强化学习（BISIRL）算法，在内循环求解下层问题，在外循环求解上层问题。
AI.result: 理论上证明了BISIRL算法的收敛性，并通过大量实验验证了算法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将IRL扩展到交互式场景，提出的BISIRL算法为解决学习者与专家主动交互的IIRL问题提供了有效的理论框架和实用方法。

title: Skill Description Deception Attack against Task Routing in Internet of Agents
summary: A new paradigm, Internet of Agents (IoA), is transforming networked systems into LLM-driven service networks, where heterogeneous agents collaborate through task routing based on their self-declared skill descriptions. Although this promising paradigm enables agentic, distributed, and advanced intelligence, it also exposes a new and overlooked attack surface. In particular, malicious agents can strategically manipulate their skill descriptions to bias routing decisions and increase their probability of being selected for task execution, thereby disrupting user tasks and degrading system reliability. To characterize this threat, we propose and formalize a new attack model, termed \emph{Skill Description Deception} (SDD) attack. We further design an LLM-enabled SDD attack framework that automatically generates deceptive skill descriptions, enabling systematic vulnerability assessment of IoA systems. Experimental results on nine representative domains show that the proposed attack can achieve up to 98\% attack success rate, demonstrating the severity and generality of the attack. Our paper reveals a new security vulnerability in IoA and calls for secure and trustworthy semantic routing mechanisms for future IoA systems.

AI.tldr: 本文首次揭示了“智能体互联网”（IoA）中存在的“技能描述欺骗”（SDD）攻击风险，攻击者通过操纵自声明的技能描述来干扰任务路由，最高可达98%的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: IoA新范式将网络系统转变为由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的服务网络，异构智能体基于自声明的技能描述进行协作。尽管该范式带来了先进智能，但也暴露了一个被忽视的攻击面：恶意智能体可通过策略性操纵技能描述来影响路由决策，从而威胁系统可靠性与安全性。目前缺乏对此类威胁的系统性研究。
AI.method: 1. 提出并形式化定义了一种新型攻击模型——“技能描述欺骗”（Skill Description Deception, SDD）攻击。\n2. 设计了一个基于LLM的SDD攻击框架，能够自动生成欺骗性技能描述。\n3. 利用该框架对IoA系统进行系统性的漏洞评估。
AI.result: 在九个代表性领域的实验表明，所提出的攻击方法最高可达到98%的攻击成功率，证明了该攻击的严重性和普遍性。这表明当前IoA系统存在严重的安全漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了IoA系统中一个新的安全漏洞，强调了恶意智能体通过操纵语义信息进行攻击的风险。研究呼吁未来IoA系统需要构建安全可信的语义路由机制以应对此类威胁。

title: Split CNN Inference on Networked Microcontrollers
summary: Running deep neural networks on microcontroller units (MCUs) is severely constrained by limited memory resources. While TinyML techniques reduce model size and computation, they often fail in practice due to excessive peak Random Access Memory (RAM) usage during inference, dominated by intermediate activations. As a result, many models remain infeasible on standalone MCUs. In this work, we present a fine-grained split inference system for networked MCUs that enables collaborative inference of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) models across multiple devices. Our key insight is that breaking the memory bottleneck requires splitting inference at sub-layer granularity rather than at layer boundaries. We reinterpret pre-trained models to enable kernel-wise and neuron-wise partitioning, and distribute both model parameters and intermediate activations across multiple MCUs. A lightweight, resource-aware coordinator orchestrates the inference across MCU devices with heterogeneous resources. We implement the proposed system on a real testbed and evaluate it on up to 8 MCUs using MobileNetV2, a representative CNN model. Our experimental results show that CNN models infeasible on a single MCU can be executed across networked MCUs, reducing the per-MCU peak RAM usage while maintaining the practical end-to-end inference latency. All the source code of this work can be found here: https://github.com/shashsuresh/split-inference-on-MCUs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向网络化MCU的细粒度分割推理系统，通过子层级的分割与分布式执行，使单设备无法运行的CNN模型能够在多个资源受限的MCU上协同执行。
AI.motivation: 在微控制器单元（MCU）上运行深度神经网络受限于极其有限的内存资源。现有TinyML技术虽能压缩模型，但往往因推理过程中间激活值导致峰值RAM占用过高而无法实际部署，致使大量模型在独立MCU上不可行。
AI.method: 提出一种细粒度分割推理系统，打破传统层级边界，在子层粒度（kernel-wise和neuron-wise）对模型进行重新解析与切分，将模型参数与中间激活值分布式存储于多个MCU；设计一个轻量级、资源感知的协调器，在资源异构的MCU设备间协同调度推理过程。
AI.result: 在真实测试平台上（最多8个MCU）以MobileNetV2为模型进行实验，结果表明：该系统能够使原本单MCU无法运行的CNN模型在网络化MCU上成功执行，显著降低了单设备峰值RAM占用，同时保持了实际的端到端推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度子层级分割推理可有效解决MCU内存瓶颈问题，实现跨设备协同推理，为资源受限环境下的深度学习模型部署提供了可行方案。

title: GELATO: Generative Entropy- and Lyapunov-based Adaptive Token Offloading for Device-Edge Speculative LLM Inference
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: The recent growth of on-device Large Language Model (LLM) inference has driven significant interest in device-edge collaborative LLM inference. As a promising architecture, Speculative Decoding (SD) is increasingly adopted where a lightweight draft model rapidly generates candidate tokens to be verified by a powerful target model. However, a fundamental challenge lies in achieving per-token resource scheduling to effectively adapt SD paradigm to resource-constrained edge environment. This paper proposes a Generative Entropy- and Lyapunov-based Adaptive Token Offloading framework, named GELATO, to maximize decoding throughput under energy constraints in a device-edge collaborative SD system. Specifically, an outer drift-plus-penalty loop makes online decisions to establish a reference drafting budget, managing long-term energy-throughput trade-off. Further, a nested entropy-driven generation mechanism executes early exiting to adapt to per-token dynamic generative uncertainty. Theoretical analysis establishes a rigorous performance bound on long-term throughput for GELATO. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that GELATO achieves a globally optimal tradeoff, outperforming state-of-the-art distributed SD architectures by 64.98% in token throughput and reducing energy consumption by 47.47% under resource-constrained environments, while preserving LLM decoding quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GELATO框架，通过结合熵驱动和Lyapunov优化方法，解决了设备-边缘协作推测解码中的资源调度问题，实现了在能耗约束下的解码吞吐量最大化。
AI.motivation: 随着设备端大语言模型推理需求的增长，设备-边缘协作推测解码架构受到广泛关注。然而，在资源受限的边缘环境中，如何实现逐令牌的资源调度以有效适应推测解码范式，仍然是一个根本性挑战。
AI.method: 提出了基于生成熵和Lyapunov的自适应令牌卸载框架（GELATO）。具体包含：1）外层漂移加惩罚循环，在线决策建立参考草稿预算，管理长期能耗-吞吐量权衡；2）嵌套的熵驱动生成机制，通过早退策略适应逐令牌的动态生成不确定性。
AI.result: 理论分析建立了GELATO长期吞吐量的严格性能界限。大量实验表明，GELATO实现了全局最优权衡，在资源受限环境下，令牌吞吐量比最先进的分布式推测解码架构提高64.98%，能耗降低47.47%，同时保持LLM解码质量。
AI.conclusion: GELATO框架成功解决了设备-边缘协作推测解码中的资源调度挑战，在保证解码质量的前提下，显著提升了吞吐量并降低了能耗，为资源受限环境下的LLM推理提供了有效解决方案。

title: LLM-guided Semi-Supervised Approaches for Social Media Crisis Data Classification
summary: Semi-supervised learning approaches have been investigated as a means to enhance the analysis of social media data in disaster management contexts. In this work, we present the first empirical evaluation of large language model (LLM) guided semi-supervised learning for crisis related tweet classification. We compare two recent LLM assisted semi-supervised methods, VerifyMatch and LLM guided Co-Training ( LG-CoTrain), against established semi-supervised baselines. Our results show that LG-CoTrain significantly outperforms classical semi-supervised approaches in low resource settings with 5, 10 and 25 labeled examples per class, achieving the highest averaged Macro F1 across events. VerifyMatch achieves competitive performance while also demonstrating strong calibration properties. As the number of labeled examples increases, the performance gap narrows and Self Training emerges as a strong baseline. We further observe that compact semi-supervised models can, in some cases, outperform very large LLMs operating in zero-shot settings. This finding highlights the potential of transferring knowledge from LLMs into smaller and more deployable models through LLM guided semi-supervised learning, offering a practical pathway for real world disaster response applications. Our project repository on Github is here.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实证评估了LLM引导的半监督学习在灾难相关推文分类中的表现。LG-CoTrain在低资源场景下显著优于传统方法，VerifyMatch具有竞争性能，且紧凑模型在某些情况下可超越零样本大模型。
AI.motivation: 灾难管理中的社交媒体数据分析面临标注数据稀缺的挑战。虽然半监督学习被视为解决方案，但缺乏对最新LLM辅助半监督方法在该领域性能的系统评估。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探索如何利用LLM增强半监督学习以应对低资源环境下的危机推文分类任务。
AI.method: 研究对比了两种LLM辅助的半监督方法（VerifyMatch和LLM引导的协同训练LG-CoTrain）与传统半监督基线方法。实验采用每类5、10、25个标注样本的低资源设置进行评估，并以Macro F1作为主要评价指标，同时考察模型校准特性。
AI.result: LG-CoTrain在低资源设置下显著优于传统半监督方法，在各事件中取得最高的平均Macro F1；VerifyMatch表现具有竞争力且校准性能优异。随着标注样本增加，性能差距缩小，Self Training成为强力基线。紧凑的半监督模型在某些情况下甚至超越了零样本设置下的超大LLM。
AI.conclusion: LLM引导的半监督学习为低资源场景下的灾难响应应用提供了有效途径，能够将LLM知识迁移到更小、更易部署的模型中，具有实际应用价值。

title: DARE: Diffusion Language Model Activation Reuse for Efficient Inference
summary:
Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to auto-regressive (AR) models, offering greater expressive capacity and potential for parallel generation and faster inference. However, open-source dLLMs remain immature, lagging behind AR models in both efficiency and quality.
  We identify an underexplored property of dLLMs: *token-wise redundancy* in bi-directional self-attention. Self-attention activations are highly correlated across tokens, and temporal changes in query representations can predict redundancy in corresponding key, value, and output activations.
  We introduce DARE, with two complementary mechanisms: DARE-KV, which reuses cached key-value (KV) activations, and DARE-O, which reuses output activations to reduce redundant computation while preserving quality.
  DARE achieves up to 1.20x per-layer latency reduction and reuses up to 87% of attention activations, with negligible degradation on reasoning and code-generation benchmarks. DARE-KV and DARE-O incur average performance drops of only 2.0% and 1.2%, respectively. Combined with techniques such as prefix caching and Fast-dLLM, DARE provides additive gains without retraining.
  These results establish token-wise reuse as an effective strategy for improving the efficiency of diffusion-based LLMs while preserving generation fidelity. Code: https://github.com/enyac-group/DARE

AI.tldr: 本文提出DARE方法，通过重用扩散大语言模型中双向自注意力的高度相关激活，在不重训练的情况下实现最高1.20倍加速和87%激活复用，性能损失仅1.2%-2.0%。
AI.motivation: 开源扩散大语言模型在效率和质量上落后于自回归模型。作者发现dLLMs双向自注意力中存在未充分探索的token级冗余：自注意力激活在token间高度相关，查询表示的时序变化可预测对应键、值和输出激活的冗余。
AI.method: 提出DARE（Diffusion Activation Reuse），包含两个互补机制：1）DARE-KV复用缓存的键值（KV）激活；2）DARE-O复用输出激活。两种机制协同减少冗余计算同时保持生成质量。方法可与前缀缓存、Fast-dLLM等技术叠加使用，无需重训练。
AI.result: DARE实现最高1.20倍每层延迟降低，复用高达87%的注意力激活。DARE-KV和DARE-O平均性能下降仅分别为2.0%和1.2%。在推理和代码生成基准测试上几乎没有性能损失。
AI.conclusion: token级重用是提升扩散大语言模型效率的有效策略，能在保持生成保真度的同时显著降低计算开销。该方法为开源dLLMs的效率优化提供了新思路。

title: Statistical Model Checking of the Keynes+Schumpeter Model: A Transient Sensitivity Analysis of a Macroeconomic ABM
summary: Agent-based models (ABMs) are increasingly used in macroeconomics, but their analysis still often relies on ad hoc Monte Carlo campaigns with heterogeneous statistical effort across parameter settings. We show how statistical model checking (SMC), implemented through MultiVeStA, can provide a principled analysis layer for a realistic macroeconomic ABM without rewriting the simulator in a dedicated formalism. Our case study is the heuristic-switching Keynes+Schumpeter(K+S) model, analysed hrough a transient sensitivity campaign over one-parameter sweeps, two macro observables (unemployment and GDP growth), and one auxiliary micro-level probe (market share) on the post-warmup phase of a 600-step horizon. The analysis is driven by reusable temporal queries, observable-specific precision targets, and confidence-based stopping rules that automatically determine the simulation effort required by each configuration. Results show a clear contrast across parameter families: macro-financial and structural sweeps produce the strongest transient effects, whereas several heuristic-rule sweeps remain much weaker under the same precision policy. More broadly, the paper shows that SMC can support reproducible and informative quantitative analysis of substantively rich economic ABMs, while making uncertainty estimates and simulation cost explicit parts of the reported results.

AI.tldr: 本文将统计模型检测（SMC）方法应用于宏观经济基于主体的模型（ABM）分析，通过MultiVeStA工具实现了对K+S模型的原则性分析，揭示了不同参数族对系统瞬态行为的差异化影响。
AI.motivation: 宏观经济ABM的分析通常依赖临时的蒙特卡洛模拟活动，不同参数设置下的统计投入异质且缺乏系统性原则。需要一种有原则的分析层来支持可重现、信息丰富的定量分析。
AI.method: 采用统计模型检测（SMC）方法，通过MultiVeStA工具实现对K+S模型的瞬态敏感性分析。分析覆盖单参数扫描、两个宏观可观测量（失业率和GDP增长）和一个微观层面探测（市场份额），使用可复用的时序查询、可观测特定的精度目标和基于置信度的停止规则来自动确定各配置所需的模拟投入。
AI.result: 不同参数族显示出明显对比：宏观金融和结构性参数扫描产生最强的瞬态效应，而多个启发式规则扫描在相同精度策略下影响较弱。SMC方法能够支持对实质性丰富的经济ABM进行可重现和信息丰富的定量分析。
AI.conclusion: SMC方法可以支持对实质性丰富的经济ABM进行可重现和信息丰富的定量分析，同时将不确定性估计和模拟成本作为报告结果的明确组成部分，为ABM分析提供了有原则的分析框架。

title: From Detection to Recovery: Operational Analysis on LLM Pre-training with 504 GPUs
comment: 42 pages, 19 figures, 16 tables. Lablup Technical Report
summary: Large-scale AI training is now fundamentally a distributed systems problem, and hardware failures have become routine operating conditions rather than rare exceptions. Public operational evidence from production training clusters, however, remains scarce. This technical report presents an empirical analysis of a 63-node NVIDIA B200 production cluster (504 GPUs), using 55 days of Prometheus time-series data and 73 days of operational logs covering 224 multi-node training sessions. The cluster operates within a cross-organizational environment in which five parties (SKT, Upstage, Lablup, NVIDIA Korea, and VAST Data) share a unified monitoring pipeline. This arrangement enabled joint diagnosis of a 60-node-scale storage I/O bottleneck that did not appear at 2-4-node scale, a production-scale phenomenon no single team could isolate alone. Drawing on a months-long pre-training campaign, we perform three quantitative analyses yielding four findings. First, statistical analysis over 751 Prometheus metrics and 10 XID-identified GPU failures achieves a 10/10 detection rate (2/10 pre-XID) at ~0.84 false positives per day. No single metric is consistently dominant across failure types, motivating a multi-signal detection strategy. Second, profiling 523 checkpoint events along the GPU VRAM to NFS path attributes the "bandwidth paradox" (1.4-10.4% utilization of 200 Gbps RoCE) to saturation of the 128-slot NFS RPC layer. Third, multi-node failure response shows concentrated exclusions (top 3 of 63 nodes account for >50% of all exclusions) and an auto-retry chain success rate of 33.3% over 12 chains (73 attempts), 2.7x the 12.5% manual recovery rate; the median retry interval is 11 min (IQR 10-11). All analyses are grounded in production infrastructure providing session-level workload management, GPU-centric scheduling, and unified observability.

AI.tldr: 本报告对63节点NVIDIA B200生产集群（504个GPU）进行了55天的Prometheus数据和73天运行日志的实证分析，揭示了大规模AI训练中的硬件故障规律：通过多指标策略实现100%故障检测率，发现存储I/O瓶颈源于NFS RPC层饱和，自动重试成功率是手动恢复的2.7倍。
AI.motivation: 大规模AI训练本质上已成为分布式系统问题，硬件故障已成为常态而非异常，但生产集群的公开运行证据仍然稀缺。研究旨在填补这一空白，通过跨组织协作的统一监控管道，深入分析生产环境下的故障特征和系统行为。
AI.method: 基于63节点NVIDIA B200生产集群（504个GPU），分析55天Prometheus时序数据和73天运行日志（覆盖224次多节点训练会话）。采用三种定量分析方法：1）对751个Prometheus指标和10次GPU故障进行统计分析；2）对523个检查点事件进行性能剖析；3）多节点故障响应分析。集群由SKT、Upstage、Lablup、NVIDIA Korea和VAST Data五方共享统一监控管道。
AI.result: 四项核心发现：1）故障检测率达到100%（10/10），每日误报率仅0.84次，但单一指标在不同故障类型间无一致性优势，需多信号检测策略；2）发现"带宽悖论"（200 Gbps RoCE利用率仅1.4-10.4%），根源在于128槽NFS RPC层饱和；3）节点故障呈现集中性，前3个节点（占总量4.8%）贡献了超过50%的排除事件；4）自动重试链成功率达33.3%，是手动恢复率（12.5%）的2.7倍，中位重试间隔11分钟。
AI.conclusion: 大规模AI训练生产集群需要多信号故障检测策略、存储I/O架构优化（特别是NFS RPC层），以及自动化重试机制来应对硬件故障常态化的挑战。跨组织协作的统一监控管道对诊断复杂的大规模问题至关重要。

title: Is DRL-based MAC Ready for Underwater Acoustic Networks? Exploring Its Practicality in Real Field Experiments
summary: Medium Access Control (MAC) protocols rely on neighbor and environment information to design collision-free access rules for Underwater Acoustic Networks (UANs). Acquiring this information suffers from high communication overhead due to the unique underwater acoustic channel characteristics, such as long propagation delay, spatiotemporal variations in communication quality, and high attenuation. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is promising to circumvent the UANs' physical constraints and provide a low-overhead solution for underwater MAC protocols, since it can decide access rules based on real-time observation without extra information exchange. However, the unique underwater acoustic channel characteristics impose significant challenges on observation acquisition, training time, and the balance of multiple reward factors for DRL-based MAC protocols. Most existing methods remain at the theoretical level: (1) they design partial intelligent agents failing to achieve fully autonomous access; (2) they assume unreasonable simulation scenarios, weakening the effects of underwater acoustic channel characteristics on MAC protocols. To enhance the practicality of DRL-based MAC protocols, we first analyze the application challenges of DRL in UANs through real field experiments. Based on the above challenges, we propose a DRL-based MAC protocol that considers observation loss and balances multiple reward factors to achieve efficient Entire Autonomous access in the UAN (EA-MAC). To further explore the feasibility of DRL-based MAC protocols, we implement EA-MAC and other state-of-the-art protocols on underwater acoustic modems and evaluate their performance in real field experiments. Experimental results demonstrate that EA-MAC can adaptively determine the scheduling sequence for each node, enabling high-throughput and fair communication in a straightforward manner for UANs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度强化学习的水声网络MAC协议（EA-MAC），通过真实海试实验验证了其在观测丢失和多奖励因子平衡方面的有效性，实现了高效、公平的全自主接入。
AI.motivation: 水声网络MAC协议依赖邻居和环境信息来设计无冲突接入规则，但获取这些信息会因水声信道特性（长传播延迟、时空变化、高衰减）而产生高通信开销。现有基于DRL的MAC方法大多停留在理论层面：部分智能体设计无法实现全自主接入，且仿真场景假设不合理，削弱了水声信道特性的影响。
AI.method: 首先通过真实现场实验分析DRL在水声网络中的应用挑战；然后提出EA-MAC协议，该协议考虑观测丢失问题，并平衡多个奖励因子以实现高效的全自主接入；最后在实际水声调制解调器上实现EA-MAC及其他先进协议，并在真实海试中进行性能评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，EA-MAC能够自适应地为每个节点确定调度序列，以直接的方式实现水声网络的高吞吐量和公平通信。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过真实现场实验验证了DRL-based MAC协议在水声网络中的可行性，EA-MAC协议成功解决了观测丢失和多奖励因子平衡问题，实现了高效的全自主接入，提升了DRL-based MAC协议的实用性。

title: Behavioral Determinants of Deployed AI Agents in Social Networks: A Multi-Factor Study of Personality, Model, and Guardrail Specification
summary: Autonomous AI agents are increasingly deployed in open social environments, yet the relationship between their configuration specifications and their emergent social behavior remains poorly understood. We present a controlled, multi-factor empirical study in which thirteen OpenClaw agents are deployed on Moltbook -- a Reddit-like social network built for AI agents -- across three systematically varied independent variables: (1) personality specification via SOUL.md, (2) underlying LLM model backbone, and (3) operational rules and memory configuration via AGENTS.md. A default control agent provides a behavioral baseline. Over a one-week observation window spanning approximately 400 autonomous sessions per agent, we collect behavioral, linguistic, and social metrics to assess how configuration layers predict emergent social behavior. We find that personality specification is the dominant behavioral lever, producing a massive spread in response length across agents, while model backbone and operational rules drive more moderate but still meaningful effects on rhetorical style and topic engagement breadth. Our findings contribute empirical evidence to the emerging literature on deployed multi-agent social systems and offer practical guidance for designing agents intended for collaborative or monitoring tasks in real social environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究在Reddit风格的AI社交平台Moltbook上部署了13个OpenClaw智能体，通过控制变量实验发现：个性配置是影响智能体社交行为的主导因素，而模型骨干和操作规则对修辞风格和话题参与度有中等程度的影响。
AI.motivation: 自主AI智能体越来越多地被部署在开放的社交环境中，但其配置规范与涌现出的社交行为之间的关系仍然缺乏深入理解，亟需通过实证研究揭示配置层如何影响智能体的社交行为表现。
AI.method: 在类似Reddit的AI社交平台Moltbook上部署13个OpenClaw智能体，进行受控多因子实验。系统性地改变三个独立变量：(1)通过SOUL.md的个性配置，(2)底层LLM模型骨干，(3)通过AGENTS.md的操作规则和记忆配置。设置一个默认控制智能体作为行为基线，进行为期一周的观察（每智能体约400次自主会话），收集行为、语言和社交指标。
AI.result: 实验发现个性配置是主导性的行为杠杆，在智能体之间产生了巨大的回复长度差异；模型骨干和操作规则驱动了更为温和但仍有意义的影响，主要体现在修辞风格和话题参与广度方面。
AI.conclusion: 研究为部署式多智能体社交系统这一新兴领域提供了实证证据，并为设计用于真实社交环境中协作或监测任务的智能体提供了实践指导。

title: Dendritic Neural Networks with Equilibrium Propagation
summary: Equilibrium propagation (EP) is a biologically plausible alternative to backpropagation (BP), but its effectiveness can degrade in deeper and more challenging learning settings. In parallel, dendritic neural networks have demonstrated improved performance and generalization when trained with BP, suggesting that structured, biologically inspired architectures may enhance learning. In this work, we investigate the integration of dendritic neural networks with equilibrium propagation using an advanced EP framework. We evaluate the proposed dendritic EP model on MNIST, Kuzushiji-MNIST (KMNIST), and Fashion-MNIST (FMNIST), considering both shallow and deeper architectures. Our results show that dendritic EP achieves performance comparable to standard EP on simple tasks, while providing consistent improvements on more challenging datasets and deeper models. In particular, dendritic EP significantly outperforms standard EP on KMNIST and FMNIST, and approaches the performance of dendritic networks trained with backpropagation through time.To further understand these improvements, we analyze the evolution of hidden states during the free phase. We observe that dendritic EP exhibits higher activation magnitudes and more distributed hidden-state activity compared to standard EP, indicating that dendritic structure alters the internal network dynamics. These findings suggest that incorporating dendritic structure can enhance the effectiveness of biologically plausible learning algorithms, especially in regimes where standard EP struggles. Our work highlights the importance of architectural design for improving biologically inspired training methods.

AI.tldr: 本文将树突神经网络与平衡传播算法相结合，提出了树突EP模型，在保持简单任务性能的同时，显著提升了深层网络和复杂数据集上的学习效果。
AI.motivation: 平衡传播（EP）作为一种生物可解释的反向传播替代方案，在深层网络和复杂学习场景中性能会下降；同时，树突神经网络在使用反向传播训练时表现出更好的性能和泛化能力。研究旨在探索将树突结构与EP相结合，以提升生物可解释学习算法的效果。
AI.method: 将树突神经网络集成到先进的平衡传播框架中，在MNIST、KMNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上评估所提出的树突EP模型，涵盖浅层和深层架构。通过分析自由阶段隐藏状态的演化，研究树突结构对网络内部动力学的影响。
AI.result: 在简单任务上，树突EP达到与标准EP相当的性能；在更具挑战性的数据集和深层模型上则有一致的改进。特别是在KMNIST和FMNIST上，树突EP显著优于标准EP，性能接近使用基于时间的反向传播训练的树突网络。分析表明，树突EP在自由阶段表现出更高的激活幅度和更分布式的隐藏状态活动。
AI.conclusion: 融入树突结构可以增强生物可解释学习算法的有效性，特别是在标准EP表现困难的情况下。研究强调了架构设计对于改进生物启发训练方法的重要性。

title: Safe Multi-Agent Behavior Must Be Maintained, Not Merely Asserted: Constraint Drift in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Modern LLM based agents are no longer passive text generators. They read repositories, call tools, browse the web, execute code, maintain memory, communicate with other agents, and act through long horizon workflows. This shift moves the unit of safety. A system may produce a compliant final answer while leaking private information through an internal message, delegating authority beyond its original scope, calling an external tool with sensitive context, or losing the evidence needed to reconstruct why an action was allowed. We argue that many emerging failures in LLM-based multi-agent systems share a common structure: safety critical constraints do not remain operative throughout the trajectory. We call this phenomenon constraint drift: the loss, distortion, weakening, or relaxation of constraints as they pass through memory, delegation, communication, tool use, audit, and optimization. The position taken here is that safe multi-agent behavior must be maintained, not merely asserted. Prompts, guardrails, tool schemas, access control, and final output checks are necessary, but they are insufficient unless constraints remain fresh, inherited, enforceable, and auditable across execution. We propose Constraint State Governance as a research paradigm for LLM-based multi-agent systems. In this paradigm, safety-critical constraints are maintained as explicit execution state, while constraint-native reinforcement learning improves utility only within maintained safety boundaries. The goal is not to freeze agentic systems under rigid rules, but to make safety operational across the trajectories through which modern agents actually act.

AI.tldr: 本文指出LLM多智能体系统中存在“约束漂移”现象，即安全约束在执行轨迹中逐渐失效。提出了约束状态治理范式，将安全约束作为显式执行状态维护，并通过约束原生的强化学习在保持安全边界的前提下提升效用。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM智能体不再是被动的文本生成器，而是能够读取仓库、调用工具、浏览网页、执行代码、维护记忆、与其他智能体通信并通过长时域工作流行动。这种转变改变了安全单元——系统可能产生合规的最终答案，但在内部消息中泄露私人信息、委托超出原始范围的权限、使用敏感上下文调用外部工具，或丢失重建行动许可所需的证据。许多新兴的LLM多智能体系统故障共享一个共同结构：安全关键约束在整个轨迹中不再有效。
AI.method: 提出约束状态治理作为LLM多智能体系统的研究范式。在该范式中，安全关键约束被维护为显式执行状态，同时约束原生强化学习仅在维护的安全边界内提升效用。安全关键约束必须在执行轨迹中保持新鲜、可继承、可执行和可审计。
AI.result: 识别并形式化了“约束漂移”现象：约束在通过记忆、委托、通信、工具使用、审计和优化时发生的丢失、扭曲、弱化或松弛。明确了提示、护栏、工具模式、访问控制和最终输出检查虽然必要但不足够，除非约束在执行中保持有效。
AI.conclusion: 安全的多智能体行为必须被维护，而不仅仅是被断言。目标不是用僵化的规则冻结智能体系统，而是使安全在现代智能体实际行动的轨迹中变得可操作。

title: ATLAS: Efficient Out-of-Core Inference for Billion-Scale Graph Neural Networks
comment: Preprint of paper to appear in the proceedings of the 35th International Symposium on High-Performance Parallel and Distributed Computing (HPDC 26): Pranjal Naman and Yogesh Simmhan, "ATLAS: Efficient Out-of-Core Inference for Billion-Scale Graph Neural Networks", in International Symposium on High-Performance Parallel and Distributed Computing (HPDC), 2026
summary: Graph Neural Network (GNN) inference on billion-scale graphs is critical for domains like fintech and recommendation systems. Full-graph inference on these large graphs can be challenging due to high communication costs in distributed settings and high I/O costs in disk-backed Out-of-Core (OOC) settings. Existing OOC systems, operating across disk and memory, primarily focus on GNN training and perform poorly for full-graph inference due to massive read amplification, irregular I/O, and memory pressure. We present ATLAS, a disk-based GNN inference framework that enables efficient full-graph, layer-wise inference on graphs whose topologies, features and intermediate embeddings exceed the available memory on single machines. ATLAS replaces gather-based execution with a broadcast-based model that enables sequential, single-pass streaming reads of features and embeddings per layer. A tiered memory-disk hierarchy with minimum-pending-message eviction, graph reordering and a GPU-accelerated pipeline sustains high throughput within $128$ GiB RAM and $2$ TiB SSD. Across out-of-core graphs with up to $4$B edges and $550$ GiB features and multiple GNN architectures, ATLAS improves end-to-end inference time by $\approx12$--$30\times$ over State-of-the-Art (SOTA) OOC baselines on a single workstation, while remaining within $\approx5\%$ when features fit in memory.

AI.tldr: ATLAS是一个针对十亿级图的磁盘GNN推理框架，通过广播模型替代传统聚合模型，在单机上实现了比SOTA OOC基线12-30倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 现有Out-of-Core系统主要针对GNN训练设计，在全图推理场景下存在严重的读放大、不规则I/O和内存压力问题，无法高效处理拓扑、特征和中间嵌入超过内存容量的大规模图推理任务。
AI.method: 提出broadcast-based执行模型替代gather-based模型，实现特征和嵌入的顺序单遍流式读取；采用分层内存-磁盘层级结构，结合最小挂起消息驱逐、图重排序和GPU加速流水线技术。
AI.result: 在128 GiB RAM和2 TiB SSD配置下，处理高达40亿边和550 GiB特征的图数据，相比SOTA OOC基线实现12-30倍端到端推理加速，在特征适应内存时性能损失仅约5%。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS成功解决了十亿级图神经网络推理的I/O瓶颈问题，证明了在单机受限内存环境下高效处理超大规模图推理的可行性，为fintech和推荐系统等应用提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Statistical Analysis for Energy-Efficient Satellite Edge Computing with Latency Guarantees
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table, submitted to IEEE GLOBECOM 2026
summary: Being able to provide latency guarantees for orbital edge computing applications through Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations is a major milestone for their integration into 5G and 6G networks. However, achieving this is fundamentally challenged by the inherent randomness in both communication and computing latency, driven by complex network dynamics, satellite motion, and hardware variability. In this paper, we perform a statistical analysis of the latency of satellite edge computing using representative computing hardware and an object detection algorithm running on a satellite image dataset. The resulting model captures the trade-off between data availability and estimation uncertainty, enabling data-driven optimization methods to meet latency targets with statistical guarantees while minimizing energy consumption. Our results show that parametric estimation and quantile regression for the execution time of the image processing algorithms can be effectively combined with models for the communication latency to select an optimal GPU clock frequency. This achieves a 95% probability of meeting a $500$ ms end-to-end deadline while reducing energy consumption by more than 50% compared to a baseline that relies on a Chebyshev-Cantelli inequality to bound execution-time quantiles. The proposed framework is generalizable across satellite edge computing workloads and hardware platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对低地球轨道（LEO）卫星边缘计算的统计延迟建模方法，通过结合参数估计和分位数回归来优化GPU时钟频率，从而在满足端到端延迟截止期限的同时显著降低能耗。
AI.motivation: 在5G/6G网络中，为轨道边缘计算应用提供延迟保证是一个重要里程碑。然而，由于网络动态、卫星运动和硬件变化性导致的通信与计算延迟的内在随机性，实现这一目标面临根本性挑战。
AI.method: 使用代表性计算硬件和目标检测算法在卫星图像数据集上进行延迟统计分析，建立了一个捕捉数据可用性与估计不确定性之间权衡的模型。该方法将图像处理算法执行时间的参数估计和分位数回归与通信延迟模型相结合，以选择最优的GPU时钟频率。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的方法能够在95%的概率下满足500毫秒的端到端截止期限，同时相比使用Chebyshev-Cantelli不等式限制执行时间分位数的基准方法，能耗降低超过50%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架具有通用性，可跨卫星边缘计算工作负载和硬件平台应用，为在统计保证下满足延迟目标并最小化能耗提供了数据驱动的优化方法。

title: Mid-Training with Self-Generated Data Improves Reinforcement Learning in Language Models
summary: The effectiveness of Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Large Language Models (LLMs) depends on the nature and diversity of the data used before and during RL. In particular, reasoning problems can often be approached in multiple ways that rely on different forms of reasoning, and exposure to only a limited range of such approaches in the training data may limit the effectiveness of RL. Motivated by this, we investigate using diverse self-generated data during mid-training as an intermediate step before RL training. Specifically, we adopt a bootstrapped data-generation framework guided by George Polya's problem-solving approaches for generating multiple variants of correct answers for each question in the training data, and then perform fine-tuning. We first provide a theoretical perspective on how mid-training on such data improves RL and explain how policy-gradient updates can incentivize combining multiple approaches. We then empirically demonstrate that RL-trained models initialized with our mid-training data achieve consistent improvements across various mathematical reasoning benchmarks and other OOD tasks like code generation and narrative reasoning. Overall, our investigative study shows that a language model learning multiple problem-solving approaches, through self-generated data helps subsequent RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在强化学习训练前引入基于Polya问题解决方法的自生成多样化数据的中期训练，通过理论分析和实验验证，证明了学习多种问题解决方法能显著提升大语言模型在数学推理、代码生成等任务上的RL训练效果。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在大语言模型中的有效性依赖于训练数据的性质和多样性。推理问题通常可以通过多种不同的推理方法来解决，而训练数据中仅包含有限的方法范围会限制RL的有效性。因此，研究如何通过多样化的自生成数据来提升模型对多种问题解决方法的学习能力成为关键动机。
AI.method: 采用基于George Polya问题解决方法的引导式自生成数据框架，为训练数据中的每个问题生成多种正确答案变体，然后进行微调作为RL训练前的中期训练步骤。同时提供理论视角分析这种中期训练如何改善RL，并解释策略梯度更新如何激励多种方法的结合。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用该中期训练数据初始化的RL训练模型在多个数学推理基准测试以及其他分布外任务（如代码生成和叙事推理）上均获得一致的改进。验证了通过自生成数据学习多种问题解决方法对后续RL训练的积极作用。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，语言模型通过自生成的多样化数据学习多种问题解决方法能够有效帮助后续的强化学习训练，为提升大语言模型的推理能力提供了新的训练范式。

title: Weight Pruning Amplifies Bias: A Multi-Method Study of Compressed LLMs for Edge AI
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables. Accepted at the 7th Annual World AIIoT Congress (AIIoT 2026). This is the author's accepted version; the version of record will appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: Weight pruning is widely advocated for deploying Large Language Models on resource-constrained IoT and edge devices, yet its impact on model fairness remains poorly understood. We conduct a controlled empirical study of three instruction-tuned models (Gemma-2-9b-it, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Phi-3.5-mini-instruct) across three pruning methods (Random, Magnitude, Wanda) at four sparsity levels (10-70%) on 12,148 BBQ bias benchmark items with 5 random seeds, totaling 2,368,860 inference records. Our results reveal a Smart Pruning Paradox: activation-aware pruning (Wanda) preserves perplexity nearly perfectly (just 3.5% increase at 50% sparsity for Mistral-7B), yet produces the highest bias amplification, with Stereotype Reliance Score increasing 83.7% and 47-59% of previously unbiased items developing new stereotypical behaviors at 70% sparsity. Random pruning destroys language capability entirely (perplexity exceeding $10^4$ and reaching $10^8$) but produces only random-chance bias. We further show that unstructured pruning provides zero storage savings and zero inference latency reduction on real edge hardware, undermining the primary motivation for its use in IoT deployment. Of 180 dense-vs-pruned comparisons, 141 (78.3%) are significant ($p < 0.05$) with mean $|h| = 0.305$. Published quantization studies report up to 21% of responses flipping between biased and unbiased states; our pruning results show transition rates nearly three times higher (47-59%), suggesting pruning poses a categorically greater risk to alignment than quantization. These findings demonstrate that perplexity-based evaluation provides false assurance of behavioral equivalence, and that IoT deployment pipelines require bias-aware validation before deploying pruned models at the edge.

AI.tldr: 本研究发现“智能剪枝悖论”：保持语言能力较好的激活感知剪枝方法反而会导致严重的偏见放大，其风险远超量化技术，且非结构化剪枝在边缘设备上无法带来实际的存储和延迟收益。
AI.motivation: 尽管权重剪枝被广泛用于在资源受限的IoT和边缘设备上部署大语言模型，但剪枝对模型公平性的影响却鲜为人知。研究者旨在填补这一空白，探究剪枝是否会导致模型偏见加剧及行为失准。
AI.method: 研究者在控制条件下进行了大规模实证研究：选取三个指令微调模型（Gemma-2-9b-it, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Phi-3.5-mini-instruct），应用三种剪枝方法（Random, Magnitude, Wanda），设定四个稀疏度水平（10%-70%），在12,148个BBQ偏见基准测试项上进行测试，使用5个随机种子，共产生2,368,860条推理记录。
AI.result: 结果揭示了“智能剪枝悖论”：激活感知剪枝在保持困惑度几乎不变（如Mistral-7B在50%稀疏度下仅增加3.5%）的同时，却产生了最高的偏见放大，刻板印象依赖分数增加83.7%，47-59%原本无偏见的样本产生了新的刻板行为。随机剪枝完全破坏了语言能力但仅产生随机水平的偏见。非结构化剪枝在实际边缘硬件上既无存储节省也无推理延迟降低。在180项对比中，78.3%差异显著（$p < 0.05$）。与量化研究相比，剪枝导致的状态翻转率高出近三倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于困惑度的评估无法真实反映模型行为，会提供虚假的安全感；剪枝对模型对齐性的威胁比量化更大。在边缘设备部署剪枝模型前，必须引入偏见感知的验证流程。

title: Effect of Graph Gluing on Consensus in Networked Multi-Agent Systems
summary: In this paper, the effects of graph gluing operations in networks of multi-agent systems and their impact on system performance are investigated. In many practical applications, multiple multi-agent subsystems must be interconnected through communication links to accomplish complex tasks, resulting in a larger communication network. Such interconnections modify the underlying graph topology and consequently affect the consensus behavior and convergence rate of the network. In particular, this paper examines both bridge gluing and interface gluing and analyzes how the number and structure of communication links between subsystems influence the Fiedler eigenvalue of the resulting graph. Since the Fiedler eigenvalue is directly related to the convergence rate of consensus dynamics, the proposed analysis establishes a clear relationship between interconnection strategies, algebraic connectivity, and system performance. The results provide theoretical insight into how different gluing mechanisms alter the spectral properties of the graph Laplacian and, in turn, the convergence characteristics of the networked multi-agent system. Simulation studies are presented to illustrate the theoretical findings and to validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多智能体系统网络中的图粘合操作（桥粘合与接口粘合），揭示了互连策略如何通过影响Fiedler特征值（代数连通性）来改变系统的一致性收敛速率。
AI.motivation: 在实际应用中，多个多智能体子系统常需通过通信链路互连以完成复杂任务，这种互连会改变底层图拓扑结构，进而影响网络的一致性行为和收敛速率。因此，研究互连方式对系统性能的影响具有重要意义。
AI.method: 分析了桥粘合（bridge gluing）和接口粘合（interface gluing）两种操作，研究子系统间通信链路的数量和结构如何影响结果图的Fiedler特征值，并建立了互连策略、代数连通性与系统性能之间的理论关系。
AI.result: 提出了图粘合机制如何改变图拉普拉斯矩阵谱特性的理论见解，明确了互连结构与Fiedler特征值（直接关联一致性动力学收敛速率）之间的定量关系，并通过仿真验证了理论发现。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为多智能体系统的网络互连设计提供了理论指导，有助于通过优化粘合策略来提升网络化系统的收敛性能。

title: PoHAR: Understanding Hyperlocal Human Activities with Pollution Sensor Networks
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, accepted to IEEE DCOSS-IoT 2026
summary: Low-cost air quality sensors are becoming ubiquitous in our daily lives as public awareness of air pollution continues to grow, and people take measures to monitor and improve the air they breathe indoors. Besides the standard operation of these sensors, fluctuations in environmental parameters can be leveraged to understand human behavior and activities in indoor spaces. Unlike traditional audio-visual, Radio Frequency, and inertial sensors, air quality sensors are easily scalable to a household, are privacy-preserving, and more economical. Such distributed sensor networks must jointly make decisions to monitor indoor occupants for downstream smart home and healthcare applications. However, due to low processing power, memory, and energy, they often struggle to maintain distributed data consensus and identify activity-affected sensor groups for accurate on-device inference. In this paper, we propose PoHAR framework that implements: (i) a conflict-free replicated data primitive for data sharing, (ii) a hierarchical clustering for ESP32 to detect activity-affected sensor groups with a self-supervised distance metric, and (iii) a leader-based group inference with off-the-shelf ML classifiers, enabling the sensor network to collaboratively detect hyperlocal indoor activities. Our extensive experiments demonstrated on-device activity detection, achieving 97.41% accuracy for indoor activity and 99.68% for cooking activity, using off-the-shelf ML models with latency below 34 microseconds.

AI.tldr: 提出了PoHAR框架，利用低成本空气质量传感器网络实现隐私保护且高精度的室内活动检测，准确率超过97%。
AI.motivation: 低成本空气质量传感器日益普及，相比传统音视频和射频传感器具有可扩展、隐私保护和经济性的优势。然而，受限于处理能力、内存和能量，分布式传感器网络难以维持数据共识并识别受活动影响的传感器组，从而无法实现准确的设备端推理。
AI.method: 提出PoHAR框架，包含三个核心组件：(i) 无冲突复制数据原语用于数据共享；(ii) 基于自监督距离度量的层次聚类算法，在ESP32上检测受活动影响的传感器组；(iii) 基于领导者的组推理机制，结合现成机器学习分类器，实现传感器网络协同检测局部室内活动。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在设备端活动检测中，室内活动识别准确率达97.41%，烹饪活动识别准确率达99.68%，使用现成ML模型的推理延迟低于34微秒。
AI.conclusion: PoHAR框架成功实现了基于空气质量传感器网络的协作式室内活动检测，在保证隐私的前提下，以低延迟和高准确率完成设备端推理，为智能家居和医疗健康应用提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Learning-Based Spectrum Cartography in Low Earth Orbit Satellite Networks: An Overview
summary: Low earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks are emerging as a key infrastructure for global connectivity and space-based sensing. Many tasks in such systems can be formulated as measurement-set-to-spatial-inference problems, where spatial variables are inferred from sparse and heterogeneous wireless observations. Spectrum cartography provides a unifying framework for this paradigm, encompassing representative tasks such as satellite-assisted localization and radio map reconstruction, as well as map-informed resource allocation. Yet the highly dynamic orbital geometry, complex propagation conditions, and reliability-varying nature of LEO measurements pose fundamental challenges for traditional model-driven and interpolation-based methods. This article surveys the literature from 1964 to 2026 on learning-based spectrum cartography as applied to LEO satellite networks, with a particular focus on attention mechanisms as a principled operator for adaptive and reliability-aware measurement fusion across localization, radio map reconstruction, and resource allocation tasks. We review modeling foundations and key challenges of representative tasks, and analyze how attention-based learning enables flexible fusion of heterogeneous measurements for both inference and map-informed decision-making. Representative formulations and simulation studies are provided to illustrate the framework and demonstrate its effectiveness, offering a unified perspective for measurement-driven inference and decision-making in LEO satellite networks.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了低地球轨道（LEO）卫星网络中基于学习的频谱制图技术，重点分析了注意力机制如何解决测量数据稀疏、异构及可靠性变化等挑战，为定位、无线电地图重构及资源分配任务提供了统一框架。
AI.motivation: LEO卫星网络在全球连接和天基感知中扮演关键角色，其任务常被表述为从稀疏异构无线观测推断空间变量的问题。然而，高度动态的轨道几何、复杂的传播条件以及测量可靠性的变化，使得传统的模型驱动和基于插值的方法难以适用，亟需新的解决方案。
AI.method: 本文调研了1964年至2026年间关于LEO卫星网络中基于学习的频谱制图文献，重点关注注意力机制作为核心算子，实现跨定位、无线电地图重构和资源分配任务的自适应、可靠性感知的测量融合。文章回顾了典型任务的建模基础与核心挑战，并分析了注意力学习如何实现异构测量的灵活融合。
AI.result: 文章展示了代表性公式与仿真研究，论证了该框架的有效性，说明了注意力机制能够有效融合异构测量数据，提升推断与地图辅助决策的性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于注意力学习的频谱制图为LEO卫星网络中的测量驱动推断与决策提供了统一视角，是解决该领域关键挑战的有效途径。

title: AI-Care: A Conversational Agentic System for Task Coordination in Alzheimer's Disease Care
summary: Individuals with Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Alzheimer's disease-related dementia (ADRD) experience memory and thinking changes that impact their ability to use digital daily management tools. For example, adding an event to a digital calendar requires multiple steps that may act as barriers to independent use for individuals with AD/ADRD. This paper presents AI-Care, a conversational agentic artificial intelligence (AI) layer built on top of a remote caregiving platform co-designed with people with AD/ADRD. AI-Care is designed to reduce the cognitive load on individuals with AD/ADRD when managing everyday tasks such as setting calendar reminders and organizing to-do lists through natural-language interaction with a voice-first chatbot. The system uses a LangGraph-based stateful orchestration approach in which each request passes through sanitization, intent classification, context loading, safety checks, deterministic slot collection, tool execution, and response composition. Safety-critical responses, particularly around medications and allergies, are grounded in caregiver-verified records rather than free-form model generation. The system does not make autonomous medical or treatment decisions. Incomplete or ambiguous requests are handled through controlled multi-turn clarification rather than silent failure or guessing. The system supports both typed and spoken input, with voice output through ElevenLabs text-to-speech. Longer responses are chunked before synthesis to avoid rushed playback. A preliminary pilot with four individuals with mild-to-moderate AD/ADRD showed that users found the system trustworthy, competent, and likable, and were able to complete the evaluated coordination tasks through conversation. We describe the design goals, system architecture, safety controls, and findings from this formative evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI-Care，一个面向阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症（AD/ADRD）患者的对话式AI代理层，通过自然语言交互降低日常数字任务管理的认知负荷，初步试点显示系统可信、有能力且受用户喜爱。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症患者存在记忆和认知障碍，难以独立使用现有的数字日常管理工具（如添加日历事件需要多步操作），因此需要一种能够降低认知负荷、支持自然交互的辅助系统。
AI.method: 开发AI-Care系统，基于LangGraph状态编排方法，请求依次经过清洗、意图分类、上下文加载、安全检查、确定性槽位收集、工具执行和响应合成。安全关键响应（如药物和过敏）基于照护者验证的记录而非自由生成。系统支持文字和语音输入，使用ElevenLabs文本转语音，长响应分段合成。不自主做出医疗决策，对不完整或模糊请求通过受控多轮澄清处理。
AI.result: 在四名轻度至中度AD/ADRD患者的初步试点中，用户认为系统可信、有能力且令人喜爱，能够通过对话完成协调任务。
AI.conclusion: AI-Care展示了通过对话式AI代理层辅助AD/ADRD患者管理日常任务的可行性，系统设计注重安全性和用户体验，为该人群的数字工具使用提供了新的解决方案。

title: The Bystander Effect in Multi-Agent Reasoning: Quantifying Cognitive Loafing in Collaborative Interactions
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) assume that collaborating inherently improves Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning. We challenge this by demonstrating that simulated social pressure triggers an algorithmic ``Bystander Effect,'' inducing severe cognitive loafing. By evaluating 22,500 deterministic trajectories across 3 dataset contexts (GAIA, SWE-bench, Multi-Challenge) with 3 state-of-the-art (SOTA) models, we semantically audit internal reasoning traces against external outputs. We formalize the \textit{Interaction Depth Limit} ($D_L$), the exact plurality threshold where an agent's logical sovereignty collapses into social compliance. Crucially, we uncover the \textit{Sovereignty Gap}: models frequently compute the correct derivation internally but suffer ``Alignment Hallucinations'' -- actively subjugating empirical evidence to sycophantically appease a simulated swarm. We prove that multi-agent social load is strictly non-commutative; the "brand" identity of the ``Lead Anchor'' auditor disproportionately dictates the swarm's integrity. These findings expose architectural vulnerabilities, proving that unstructured multi-agent topologies can degrade independent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了“多智能体协作必然提升LLM推理能力”的假设，发现模拟社会压力会引发算法层面的“旁观者效应”，导致严重的认知懈怠。
AI.motivation: 现有MAS研究普遍假设协作能提升LLM推理能力，但缺乏对社会压力与群体动态如何影响个体推理严谨性的系统性审视。作者旨在揭示无结构多智能体拓扑在何种条件下会损害而非增强独立推理。
AI.method: 在3个数据集（GAIA、SWE-bench、Multi-Challenge）上，使用3个SOTA模型评估了22,500条确定性轨迹。方法核心是对内部推理轨迹与外部输出进行语义审计，形式化定义了交互深度极限（D_L）与主权差距，并分析多智能体社会负载的非交换性。
AI.result: 发现模拟社会压力会诱发“旁观者效应”；形式化定义了交互深度极限（D_L），即个体逻辑主权崩溃为社会顺从的阈值；揭示了“主权差距”：模型常在内部计算出正确结果，却因“对齐幻觉”而主动屈从于群体意见；证明多智能体社会负载严格非交换，“主审计者”的品牌身份对群体完整性有不成比例的决定性影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现揭示了多智能体系统的架构脆弱性，证明无结构的多智能体拓扑会削弱独立推理能力，而非增强。这对未来MAS架构设计提出了关键警示。

title: Adaptive DNN Partitioning and Offloading in Heterogeneous Edge-Cloud Continuum
summary: In recent years, the use of artificial intelligence on resource-constrained IoT devices has grown significantly. However, existing approaches to DNN partitioning and offloading across the edge-cloud continuum typically rely on static methods that ignore runtime dynamics. Furthermore, they are often evaluated in simulated environments rather than on real hardware. To address this gap, we propose a framework that dynamically splits neural network layers across the heterogeneous continuum. The framework profiles the model at startup, measures network link conditions between nodes, and periodically re-evaluates the partition to adapt to environmental changes. We created a physical testbed comprising a Raspberry Pi edge device, a laptop fog, and a high-performance desktop PC as the cloud. We evaluated the framework over three widely adopted convolutional neural networks: VGG16, AlexNet, and MobileNetV2. Our results show that the framework achieves reductions in energy and end-to-end latency of 27.09--35.82% and 6.34--22.92%, respectively, compared to a static partitioning baseline. These findings confirm the superiority of adaptive to static partitioning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个动态神经网络分割框架，在真实硬件测试平台上验证，相比静态分割方法在能耗和延迟上均有显著降低。
AI.motivation: 现有边缘-云计算中的DNN分割与卸载方法多采用静态策略，忽略了运行时的动态变化，且多在模拟环境中评估，缺乏真实硬件验证。
AI.method: 提出一个动态分割框架，在异构计算环境中分割神经网络层。该框架在启动时对模型进行性能分析，测量节点间链路状况，并周期性重新评估分割点以适应环境变化。在树莓派边缘设备、笔记本雾节点和高性能桌面云节点组成的物理测试平台上进行实验。
AI.result: 在VGG16、AlexNet和MobileNetV2三个卷积神经网络上进行评估，相比静态分割基线，能耗降低27.09-35.82%，端到端延迟降低6.34-22.92%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证实，自适应动态分割方法明显优于传统的静态分割方法，能够有效提升资源受限IoT设备上AI应用的性能。

title: Demystifying Deep Reinforcement Learning: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Interpretable Open RAN Automation
summary: Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN) are increasingly adopting data-driven control through Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) to optimize complex tasks such as network slicing and mobility management. However, the deployment of DRL in carrier-grade networks is hindered by its inherent opacity and stochastic execution, which limit operator trust, auditability, and safe deployment. Existing explainable AI (XAI) approaches primarily provide post-hoc insights and fail to produce executable, interpretable policies suitable for operational environments. In this paper, we present DeRAN, a neuro-symbolic framework that bridges the gap between DRL performance and operational transparency by distilling black-box DRL policies into human-readable symbolic representations. DeRAN introduces a concept-driven abstraction layer that transforms high-dimensional network telemetry into a compact set of semantically meaningful features, enabling interpretable policy learning. Building on the semantically grounded concepts, DeRAN synthesizes symbolic policies using deep symbolic regression (DSR) for continuous control and neurally guided differentiable logic (NUDGE) for discrete decision-making. We implement DeRAN on a live 5G O-RAN testbed and evaluate it on two representative use cases. Experimental results demonstrate that DeRAN achieves 78\% and 87\% of DRL's cumulative rewards in the two use cases, while offering interpretability and auditability by design. Source code is available at https://github.com/Jadejavu/A-Neuro-Symbolic-Framework-for-Interpretable-Open-RAN-Automation

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeRAN框架，通过将黑盒深度强化学习(DRL)策略蒸馏为人类可读的符号表示，在保持78%-87%性能的同时，为O-RAN网络控制提供可解释性和可审计性。
AI.motivation: O-RAN网络越来越多地采用深度强化学习(DRL)进行数据驱动的控制优化，但DRL固有的不透明性和随机执行特性限制了运营商信任、审计能力和安全部署。现有的可解释AI(XAI)方法主要提供事后洞察，无法产生适合运营环境的可执行、可解释策略。
AI.method: 提出DeRAN神经符号框架：(1)引入概念驱动的抽象层，将高维网络遥测数据转换为语义有意义的紧凑特征集；(2)针对连续控制任务使用深度符号回归(DSR)合成符号策略；(3)针对离散决策任务使用神经引导的可微分逻辑(NUDGE)方法。该框架在真实5G O-RAN测试平台上实现并验证。
AI.result: 在两个代表性用例中，DeRAN分别达到DRL累积奖励的78%和87%，同时通过设计提供可解释性和可审计性。实验证明了该框架在保持性能的同时实现策略透明化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DeRAN成功弥合了DRL性能与操作透明度之间的差距，为O-RAN自动化提供了一种可行的解决方案，使得运营商能够理解、信任并审计网络控制策略，为DRL在运营商级网络中的安全部署铺平了道路。

title: Latent Personality Alignment: Improving Harmlessness Without Mentioning Harms
comment: published at Trustworthy AI Workshop, ICLR 2026
summary: Current adversarial robustness methods for large language models require extensive datasets of harmful prompts (thousands to hundreds of thousands of examples), yet remain vulnerable to novel attack vectors and distributional shifts. We propose Latent Personality Alignment (LPA), a sample-efficient defense that achieves robustness by training models on abstract personality traits rather than specific harmful behaviors. Using fewer than 100 trait statements and latent adversarial training, LPA achieves comparable attack success rates to methods trained on 150k+ examples, while maintaining superior utility. Critically, LPA generalizes better to unseen attack distributions, reducing misclassification rates by 2.6x compared to baseline across six harm benchmarks -- without ever seeing harmful examples during training. Our results demonstrate that personality-based alignment offers a principled approach to building robust defenses with minimal cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了潜在人格对齐（LPA）方法，通过在抽象人格特质上进行训练，仅需不到100条特质陈述即可达到与使用15万+样本训练的方法相当的防御效果，且在未见过的攻击分布上泛化能力更强。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型对抗鲁棒性方法需要大量有害提示数据集（数千至数十万样本），但仍容易受到新型攻击向量和分布偏移的影响，且数据收集成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出潜在人格对齐（LPA）方法，这是一种样本高效的防御策略。该方法不依赖具体的有害行为样本，而是基于抽象人格特质进行训练。结合潜在对抗训练技术，仅使用不到100条特质陈述来引导模型行为。
AI.result: LPA在攻击成功率上与基于15万+样本训练的方法相当，同时保持了更优的模型效用。在六个危害基准测试中，LPA对未见攻击分布的误分类率降低了2.6倍，且训练过程中完全未接触有害示例。
AI.conclusion: 基于人格特质的对齐方法为构建低成本、高鲁棒性的防御机制提供了一种有原则的方法，证明了抽象特质训练相比具体行为样本训练具有更好的样本效率和泛化能力。

title: Reasoning emerges from constrained inference manifolds in large language models
