Decentralized mix-and-forward designs remove the server, but repeated local mixing can attenuate global information under heterogeneity and exposes peer-to-peer neighborhoods as a privacy attack surface. To preserve FedAvg-style aggregation semantics (over updates reconstructable by the round deadline) while scaling dissemination, we present FLTorrent, a BitTorrent-based dissemination layer for serverless FL with a short warm-up. Warm-up hardens within-round source unlinkability -- a dissemination-layer goal orthogonal to content protections (e.g., DP or secure aggregation) -- via (i) pre-round obfuscation, (ii) randomized lags, and (iii) coordination-only non-owner-first scheduling (tracker off the data path), before switching to vanilla BitTorrent swarming. We upper-bound the per-transfer attribution posterior by the fraction of owner chunks in a sender's eligible cover set, and derive a tighter high-probability bound that improves with early non-owner mass. A simple heuristic, GreedyFastestFirst, attains approximately 92% of a bandwidth-optimal max-flow upper bound, while warm-up remains a stable approximately 12% share of a round across 100--500 peers. Under an observation-only local adversary, FLTorrent drives attribution success close to neighborhood-level random guessing for typical nodes, improves with network size, and remains robust under collusion. In LLM-scale stress tests (Gemma-7B, DeepSeek-R1-14B, Qwen2.5-32B, and Llama-3.3-70B) over 7--10 Gbps access links, FLTorrent adds only approximately 6--10% end-to-end overhead relative to BitTorrent-only. Overall, FLTorrent shows that within-round unlinkability and BitTorrent-level efficiency can co-exist with predictable, low overheads at scale.

AI.tldr: FLTorrent是一种基于BitTorrent的无服务器联邦学习传播层，通过短暂的预热阶段实现轮内源不可链接性，在保持高效传播的同时显著提升隐私保护。
AI.motivation: 传统联邦学习依赖中心聚合服务器，存在性能瓶颈和隐私风险；现有的去中心化mix-and-forward设计在异构性下会衰减全局信息，且点对点邻域暴露了隐私攻击面。需要一种既能保持FedAvg风格聚合语义，又能扩展传播规模且保护隐私的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出FLTorrent，基于BitTorrent的无服务器FL传播层，包含短暂预热阶段。预热通过(i)轮前混淆、(ii)随机延迟和(iii)仅协调的非所有者优先调度（tracker不在数据路径上）来强化轮内源不可链接性，之后切换到标准BitTorrent群传模式。提出GreedyFastestFirst启发式算法优化带宽利用。
AI.result: GreedyFastestFirst算法达到带宽最优最大流上界的约92%，预热阶段在100-500个节点中稳定占轮次的约12%。在仅观察的本地对手下，FLTorrent将归属成功率接近邻域级随机猜测，并随网络规模提升，在合谋攻击下保持鲁棒性。在LLM规模压力测试（Gemma-7B到Llama-3.3-70B）中，相比纯BitTorrent仅增加约6-10%的端到端开销。
AI.conclusion: FLTorrent证明了轮内不可链接性与BitTorrent级效率可以在大规模下共存，具有可预测的低开销，为无服务器联邦学习提供了一种实用的隐私保护传播方案。

title: What Will Happen Next: Large Models-Driven Deduction for Emergency Instances
summary: Traditional simulation methods reproduce occurred emergency instances through presetting to assist people in risk assessment and emergency decision-making. However, due to the lack of randomness and diversity, existing simulation systems struggle to fully explore the potential risk as emergency instances are scarce. In contrast, Large Models (LMs) can dynamically adjust generation strategies to introduce controllable randomness, while also possessing extensive prior knowledge and cross-domain knowledge transfer capabilities. Inspired by it, we propose the LMs-driven World Line Divergence System (WLDS), which enables diversified visualization and deduction of emergency instances in different domains. WLDS leverages LMs to deduce emergency instances in various development directions, and introduces the factual calibration and logical calibration mechanism to ensure factual accuracy and logical rigor during the deduction process. The interactive module can independently select deduction directions to avoid potential hallucinations that are difficult for the system to identify. Furthermore, by introducing the visualization module, WLDS forms simulation and deduction that combine text and images, which enhances interpretability. Extensive experiments conducted on the proposed Emergency Instances Deduction (EID) benchmark dataset demonstrate that WLDS achieves high-precision and high-fidelity simulation and deduction of emergency instances in multiple specific domains. Relevant experiments further demonstrate that WLDS can generate more emergency instances deduction data for users and provide support for better decision-making in similar emergency instances in the future.

AI.tldr: 提出LMs驱动的世界线分歧系统(WLDS)，利用大模型的可控随机性实现应急案例的多维度可视化推演，通过校准机制保证准确性，为应急决策提供支持。
AI.motivation: 传统仿真方法通过预设重现已发生的应急案例，但缺乏随机性和多样性，难以充分探索潜在风险；而应急案例本身稀缺，现有仿真系统难以覆盖全面的风险场景。
AI.method: 提出LMs驱动的世界线分歧系统(WLDS)：利用大模型推演不同发展方向的应急案例；引入事实校准和逻辑校准机制确保推演的事实准确性和逻辑严密性；设计交互模块支持用户独立选择推演方向以规避幻觉问题；结合可视化模块实现图文结合的仿真推演。
AI.result: 在提出的应急案例推演(EID)基准数据集上进行广泛实验，WLDS在多个特定领域实现了高精度、高保真的应急案例仿真与推演；能生成更多应急案例推演数据辅助决策。
AI.conclusion: WLDS能够有效生成多样化的应急案例推演数据，为用户在类似应急案例中提供更好的决策支持，弥补了传统仿真方法在随机性和多样性方面的不足。

title: Physics-Modeled Neural Networks
summary:
We introduce \emph{Dynamical Physics-Modeled Neural Networks} (DynPMNNs), a continuous-time deep learning architecture in which each hidden layer is defined as the solution of an ordinary differential equation. Unlike classical feed-forward networks, this approach replaces static activation functions with time-evolving dynamical systems, providing a biologically inspired interpretation of hidden-layer behavior and enabling the integration of physically meaningful models. The framework is rigorously grounded in Reproducing Kernel Banach Spaces (RKBSs), allowing DynPMNNs to be characterized as finite-dimensional solutions of an abstract training problem and revealing structural connections with standard neural networks.
  We present a concrete implementation based on the FitzHugh--Nagumo model for neuronal activation, where numerical ODE solvers are embedded into the computational graph via Euler-type schemes. Both network weights and dynamical parameters are trained jointly. Through experiments on the California Housing dataset, we compare DynPMNNs with Neural ODEs (NODEs) and Closed-form Continuous-Time Networks (CfCs). Despite using fewer trainable parameters, DynPMNNs achieve competitive performance.
  These results position DynPMNNs as a principled bridge between dynamical systems and deep learning, with promising directions for further research in expressivity, stability, and physics-based modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出DynPMNNs，一种基于ODE的连续时间神经网络，用动态物理模型替代静态激活函数，在参数更少的情况下性能优于或持平Neural ODEs与CfCs。
AI.motivation: 传统前馈网络中的静态激活函数缺乏生物可解释性，且难以融合物理先验；希望借助动力系统构建更具表达力与物理意义的新型网络架构。
AI.method: 在RKBS框架下，将每个隐藏层定义为ODE的解，实现为时间演化的动力系统；以FitzHugh–Nagumo神经元模型为具体实例，采用Euler型数值格式嵌入计算图，联合训练网络权重与动力学参数。
AI.result: 在California Housing数据集上，DynPMNNs以更少的可训练参数取得了与Neural ODEs和CfCs相当或更好的性能。
AI.conclusion: DynPMNNs为动力系统与深度学习提供了原理性桥梁，在表达能力、稳定性及物理建模方面具有研究前景。

title: CodeClinic: Evaluating Automation of Coding Skills for Clinical Reasoning Agents
summary: Clinical reasoning agents based on large language models (LLMs) aim to automate tasks such as intensive care unit (ICU) monitoring and patient state tracking from electronic health records (EHRs). Existing systems typically rely on manually curated clinical tools or skills for concepts such as sepsis detection and organ failure assessment. However, maintaining these tool libraries requires substantial expert effort, while zero-shot querying or code generation often produces inefficient and unreliable reasoning chains, especially under institution-specific clinical policies. We introduce CodeClinic, a benchmark built on MIMIC-IV for evaluating whether LLM agents can synthesize and compose reusable clinical skills instead of relying on fixed toolboxes. The benchmark contains two complementary tasks: longitudinal ICU surveillance and compositional information seeking. The longitudinal setting simulates monitoring patient trajectories with structured decisions every four hours across 25 findings and eight clinical families, while the compositional setting spans 63k instances across 259 tasks in nine domains and is stratified by compositional dependency depth to evaluate increasingly complex multi-step reasoning. We further propose an offline autoformalization pipeline that converts natural-language clinical guidelines into reusable and verified Python skill libraries through iterative LLM refinement. Compared with zero-shot code generation, the resulting libraries improve consistency while reducing per-query token usage by up to 40%.

AI.tldr: 提出了CodeClinic基准和离线自动形式化流程，用于评估和构建可复用的临床技能库，相比零样本代码生成，提高了ICU临床推理任务的一致性并减少了40%的令牌使用量。
AI.motivation: 现有的临床推理智能体依赖人工维护的临床工具库，维护成本高；零样本查询或代码生成在特定机构政策下常产生低效且不可靠的推理链。
AI.method: 1. 构建基于MIMIC-IV的CodeClinic基准，包含纵向ICU监护和组合信息查询两项任务；2. 提出离线自动形式化流程，通过迭代LLM精炼将自然语言临床指南转化为可验证、可复用的Python技能库。
AI.result: 与零样本代码生成相比，自动形式化生成的技能库提高了推理一致性，并将每次查询的令牌使用量降低了最多40%。
AI.conclusion: 通过离线自动形式化构建可复用的临床技能库，可以有效替代手工工具维护，显著提升临床推理智能体在复杂临床场景下的效率和可靠性。

title: Accelerating Compound LLM Training Workloads with Maestro
summary: Compound LLM training workloads-such as knowledge distillation and multimodal LLM (MLLM) training-are gaining prominence. These typically comprise heterogeneous components differing in parameter scale, execution mode (forward-only or full forward-backward), and sequence length. Besides, component activation can be data-dependent: in MLLM training, modality-specific parts activate only when inputs contain corresponding modalities, causing dynamic computational paths and irregular runtime workloads. Conventional frameworks, designed for monolithic models, cannot handle the dual heterogeneity-static (across components) and dynamic (runtime). By enforcing one-size-fits-all training configurations across components and ignoring input-induced variations, they suffer suboptimal throughput and poor GPU utilization. In this paper, we introduce Maestro, a section-centric training framework that addresses both challenges. Maestro first restructures the workload into a coarse-grained section graph. Each section independently configures its parallelism strategy, micro-batch size, and data-parallel degree-enabling fine-grained, component-aware resource allocation to tackle static heterogeneity. To tackle runtime irregularity, Maestro introduces a wavefront scheduling algorithm that dynamically reorders input samples to orchestrate concurrent section execution while preserving cross-section data dependencies. This maximizes inter-section parallelism and minimizes stalls, boosting hardware utilization. Deployed in production for millions of GPU hours, Maestro reduces GPU consumption by ~40% on key workloads-including knowledge distillation and MLLM training-validating its real-world impact.

AI.tldr: 提出了Maestro，一个面向组件化LLM训练（如知识蒸馏、多模态LLM训练）的系统框架，通过段落级独立配置和波前调度算法解决了静态与动态双重异构性挑战，在关键任务上降低约40%的GPU消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度学习训练框架主要针对单一模型设计，无法有效处理复合LLM训练负载中的双重异构性：静态异构性（不同组件在参数规模、执行模式、序列长度上的差异）和动态异构性（运行时因输入数据不同导致的计算路径和负载不规则变化）。传统框架采用一刀切的训练配置并忽略输入引起的运行时变化，导致吞吐量低下和GPU利用率不佳。
AI.method: 提出了Maestro，一个以段落为中心的训练框架：1）将负载重构为粗粒度段落图，每个段落独立配置并行策略、微批次大小和数据并行度，实现细粒度的组件感知资源分配以应对静态异构性；2）引入波前调度算法，通过动态重排序输入样本来编排并发段落执行并保持跨段落数据依赖，最大化段间并行度并减少停顿，从而应对运行时不规则性。
AI.result: Maestro已在生产环境中部署数百万GPU小时。在知识蒸馏和多模态LLM训练等关键任务上，Maestro将GPU消耗降低了约40%，验证了其实际应用价值。
AI.conclusion: Maestro成功解决了复合LLM训练负载中的双重异构性问题，通过段落级独立配置和动态调度实现了高效的资源利用，为大规模LLM训练提供了有效的系统级解决方案，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: The Echo Amplifies the Knowledge: Somatic Marker Analogues in Language Models via Emotion Vector Re-Injection
summary:
Current language model memory systems store what happened but not how it felt. This distinction -- between semantic memory (knowing about a past event) and episodic memory (re-experiencing it) -- was identified by Tulving as the difference between noetic and autonoetic consciousness. Damasio demonstrated that humans with intact knowledge but absent emotional markers exhibit impaired decision-making.
  We bridge this gap for language models. Using Gemma 3 1B-IT with pretrained Gemma Scope 2 sparse autoencoders, we identify 310 emotion-exclusive features at layer 22 with psychologically valid geometry. We construct distinctive-feature emotion vectors during experience and partially re-inject them during recall, triggered by context similarity at layer 7.
  We test four conditions paralleling Damasio's framework: A (no memory), B (semantic labels), C (emotion echo), and BC (semantic + echo). For emotional orientation, the echo alone steepens the threat-safety gradient: the regression slope of threat rating on contextual similarity is 0.80 for C vs 0.56 for A ($p$=0.011, permutation test). For decisions, the echo amplifies knowledge into action: BC=80% good choices vs B=52% ($z$=+2.60, $p$<0.01), while the echo alone has no effect (C=22%, n.s.). The echo changes how the model feels independently, but changes what it does only when combined with knowledge -- replicating Damasio's core finding.
  The echo amplifies knowledge. It does not replace it.

AI.tldr: 本研究为语言模型构建了类似人类情节记忆的“情感回声”机制，通过在回忆时重新注入情感特征向量，成功复现了达马西奥关于情感标记促进决策的核心发现：情感回声单独作用改变模型感受，但需与语义知识结合才能改善决策行为。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型记忆系统仅存储语义信息（发生了什么），缺乏情节记忆中的情感体验（感觉如何）。根据Tulving的理论，这对应于认知意识与自知意识的区别；Damasio的研究表明，仅有知识但缺失情感标记会导致决策能力受损。本研究旨在弥合语言模型中知识与情感体验之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 使用Gemma 3 1B-IT模型和预训练的Gemma Scope 2稀疏自编码器，在第22层识别出310个具有心理学有效几何结构的情感专属特征。在体验阶段构建特异性情感特征向量，在回忆阶段通过第7层的上下文相似性触发部分重新注入这些向量（情感回声机制）。设计四种条件进行测试：A（无记忆）、B（语义标签）、C（情感回声）、BC（语义+回声），以平行对照Damasio的实验框架。
AI.result: 情感回声单独作用时显著增强了威胁-安全梯度（条件C的回归斜率为0.80，条件A为0.56，p=0.011），改变了模型的感受。在决策方面，情感回声与语义知识结合时效果最佳（条件BC的正确选择率为80%，条件B为52%，z=+2.60，p<0.01）；而情感回声单独使用时无显著效果（条件C正确率22%）。这表明情感回声放大知识而非替代知识。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功在语言模型中复现了Damasio的核心发现：情感标记独立地改变模型的感受状态，但只有与语义知识结合时才能改善决策行为。这证明为语言模型补充类情节记忆的情感维度是可行且有效的，为构建更完善的人工智能记忆系统提供了新方向。

title: Echo-LoRA: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning via Cross-Layer Representation Injection
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become a practical route for adapting large language models to downstream tasks, with LoRA-style methods being particularly attractive because they are inexpensive to train and easy to deploy. Most LoRA variants, however, revise the update rule within the weight space of each layer and leave the intermediate representations formed by deeper layers largely unused. We propose Echo-LoRA, a cross-layer representation injection method for parameter-efficient fine-tuning. During training, Echo-LoRA collects boundary hidden states from deeper source layers, aggregates them into a sample-level echo representation, and uses lightweight projection and gating networks to inject the resulting signal into shallow LoRA or DoRA modules. Answer-only masking, masked distillation, and stochastic routing are used to keep this auxiliary path stable and to reduce the gap between training and inference. On eight commonsense reasoning benchmarks, Echo-LoRA exceeds the reported LoRA baselines by 5.7 percentage points on average across LLaMA-7B, LLaMA2-7B, and LLaMA3-8B. Under reproduced LoRA baselines in our unified implementation, the average gain is 3.0 points; when combined with DoRA, the gain is 2.7 points. The Echo path is discarded after training, so the deployed model keeps the original low-rank LoRA/DoRA form and adds neither inference-time parameters nor inference computation.

AI.tldr: 提出Echo-LoRA，通过跨层表示注入提升PEFT性能，平均提升3.0-5.7个百分点，且不增加推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有LoRA变体主要修改层内权重更新规则，而忽略了深层形成的中间表示的利用，存在信息利用不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出Echo-LoRA跨层表示注入方法：训练时从深层源层收集边界隐藏状态，聚合为样本级回声表示，通过轻量投影和门控网络注入到浅层LoRA/DoRA模块。采用仅答案掩码、掩码蒸馏和随机路由技术保持辅助路径稳定性并缩小训练推理差距。训练后丢弃Echo路径，保持原始低秩形式。
AI.result: 在8个常识推理基准测试上，相比报告的LoRA基线，在LLaMA-7B、LLaMA2-7B和LLaMA3-8B上平均提升5.7个百分点；在统一实现的重现基线上平均提升3.0点；与DoRA结合时提升2.7点。
AI.conclusion: Echo-LoRA成功利用跨层表示增强参数高效微调，显著提升性能的同时不增加推理时参数和计算开销，保持了部署的简便性。

title: EnactToM: An Evolving Benchmark for Functional Theory of Mind in Embodied Agents
summary: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to track others epistemic state, makes humans efficient collaborators. AI agents need the same capacity in multi agent settings, yet existing benchmarks mostly test literal ToM by asking direct belief questions. The ability act optimally on implicit beliefs in embodied environments, called functional ToM, remains largely untested. We introduce EnactToM, an evolving benchmark of 300 embodied multi-agent tasks set in a 3D household with partial observability, private information, and constrained communication. Each task is formally verified for solvability and required epistemic depth, and new tasks are generated increase difficulty as models improve. On the hard split, all seven evaluated frontier models score 0.0% Pass^3 on functional task completion, while averaging 45.0% on literal belief probes. Manual analysis traces 93% of sampled failures to epistemic coordination breakdowns such as withheld information, ignored partner constraints, and misallocated messages, providing a concrete target for future work.

AI.tldr: 提出了EnactToM基准测试，用于评估AI在具身多智能体环境中的功能性心智理论。现有前沿模型在功能性任务完成上得分为0%，而在字面信念探测上平均得分为45.0%，主要失败原因归因于认知协调崩溃。
AI.motivation: 现有的心智理论基准测试主要评估字面ToM，即通过直接询问信念问题来测试。然而，在多智能体环境中，AI智能体需要具备功能性ToM能力，即在具身环境中基于隐含信念最优行动的能力。这种关键能力目前缺乏有效测试。
AI.method: 引入EnactToM基准测试，包含300个具身多智能体任务，设置在具有部分可观测性、私人信息和受限通信的3D家庭环境中。每个任务都经过形式验证以确保可解性和所需的认知深度，并随着模型改进生成新任务以增加难度。
AI.result: 在困难划分上，所有七个评估的前沿模型在功能性任务完成上的Pass^3得分均为0.0%，而在字面信念探测上平均得分为45.0%。人工分析发现93%的抽样失败可追溯到认知协调崩溃，包括隐瞒信息、忽视合作伙伴约束和错误分配消息。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前AI模型在功能性心智理论方面的重大缺陷，将失败原因具体追溯到认知协调崩溃，为未来研究提供了明确目标。这表明从字面ToM到功能性ToM的跨越仍是AI系统的重大挑战。

title: Surviving Partial Rank Failures in Wide Expert-Parallel MoE Inference
summary:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) serving relies on wide expert parallelism (EP) to aggregate the memory capacity and bandwidth of many GPUs within one inference instance. This efficiency comes with a systems cost: every decoding step depends on token dispatch and combination across all active EP ranks, so even one rank failure can disrupt the entire service. Existing EP stacks handle such failures poorly because they treat membership as a fixed configuration established at initialization. The same rank set determines communicator state, expert placement, and the routing metadata baked into CUDA execution graphs, leaving the system with no way to shrink around a failure while keeping the instance valid.
  This paper argues that partial-failure tolerance should instead be formulated as a live EP validity problem. We present EEP, a communication and runtime substrate that represents membership as explicit, mutable runtime state. EEP repairs the specific state invalidated by a fault: it restores peer reachability without rebuilding the communication substrate, repairs lost expert coverage through a bandwidth-aware hierarchy, and reintegrates repaired ranks without forcing healthy ranks to recapture their CUDA graphs.
  We implement EEP in an EP serving stack integrated with SGLang and evaluate it under steady-state serving, failure recovery, and rank reintegration. The results show that explicit mutable membership preserves the steady-state fast path, staying within 4.4% of a fixed-membership DeepEP baseline under static serving, while turning a local rank fault from whole-instance downtime into two bounded interruptions. On a single-rank failure workload, EEP incurs an 11s recovery pause and an 8s reintegration pause, and restores throughput to within 95% of the pre-fault level within 52s, whereas a fixed-membership full-restart baseline remains unavailable until 348s.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EEP，一个支持显式可变成员状态的通信与运行时框架，使MoE推理系统具备部分容错能力。它能在单卡故障时快速恢复服务（恢复停顿11秒、重整合停顿8秒），而无需重启整个实例，且稳态性能仅比固定成员基线下降4.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE推理系统采用专家并行（EP）聚合多GPU内存，但将成员关系视为初始化时固定的配置。一旦某个EP rank发生故障，由于通信状态、专家放置和路由元数据均固化在CUDA执行图中，系统无法收缩以隔离故障，导致整个服务中断。作者认为应将部分容错建模为“在线EP有效性问题”。
AI.method: 提出EEP框架，将成员关系表示为显式、可变的运行时状态。故障后，EEP：1) 无需重建通信底座即可恢复对等可达性；2) 通过带宽感知层级机制修复专家覆盖；3) 在重合修好的rank时无需强制健康rank重新捕获CUDA执行图。基于SGLang集成实现EP服务栈。
AI.result: 在稳态服务下，EEP相比固定成员DeepEP基线性能损失仅4.4%。在单rank故障场景下，EEP将全局服务中断转化为两次有限中断：恢复停顿11秒、重整合停顿8秒，52秒内吞吐恢复至故障前95%；而固定成员全重启基线在348秒内完全不可用。
AI.conclusion: 将成员关系显式化为可变运行时状态是实现MoE服务部分容错的关键。EEP在不牺牲稳态性能的前提下，显著降低了单点故障对服务可用性的影响，为大规模MoE部署提供了更鲁棒的运行时支撑。

title: Generalized Category Discovery in Federated Graph Learning
summary: Federated Graph Learning (FGL) enables collaborative learning over distributed graph data, yet existing approaches largely rely on a closed-world assumption, limiting their applicability in dynamic environments where novel categories continuously emerge. To bridge this gap, we target the practical scenario of Federated Graph Generalized Category Discovery (FGGCD), aiming to collaboratively discover novel categories across decentralized graph clients while retaining knowledge of known categories. We observe that FGGCD introduces two fundamental challenges: (1) the Neighborhood Absorption Effect, where structural fragmentation leads to biased neighborhood aggregation, causing novel nodes to be misclassified as known categories; and (2) Global Semantic Inconsistency, where the aforementioned local biases propagate to the server and are amplified by heterogeneous subgraph distributions, hindering cross-client knowledge integration. To address these issues, we propose GCD-FGL, an FGL framework for GCD that integrates a client-side Topology-Reliable Semantic Alignment and Discovery process to mitigate the neighborhood absorption effect, and a server-side Hierarchical Prototype Alignment strategy to resolve global semantic inconsistency. Extensive experiments on five real-world graph datasets demonstrate that GCD-FGL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average absolute gain of +4.86 in HRScore.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GCD-FGL框架，解决了联邦图学习中动态环境下新类别发现的问题，通过拓扑可靠的语义对齐与发现过程以及分层原型对齐策略，有效缓解了邻域吸收效应和全局语义不一致问题，在五个真实图数据集上取得了显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的联邦图学习方法主要基于封闭世界假设，限制了其在动态环境中的适用性，而在实际场景中，新类别会持续出现。为了填补这一空白，本文针对联邦图广义类别发现（FGGCD）的实际场景，旨在跨去中心化图客户端协作发现新类别，同时保留已知类别的知识。
AI.method: 提出了GCD-FGL框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 客户端的拓扑可靠语义对齐与发现过程，通过缓解邻域吸收效应来解决结构碎片化导致的偏向性邻域聚合问题；(2) 服务器端的分层原型对齐策略，解决由异构子图分布放大导致的跨客户端知识集成困难。
AI.result: 在五个真实世界图数据集上进行了广泛实验，GCD-FFL一致性地超越了最先进的基线方法，在HRScore上实现了平均绝对增益+4.86。
AI.conclusion: GCD-FGL框架成功解决了联邦图广义类别发现中的邻域吸收效应和全局语义不一致两个根本性挑战，证明了该方法在动态环境中进行联邦图学习的有效性和优越性，为开放世界下的联邦图学习提供了新的解决方案。

title: RADAR: Redundancy-Aware Diffusion for Multi-Agent Communication Structure Generation
summary: Compared with individual agents, large language model based multi-agent systems have shown great capabilities consistently across diverse tasks, including code generation, mathematical reasoning, and planning, etc. Despite their impressive performance, the effectiveness and robustness of these systems heavily rely on their communication topology, which is often fixed or generated in a single step. This restricts fine-grained structural exploration and flexible composition, resulting in excessive token utilization on simple tasks while limiting capability on complicated tasks. To mitigate this challenge, we introduce RADAR, a redundancy-aware and query-adaptive generative framework that actively reduce communication overhead. Motivated by recent progress in conditional discrete graph diffusion models, we formulate communication topology design as a step-by-step generation process, guided by the effective size of the graph. Comprehensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that RADAR consistently outperforms recent baselines, achieving higher accuracy, lower token consumption, and greater robustness across diverse scenarios. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/cszhangzhen/RADAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RADAR框架，通过将通信拓扑设计建模为逐步生成过程，实现了冗余感知和查询自适应的多智能体通信优化，在六项基准测试中取得了更高准确性、更低token消耗和更强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的多智能体系统性能高度依赖通信拓扑，但现有拓扑结构往往固定或单步生成，缺乏细粒度结构探索和灵活组合能力，导致简单任务token浪费而复杂任务能力受限。
AI.method: 受条件离散图扩散模型启发，将通信拓扑设计建模为由图有效规模引导的逐步生成过程，实现冗余感知和查询自适应的通信开销优化。
AI.result: 在六个基准测试上的综合实验表明，RADAR在准确性、token消耗和鲁棒性方面均一致优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: RADAR成功解决了多智能体系统中通信拓扑设计的关键挑战，通过自适应生成过程实现了性能与效率的有效平衡，为多智能体系统设计提供了新的范式。

title: An Uncertainty-Aware Resilience Micro-Agent for Causal Observability in the Computing Continuum
summary: Grey failures in the computing continuum produce ambiguous overlapping symptoms that existing approaches fail to diagnose reliably, either due to a lack of causal awareness or acting under high epistemic uncertainty, risking destructive interventions. This paper presents an uncertainty-aware resilience micro-agent for causal observability (AURORA), a lightweight framework for diagnosing and mitigating grey failures in edge-tier environments. The framework employs parallel micro-agents that integrate the free-energy principle, causal do-calculus, and localized causal state-graphs to support counterfactual root-cause analysis within each fault's Markov blanket. Restricting inference to causally relevant variables reduces computational overhead while preserving diagnostic fidelity. AURORA further introduces a dual-gated execution mechanism that authorizes remediation only when causal confidence is high and predicted epistemic uncertainty is bounded; otherwise, it abstains from local intervention and escalates the diagnostic payload to the fog tier. Our experiments demonstrate that AURORA outperforms baselines, achieving a 0% destructive action rate, while maintaining 62.0% repair accuracy and a 3ms mean time to repair.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AURORA框架，通过因果推理和不确定性感知机制在边缘环境中诊断灰色故障，实现了零破坏性操作和较高修复准确率。
AI.motivation: 计算连续体中的灰色故障产生模糊重叠症状，现有诊断方法因缺乏因果意识或在高认识不确定性下行动，导致诊断不可靠并可能引发破坏性干预。
AI.method: 提出轻量级框架AURORA，采用并行微智能体集成自由能原理、因果do-calculus和局部因果状态图，在每个故障的马尔可夫毯内进行反事实根因分析。引入双门控执行机制，仅在因果置信度高且预测认识不确定性有界时授权修复，否则升级至雾层处理。
AI.result: 实验表明AURORA优于基线方法，实现0%破坏性行为率，保持62.0%修复准确率，平均修复时间为3ms。
AI.conclusion: AURORA通过限制推断于因果相关变量并结合不确定性感知机制，在保持诊断保真度的同时降低计算开销，为边缘层灰色故障提供了可靠且安全的诊断与缓解方案。

title: DiagnosticIQ: A Benchmark for LLM-Based Industrial Maintenance Action Recommendation from Symbolic Rules
summary: Monitoring complex industrial assets relies on engineer-authored symbolic rules that trigger based on sensor conditions and prompt technicians to perform corrective actions. The bottleneck is not detection but response: translating rules into maintenance steps requires asset-specific knowledge gained through years of practice. We investigate whether LLMs can serve as decision support for this rule-to-action step and introduce \ours{}, a benchmark of 6{,}690 expert-validated multiple-choice questions from 118 rule-action pairs across 16 asset types. We contribute (i) a symbolic-to-MCQA pipeline normalizing rules to Disjunctive Normal Form with embedding-based distractor sampling, (ii) five variants probing distinct failure modes (Pro, Pert, Verbose, Aug, Rationale), and (iii) a benchmark of 29 LLMs and 4 embedding baselines. A human evaluation (9 practitioners, mean 45.0\%) confirms \ours{} requires specialist knowledge beyond operational experience. Three findings stand out. The frontier has closed: the top three LLMs lie within one Macro point, with Bradley-Terry Elo placing claude-opus-4-6 30 points above the next model. Yet \ours{}\,Pro exposes brittleness, with every model losing 13--60\% relative accuracy under distractor expansion. \ours{}\,Aug exposes pattern-matching: under condition inversion, frontier models still select the original answer 49--63\% of the time. The deployment bottleneck is not capability but calibration: frontier models handle template-style fault detection but break under structural perturbation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Rule2Action基准测试，包含6,690个专家验证的多选题，用于评估LLM在工业资产维护中将符号规则转化为维护行动的能力。研究发现：前沿模型性能相近但面对干扰项扩展时脆弱性显著（准确率下降13-60%），存在模式匹配倾向，校准问题比能力问题更关键。
AI.motivation: 工业资产监控依赖工程师编写的符号规则触发传感器条件并提示技术人员采取纠正措施。瓶颈不在于检测而在于响应：将规则转化为维护步骤需要通过多年实践获得的特定资产知识。本文旨在研究LLM是否能作为规则到行动步骤的决策支持工具。
AI.method: 1) 构建符号到多选题（MCQA）的流程：将规则规范化为析取范式（DNF），使用基于嵌入的干扰项采样；2) 设计五种变体探测不同失效模式：Pro（专业版）、Pert（扰动）、Verbose（冗长）、Aug（增强）、Rationale（理由）；3) 对29个LLM和4个嵌入基线进行基准测试；4) 进行人工评估（9名从业者）。
AI.result: 1) 前沿模型差距缩小：前三名LLM在一个宏观点范围内，Bradley-Terry Elo显示claude-opus-4-6领先30分；2) Rule2Action Pro暴露脆弱性：所有模型在干扰项扩展下相对准确率损失13-60%；3) Rule2Action Aug暴露模式匹配问题：在条件反转下，前沿模型仍49-63%的时间选择原始答案；4) 人工评估（平均45.0%）证实该基准需要超越操作经验的专业知识。
AI.conclusion: 部署瓶颈不在于能力而在于校准：前沿模型能够处理模板式的故障检测，但在结构扰动下会失效。这表明LLM在工业维护决策支持中需要更好的鲁棒性和可靠性，而不仅仅是提高基础能力。

title: Quantile Geometry Regularization for Distributional Reinforcement Learning
summary: Quantile-based distributional reinforcement learning methods learn return distributions through sampled quantile regression, but their bootstrapped target quantiles may induce distorted or degenerate distribution estimates. We propose Robust Quantile-based Implicit Quantile Networks (RQIQN), a lightweight Wasserstein distributionally robust enhancement boosted from a quantile estimation perspective. We first reinterpret a snapshot of IQN loss as a collection of local empirical quantile estimation problems over sampled current fractions. We then robustify each local slot with a Wasserstein distributionally robust quantile estimation formulation, yielding a closed-form, fraction-dependent correction to the Bellman target. This correction directly addresses distributional degeneration: its median antisymmetry preserves the risk-neutral quantile average, while its monotonicity enlarges upper-lower quantile gaps and counteracts collapsed distributional spread. RQIQN thus regularizes quantile geometry without changing the underlying value objective or requiring additional sample set reconstruction. Finally, we empirically show that the proposed RQIQN outperforms other existing quantile-based distributional reinforcement learning algorithms in risk-sensitive navigation and Atari games.

AI.tldr: 提出RQIQN算法，通过Wasserstein分布鲁棒量化估计校正Bellman目标，解决分位数分布强化学习中分布退化问题，在风险敏感导航和Atari游戏中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于分位数的分布强化学习方法通过采样分位数回归学习回报分布，但其自举目标分位数可能导致扭曲或退化的分布估计，特别是分布展度塌缩问题。
AI.method: 将IQN损失重新解释为在采样当前分数上的局部经验分位数估计问题集合，然后使用Wasserstein分布鲁棒分位数估计公式对每个局部位置进行鲁棒化，产生闭式的、依赖分数的Bellman目标校正。该校正具有中位数反对称性以保持风险中性分位数平均值，同时其单调性扩大上下分位数间隙，抵消分布展度塌缩。
AI.result: RQIQN直接解决了分布退化问题，在不改变底层价值目标或需要额外样本集重建的情况下，正则化分位数几何。实验表明在风险敏感导航和Atari游戏中，RQIQN优于其他现有基于分位数的分布强化学习算法。
AI.conclusion: RQIQN提供了一种轻量级的Wasserstein分布鲁棒增强方法，有效解决了分位数分布强化学习中的分布估计失真问题，保持了理论上的风险中性，同时在实际应用中取得了更好的性能。

title: Route by State, Recover from Trace: STAR with Failure-Aware Markov Routing for Multi-Agent Spatiotemporal Reasoning
summary: Compositional spatiotemporal reasoning often requires a system to invoke multiple heterogeneous specialists, such as geometric, temporal, topological, and trajectory agents. A central question is how such a system should route among specialists when execution does not simply succeed or fail, but fails in qualitatively different ways. Existing tool-augmented and multi-agent LLM systems typically leave this routing decision implicit in language generation, making recovery ad hoc, difficult to interpret, and hard to optimize. This paper presents STAR (Spatio-Temporal Agent Router), a failure-aware routing framework that externalizes inter-agent control as a state-conditioned transition policy over the current agent, task type, and typed execution status. At the center of STARis an agent routing matrix that combines expert-specified nominal routes with recovery transitions learned from execution traces. Because the matrix conditions on distinct failure states, the router can respond differently to malformed outputs, missing dependencies, and tool--query mismatches, rather than collapsing them into a generic retry signal. Specialists execute through a tool-grounded extract--compute--deposit protocol and write intermediate results to a shared blackboard for downstream fusion. Results prove that retaining unsuccessful traces during training enlarges the support of the routing policy on error states, enabling recovery transitions that success-only training cannot represent. Across three spatiotemporal benchmarks and eight backbone LLMs, STAR improves over multiple baselines with the clearest gains on queries whose execution deviates from the nominal routing path. Router-specific ablations and recovery analyses further show that typed failure-aware routing, rather than specialist composition alone, is a key factor for these improvements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了STAR（时空智能体路由器）框架，通过显式建模失败状态的类型（如输出错误、依赖缺失、工具查询不匹配），利用状态条件转移策略和路由矩阵实现失败感知的智能体路由，在多个时空推理基准和LLM骨干网络上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM系统在处理复杂时空推理任务时，路由决策隐含在语言生成过程中，当执行失败时恢复策略是临时的、难以解释且难以优化。现有系统将不同类型的失败合并为通用的重试信号，无法针对不同失败类型采取差异化恢复策略。
AI.method: STAR框架将智能体间控制外化为基于当前智能体、任务类型和类型化执行状态的状态条件转移策略。核心是一个智能体路由矩阵，结合专家指定的名义路由和从执行轨迹学习的恢复转移。专家通过工具驱动的提取-计算-存储协议执行，将中间结果写入共享黑板供下游融合。训练时保留失败轨迹以扩大路由策略对错误状态的支持。
AI.result: 在三个时空推理基准和八个LLM骨干网络上，STAR优于多个基线方法，在偏离名义路由路径的查询上提升最为明显。消融实验和恢复分析表明，类型化失败感知路由（而非仅专家组合）是性能提升的关键因素。保留失败轨迹的训练使路由策略能够学习到仅成功训练无法表示的恢复转移。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模失败类型的状态条件路由策略对于组合式时空推理任务至关重要。失败感知路由使系统能针对不同失败类型采取差异化响应，而非简单重试。保留失败轨迹的训练可以扩大路由策略在错误状态上的支持，实现更鲁棒的智能体协作。

title: Closer in the Gap: Towards Portable Performance on RISC-V Vector Processors
comment: To be published in the 32nd European Conference on Parallel and Distributed Processing(Euro-Par 2026)
summary: The RISC-V Vector Extension~(RVV) is a cornerstone for supporting compute throughout in scientific and machine learning workloads. Yet compiler support and performance monitoring on real RVV~1.0 hardware are still evolving. In this work, we design a suite of assembly microbenchmarks to establish performance ceilings and calibrate performance counters on RVV hardware. Leveraging the assembly benchmarks, we find that predication overhead and stride load pose performance challenges that current compiler cost models do not yet fully address. Moreover, we present the first evaluation of GCC~15 and LLVM~21 autovectorization in HPC and ML proxy applications. GCC~15 outperforms LLVM~21 in four out of six applications. LLVM~21 only outperforms GCC~15 in SGEMM and DGEMM, driven by more aggressive instruction reduction confirmed through validated \texttt{perf} counters on the RVV hardware. We further show that the default LMUL selection in compilers performs close to the optimal. To study the RVV support for product-level application, we also evaluate the state-vector quantum simulator, Google's Qsim, with both manual RVV intrinsics and compiler auto-vectorization, revealing immaturity in current RVV compiler for complicated memory access pattern.

AI.tldr: 本文设计了RISC-V向量扩展（RVV）的汇编微基准测试套件，评估了GCC 15和LLVM 21的自动向量化性能，发现GCC在多数应用中表现更优，并揭示了当前编译器在谓词开销、跨步加载和复杂内存访问模式方面的不足。
AI.motivation: RISC-V向量扩展（RVV）是支持科学计算和机器学习工作负载计算吞吐量的基石，但真实RVV 1.0硬件上的编译器支持和性能监控仍在发展中，缺乏系统性的性能分析和编译器评估。
AI.method: 设计一套汇编微基准测试来建立性能上限并校准RVV硬件上的性能计数器；利用汇编基准测试分析谓词开销和跨步加载的性能挑战；首次评估GCC 15和LLVM 21在HPC和ML代理应用中的自动向量化表现；通过验证的perf计数器确认指令减少情况；评估手动RVV intrinsics和编译器自动向量化在量子模拟器Qsim上的表现。
AI.result: 发现谓词开销和跨步加载构成当前编译器代价模型未完全解决的性能挑战；GCC 15在六个应用中的四个超越LLVM 21；LLVM 21仅在SGEMM和DGEMM中优于GCC 15，这得益于经验证的更激进的指令减少；编译器默认的LMUL选择接近最优；对于复杂内存访问模式的应用（如Qsim），当前RVV编译器在自动向量化方面仍显不成熟。
AI.conclusion: 当前RVV编译器在处理谓词开销、跨步加载和复杂内存访问模式方面存在显著不足，GCC 15在多数HPC/ML应用中表现更优，而LLVM 21在矩阵乘法类 kernels 上具有优势，揭示了RVV编译器支持需要进一步成熟的领域。

title: C2L-Net: A Data-Driven Model for State-of-Charge Estimation of Lithium-Ion Batteries During Discharge
summary: Accurate state-of-charge (SOC) estimation is critical for the safe and efficient operation of lithium-ion batteries in battery management systems (BMS). Although data-driven approaches can effectively capture nonlinear battery dynamics, many existing methods rely on long historical input sequences, resulting in high computational cost and introducing padding-induced positional bias at the beginning of drive cycles. To address these limitations, we propose C2L-Net, a novel context-to-latest data-driven framework for realistic online SOC estimation using only a short historical window (20 s). Unlike existing short-receptive-field or long-history models, the proposed framework explicitly separates contextual encoding from latest-measurement updating, enabling both efficient temporal modeling and rapid adaptation to dynamic battery states. The proposed model incorporates a chunk-based feature extraction mechanism that combines Theta Attention Pooling with a Fourier-based Seasonality Basis to capture local temporal patterns while reducing sequence length. A causal context encoder, integrating a gated recurrent unit (GRU) with Causal Cosine Attention, models temporal dependencies without information leakage. Furthermore, a latest-measurement decoder, inspired by recursive filtering, updates the contextual state using the most recent measurement, enhancing responsiveness to dynamic operating conditions. Extensive experiments on a public lithium-ion battery drive-cycle dataset under multiple fixed-temperature conditions demonstrate that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art or competitive accuracy while significantly improving computational efficiency. In particular, C2L-Net achieves up to 60 times faster inference and requires fewer parameters than recent data-driven baselines, while maintaining robust performance across unseen driving profiles.

AI.tldr: 提出C2L-Net框架，通过分离上下文编码与最新测量更新，仅用20秒短历史窗口实现高效、准确的锂离子电池在线SOC估计。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动的电池荷电状态(SOC)估计方法通常依赖长历史输入序列，导致计算成本高且在驾驶周期开始时引入填充引起的位置偏差，限制了其实际在线应用。
AI.method: 提出C2L-Net框架，明确分离上下文编码与最新测量更新。引入分块特征提取机制（结合Theta Attention Pooling和傅里叶季节性基）捕获局部时序模式并减少序列长度；使用因果上下文编码器（整合GRU与因果余弦注意力）建模时序依赖；设计受递归滤波启发的最新测量解码器，利用最新测量更新上下文状态。
AI.result: 在公开锂离子电池驾驶周期数据集上，C2L-Net在多种固定温度条件下实现了最先进或具有竞争力的准确率。与现有数据驱动基线相比，推理速度提升高达60倍，参数量更少，且在未见过的驾驶工况下保持鲁棒性能。
AI.conclusion: C2L-Net通过创新的架构设计，成功解决了现有方法在计算效率和位置偏差方面的局限性，为BMS系统提供了一种高效、准确且实用的在线SOC估计方案。

title: Synergistic Simplex: Cooperative Runtime Assurance for Safety-Critical Autonomous Systems
summary:
Autonomous systems increasingly rely on machine-learning (ML) components for safety-critical tasks such as perception and control in autonomous vehicles (AVs). While ML enables essential capabilities, it inevitably exhibits long-tail faults that make it unsuitable for safety-critical tasks. Runtime assurance (RTA) mitigates this issue by pairing ML components with verifiable safety monitors, e.g., Control Simplex and Perception Simplex architectures. However, the limited performance of safety monitors remains a major bottleneck.
  The Synergistic Simplex (SS) architecture improves system performance by enabling bidirectional integration between ML components and safety monitors while preserving formal safety guarantees. The key innovation here is allowing safety monitors to use ML outputs, which is typically prohibited in RTA systems. We formally derive conditions under which this integration preserves safety and demonstrate the performance benefits. We present the design, analysis, and evaluation of SS for AV obstacle detection.

AI.tldr: 提出协同简单架构(Synergistic Simplex)，通过允许安全监视器使用机器学习组件的输出实现双向集成，在保持形式化安全保证的同时提升自动驾驶系统的性能。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶系统依赖机器学习组件执行安全关键任务，但机器学习固有的长尾故障使其不适合此类应用。现有运行时保障(RTA)方法通过配对机器学习组件与可验证的安全监视器(如控制简单架构和感知简单架构)来缓解此问题，然而安全监视器的有限性能仍是主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出协同简单架构(SS)，实现机器学习组件与安全监视器之间的双向集成，其核心创新在于打破传统RTA系统的限制，允许安全监视器使用机器学习输出。研究形式化推导了这种集成保持安全性的条件，并以自动驾驶障碍检测为例进行了架构设计、分析与评估。
AI.result: 形式化证明了在特定条件下，协同简单架构能够在保持安全性保证的前提下实现性能提升，并通过自动驾驶障碍检测场景验证了该架构的性能优势。
AI.conclusion: 协同简单架构成功突破了传统运行时保障系统的性能瓶颈，通过创新的双向集成机制，在保持形式化安全保证的同时显著提升了系统性能，为机器学习在安全关键系统中的应用提供了新思路。

title: PC3D: Zero-Shot Cooperation Across Variable Rosters via Personalized Context Distillation
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning often assumes a fixed execution team, yet many decentralized systems must operate with varying numbers of active agents during deployment. We study this setting under episodic roster variation: each episode is executed by a set of homogeneous agents, with the team size varying across episodes. Agents act only from local histories, without execution-time communication, privileged coordinators, or online retraining. Therefore, effective cooperation requires each agent to recover relevant context about the active team and adapt its behavior accordingly. To this end, we propose PC3D (Personalized Central Coordination Context Distillation), a method for training decentralized policies to recover and use personalized coordination context from local interaction histories. During training, a set-structured centralized teacher compresses the active team into coordination tokens and personalizes them into agent-specific contexts, which are distilled into decentralized policies. At execution, each agent predicts its own context from local history and adaptively uses it to condition decision-making. Across three cooperative MARL benchmarks, PC3D achieves higher returns than the evaluated baselines with both seen and unseen roster sizes, and ablations attribute these gains to both context distillation and adaptive context use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PC3D方法，通过集中式教师将活跃团队压缩为协调令牌并个性化为特定智能体上下文，再蒸馏至去中心化策略，使智能体能从局部历史中恢复个性化协调上下文，从而在变化团队规模下实现有效协作。
AI.motivation: 现有协作多智能体强化学习研究通常假设执行团队规模固定，但实际去中心化系统在部署时常需应对活跃智能体数量变化的情况。在情节性名单变化设置下，每个情节由同质智能体集合执行，团队规模跨情节变化，且智能体仅能基于局部历史行动，无执行时通信、特权协调器或在线重训练，因此需要每个智能体恢复关于活跃团队的相关上下文并相应调整行为。
AI.method: 提出PC3D（个性化集中协调上下文蒸馏）方法：训练阶段，集合结构的集中式教师将活跃团队压缩为协调令牌，并将其个性化为智能体特定上下文，然后蒸馏到去中心化策略中；执行阶段，每个智能体从局部历史预测自己的上下文，并自适应地用于条件化决策。
AI.result: 在三个协作MARL基准测试中，PC3D在已见和未见团队规模下均取得了比评估基线更高的回报，消融实验将性能提升归因于上下文蒸馏和自适应上下文使用两个方面。
AI.conclusion: PC3D有效解决了变化团队规模下的协作问题，通过上下文蒸馏和自适应使用机制，使去中心化策略能够从局部历史中恢复个性化协调上下文，实现了更好的泛化性能和协作效果。

title: UMEDA: Unified Multi-modal Efficient Data Fusion for Privacy-Preserving Graph Federated Learning via Spectral-Gated Attention and Diffusion-Based Operator Alignment
summary: Device-free localization trains models from heterogeneous wireless and visual sensors (e.g., Wi-Fi, LiDAR) distributed across edge devices. Federated learning offers a privacy-respecting framework, but is brittle when clients differ in sensor modality and resolution, when their data distributions drift, and when privacy noise destroys the structural signal needed for localization. We propose UMEDA, a graph federated learning framework in which clients form nodes of a global graph that share a continuous integral operator, and aggregation is reformulated as spectral signal processing on this operator. Each client encodes its local sensors with a linear-attention layer whose kernel spectrum is low-rank filtered, suppressing modality-specific residuals so clients with different sensors align in a common low-rank subspace. The server then aggregates client updates via a diffusion model over the kernel's spectral coefficients, treating updates as discretizations of a shared operator rather than topology-bound weights -- this absorbs varying graph sizes and missing modalities without node-wise correspondence. To balance privacy and utility, we add an anisotropic differential-privacy mechanism that projects noise preferentially into the null space of the signal subspace, preserving dominant eigendirections while ensuring formal $(ε, δ)$-DP under gradient clipping. On MM-Fi and the RELI11D out-of-distribution benchmark, UMEDA outperforms state-of-the-art federated baselines in accuracy, convergence, and communication efficiency, particularly under high modality heterogeneity and tight privacy budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出UMEDA图联邦学习框架，通过低秩滤波和扩散聚合解决设备无关定位中的传感器模态异构性、数据漂移和隐私噪声问题，在保持差分隐私的同时显著提升定位精度和收敛效率。
AI.motivation: 设备无关定位需要从分布式边缘设备的异构无线和视觉传感器（如Wi-Fi、LiDAR）训练模型，但现有联邦学习方法在面对传感器模态和分辨率差异、数据分布漂移以及隐私噪声破坏定位结构信号时表现脆弱。
AI.method: 1) 将客户端建模为共享连续积分算子的全局图节点，将聚合重构为该算子上的谱信号处理；2) 客户端使用低秩滤波的线性注意力层编码本地传感器，抑制模态特有残差，使不同传感器的客户端在公共低秩子空间对齐；3) 服务器通过核谱系数上的扩散模型聚合客户端更新，将更新视为共享算子的离散化而非拓扑约束权重；4) 引入各向异性差分隐私机制，将噪声优先投影到信号子空间的零空间，在梯度裁剪下保证正式的(ε, δ)-DP。
AI.result: 在MM-Fi和RELI11D分布外基准测试上，UMEDA在精度、收敛性和通信效率方面均优于最先进的联邦基线，尤其在高模态异构性和严格隐私预算条件下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: UMEDA成功解决了异构传感器联邦学习中的模态对齐、拓扑变化和隐私保护三大挑战，为设备无关定位提供了有效的隐私保护解决方案，证明了谱方法在处理联邦学习异构性方面的潜力。

title: ExecuTorch -- A Unified PyTorch Solution to Run AI Models On-Device
summary: Local execution of AI on edge devices is important for low latency and offline operation. However, deploying models on diverse hardware remains fragmented, often requiring model conversion or complete reimplementation outside the PyTorch ecosystem where the model was originally authored. We introduce ExecuTorch, a unified PyTorch-native deployment framework for edge AI. ExecuTorch enables seamless deployment of machine learning models across heterogeneous compute environments. It scales from embedded microcontrollers to complex system-on-chips (SoCs) with dedicated accelerators, powering devices ranging from wearables and smartphones to large compute clusters. ExecuTorch preserves PyTorch semantics while allowing customization, support for optimizations like quantization, and pluggable execution "backends". These features together enable fast experimentation, allowing researchers to validate deployment behavior entirely within PyTorch, bridging the gap between research and production.

AI.tldr: ExecuTorch是一个统一的PyTorch原生边缘AI部署框架，实现了从微控制器到复杂SoC的跨异构硬件无缝部署。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备本地执行AI对低延迟和离线操作至关重要，但现有部署方案碎片化严重，往往需要模型转换或在PyTorch生态系统外完全重新实现，导致研究和生产之间存在显著差距。
AI.method: 提出ExecuTorch框架，保持PyTorch语义的同时支持自定义、量化等优化技术，并通过可插拔的执行"后端"实现跨异构计算环境的部署能力。
AI.result: 成功构建了可从嵌入式微控制器扩展到配备专用加速器的复杂SoC的统一框架，支持从可穿戴设备、智能手机到大型计算集群的广泛设备范围。
AI.conclusion: ExecuTorch通过实现完全在PyTorch内验证部署行为，加速了实验迭代，有效弥合了研究与生产之间的鸿沟，为边缘AI部署提供了统一解决方案。

title: Optimal and Scalable MAPF via Multi-Marginal Optimal Transport and Schrödinger Bridges
comment: Accepted in ICML 2026 as a spotlight paper
summary: We consider anonymous multi-agent path finding (MAPF) where a set of robots is tasked to travel to a set of targets on a finite, connected graph. We show that MAPF can be cast as a special class of multi-marginal optimal transport (MMOT) problems with an underlying Markovian structure, under which the exponentially large MMOT collapses to a linear program (LP) polynomial in size. Focusing on the anonymous setting, we establish conditions under which the corresponding LP is feasible, totally unimodular, and consequently, yields min-cost, integral $(\{0,1\})$ transports that do not overlap in both space and time. To adapt the approach to large-scale problems, we cast the MAPF-MMOT in a probabilistic framework via Schrödinger bridges. Under standard assumptions, we show that the Schrödinger bridge formulation reduces to an entropic regularization of the corresponding MMOT that admits an iterative Sinkhorn-type solution. The Schrödinger bridge, being a probabilistic framework, provides a shadow (fractional) transport that we use as a template to solve a reduced LP and demonstrate that it results in near-optimal, integral transports at a significant reduction in complexity. Extensive experiments highlight the optimality and scalability of the proposed approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文将匿名多智能体路径规划（MAPF）问题转化为具有马尔可夫结构的多边际最优传输（MMOT）问题，通过线性规划（LP）和薛定谔桥方法实现了高效、可扩展的最优路径求解。
AI.motivation: 多智能体路径规划（MAPF）是一个经典的组合优化问题，传统方法在大规模问题上面临计算复杂度高的挑战。作者受到最优传输理论的启发，希望利用MMOT的数学框架来重新表述MAPF问题，从而利用成熟的优化理论和算法来解决路径规划中的复杂性和可扩展性问题。
AI.method:
1. **MMOT转化**：将匿名MAPF建模为具有马尔可夫结构的多边际最优传输问题，证明在此结构下指数级规模的MMOT可以坍缩为多项式规模的线性规划（LP）。
2. **理论分析**：针对匿名设定，证明了相应LP的可行性条件和全幺模性，从而保证能得到无时空冲突的整数（{0,1}）最优传输方案。
3. **薛定谔桥扩展**：为适应大规模问题，引入薛定谔桥概率框架，将其表述为MMOT的熵正则化形式，采用Sinkhorn迭代算法求解。
4. **近似算法**：利用薛定谔桥得到的分数解作为模板，求解简化后的LP，以低复杂度获得近优整数解。
AI.result:
1. 证明了MAPF-MMOT对应的LP具有全幺模性，可直接得到最优整数路径方案。
2. 薛定谔桥方法能够在显著降低计算复杂度的前提下，获得近优的整数传输解。
3. 大量实验验证了所提方法在最优性和可扩展性方面的优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功建立了MAPF与最优传输理论之间的理论桥梁，证明了MMOT框架下MAPF问题的LP可解性，并通过薛定谔桥方法实现了大规模问题的高效近似求解，为多智能体路径规划提供了新的理论视角和实用的算法框架。

title: Private Vertical Federated Inference for Time-Series
summary: Institutions may benefit from collaborative inference on time-series data. In settings where privacy is necessary, multi-party computation (MPC) is a straightforward approach to providing strong guarantees, yet it remains prohibitively expensive and scales poorly with modern transformer architectures. Vertical Federated Learning (VFL) offers efficiency but suffers from privacy leakage at the embedding level, and securing the entire VFL model head via MPC remains prohibitively slow and communication-heavy for larger models. To enable practical, secure inference at scale, we propose "Public/Private Hybrid Head-VFL" (PPHH-VFL). This hybrid architecture splits the model head into an efficient plaintext public head and a secure, lightweight MPC private head. By applying adversarial training to the public embeddings, we mitigate privacy leakage; concurrently, the small private head securely preserves the flow of sensitive information needed for high downstream utility. Empirical evaluations on models ranging up to 86 million parameters demonstrate that PPHH-VFL accelerates inference by up to six orders of magnitude compared to end-to-end MPC. Compared to a standard VFL+MPC baseline, our approach scales significantly better, achieving a speedup of up to 44.4x in WAN and a 91.2x reduction in communication costs (dropping from 1.7 GB to 19 MB per batch), while simultaneously improving downstream classification accuracy by 2.50% and regression RMSE by 40.7%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PPHH-VFL混合架构，通过将模型头拆分为明文公共头和轻量级MPC私有头，结合对抗训练缓解隐私泄露，在保证安全性的同时实现了相比端到端MPC高达6个数量级的加速，相比VFL+MPC基线提升44.4倍速度并降低91.2%通信成本。
AI.motivation: 机构间协作推理需要隐私保护，但现有方案存在明显缺陷：MPC提供强安全保证但成本过高且难以扩展至现代Transformer架构；VFL效率较高但在嵌入层存在隐私泄露风险，而对整个VFL模型头应用MPC保护在大模型上仍然过慢且通信开销过大。因此需要一种既能保证隐私安全又具有实用效率的大规模安全推理方案。
AI.method: 提出"公私混合头VFL"(PPHH-VFL)架构，核心思想是将模型头拆分为两部分：(1)高效的明文公共头，通过对公共嵌入应用对抗训练来缓解隐私泄露；(2)安全的轻量级MPC私有头，用于安全地保留下游任务所需的关键敏感信息流。这种混合设计平衡了效率与安全性需求。
AI.result: 在最大8600万参数模型上的实验表明：相比端到端MPC实现高达6个数量级加速；相比VFL+MPC基线，WAN环境下加速44.4倍，通信成本从每批次1.7GB降至19MB（降低91.2%），同时下游分类准确率提升2.50%，回归RMSE改善40.7%。
AI.conclusion: PPHH-VFL成功实现了大规模实用化安全推理，通过创新的混合架构设计在效率、通信成本和模型性能三个维度同时取得显著提升，为隐私保护下的机构协作推理提供了可行的规模化解决方案。

title: Iterative Critique-and-Routing Controller for Multi-Agent Systems with Heterogeneous LLMs
summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems often rely on a controller to coordinate a pool of heterogeneous models, yet existing controllers are typically limited to one-shot routing: they select a model once and return its output directly. Such routing-only designs provide no mechanism to critique intermediate drafts or support iterative refinement. To address this limitation, we propose a critique-and-routing controller that casts multi-agent coordination as a sequential decision problem. At each turn, the controller evaluates the current draft, decides whether to stop or continue, and, if needed, selects the next agent for further refinement. We formulate this process as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process (MDP) with explicit agent-utilization constraints, design a composite reward for controller decisions across turns, and optimize the controller via policy gradients under a Lagrangian-relaxed objective. Extensive experiments across multiple heterogeneous multi-agent systems and seven reasoning benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and substantially narrows the gap to the strongest agent, while using it for fewer than 25% of total calls.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种“批判-路由”控制器，将多智能体协调建模为有限视界MDP，通过迭代评估、决策和选择智能体实现逐步优化，显著提升了多智能体LLM系统的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM系统的控制器仅支持单次路由（one-shot routing），即选择一个模型并直接返回其输出，缺乏对中间草稿的批判机制，无法支持迭代优化。
AI.method: 将多智能体协调建模为有限视界马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），引入显式的智能体使用约束；设计复合奖励函数评估控制器跨轮决策，并在拉格朗日松弛目标下通过策略梯度优化控制器；在每一轮评估当前草稿、决定是否停止或继续，并在需要时选择下一个智能体进行进一步优化。
AI.result: 在多个异构多智能体系统和七个推理基准上的广泛实验表明，本方法始终优于现有最先进基线，大幅缩小与最强智能体的差距，且对最强智能体的调用比例不足总调用次数的25%。
AI.conclusion: “批判-路由”控制器有效解决了传统路由机制无法迭代优化的问题，在保持计算效率的同时显著提升了多智能体LLM系统的整体性能。

title: ReplaySCM: A Benchmark for Executable Causal Mechanism Induction from Interventions
summary: Most causal benchmarks for language models score local answers or graph structure. We introduce ReplaySCM, a 1,300 item benchmark for executable causal mechanism induction from finite interventional evidence. Each item contains binary worlds generated by a latent fully observed acyclic Boolean structural causal model (SCM). A system must output a mechanism map in a restricted Boolean DSL; the submission is parsed, checked for legality and acyclicity, and replayed on training and held-out intervention worlds. Scoring uses replay behavior rather than formula strings, so syntactically different mechanisms receive credit when they behave correctly. ReplaySCM varies the structural information disclosed to the model through Ordered, Block-order, Hidden-order, and Hidden-roots settings, and includes Alternative-SCM tasks that supply a valid reference SCM and ask for a semantically distinct alternative that fits the training worlds, together with a separating intervention and witness. Frontier LLMs infer parts of the functional-parent structure, but held-out replay drops sharply when order or root structure is hidden. We also evaluate a matched support-audit ladder: Original, Extra Worlds, and Counterexample Audit (CEx), that raises mean local predecessor-pattern coverage from 0.8949 to 0.9815 to 1.0; under the audited searches, no discovered semantic alternative remains consistent with the training worlds. The Ordered/Hidden-order gap persists under this stronger evidence. ReplaySCM complements answer-level causal reasoning and graph-discovery benchmarks by evaluating executable replay generalization from finite interventional evidence, without claiming unique identification of the latent SCM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ReplaySCM基准，包含1,300个任务，用于评估语言模型从有限干预证据中归纳可执行因果机制的能力。前沿LLMs在因果结构信息被隐藏时表现显著下降。
AI.motivation: 现有因果推理基准主要评估局部答案或图结构，缺乏对语言模型从有限干预证据中归纳可执行因果机制能力的评估。需要一个新的基准来测试模型能否生成行为正确的因果机制，而非仅关注语法形式。
AI.method: 构建包含1,300个任务的ReplaySCM基准，每个任务由潜在的完全观测无环布尔结构因果模型（SCM）生成二元世界。系统需在受限布尔DSL中输出机制映射，通过在训练和测试干预世界上重放行为进行评分，而非比较公式字符串。基准设置了四种结构信息披露方式（有序、块序、隐藏序、隐藏根），并引入替代SCM任务和支持审计阶梯（原始、额外世界、反例审计）。
AI.result: 前沿LLMs能够推断部分功能-父节点结构，但当顺序或根结构被隐藏时，测试集重放准确率急剧下降。审计阶梯将局部前驱模式覆盖率从0.8949提升至1.0；在审计搜索下，未发现与训练世界一致的语义替代方案。有序/隐藏序差距在更强证据下仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: ReplaySCM通过评估从有限干预证据中的可执行重放泛化能力，补充了答案级因果推理和图发现基准，无需声称唯一识别潜在SCM。研究揭示了当前LLMs在因果结构信息不完整时的局限性。

title: FlashEvolve: Accelerating Agent Self-Evolution with Asynchronous Stage Orchestration
summary: LLM-based evolution has emerged as a promising way to improve agents by refining non-parametric artifacts, but its wall-clock cost remains a major bottleneck. We identify that this cost comes from synchronized stage execution and imbalance inside each LLM-heavy stage. We present FlashEvolve, an efficient framework that replaces synchronized execution with asynchronous workers and queues, allowing different stages and steps to overlap. To handle data staleness introduced by asynchrony, FlashEvolve tracks artifact versions and applies different policies to update, discard, or patch stale artifacts. Unlike weight-space staleness in asynchronous RL, language-space staleness is inspectable and repairable: a stale artifact is not just delayed work, but readable evidence that the LLM can reflect on, revise, and turn into useful evolution signal. FlashEvolve further improves throughput and token efficiency with speculative stage completion and adaptive workflow control. On GEPA workloads, FlashEvolve improves proposal throughput by $3.5\times$ on local vLLM and $4.9\times$ on API serving over synchronous GEPA. The same design also applies to ACE and Meta-Harness.

AI.tldr: FlashEvolve通过异步执行和版本管理机制，将LLM演化流程的提案吞吐量提升3.5-4.9倍。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的演化方法在改进智能体方面表现出色，但其主要瓶颈在于同步阶段执行和各阶段内部负载不均衡导致的wall-clock成本过高。
AI.method: 提出FlashEvolve框架：1) 使用异步工作器和队列替代同步执行，实现阶段与步骤的重叠；2) 引入工件版本追踪机制，对陈旧工件采取更新、丢弃或修补策略；3) 利用语言空间陈旧性的可检查和可修复特性，让LLM反思和修订陈旧工件；4) 采用推测性阶段完成和自适应工作流控制提升吞吐量和token效率。
AI.result: 在GEPA工作负载上，FlashEvolve在本地vLLM上将提案吞吐量提升3.5倍，在API服务上提升4.9倍。该设计同样适用于ACE和Meta-Harness。
AI.conclusion: FlashEvolve成功解决了LLM演化过程中的同步开销问题，证明了异步执行与陈旧性管理在语言空间的有效性，为高效LLM演化提供了通用框架。

title: Reconciling Consistency-Based Diagnosis with Actual-Causality-Based Explanations
summary: We establish, from the point of view of Explainable AI (XAI), connections between Consistency-Based Diagnosis (CBD), on one side, and Actual Causality and Causal Responsibility, on the other. CBD has received little attention from the XAI community. Connections between these two areas could have a fruitful impact on XAI and Explainable Data Management.

AI.tldr: 本文从可解释人工智能（XAI）的角度，建立了基于一致性的诊断（CBD）与实际因果关系及因果责任之间的联系，为XAI和可解释数据管理提供了新的研究方向。
AI.motivation: 基于一致性的诊断（CBD）在可解释人工智能（XAI）社区中受到的关注较少。作者认为建立CBD与实际因果关系及因果责任之间的联系，可能对XAI和可解释数据管理领域产生积极且富有成效的影响。
AI.method: 从可解释人工智能（XAI）的视角出发，对基于一致性的诊断（CBD）与实际因果关系、因果责任这两个领域进行理论层面的分析与连接建立。
AI.result: 成功建立了基于一致性的诊断（CBD）与实际因果关系及因果责任之间的理论联系。
AI.conclusion: CBD与因果理论之间的这种联系有望对可解释人工智能（XAI）和可解释数据管理领域产生重要且有价值的贡献。

title: FairHealth: An Open-Source Python Library for Trustworthy Healthcare AI in Low-Resource Settings
summary: We present FairHealth, an open-source Python library that provides a unified, modular framework for trustworthy machine learning in healthcare applications, with particular focus on low-resource and low-income country (LMIC) settings such as Bangladesh. FairHealth addresses four critical gaps in existing healthcare AI toolkits: (1) the absence of integrated fairness auditing for biosignals and clinical tabular data; (2) the lack of privacy-preserving federated learning tools compatible with standard ML workflows; (3) missing explainability tools tailored for low-bandwidth clinical decision support; and (4) no existing toolkit covering Global South healthcare datasets. Built from five peer-reviewed research contributions, FairHealth provides six modules covering federated learning with homomorphic encryption (fairhealth.federated), intersectional fairness metrics (fairhealth.fairness), hybrid fuzzy-SHAP explainability (fairhealth.explain), multilingual dengue triage (fairhealth.lowresource), equitable disaster aid allocation (fairhealth.equity), and public dataset loaders (fairhealth.datasets). All datasets used are publicly available without institutional data use agreements. FairHealth is installable via pip install fairhealth(PyPI: pypi.org/project/fairhealth/) and available at https://github.com/Farjana-Yesmin/fairhealth.

AI.tldr: FairHealth是一个开源Python库，为中低收入国家（如孟加拉国）的医疗AI应用提供统一、模块化的可信机器学习框架，填补了现有工具包在公平性审计、隐私保护联邦学习、低带宽可解释性工具以及全球南方医疗数据集覆盖方面的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗AI工具包存在四个关键缺口：（1）缺乏针对生物信号和临床表格数据的集成公平性审计；（2）缺少与标准ML工作流兼容的隐私保护联邦学习工具；（3）缺乏针对低带宽临床决策支持定制的可解释性工具；（4）没有覆盖全球南方医疗数据集的工具包。这些缺口限制了医疗AI在中低收入国家的可信应用。
AI.method: 基于五篇同行评审研究成果，构建包含六个模块的框架：联邦学习与同态加密模块、交叉公平性指标模块、混合模糊-SHAP可解释性模块、多语言登革热分诊模块、公平灾害援助分配模块和公共数据集加载器模块。所有数据集均为公开可用，无需机构数据使用协议。
AI.result: 成功开发了FairHealth开源Python库，可通过pip安装，在PyPI和GitHub上公开发布。该框架集成了联邦学习、公平性审计、可解释性分析等功能，并特别针对低资源环境进行了优化，提供了适用于全球南方医疗场景的工具集。
AI.conclusion: FairHealth为医疗AI在资源受限环境中的可信部署提供了首个综合性开源解决方案，特别是填补了中低收入国家医疗AI工具的空白，为促进医疗AI的公平、透明和隐私保护应用做出了重要贡献。

title: PAAC: Privacy-Aware Agentic Device-Cloud Collaboration
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents face a structural tension: cloud agents provide strong reasoning but expose user data, while on-device agents preserve privacy at the cost of overall capability. Existing device-cloud designs treat this boundary as a compute split rather than a trust boundary suited to agentic workloads, and existing sanitizers force a choice between policy flexibility and the structural fidelity tool calls require. In this work, we develop PAAC, a privacy-aware agentic framework that aligns planner--executor decomposition with the device-cloud boundary so that role specialization itself becomes the privacy mechanism. The cloud agent reasons over typed placeholder tokens that preserve each sensitive value's reasoning role while discarding its content, while the on-device agent identifies sensitive spans and distills each step's execution outcome into compact key findings. Sanitization confines the on-device LLM to proposing which spans to mask, while a deterministic registry performs all substitution and reversal, keeping actions directly executable on device. On three agentic benchmarks under strict privacy settings, PAAC dominates the Pareto frontier of privacy and accuracy, improving average accuracy by 15-36\% and reducing average leakage by 2-6$\times$ over state-of-the-art device-cloud baselines, with the largest margins on privacy targets outside fixed entity taxonomies. We find consistent improvements on 17 additional benchmarks spanning 10 domains, including math, science, and finance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAAC框架，通过将规划器-执行器分解与设备-云边界对齐，实现隐私保护与模型能力的平衡，在准确率上提升15-36%，隐私泄露减少2-6倍。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体面临结构性矛盾：云端智能体推理能力强但暴露用户数据，设备端智能体保护隐私但能力受限。现有设备-云设计将边界视为计算划分而非信任边界，现有脱敏方法无法同时满足策略灵活性与工具调用所需的结构保真度。
AI.method: 提出PAAC隐私感知智能体框架：1）将规划器-执行器分解与设备-云边界对齐，使角色专业化成为隐私机制；2）云端智能体对类型化占位符token进行推理，保留敏感值的推理角色但丢弃其内容；3）设备端智能体识别敏感片段并将执行结果提炼为紧凑关键发现；4）脱敏过程限制设备端LLM仅提议遮蔽片段，确定性注册表执行所有替换和逆转，确保动作可在设备上直接执行。
AI.result: 在三个智能体基准测试的严格隐私设置下，PAAC在隐私-准确率帕累托前沿上占主导地位：平均准确率提升15-36%，相比最先进的设备-云基线平均泄露减少2-6倍，在固定实体分类之外的隐私目标上优势最大。在涵盖10个领域（包括数学、科学、金融）的17个额外基准测试上获得一致性改进。
AI.conclusion: PAAC成功实现了隐私保护与智能体能力的有效平衡，通过结构化的设备-云协作机制，在保持工具调用结构保真度的同时实现灵活的隐私保护，为LLM智能体的隐私保护提供了新的解决方案。

title: SkillMaster: Toward Autonomous Skill Mastery in LLM Agents
summary: Skills provide an effective mechanism for improving LLM agents on complex tasks, yet in existing agent frameworks, their creation, refinement, and selection are typically governed by external teachers, hand-designed rules, or auxiliary modules. As a result, skills remain external resources to be invoked, rather than capabilities that agents can develop, adapt, and internalize through experience. To endow LLM agents with autonomous skill mastery, we propose SkillMaster, a training framework that teaches agents to create new skills, refine existing skills, and select accumulated skills during task solving. This capability is achieved through three key designs. First, we train agents through trajectory-informed skill review, teaching agents to propose, update, or retain skills based on evidence from completed episodes. Second, each candidate skill edit is designed to be evaluated by its counterfactual utility on related probe tasks, providing a direct learning signal for training skill-editing decisions. Third, we introduce DualAdv-GRPO, which separately estimates advantages for task-solving actions and skill-editing decisions, stabilizing joint training across task solving and skill management. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that SkillMaster improves the overall success rate over state-of-the-art baselines by 8.8% and 9.3%, respectively, achieving the best performance among all compared methods. Further analysis reveals a marked shift in agent capability: agents trained with SkillMaster can identify skill failures, refine procedural knowledge from trajectory evidence, and transfer improvements to future tasks with limited skill-bank edits. Overall, SkillMaster moves LLM agents beyond mere skill use toward self-improving agents capable of developing, adapting, and applying their own skill repertoires.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillMaster框架，使LLM智能体能够自主创建、优化和选择技能，在ALFWorld和WebShop上分别比SOTA基线提升8.8%和9.3%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体框架中，技能的创建、优化和选择通常由外部教师、手工规则或辅助模块控制，技能只是被调用的外部资源，而非智能体通过经验自主发展、适应和内化的能力。研究旨在赋予LLM智能体自主掌握技能的能力。
AI.method: 提出SkillMaster训练框架，包含三个关键设计：1）轨迹引导的技能回顾，让智能体基于已完成轨迹的证据来提议、更新或保留技能；2）通过反事实效用评估候选技能编辑在相关探针任务上的表现，为技能编辑决策提供直接学习信号；3）引入DualAdv-GRPO，分别估计任务解决动作和技能编辑决策的优势值，稳定任务解决和技能管理的联合训练。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop基准测试中，SkillMaster分别比最先进基线提升8.8%和9.3%的成功率，在所有对比方法中取得最佳性能。分析表明，训练后的智能体能够识别技能失败、从轨迹证据中优化过程知识，并通过有限的技能库编辑将改进迁移到未来任务中。
AI.conclusion: SkillMaster推动LLM智能体超越单纯的技能使用，向能够自主开发、适应和应用自身技能库的自我改进型智能体方向发展，实现了从外部资源调用向内化能力发展的转变。

title: Weakly Supervised Concept Learning for Object-centric Visual Reasoning
summary: Neurosymbolic systems promise to combine deep neural network's (DNN) processing of raw sensor inputs with few-shot performance of symbolic artificial intelligence. Two-stage approaches explicitly decouple DNN based perception from subsequent rule based reasoning. This avoids optimization and interpretability issues of end to end differentiable approaches, but requires costly labels for the perception output. This paper introduces an efficient weak supervision scheme for the perception stage to ground its output symbols for logical induction in object-centric reasoning tasks. It combines a slot-based architecture for object-centricity with a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) for self-supervision, competing with concept guidance on latent dimensions for human interpretable grounding. The resulting predictions are translated into symbolic background knowledge for reasoning frameworks, such as Inductive Logic Programming (ILP), Decision Trees, and Bayesian Networks. Our extensive empirical evaluation on synthetic and real world datasets shows that our approach can discover complex, abstract rules for object centric reasoning whilst reducing supervision to as little as 1% of labels, and being robust even under substantial domain shift. Notably, at 1% supervision it even outperforms state of the art foundation model baselines in domain generalization

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的弱监督框架，用于神经符号系统中感知阶段的符号接地，仅需1%的标签即可发现复杂的对象中心推理规则，并在领域泛化中超越基础模型基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的两阶段神经符号方法虽然避免了端到端可微方法的优化和可解释性问题，但需要为感知输出提供昂贵的标签。研究旨在解决感知阶段的标签成本问题，实现高效的符号接地以支持逻辑归纳。
AI.method: 结合基于槽位的架构实现对象中心性，使用变分自编码器(VAE)进行自监督，通过概念引导在潜在维度上竞争以获得人类可解释的接地。将预测结果转化为符号背景知识，用于归纳逻辑编程(ILP)、决策树和贝叶斯网络等推理框架。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上的广泛评估表明，该方法在仅用1%标签的情况下能发现复杂的抽象规则，在显著领域偏移下保持鲁棒性，且在1%监督下领域泛化性能超越了最先进的基础模型基线。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的弱监督方案成功降低了神经符号系统中感知阶段的标注成本，同时保持了强大的推理能力和领域泛化性能，为对象中心推理任务提供了一种高效实用的解决方案。

title: FedGMI: Generative Model-Driven Federated Learning for Probabilistic Mixture Inference
summary: Federated Learning (FL) facilitates collaborative model training across decentralized clients while preserving data privacy by avoiding raw data exchange. Despite its potential, FL performance is often compromised by data heterogeneity across clients. To address this, Clustered Federated Learning (CFL) groups clients with similar data distributions to improve model performance, but constrained by intra-cluster heterogeneity. Conversely, Personalized Federated Learning (PFL) tailors models to individual clients, but usually neglects the underlying structural similarities among clients. In this work, we investigate a probabilistic mixture (PM) scenario, where each client's local data distribution is modeled as a convex combination of several shared inherent distributions. To effectively model this structure, we propose FedGMI, a framework that utilizes Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) as generative density estimators to represent these inherent distributions and infer the mixture components of clients' local data distributions. This approach enables structured personalization without sacrificing the benefits of collaborative learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedGMI effectively characterizes and discriminate the inherent distributions, as well as accurately estimates mixture proportions. Furthermore, FedGMI maintains robust performance even under communication cost constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedGMI框架，利用变分自编码器建模联邦学习中的概率混合场景，在解决数据异构性问题的同时实现了结构化个性化。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习面临数据异构性挑战，现有的聚类联邦学习(CFL)受限于集群内部异构性，而个性化联邦学习(PFL)往往忽视客户端之间的结构相似性。本文旨在解决概率混合(PM)场景下的建模问题，即每个客户端的局部数据分布是若干共享内在分布的凸组合。
AI.method: 提出FedGMI框架，采用变分自编码器(VAEs)作为生成密度估计器来表示内在分布，并推断客户端局部数据分布的混合成分。该方法通过建模数据的潜在结构，实现了结构化个性化与协作学习优势的平衡。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FedGMI能够有效刻画和区分内在分布，准确估计混合比例，并在通信成本受限的情况下保持鲁棒性能。
AI.conclusion: FedGMI成功解决了联邦学习中的数据异构性问题，通过概率混合建模实现了结构化个性化，为联邦学习在复杂异构数据场景下的应用提供了新的解决方案。

title: MBP-KT: Learning Global Collaborative Information from Meta-Behavioral Pattern for Enhanced Knowledge Tracing
summary: The emerging collaborative information-based knowledge tracing (KT) has been a promising way to enhance modeling of learners' knowledge states. The core idea is to extract the collaborative information from interaction sequences of other learners to assist the prediction on the target one. Despite effectiveness, existing methods are built on the raw interaction sequences with tailored modules, which inevitably limits their capacity in deeply capturing learning behavioral patterns and generalization. To this end, we propose a general meta-behavioral pattern-aware framework (MBP-KT) for KT. Specifically, MBP-KT introduces a novel meta-behavioral sequence construction to transform the raw interaction sequences into the combinations of different meta-behavioral patterns. In this way, the learning behavioral patterns of learners can be effectively preserved. Then, MBP-KT develops a parameter-free module to extract the global collaborative representations from the constructed meta-behavioral sequences. Moreover, MBP-KT provides general injection strategies to introduce the extracted global collaborative information into various downstream KT models, ensuring the universality of the collaborative information. Extensive results on real-world datasets demonstrate that MBP-KT can consistently boosts the performance of a wide range of KT models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个通用的元行为模式感知知识追踪框架（MBP-KT），通过将原始交互序列转换为元行为模式组合，并提取全局协作信息注入下游模型，从而显著提升各类知识追踪模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的协作信息知识追踪方法基于原始交互序列构建定制模块，限制了对学习者行为模式的深度捕获能力和模型的泛化性能，无法有效保留学习行为模式。
AI.method: 提出MBP-KT框架：1)设计元行为序列构建方法，将原始交互序列转换为不同元行为模式的组合以保留学习行为模式；2)开发无参数模块从构建的元行为序列中提取全局协作表示；3)提供通用注入策略将提取的全局协作信息引入多种下游知识追踪模型，确保协作信息的普适性。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的大量实验表明，MBP-KT能够持续提升广泛的知识追踪模型的性能表现，验证了框架的有效性和通用性。
AI.conclusion: MBP-KT框架通过元行为模式建模和全局协作信息提取，成功解决了现有方法在行为模式捕获和泛化能力方面的不足，为知识追踪领域提供了一个性能优越且具有广泛适用性的解决方案。

title: Beyond Penalization: Diffusion-based Out-of-Distribution Detection and Selective Regularization in Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) faces a critical challenge of overestimating the value of out-of-distribution (OOD) actions. Existing methods mitigate this issue by penalizing unseen samples, yet they fail to accurately identify OOD actions and may suppress beneficial exploration beyond the behavioral support. Although several methods have been proposed to differentiate OOD samples with distinct properties, they typically rely on restrictive assumptions about the data distribution and remain limited in discrimination ability. To address this problem, we propose DOSER (Diffusion-based OOD Detection and Selective Regularization), a novel framework that goes beyond uniform penalization. DOSER trains two diffusion models to capture the behavior policy and state distribution, using single-step denoising reconstruction error as a reliable OOD indicator. During policy optimization, it further distinguishes between beneficial and detrimental OOD actions by evaluating predicted transitions, selectively suppressing risky actions while encouraging exploration of high-potential ones. Theoretically, we prove that DOSER is a $γ$-contraction and therefore admits a unique fixed point with bounded value estimates. We further provide an asymptotic performance guarantee relative to the optimal policy under model approximation and OOD detection errors. Across extensive offline RL benchmarks, DOSER consistently attains superior performance to prior methods, especially on suboptimal datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DOSER框架，通过扩散模型检测分布外动作并选择性正则化，解决了离线强化学习中过度估计OOD动作价值的问题，在次优数据集上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习面临分布外动作价值过度估计的关键挑战。现有方法通过对未见样本施加惩罚来缓解该问题，但无法准确识别OOD动作，且可能抑制行为支持集之外的有益探索。尽管已有方法尝试区分具有不同属性的OOD样本，但它们通常依赖于对数据分布的严格假设，且判别能力有限。
AI.method: 提出DOSER框架，训练两个扩散模型分别捕获行为策略和状态分布，利用单步去噪重建误差作为可靠的OOD指示器。在策略优化过程中，通过评估预测转移来区分有益和有害的OOD动作，选择性抑制高风险动作，同时鼓励对高潜力动作的探索。
AI.result: 在广泛的离线强化学习基准测试中，DOSER始终优于先前方法，特别是在次优数据集上表现突出。理论上证明了DOSER是γ-收缩映射，具有有界值估计的唯一不动点，并在模型近似和OOD检测误差下提供了相对于最优策略的渐近性能保证。
AI.conclusion: DOSER成功实现了超越统一惩罚的细粒度OOD处理，通过区分有益和有害的OOD动作，有效平衡了风险抑制与探索鼓励，为离线强化学习提供了一种更精确、更高效的价值估计方法。

title: Metal-Sci: A Scientific Compute Benchmark for Evolutionary LLM Kernel Search on Apple Silicon
summary: We present Metal-Sci, a 10-task benchmark of scientific Apple Silicon Metal compute kernels spanning six optimization regimes (stencils, all-pairs in $n$-body problems, multi-field Boltzmann, neighbor-list molecular dynamics, multi-kernel PDE, FFT). Each task ships a CPU reference, a roofline-anchored fitness function, and a held-out generalization size. We pair the benchmark with a lightweight harness for automatic kernel search that runtime-compiles each candidate, scores it against the roofline across multiple sizes, and feeds structured compile and per-size correctness diagnostics back to a frozen LLM driving a $(1{+}1)$ evolutionary loop. We report matched single-model sweeps of Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT 5.5 on M1 Pro: in-distribution self-speedups span $1.00\times$ to $10.7\times$. Beyond raw speedup, our central methodological claim is structural: the held-out gate scoring function $Φ_\mathcal{T}$ (evaluated once at end-of-run on a configuration the agent never sees during search) functions as a cheap mechanical oversight primitive on this automatic search loop, catching e.g. an Opus template <uint D> HMC win that returns wrong samples at unseen dimensions, and a GPT FFT3D best that wins in-distribution at $2.95\times$ speedup but collapses to $0.23\times$ on a $256^3$ held-out cube, a silent regression that the in-distribution score alone cannot see. Code at https://github.com/vicgalle/metal-sci-kernels

AI.tldr: 提出了Metal-Sci基准测试（包含10个科学计算Metal内核任务），并提出了一种使用留出泛化尺寸作为廉价监督机制的方法，成功检测到LLM生成内核中的隐性回归问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的自动内核搜索方法缺乏有效的监督机制，仅在训练分布尺寸上优化可能导致生成的内核在未见尺寸上出现性能崩溃或正确性错误，需要一种廉价且有效的机械监督原语。
AI.method: 构建Metal-Sci基准（涵盖6类优化领域），配置CPU参考实现、roofline锚定适应度函数和留出泛化尺寸；设计轻量级测试工具，通过冻结LLM驱动的(1+1)进化循环生成候选内核，运行时编译并评分；关键创新在于引入留出门控评分函数Φ_T作为监督原语，仅在运行结束时在未见配置上评估一次。
AI.result: 在M1 Pro上对Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro和GPT 5.5进行单模型扫描，分布内自加速倍数在1.00×至10.7×之间；成功检测到隐性错误案例：Opus生成的HMC内核在未见维度上返回错误样本，GPT生成的FFT3D内核在分布内获得2.95×加速但在256³留出立方体上崩溃至0.23×。
AI.conclusion: 留出门控评分函数Φ_T能够有效捕获分布内评分无法检测的隐性回归问题，是一种廉价有效的自动搜索循环监督原语。

title: RewardHarness: Self-Evolving Agentic Post-Training
summary: Evaluating instruction-guided image edits requires rewards that reflect subtle human preferences, yet current reward models typically depend on large-scale preference annotation and additional model training. This creates a data-efficiency gap: humans can often infer the target evaluation criteria from only a few examples, while models are usually trained on hundreds of thousands of comparisons. We present RewardHarness, a self-evolving agentic reward framework that reframes reward modeling as context evolution rather than weight optimization. Instead of learning from large-scale annotations, RewardHarness aligns with human preferences by iteratively evolving a library of tools and skills from as few as 100 preference demonstrations. Given a source image, candidate edited images, and an editing instruction, an Orchestrator selects the most relevant subset of tools and skills from the maintained library, and a frozen Sub-Agent uses them to construct a reasoning chain that produces a preference judgment. By comparing predicted judgments with ground-truth preferences and analyzing successes and failures in the reasoning process, the Orchestrator automatically refines its library of tools and skills without additional human annotation. Using only 0.05% of the EditReward preference data, RewardHarness achieves 47.4% average accuracy on image-editing evaluation benchmarks, surpassing GPT-5 by 5.3 points. When used as a reward signal for GRPO fine-tuning, RL-tuned models achieve 3.52 on ImgEdit-Bench. Project page: https://rewardharness.com.

AI.tldr: 提出了RewardHarness，一种自演进的智能体奖励框架，仅需100个偏好演示（0.05%数据）即可在图像编辑评估基准上达到47.4%准确率，超越GPT-5 5.3个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有奖励模型通常依赖大规模偏好标注和额外模型训练，而人类仅需少量示例即可推断评估标准。这种数据效率差距促使作者重新思考奖励建模范式，将其从权重优化转变为上下文演进。
AI.method: 提出RewardHarness框架，包含两个核心组件：（1）Orchestrator从工具与技能库中选择相关子集；（2）冻结的Sub-Agent使用选定工具构建推理链并输出偏好判断。通过比较预测判断与真实偏好并分析推理过程的成败，Orchestrator自动优化工具与技能库，无需额外人工标注。
AI.result: 仅使用EditReward偏好数据的0.05%，在图像编辑评估基准上达到47.4%平均准确率，超越GPT-5 5.3个百分点。作为GRPO微调的奖励信号时，RL调优模型在ImgEdit-Bench上取得3.52分。
AI.conclusion: RewardHarness成功将奖励建模重构为上下文演进而非权重优化问题，显著提升数据效率，证明了智能体框架在少量样本下对齐人类偏好的有效性。

title: Learngene Search Across Multiple Datasets for Building Variable-Sized Models
summary: Deep learning methods are widely used under diverse resource constraints, resulting in models of varying sizes, such as the Vision Transformer (ViT) series. Deploying these models typically requires costly pretraining and finetuning. The Learngene paradigm addresses this issue by extracting transferable components, called learngenes, from a pretrained ancestry model (Ans-Net) to initialize variable-sized descendant models (Des-Nets).Existing learngene extraction methods rely on a single dataset, limiting downstream performance. To address this limitation, we propose Learngene Search Across Multiple Datasets for Building Variable-Sized Models (LSAMD). LSAMD expands the Ans-Net into a searchable super Ans-Net with dataset-specific blocks and dataset adapters (DADs). During training, LSAMD searches for an optimal architecture path for each dataset. The base blocks most frequently selected across datasets are extracted as learngenes for initializing Des-Nets.Experiments on multiple datasets show that LSAMD achieves performance comparable to pretrain-finetune methods while significantly reducing storage and training costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LSAMD方法，通过跨多数据集搜索从预训练模型中提取可迁移组件（learngenes），用于初始化不同规模的模型，在显著降低存储和训练成本的同时达到与预训练-微调方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有learngene提取方法仅依赖单一数据集，限制了下游任务的性能；而部署不同规模的模型通常需要昂贵的预训练和微调过程。
AI.method: 提出LSAMD方法：将祖先网络(Ans-Net)扩展为包含数据集特定块和数据集适配器(DADs)的可搜索超级网络；训练时为每个数据集搜索最优架构路径；提取各数据集最频繁选择的基础块作为learngenes，用于初始化不同规模的后代网络(Des-Nets)。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，LSAMD在显著减少存储和训练成本的同时，实现了与预训练-微调方法相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: LSAMD成功实现了跨多数据集的learngene提取，为构建可变规模模型提供了一种高效的解决方案，有效平衡了模型性能与部署成本。

title: AgentPSO: Evolving Agent Reasoning Skill via Multi-agent Particle Swarm Optimization
summary: Multi-agent reasoning has shown promise for improving the problem-solving ability of large language models by allowing multiple agents to explore diverse reasoning paths. However, most existing multi-agent methods rely on inference-time debate or aggregation, which can be vulnerable to incorrect peer influence and biased consensus. Moreover, the agents themselves remain static, as their underlying reasoning skills do not evolve across tasks. In this paper, we introduce AgentPSO, a particle-swarm-inspired framework for evolving multi-agent reasoning skills. AgentPSO treats each agent as a particle-like reasoner whose state is a natural-language skill and whose velocity is a semantic update direction, iteratively moving agents toward stronger skill states to improve both individual and collective reasoning performance. Across training iterations, each agent updates its skill by combining its previous velocity, personal-best skill, global-best skill, and a self-reflective direction derived from peer reasoning trajectories. This enables agents to learn reusable reasoning behaviors from both their own experiences and the strongest skills discovered by the population, without updating the parameters of the backbone language model. Experiments on mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks show that AgentPSO improves over static single-agent skills and test-time-only multi-agent reasoning baselines. The evolved skills further transfer across benchmarks and to another backbone model, suggesting that AgentPSO captures reusable reasoning procedures rather than merely optimizing benchmark-specific prompts. Code is open-sourced at https://github.com/HYUNMIN-HWANG/AgentPSO/.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentPSO框架，将多智能体推理过程建模为粒子群优化过程，通过迭代更新智能体的自然语言技能状态，使智能体能够学习和进化可复用的推理技能，从而提升大语言模型的问题解决能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体推理方法主要依赖推理时的辩论或聚合，容易受到错误同伴影响和偏见共识的影响；此外，智能体本身保持静态，其底层推理技能无法跨任务进化。因此需要一种能让智能体推理技能持续演化的方法。
AI.method: 将每个智能体视为粒子群优化中的一个粒子，其状态为自然语言技能，速度为语义更新方向。每次迭代中，智能体结合自身历史速度、个人最优技能、全局最优技能以及从同伴推理轨迹中获得的自我反思方向来更新技能，使智能体无需更新骨干语言模型参数即可学习可复用的推理行为。
AI.result: 在数学和通用推理基准测试上，AgentPSO优于静态单智能体技能和仅测试时的多智能体推理基线方法。进化后的技能能够跨基准测试迁移，并适用于其他骨干模型，证明该方法能够捕获可复用的推理过程而非仅仅优化特定基准的提示。
AI.conclusion: AgentPSO成功将群体智能优化思想引入多智能体推理领域，实现了智能体推理技能的动态进化与跨任务迁移，为大语言模型推理能力的提升提供了新范式。

title: LLMs with in-context learning for Algorithmic Theoretical Physics
summary: There is an increasing number of algorithmic computations in theoretical physics. These, while conceptually simple, can nevertheless be time-consuming and contain subtleties that should not be overlooked.
