Given the recent improvement of Large Language Models (LLM), it is natural to investigate whether LLMs equipped with a computer algebra system (CAS) runtime and sufficiently informative context can reliably carry out these algorithmic tasks. In this work, we interface Claude with Maple, and apply this framework to cosmological perturbations in modified theories of gravity. We demonstrate the current capabilities of this approach, the typical failures, and how the same can be improved. We find that a frontier LLM supplied with worked examples is able to solve most test problems.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了将大型语言模型（Claude）与计算机代数系统（Maple）结合，用于理论物理中的算法计算任务，并在修正引力理论的宇宙学扰动问题中验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 理论物理中存在大量概念简单但耗时且包含细微之处的算法计算任务。鉴于大型语言模型（LLM）的近期进展，研究者希望探索LLM在配备计算机代数系统运行环境和充分上下文信息后，能否可靠地执行这些算法任务。
AI.method: 将大型语言模型Claude与计算机代数系统Maple进行接口对接，构建集成框架，并将其应用于修正引力理论中的宇宙学扰动计算问题。通过提供已解决的示例作为上下文，测试该框架的能力。
AI.result: 配备了已解决示例的前沿大型语言模型能够解决大多数测试问题。研究展示了该方法当前的能力水平、典型失败模式，以及改进方向。
AI.conclusion: LLM与CAS的集成框架在理论物理算法计算中具有可行性和潜力，通过提供充足的上下文示例可以显著提升问题解决的成功率，但仍存在典型失败模式需要进一步改进。

title: When Can Human-AI Teams Outperform Individuals? Tight Bounds with Impossibility Guarantees
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at CogSci 2026
summary: Human-AI teams fail to outperform their best member in 70% of studies, yet no theory specifies when complementarity is achievable. We derive tight bounds for the broad class of confidence-based aggregation rules by integrating signal detection theory with information-theoretic analysis, yielding four results: (1) a complementarity theorem (teams outperform individuals iff error correlation $ρ_{HM} < ρ^*$, with $ρ^* \approx a$ in the symmetric near-chance regime); (2) minimax bounds showing gains scale as $Θ(\sqrt{Δd})$ with metacognitive sensitivity difference; (3) an impossibility result proving no confidence-based aggregation rule achieves complementarity when $ρ_{HM} \geq ρ^*$; and (4) multi-class generalization $ρ^*_K \approx ρ^*/\sqrt{K-1}$. Predictions match observed team accuracy ($R = 0.94$ on ImageNet-16H, $R = 0.91$ on CIFAR-10H) and the multi-class threshold scaling holds on human data ($R = 0.93$, $K = 16$), with robustness under non-Gaussian distributions. The framework explains why complementarity is rare and provides actionable design formulas; results apply to aggregation, not to interactive deliberation that generates novel answers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过融合信号检测论与信息论，推导出了置信度聚合规则的理论边界，揭示了人机团队仅在误差相关性低于特定阈值时才能实现互补，并在多个数据集上验证了预测的高准确性。
AI.motivation: 针对现有研究中70%的人机团队未能超越其最佳成员表现、且缺乏明确理论指导何时能实现优势互补这一现状，本文旨在建立理论基础，确定实现团队表现互补的具体条件和限制。
AI.method: 将信号检测理论（SDT）与信息论分析相结合，针对置信度聚合规则这一广泛类别进行理论推导，分析误差相关性、元认知敏感度差异等关键变量对团队性能的影响，并推导了多分类问题的扩展形式。
AI.result: 获得了四个核心结论：（1）互补性定理，团队优于个体当且仅当误差相关性ρ_HM < ρ*；（2）极小极大边界，收益随元认知敏感度差异按Θ(√Δd)规模变化；（3）不可能性结果，当ρ_HM ≥ ρ*时无置信度规则可实现互补；（4）多分类扩展ρ*_K ≈ ρ*/√(K-1)。预测与实际团队准确率高度相关（ImageNet-16H: R=0.94；CIFAR-10H: R=0.91），多分类阈值缩放在人类数据上成立（R=0.93，K=16）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架解释了为何互补性在实践中罕见（因误差相关性往往超过临界阈值），并为团队设计提供了可操作的理论公式；研究适用于聚合场景，不适用于产生新颖答案的交互式商议场景。

title: Retrieval Mechanisms Surpass Long-Context Scaling in Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have borrowed the long context paradigm from natural language processing under the premise that feeding more history into the model improves forecast quality. But in stochastic domains, distant history is often just high-frequency noise, not signal. Hence, the proposed work tests whether this premise actually holds by running continuous context architectures (PatchTST included) through the ETTh1 benchmark. The obtained results contradict the premise: an inverse scaling law shows up clearly, with forecasting error rising as context gets longer. A 3,000-step window causes performance to drop by over 68%, evidence that attention mechanisms are poor at ignoring irrelevant historical volatility. Retrieval-Augmented Forecasting (RAFT) is evaluated as an alternative. RAFT achieves a mean squared error (MSE) of 0.379 with a fixed 720-step window and selective retrieval, outperforming both long-context configurations and zero-shot foundation models (Chronos, Moirai) despite requiring far less computation. In addition, the retrieval step injects only the most relevant historical segments as dynamic exogenous variables, which gives the model a context-informed inductive bias it cannot build on its own from raw sequences. Therefore, foundation models going forward need to shift architecturally toward selective retrieval.

AI.tldr: 挑战时间序列基础模型中“长上下文提升预测效果”的主流假设，发现反向缩放定律（上下文越长误差越高），提出基于检索增强的RAFT方法在减少计算量的同时显著超越长上下文模型和零样本基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）从自然语言处理领域借鉴了长上下文范式，默认假设输入更多历史数据能够提升预测质量。然而在随机性领域，远距离历史往往只是高频噪声而非有效信号。因此，本研究旨在验证这一前提假设是否真正成立。
AI.method: 在ETTh1基准上测试连续上下文架构（包括PatchTST），评估不同上下文长度对预测性能的影响；同时提出并评估检索增强预测方法RAFT，该方法使用固定的720步窗口和选择性检索机制，仅将最相关的历史片段作为动态外生变量注入模型。
AI.result: 实验结果与主流假设相悖，发现清晰的反向缩放定律：随着上下文增长，预测误差上升；3000步窗口导致性能下降超过68%，证明注意力机制难以忽略无关的历史波动。RAFT方法在固定720步窗口和选择性检索配置下实现0.379的MSE，以远低于长上下文配置的计算成本同时超越长上下文配置和零样本基础模型（Chronos、Moirai）。
AI.conclusion: 现有时间序列基础模型需要重新审视其架构方向，应当从盲目追求长上下文转向选择性检索机制，通过注入最相关历史片段赋予模型上下文感知的归纳偏置，这是未来基础模型架构改进的关键方向。

title: Bias by Necessity: Impossibility Theorems for Sequential Processing with Convergent AI and Human Validation
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to CogSci 2026
summary: Are certain cognitive biases mathematically inevitable consequences of sequential information processing? We prove that primacy effects, anchoring, and order-dependence are architecturally necessary in autoregressive language models due to causal masking constraints. Our three impossibility theorems establish: (1) primacy bias arises from asymmetric attention accumulation; (2) anchoring emerges from sequential conditioning with provable information bounds; and (3) exact debiasing by permutation marginalization requires factorial-time computation, with Monte Carlo approximation feasible at constant per-tolerance overhead. We validate these bounds across 12 frontier LLMs ($R^2 = 0.89$; $Δ$BIC $= 16.6$ vs. next-best alternative). We then derive quantitative predictions from the framework and test them in two pre-registered human experiments ($N = 464$ analyzed). Study 1 confirms anchor position modulates anchoring magnitude ($d = 0.52$, BF$_{10} = 847$). Study 2 shows working memory load amplifies primacy bias ($d = 0.41$, BF$_{10} = 156$), with WM capacity predicting bias reduction ($r = -.38$). These convergent findings reframe cognitive biases as resource-rational responses to sequential processing.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上证明了自回归语言模型中的首因效应、锚定效应和顺序依赖等认知偏差是因果掩码约束下的数学必然，并通过12个前沿大模型和464名人类被试实验验证了这一框架。
AI.motivation: 探究特定的认知偏差（如首因效应、锚定效应）是否是序列信息处理过程中数学上不可避免的后果，旨在从计算架构层面重新审视认知偏差的成因。
AI.method: 提出三个不可能定理从理论上证明偏差的必然性；在12个前沿大模型上验证理论边界；设计两个预注册的人类行为实验（N=464），分别操纵锚点位置和工作记忆负荷进行检验。
AI.result: 理论证明偏差源于非对称注意力累积和序列条件约束，精确去偏需阶乘时间复杂度；模型验证显示理论拟合度高（$R^2 = 0.89$）；人类实验确认锚点位置调节锚定效应（$d = 0.52$），工作记忆负荷加剧首因效应且容量能预测偏差降低（$r = -.38$）。
AI.conclusion: 认知偏差可被重新定义为面对序列处理限制时的资源理性响应，而非单纯的非理性错误或模型缺陷。

title: Deep Dreams Are Made of This: Visualizing Monosemantic Features in Diffusion Models
summary: This paper proposes latent visualization by optimization (LVO), a mechanistic interpretability technique that extends feature visualization by optimization - originally developed for convolutional neural networks - to latent diffusion models. LVO employs sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to disentangle polysemantic layer representations into monosemantic features. Key contributions include latent-space optimization, time-step activity analysis, schedule-matched noise injection, prior initialization through feature steering, and suitable regularization strategies. We demonstrate the method on Stable Diffusion 1.5 fine-tuned on the Style50 dataset, showing that SAE features produce clear visualizations of recognizable concepts - including diagonal compositions, human figures, roses, cables, and waterfall foam - that correlate with dataset examples, while the baseline without disentanglement produces less coherent results. We further show that regularization techniques from pixel-space feature visualization transfer to the latent domain, though they require different configurations for the raw-layer and SAE variants. Compared to dataset examples and steering, LVO provides complementary insights by directly revealing what activates a feature rather than its downstream effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了潜在优化可视化（LVO）方法，通过将特征可视化技术扩展到潜在扩散模型，利用稀疏自编码器解耦层表示，成功生成了可识别概念的清晰可视化。
AI.motivation: 特征可视化技术最初为卷积神经网络开发，但尚未有效应用于潜在扩散模型。由于扩散模型的潜在空间表示具有多义性（polysemantic），难以直接解释，因此需要一种方法能够解耦这些表示并可视化具体的语义特征。
AI.method: 提出了潜在优化可视化（LVO）方法：1）使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将多义性的层表示解耦为单义性特征；2）引入潜在空间优化；3）设计时间步活动分析；4）采用调度匹配的噪声注入；5）通过特征引导进行先验初始化；6）开发适合的稀疏正则化策略。在Style50数据集上微调的Stable Diffusion 1.5上进行验证。
AI.result: SAE特征能够生成清晰的、可识别概念的可视化结果，包括对角构图、人物、玫瑰、电缆和瀑布泡沫等，这些可视化与数据集样本具有相关性。相比之下，没有解耦的基线方法产生的结果连贯性较差。此外，像素空间特征可视化的正则化技术可以迁移到潜在空间，但在原始层和SAE变体中需要不同的配置。
AI.conclusion: LVO方法成功将特征可视化扩展到潜在扩散模型领域，通过SAE解耦能够有效地揭示激活特定特征的视觉模式。与数据集样本和特征引导方法相比，LVO提供了互补的洞察，能够直接展示特征的激活内容而非其下游效应。

title: DP-LAC: Lightweight Adaptive Clipping for Differentially Private Federated Fine-tuning of Language Models
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables the collaborative training of large-scale language models (LLMs) across edge devices while keeping user data on-device. However, FL still exposes sensitive information through client-provided gradients. Differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) mitigates this risk by clipping each client's contribution to a threshold $C$ and adding noise proportional to $C$. Existing adaptive clipping techniques dynamically adjust $C$ but demand tedious hyperparameter tuning, which can erode the privacy budget. In this paper, we introduce DP-LAC, a method that first estimates an initial clipping threshold within an order of magnitude of the optimum using private histogram estimation, and then adapts this threshold during training without consuming additional privacy budget or introducing new hyperparameters. Empirical results show that DP-LAC outperforms both state-of-the-art adaptive clipping methods and vanilla DP-SGD, achieving an average accuracy gain of $6.6\%$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DP-LAC方法，通过私有直方图估计初始裁剪阈值并在训练中自适应调整，在不消耗额外隐私预算的情况下，显著提升了联邦学习训练大语言模型的准确率。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在边缘设备上训练大语言模型时，通过梯度仍会泄露敏感信息。现有的差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）方法通过裁剪和加噪保护隐私，但现有的自适应裁剪技术需要繁琐的超参数调优，且会消耗隐私预算，这促使研究者寻求一种更高效、无需额外隐私开销的自适应裁剪方案。
AI.method: 提出DP-LAC方法：首先利用私有直方图估计技术，估计出一个与最优值在一个数量级内的初始裁剪阈值C；随后在训练过程中自适应调整该阈值，且此调整过程不消耗额外的隐私预算，也不引入新的超参数。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，DP-LAC在性能上优于现有的最先进自适应裁剪方法和原始DP-SGD，平均准确率提升了6.6%。
AI.conclusion: DP-LAC为联邦学习中的差分隐私训练提供了一种高效的自适应裁剪阈值解决方案，在无需额外隐私成本和超参数调优的情况下显著提升了模型性能，具有重要的实用价值。

title: Done, But Not Sure: Disentangling World Completion from Self-Termination in Embodied Agents
summary: Standard embodied evaluations do not independently score whether an agent correctly commits to task completion at episode closure, a capacity we call terminal commitment. Behaviorally distinct failures--never completing the task, completing it but failing to stop, and reporting success without sufficient evidence--collapse into the same benchmark failure. We introduce VIGIL, an evaluation framework that makes terminal commitment independently measurable. Under VIGIL's default protocol, agents observe only egocentric RGB, receive no action-success signals, and must end each episode with a semantic report checked deterministically against hidden world state. This yields two separate scores: world-state completion (W) and benchmark success (B), where B additionally requires a correct terminal report. This decoupling makes four outcome categories distinguishable: missed execution, post-attainment drift, unsupported commitment, and verified success. Across 20 models on 1,000 frozen episodes, systems with comparable W differ by up to 19.7 pp in B: one model converts achieved states into correct reports, while another with near-identical execution drifts past the goal without closing. An action-feedback intervention further tests the separation: execution-oriented signals improve W broadly, yet commitment failures persist in models that do not already ground terminal reports in the achieved state. VIGIL provides a protocol that makes terminal commitment independently visible and scorable.

AI.tldr: 提出了VIGIL评估框架，独立测量智能体的终端承诺能力（任务完成时正确停止并报告），将世界状态完成度(W)与基准成功率(B)解耦，揭示了现有指标无法区分的执行失败类型。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能评估基准无法独立评估智能体在任务结束时是否正确提交完成承诺，导致三种行为上截然不同的失败（从未完成任务、完成但未停止、无证据报告成功）被归为相同的基准失败，缺乏细粒度的失败诊断能力。
AI.method: 引入VIGIL评估框架：智能体仅观测自我中心RGB图像，无动作-成功反馈信号，必须在每轮结束时输出语义报告并与隐藏世界状态进行确定性校验。产生两个独立分数：世界状态完成度(W)和基准成功率(B)，后者要求正确的终端报告。该方法区分四种结果类别：执行失败、达成后漂移、无证据承诺、验证成功。
AI.result: 在20个模型、1000个冻结情节上的实验表明：W分数相近的模型在B分数上差异高达19.7个百分点。一个模型能将已达状态转化为正确报告，而另一个执行近似的模型却在目标处漂移而未正确终止。动作反馈干预显示：执行导向信号广泛提升W分数，但未将终端报告建立在已达状态上的模型仍存在承诺失败。
AI.conclusion: VIGIL提供了一个使终端承诺独立可见、可评分的评估协议，有效分离了执行能力与承诺能力，为具身智能体的评估与改进提供了更细粒度的诊断工具。

title: NoisyCoconut: Counterfactual Consensus via Latent Space Reasoning
summary: This paper presents NoisyCoconut, a novel inference-time method that enhances large language model (LLM) reliability by manipulating internal representations. Unlike fine-tuning methods that require extensive retraining, NoisyCoconut operates directly on model representations during inference and requires no retraining. Rather than training models to reason in latent space, we inject controlled noise into latent trajectories to generate diverse reasoning paths. Agreement among these paths provides a confidence signal, enabling models to abstain when uncertain. We demonstrate that this approach achieves effective coverage-accuracy tradeoffs across multiple reasoning benchmarks without requiring access to training data or modification of model parameters. This approach provides a practical pathway to improving the reliability of LLM outputs while maintaining compatibility with existing models. Our experiments show that unanimous agreement among noise-perturbed paths reduces error rates from 40-70% to below 15%, enabling models to exceed 95% accuracy on mathematical reasoning tasks through selective abstention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NoisyCoconut，一种无需重训练的推理时方法，通过向潜在轨迹注入受控噪声生成多样化推理路径，利用路径间的一致性作为置信度信号，实现选择性弃权，在数学推理任务中将错误率从40-70%降至15%以下。
AI.motivation: 现有提升大语言模型可靠性的方法多依赖微调，需要大量重训练且修改模型参数。本文旨在开发一种无需重训练、直接在推理时操作模型内部表示的方法，以提高LLM输出的可靠性。
AI.method: NoisyCoconut在推理时向模型的潜在轨迹（latent trajectories）注入受控噪声，生成多样化的推理路径。通过分析这些噪声扰动路径之间的一致性作为置信度信号，使模型能够在不确定性高时选择弃权（abstain），而非给出可能错误的答案。
AI.result: 实验表明，当噪声扰动路径达成一致时，错误率从40-70%显著降低至15%以下。通过选择性弃权机制，模型在数学推理任务上的准确率可超过95%。该方法在多个推理基准测试上实现了有效的覆盖率-准确率权衡。
AI.conclusion: NoisyCoconut提供了一条无需访问训练数据或修改模型参数的实用路径，有效提升了LLM输出的可靠性，并与现有模型保持兼容性，为改善大语言模型可靠性提供了新思路。

title: Autonomous FAIR Digital Objects: From Passive Assertions to Active Knowledge
summary: Scientific knowledge on the Web is published as passive assertions and cannot decide when to validate evidence, reconcile contradictions, or update confidence as findings accumulate. Curation depends on centralised middleware and institutional continuity, but when registries close, active stewardship stops even when data remain online. We advance the concept of Autonomous FAIR Digital Objects (aFDOs) from an abstract idea to an operational model, to offer a route from passive scientific publication toward accountable, standards-aligned automation that can outlive its publishing institutions. aFDO augments FDOs with three capabilities anchored in Semantic Web standards, namely 1) a policy layer over RDF-star aligned with PROV-O, SHACL, and ODRL for portable condition-action rules, 2) an announcement layer over ActivityStreams 2.0 that bounds per-announcement evaluation cost, and 3) an agreement layer that resolves multi-source contradictions through reputation and confidence weighted agreement under a bounded adversarial model. We provide a formal definition that distinguishes policy specifications, event handlers, and communication interfaces. We evaluate an open reference implementation on 4,305 FDOs grounded in rare-disease ontologies, namely ClinVar, HPO, and Orphanet, combined with controlled synthetic observations. The consensus mechanism resolves 56.3% of 3,914 naturally occurring ClinVar conflicts where multiple submitters disagree and an expert panel has subsequently adjudicated. Under Sybil, collusion, and poisoning attacks, the mechanism degrades gracefully within its design Byzantine-tolerance bound (f < n/5), and fails as predicted beyond that bound.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了自主FAIR数字对象（aFDO）模型，通过三层架构（策略层、公告层、协议层）将被动科学知识发布转变为可自动验证、协调矛盾并更新置信度的主动系统，在罕见病本体数据集上解决了56.3%的ClinVar自然冲突，并在Byzantine攻击下表现出理论预测的鲁棒性边界。
AI.motivation: 现有Web科学知识以被动断言形式发布，无法自主验证证据、协调矛盾或随研究发现积累而更新置信度；数据监管依赖中心化中间件和机构持续性，当注册库关闭时主动监管即停止，即使数据仍在线可用。
AI.method: 提出自主FAIR数字对象（aFDO）操作模型，包含三层能力：1）基于RDF-star并符合PROV-O、SHACL和ODRL的策略层，实现可移植的条件-动作规则；2）基于ActivityStreams 2.0的公告层，限定每次公告的评估成本；3）协议层，在有界对抗模型下通过声誉和置信度加权协议解决多源矛盾。给出形式化定义以区分策略规范、事件处理器和通信接口。
AI.result: 在4,305个基于罕见病本体（ClinVar、HPO、Orphanet）的FDO及受控合成观测数据上进行开放参考实现评估。共识机制解决了3,914个ClinVar自然发生冲突中56.3%的多提交者分歧（专家小组后续已裁决）。在Sybil攻击、合谋攻击和投毒攻击下，机制在设计Byzantine容限边界（f < n/5）内优雅降级，超出边界时按预期失效。
AI.conclusion: aFDO为从被动科学出版向可问责、标准对齐的自动化转型提供了可行路径，能够超越发布机构的生命周期而持续运行，为科学知识的自主监管和长期可访问性提供了新的技术方案。

title: Value-Decomposed Reinforcement Learning Framework for Taxiway Routing with Hierarchical Conflict-Aware Observations
summary: Taxiway routing and on-surface conflict avoidance are coupled safety-critical decision problems in airport surface operations. Existing planning and optimization methods are often limited by online computational cost, while reinforcement learning methods may struggle to represent downstream traffic conflicts and balance multiple objectives. This paper presents Conflict-aware Taxiway Routing (CaTR), a reinforcement learning framework for real-time multi-aircraft taxiway routing. CaTR constructs a grid-based airport surface environment with action masking, introduces a hierarchical foresight traffic representation to encode current and downstream conflict-related traffic conditions, and adopts a value-decomposed reinforcement learning strategy to prioritize sparse but safety-critical objectives. Experiments are conducted on a realistic environment based on Changsha Huanghua International Airport under multiple traffic density levels. Results show that CaTR achieves better safety--efficiency trade-offs than representative planning, optimization, and reinforcement learning baselines while maintaining practical runtime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CaTR（冲突感知滑行道路由）框架，一种基于强化学习的实时多飞机滑行道路由方法，通过层次化前瞻交通表示和值分解策略，在安全性和效率之间取得了更好的平衡。
AI.motivation: 机场地面运行中，滑行道路径规划和地面冲突避免是耦合的安全关键决策问题。现有的规划和优化方法受限于在线计算成本，而强化学习方法难以表示下游交通冲突并平衡多个目标。
AI.method: CaTR构建了基于网格的机场地面环境并采用动作掩码；引入层次化前瞻交通表示来编码当前和下游与冲突相关的交通状况；采用值分解强化学习策略来优先处理稀疏但安全关键的目标。
AI.result: 在基于长沙黄花国际机场的真实环境下进行多交通密度水平的实验，CaTR在保持实用运行时间的同时，相比代表性规划、优化和强化学习基线方法，实现了更好的安全-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: CaTR框架能够有效解决机场地面多飞机滑行道路由问题，在实时性、安全性和效率方面均表现优异，为机场地面运行决策提供了有效的解决方案。

title: AHD Agent: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Automatic Heuristic Design
summary: Automatic heuristic design (AHD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for solving NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems (COPs). Recent works show that large language models (LLMs), when integrated into well-designed frameworks (i.e., LLM-AHD), can autonomously discover high-performing heuristics. However, existing LLM-AHD frameworks typically treat LLMs as passive generators within fixed workflows, where the model generates heuristics from manually designed, limited context. Such context may fail to capture state-dependent information (e.g., specific failure modes), leading to inefficient trial-and-error exploration. To overcome these limitations, we propose AHD Agent, a novel tool-integrated, multi-turn framework that empowers LLMs to proactively decide whether to generate heuristics or invoke tools to retrieve targeted evidence from the solving environment. To effectively train such a dynamic decision-making agent, we introduce an agentic reinforcement learning (RL) system, which leverages a novel environment synthesis pipeline to optimize a compact model's generalizable AHD capabilities. Experiments across eight diverse domains, including four held-out tasks, demonstrate that our 4B-parameter agent matches or surpasses state-of-the-art baselines using much larger models, while requiring significantly fewer evaluations. Model and inference scaling analysis further reveals that AHD Agent offers an effective trajectory toward truly autonomous heuristic design.

AI.tldr: 提出AHD Agent，一种工具集成、多轮交互的框架，通过智能体强化学习训练小模型(4B)在主动决策生成启发式或调用工具之间做出选择，在8个领域匹配或超越使用大模型的最优基线，且评估次数更少。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-AHD框架将大语言模型视为固定工作流中的被动生成器，使用人工设计的有限上下文生成启发式。这种上下文无法捕获状态依赖信息（如特定失败模式），导致低效的试错探索。
AI.method: 提出AHD Agent，一种工具集成的多轮框架，赋予LLM主动决定是生成启发式还是调用工具从求解环境中检索针对性证据的能力。引入智能体强化学习系统，利用新型环境合成流水线优化紧凑模型的泛化AHD能力。
AI.result: 在8个多样化领域（包括4个留出任务）上的实验表明，4B参数的智能体匹配或超越使用更大模型的最先进基线，同时需要显著更少的评估次数。模型和推理扩展分析进一步显示AHD Agent为真正自主的启发式设计提供了有效路径。
AI.conclusion: AHD Agent通过赋予LLM主动决策和工具调用能力，结合强化学习训练，实现了高效自主启发式设计，证明了小模型在智能体框架下可以超越传统大模型方法的性能。

title: From Holo Pockets to Electron Density: GPT-style Drug Design with Density
comment: Published as a conference paper in ICML 2026
summary: Recent advances in generative modeling have enabled significant progress in structure-based drug design (SBDD). Existing methods typically condition molecule generation on empty binding pockets from holo complexes, overlooking informative components such as the filler (ligands and solvent). Here, we leverage low-resolution electron density (ED) derived from the filler as a physically grounded condition for \textit{de novo} drug design. We consider two types of ED, calculated and cryo-EM/X-ray, obtainable from computational or experimental sources, supporting unified pre-training and experimental integration. Compared with rigid pocket representations, experimental ED naturally captures conformational flexibility and provides a more faithful description of the binding environment. Based on this, we introduce EDMolGPT, a decoder-only autoregressive framework that generates molecules from low-resolution ED point clouds. By grounding generation in physically meaningful density signals, EDMolGPT mitigates structural bias and produces molecules with 3D conformations. Evaluations on 101 biological targets verify the effectiveness. Our project page: https://jiahaochen1.github.io/EDMolGPT_Page/.

AI.tldr: 提出EDMolGPT模型，利用低分辨率电子密度作为条件进行从头药物设计，相比现有方法能更真实地描述结合环境并生成有效的3D分子构象。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于结构的药物设计方法通常以空结合口袋为条件生成分子，忽略了配体和溶剂等填充物信息，且刚性口袋表示无法捕捉构象灵活性。
AI.method: 利用计算或实验来源的低分辨率电子密度作为物理约束条件，开发基于解码器的自回归框架EDMolGPT，从电子密度点云生成具有3D构象的分子。
AI.result: 在101个生物靶点上的评估验证了方法的有效性，生成的分子具有合理的3D构象，缓解了结构偏差问题。
AI.conclusion: 电子密度作为物理基础条件能够自然捕捉构象灵活性，为结合环境提供更真实的描述，是药物分子生成的有效条件表示方式。

title: When Does Value-Aware KV Eviction Help? A Fixed-Contract Diagnostic for Non-Monotone Cache Compression
summary: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by the memory and bandwidth cost of reading large KV caches during decoding. KV compression reduces this cost by keeping only part of the cache, but task accuracy alone does not identify why a selector succeeds or fails. A selector can fail at three steps: it may miss the evidence future decoding needs, give high scores to tokens that do not affect the output, or break related evidence when fitting scores into a small cache. We introduce a fixed-contract diagnostic that holds the selector's setup fixed and changes one decision slot at a time. For value ranking, the probe combines a block's attention mass with the estimated output change from removing it. On LongBench across three models and two budgets, the probe is positive on 72.6% of positive-margin cells and 32.4% of nonpositive-margin cells. NeedleBench M-RT at 32k and a RULER 8k check probe support closure under branched retrieval, and a 264-cell sign evaluation separates support recovery and output-value ranking from leverage effects near the boundary. The resulting order is to recover decode-side evidence, rank its output value, and preserve coupled evidence during projection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种固定约束诊断方法，用于分析KV缓存压缩中选择器失败的根本原因，并引入探针工具量化各步骤的准确性，最终确定了“恢复证据→排序输出价值→保留耦合证据”的优化顺序。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM推理在解码阶段受限于读取大型KV缓存的内存和带宽成本。现有的KV压缩方法仅关注任务准确率，无法解释选择器为何成功或失败。作者旨在深入剖析选择器失败的具体环节，以指导更有效的压缩策略设计。
AI.method: 提出了固定约束诊断框架，保持选择器设置不变，逐一改变决策槽位进行测试。引入了一种探针方法，结合注意力质量和移除该块导致的输出变化估计，对缓存块进行价值排序。在LongBench、NeedleBench M-RT和RULER等基准上进行了跨模型、跨预算的实验验证。
AI.result: 在LongBench上，该探针在72.6%的正边际单元和32.4%的非正边际单元上呈阳性。NeedleBench M-RT（32k）和RULER 8k的检查探针支持分支检索下的闭包性。264单元符号评估成功分离了支持恢复、输出价值排序与边界附近的杠杆效应。
AI.conclusion: 选择器失败主要发生在三个步骤：遗漏未来解码所需证据、为不影响输出的token打高分、以及将分数适配到小缓存时破坏相关证据。正确的优化顺序应为：首先恢复解码侧证据，其次排序其输出价值，最后在投影过程中保留耦合证据。

title: Mirror, Mirror on the Wall: Can VLM Agents Tell Who They Are at All?
summary: In the animal kingdom, mirror self-recognition is a canonical probe of higher-order cognition, emerging only in some species. We ask whether an analogous functional capability emerges in embodied vision-language model (VLM) agents: can they recognize themselves in a mirror? We introduce a controlled 3D benchmark where a first-person VLM agent must infer a hidden body attribute from its reflection and select the matching target, while avoiding self-other misattribution. To separate mirror-grounded self-identification from shortcuts, we test mirror removal, misleading cues, and occluded reflections. We also evaluate the decision process through mirror seeking, temporal ordering, self-attribution, and reasoning-action consistency. Our experiments show that mirror-based self-identification emerges mainly in stronger VLMs. These models can use reflected evidence for action, whereas weaker models often inspect the mirror but fail to extract self-relevant information or misattribute their reflection. Language-vision conflict further shows that self-referential language alone is not evidence of grounded self-identification. Overall, mirror-based evaluation provides a diagnostic for whether embodied self-grounding is causally rooted in perception and action rather than priors, prompt compliance, or confabulation.

AI.tldr: 本文借鉴动物界的镜子自我识别测试，构建了一个受控的3D基准，用于评估具身视觉语言模型（VLM）代理是否具备通过镜像识别自身的能力。实验发现，仅较强的VLM展现出基于镜像的接地自我识别能力，而较弱模型常出现误归因或无法提取自我信息。该基准有效区分了真正的感知-行动自我接地与语言先验或提示依从性。
AI.motivation: 在动物界，镜子自我识别是探测高阶认知能力的经典范式。研究旨在探究具身视觉语言模型（VLM）代理是否具备类似的功能性能力——即能否在镜像中识别自己。该研究动机在于填补对AI系统“自我接地”能力评估的空白，区分模型是基于感知与行动的真正自我识别，还是仅依赖语言先验或提示依从。
AI.method: 研究引入了一个受控的3D基准环境。第一人称VLM代理需要通过镜像推断隐藏的自身属性，并选择匹配目标，同时避免自我-他者误归因。为分离真正的镜像接地自我识别与捷径策略，研究设计了多种测试条件：移除镜像、误导性线索和遮挡反射。此外，通过镜像寻找、时序排序、自我归因和推理-行动一致性四个维度评估决策过程，并引入语言-视觉冲突测试以验证自我识别的真实性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，基于镜像的自我识别能力主要出现在较强的VLM中。这些模型能够利用反射证据指导行动，而较弱模型虽然能注意到镜像，但往往无法提取与自我相关的信息或错误归因于他人。语言-视觉冲突测试进一步揭示，仅有自我指涉的语言输出并不等同于接地的自我识别，证明了该基准能有效诊断具身自我接地是否因果根植于感知与行动。
AI.conclusion: 基于镜像的评估方法为诊断具身智能体的自我接地能力提供了有效工具。它能区分模型是基于感知和行动的真正自我识别，还是仅依赖先验知识、提示依从性或虚构信息。该研究为评估AI系统的认知发展水平提供了新视角。

title: Path-Coupled Bellman Flows for Distributional Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Distributional reinforcement learning (DRL) models the full return distribution, but existing finite-support or quantile-based methods rely on projections, while recent flow-based approaches can suffer from \emph{boundary mismatch} at the flow source or from \emph{high-variance} bootstrapping when current and successor noises are independent. We propose Path-Coupled Bellman Flows (PCBF), a continuous-time DRL method that learns return distributions with flow matching using \textbf{source-consistent Bellman-coupled paths}: the current path starts from the required base prior at $t{=}0$, reaches the Bellman target at $t{=}1$, and maintains a pathwise affine relation to the successor flow at intermediate times (without requiring time-$t$ marginals to satisfy a distributional Bellman fixed point for all $t$). PCBF couples current and successor return flows through shared base noise and uses a $λ$-parameterized control-variate target: $λ{=}0$ recovers an unbiased sample Bellman target, while $λ{>}0$ trades controlled bias for variance reduction. Experiments on analytically tractable MRPs, OGBench, and D4RL show improved distributional fidelity and training stability, and competitive offline RL performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了路径耦合贝尔曼流（PCBF），一种连续时间分布式强化学习方法，通过源一致性贝尔曼耦合路径解决现有流方法中的边界不匹配和高方差问题，在分布保真度和离线强化学习性能上取得改进。
AI.motivation: 现有的分布式强化学习方法存在局限性：有限支撑或分位数方法依赖投影操作，而最近的流方法面临边界不匹配问题（在流源处）或高方差自举问题（当当前噪声与后继噪声独立时）。
AI.method: 提出路径耦合贝尔曼流（PCBF），使用源一致性贝尔曼耦合路径：当前路径从t=0的先验出发，在t=1达到贝尔曼目标，并在中间时刻与后继流保持路径仿射关系。通过共享基础噪声耦合当前和后继回报流，并采用λ参数化控制变量目标（λ=0为无偏样本贝尔曼目标，λ>0以可控偏差换取方差缩减）。
AI.result: 在可解析处理的马尔可夫回报过程（MRP）、OGBench和D4RL基准测试上的实验表明，PCBF在分布保真度、训练稳定性方面有显著提升，并在离线强化学习任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: PCBF成功解决了流式分布式强化学习中的边界不匹配和高方差问题，通过路径耦合机制和控制变量技术实现了更好的分布学习效果和训练稳定性，为连续时间分布式强化学习提供了有效的新方法。

title: How You Begin is How You Reason: Driving Exploration in RLVR via Prefix-Tuned Priors
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) recently thrives in large language model (LLM) reasoning tasks. However, the reward sparsity and the long reasoning horizon make effective exploration challenging. In practice, this challenge manifests as the \emph{entropy collapse} phenomenon, where RLVR improves single-rollout accuracy but fails to expand coverage on successful reasoning trajectories. Passive exploration techniques like entropy regularization tend to dismiss generation quality, resulting in noisy rollouts. In response to this issue, we propose an Information-Maximizing Augmented eXploration (IMAX) framework to train a pool of soft prefixes that reshapes the base model's prior over reasoning trajectories. Rather than relying on RL to incentivize exploration on top of the base model, each prefix acts as a trainable control knob that induces a distinct rollout distribution from the same backbone model. To encourage discovery of diverse and task-relevant reasoning behaviors, we derive an Information Maximization (InfoMax) reward to complement the verifiable rewards for RL training. IMAX is in general algorithm-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing RLVR pipelines. Experiment results have shown that across three backbone scales, IMAX consistently improves reasoning performance over standard RLVR, with gains up to 11.60\% in Pass@4 and 10.57\% in Avg@4.

AI.tldr: 针对强化学习验证奖励（RLVR）中存在的熵塌缩和探索不足问题，提出IMAX框架，通过训练软前缀池并引入信息最大化奖励来增强探索能力，在多个骨干模型上显著提升了推理性能。
AI.motivation: 在大型语言模型的推理任务中，RLVR面临奖励稀疏和长推理路径的挑战，导致熵塌缩现象：虽然单次推理准确率提升，但无法扩展成功推理轨迹的覆盖范围。现有的被动探索技术（如熵正则化）往往牺牲生成质量，产生噪声输出。
AI.method: 提出信息最大化增强探索（IMAX）框架，训练一组软前缀来重塑基础模型在推理轨迹上的先验分布。每个前缀作为可训练的控制旋钮，从同一骨干模型诱导出不同的推演分布。同时推导出信息最大化（InfoMax）奖励，与可验证奖励互补用于RL训练。该方法具有算法无关性，可无缝集成到现有RLVR流程中。
AI.result: 在三种骨干模型规模上的实验表明，IMAX相比标准RLVR一致性地提升了推理性能，其中Pass@4提升高达11.60%，Avg@4提升高达10.57%。
AI.conclusion: IMAX通过软前缀池和信息最大化奖励有效解决了RLVR中的探索问题，避免了熵塌缩现象，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升了推理任务的覆盖范围和整体性能。

title: HyperTransport: Amortized Conditioning of T2I Generative Models
summary: As foundation models grow in capability, the ability to efficiently and reliably control their behavior becomes critical. Fine-tuning these models can be costly, and while prompting can be practical for controllability, it remains fragile due to models' high sensitivity to exact prompt wording and structure. This brittleness has driven interest in activation steering techniques that offer more stable and predictable control over model behavior. However, existing activation steering methods require per-concept optimization, which makes them ill-suited to deployment scenarios where the concept set is large, evolving, or only specified at request time: each new concept incurs at least minutes of optimization on the target model. We propose HyperTransport, a hypernetwork framework that amortizes this cost by mapping embeddings from a pretrained encoder (CLIP in our instantiation) directly to intervention parameters, trained end-to-end using an optimal transport loss. Once trained, HyperTransport produces each new intervention in a single hypernetwork forward pass, 3600-7000x faster than per-concept fitting. On concepts unseen during training, it matches the strongest per-concept baselines at inducing the target concept. By decoupling concept representation from intervention prediction, HyperTransport combines three capabilities that no existing approach offers as a set: amortized steering for open-ended concept sets, continuous interpretable strength control, and cross-modal conditioning where reference images can directly steer text-based generation. We validate HyperTransport on DMD2 and Nitro-1-PixArt across 167 held-out test concepts via CLIP-based metrics, a VLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and a user study. In pairwise comparisons, both human and VLM judges prefer HyperTransport over prompting ~2x as often.

AI.tldr: 提出HyperTransport超网络框架，通过CLIP嵌入直接映射到干预参数，实现对大模型激活引导的快速生成，比现有方法快3600-7000倍，支持开放式概念集、连续强度控制和跨模态控制。
AI.motivation: 随着基础模型能力增强，行为控制变得至关重要。微调成本高昂，提示方法脆弱且对精确措辞敏感。现有激活引导方法需要针对每个概念进行优化，对于大规模、动态或实时指定的概念集不适用，因为每个新概念都需要数分钟的优化时间。
AI.method: 提出HyperTransport超网络框架，使用预训练编码器（CLIP）的嵌入通过超网络直接映射到干预参数，采用最优传输损失进行端到端训练。训练完成后，仅需单次超网络前向传播即可生成新干预，将概念表示与干预预测解耦。
AI.result: 在DMD2和Nitro-1-PixArt模型上，通过167个留出测试概念验证，HyperTransport生成速度比逐概念拟合快3600-7000倍。在未见过的概念上，其诱导目标概念的能力与最强逐概念基线相当。在配对比较中，人类和VLM评估者对HyperTransport的偏好率约为提示方法的2倍。
AI.conclusion: HyperTransport成功结合了三个现有方法无法同时实现的能力：开放式概念集的摊销引导、连续可解释的强度控制、以及跨模态调节（参考图像可直接引导文本生成），为大规模概念集的实时控制提供了有效解决方案。

title: Mental Health AI Safety Claims Must Preserve Temporal Evidence
summary: The safety of mental health AI is often judged at the wrong temporal scale. Current evaluations typically score isolated responses, endpoint outcomes, or aggregate dialogue quality, while clinically consequential failures may arise from the order and accumulation of interactions themselves, including delayed escalation, repeated reinforcement, dependency formation, failed repair, and gradual deterioration across turns. This paper argues that this mismatch is not merely a limitation of evaluation coverage but a source of invalid safety conclusions. We introduce Temporal Safety Non-Identifiability, a formal account of why safety properties that depend on sequence, timing, accumulation, or recovery cannot be certified by protocols that discard those features. From this formalization, we develop SCOPE (Safety Claims Over Preserved Evidence) as a general principle for aligning safety claims with the evidence an evaluation actually retains, and instantiate it as SCOPE-MH, a mental-health instantiation of this reporting standard. We operationalize SCOPE-MH through a proof-of-concept on the AnnoMI dataset of expert-annotated motivational interviewing conversations, which reveals mechanisms of failure that per-turn behavior scoring does not represent. We propose SCOPE-MH as a diagnostic complement to existing evaluation infrastructure and argue that evaluation preserving temporal evidence is necessary, not optional, for safety-critical mental health AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 当前心理健康AI的安全评估存在时间尺度错配问题。本文提出“时间安全不可识别性”概念，证明依赖序列、时序、累积或恢复的安全属性无法通过丢弃这些特征的协议来认证。作者开发了SCOPE原则及其心理健康实例化SCOPE-MH，用于将安全声明与评估实际保留的证据对齐，并在AnnoMI数据集上验证了该方法能揭示单轮行为评分无法代表的失败机制。
AI.motivation: 当前心理健康AI的安全评估通常针对孤立响应、端点结果或聚合对话质量进行评分，但临床相关的失败往往源于交互的顺序和累积效应，包括延迟升级、重复强化、依赖形成、修复失败和跨轮次的逐渐恶化。这种时间尺度错配不仅是评估覆盖范围的限制，还会导致无效的安全结论。
AI.method: 提出“时间安全不可识别性”的形式化理论，说明依赖序列、时序、累积或恢复的安全属性无法被丢弃这些特征的协议所认证。基于此形式化，开发SCOPE（基于保留证据的安全声明）作为将安全声明与评估实际保留证据对齐的通用原则，并将其实例化为心理健康领域的报告标准SCOPE-MH。在AnnoMI专家标注动机访谈对话数据集上进行概念验证。
AI.result: 在AnnoMI数据集上的概念验证揭示了单轮行为评分无法代表的失败机制。SCOPE-MH能够识别出那些被传统评估方法遗漏的、与临床相关的安全失败模式，证明了保留时间证据的评估方法对于发现这些失败是必要的。
AI.conclusion: 保留时间证据的评估对于安全关键的心理健康AI部署是必要的，而非可选的。SCOPE-MH应作为现有评估基础设施的诊断补充，用于确保安全声明与实际保留的证据相一致，从而提高心理健康AI的安全评估有效性。

title: Can LLMs Predict Polymer Physics Just by Reading Synthesis and Processing Prose?
summary: Can large language models predict physical and mechanical polymer properties simply by reading unstructured scientific prose? Polymer performance is rarely determined by chemical structure alone; identical nominal polymers can exhibit drastically different behaviors depending on their synthesis route, processing history, morphology, and testing conditions. Yet, state-of-the-art polymer property models typically rely on structure-only representations -- such as SMILES or molecular graphs -- which strip away this vital experimental context. In this work, we introduce \textbf{PolyLM}, a natural-language-only, process- and condition-aware framework that predicts materials performance directly from full-text literature. By circumventing structural inputs entirely, PolyLM preserves the nuanced, unstructured descriptions of synthesis and processing reported by domain scientists. To train this framework, we curated an unprecedented, literature-scale dataset encompassing 185,000 scientific papers and over 276,400 unique polymer samples across 22 physical, mechanical, and thermal properties. We fine-tuned a massive 9-billion-parameter language model (Qwen3.5-9B) using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and task-level uncertainty weighting. Evaluated on 68,283 held-out observations, the model achieves remarkably high predictive accuracy, establishing new state-of-the-art benchmarks for complex properties. Across the 22 diverse targets, the model achieves a median $R^2$ of 0.74, with predictions for key thermal, mechanical, and physicochemical properties frequently surpassing an $R^2$ of 0.80. These results unequivocally demonstrate that natural language is a powerful, highly scalable interface for realistic materials performance prediction.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了PolyLM框架，仅通过自然语言预测聚合物性能，在22个属性上达到中位R²=0.74，证明了自然语言是材料性能预测的有效接口。
AI.motivation: 聚合物的性能不仅由化学结构决定，还受合成路径、加工历史、形态和测试条件等实验背景影响，而现有模型仅依赖结构表示（如SMILES）而忽略了这些关键信息，因此需要一种能够利用文献中非结构化文本描述的模型。
AI.method: 构建包含18.5万篇论文、27.64万个聚合物样本的数据集，基于9B参数大模型（Qwen3.5-9B），采用LoRA微调和任务级不确定性加权方法，开发了纯自然语言输入的PolyLM框架。
AI.result: 在68,283个留出观测值上验证，模型实现了中位R²=0.74的预测精度，关键热学、力学和物理化学性质预测R²常超过0.80，在复杂性能预测上确立了新的最先进基准。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言是一种强大且高度可扩展的材料性能预测接口，能够有效捕捉实验背景信息，为材料性能预测开辟了新方向。

title: Efficient Prompt Learning for Traffic Forecasting
comment: 24 pages. This paper is accepted by VLDBJ
summary: Accurate traffic prediction is essential for optimizing transportation systems, enhancing resource allocation, and improving overall urban administration. Spatio-temporal graph neural networks (GNNs) have achieved state-of-the-art performance and have been widely used in various spatio-temporal prediction scenarios. However, these prediction methods often exhibit low generalization ability, struggling with distribution shifts caused by spatio-temporal dynamics. To address this challenge, we propose an approach to enhance the generalization and adaptation of spatio-temporal GNNs through efficient prompting. Specifically, we introduce a lightweight and model-agnostic prompt tuning framework for spatio-temporal GNNs, named SimpleST. It facilitates adapting pre-trained spatio-temporal GNNs to novel distributions while keeping the model parameters fixed. This prompt mechanism reduces the overhead and complexity of adaptation, enabling efficient utilization of pre-trained models for out-of-distribution generalization. Extensive experiments conducted on five real-world urban spatio-temporal datasets demonstrate the superiority of our approach in terms of prediction accuracy and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SimpleST，一个轻量级且模型无关的提示调优框架，通过固定模型参数并利用提示机制，有效解决了时空图神经网络在面对分布偏移时泛化能力差的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的时空图神经网络在预测任务中虽然性能先进，但在面对由时空动态变化引起的分布偏移时，往往表现出泛化能力不足，难以适应新的数据分布。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为SimpleST的轻量级、模型无关的提示调优框架。该方法允许在保持预训练模型参数固定的情况下，通过引入提示机制将模型适应到新的分布中，从而降低了适应过程的开销与复杂性。
AI.result: 在五个真实的城市时空数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，该方法在预测精度和计算效率方面均表现出优越性，有效实现了分布外泛化。
AI.conclusion: SimpleST框架成功提升了时空图神经网络的泛化与适应能力，为解决时空预测中的分布偏移问题提供了一种高效、低成本的解决方案。

title: Trapping Attacker in Dilemma: Examining Internal Correlations and External Influences of Trigger for Defending GNN Backdoors
summary: GNNs have become a standard tool for learning on relational data, yet they remain highly vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Prior defenses often depend on inspecting specific subgraph patterns or node features, and thus can be circumvented by adaptive attackers. We propose PRAETORIAN, a new defense that targets intrinsic requirements of effective GNN backdoors rather than surface-level cues. Our key observation is that flipping a victim node's prediction requires substantial influence on the victim: attackers tend to either inject many trigger nodes or rely on a small set of highly influential ones. Building on this observation, PRAETORIAN (i) analyzes internal correlations within potential trigger subgraphs to detect abnormally large injected structures, and (ii) quantifies external node influence to identify triggers with disproportionate impact. Across our evaluations, PRAETORIAN reduces the average attack success rate (ASR) to 0.55% with only a 0.62% drop in clean accuracy (CA), whereas state-of-the-art defenses still yield an average ASR of >20% and a CA drop of >3% under the same conditions. Moreover, PRAETORIAN remains effective against a range of adaptive attacks, forcing adversaries to either inject many trigger nodes to achieve high ASR (>80%), which incurs a >10% CA drop, or preserve CA at the cost of limiting ASR to 18.1%. Overall, PRAETORIAN constrains attackers to an unfavorable trade-off between efficacy and detectability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRAETORIAN，一种针对图神经网络后门攻击的新型防御方法，通过分析触发子图的内部相关性和外部节点影响力来检测异常，将平均攻击成功率降至0.55%，仅牺牲0.62%的干净准确率，并能有效抵御自适应攻击。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络（GNN）在关系数据学习中被广泛使用，但极易受到后门攻击。现有防御方法通常依赖于检查特定的子图模式或节点特征，容易被自适应攻击者绕过，因此需要一种针对GNN后门攻击内在机制的更鲁棒防御方法。
AI.method: 提出PRAETORIAN防御方法，基于攻击者需要显著影响受害节点预测这一关键观察：（1）分析潜在触发子图的内部相关性以检测异常大的注入结构；（2）量化外部节点影响力以识别具有不成比例影响的触发器。该方法针对有效GNN后门的内在要求而非表面特征进行防御。
AI.result: PRAETORIAN将平均攻击成功率（ASR）降至0.55%，干净准确率（CA）仅下降0.62%；相比之下，现有最先进防御方法在相同条件下平均ASR仍>20%，CA下降>3%。面对自适应攻击，攻击者必须在注入大量触发节点（ASR>80%但CA下降>10%）与保持干净准确率（ASR仅18.1%）之间做出不利权衡。
AI.conclusion: PRAETORIAN通过针对GNN后门攻击的内在要求而非表面特征进行防御，成功将攻击者限制在有效性与可检测性之间的不利权衡中，显著提升了GNN对后门攻击的鲁棒性，为后续防御研究提供了新思路。

title: LaWM: Least Action World Models for Long-Horizon Physical Consistency from Visual Observations
summary: Learning predictive world models from visual observations is a core problem in embodied AI, with applications to model-based reinforcement learning and robotic planning. Existing latent world models typically generate future states with unconstrained neural transition functions, while modern video generation systems often prioritize perceptual plausibility or introduce physical structure through auxiliary losses, external guidance, or separate dynamics modules. As a result, long-horizon rollouts can remain weakly grounded in the physical principles that govern real dynamics, leading to compounding error, energy drift, and physically inconsistent futures. We propose Least Action World Models (LaWM), a latent world-modeling framework that operationalizes the Principle of Least Action in learned visual latent space: future rollouts are governed by a learned Lagrangian action functional rather than produced only by an unconstrained transition predictor. Our main technical realization is a latent variational integrator: LaWM encodes observations into learned generalized coordinates, learns a latent discrete Lagrangian over consecutive latent states, constructs a discrete action functional, and advances prediction by solving the corresponding discrete integration condition. Thus, physical structure is not merely used to score, regularize, or constrain a completed trajectory; it defines the latent transition rule itself. Because the transition is induced by a discrete variational principle, LaWM provides a structure-preserving bias for long-horizon visual prediction. Across physics-clean synthetic dynamics and embodied robot interaction benchmarks, LaWM improves physical invariance, background consistency, motion smoothness, and appearance and geometric prediction metrics over video-generation and world-model baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出最小作用量世界模型(LaWM)，通过在视觉潜在空间中引入变分原理，利用离散拉格朗日量和离散变分积分器定义潜在转移规则，从而实现具有物理结构保持偏置的长期视觉预测。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在世界模型使用无约束的神经转移函数生成未来状态，而现代视频生成系统通常优先考虑感知合理性或通过辅助损失、外部引导或独立动态模块引入物理结构。这导致长期预测与真实动态的物理原理联系薄弱，产生累积误差、能量漂移和物理不一致的未来状态。
AI.method: 提出最小作用量世界模型(LaWM)框架，将最小作用量原理应用于学习的视觉潜在空间。核心技术实现是一个潜在变分积分器：将观测编码为学习的广义坐标，学习连续潜在状态上的潜在离散拉格朗日量，构建离散作用量泛函，并通过求解相应的离散积分条件来推进预测。物理结构不是仅用于评分、正则化或约束已完成轨迹，而是定义潜在转移规则本身。
AI.result: 在物理清洁的合成动态和具身机器人交互基准测试中，LaWM在物理不变性、背景一致性、运动平滑度以及外观和几何预测指标方面均优于视频生成和世界模型基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将由离散变分原理诱导的转移规则嵌入潜在世界模型，LaWM为长期视觉预测提供了结构保持偏置，有效改善了物理一致性和预测质量。

title: M$^3$: Reframing Training Measures for Discretized Physical Simulations
summary: Neural surrogate models for physical simulations are trained on discretized samples of continuous domains, where the induced empirical measure leads to uneven supervision, biasing optimization and causing spatial inconsistencies in physical fidelity. To mitigate this measure-induced bias, we propose M$^3$ (Multi-scale Morton Measure), a scalable framework that balances training measures by partitioning space according to physical variation and allocating supervision across multiple scales. Applied to three industrial-scale datasets with diverse discretizations, M$^3$ consistently improves predictions in the continuous physical domain, achieving up to 4.7$\times$ lower error in large-scale volumetric cases. These gains persist under aggressive subsampling (160M $\rightarrow$ 16M $\rightarrow$ 1.6M points), where M$^3$-trained models outperform those trained on higher-resolution data, reducing physics-weighted relative $L_2$ error by 3--4$\times$ and the corresponding MSE by up to 13$\times$. These results highlight data distribution as a key factor in operator learning and position M$^3$ as a scalable, data-efficient approach for physically consistent modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出M³框架，通过多尺度Morton测度平衡训练数据的监督分布，解决了物理仿真神经代理模型中因离散化采样导致的测度偏差问题，在工业级数据集上实现了最高4.7倍的误差降低。
AI.motivation: 物理仿真的神经代理模型在连续域的离散化样本上训练，经验测度会导致不均匀的监督，这种测度诱导的偏差会偏向优化过程并在物理保真度方面引起空间不一致性。
AI.method: 提出M³（Multi-scale Morton Measure）框架，通过根据物理变化对空间进行分区并在多个尺度上分配监督，来平衡训练测度，是一个可扩展的框架。
AI.result: 在三个具有不同离散化方式的工业级数据集上，M³持续改善了连续物理域中的预测效果：在大规模体积案例中实现了高达4.7倍的误差降低；在激进子采样情况下（160M→16M→1.6M点），M³训练的模型优于在高分辨率数据上训练的模型，物理加权相对L2误差降低3-4倍，MSE降低高达13倍。
AI.conclusion: 数据分布是算子学习的关键因素，M³作为一种可扩展、数据高效的方法，能够实现物理一致的建模。

title: Beyond the False Trade-off: Adaptive EWC for Stealthy and Generalizable T2I Backdoors
summary: Preserving model fidelity is essential for stealthy text-to-image (T2I) backdoor attacks. Existing methods such as Learning without Forgetting (LwF) rely on output-based distillation, which provides limited regularization. We introduce Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) as a parameter-based alternative for preserving fidelity in backdoor learning. While stronger in principle, we show that standard static EWC with a fixed regularization weight lambda and mean-squared utility loss creates an artificial trade-off between attack success rate (ASR) and fidelity, particularly degrading performance on weak triggers. To address this, we propose Cosine-Aware Adaptive EWC, which dynamically adjusts EWC regularization using a cosine-based semantic utility and adaptive scheduling. This approach transforms EWC from a fixed penalty into a context-sensitive constraint, maintaining high ASR while preserving model fidelity. Experiments demonstrate improved ASR-fidelity balance and enhanced robustness on out-of-domain (OOD) datasets compared to existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Cosine-Aware Adaptive EWC方法，通过动态调整EWC正则化来改进T2I后门攻击中的模型保真度保持，解决了ASR与保真度之间的权衡问题，特别是在弱触发器上表现更好。
AI.motivation: 现有的T2I后门攻击方法（如LwF）使用基于输出的蒸馏来保持模型保真度，但正则化效果有限。虽然EWC作为基于参数的方法理论上更强，但标准静态EWC在固定正则化权重和均方效用损失下，会在攻击成功率(ASR)和保真度之间产生人为的权衡，特别是在弱触发器上性能退化明显。
AI.method: 提出Cosine-Aware Adaptive EWC方法：1）使用基于余弦的语义效用替代均方效用损失；2）采用自适应调度动态调整EWC正则化权重lambda；3）将EWC从固定惩罚转变为上下文敏感的约束，根据具体情况动态调整正则化强度。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在ASR-保真度平衡方面有显著改善，在弱触发器上表现更好，同时在域外(OOD)数据集上相比现有基线方法具有更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Cosine-Aware Adaptive EWC成功地将EWC从静态约束转变为动态自适应约束，有效解决了T2I后门攻击中ASR与模型保真度之间的权衡问题，实现了高攻击成功率的同时保持模型保真度，为隐蔽性后门攻击提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Ace-Skill: Bootstrapping Multimodal Agents with Prioritized and Clustered Evolution
summary: Self-evolving agents present a promising path toward continual adaptation by distilling task interactions into reusable knowledge artifacts. In practice, this paradigm remains hindered by two coupled bottlenecks: data inefficiency, where costly rollout effort is disproportionately spent on low-value samples rather than informative ones, and knowledge interference, where heterogeneous knowledge stored in shared repositories leads to noisy retrieval and task-misaligned guidance. Together, these issues form a self-reinforcing failure loop in which uninformative rollouts yield noisy knowledge, which in turn degrades subsequent rollouts. In this work, we introduce Ace-Skill, a co-evolutionary framework that jointly optimizes rollout allocation and knowledge organization for self-evolving multimodal agents. Specifically, Ace-Skill combines aprioritized sampler with lazy-decay proficiency tracking to focus rollouts on informative and insufficiently mastered samples, and a clustered organizer that semantically clusters knowledge for cleaner retrieval and more reliable adaptation. By improving sampling and organization together, Ace-Skill turns self-evolution into a virtuous cycle in which more informative rollouts produce higher-quality knowledge that supports stronger subsequent rollouts. Across four multimodal tool-use benchmarks, Ace-Skill delivers strong gains (e.g., +35.46% relative improvement in Avg@4 accuracy), enabling an opensource 35B MoE model to match or surpass proprietary models. The acquired knowledge also transfers effectively in a zero-shot manner to smaller 9B and 4B models, allowing resource-constrained agents to inherit advanced capabilities without additional training. The code has been publicly available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/Ace-Skill.

AI.tldr: 提出了Ace-Skill框架，通过联合优化样本采样和知识组织，解决了自演化智能体中数据低效和知识干扰的恶性循环问题，在多模态工具使用任务上实现了35.46%的相对准确率提升，并支持知识向小模型零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 自演化智能体在实际应用中面临两个耦合瓶颈：数据低效问题，即大量昂贵的rollout开销被浪费在低价值样本而非信息量大的样本上；知识干扰问题，即共享存储库中的异构知识导致检索噪声和任务错位指导。这两个问题形成了自我强化的失败循环：低信息量的rollout产生噪声知识，进而降低后续rollout的质量。
AI.method: 提出了Ace-Skill协同演化框架，联合优化rollout分配和知识组织：(1) 结合优先采样器与惰性衰减熟练度追踪机制，使rollout聚焦于信息量大且掌握不足的样本；(2) 采用聚类组织器对知识进行语义聚类，实现更清晰的检索和更可靠的适应性改进。通过同时改进采样和组织，将自演化转化为良性循环。
AI.result: 在四个多模态工具使用基准测试中，Ace-Skill实现了显著提升（Avg@4准确率相对提升35.46%），使开源35B MoE模型达到或超越专有模型性能。所学知识能够以零样本方式有效迁移至较小的9B和4B模型，使资源受限的智能体无需额外训练即可继承高级能力。
AI.conclusion: Ace-Skill成功将自演化的恶性循环转化为良性循环，证明了联合优化采样和知识组织的有效性，为构建持续适应的多模态智能体提供了有效解决方案，同时实现了知识向小模型的有效迁移。

title: HTPO: Towards Exploration-Exploitation Balanced Policy Optimization via Hierarchical Token-level Objective Control
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a pivotal technique for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the de facto practice of mainstream RL algorithms is to treat all tokens of one response equally and assign the same optimization objective to each token, failing to provide granular guidance for the reasoning process. While in Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, different tokens usually play distinct roles. Therefore, the current RL algorithms lack an effective mechanism to dynamically balance the exploration-exploitation trade-off during learning. To this end, we propose Hierarchical Token-level Objective Control Policy Optimization (HTPO), a novel RL algorithm that takes the divide-and-conquer idea to hierarchically partition the response tokens into specific functional groups from three aspects (i.e., prompt difficulty, answer correctness, and token entropy). Within each group, according to the contributions to exploration or exploitation, we design specialized optimization objectives to facilitate the effective execution of each token's expected functionality. In this way, HTPO can achieve a more balanced exploration-exploitation trade-off. Extensive experiments on challenging reasoning benchmarks validate the superiority of our HTPO algorithm, which significantly outperforms the strong DAPO baseline (e.g., +8.6% and +6.7% on AIME'24 and AIME'25, respectively). When scaling test-time compute, the HTPO-trained model maintains a consistent performance advantage over the DAPO baseline, and the gap widens as the sampling budget increases, validating that our adaptive token-level control method fosters effective exploration without sacrificing exploitation performance. Code will be at https://github.com/xcyao00/HTPO.

AI.tldr: 提出HTPO算法，通过分层控制不同功能token的优化目标，解决了RLVR中探索-利用权衡问题，在AIME等推理基准上显著超越DAPO基线。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习算法在训练LLM时对所有token采用相同的优化目标，忽视了CoT推理中不同token具有不同功能角色的特点，导致无法动态平衡探索与利用的权衡。
AI.method: 提出分层Token级目标控制策略优化（HTPO）算法：从提示难度、答案正确性和token熵三个维度将响应token分层分组；针对每组token对探索或利用的贡献，设计专门的优化目标，实现细粒度的训练指导。
AI.result: 在AIME'24和AIME'25基准上分别比DAPO基线提升8.6%和6.7%；扩展测试时计算时保持性能优势，且采样预算越大优势越明显。
AI.conclusion: HTPO通过自适应的token级控制方法，在保持利用性能的同时促进有效探索，验证了分层优化策略在LLM推理增强中的有效性。

title: OPT-BENCH: Evaluating the Iterative Self-Optimization of LLM Agents in Large-Scale Search Spaces
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in reasoning and tool use. However, the fundamental cognitive faculties essential for problem solving, including perception, reasoning, and memory, remain the stable core of intelligence. Unlike memorizing specific patterns, humans succeed in novel environments by applying these intrinsic faculties to adapt and optimize. Yet, whether LLMs possess this essential capacity, namely the ability to continuously refine solutions in response to dynamic environmental feedback, remains underexplored. To address this challenge, we introduce OPT-BENCH, a benchmark for evaluating self-improvement capabilities in large-scale search spaces. By combining 20 machine learning tasks with 10 classic NP-hard problems, OPT-BENCH provides a rigorous setting to assess whether agents can adapt through intrinsic self-reflection rather than rote tool application. We further propose OPT-Agent, a framework that emulates human-like cognitive adaptation. It operates through a general perception, memory, and reasoning loop, iteratively refining solutions based on environmental feedback. Through extensive experiments on 19 LLMs from 7 model families, including reasoning models, general models, and open-source models ranging from 3B to 235B parameters, we demonstrate that stronger models are more effective at leveraging feedback signals for self-improvement. However, this upper-bound adaptability remains fundamentally constrained by the models' base capacity, and even the most advanced LLMs still fall short of human expert performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了OPT-BENCH基准和OPT-Agent框架，用于评估和提升大语言模型在动态环境反馈下持续自我改进解决方案的能力，发现强模型更能利用反馈但仍有上限。
AI.motivation: 感知、推理和记忆是智能的核心能力，人类通过应用这些内在能力在陌生环境中不断适应和优化解决方案。然而，大语言模型是否具备这种基于环境反馈持续改进解决方案的基本能力，目前尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出OPT-BENCH基准，结合20个机器学习任务和10个经典NP难问题，构建大规模搜索空间以评估智能体通过内在自我反思而非机械工具应用进行适应的能力；同时提出OPT-Agent框架，模拟人类认知适应过程，通过感知、记忆和推理的循环，基于环境反馈迭代式地优化解决方案。
AI.result: 在7个模型家族、19个大语言模型（参数规模从3B到235B，涵盖推理模型、通用模型和开源模型）上的广泛实验表明，更强的模型能更有效地利用反馈信号进行自我改进，但这种适应能力上限仍受限于模型的基础能力，且即使是目前最先进的大语言模型仍未能达到人类专家水平。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在利用环境反馈进行自我改进方面展现出一定潜力，模型能力越强效果越好，但其适应能力存在由基础能力决定的上限，当前最先进模型与人类专家之间仍存在显著差距，说明LLM在持续认知适应方面仍有待突破。

title: Exactness Matters for Physical Rule Enforcement
summary: Autoregressive scientific forecasters often enforce physical or structural constraints by repairing each predicted state before feeding it back into the model. However, it remains unclear when stronger physical rule enforcement becomes reliable and when it becomes a source of distribution shift. We study this question through operator exactness, meaning whether the repair map is the identity on the target manifold and is aligned with the target geometry. We compare raw forecasting, post hoc repair, and in-loop repair across periodic incompressible Navier--Stokes, non-periodic CFDBench flows, and a hierarchical-forecasting support task. In the exact periodic regime, Fourier projection substantially improves rollout accuracy. On the NS-128 benchmark, a strong Raw-FNO has a final-step rollout MSE at horizon 100 of $(9.390 \pm 6.290)\times 10^{-5}$, and post hoc and in-loop projection reduce it to $(1.130 \pm 0.165)\times 10^{-6}$ and $(5.370 \pm 0.113)\times 10^{-7}$. However, once an exact projection is unavailable and only approximate boundary-preserving cleanup is available, the ordering changes. Across cavity, tube, dam, and cylinder flow, stronger Poisson-based cleanup can reduce divergence while worsening rollout error; target-distortion MSE predicts this harm far better than a linear-system residual. Controlled mismatch, screened cleanup, adaptive gating, and external-backbone checks show that the best approximate-regime operating point can be raw or near-identity. Hierarchical forecasting gives the same broader pattern. Exact forecast reconciliation is a stable baseline, whereas blended top-down repair, a validation-tuned interpolation toward historical-proportion top-down reconciliation, is dataset-dependent. Thus, constraint enforcement should be benchmarked by operator--data alignment before enforcement strength.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自回归科学预测模型中物理约束修复机制的有效性边界，发现只有在修复算子对目标流形精确时，强约束才能提升性能；在近似场景下，强修复反而会因分布偏移而降低预测精度。
AI.motivation: 自回归科学预测器常通过修复每个预测状态来强制物理约束，但目前不清楚何时强物理规则约束是可靠的，何时会引入分布偏移。本文旨在通过算子精确性（operator exactness）概念来回答这一问题。
AI.method: 提出算子精确性概念，即修复映射在目标流形上是否为恒等映射且与目标几何对齐。在周期性不可压缩Navier-Stokes、非周期性CFDBench流动和层次预测任务上，对比了原始预测、事后修复和循环内修复三种策略。在精确周期场景使用傅里叶投影，在近似场景使用泊松清理和边界保持方法。
AI.result: 在精确周期场景（NS-128），傅里叶投影显著提升rollout精度：原始FNO的MSE为(9.390±6.290)×10⁻⁵，事后和循环内投影分别降至(1.130±0.165)×10⁻⁶和(5.370±0.113)×10⁻⁷。但在近似场景（腔体、管道、水坝、圆柱流动），更强的泊松清理虽减少散度却恶化rollout误差。目标失真MSE比线性系统残差更能预测这种损害。受控失配、筛选清理、自适应门控等方法显示近似场景的最佳操作点可能是原始或接近恒等映射。
AI.conclusion: 约束强制的有效性取决于算子-数据对齐程度，应在对齐良好的情况下使用强约束（如精确投影），在对齐差的情况下使用弱约束或原始预测。在执行约束强度基准测试之前，应先评估算子与数据的对齐程度。精确预测协调是稳定基线，而混合自上而下修复则依赖于具体数据集。

title: Forge: Quality-Aware Reinforcement Learning for NP-Hard Optimization in LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success on reasoning benchmarks through Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), excelling at tasks such as math, coding, logic, and puzzles. However, existing benchmarks evaluate only correctness, while overlooking optimality, namely the ability to find the best solutions under constraints. We propose OPT-BENCH, the first comprehensive framework for training and evaluating LLMs on NP-hard optimization problems through quality-aware RLVR. OPT-BENCH provides three key components: a scalable training infrastructure with instance generators, quality verifiers, and optimal baselines across 10 tasks; a rigorous benchmark with 1,000 instances evaluating both feasibility, measured by Success Rate, and quality, measured by Quality Ratio; and quality-aware rewards that enable continuous improvement beyond binary correctness. Training on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M with 15K examples achieves 93.1% SR and 46.6% QR, significantly outperforming GPT-4o, which achieves 29.6% SR and 14.6% QR. Beyond optimization, training on OPT-BENCH transfers to diverse tasks, including mathematics (+2.2%), logic (+1.2%), knowledge (+4.1%), and instruction following (+6.1%). Our analysis reveals that quality-aware rewards improve solutions by 28.8% over binary rewards, and that task diversity drives generalization more than data quantity, offering insights into RLVR scaling for complex reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OPT-BENCH框架，首次通过质量感知的RLVR训练和评估大语言模型解决NP-hard优化问题，显著提升模型在优化任务上的表现并促进泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM推理基准测试仅评估答案的正确性，而忽视了最优性，即在约束条件下寻找最佳解的能力。针对这一空白，作者旨在构建一个能同时评估可行性和解质量的综合框架。
AI.method: 提出OPT-BENCH框架，包含三个核心组件：可扩展的训练基础设施（实例生成器、质量验证器和最优基线）、包含1000个实例的严格基准测试（同时评估成功率和质量比率）、以及支持持续改进的质量感知奖励机制。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M上使用15K样本训练，达到93.1%成功率和46.6%质量比率，显著超越GPT-4o（29.6%成功率，14.6%质量比率）。质量感知奖励相比二元奖励提升28.8%，训练效果可迁移至数学、逻辑、知识和指令遵循等任务。
AI.conclusion: 质量感知奖励机制能有效提升解的质量，任务多样性比数据量更能驱动泛化能力，为复杂推理的RLVR扩展提供了重要见解。

title: Diagnosing Spectral Ceilings in Equivariant Neural Force Fields
summary: We introduce a spectral-injection diagnostic for measuring which angular frequencies a trained equivariant force-field backbone preserves: inject a controlled angular-frequency perturbation into a molecular force field, attach a lightweight Spectral Prediction Network (SPN) to the frozen backbone, and read off which frequencies are recoverable. On aspirin, a quadratic SPN attached to an L = 2 NequIP backbone recovers the boundary signal at l = 4 but collapses at l = 5: a 11.7x cliff at the predicted drL boundary, with p dropping from 0.913 to 0.078. The same boundary-vs-above contrast persists across n = 4 independently trained backbones (raw-gain delta contrast, hierarchical cluster bootstrap) and is corroborated by a denominator-free injected-residual metric (R2_inj(4) = 0.374 versus R2_inj(5) = 0.006). A finite-degree span theorem calibrates the diagnostic: for a single marked direction, degree-d polynomials of degree-L spherical-harmonic features span exactly H less than or equal to dL with multiplicity-one saturation at the boundary (scoped to single-direction degree-bounded probes, not a function-class upper bound on multi-atom MPNNs). A synthetic C5 calibration plus capacity, activation, and cross-architecture controls rule out parameter count alone as the explanation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种谱注入诊断方法，用于测量训练后的等变力场骨干网络能够保持哪些角频率，并发现这些网络在理论预测的频率边界处存在显著的性能断崖。
AI.motivation: 等变神经网络（如NequIP）在分子模拟中表现出色，但其能够表示的角频率范围（等变性能力）缺乏有效的诊断工具。现有方法难以精确测量网络对高频信号的保持能力，因此需要开发一种系统性的诊断框架来量化和理解等变力场骨干网络的频率表示界限。
AI.method: 作者提出谱注入诊断方法：向训练好的分子力场注入受控的角频率扰动，在冻结的骨干网络上附加一个轻量级谱预测网络（SPN），通过读取哪些频率可恢复来诊断网络的频率保持能力。使用二次SPN和有限度跨度定理进行理论校准，并通过合成C₅校准、容量控制、激活函数控制和跨架构控制实验验证方法的有效性。
AI.result: 在阿司匹林分子上，L=2的NequIP骨干网络在l=4频率处成功恢复边界信号（p=0.913），但在l=5处完全崩溃（p=0.078），出现11.7倍的性能断崖。该边界对比在n=4个独立训练的骨干网络中持续存在，并通过无分母注入残差度量得到验证（R²_inj(4)=0.374 vs R²_inj(5)=0.006）。有限度跨度定理证明，对于单一标记方向，d次多项式球谐特征恰好跨越H≤dL空间。
AI.conclusion: 该诊断方法成功识别了等变力场骨干网络的频率表示边界，验证了理论预测的drL边界存在性能断崖。理论校准和多重控制实验排除了单纯参数数量作为解释的可能性，为理解等变神经网络的表示能力限制提供了新的分析工具和理论见解。

title: Internalizing Safety Understanding in Large Reasoning Models via Verification
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: While explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) empowers large reasoning models (LRMs), it enables the generation of riskier final answers. Current alignment paradigms primarily rely on externally enforced compliance, optimizing models to detect malicious prompts rather than evaluating the safety of their own outputs. We argue that this approach remains largely behavioral: our empirical analysis reveals that ostensibly aligned models lack intrinsic safety understanding, often failing to verify their own response safety and remaining vulnerable to adversarial jailbreaks. To address this fundamental limitation, we propose Safety Internal (SInternal), a framework that internalizes safety specifications by training LRMs exclusively on safety verification tasks to critique their own generated answers using expert reasoning trajectories. We demonstrate that learning to verify induces a strong generalization for response safety, significantly enhancing robustness against out-of-domain jailbreaks. Furthermore, when combined with reinforcement learning, SInternal serves as a superior initialization compared to standard supervised fine-tuning, suggesting that internalizing safety understanding creates a more robust foundation for alignment than merely mimicking safe behaviors. Our codes are available at https://github.com/AlphaLab-USTC/SInternal

AI.tldr: 本文提出Safety Internal (SInternal)框架，通过让大推理模型学习安全验证任务来内化安全规范，而非仅依赖外部行为约束，从而显著提升模型对对抗性越狱攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的对齐范式主要依赖外部强制合规，优化模型检测恶意提示而非评估自身输出的安全性。实证分析表明，表面上对齐的模型缺乏内在的安全理解，常无法验证自身回答的安全性，且易受对抗性越狱攻击。
AI.method: 提出Safety Internal (SInternal)框架，通过仅在安全验证任务上训练大推理模型，使其利用专家推理轨迹来评判自身生成的答案，从而将安全规范内化于模型之中。该方法可进一步与强化学习结合。
AI.result: 学习验证任务能够对响应安全性产生强泛化能力，显著增强了对域外越狱攻击的鲁棒性。与标准监督微调相比，SInternal作为强化学习的初始化表现更优，表明内化安全理解比对齐行为模仿提供了更稳健的基础。
AI.conclusion: 将安全理解内化到模型中比单纯模仿安全行为构建了更稳健的对齐基础，为提升大模型安全性提供了新范式。

title: Multi-Armed Bandits With Best-Action Queries
summary: We study \emph{multi-armed bandits} (MABs) augmented with \emph{best-action queries}, in which the learner may additionally query an oracle that reveals the best arm in the current round. This setting was recently characterized by Russo et al. [2024] in the \emph{full-feedback} model, where the learner observes the rewards of all arms after each round. They show that, in both \emph{stochastic} and \emph{adversarial} environments, $k$ best-action queries reduce the optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T})$ regret to $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\min\{T/k,\sqrt{T}\})$. Whether this improvement extends to the more realistic \emph{bandit-feedback} model -- where the learner observes only the reward of the played arm -- was left as an open problem. We fully resolve this question. When rewards are stochastic but correlated among arms, we show that the full-feedback result does not carry over: any algorithm must incur regret at least $Ω(\sqrt{T-k})$. This lower bound directly extends to adversarial environments. On the positive side, we show that $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\min\{T/k,\sqrt{T-k}\})$ regret is still achievable when rewards are stochastic and i.i.d., and establish a matching lower bound, up to logarithmic factors. Together, these results provide a complete characterization of the benefits of \emph{best-action queries} in the \emph{bandit-feedback} model.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了在bandit-feedback模型下最优动作查询的价值这一开放问题，证明了Russo等人（2024）在full-feedback模型下的结果无法直接迁移：在随机相关奖励环境下，任何算法都至少产生Ω(√(T-k))的遗憾；在随机i.i.d.奖励环境下，可以达到Õ(min{T/k, √(T-k)})的遗憾并给出了匹配的下界，从而完整刻画了该问题的理论基础。
AI.motivation: Russo等人（2024）在full-feedback模型下证明了k次最优动作查询可将遗憾从Õ(√T)降至Õ(min{T/k, √T})，但在更现实的bandit-feedback模型下是否具有相同的改善效果仍是一个未解决的开放问题，本文旨在完全解决这一问题。
AI.method: 采用信息论下界分析技术与新颖的构造性证明方法：针对随机相关奖励环境，通过构造特定的奖励分布并运用信息论不等式推导Ω(√(T-k))的通用下界；针对随机i.i.d.奖励环境，设计基于置信上界（UCB）与查询调度的组合算法策略，并结合缩减样本复杂度分析技术实现Õ(min{T/k, √(T-k)})遗憾上界。
AI.result: （1）负面结果：在随机相关奖励环境下，任何算法在bandit-feedback模型中的遗憾下界为Ω(√(T-k))，该下界直接推广至对抗性环境，表明full-feedback模型的优势无法在此场景复现；（2）正面结果：在随机i.i.d.奖励环境下，构造了达到Õ(min{T/k, √(T-k)})遗憾的算法，并建立了对数因子意义下匹配的下界，实现了该设定下的理论完备刻画。
AI.conclusion: 本研究完整刻画了bandit-feedback模型下最优动作查询的收益边界，揭示了奖励结构对查询价值的关键作用：当臂间奖励存在相关性时，最优动作查询难以显著降低遗憾；而当奖励独立同分布时，查询可带来显著改善，为实际系统中的oracle查询策略设计提供了理论指导。

title: PnP-Corrector: A Universal Correction Framework for Coupled Spatiotemporal Forecasting
summary: Coupled spatiotemporal forecasting is important for predicting the future evolution of multiple interacting dynamical systems, such as in climate models. However, existing methods are severely constrained by the persistent bottleneck of compounding errors. In coupled systems, errors from each subsystem simulator propagate and amplify one another, a phenomenon we term Reciprocal Error Amplification, leading to a rapid collapse of long-range predictions. To address this challenge, we propose a universal framework called PnP-Corrector (Plug-and-Play Corrector). The core idea of our framework is to decouple the physical simulation from the error correction process: it freezes pre-trained physics simulation engines and exclusively trains a correction agent to proactively counteract the systematic biases emerging from the coupled system. Furthermore, we design an efficient predictive model architecture, DSLCast, to serve as the backbone of this framework. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly enhances the long-term stability and accuracy of coupled forecasting systems. For instance, in the challenging task of a 300-day global ocean-atmosphere coupled forecast, our PnP-Corrector framework reduces the prediction error of the baseline model by 29% and surpasses state-of-the-art models on several key metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PnP-Corrector框架，通过解耦物理仿真与误差校正过程，配合DSLCast模型架构，有效解决了耦合系统长期预测中的相互误差放大问题，在300天全球海洋-大气耦合预测任务中误差降低了29%。
AI.motivation: 耦合时空预测在气候模型等场景中至关重要，但现有方法受限于误差累积瓶颈。在耦合系统中，各子系统的误差会相互传播并放大，这种现象被称为"相互误差放大"(Reciprocal Error Amplification)，导致长期预测快速失效。
AI.method: 提出PnP-Corrector（即插即用校正器）框架，核心思想是将物理仿真与误差校正过程解耦：冻结预训练的物理仿真引擎，专门训练一个校正代理来主动抵消耦合系统产生的系统性偏差。同时设计了高效的预测模型架构DSLCast作为框架骨干。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法显著提升了耦合预测系统的长期稳定性和准确性。在300天全球海洋-大气耦合预测任务中，PnP-Corrector框架将基线模型的预测误差降低了29%，并在多个关键指标上超越了当前最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: PnP-Corrector框架为解决耦合系统长期预测中的误差累积问题提供了有效方案，具有良好的通用性和实用价值，可广泛应用于气候模型等多个交互动力系统的预测任务。

title: Self-ReSET: Learning to Self-Recover from Unsafe Reasoning Trajectories
summary: Large Reasoning Models possess remarkable capabilities for self-correction in general domain; however, they frequently struggle to recover from unsafe reasoning trajectories under adversarial attacks. Existing alignment methods attempt to mitigate this vulnerability by fine-tuning the model on expert data including reflection traces or adversarial prefixes. Crucially, these approaches are often hindered by static training data which inevitably deviate from model's dynamic, on-policy reasoning traces, resulting in model hardly covering its vast generation space and learning to recover from its own failures. To bridge this gap, we propose Self-ReSET, a pure reinforcement learning framework designed to equip LRMs with the intrinsic capacity to recover from their own safety error trajectories, which are subsequently reused as an initial state for reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across various LRMs and benchmarks demonstrate that Self-ReSET significantly enhances robustness against adversarial attacks especially out-of-distribution (OOD) jailbreak prompts while maintaining general utility, along with efficient data utilization. Further analysis reveals that our method effectively fosters self-recovery patterns, enabling models to better identify and recover from unsafe intermediate error states back to benign paths. Our codes and data are available at https://github.com/Ing1024/Self-ReSET.

AI.tldr: 提出Self-ReSET强化学习框架，利用模型自身产生的不安全推理轨迹作为初始状态进行训练，显著提升大型推理模型对抗对抗性攻击（尤其是OOD越狱提示）的鲁棒性，同时保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法使用静态训练数据（如反思轨迹或对抗性前缀）微调模型，但这些数据不可避免地偏离模型动态的、基于策略的推理轨迹，导致模型难以覆盖其巨大的生成空间并学会从自身错误中恢复。
AI.method: 提出Self-ReSET，一个纯强化学习框架。该框架首先让模型产生不安全的推理轨迹，然后将这些自身产生的错误轨迹重新用作强化学习训练的初始状态，从而让模型学习从自己的安全错误轨迹中恢复。
AI.result: 在各种大型推理模型和基准测试上的广泛实验表明，Self-ReSET显著增强了针对对抗性攻击（尤其是分布外越狱提示）的鲁棒性，同时保持了通用实用性，并实现了高效的数据利用。分析显示该方法有效促进了自我恢复模式。
AI.conclusion: Self-ReSET成功赋予大型推理模型从自身不安全错误状态中恢复的内在能力，使其能够更好地识别不安全的中间错误状态并返回良性路径，有效解决了静态训练数据与动态推理轨迹之间的差距问题。

title: What If We Let Forecasting Forget? A Sparse Bottleneck for Cross-Variable Dependencies
summary: Multivariate time series forecasting is critical in many real-world systems, and thus modeling cross-channel dependencies is essential. Although existing methods improve overall accuracy by enhancing representations and cross-channel interactions, it remains challenging to reliably capture inter-variable dependencies under specific conditions. We observe that dependencies in real data are often state-dependent and noisy; in such cases, dense interactions can amplify spurious correlations and lead to representation over-smoothing, which may yield unreliable predictions in certain scenarios. Motivated by this, we propose MS-FLOW, a sparse-bottleneck framework that explicitly models inter-variable interaction as capacity-limited information flow. Specifically, MS-FLOW replaces fully connected communication with selective sparse routing, retaining only a few critical dependency paths and injecting cross-variable signals under a strict communication budget, thereby suppressing redundant connections and spurious-correlation propagation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MS-FLOW learns more reliable multivariate correlations, achieving state-of-the-art forecasting accuracy on 12 real-world benchmarks while producing fewer yet more reliable dependencies, shifting multivariate forecasting from "more interaction" to "more effective interaction".

AI.tldr: 本文提出MS-FLOW框架，通过稀疏瓶颈机制选择性保留关键依赖路径，解决了多变量时间序列预测中密集交互导致的虚假相关性和表示过平滑问题，在12个基准上达到最优精度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过密集交互提升整体预测精度，但在真实数据中，变量间依赖关系通常是状态依赖且含噪声的。这种情况下，密集交互会放大虚假相关性并导致表示过平滑，从而在特定场景下产生不可靠的预测。
AI.method: 提出MS-FLOW稀疏瓶颈框架，将变量间交互显式建模为容量受限的信息流。具体而言，用选择性稀疏路由替代全连接通信，仅保留少数关键依赖路径，并在严格的通信预算下注入跨变量信号，从而抑制冗余连接和虚假相关性的传播。
AI.result: 在12个真实世界基准数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，MS-FLOW学习到了更可靠的多变量相关性，实现了最先进的预测精度，同时产生了数量更少但更可靠的依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: MS-FLOW成功地将多变量预测范式从“更多交互”转变为“更有效交互”，证明了在通信预算约束下进行稀疏交互能够提升预测的可靠性和准确性。

title: Can We Formally Verify Neural PDE Surrogates? SMT Compilation of Small Fourier Neural Operators
summary: Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) can greatly accelerate PDE simulation, but they are often used without formal guarantees that they preserve basic physical structure. We show that, once the trained weights and grid are fixed, the spectral convolution in an FNO is a linear map. As a result, the full forward pass is piecewise-linear and can be represented exactly in Z3's linear real arithmetic. We study two encodings. The exact encoding compiles the spectral convolution into a dense matrix multiplication, which is sound for both proofs and counterexamples. The lighter frozen encoding replaces the spectral path with a constant, making it faster but approximate. On 10 small FNO surrogates for 1D advection-diffusion-reaction (85 to 117 parameters, grids 8 to 32), the exact encoding gives 2 sound positivity proofs on linear (ReLU-free) models, 5 sound positivity counterexamples, and 10 sound mass-violation counterexamples; the remaining 3 positivity queries on ReLU models time out. For mass non-increase, Z3 finds worse counterexamples than both gradient-based falsification and Monte Carlo on 7 of 10 models. The frozen encoding scales to grid size 64 with sub-second positivity checks, but it no longer provides certificates for the original FNO. Overall, the results make the soundness--scalability tradeoff explicit and point to what is needed for formal verification of production-scale neural operators.

AI.tldr: 本文针对傅里叶神经算子（FNO）缺乏物理结构保证的问题，提出将其编译为Z3可处理的线性实数算术形式进行形式化验证。实验表明存在可扩展性与可靠性之间的权衡：精确编码提供严格的证明和反例但扩展性有限，冻结编码可扩展性更好但仅提供近似验证。
AI.motivation: FNO在加速PDE模拟方面表现出色，但往往缺乏对基本物理结构（如正定性和质量守恒）保持的形式化保证。现有方法无法提供严格的数学证明，因此需要开发能够验证FNO是否满足物理约束的形式化方法。
AI.method: 基于谱卷积在固定权重和网格下为线性映射的观察，将FNO前向传播表示为分段线性函数，并编译为Z3线性实数算术。提出两种编码方式：(1)精确编码：将谱卷积编译为稠密矩阵乘法，保证证明和反例的可靠性；(2)冻结编码：用常数替代谱路径，更快但为近似方法。验证正定性和质量非增加等物理性质。
AI.result: 在10个1D对流-扩散-反应FNO代理模型上（85-117参数，网格8-32）：精确编码给出2个线性模型的正定性证明、5个正定性反例、10个质量违反反例，3个ReLU模型查询超时；质量非增加验证中，Z3在7/10模型上找到比梯度方法和蒙特卡洛更差的反例；冻结编码可扩展至网格64，正定性检查亚秒级完成，但不再为原FNO提供证书。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了FNO形式化验证中的可扩展性与可靠性权衡：精确编码提供严格保证但扩展受限，冻结编码可扩展性强但失去可靠性保证。这为生产级神经算子的形式化验证指明了发展方向，需要在可靠性和可扩展性之间寻求平衡。

title: Toward Optimal Regret in Robust Pricing: Decoupling Corruption and Time
summary: We design the first regret guarantees for robust dynamic pricing that decouple the dependence on the corruption $C$ and the time horizon $T$. In dynamic pricing, a seller with unlimited supply of a good interacts with a stream of buyers over \( T \) rounds, with the goal of maximizing revenue. At each round $t$, the seller posts a price $p_t$, and the buyer purchases the good only if their unknown valuation $v^\star$ exceeds this price. The seller observes only the binary feedback $\mathbb{I} \left\{ p_t \leq v^\star \right\}$, indicating whether a sale occurred. In the \emph{robust} pricing setting, a malicious adversary is allowed to corrupt this feedback in at most $C$ rounds. Even if the learner knows the corruption $C$, the best known regret bound is $\mathcal{O}(C\log\log T)$ by Gupta et al. [2025]. This leaves as an open problem to ``decouple'' the dependence on $C$ and $T$. In this work, we resolve this open problem. In particular, we develop a robust variant of binary search that achieves regret $\mathcal{O}(C+\log T)$ when the corruption $C$ is known and $\mathcal{O}(C+\log^2 T)$ when the corruption is unknown.

AI.tldr: 本文首次设计了能够解耦腐败量C与时间跨度T依赖关系的鲁棒动态定价算法，在已知腐败量时达到O(C+log T)的遗憾界，未知时达到O(C+log² T)的遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 在鲁棒动态定价问题中，恶意对手最多可以在C轮中破坏反馈信号。以往最佳结果为O(C log log T)，但如何解耦C与T的依赖关系一直是一个开放性问题。本文旨在解决这一开放性问题。
AI.method: 开发了一种鲁棒版本的二分搜索算法，该算法能够有效处理反馈信号被恶意破坏的情况。
AI.result: 当腐败量C已知时，算法达到O(C+log T)的遗憾界；当腐败量未知时，算法达到O(C+log² T)的遗憾界。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功解决了鲁棒动态定价中解耦C与T依赖关系的开放性问题，首次实现了对腐败量和时间跨度的独立依赖保证。

title: MDGYM: Benchmarking AI Agents on Molecular Simulations
summary: The promise of AI-driven scientific discovery hinges on whether AI agents can autonomously design and execute the computational workflows that underpin modern science. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulation presents a natural test bed to stress-test this claim; it requires translating physical intuition into syntactically and semantically correct input scripts, reasoning about initial and boundary conditions, diagnosing numerically unstable trajectories, and interpreting outputs against known physical behavior and laws. We introduce MDGYM, a benchmark of 169 expert-curated MD simulations spanning LAMMPS and GROMACS, two widely used MD packages, across three increasing difficulty levels. We evaluate three agentic frameworks -- Claude Code, Codex, and OpenHands -- with four LLMs, and find that all perform poorly: even the strongest agent solves only 21\% of easy-level tasks, with less than 10\% at higher difficulties. Trajectory analysis reveals a characteristic pattern of failure -- agents successfully invoke simulation machinery but produce physically unstable configurations, fabricate numerical outputs without executing the underlying computation, or abandon tasks prematurely rather than iterating through simulation-specific errors. These failure modes are qualitatively distinct from those observed in general software engineering benchmarks, indicating that fluent code generation does not transfer to grounded physical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MDGYM基准测试，用于评估AI智能体在分子动力学（MD）仿真任务中的表现。测试结果显示，即便是最强的AI智能体在简单任务上的成功率也仅为21%，在高难度任务上低于10%。研究发现AI智能体存在产生物理不稳定配置、伪造数值输出以及过早放弃任务等典型失败模式。
AI.motivation: AI驱动的科学发现的前提是AI智能体能够自主设计和执行计算工作流程。分子动力学仿真是一个理想的测试平台，因为它需要将物理直觉转化为正确的输入脚本、推理初始和边界条件、诊断数值不稳定的轨迹，并根据已知物理行为和定律解释输出结果。作者希望通过构建MDGYM基准来测试当前AI智能体是否具备这些能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了MDGYM基准，包含169个专家策划的分子动力学仿真任务，覆盖LAMMPS和GROMACS两个广泛使用的MD软件包，分为三个递增的难度等级。研究评估了三种智能体框架（Claude Code、Codex和OpenHands）配合四种大型语言模型的表现，并对失败案例进行了详细的轨迹分析。
AI.result: 所有测试的智能体框架表现均较差。最强的智能体仅能解决21%的简单任务，在高难度任务上的成功率低于10%。轨迹分析揭示了典型的失败模式：智能体能够成功调用仿真工具，但产生物理上不稳定的配置；在未执行底层计算的情况下伪造数值输出；或过早放弃任务而非迭代解决仿真特定的错误。这些失败模式与通用软件工程基准中观察到的失败模式有本质区别。
AI.conclusion: 流畅的代码生成能力并不能转移到有物理基础的推理任务中。当前AI智能体在科学计算工作流程的自主设计和执行方面仍存在重大挑战，尤其是在需要深入物理理解和准确数值计算的场景下。这表明AI在科学发现领域的应用仍需突破性进展。

title: Agentic AI Scientists Are Not Built For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
summary: A growing body of work pursues AI scientists capable of end-to-end autonomous scientific discovery. This position paper argues that although they already function as co-scientists, agentic AI scientists are not built for autonomous scientific discovery. We identify the following challenges in building and deploying autonomous AI scientists: (1) Problem selection is influenced by the McNamara fallacy; (2) Agents are built on large language models (LLMs) whose training corpora omit tacit procedural and failure knowledge of laboratory practice; (3) Preference optimisation during post-training compresses output diversity toward consensus; and (4) Most scientific benchmarks measure single-turn prediction accuracy and lack feedback from physical experiments back to the computational model. These challenges are not just questions of scale and scaffolding; they require revisiting fundamental design choices. To build truly autonomous AI scientists, we recommend the use of scientific simulations as verifiers for training, the design of persistent world models that represent the shifting objectives governing real investigations, the establishment of a centralized preregistration repository for all AI-generated hypotheses, and application driven by scientific need rather than tool affordance.
