Furthermore, the framework naturally extends to in-context learning within a sandboxed environment, enabling agents not only to tune and debug generated constraint handlers on real instances, but also to explore global constraint patterns in MIP problems and discover novel propagation strategies not yet implemented in SCIP. This framework allows us to systematically distinguish meaningful algorithmic improvements from low-value or overly costly candidates: the novel propagation methods successfully solved five additional instances within the explored benchmark. Overall, this framework demonstrates that LLM agents can autonomously navigate the complex MIP research loop, paving the way for a more automated solver development process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于LLM智能体的MIP研究框架，通过自动生成、验证和评估SCIP求解器插件，成功发现了新的传播策略并额外解决了5个基准实例。
AI.motivation: 混合整数规划（MIP）研究需要大量的实现、调试、调优和大规模基准测试工作，传统的研究反馈循环周期长、成本高。作者希望缩短这一反馈循环，加速MIP算法的研究与开发。
AI.method: 提出一个将LLM智能体嵌入到求解器感知框架中的方法，用于自动生成、验证和评估开源求解器SCIP的插件。重点研究MIP形式的语义提升到全局约束，以及自动构建仅传播的SCIP约束处理器，并在沙盒环境中支持上下文学习。
AI.result: 在MIPLIB 2017基准测试集上，框架成功从约束规划中恢复全局约束结构，生成可执行的约束检测器和传播约束处理器，并发现了SCIP中尚未实现的新型传播策略，成功额外解决了5个实例。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了LLM智能体能够自主导航复杂的MIP研究循环，系统地区分有意义的算法改进和低价值候选项，为更自动化的求解器开发流程铺平了道路。

title: P-Flow: Proxy-gradient Flows for Linear Inverse Problems
summary: Generative models based on flow matching have emerged as a powerful paradigm for inverse problems, offering straighter trajectories and faster sampling compared to diffusion models. However, existing approaches often necessitate differentiating through unrolled paths, leading to numerical instability and prohibitive computational overhead. To address this, we propose P-Flow, a framework that stabilizes the reconstruction process by leveraging a proxy gradient to update the source point. This approach effectively circumvents the numerical instability and memory overhead of long-chain differentiation. To ensure consistency with the prior distribution, we employ a Gaussian spherical projection motivated by the concentration of measure phenomenon in high-dimensional spaces. We further provide a theoretical analysis for P-Flow based on Bayesian theory and Lipschitz continuity. Experiments across diverse restoration tasks demonstrate that P-Flow delivers competitive performance, especially under extreme degradations such as severely ill-posed conditions and high measurement noise.

AI.tldr: 提出P-Flow框架，通过代理梯度更新源点解决了Flow Matching模型在逆问题中存在的数值不稳定和计算开销大的问题，在极端退化条件下表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于Flow Matching的生成模型在解决逆问题时，需要对展开路径进行微分，这导致了数值不稳定性和巨大的计算开销，限制了其实际应用。
AI.method: 提出P-Flow框架，利用代理梯度更新源点以避免长链微分带来的问题；基于高维空间测度集中现象采用高斯球面投影确保与先验分布的一致性；并基于贝叶斯理论和Lipschitz连续性提供了理论分析。
AI.result: 在多种图像复原任务上的实验表明，P-Flow取得了具有竞争力的性能，特别是在严重不适定条件和测量噪声高等极端退化场景下表现更为突出。
AI.conclusion: P-Flow成功解决了Flow Matching模型在逆问题中的关键瓶颈问题，在保持理论严谨性的同时实现了稳定高效的重建过程。

title: Emergent Semantic Role Understanding in Language Models
summary: Understanding how linguistic structure emerges in language models is central to interpreting what these systems learn from data and how much supervision they truly require. In particular, semantic role understanding ("who did what to whom") is a core component of meaning representation, yet it remains unclear whether it arises from pre-training alone or depends on task-specific fine-tuning. We study whether semantic role understanding emerges during language model pre-training or requires task-specific fine-tuning. We freeze decoder-only transformers and train linear probes to extract semantic roles, using performance to infer whether role information is already encoded in pre-training or learned during adaptation. Across model scales, we find that frozen representations contain substantial semantic role information, with performance improving but not fully matching fine-tuned models. This indicates partial but incomplete emergence from pre-training alone. We show that semantic role structure emerges from language modeling objectives, but its internal implementation shifts toward more distributed representations as model scale increases.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现语义角色理解在语言模型预训练阶段部分涌现，但仍需任务微调才能达到完整性能；随着模型规模增大，语义角色信息的内部表征呈现更分布式的特点。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型中的语义角色理解（“谁对谁做了什么”）是源于预训练阶段还是依赖于任务特定的微调，这对于理解模型从数据中学到了什么以及需要多少监督具有重要意义。
AI.method: 冻结仅解码器的Transformer模型，训练线性探针（linear probes）来提取语义角色信息。通过探针的性能推断角色信息是已在预训练中编码，还是在适应过程中学习得到的。研究涵盖了不同规模的模型。
AI.result: 冻结的模型表征中包含大量语义角色信息，性能虽优于随机但未完全匹配微调后的模型。这表明预训练能够产生部分但不完全的语义角色理解。研究发现语义角色结构从语言建模目标中涌现，但随着模型规模增大，其内部实现向更分布式的表征转变。
AI.conclusion: 语义角色结构确实从语言建模目标中自然涌现，但这种涌现是部分的；完全的语义角色理解仍需任务特定微调。模型规模的增加改变了内部表征方式，使其更加分布式。

title: CDS4RAG: Cyclic Dual-Sequential Hyperparameter Optimization for RAG
comment: Accepted by main track at IJCAI 2026
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is sensitive to the vast hyperparameters of the retriever and generator, yet optimizing them using given queries is a challenging task due to the complex interactions and expensive evaluation costs. Existing algorithms are ineffective and slow in convergence, since they often treat RAG as a monolithic black box or only optimize partial hyperparameters. In this paper, we propose CDS4RAG, a framework that optimizes the full RAG hyperparameters using given queries via a new cyclic dual-sequential formulation. CDS4RAG is special in the sense that it distinguishes the hyperparameters of the retriever and generator, cyclically optimizing them in turn. Such a paradigm allows us to design fine-grained within-cycle budget provision and expedite the optimization via cross-cycle seeding when optimizing the generator. CDS4RAG is also an algorithm-agnostic framework that can be paired with diverse general algorithms. Through experiments on four common benchmarks and two backbone LLMs, we reveal that CDS4RAG considerably boosts the vanilla algorithms in 21/24 cases while significantly outperforming state-of-the-art algorithms in all cases with up to 1.54x improvements of generation quality and better speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CDS4RAG框架，通过循环双序列优化策略分别优化检索器和生成器的超参数，在提升生成质量（最高1.54倍）的同时加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）对检索器和生成器的大量超参数敏感，但由于复杂的交互作用和昂贵的评估成本，利用给定查询优化这些超参数极具挑战性。现有算法将RAG视为单一黑盒或仅优化部分超参数，导致效率低下且收敛缓慢。
AI.method: 提出CDS4RAG框架，采用循环双序列公式，区分检索器和生成器的超参数并交替循环优化。该方法支持细粒度的周期内预算分配，并在优化生成器时利用跨周期种子加速优化过程。该框架具有算法无关性，可与多种通用算法结合使用。
AI.result: 在四个通用基准测试和两个骨干大语言模型（LLM）上的实验表明，CDS4RAG在24个案例中的21个显著优于原始算法，并在所有案例中显著超越最先进算法，生成质量提升最高达1.54倍，同时实现了更好的加速效果。
AI.conclusion: CDS4RAG通过区分并交替优化检索器与生成器超参数的有效范式，成功解决了RAG超参数优化的难题，显著提升了生成质量和优化速度，证明了该方法的有效性和通用性。

title: Evidence Over Plans: Online Trajectory Verification for Skill Distillation
summary: Agent skills can remarkably improve task success rates by using human-written procedural documents, but their quality is difficult to assess without environment-grounded verification. Existing skill generation methods heavily rely on preference logs rather than direct environment interaction, often yielding negligible or even degraded gains. We identify that it is a fundamental timing bottleneck: robust skills should be posterior-based, distilled from empirical environment interaction rather than prior plans. In this study, we introduce the Posterior Distillation Index (PDI), a trajectory-level metric that quantifies how well a distilled skill is grounded in the task-environment evidence. To operationalize PDI, we present SPARK (Structured Pipelines for Autonomous Runnable tasKs and sKill generation) for preserving task execution evidence towards full trajectory-level analysis. SPARK generates environment-verified trajectories used to compute PDI, and it applies PDI as an online diagnostic and intervention signal to ensure posterior skill formation. Across 86 runnable tasks, SPARK-generated skills consistently surpass no-skill baselines and outperform human-written skills on student models (inference cost up to 1,000x cheaper than teacher models). These findings show that PDI-guided distillation produces efficient and transferable skills grounded in the task-environment interaction. We release our code at https://github.com/EtaYang10th/spark-skills .

AI.tldr: 提出了PDI指标和SPARK框架，通过环境交互验证生成高质量智能体技能，显著提升任务成功率并降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体技能生成方法依赖偏好日志而非直接环境交互，难以评估技能质量，导致性能增益微乎其微甚至下降；缺乏基于环境交互的后验验证是核心瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出轨迹级指标PDI（后验蒸馏指数）量化技能与任务环境证据的契合度；构建SPARK框架生成环境验证的轨迹用于计算PDI，并将PDI作为在线诊断与干预信号确保后验技能形成。
AI.result: 在86个可运行任务上，SPARK生成的技能超越无技能基线，在学生模型上优于人类编写技能（推理成本比教师模型降低高达1000倍）。
AI.conclusion: PDI引导的蒸馏能够产生高效、可迁移且基于任务环境交互验证的技能，为智能体技能学习提供了有效范式。

title: The Geometry of Forgetting: Temporal Knowledge Drift as an Independent Axis in LLM Representations
summary: Large language models confidently produce outdated answers, and no existing method can detect them. We show this is not an engineering failure but a structural one: temporal drift, whether a stored fact has changed since training, is encoded as a direction in the residual stream geometrically orthogonal to both correctness and uncertainty. Any method operating on correctness or uncertainty signals is therefore blind to drift by construction. We verify this across six instruction-tuned models. A linear probe trained directly on drift labels achieves AUROC $0.83$--$0.95$; methods based on token entropy, semantic entropy, CCS, and SAPLMA all remain near chance ($0.49$--$0.57$). Five tests confirm the geometric orthogonality: weight cosines ($|\cos| \leq 0.14$), score correlations ($|r| \leq 0.20$), bidirectional null-space projection ($|Δ| \leq 0.008$), iterative null-space projection with $k{=}10$, and difference-of-means dissociation. Mechanistically, the MLP retrieval circuit produces identical dynamics for stale recall and confabulation ($r > 0.81$, six models), explaining why output confidence cannot separate them. A cross-cutoff experiment holds inputs constant and varies only the model: the probe fires on the model whose training predates the fact's transition and stays silent otherwise ($P(A{>}B) = 0.975$--$0.998$, twelve model pairs), confirming it reads model-internal knowledge state rather than input properties. Our code and datasets will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大语言模型产生过时答案的问题源于结构性的时间漂移，它与正确性和不确定性在几何上正交，现有方法无法检测。作者训练的线性探针可高效识别漂移，并通过多模型实验验证了其机制有效性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型会自信地生成过时答案，且现有方法无法检测这种时间漂移（即训练后事实发生变化的情况）。作者旨在揭示这一问题的根本原因，并提出有效的检测方法。
AI.method: 作者证明时间漂移在残差流中编码为一个方向，且与正确性和不确定性几何正交。通过在六个指令微调模型上训练线性探针来检测漂移，并采用五项测试验证几何正交性，同时进行跨截止日期实验和机制分析。
AI.result: 线性探针在检测漂移方面达到AUROC 0.83-0.95，而基于词元熵、语义熵、CCS和SAPLMA的方法均接近随机水平（0.49-0.57）。五项测试确认了几何正交性，跨截止日期实验显示探针能够准确识别模型内部知识状态（P(A>B) = 0.975-0.998）。
AI.conclusion: 时间漂移是结构性问题而非工程失败，任何依赖正确性或不确定性信号的方法都无法检测漂移。MLP检索电路对过时回忆和虚构产生相同动态，解释了为何输出置信度无法区分它们。训练在漂移标签上的探针可以有效检测这一现象。

title: What Time Is It? How Data Geometry Makes Time Conditioning Optional for Flow Matching
summary: Recent work has shown that models flow matching models can be trained without explicit time conditioning, challenging the standard view that the interpolation time is needed to disambiguate velocity targets. But why should a time-blind model work at all? Decomposing the time-blind flow matching loss, we identify two sources of irreducible error: a coupling variance, which arises from ambiguous velocity targets induced by how noise and data points are paired, and the time-blindness gap, which is the additional error caused by ignoring time. This gap shows that time-blind training is strictly harder than conventional training, reinforcing the puzzle that time-blind models work so well in practice. We resolve this tension by showing that the geometry of high-dimensional data makes time identifiable directly from noisy observations. When data concentrates near a $k$-dimensional subspace, time can be recovered from the statistical structure of noisy interpolants in directions orthogonal to the data; under a spiked-covariance model, this yields a closed-form estimator that recovers $t$ from a single observation $z$ at rate $O(1/\sqrt{d-k})$ for ambient dimension $d$. As a consequence, we prove that the time-blindness gap is asymptotically negligible relative to the coupling variance. We empirically demonstrate our identifiability result on real-world data and show that changing the coupling has a much larger effect on loss and sample quality than removing time conditioning across CIFAR-10, CelebA-HQ, and FFHQ. These results explain why time-blind flow matching works and show that the main practical lever is the choice of coupling, not explicit time conditioning.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论和实验上揭示了时间盲流匹配模型为何有效：高维数据的几何结构使时间可从噪声观测中恢复，时间盲训练的额外误差可忽略，耦合选择才是影响性能的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 近期研究表明流匹配模型可在无显式时间条件下训练，挑战了传统观点。作者旨在解释为何时间盲模型在实践中表现良好，并量化时间盲训练的误差来源。
AI.method:
1. 分解时间盲流匹配损失，识别耦合方差和时间盲性间隙两种误差源；
2. 在高维数据集中于k维子空间的假设下，推导从正交方向噪声插值恢复时间的闭式估计器；
3. 在spiked-covariance模型下证明时间恢复速率为O(1/√(d-k))；
4. 在CIFAR-10、CelebA-HQ和FFHQ数据集上进行实验验证。
AI.result:
1. 证明了时间盲性间隙相对于耦合方差渐近可忽略；
2. 提出从单一观测z恢复时间t的闭式估计器；
3. 实验表明改变耦合对损失和样本质量的影响远大于移除时间条件；
4. 验证了高维数据中时间的可识别性。
AI.conclusion: 时间盲流匹配的有效性源于高维数据的几何结构使时间可识别，实践中耦合选择比显式时间条件更重要，这为理解和改进流匹配模型提供了理论指导和实践启示。

title: Convergence Analysis of Newton's Method for Neural Networks in the Overparameterized Limit
summary: A convergence analysis is developed for the regularized Newton method for training neural networks (NNs) in the overparameterized limit. As the number of hidden units tends to infinity, the NN training dynamics converge in probability to the solution of a deterministic limit equation involving a ``Newton neural tangent kernel'' (NNTK). Explicit rates characterizing this convergence are provided and, in the infinite-width limit, we prove that the NN converges exponentially fast to the target data (i.e., a global minimizer with zero loss). We show that this convergence is uniform across the frequency spectrum, addressing the spectral bias inherent in gradient descent. The eigenvalues of the NTK for gradient descent accumulate at zero, leading to slow convergence for target data with high-frequency components. In contrast, the NNTK has uniformly lower bounded eigenvalues if the regularization parameter is selected appropriately, allowing Newton's method to converge more quickly for data with high-frequency components. Mathematical challenges that need to be addressed in our analysis include the implicit parameter update of the Newton method with a potentially indefinite Hessian matrix and the fact that the dimension of this linear system of equations tends to infinity as the NN width grows. This complicates deriving the training dynamics in the overparameterized limit as well as proving the convergence of the finite-width dynamics thereto. The analysis identifies a scaling formula for selecting the regularization parameter, which we show can vanish at a suitable rate as the number of hidden units becomes larger. We prove that, for sufficiently large numbers of hidden units, the regularized Hessian remains positive definite during training and the Newton updates for individual NN parameters converge to zero, showing that the model behaves as a linearization around the initialization.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了正则化牛顿方法在过参数化神经网络训练中的收敛性：在无限宽极限下，神经网络以指数速率收敛到目标数据，且在整个频谱上均匀收敛，克服了梯度下降的谱偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 梯度下降训练神经网络时，神经正切核（NTK）的特征值在零处聚集，导致高频成分的目标数据收敛缓慢，即谱偏差问题。本文旨在研究正则化牛顿方法在过参数化极限下的收敛性，以解决这一频率依赖的收敛速度问题。
AI.method: 建立了正则化牛顿方法在过参数化极限下的收敛分析框架：引入"牛顿神经正切核"（NNTK）概念，证明训练动力学在概率意义下收敛到确定性极限方程；解决了黑塞矩阵可能不定以及系统维度趋于无穷的数学挑战；确定了正则化参数的缩放公式。
AI.result: 证明了在无限宽极限下，神经网络以指数速率收敛到目标数据（零损失的全局最小值）；收敛在整个频谱上均匀进行；当正则化参数选择适当时，NNTK的特征值一致下有界，而梯度下降的NTK特征值在零处聚集；正则化黑塞矩阵在训练过程中保持正定。
AI.conclusion: 正则化牛顿方法相比梯度下降能够更快收敛高频成分的数据，克服了谱偏差；当隐藏单元数量足够大时，模型表现为围绕初始化的线性化行为，单个参数的牛顿更新趋于零。

title: How Much is Brain Data Worth for Machine Learning?
comment: 9 pages main text, 5 figures, 34 pages of appendix with detailed proofs
summary: If a person can solve a task, can measuring their brain make it easier to train a model to solve that task too? Recent NeuroAI work suggests that supplementing task training with neural recordings can modestly improve model performance and robustness. However, it is unclear when there should be a benefit from using neural data and how much benefit to expect. We formulate this question mathematically, and begin to address it theoretically using a simple, analytically tractable linear gaussian model of task targets and neural recordings. For a multimodal estimator trained on both brain data and task labels, we derive scaling laws for how performance scales with the numbers of brain and task samples. From these laws we derive relative value and exchange rates between brain samples and task samples, quantifying how much extra task samples neural data is worth as a function of task-brain alignment, neural and task noise, latent dimension, and brain data sample size. We also analyze test distribution shift, to identify conditions where brain-regularized learning can produce substantial robustness gains through learned invariances. Finally, under a fixed collection budget, we characterize the regimes in which brain data is worth collecting. Our results provide a foundation for understanding how valuable brain data could be for improving machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究了神经数据在多大程度上能辅助机器学习模型训练，推导了脑样本与任务样本之间的定量交换率，并指出了在何种条件下收集脑数据具有价值。
AI.motivation: 近期神经人工智能（NeuroAI）研究表明，利用神经 recording 数据辅助任务训练可以适度提升模型性能和鲁棒性，但目前尚不清楚在何种情况下会有收益以及收益大小，缺乏对脑数据价值的理论理解。
AI.method: 构建了一个数学上可解析处理的线性高斯模型来描述任务目标和神经记录；使用多模态估计器同时训练脑数据和任务标签；推导了性能随脑样本数和任务样本数变化的缩放定律；分析了测试分布偏移下的情况。
AI.result: 推导出了性能缩放定律，以及脑样本与任务样本之间的相对价值和交换率，量化了脑数据价值如何取决于任务-脑对齐度、神经与任务噪声、潜在维度和脑数据样本量等因素；识别了脑正则化学习通过学习不变性产生显著鲁棒性收益的条件；刻画了在固定采集预算下值得收集脑数据的情形。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为理解脑数据在改进机器学习中的潜在价值提供了理论基础，建立了预测脑数据收益的定量框架，有助于指导未来神经数据采集和NeuroAI研究的决策。

title: SWE Atlas: Benchmarking Coding Agents Beyond Issue Resolution
summary: We introduce SWE Atlas, a benchmark suite for coding agents spanning three professional software engineering workflows: Codebase Q&A (124 tasks), Test Writing (90 tasks), and Refactoring (70 tasks). SWE Atlas differs from prior SWE benchmarks in three key ways: it targets underrepresented but practically important task categories, uses comprehensive category-specific evaluation protocols, and adopts under-specified, agentic task formulations that better reflect real-world usage. Its evaluation framework combines programmatic checks with rubric-based assessment. This goes beyond functional correctness, evaluating software engineering quality, including test and refactor completeness, maintainability, reusable abstractions, and codebase hygiene. We evaluate a range of frontier and open-weight models on SWE Atlas and find that GPT-5.4 and Opus 4.7 achieve the strongest overall performance, while even the best open-weight models score poorly. Our analysis suggests that top models rely on extensive codebase exploration and runtime-driven reasoning. However, even top models consistently struggle with subtle edge cases, complex runtime analysis, and adherence to software engineering best practices. Overall, SWE Atlas provides a complementary evaluation suite for measuring both correctness and engineering quality in coding agents.

AI.tldr: 发布了SWE Atlas基准测试套件，涵盖代码库问答、测试编写和重构三类软件工程工作流，评估显示GPT-5.4和Opus 4.7表现最佳，但所有模型在边缘情况和工程最佳实践方面仍存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有SWE基准测试主要关注功能正确性，缺乏对工程质量的评估。本文旨在填补这一空白，针对现有基准中被忽视但实际工作中重要的任务类别，设计更能反映真实世界使用场景的、规范不明确的代理式任务，以全面评估编码代理的正确性和工程质量。
AI.method: 构建包含124个代码库问答任务、90个测试编写任务和70个重构任务的基准套件SWE Atlas。采用程序化检查与基于评分标准的评估相结合的框架，不仅评估功能正确性，还评估测试完整性、重构完整性、可维护性、可复用抽象和代码库卫生等软件工程质量指标。
AI.result: 对前沿模型和开源权重模型进行评估，发现GPT-5.4和Opus 4.7整体表现最强，而最佳开源模型表现不佳。顶级模型依赖广泛的代码库探索和运行时驱动推理，但在处理微妙边缘情况、复杂运行时分析和遵循软件工程最佳实践方面持续表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: SWE Atlas作为一个补充性评估套件，能够同时衡量编码代理的正确性和工程质量，揭示了当前模型在软件工程能力上的关键短板，为未来编码代理的研究和改进提供了有价值的评估工具。

title: SeePhys Pro: Diagnosing Modality Transfer and Blind-Training Effects in Multimodal RLVR for Physics Reasoning
summary: We introduce SeePhys Pro, a fine-grained modality transfer benchmark that studies whether models preserve the same reasoning capability when critical information is progressively transferred from text to image. Unlike standard vision-essential benchmarks that evaluate a single input form, SeePhys Pro features four semantically aligned variants for each problem with progressively increasing visual elements. Our evaluation shows that current frontier models are far from representation-invariant reasoners: performance degrades on average as information moves from language to diagrams, with visual variable grounding as the most critical bottleneck. Motivated by this inference-time fragility, we further develop large training corpora for multimodal RLVR and use blind training as a diagnostic control, finding that RL with all training images masked can still improve performance on unmasked validation sets. To analyze this effect, text-deletion, image-mask-rate, and format-saturation controls suggest that such gains can arise from residual textual and distributional cues rather than valid visual evidence. Our results highlight the need to evaluate multimodal reasoning not only by final-answer accuracy, but also by robustness under modality transfer and by diagnostics that test whether improvements rely on task-critical visual evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出了SeePhys Pro基准，发现当前前沿模型在信息从文本转移到图像时推理能力下降；发现使用全掩码图像训练仍能提升性能，揭示模型可能依赖文本和分布线索而非视觉证据。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅关注单一输入形式，缺乏对模型在不同模态表示下推理一致性的考察。研究旨在探究当关键信息逐步从文本转移至图像时，模型是否仍能保持相同的推理能力。
AI.method: 构建SeePhys Pro基准，为每个问题提供四个语义对齐的变体（逐步增加视觉元素）；基于此开发多模态RLVR训练语料库，采用盲训练（掩码所有训练图像）作为诊断对照，并进行文本删除、图像掩码率和格式饱和度控制实验。
AI.result: 当前前沿模型远非表示不变推理器：随着信息从语言转移到图表，性能平均下降，视觉变量定位是最关键的瓶颈；使用全掩码图像的强化学习训练仍能提升未掩码验证集性能；控制实验表明这种提升源于残留的文本和分布线索，而非有效的视觉证据。
AI.conclusion: 多模态推理评估不应仅依赖最终答案准确性，还需考察模态转移下的鲁棒性，并通过诊断测试验证改进是否真正依赖于任务关键的视觉证据。

title: Embedding Dimension Lower Bounds for Universality of Deep Sets and Janossy Pooling
summary: In many practical applications it is important to build symmetries into neural network architectures. Consider the important case of permutation symmetry on point clouds consisting of $n$ points in $d$ dimensions. In this case the network learns a function on a set of $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^d$, and a natural paradigm for constructing invariant networks is Janossy pooling, which generalizes the popular Deep Sets architecture. We study the universality of this approach, in particular the important question of how large the embedding dimension must be to guarantee universality of this architecture. Specifically, using a novel technique, we prove new lower bounds on the required size of this embedding dimension. For Deep Sets, this gives the correct minimal dimension up to a constant factor for all $d > 1$. For $k$-ary Janossy pooling, we prove the first non-trivial lower bound on the required embedding dimension when $k > 1$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有置换对称性的神经网络架构（如Deep Sets和Janossy pooling）的通用性，证明了保证架构通用性所需的嵌入维度的下界。对于Deep Sets，给出了几乎所有情况下的正确最小维度；对于k-ary Janossy pooling，证明了首个非平凡的下界。
AI.motivation: 在实际应用中，将对称性融入神经网络架构非常重要。特别是在处理点云数据时，需要构建对点集置换具有不变性的网络。Janossy pooling（推广了流行的Deep Sets架构）是构建此类不变网络的自然范式，但保证其通用性所需的嵌入维度大小是一个重要且未解决的问题。
AI.method: 作者开发了一种新颖的技术来分析Janossy pooling架构的通用性，重点研究保证架构通用性所需的嵌入维度。通过对Deep Sets架构和k-ary Janossy pooling进行理论分析，推导嵌入维度的下界。
AI.result: 对于Deep Sets架构，证明了所需嵌入维度的下界，在所有d>1的情况下，该下界与正确最小维度仅相差一个常数因子。对于k>1的k-ary Janossy pooling，证明了首个非平凡的嵌入维度下界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为具有置换对称性的神经网络架构提供了理论基础，明确了保证通用性所需的最小嵌入维度。这些结果为实际应用中架构设计提供了重要指导，避免过度参数化或维度不足的问题。

title: Shaping Schema via Language Representation as the Next Frontier for LLM Intelligence Expanding
summary: Although natural language is the default medium for Large Language Models (LLMs), its limited expressive capacity creates a profound bottleneck for complex problem-solving. While recent advancements in AI have relied heavily on scaling, merely internalizing knowledge does not guarantee its effective application. Defining language representation as the linguistic and symbolic constructs used to map and model the real world, this paper argues that shaping schemas through advanced language representation is the next frontier for expanding LLM intelligence. We posit that an LLM's knowledge activation and organization -- its schema -- depends heavily on the structural and symbolic sophistication of the language used to represent a given task. This paper contributes both a formalization of this claim and the empirical evidence to support it. With a new formalization, we present multiple lines of evidence to support our position: Firstly, we review recent empirical practices and emerging methodologies that demonstrate the substantial performance gains achievable through deliberate language representation design, even without modifying model parameters or scale. Secondly, we conduct controlled experiments showing that LLM performance and its internal feature activations vary under different language representations of the same underlying task. Together, these findings highlight language representation design as a promising direction for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言表示设计是提升大语言模型（LLM）智能的关键前沿。通过理论形式化与实验验证，证明精心设计的语言表示（而非单纯依赖模型扩展）能显著改善任务性能和内部特征激活，为未来研究提供了新方向。
AI.motivation: 尽管自然语言是LLM的默认媒介，但其表达能力有限，严重制约复杂问题求解。现有AI进展多依赖规模扩展，仅内部化知识并不能保证其有效应用。作者认为，语言表示（即用于映射现实世界的语言和符号结构）的结构化与符号化水平深刻影响LLM的知识激活与组织（即“图式”），因此塑造高级语言表示是突破LLM智能瓶颈的下一个前沿。
AI.method: 1) 提出理论形式化框架，明确LLM的“图式”依赖于任务语言表示的结构与符号复杂度；2) 综述近期实证方法，展示在不修改模型参数或规模的情况下，通过语言表示设计即可获得显著性能提升；3) 设计对照实验，验证同一任务在不同语言表示下，LLM性能与内部特征激活存在差异。
AI.result: 理论与实证结果一致表明：语言表示设计对LLM性能有因果性影响。即便不改变模型参数或规模，优化语言表示仍能提升任务表现；对照实验进一步证实，不同表示方式会导致模型内部特征激活模式的系统性变化。
AI.conclusion: 语言表示设计是释放LLM潜力的关键路径。未来研究应重视语言与符号结构的设计，而非仅依赖模型规模扩展，这为提升LLM的推理与问题解决能力提供了新范式。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Scalable and Trustworthy Intelligent Systems
summary:
Reinforcement learning has become a powerful paradigm for improving the capability of intelligent systems, but its practical deployment faces two central challenges. First, reinforcement learning must scale efficiently in distributed environments where communication bandwidth is limited and computation is heterogeneous across agents. Second, as reinforcement learning is increasingly used in post-training large language models and autonomous agents, the optimized policies must also be aligned with human preferences and satisfy safety requirements such as privacy-aware information disclosure. This dissertation addresses both challenges through four complementary contributions spanning federated optimization, preference alignment, and contextual safety.
  The first part of the dissertation studies scalable reinforcement learning in federated settings. The second part of the dissertation studies trustworthy reinforcement learning for large language models. Together, these contributions advance reinforcement learning along two complementary dimensions. On the one hand, they make reinforcement learning more scalable through communication-efficient and asynchronous federated optimization. On the other hand, they make reinforcement learning more trustworthy by improving alignment with human preferences and by reducing contextually inappropriate information disclosure in language-based intelligent systems. As a whole, this dissertation argues that the next generation of intelligent systems will require both efficient optimization and trustworthy behavior, and that reinforcement learning provides a unifying framework for addressing both goals.

AI.tldr: 本论文旨在解决强化学习在实际部署中的两大挑战——分布式环境下的扩展性问题和智能系统的可信度问题，通过联邦优化、偏好对齐和上下文安全四个互补性贡献，使强化学习更具可扩展性和可信性。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在实际部署中面临两个核心挑战：首先，在通信带宽有限且计算异构的分布式环境中，强化学习需要高效扩展；其次，随着强化学习被广泛用于大语言模型的后训练和自主智能体，优化策略必须与人类偏好对齐并满足隐私保护等安全要求。
AI.method: 论文分为两部分：第一部分研究联邦设置下的可扩展强化学习方法；第二部分研究面向大语言模型的可信强化学习方法。整体上通过联邦优化、偏好对齐和上下文安全等四个互补性贡献来解决问题。
AI.result: 一方面通过通信高效且异步的联邦优化使强化学习更具可扩展性；另一方面通过与人类偏好对齐和减少基于语言智能系统中上下文不当信息披露，使强化学习更具可信性。
AI.conclusion: 下一代智能系统需要同时具备高效优化能力和可信行为，而强化学习提供了一个统一框架来同时实现这两个目标。本研究论证了在联邦优化和可信性两个互补维度上推进强化学习的必要性和可行性。

title: Towards Conversational Medical AI with Eyes, Ears and a Voice
comment: Video examples are available on Youtube: https://youtu.be/y5Vaa_SN1t0, https://youtu.be/dC4icb75vLQ, and https://youtu.be/E7iEvWo-E6c
summary: The practice of medicine relies not only upon skillful dialogue but also on the nuanced exchange and interpretation of rich auditory and visual cues between doctors and patients. Building on the low-latency voice and video processing capabilities of Gemini, we introduce AI co-clinician, a first-of-its-kind conversational AI system utilizing continuous streams of audio-visual data from live patient conversations to inform real-time clinical decisions. Its dual-agent architecture balances deep clinical reasoning with the low latency required for natural dialogue. To assess this system, we implemented a video-based interface emulating telemedicine consultations. We crafted 20 standardized outpatient scenarios requiring proactive real-time auditory and visual reasoning and designed "TelePACES" evaluation criteria alongside case-specific rubrics. In a randomized, interface-blinded, crossover simulation study (n = 120 encounters) with 10 internal medicine residents as patient actors, we compared AI co-clinician with primary care physicians (PCPs), GPT-Realtime, and a baseline agent. AI co-clinician approached PCPs in key TelePACES dimensions, including management plans and differential diagnosis, while significantly outperforming GPT-Realtime across all general criteria. While our agent demonstrated parity with PCPs in case-specific triage measures, physicians maintained superior overall performance in case-specific assessments. Although AI co-clinician marks a significant advance in real-time telemedical AI, gaps remain in physical examination and disease-specific reasoning. Our work shows that text-only approaches fail to capture the true challenges of medical consultation and suggests that high-stakes real-time diagnostic AI is most safely advanced in collaborative, triadic models where AI can be a supportive co-clinician for doctors and patients.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了首个基于Gemini实时音视频处理能力的AI联合临床医师系统，通过双智能体架构实现自然对话交互与深度临床推理的平衡。在模拟远程医疗评估中，该系统在关键临床维度上接近初级保健医师水平，显著优于GPT-Realtime，但在体格检查和疾病特异性推理方面仍存在差距。
AI.motivation: 临床医学实践不仅依赖语言对话，还涉及医生与患者之间丰富的听觉和视觉线索的细微交换与解读。现有基于文本的方法无法捕捉医疗咨询的真实挑战，因此需要开发能够实时处理连续音视频流的AI系统，以支持临床决策。
AI.method: 基于Gemini的低延迟音视频处理能力，开发了双智能体架构的AI联合临床医师系统，平衡深度临床推理与自然对话所需的低延迟。通过模拟远程医疗视频界面，设计了20个标准化门诊场景和"TelePACES"评估标准，进行随机、界面盲法、交叉模拟研究(n=120次问诊)。
AI.result: AI联合临床医师在管理方案和鉴别诊断等关键TelePACES维度上接近初级保健医师(PCPs)水平，在所有通用标准上显著优于GPT-Realtime。在病例特异性分诊措施方面与PCPs相当，但在病例特异性评估的整体表现上医生仍保持优势。系统在体格检查和疾病特异性推理方面存在明显不足。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明纯文本方法无法捕捉医疗咨询的真实挑战，高风险实时诊断AI最安全的发展方向是协作式三方模型，即AI作为医生和患者的支持性联合临床医师角色参与临床决策过程。

title: The Power of Second Order Methods for Sequence Preconditioning
summary: Sequence prediction methods for dynamical systems with long memory, i.e. marginally stable systems, typically achieve regret that grows polynomially with the hidden dimension of the underlying generative model. Universal Sequence Preconditioning (USP) is a method that compresses any sequence which comes from a linear dynamical system into a "preconditioned" sequence which requires exponentially shorter memory for accurate prediction. However, the preconditioned sequence yields exponentially larger diameters and gradients, hindering USP from unlocking optimal regret bounds. Inspired by the minimum description length principle, we show that the Vovk-Azoury-Warmuth (VAW) algorithm is naturally matched to the USP regime. Indeed, it takes advantage of the memory compression while remaining robust to the exponential explosion of the diameter. We prove that combining USP with VAW achieves astoundingly strong results: for any marginally-stable linear dynamical system, this algorithm achieves polylogarithmic regret $O \left( \log^3 T \right)$ even in the presence of asymmetric hidden transition matrices. Finally, we extend the applicability of USP beyond bounded-spectrum systems by providing new complex-analytic bounds on Chebyshev polynomials, allowing for systems with constant complex arguments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将通用序列预处理（USP）与VAW算法结合，解决了边缘稳定线性动力系统的序列预测问题，实现了$O(\log^3 T)$的polylogarithmic遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 对于具有长记忆特性的边缘稳定动力系统，现有序列预测方法的遗憾随隐藏维度呈多项式增长。USP方法虽能压缩序列内存需求，但会导致直径和梯度指数级爆炸，无法实现最优遗憾界。
AI.method: 受最小描述长度原理启发，发现VAW算法天然适用于USP框架：既能利用内存压缩优势，又对直径的指数级爆炸保持鲁棒性。通过复杂分析建立Chebyshev多项式的新界，将USP扩展到具有常数复参数的系统。
AI.result: 对于任意边缘稳定的线性动力系统（包括非对称隐藏转移矩阵），USP-VAW组合算法实现了$O(\log^3 T)$的polylogarithmic遗憾界，相比现有方法的多项式遗憾有显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功解决了长记忆动力系统预测中的核心挑战，将遗憾从多项式级别提升到polylogarithmic级别，同时将USP方法从有界谱系统扩展到更一般的复参数系统。

title: EquiMem: Calibrating Shared Memory in Multi-Agent Debate via Game-Theoretic Equilibrium
summary: Multi-agent debate (MAD) systems increasingly rely on shared memory to support long-horizon reasoning, but this convenience opens a critical vulnerability: a single corrupted entry can contaminate the downstream memory-augmented reasoning, and debate alone fails to filter such errors. Existing safeguards filter entries via heuristics or LLM-based validation, yet they rely on AI judgments that share the same failure modes and overlook the cross-agent dynamics of MAD. We address this gap by formulating memory updating in MAD as a zero-trust memory game, in which no agent is assumed honest and the game's equilibrium serves as an indicator of optimal memory trust. Guided by this equilibrium, we propose EquiMem, an inference-time calibration mechanism that quantifies each update algorithmically against the shared memory state, using agents' existing retrieval queries and traversal paths as evidence rather than soliciting any LLM judgment. EquiMem instantiates calibration for both embedding- and graph-based memory, and across diverse benchmarks, MAD frameworks, and memory architectures, it consistently outperforms existing safeguards, remains robust under adversarial agents, and incurs negligible inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EquiMem，一种用于多智能体辩论系统中共享记忆的推理时校准机制，通过零信任博弈模型和算法化量化来过滤错误记忆条目，无需依赖LLM判断，显著优于现有防护方法。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论系统依赖共享记忆支持长程推理，但存在关键漏洞：单个被破坏的记忆条目会污染后续推理，而辩论本身无法过滤此类错误。现有防护方法依赖启发式或LLM验证，这些方法存在相同的失败模式，且忽视了MAD的跨智能体动态特性。
AI.method: 将MAD中的记忆更新建模为零信任记忆博弈，假设无智能体诚实，以博弈均衡作为最优记忆信任的指标。基于此均衡提出EquiMem机制，利用智能体现有的检索查询和遍历路径作为证据，算法化地量化每次更新，而非请求LLM判断，实现对嵌入型和图型记忆的校准。
AI.result: 在多种基准测试、MAD框架和记忆架构上，EquiMem持续优于现有防护方法；在对抗性智能体攻击下保持鲁棒性；且推理开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: EquiMem为零信任多智能体系统提供了一种有效的记忆安全防护范式，通过博弈论方法克服了现有LLM依赖型防护的局限性，为MAD系统的安全部署提供了可靠保障。

title: SACHI: Structured Agent Coordination via Holistic Information Integration in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning agents that act on partial local observations face a fundamental information bottleneck: the knowledge needed to select jointly optimal actions is scattered across the team, yet each agent must commit to a decision without access to its teammates' observations, intentions, or chosen actions. Existing methods either ignore this bottleneck, compress it into a scalar mixing signal, or route around it with learned communication channels. Framing action coordination as a problem of structured information integration among agents, we propose \textit{structured agent coordination via holistic information integration}, or SACHI, in which graph transformer convolutions over an inter-agent coordination graph enrich each agent's representation with receiver-sensitive, content-dependent signals from teammates prior to action selection. We evaluate SACHI across five cooperative tasks spanning spatial, communicative, and adversarial coordination challenges against twelve baselines. SACHI consistently matches or outperforms the best baseline on every task, and rigorous aggregate statistical analyses, including normalized metrics with bootstrap confidence intervals, Friedman ranking, and performance profiling, confirm that this advantage is statistically significant, robust across environments, and not attributable to increased model capacity. Parameter-matched ablations further trace the source of the gains to a single architectural property: the degree of content-dependence in the message-passing operator.

AI.tldr: 提出SACHI方法，通过图Transformer卷积实现智能体间的结构化信息整合，有效解决了部分可观测多智能体协作中的信息瓶颈问题，在多个任务上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测协作多智能体强化学习面临核心信息瓶颈：最优联合决策所需知识分散在团队中，但各智能体必须在无法获取队友观测、意图或动作的情况下做出决策。现有方法要么忽视该瓶颈，要么将其压缩为标量混合信号，或通过学习通信通道绕过该问题。
AI.method: 提出SACHI（通过整体信息整合的结构化智能体协调）方法，在智能体动作选择之前，利用智能体间协调图上的图Transformer卷积，用来自队友的接收者敏感、内容依赖的信号丰富各智能体的表示。核心是将动作协调构建为智能体间结构化信息整合问题。
AI.result: 在跨越空间、通信和对抗性协调挑战的五项协作任务上，与十二个基线进行对比评估。SACHI在每项任务上都达到或超过最佳基线性能。通过归一化指标与Bootstrap置信区间、Friedman排名和性能剖析等严格的汇总统计分析，确认该优势具有统计显著性、跨环境鲁棒性，且非源于模型容量的增加。参数匹配的消融实验进一步追溯增益来源为消息传递算子中内容依赖的程度。
AI.conclusion: SACHI通过单一的架构属性——消息传递算子的内容依赖程度——实现了性能提升，证明了结构化信息整合在解决多智能体协作信息瓶颈问题上的有效性，为部分可观测协作任务提供了更优的解决方案。

title: A Prompt-Aware Structuring Framework for Reliable Reuse of AI-Generated Content in the Agentic Web
summary: The evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the software agents built on them (AI agents) marks a turning point in the transition from a human-centric Web to an ``Agentic Web'' driven by AI agents. However, for AI-Generated Content (AIGC), which is expected to dominate the Web, there is currently no mechanism for agents to verify its reliability, reproducibility, or license compliance during generation. This lack of transparency risks causing chained hallucinations and compliance violations through the reuse of AIGC. Consequently, a framework to manage the provenance and generation conditions of AIGC is essential. In this paper, we present a framework that automatically attaches structured metadata to AIGC at generation time, including modularized prompts, contexts, thoughts, model information, hyperparameters, and confidence. The metadata is enveloped together with verifiable credentials to support the reliable assessment and reuse of AIGC. This framework enables efficient curation of structured AIGC and facilitates its safe use for applications such as fine-tuning and knowledge distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个在AIGC生成时自动附加结构化元数据的框架，以解决AI代理网络中内容缺乏透明度、可靠性和合规性验证的问题。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型和AI代理的发展，网络正从以人为中心转向以AI代理为中心。然而，目前缺乏机制让AI代理在生成AI生成内容（AIGC）时验证其可靠性、可复现性和许可证合规性，这种透明度的缺失可能导致连锁幻觉和合规违规问题。
AI.method: 提出了一个框架，在AIGC生成时自动附加结构化元数据，包括模块化的提示、上下文、思维过程、模型信息、超参数和置信度，并将元数据与可验证凭证封装在一起。
AI.result: 该框架支持对AIGC进行可靠性评估和复用，能够高效地管理结构化的AIGC，并促进其在微调和知识蒸馏等应用中的安全使用。
AI.conclusion: 通过为AIGC附加可验证的结构化元数据和凭证，该框架有效解决了AI代理网络中内容透明度和合规性问题，为AIGC的安全复用和应用提供了基础保障。

title: Geometry-Aware Discretization Error of Diffusion Models
summary: Practical diffusion sampling is a numerical approximation problem: under a fixed inference budget, one must simulate a reverse-time ODE or SDE using only a limited number of denoising steps, so discretization error is often the dominant source of error. Existing non-asymptotic analyses provide convergence guarantees, but are typically too loose and too insensitive to diffusion parameters to guide practical design: broad families of schedules receive the same rates, which depend on coarse worst-case quantities such as the dimension or the drift Lipschitz constant. We take a less ambitious but more informative route. In the exact-score setting, we derive first-order asymptotic expansions of the Euler-Maruyama weak and Fréchet discretization errors. These formulas hold for general smooth reverse diffusions and become fully explicit under Gaussian data. They show how discretization error adapts to the geometry of the data through the covariance spectrum, and how this geometry interacts with key diffusion parameters, including the diffusion schedules and the diffusion-term coefficient. This yields tractable objectives for geometry-aware parameter optimization. Finally, we show that the qualitative predictions of the Gaussian formulas remain robust across diffusion sampling problems with different geometries, including image generation on different datasets and image posterior sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文针对扩散模型采样中的离散化误差问题，在精确分数设置下推导了一阶渐近展开公式，揭示了数据几何结构通过协方差谱影响误差，并为几何感知的参数优化提供了可处理的目标函数。
AI.motivation: 现有的非渐近分析提供的收敛保证过于宽松，对扩散参数不够敏感，无法指导实际设计——广泛的调度族获得相同的收敛率，且依赖粗粒度的最坏情况量（如维度或漂移Lipschitz常数）。作者旨在提供更精确、更有信息量的误差分析。
AI.method: 在精确分数（exact-score）设置下，推导Euler-Maruyama弱误差和Fréchet离散化误差的一阶渐近展开公式。这些公式对一般平滑反向扩散成立，在高斯数据假设下变得完全显式。分析展示了离散化误差如何通过协方差谱适应数据几何，以及几何如何与关键扩散参数（包括扩散调度和扩散项系数）相互作用。
AI.result: 得到了离散化误差的一阶渐近展开式，在高斯数据情形下公式完全显式；展示了离散化误差如何通过协方差谱适应数据几何；推导出几何感知参数优化的可处理目标函数；验证了高斯公式的定性预测在不同几何的扩散采样问题（包括不同数据集的图像生成和图像后验采样）中保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的渐近展开方法比现有非渐近分析更具信息量，能够捕捉数据几何与扩散参数之间的精细相互作用关系。高斯公式的定性预测在各种扩散采样问题中保持鲁棒性，为扩散模型的实际设计提供了有价值的理论指导。

title: PiCA: Pivot-Based Credit Assignment for Search Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based search agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) have significantly improved the performance of knowledge-intensive tasks. However, existing methods encounter critical challenges in long-horizon credit assignment: (i) Reward Sparsity, where models receive only outcome feedback without step-level guidance to differentiate action quality; (ii) Isolated Credit, where credit is assigned to steps independently, failing to capture sequential dependencies; and (iii) Distributional Shift, where rewards are estimated on templates that deviate from the model's natural generative distribution. To address these issues, we propose Pivot-Based Credit Assignment (PiCA), a novel step reward mechanism that reformulates the search trajectory as a sequential process of cumulative search progress. Unlike prior isolated step rewards, PiCA defines process rewards as success probabilities dependent on the historical context based on Potential-Based Reward Shaping (PBRS). This approach identifies pivot steps, which comprise target golden sub-queries and sub-answers derived from historical trajectories, as information peaks that significantly boost the likelihood of a correct final answer. By anchoring these step rewards to the final task objective, PiCA provides dense, pivot-aware and trajectory-dependent guidance while maintaining distributional consistency. Extensive experiments show that PiCA outperforms existing strong baselines across seven knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks, achieving 15.2% and 2.2% improvements for 3B and 7B models. The consistent performance gains across various models show PiCA's robust generalization. The code is available at https://github.com/novdream/PiCA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PiCA（Pivot-Based Credit Assignment），一种基于枢轴步骤的奖励机制，通过识别搜索轨迹中的关键步骤并利用基于势能的奖励整形方法，为LLM搜索代理提供密集且依赖轨迹的指导，在七个知识密集型QA基准上实现了显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的LLM搜索代理在长视界信用分配方面面临三大挑战：(1)奖励稀疏性，模型仅获得结果反馈而缺乏步骤级指导；(2)孤立信用，信用被独立分配给各步骤，未能捕捉序列依赖关系；(3)分布偏移，奖励估计基于偏离模型自然生成分布的模板。
AI.method: 提出PiCA机制，将搜索轨迹重新表述为累积搜索进度的序列过程。该方法基于势能奖励整形（PBRS），将过程奖励定义为依赖于历史上下文的成功概率。核心思想是识别枢轴步骤（pivot steps），即从历史轨迹中提取的目标黄金子查询和子答案，作为显著提高正确最终答案可能性的信息峰值，并将这些步骤奖励锚定到最终任务目标。
AI.result: 在七个知识密集型QA基准上的广泛实验表明，PiCA优于现有强基线方法，3B模型提升15.2%，7B模型提升2.2%，且在各种模型上表现出一致的性能增益，证明了其强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PiCA通过提供密集、枢轴感知且依赖轨迹的指导，同时保持分布一致性，有效解决了长视界信用分配问题，为LLM搜索代理的强化学习训练提供了一种有效的解决方案，具有良好的泛化性和实用性。

title: Exploring and Exploiting Stability in Latent Flow Matching
summary: In this work, we show that Latent Flow-Matching (LFM) models are robust to different types of perturbations, including data reduction and model capacity shrinkage. We characterize this stability by their tendency to generate similar outputs under identical noise seeds. We provide a perspective relating this phenomenon to flow matching theory, which indicates that this stability is inherent to the FM objective. We further exploit this stability to derive practical algorithms for more efficient training and inference. Concretely, first, we show that by training LFM models on significantly reduced datasets, the performance does not degrade perceptually or quantitatively. This yields multiple advantages, such as reducing training time by converging faster under limited compute budget, and alleviating annotation effort when training conditional models. Second, LFM stability under architectural shrinkage gives rise to a two-model coarse-to-fine approach, one using a light-weight architecture for the first phase of the FM trajectory, and one with higher capacity for the second, thereby reducing the inference cost substantially. To determine which samples are informative, we introduce three sample-scoring criteria and evaluate them under standard metrics for generative models. Our results are thoroughly evaluated on multiple datasets, demonstrating the practical advantage of this stability, including data saving and a more than two-fold inference speedup while generating comparable outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了潜在流匹配(LFM)模型对数据缩减和模型容量缩减等扰动具有鲁棒性。利用这一特性，作者提出了高效训练和推理算法，在保持生成质量的同时实现了数据节省和两倍以上的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 研究发现潜在流匹配(LFM)模型在面对不同类型的扰动（如数据缩减和模型容量缩减）时表现出显著的稳定性，即在相同噪声种子下倾向于生成相似的输出。作者希望从流匹配理论角度解释这一现象，并探索如何利用这种稳定性来提高训练和推理效率。
AI.method: 作者从流匹配理论视角分析了LFM稳定性的理论基础。在应用层面提出两个方法：(1)在大幅缩减的数据集上训练LFM模型，实现更快的收敛速度并减轻标注负担；(2)提出粗到细的两模型方法，第一阶段使用轻量级架构，第二阶段使用高容量架构，显著降低推理成本。此外，引入了三种样本评分标准来确定信息量大的样本。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的全面评估表明：(1)在显著缩减的数据集上训练，LFM模型在感知质量和定量指标上均未出现性能下降；(2)两阶段方法实现了两倍以上的推理加速；(3)生成的输出质量与基线方法相当。这验证了LFM稳定性的实际优势。
AI.conclusion: LFM模型对数据缩减和架构缩减具有内在的稳定性，这种稳定性源于流匹配目标函数的特性。通过巧妙利用这一特性，可以在不牺牲生成质量的前提下实现更高效的训练和推理，为生成模型的实际应用提供了新的优化思路。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Evaluating Strategy Diversity in LLM Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Large language models now achieve high final-answer accuracy on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, but accuracy alone does not capture reasoning flexibility. We introduce a strategy-level evaluation framework instantiated on 80 AMC 10/12 and AIME problems with 217 AoPS-derived reference strategy families. Model outputs are annotated for strategy identity, validity, and correctness using dual-AI coding with human adjudication. Across four frontier models, we find a pronounced decoupling between answer accuracy and strategy diversity. Under a single-solution prompt, all models achieve high accuracy (95%-100%), but under a multiple-strategy prompt they recover substantially fewer strategies than the human reference set. Gemini, DeepSeek, GPT, and Claude generate 184, 152, 151, and 110 distinct valid strategies, respectively, with the largest gaps in Geometry and Number Theory. The models collectively produce 50 benchmark-novel valid strategies, indicating both incomplete coverage of human strategies and some capacity for alternative reasoning. A repeated-run robustness check on 20 problems shows diminishing gains in discovered strategies, with the strongest model recovering only 39 of 55 AoPS-reference strategies (71%) after three runs. These findings position strategy diversity as a complementary dimension for evaluating mathematical reasoning beyond answer correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出策略级评估框架，发现大模型在数学问题上答案准确率高但策略多样性不足，模型能发现部分新颖策略但对人类策略覆盖不全，建议将策略多样性作为评估数学推理的补充维度。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅关注最终答案准确率，无法捕捉推理的灵活性。大模型在数学推理基准上虽然准确率高，但其解题策略的多样性和覆盖范围尚不清楚，因此需要一个新的评估维度来衡量推理能力。
AI.method: 构建策略级评估框架，选取80道AMC 10/12和AIME题目，建立217个源自AoPS的参考策略族。采用双AI编码加人工裁决的方式，对四个前沿模型（Gemini、DeepSeek、GPT、Claude）的输出进行策略身份、有效性和正确性标注。设置单解提示和多策略提示两种条件，并在20道题目上进行多次运行的鲁棒性检验。
AI.result: 单解提示下所有模型准确率达95%-100%，但多策略提示下策略数量远少于人类参考集。四个模型分别生成184、152、151、110种有效策略，几何和数论领域差距最大。模型共发现50种基准新颖的有效策略。在鲁棒性测试中，最强模型三次运行后仅能恢复55种AoPS参考策略中的39种（71%）。
AI.conclusion: 答案准确率与策略多样性之间存在显著脱节，模型对人类策略覆盖不完整但具备一定替代推理能力。策略多样性应作为评估数学推理的补充维度，单一指标不足以全面衡量模型推理能力。

title: AdamFLIP: Adaptive Momentum Feedback Linearization Optimization for Hard Constrained PINN Training
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a flexible framework for solving forward and inverse problems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs), but standard PINN training typically relies on soft penalty formulations that combine PDE residuals, data mismatch, and initial/boundary conditions using manually chosen weights. This often leads to ill-conditioning, sensitivity to loss weights, and poor constraint satisfaction. In this work, we reformulate PINN training as an equality-constrained optimization problem and propose a novel Adaptive Momentum Feedback Linearization Optimization for Hard Constrained PINN (AdamFLIP). The key idea is to view the constraint residuals as the output of a controlled dynamical system and to compute the Lagrange multiplier as a feedback input that locally drives these residuals toward stable linear contraction dynamics. AdamFLIP then applies Adam-style first- and second-moment adaptation to the resulting feedback-linearized Lagrangian gradient, combining principled constraint handling with the scalability and robustness of adaptive neural-network optimization. We test AdamFLIP on a range of benchmark forward and inverse PDE problem, and it consistently outperforms both the standard soft-constrained PINN and state-of-the-art constrained optimizers. Specifically, on the Navier--Stokes equations benchmark, AdamFLIP \textbf{reduces relative $L_2$ error by more than two thirds} for the predicted solution compared to the next best method. Our AdamFLIP framework provides an effective and computationally scalable hard constraint optimization method for PINN training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdamFLIP方法，将PINN训练重构为等式约束优化问题，通过反馈线性化和自适应矩优化实现硬约束处理，在Navier-Stokes方程上将相对L2误差降低了三分之二以上。
AI.motivation: 标准PINN训练依赖软惩罚公式，需要手动选择损失权重来组合PDE残差、数据失配和初始/边界条件，这会导致病态问题、对损失权重敏感以及约束满足不佳。
AI.method: 将PINN训练重构为等式约束优化问题，提出自适应动量反馈线性化优化方法（AdamFLIP）。核心思想是将约束残差视为受控动力学系统的输出，将拉格朗日乘子计算为反馈输入，驱动残差向稳定的线性收缩动力学演化，然后对反馈线性化的拉格朗日梯度应用Adam风格的一阶和二阶矩自适应。
AI.result: 在一系列基准正向和逆向PDE问题上进行测试，AdamFLIP始终优于标准软约束PINN和最先进的约束优化器。特别是在Navier-Stokes方程基准测试中，AdamFLIP将预测解的相对L2误差相比次优方法降低了三分之二以上。
AI.conclusion: AdamFLIP框架为PINN训练提供了一种有效且计算可扩展的硬约束优化方法，结合了有原则的约束处理与自适应神经网络优化的可扩展性和鲁棒性。

title: Beyond ESG Scores: Learning Dynamic Constraints for Sequential Portfolio Optimization
summary: ESG-aware portfolio optimization is increasingly important for sustainable capital allocation, yet most learning-based methods still operationalize ESG by appending static scores to the policy observation or reward. This creates a mismatch for sequential control: ESG scores are noisy, provider-dependent, low-frequency, and temporally misaligned with sequential portfolio decisions, while financial evidence suggests that ESG is better treated as a portfolio preference, risk-exposure, or hedge dimension than as a robust alpha factor. We propose to impose ESG constraints without modifying the financial policy's observation or reward, using a Multimodal Action-Conditioned Constraint Field (MACF) that learns mechanism-specific ESG costs from point-in-time multimodal evidence and contemplated portfolio transitions. We then introduce MACF-X, a family of optimizer-specific adapters that converts MACF costs and uncertainties into native constrained-optimization interfaces through a shared slack- and uncertainty-aware pressure layer. Across multiple constraint-integration interfaces, MACF-X reduces tail ESG budget pressure while maintaining competitive financial performance. Ablations show that this improvement depends on dynamic evidence inputs and three-head decomposition, while static ESG-score proxies are nearly indistinguishable from score-shuffled noise baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出MACF-X框架，通过学习多模态动态ESG证据产生的机制特定成本，在不修改金融策略观察或奖励的情况下施加ESG约束，有效降低尾部ESG预算压力并保持竞争性财务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的ESG投资组合优化方法将静态ESG分数附加到策略观察或奖励中，但这存在不匹配问题：ESG分数具有噪声、依赖供应商、低频、时间错位等特征，且金融证据表明ESG更适合作为组合偏好、风险敞口或对冲维度，而非稳健的alpha因子。
AI.method: 提出多模态动作条件约束场（MACF）从时点多模态证据和预期的组合转换中学习机制特定的ESG成本；引入MACF-X优化器特定适配器族，通过共享的松弛和不确定性感知压力层将MACF成本和不确定性转换为本机约束优化接口。
AI.result: 在多种约束集成接口上，MACF-X在维持竞争性财务表现的同时降低了尾部ESG预算压力。消融实验表明该改进依赖于动态证据输入和三分头分解，而静态ESG分数代理与分数打乱噪声基线几乎无法区分。
AI.conclusion: 将ESG约束与金融策略解耦并通过动态多模态证据学习的约束场进行集成是有效的，静态ESG分数方法在该任务中表现不佳，证明了动态机制特定ESG成本建模的必要性。

title: Central Limit Theorem for Two-Time-Scale Approximate Distributionally Robust RL
summary: Designing model-free algorithms for distributionally robust reinforcement learning (DRRL) poses fundamental challenges. The robust Bellman operator is nonlinear in the transition kernel, which makes one-sample Bellman updates biased, while the adversarial optimization underlying robustness makes robust evaluation computationally demanding. To address these difficulties, we consider the natural small-ambiguity regime under Kullback--Leibler ambiguity sets and propose an approximate DRRL framework based on a first-order expansion of the relevant robust functional. This yields an approximate robust Bellman equation that removes the adversarial optimization while remaining first-order accurate in the ambiguity radius. To learn the fixed point of this approximate equation, we propose Mean-Variance Stochastic Approximation (MVSA), a model-free algorithm that uses only one-sample updates. This is achieved via a lifted stochastic approximation dynamics and a two-time-scale design. We then prove convergence and a central limit theorem for MVSA: its main iterate satisfies a central limit theorem at the canonical $n^{-1/2}$ scale, with explicitly characterized asymptotic covariances. Finally, we validate our theoretical findings with a numerical experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文针对分布鲁棒强化学习（DRRL）中的模型无关算法设计难题，提出了一种基于一阶展开的近似框架，并开发了均方随机逼近（MVSA）算法，在KL散度模糊集下实现了单样本更新的模型无关学习，并证明了其收敛性和中心极限定理。
AI.motivation: 设计分布鲁棒强化学习的模型无关算法面临两大核心挑战：1）鲁棒贝尔曼算子在转移核上的非线性导致单样本贝尔曼更新存在偏差；2）鲁棒性背后的对抗优化使得鲁棒评估计算代价高昂。这些困难阻碍了模型无关DRRL算法的发展。
AI.method: 在KL散度模糊集的小模糊度自然情形下，通过对相关鲁棒泛函进行一阶展开，构建近似鲁棒贝尔曼方程，消除了对抗优化同时保持对模糊半径的一阶精度。进而提出均方随机逼近（MVSA）算法，利用提升的随机逼近动力学和双时间尺度设计，实现仅需单样本更新的模型无关学习。
AI.result: 证明了MVSA算法的收敛性及其主迭代满足标准$n^{-1/2}$收敛速率的中心极限定理，并显式刻画了渐近协方差矩阵。数值实验验证了理论发现。
AI.conclusion: 通过一阶近似框架和双时间尺度随机逼近设计，成功解决了DRRL中模型无关学习的偏差与计算难题，为小模糊度情形下的鲁棒强化学习提供了理论保障和高效算法。

title: How LLMs Are Persuaded: A Few Attention Heads, Rerouted
summary: Language models can be persuaded to abandon factual knowledge. This vulnerability is central to AI safety, but its internal mechanism remains poorly understood. We uncover a compact causal mechanism for persuasion-induced factual errors. A small set of mid-layer attention heads almost entirely determines the model's answer. These heads write answer options into a low-dimensional polyhedron, with options occupying distinct vertices. Persuasion does not blur belief or merely reduce confidence; it causes a discrete latent jump from the correct-answer vertex to the persuasion-target vertex. We show that decision heads are not reasoning over evidence. Instead, they copy whichever option token their attention selects. Persuasion works by redirecting attention. We isolate a rank-one evidence-routing feature that controls the route. Directly modifying this feature steers the model's choice, and removing it blocks persuasion. We then trace the feature back to a band of shallower attention heads that build it from persuasive keywords in the input. Every step is validated by intervention. This mechanism appears across open-source LLMs and realistic poisoning scenarios such as Generative Engine Optimization, revealing persuasion as a narrow, monitorable circuit.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了语言模型被诱导产生事实错误的紧凑因果机制：通过控制中间层少量注意力头及其中的秩一特征，可导致模型在潜在空间中从正确答案顶点跳跃至诱导目标顶点。
AI.motivation: 语言模型容易被诱导放弃事实知识，这是AI安全领域的核心漏洞，但其内部机制尚不明确。作者旨在揭示 persuasion 导致事实错误的具体因果机制，以理解并监控这一安全风险。
AI.method: 通过因果干预和可解释性分析技术，定位并验证了一套紧凑的电路：中间层的决策注意力头将答案选项写入低维多面体的不同顶点；persuasion 通过重定向注意力（而非模糊信念或降低置信度）实现；分离出一个秩一的证据路由特征，可控制模型选择；追踪该特征至更浅层的注意力头从输入中的诱导关键词构建而成。
AI.result: 发现少量中间层注意力头几乎完全决定模型答案；persuasion 导致潜在空间中从正确答案顶点到诱导目标顶点的离散跳跃；决策头不进行推理，而是复制其注意力选中的选项标记；秩一证据路由特征可直接操控模型选择，移除该特征可阻断 persuasion；该机制在开源LLM和现实中毒场景（如生成式引擎优化）中普遍存在。
AI.conclusion: Persuasion 是一个狭窄、可监控的电路：通过精确干预关键注意力头和秩一特征，可理解、预测并防御模型被诱导产生事实错误的脆弱性。

title: Queryable LoRA: Instruction-Regularized Routing Over Shared Low-Rank Update Atoms
summary: We present a data-adaptive method for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large neural networks. Standard low-rank adaptation methods improve efficiency by restricting each layer update to a fixed low-rank form, but this static parameterization can be too rigid when the appropriate correction depends on the input and on the evolving depth-wise computation of the network. Our approach replaces a purely layer-local adapter with a shared queryable memory of low-rank update atoms. For each block of layers, the model forms a query from the current low-rank state and a running summary of previous blocks, uses this query to retrieve a content-dependent combination of shared update components via attention, and applies the resulting routed operator within the low-rank bottleneck. In this way, the method retains the efficiency and scalability of low-rank adaptation while allowing the effective update to vary across inputs and to share reusable structure across layers. The resulting architecture provides a principled middle ground between static LoRA-style updates and fully generated parameter updates: it remains compact and parameter-efficient while supporting dynamic, context-sensitive adaptation. Further, we incorporate instruction-regularization by augmenting routing logits with a language-induced prior over update atoms, thereby biasing the selection of low-rank transformations toward semantically relevant directions without generating unconstrained parameter updates. Experiments on noisy non-linear regression tasks and LLM fine-tuning suggest that this queryable update-memory formulation can improve final test performance and training stability compared to standard low-rank adaptation, while using a comparable number of trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据自适应的参数高效微调方法，通过引入可查询的低秩更新记忆，使模型能够根据输入和深度动态组合共享的更新组件，在保持低秩适应效率的同时提升了性能和训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 标准的低秩适应（LoRA）方法通过将每层的更新限制为固定的低秩形式来提高效率，但这种静态参数化过于僵化，无法适应依赖于输入和网络深度计算变化的动态更新需求。
AI.method: 该方法用共享的可查询低秩更新原子记忆替代纯局层级适配器。对于每个层块，模型根据当前低秩状态和前面块的运行摘要形成查询，通过注意力机制检索内容相关的共享更新组件组合，并将结果路由操作符应用于低秩瓶颈。此外，还引入指令正则化，通过语言诱导的先验增强路由logits，使低秩变换的选择偏向语义相关方向。
AI.result: 在噪声非线性回归任务和大语言模型微调实验中，该方法相比标准低秩适应提升了最终测试性能和训练稳定性，同时使用了相当数量的可训练参数。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在静态LoRA式更新和完全生成的参数更新之间提供了有原则的中间方案，既保持紧凑和参数高效，又支持动态、上下文敏感的自适应，证明了可查询更新记忆机制的有效性。

title: Do Self-Evolving Agents Forget? Capability Degradation and Preservation in Lifelong LLM Agent Adaptation
summary:
Recent advances in LLM agents enable systems that autonomously refine workflows, accumulate reusable skills, self-train their underlying models, and maintain persistent memory. However, we show that such self-evolution is often non-monotonic: adapting to new task distributions can progressively degrade previously acquired capabilities across all major evolution channels.
  We identify this phenomenon as \emph{capability erosion under self-evolution} and show that it consistently emerges across workflow, skill, model, and memory evolution. To mitigate this issue, we propose \emph{Capability-Preserving Evolution} (CPE), a general stabilization principle that constrains destructive capability drift during continual adaptation. Across all four evolution dimensions, CPE consistently improves retained capability stability while preserving adaptation performance. For example, in workflow evolution, CPE improves retained simple-task performance from 41.8\% to 52.8\% under GPT-5.1 optimization while simultaneously achieving stronger complex-task adaptation.
  Our findings suggest that stable long-horizon self-evolving agents require not only acquiring new capabilities, but also explicitly preserving previously learned ones during continual adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLM智能体在自我演化过程中普遍存在的“能力侵蚀”现象，即适应新任务会导致已习得能力的退化，并提出了一种通用的稳定化原则“能力保持演化”（CPE），有效缓解了该问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM智能体已具备自主精炼工作流、积累技能、自训练模型和维持记忆的能力，但作者发现这种自我演化过程往往是非单调的：在适应新任务分布时，智能体会逐步丧失先前获得的能力。为了揭示并解决这一被忽视的根本性挑战，作者开展了此项研究。
AI.method: 作者首先识别并定义了“自我演化下的能力侵蚀”这一现象，证实其存在于工作流、技能、模型和记忆这四大演化维度中。随后，提出了“能力保持演化”（CPE）这一通用稳定化原则，旨在约束持续适应过程中具有破坏性的能力漂移。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，CPE在所有四个演化维度上均能持续改善已保留能力的稳定性，同时不影响适应性能。具体而言，在工作流演化中，CPE将已保留简单任务的性能从41.8%提升至52.8%（GPT-5.1优化下），同时实现了更强的复杂任务适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论指出，构建稳定的长期自我演化智能体，不仅需要获取新能力，更必须在持续适应过程中显式地保留先前习得的能力，这为未来智能体的设计提供了关键指导。

title: Generalized Wasserstein Flow Matching: Transport Plans, Everywhere, All at Once
summary: Flow matching has recently emerged as a flexible and efficient framework for generative modelling by learning deterministic transport dynamics between probability measures. In this work, we extend flow matching to the space of probability measures over probability measures, introducing a Wasserstein-on-Wasserstein (WoW) formulation. Leveraging the nested Wasserstein geometry, we show that measures over transport plans naturally induce velocity fields that realize metameasure flows. This yields a principled generalization of Wasserstein flow matching via coupled outer and inner transport plans. To address the substantial computational cost of WoW transport, we propose scalable approximations based on sliced and linear Wasserstein distances, enabling efficient training while promoting numerically stable, near-straight trajectories. Our framework unifies and extends existing approaches to point cloud and set generation, providing a practical and theoretically grounded method for generative modelling in WoW spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Wasserstein-on-Wasserstein (WoW) 流匹配框架，将流匹配方法扩展到概率测度空间的概率测度空间，通过分层Wasserstein几何实现了元测度流的生成建模。
AI.motivation: 现有的流匹配方法主要应用于标准的概率测度空间，但在处理点云、集合等复杂数据结构时存在局限性。为了提供一个更通用且理论完备的生成建模框架，需要将流匹配扩展到嵌套的概率测度空间中。
AI.method: 基于嵌套Wasserstein几何，证明了传输计划上的测度可以自然地诱导出实现元测度流的速场，通过耦合的外层和内层传输计划推广了Wasserstein流匹配。针对WoW传输的高计算成本问题，提出了基于切片Wasserstein距离和线性Wasserstein距离的可扩展近似方法。
AI.result: 所提出的框架能够统一并扩展现有的点云和集合生成方法，同时近似方法在保证高效训练的同时促进了数值稳定性和近似直线的轨迹生成。
AI.conclusion: WoW流匹配框架为概率测度空间上的生成建模提供了一个实用且理论完备的方法，成功地将流匹配方法推广到更复杂的嵌套测度空间结构中。

title: SKG-VLA: Scene Knowledge Graph Priors for Structured Scene Semantics and Multimodal Reasoning for Decision Making
summary: Decision making in large-scale complaint handling systems increasingly relies on heterogeneous evidence, including complaint narratives, screenshots, order metadata, historical interactions, and platform policies. Existing complaint understanding systems mainly perform shallow classification or template matching over isolated modalities, while underutilizing explicit scene structure, rule knowledge, and cross-evidence dependencies. To address this limitation, we present SKG-VLA for multimodal complaint decision making. The core idea is to model each case as a structured complaint scene and represent its decision-relevant semantics with a \emph{Scene Knowledge Graph} (SKG), which organizes complaint entities, evidence items, policy clauses, temporal events, transactional states, and action-relevant relations into a unified graph. Based on SKG, we build a data synthesis pipeline that generates complaint scene descriptions, rule-consistent graph generalizations, question-answer supervision, and decision recommendations. We further construct a large-scale complaint scene dataset with both text-only and multimodal in-domain benchmarks. Finally, we adopt a three-stage training strategy -- domain-adaptive pre-training, task-oriented instruction fine-tuning, and end-to-end multimodal alignment -- to inject structured scene priors into a multimodal decision model. Experiments show that SKG-VLA consistently improves policy-grounded reasoning, complaint decision accuracy, long-tail generalization, and robustness under incomplete evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SKG-VLA方法，通过构建场景知识图谱（SKG）统一建模投诉实体、证据、政策和关系，结合数据合成管道和三阶段训练策略，显著提升了大规模投诉处理系统的决策准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有投诉理解系统主要对孤立模态进行浅层分类或模板匹配，未能充分利用显式场景结构、规则知识和跨证据依赖关系，限制了决策能力。
AI.method: 1. 将每个案件建模为结构化投诉场景，用场景知识图谱（SKG）统一组织投诉实体、证据项、政策条款、时序事件、交易状态及行动相关关系；2. 构建数据合成管道生成场景描述、规则一致图谱、问答监督和决策建议；3. 构建大规模投诉场景数据集（含纯文本和多模态基准）；4. 采用三阶段训练策略：领域自适应预训练、任务导向指令微调、端到端多模态对齐。
AI.result: SKG-VLA在策略导向推理、投诉决策准确性、长尾泛化能力以及证据不完整情况下的鲁棒性方面均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入结构化场景先验知识，SKG-VLA为大规模多模态投诉决策系统提供了有效解决方案，在多项关键指标上优于现有方法。

title: A meshfree exterior calculus for generalizable and data-efficient learning of physics from point clouds
summary: We introduce a meshfree exterior calculus (MEEC) for learning structure-preserving descriptions of physics on point clouds, and use it to build MEEC-Net, a data-efficient surrogate that transfers across resolutions, geometries, and physical parameters. MEEC equips an $\varepsilon$-ball graph with virtual node and edge measures via a single sparse Schur complement solve; the resulting complex satisfies discrete conservation exactly, is end-to-end differentiable in the point positions, and exposes a direct geometry-to-physics link without the mesh-generation step required by conventional structure-preserving discretizations. MEEC-Net learns unknown physics as a shared edge-wise flux law in an SO($d$)-invariant local frame, so the same kernel produces compatible fluxes on any point cloud whose features lie in the training range. We prove a solution-error bound that splits into discretization and kernel-approximation terms which is independent of problem geometry, explaining the observed transfer from very few examples. We show that single-solution training transfers to unseen geometries, boundary conditions, and physical parameters. On five canonical PDE benchmarks MEEC-Net achieves 1-2 orders of magnitude lower out-of-distribution error than baseline neural-operator approaches. On the SimJEB structural-bracket benchmark it achieves competitive error while using substantially fewer training geometries.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无网格外代数（MEEC）方法，用于在点云上学习保持物理结构的描述，并构建了MEEC-Net数据高效代理模型，能够跨分辨率、几何和物理参数迁移，在基准测试中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统保持结构的离散化方法依赖网格生成步骤，难以直接处理点云数据。本文旨在开发一种无需网格生成的结构保持方法，以实现物理模型在不同分辨率、几何形状和物理参数之间的迁移。
AI.method: 通过稀疏Schur补求解为ε-球图配备虚拟节点和边测度，构建满足离散守恒的复形；该复形关于点位置端到端可微，无需网格生成即可建立几何到物理的直接联系。MEEC-Net在SO(d)不变的局部框架中学习边通量律，使同一核能在特征位于训练范围内的任意点云上产生兼容通量。
AI.result: 证明了误差界限可分解为离散化和核逼近项，且与问题几何无关，解释了从少量样本迁移的现象。在五个典型PDE基准上，MEEC-Net在分布外误差上比基线神经算子方法低1-2个数量级。在SimJEB结构支架基准上，使用更少的训练几何即可达到竞争性误差。单解训练可迁移到未见过的几何、边界条件和物理参数。
AI.conclusion: MEEC成功实现了无网格的结构保持物理建模，MEEC-Net展现出卓越的数据效率和跨域迁移能力，为点云上的物理仿真提供了一种有效的替代方法。

title: Dsat: A Native SAT Solver for Discrete Logic
comment: To Appear at The International Conferences on Theory and Applications of Satisfiability Testing (SAT), 2026
summary: Discrete variables are common in many applications, such as probabilistic reasoning, planning and explainable AI. When symbolic reasoning techniques are brought in to bear on these applications, a standard technique for handling discrete variables is to binarize them into Boolean variables to allow the use of Boolean computational machinery such as SAT solvers. This technique can face both computational and semantical challenges though. In this work, we develop a native SAT solver for discrete logic, which is a direct extension of Boolean logic in which variables can take arbitrary values. Our proposed solver has a similar design to Boolean SAT solvers, with ingredients such as unit resolution and clause learning but ones that operate natively on discrete variables. We illustrate the merits of the developed SAT solver by comparing it empirically to CSP solvers applied to discrete CNFs, to Boolean SAT solver applied to binarized CNFs, and to some hybrid solvers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种原生的离散逻辑SAT求解器，避免了传统二值化方法的计算和语义问题，在实验中表现优于多种现有求解方法。
AI.motivation: 在概率推理、规划和可解释AI等应用中普遍存在离散变量。传统处理方法是将离散变量二值化为布尔变量以利用布尔计算机制（如SAT求解器），但这种技术面临计算和语义两方面的挑战。
AI.method: 开发了一种原生的离散逻辑SAT求解器，这是布尔逻辑的直接扩展，变量可取任意值。该求解器采用与布尔SAT求解器相似的设计，包含单元消解和子句学习等组件，但这些组件直接在离散变量上原生操作。
AI.result: 通过将所开发的SAT求解器与以下方法进行实证比较，展示了其优越性：(1) 应用于离散CNF的CSP求解器；(2) 应用于二值化CNF的布尔SAT求解器；(3) 某些混合求解器。
AI.conclusion: 原生离散SAT求解器能够有效处理离散变量，避免了二值化带来的问题，在实际应用中具有良好的性能表现。

title: TARO: Temporal Adversarial Rectification Optimization Using Diffusion Models as Purifiers
summary: Adversarial purification with diffusion models seeks to project adversarial examples back toward the data manifold, but balancing semantic preservation and robustness against adaptive attacks remains challenging. Recent work shows that standard diffusion purification can fail under adaptive evaluation, while test-time score-based optimization is more resilient. Existing optimization defenses, however, typically rely on a single diffusion noise regime or treat timesteps uniformly, overlooking the distinct roles of coarse and fine denoising scales. We propose Temporal Adversarial Rectification Optimization (TARO), an inference-time purification method that builds a temporally guided score prior from multiple denoising views along the diffusion trajectory. TARO forms a coarse-to-fine residual target: high-noise experts provide globally smoothed structure with reduced adversarial sensitivity, while low-noise experts restore image-specific, class-relevant details. A guidance strength controls this temporal correction, allowing TARO to balance robust global rectification with semantic preservation. Empirically, TARO improves robust accuracy across datasets and adaptive threat models in a zero-shot setting, while remaining compatible with complementary adversarial-likelihood objectives for further robustness gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TARO方法，通过利用扩散模型轨迹上的多尺度去噪先验，实现了对抗样本净化的鲁棒性与语义保持之间的更好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于扩散模型的对抗净化方法在面对自适应攻击时表现不佳，而基于测试时优化的防御方法虽然更具韧性，但通常依赖单一的扩散噪声机制或均匀处理时间步，忽视了粗粒度与细粒度去噪尺度的不同作用，难以同时兼顾防御鲁棒性与语义保留。
AI.method: 提出时间对抗修正优化（TARO），这是一种推理时净化方法。该方法沿扩散轨迹构建时间引导的分数先验，形成粗到细的残差目标：高噪声专家提供全局平滑结构以降低对抗敏感性，低噪声专家恢复图像特定的类别相关细节，并通过引导强度控制时间修正，平衡全局修正与语义保留。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在零样本设置下，TARO在多种数据集和自适应威胁模型中均提升了鲁棒准确率，并且可与互补的对抗似然目标兼容以进一步增强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TARO通过多粒度去噪专家的协作，成功解决了对抗净化中鲁棒性与语义保持的权衡问题，为扩散模型防御自适应攻击提供了一种有效的新思路。

title: CHAINTRIX: A multi-pipeline LLM-augmented framework for automated smart-contract security auditing
summary: Smart-contract exploits have caused billions of USD in cumulative losses, yet audits remain expensive and slow. Automated tools have emerged to close this gap, but each class has a characteristic failure mode. Static analyzers report findings that frequently fail manual triage at high rates, while large language models (LLMs) hallucinate findings that contradict the source code. Thus, we propose Chaintrix, an end-to-end auditing framework whose central architectural commitment is that every LLM-generated claim must be discharged against a deterministic structural contract representation. We introduce a Cross-Contract Interaction Model (CCIM) that parses Solidity into a structured map of function-level reads, writes, modifiers and resolved cross-contract calls. CCIM serves as the substrate against which all 12 of Chaintrix's deterministic signal engines and the parallel LLM audit pipelines operate. A staged false-positive-reduction pipeline, terminating in a Structural Verdict Engine (SVE) that applies deterministic structural checks against parsed code, filters the merged finding set, with selected high-confidence findings further validated through symbolic execution and fuzz testing. We evaluate Chaintrix on EVMbench, the smart-contract security benchmark by OpenAI, Paradigm, OtterSec. Chaintrix detects 86 of 120 high-severity vulnerabilities (71.7% recall), with 25 audits scoring 100% recall, placing Chaintrix 26 percentage points above the strongest frontier-model baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出Chaintrix智能合约审计框架，通过将LLM生成的声明与确定性结构化合约表示进行验证，在EVMbench基准测试中达到71.7%的召回率，超越最强前沿模型基线26个百分点。
AI.motivation: 智能合约漏洞利用已造成数十亿美元损失，但人工审计成本高且速度慢。现有自动化工具存在固有缺陷：静态分析器报告的发现经常无法通过人工分类验证，而大语言模型（LLM）会产生与源代码矛盾的幻觉性发现。
AI.method: 提出Chaintrix端到端审计框架，核心架构原则是每个LLM生成的声明都必须对照确定性的结构化合约表示进行验证。引入跨合约交互模型（CCIM）将Solidity解析为函数级别的读写、修饰符和已解析跨合约调用的结构化映射。CCIM作为所有12个确定性信号引擎和并行LLM审计流水线的操作基础。采用分阶段的假阳性减少流水线，最终通过结构裁决引擎（SVE）对解析后的代码应用确定性结构检查来过滤合并的发现集，选定的高置信度发现进一步通过符号执行和模糊测试进行验证。
AI.result: 在OpenAI、Paradigm、OtterSec发布的智能合约安全基准EVMbench上评估Chaintrix。Chaintrix检测出120个高危漏洞中的86个（召回率71.7%），其中25次审计达到100%召回率，比最强前沿模型基线高出26个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Chaintrix通过将LLM生成的声明与确定性结构化表示相结合的方式，有效解决了现有自动化审计工具的可靠性问题，在智能合约安全审计中取得了显著优于现有方法的性能。

title: DUET: Optimize Token-Budget Allocation for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) generates hundreds of thousands of tokens per training step, with rollout generation dominating the computational cost. The overall token budget can be controlled along two main dimensions: (i) deciding which prompts to allocate rollouts to, and (ii) deciding how long each rollout should be. Prior work has generally controlled only one of these dimensions at a time. We show that jointly tuning both decisions under a shared compute budget improves both reasoning quality and wall-clock training time. We instantiate this view as \textbf{DU}al-controlled tok\textbf{E}n alloca\textbf{T}ion (DUET), a computationally efficient layer over GRPO that uses a lightweight pre-rollout surrogate of prompt informativeness to set how many rollouts each prompt receives, and a marker-gated abort rule with importance reweighting to set when to stop them. On Qwen3-1.7B trained on MATH, DUET outperforms full-budget GRPO and the other three budget-aware baseline methods. DUET's advantage further generalizes to other benchmarks across math and coding, and is on par with the best baseline on the scientific Q\&A domain, while also achieving a $1.62\times$ wall-clock speedup. More notably, using only 50\% of the token budget, DUET still outperforms all baseline methods at their full budget, achieving an even higher $2.51\times$ speedup over full-budget GRPO. We verify the high performance of DUET on other backbone LLMs, including Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct. Notably, the gap between DUET and the strongest baseline \emph{widens} as the budget tightens, contrary to the usual pattern in which efficient methods trade off quality as compute decreases. More broadly, these results suggest that DUET budget-aware control strategies are valuable not only for accelerating training, but also for improving the quality of the learning signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DUET框架，通过联合控制提示词的rollout分配数量和每个rollout的终止长度，在有限计算预算下实现了比全预算GRPO更好的性能和1.62倍的速度提升；仅需50%的token预算即可超越所有全预算基线方法。
AI.motivation: 强化学习可验证奖励（RLVR）的训练成本主要由rollout生成主导。现有工作通常仅控制两个预算维度之一（分配哪些提示词进行rollout，或控制rollout的长度），而单独控制某一维度的效果有限。本文旨在研究如何在共享计算预算下联合优化这两个决策，以同时提升推理质量和训练效率。
AI.method: 提出双控token分配框架（DUET），作为GRPO的高效计算层：1）使用轻量级预rollout代理来评估提示词的信息量，据此决定每个提示词获得的rollout数量；2）设计基于标记的门控中止规则配合重要性重加权，决定何时停止rollout。该方法实现了对提示词分配和rollout长度的联合优化。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B和MATH数据集上，DUET超越全预算GRPO和三个预算感知基线方法；在数学和编程基准测试上表现优异，在科学问答领域与最佳基线持平；实现1.62倍的实际加速。更关键的是，仅使用50%的token预算，DUET仍超越所有全预算基线，达到2.51倍加速。随着预算收紧，DUET与最强基线的性能差距反而扩大，打破了效率方法在计算减少时牺牲质量的常规模式。该方法在Qwen3-4B和Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct等其他骨干LLM上同样验证有效。
AI.conclusion: DUET预算感知控制策略不仅能加速训练，还能改善学习信号质量，表明联合优化rollout分配和长度决策是提升RLVR效率的有效途径。这一发现为计算受限场景下的强化学习训练提供了新思路。

title: The Wittgensteinian Representation Hypothesis: Is Language the Attractor of Multimodal Convergence?
summary: Understanding why independently trained neural networks from different modalities converge toward shared representations, and where this convergence leads, remains an open question in representation learning. All existing evidence relies on symmetric similarity measures, which can detect convergence but are structurally blind to its direction. We introduce directional convergence analysis using cycle-kNN, an asymmetric alignment measure, applied across dozens of independently trained unimodal models spanning point clouds, vision, and language. We uncover a consistent directional asymmetry: non-language modalities move toward the neighborhood structure of language significantly more than the reverse, and this pattern holds across all model families and scales--yet is entirely invisible to symmetric measures. Mechanistic analysis traces the directionality to feature density asymmetry, whereby language representations occupy the most compact regions of representational space. The Information Bottleneck framework provides a principled interpretation: optimization under compression drives representations toward discrete, compositional structures characteristic of language. We formalize this as the Wittgensteinian Representation Hypothesis: the semantic structure of language is the asymptotic attractor of multimodal representation convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文发现不同模态的独立训练模型在表征空间中存在方向性收敛现象：非语言模态会显著地向语言模态的表征结构靠拢，反之不然。这种不对称性源于语言表征具有更高的紧凑性，可用信息瓶颈框架解释，并提出了维特根斯坦表征假设。
AI.motivation: 理解为什么不同模态的独立训练神经网络会收敛到共享表征，以及这种收敛的方向，是表征学习中的开放性问题。现有证据都依赖对称相似性度量，这些方法可以检测收敛但无法识别收敛的方向性。
AI.method: 引入cycle-kNN（一种非对称对齐度量）进行方向性收敛分析，应用于跨点云、视觉和语言的数十个独立训练的单模态模型；并通过机制分析追溯方向性的成因，结合信息瓶颈框架进行理论解释。
AI.result: 发现一致的方向性不对称：非语言模态向语言模态的邻域结构移动的程度显著大于反向，该规律在所有模型家族和规模中均成立，但对称度量完全无法检测到这一现象。机制分析表明，方向性源于特征密度不对称，语言表征占据了表征空间中最紧凑的区域。
AI.conclusion: 提出维特根斯坦表征假设：语言的语义结构是多模态表征收敛的渐近吸引子。信息瓶颈框架提供了原则性解释：压缩约束下的优化驱动表征趋向语言特有的离散化、组合化结构。

title: Direct Bethe Free Energy Minimization for Bayesian Neural Ne twork
summary: We propose training Bayesian neural networks by directly minimizing the Bethe free energy rather than maximizing a variational lower bound. On tree-structured factor graphs the Bethe free energy is exact; deterministic layers drop out of the objective and are trained by standard backpropagation, so the framework accommodates any mixture of probabilistic and deterministic subgraphs without modification. Restricting the weight posterior to a last-layer Gaussian yields analytically tractable losses: for a Gaussian likelihood the Bethe loss equals the exact marginal likelihood, and for a probit likelihood it reduces to a closed form via the probit-Gaussian convolution. Both objectives sit strictly between MAP and the ELBO ($L_\text{MAP} \leq L_\text{Bethe} \leq L_\text{ELBO}$), removing the structural Jensen gap that no choice of variational family can close. The Z-consistent prior formulation makes the prior precision a differentiable parameter, enabling empirical Bayes - joint optimization of weights, covariance, and hyperparameters - in a single gradient pass, with no cross-validation or outer loop. All variants admit a closed-form predictive at MAP-equivalent inference cost, in contrast to ensemble and sampling-based methods. On 8 UCI regression and 12 UCI classification benchmarks evaluated under a single shared hyperparameter regime, Bethe is competitive with standard reference methods at single-pass cost. Independently, joint single-pass empirical Bayes matches grid-search cross-validation of the prior precision on essentially all dataset-variant combinations, eliminating the outer hyperparameter loop without measurable cost. Isolated optimization gaps on a few datasets reflect numerical rather than principled limitations of the framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过直接最小化Bethe自由能来训练贝叶斯神经网络的新方法。该方法在树结构因子图上是精确的，支持概率层和确定性层的任意混合，在8个回归和12个分类基准测试上具有竞争力，同时实现了单次梯度通过的联合经验贝叶斯优化，无需交叉验证。
AI.motivation: 传统的变分推断方法通过最大化证据下界（ELBO）来训练贝叶斯神经网络，但存在结构性的Jensen间隙问题，且没有任何变分族选择能够消除这一间隙。此外，超参数优化通常需要交叉验证或外层循环，计算成本高昂。本文旨在解决这些问题。
AI.method: 作者提出直接最小化Bethe自由能而非最大化变分下界。对于树结构因子图，Bethe自由能是精确的；确定性层通过标准反向传播训练。将权重后验限制为最后一层高斯分布，可获得解析可处理的损失函数：高斯似然下Bethe损失等于精确边际似然，probit似然下可通过probit-高斯卷积得到闭式解。采用Z-consistent先验表述使先验精度成为可微参数，实现了权重、协方差和超参数的联合单次梯度通过优化。
AI.result: Bethe损失严格位于MAP和ELBO之间（$L_\text{MAP} \leq L_\text{Bethe} \leq L_\text{ELBO}$），消除了结构性Jensen间隙。所有变体都支持闭式预测，推理成本与MAP相当。在8个UCI回归和12个UCI分类基准测试中，使用单一共享超参数机制，Bethe方法在单次通过成本下与标准参考方法具有竞争力。联合单次通过经验贝叶斯在几乎所有数据集-变体组合上与先验精度的网格搜索交叉验证相匹配，消除了外层超参数循环。少数数据集上的优化间隙反映的是数值而非框架原则上的局限性。
AI.conclusion: Bethe自由能最小化为贝叶斯神经网络训练提供了一个理论上有原则、实践中高效的框架。它成功消除了变分推断的结构性间隙，实现了真正的单次通过经验贝叶斯优化，无需交叉验证即可自动调整超参数，同时保持与标准方法相当的性能，为贝叶斯深度学习提供了一条新的可行路径。

title: Position: Avoid Overstretching LLMs for every Enterprise Task
summary: Enterprise workloads are dominated by deterministic, structured, and knowledge-dependent tasks operating under strict cost, latency, and reliability constraints. While these are often addressed through large language model (LLM) deployment or distillation into smaller models, we argue this is inefficient, unreliable, and misaligned with enterprise task structures. Instead, AI systems should treat language models as interfaces rather than monolithic engines, externalizing knowledge and computation into dedicated components for greater reliability, scalability, and transparency. Our theoretical evidences show that finite-capacity models cannot fully capture the breadth of knowledge required for enterprise tasks, creating inherent limits to efficiency and interpretability.
