Empirically, weak LGS is a strong diagnostic of goal-level failure across update rules, curricula, larger grids, and bottleneck geometries: the fixed rule LGS <= 0.5 identifies low-success goals with precision 0.921, recall 0.929, and F1 0.925 in the main 8x8 TD setting, with similar performance across variants. However, local support is not sufficient for global success: some supported goals still fail because distant states are captured by competing attractors or fragmented basin structure. We therefore introduce a compact post-hoc taxonomy of policy-induced graphs -- goal-dominant, competitor-dominated, partial/contested, and fragmented -- to characterize residual failure modes beyond local support. These results show that sparse GCRL failures can be understood as structured policy-induced dynamics, and that local one-step policy structure provides a cheap post-training diagnostic for goal-level failure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出局部目标支持（LGS）作为稀疏目标条件强化学习中的目标级故障诊断工具，并建立了策略诱导图的分类法来表征残差故障模式。
AI.motivation: 稀疏目标条件强化学习产生的策略可能存在隐藏的故障，这些故障会被总体成功率所掩盖。需要深入理解学习策略中的局部到全局结构，以识别和诊断目标级故障。
AI.method: 通过贪婪评估诱导的确定性功能图分析训练的目标条件值策略：对每个目标，每个状态映射到单个后继状态，将行为分解为吸引子和盆地。定义局部目标支持（LGS）作为一步统计量，测量有效邻居状态中贪婪后继为目标的比例。引入策略诱导图的事后分类法：目标主导、竞争者主导、部分/有争议和碎片化。
AI.result: 在确定性稀疏GridWorlds中，零LGS精确排除了从非目标开始的目标进入。经验表明，弱LGS是跨更新规则、课程、更大网格和瓶颈几何结构的目标级故障的强诊断指标。固定规则LGS≤0.5在主要8x8 TD设置中以精度0.921、召回率0.929和F1 0.925识别低成功目标，在变体中具有类似性能。同时也发现局部支持对全局成功不足：某些支持目标仍因远距离状态被竞争吸引子捕获或盆地结构碎片化而失败。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏GCRL故障可以理解为结构化的策略诱导动力学，局部一步策略结构为目标级故障提供了廉价的后训练诊断方法。局部支持是必要但不充分条件，需要结合策略诱导图的分类法来全面表征故障模式。

title: Adversary-Robust Learning from Fully Asynchronous Directional Derivative Estimates
summary: We propose FAR-SIGN (Fully Asynchronous Robust optimization via SIGNed directional projections) for adversary-resilient learning in parameter-server--worker systems. FAR-SIGN achieves robustness through sign-based updates along carefully designed directions and mitigates the resulting bias via a two-timescale mechanism. It admits both first-order and zeroth-order implementations and enables fully asynchronous execution without requiring a private reference dataset at the server. We establish almost-sure convergence of FAR-SIGN to the set of stationary points for smooth, nonconvex objectives. Moreover, we prove the near-optimal rate of $O(n^{-1/4+ε})$ in the first-order setting and the standard $O(n^{-1/6+ε})$ in the zeroth-order setting, where $n$ is the iteration count and $ε>0$ can be chosen arbitrarily small. Experiments on MNIST show that FAR-SIGN outperforms robust aggregation-based methods in both accuracy and wall-clock time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FAR-SIGN算法，用于参数服务器-工作者系统中的抗对抗学习。该算法通过基于符号的更新实现鲁棒性，采用双时间尺度机制消除偏差，支持一阶和零阶实现的完全异步执行，收敛率分别为O(n^{-1/4+ε})和O(n^{-1/6+ε})。
AI.motivation: 在参数服务器-工作者系统中，分布式学习容易受到对抗性攻击的影响。现有的鲁棒聚合方法存在性能瓶颈，且通常依赖私有参考数据集或同步执行，限制了其实际应用。因此需要设计一种既能保证鲁棒性又能实现完全异步执行且不依赖私有参考数据集的优化算法。
AI.method: 提出FAR-SIGN（通过符号方向投影的完全异步鲁棒优化）算法：1）沿精心设计的方向使用基于符号的更新实现鲁棒性；2）通过双时间尺度机制缓解符号更新带来的偏差；3）支持一阶和零阶两种实现方式；4）无需服务器端的私有参考数据集即可实现完全异步执行。
AI.result: 理论结果：对光滑非凸目标函数，建立了FAR-SIGN到平稳点集的几乎必然收敛性；证明了接近最优的一阶设置收敛率O(n^{-1/4+ε})和标准的零阶设置收敛率O(n^{-1/6+ε})，其中n为迭代次数，ε>0可任意小。实验结果：在MNIST数据集上，FAR-SIGN在准确率和实际运行时间方面均优于基于鲁棒聚合的方法。
AI.conclusion: FAR-SIGN成功实现了在参数服务器-工作者系统中的抗对抗学习，通过创新的符号更新和双时间尺度机制，在保证理论收敛性的同时实现了实际性能的提升，为分布式鲁棒优化提供了一个有效的解决方案。

title: Selection Plateau and a Sparsity-Dependent Hierarchy of Pruning Features
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Empirical study + framework hypothesis on ViT-Small/CIFAR-10. Cross-domain validation (vision token pruning, KV cache compression, MoE routing) and cross-architecture extensions deferred to follow-up work
summary: We identify a Selection Plateau phenomenon in one-shot neural network pruning: all rank-monotone weight scorers converge to identical accuracy at fixed sparsity, independent of functional form. We propose the Sparsity-Information-Complexity Spectrum (SICS) hypothesis: a sparsity-dependent minimum feature complexity kappa(S) governs plateau escape, with kappa=0 sufficient at low sparsity (S<0.65), kappa=1 dominant at critical sparsity (S~0.7), and kappa=2 necessary at extreme sparsity (S>0.75). On ViT-Small/CIFAR-10, testing nine feature classes across four sparsities, smooth non-monotone features provide +6.6% escape at S=0.7, while only raw features with high-frequency wiggle escape at S=0.8 (+2.6%). A fake non-monotone scorer underperforms the gradient baseline, indicating the requirement is magnitude-independent non-monotonicity. A handcrafted Gaussian bump achieves only +0.006 escape vs. chaos-derived +0.046, indicating rank-alignment is necessary but insufficient. SICS provides a unifying explanation for the performance clustering of diverse pruning methods and suggests that future selection algorithms should adapt feature complexity to target sparsity.

AI.tldr: 本文发现了单次神经网络剪枝中的“选择平台”现象，并提出了SICS假设来解释如何突破该平台：需根据目标稀疏度自适应调整特征复杂度。
AI.motivation: 研究者观察到在单次神经网络剪枝中存在一种“选择平台”现象：在固定稀疏度下，所有秩单调的权重评分器无论函数形式如何，最终都会收敛到相同的精度。为了解释这一现象并探索如何突破该平台，作者开展了此项研究。
AI.method: 作者提出了“稀疏度-信息-复杂度谱”（SICS）假设，认为存在一个依赖于稀疏度的最小特征复杂度κ(S)来决定能否突破平台。研究在ViT-Small/CIFAR-10数据集上，测试了九种特征类别在四种稀疏度下的表现，并对比了平滑非单调特征、高频振荡特征、伪非单调评分器以及手工设计的高斯凸起与混沌派生特征的效果。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：(1) 在临界稀疏度S=0.7时，平滑非单调特征可提供+6.6%的突破增益；(2) 在极端稀疏度S=0.8时，仅有带高频振荡的原始特征能实现突破（+2.6%）；(3) 伪非单调评分器表现不及梯度基线，说明需要幅度无关的非单调性；(4) 手工高斯凸起仅带来+0.006的增益，而混沌派生特征带来+0.046，表明秩对齐是必要但不充分条件。
AI.conclusion: SICS假说为不同剪枝方法的性能聚类现象提供了统一的解释，表明未来的选择算法应根据目标稀疏度自适应地调整特征复杂度，以有效突破选择平台现象。

title: FLAME: Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts for Continual Multimodal Multi-Task Learning
summary: Real-world model deployment across multiple domains requires multimodal models to operate under two complementary regimes: (1) multi-task pretraining, tasks are co-available at design time where related tasks could borrow representational strength from one another, (2) continual adaptation, in which new tasks emerge after deployment with previously unseen modality combinations. However, neither regime alone suffices: the pretraining task set is never exhaustive, while bypassing joint training forfeits the transfer gains and efficiency among co-trainable tasks. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a natural fit for this dual requirement: sparse activation enables modular capacity expansion as new tasks arrive, while routing decouples modality-level computation from task-level composition. In this work, we propose a scalable MoE framework for multitask pretraining and continual learning across flexible modality combinations. The framework is designed to support training on multimodal tasks with diverse modality configurations by leveraging modality-specific routers that process tokens from each modality across tasks. Furthermore, it enables continual learning over sequential multimodal tasks within a fixed-capacity MoE by compressing accumulated expert knowledge into low-rank memory subspaces, while expanding only the lightweight routers. We validate the effectiveness of our method on multiple healthcare multimodal benchmarks. It demonstrates competitive multitask pretraining performance while alleviating catastrophic forgetting and improving parameter efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可扩展的稀疏专家混合(MoE)框架，通过模态特定路由器支持多任务预训练，并利用低秩记忆子空间压缩知识以实现持续学习，有效解决了多模态模型在预训练任务不完整和持续适应新任务之间的矛盾。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的模型部署面临双重需求：多任务预训练（设计时任务共现，可互相借鉴表征能力）和持续适应（部署后出现新任务和未见过的模态组合）。然而，仅依靠任一机制都不充分：预训练任务集永远无法穷尽，而跳过联合训练又会损失任务间的迁移增益和效率。稀疏专家混合(MoE)天然适合这一双重需求，因为稀疏激活支持模块化容量扩展，路由机制解耦了模态级计算与任务级组合。
AI.method: 提出了一种可扩展的MoE框架，用于跨灵活模态组合的多任务预训练和持续学习。该框架利用模态特定路由器处理各任务中来自每个模态的token，支持训练具有多样化模态配置的多模态任务。对于持续学习，该方法通过将累积的专家知识压缩到低秩记忆子空间中，在固定容量的MoE内实现对顺序多模态任务的学习，同时仅扩展轻量级路由器。
AI.result: 在多个医疗多模态基准测试上验证了方法的有效性。该方法展示了具有竞争力的多任务预训练性能，同时减轻了灾难性遗忘并提高了参数效率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功统一了多任务预训练和持续学习两个阶段，通过MoE架构的稀疏激活和路由机制，实现了在新任务到来时的模块化容量扩展，并通过低秩记忆压缩有效平衡了知识保留与模型扩展，为多模态模型的实际部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: Skill-R1: Agent Skill Evolution via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic large language models often rely on skills, reusable natural language procedures that guide planning, action, and tool use. In practice, skills are typically improved through prompt engineering or by aligning the task LLM itself, which is costly, model-specific, and often infeasible for closed-source models. Skill optimization is not a one-step problem but a recurrent process with two coupled levels of credit assignment: a useful skill must improve rollout quality under current conditioning, while a useful revision must turn observed outcomes into a better skill for the next round. We propose Skill-R1, a reinforcement learning framework for instance-level recurrent skill optimization from verifiable rewards. Rather than updating the task LLM, Skill-R1 trains a lightweight skill generator that conditions on the task context, prior rollouts, and their verified outcomes to produce skills that steer a frozen task LLM. This preserves black-box compatibility with both open- and closed-source models while making adaptation substantially cheaper than model-level updates. Skill-R1 proceeds over multiple generations: at each step, the current skill induces rollouts whose verified outcomes are fed back to produce the next revision. To optimize this recurrent process, we introduce a bi-level group-relative policy optimization objective combining intra-generation and inter-generation advantages. The intra-generation term compares rollouts under shared skill conditioning, while the inter-generation term rewards revisions that improve behavior across successive generations. Together, these provide a principled objective for directional skill evolution rather than one-shot self-refinement. Empirically, Skill-R1 achieves consistent gains over no-skill baselines and standard GRPO across benchmarks with verifiable rewards, with particularly strong improvements on complex, multi-step tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Skill-R1强化学习框架，通过训练轻量级技能生成器来优化Agent LLM的技能，无需修改任务模型本身，实现低成本、跨代的技能迭代优化。
AI.motivation: 现有Agent LLM的技能优化主要依赖提示工程或任务模型对齐，这些方法成本高、模型特定，且对闭源模型不可行。技能优化是一个循环过程，涉及双层信用分配问题：有用的技能需在当前条件下提升执行质量，有用的修正需将观察结果转化为下一轮更好的技能。
AI.method: 提出Skill-R1强化学习框架，训练轻量级技能生成器而非更新任务LLM。生成器以任务上下文、先前执行轨迹及其验证结果为条件生成技能，指导冻结的任务LLM。引入双层组相对策略优化目标：代内优势项比较共享技能条件下的执行轨迹，代间优势项奖励跨代改进行为修正。通过多代迭代实现技能的定向演化。
AI.result: 在具有可验证奖励的基准测试中，Skill-R1相比无技能基线和标准GRPO取得一致提升，在复杂多步任务上改进尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: Skill-R1为Agent LLM提供了一种模型无关、成本高效的技能优化方案，通过双层优化目标实现了技能的跨代定向演化，在复杂任务上表现优异。

title: Your Simulation Runs but Solves the Wrong Physics: PDE-Grounded Intent Verification for LLM-Generated Multiphysics Simulation Code
summary: Execution-based evaluation of LLM-generated code implicitly treats successful execution as a proxy for correctness. In scientific simulation, this proxy is insufficient: a generated input file can run, mesh, and converge while encoding governing equations that differ from the user's intent. We call this mismatch between intended physics and generated code the comprehension-generation gap. We instantiate this in MOOSE, where Kernel and BC objects map compositionally to weak-form residual terms, enabling deterministic reconstruction of the encoded PDE and comparison against an intended contract. We formalize this comparison as the Intent Fidelity Score (IFS), a structural metric covering governing terms, BCs, ICs, coefficients, and time scheme. Building on IFS, we develop a PDE-grounded refinement loop that uses deterministic violation reports to correct generated code iteratively. We evaluate on MooseBench, a 220-case multiphysics benchmark with PDE-level ground truth released with this work. On this benchmark, our method consistently improves mean IFS over direct generation, with gains concentrated on hard cases. On the subset where direct generation falls below IFS 0.7, refinement adds +0.22 to +0.41 absolute IFS. In the deployment audit, execution-only repair improves execution success while leaving 39-40% of all 220 cases runnable but still solving the wrong physics across the three main deployment-audit models, exposing executability and intent fidelity as separable failure modes. Static proof-of-concept experiments on four PDE-oriented DSLs (UFL/FEniCS, FreeFEM, FiPy, and Devito) suggest that the reconstruction-and-comparison pattern extends beyond MOOSE. These findings reinforce that executable simulation code should be verified against the mathematical structure it is intended to encode, not accepted on execution alone.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了科学仿真代码生成中“理解-生成差距”问题：可执行代码可能编码错误的物理方程。提出意图保真度分数（IFS）量化PDE结构与意图的匹配度，并开发基于IFS的迭代精化方法。在MooseBench基准上，精化方法在困难案例上将IFS提升0.22-0.41，而仅修复执行错误的代码仍有39-40%求解错误物理。
AI.motivation: 现有基于执行的LLM代码评估方法将成功执行作为正确性代理，但在科学仿真中这一代理不足：生成的输入文件可以成功运行、网格化和收敛，却编码了与用户意图不同的控制方程。作者将这种意图物理与生成代码之间的失配称为“理解-生成差距”，需要新的评估范式。
AI.method: 1. 在MOOSE框架中实例化问题，利用Kernel和BC对象组合映射到弱形式残差项，实现编码PDE的确定性重建；2. 形式化提出意图保真度分数（IFS），作为覆盖控制项、边界条件、初始条件、系数和时间方案的结构化度量；3. 开发基于IFS的PDE引导精化循环，利用确定性违规报告迭代修正生成代码；4. 发布包含220个案例的多物理基准MooseBench，提供PDE级真值。
AI.result: 在MooseBench上，精化方法相比直接生成持续提升平均IFS，增益集中在困难案例：对直接生成IFS<0.7的子集，精化增加+0.22到+0.41绝对IFS。部署审计显示，仅执行修复提升执行成功率，但三模型中39-40%的案例仍可运行但求解错误物理，暴露可执行性与意图保真度为可分离失败模式。在UFL/FEniCS、FreeFEM、FiPy和Devito四个PDE导向DSL上的静态概念验证实验表明重建-比较模式可推广。
AI.conclusion: 可执行的仿真代码应根据其意图编码的数学结构进行验证，而非仅凭执行通过即接受。执行成功与物理意图保真是两个独立目标，需要结构化的PDE级验证方法来弥合理解-生成差距。

title: Near-Optimal Last-Iterate Convergence for Zero-Sum Games with Bandit Feedback and Opponent Actions
summary:
Last-iterate convergence of learning dynamics in games has attracted significant recent attention. In two-player zero-sum games with bandit feedback, where only the loss of the selected action pair is observed, Fiegel et al. (2025) show a separation between average-iterate and last-iterate convergence in duality gap: while the optimal t^(-1/2) rate after t rounds is achievable for the former via standard no-regret algorithms, the latter cannot converge faster than t^(-1/3) in expectation or t^(-1/4) with high probability. However, in many practical settings, such as preference learning, the players observe not only their loss but also the opponent's action. This raises a natural question: can such additional information enable faster last-iterate convergence?
  We answer this question affirmatively, showing that t^(-1/2) last-iterate convergence is achievable with high probability in this setting, via an efficient algorithm that updates its strategy infrequently by solving an estimated log-barrier-regularized game. We identify fundamental obstacles preventing standard analysis for multi-armed bandits, the single-player case, from generalizing to games, and develop a novel analysis to overcome them. Experiments confirm that our algorithm indeed converges faster than naive baselines and prior methods that do not exploit opponent-action feedback. Finally, we note that our results also improve those for dueling bandits, a special case with skew-symmetric game matrices.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了博弈学习中的末次迭代收敛问题，发现在能观察到对手动作的设置下，通过一种低频更新对数障碍正则化博弈估计的高效算法，可以高概率实现O(t^{-1/2})的收敛率，优于仅能观察到损失反馈时的理论下界。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明，在两人零和博弈的强盗反馈设置下（仅能观察到所选动作对的损失），末次迭代的收敛速率存在理论下界（期望O(t^{-1/3)，高概率O(t^{-1/4)），慢于平均迭代的最优O(t^{-1/2)速率。然而，在实际场景（如偏好学习）中，玩家往往能同时观察到对手的动作。本文旨在探究这一额外信息是否能打破现有理论瓶颈，实现更快的末次迭代收敛。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种高效算法，其核心机制是“低频更新”：通过求解一个带对数障碍正则化的博弈估计问题来更新策略，而非每轮更新。在分析层面，作者指出标准多臂老虎机分析方法无法直接推广至博弈场景，因此开发了一套新颖的分析框架来克服这些根本性障碍。
AI.result: 理论结果表明，在能观察到对手动作的设置下，该算法能以高概率实现O(t^{-1/2)的末次迭代收敛速率，填补了与平均迭代收敛速率之间的差距。实验结果证实，该算法收敛速度确实快于未利用对手动作反馈的朴素基线及现有方法。此外，该结果还改进了决斗强盗这一特例情形下的已有结论。
AI.conclusion: 本文不仅肯定地回答了利用对手动作反馈能否实现更快末次迭代收敛的问题，突破了强盗反馈下的理论限制，还为博弈学习动态的分析提供了新的技术手段，具有重要的理论与实践意义。

title: Multi-scale Predictive Representations for Goal-conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper investigates robust representation learning in offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL). Particularly in sparse reward scenarios, learning representations that align state and goal latents is a challenge that frequently culminates in representation divergence where the encoder drifts toward a low-dimensional, goal-agnostic subspace that destabilizes policy learning. We address this issue by showing that an agent must acquire a fundamental understanding of its environment across multiple scales, from local physical dynamics to long-horizon goal-directed structure. Building on this insight, we propose Ms.PR, a framework that leverages multi-scale predictive supervision to enforce goal-directed alignment within the latent space. We demonstrate that Ms.PR leads to improved representation quality and strong performance on both vision and state-based tasks. Furthermore, we show that our approach is exceptionally resilient under realistic, challenging data regimes, maintaining state-of-the-art performance across a wide variety of tasks, trajectory stitching scenarios, and extreme noise conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ms.PR框架，通过多尺度预测监督解决离线目标条件强化学习中的表示发散问题，在稀疏奖励和极端噪声条件下实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 在离线目标条件强化学习中，特别是稀疏奖励场景下，状态和目标潜在表示的对齐是一个关键挑战。现有方法经常出现表示发散问题，编码器会漂移到低维的、与目标无关的子空间，从而破坏策略学习的稳定性。
AI.method: 提出Ms.PR框架，利用多尺度预测监督来强制潜在空间内的目标导向对齐。该方法使智能体能够在多个尺度上获得对环境的理解，从局部物理动力学到长期目标导向结构。
AI.result: Ms.PR在视觉和状态任务上均表现出改进的表示质量和强大的性能。该方法在现实的、具有挑战性的数据机制下表现出卓越的韧性，在轨迹拼接场景和极端噪声条件下都能保持最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过多尺度预测监督可以有效解决离线目标条件强化学习中的表示发散问题，该方法在各种任务和挑战性条件下都具有很强的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: Learning-Augmented Scalable Linear Assignment Problem Optimization via Neural Dual Warm-Starts
summary: The Linear Assignment Problem (LAP) is a fundamental combinatorial optimization task with applications ranging from computer vision to logistics. Classical exact solvers such as the Hungarian and Jonker-Volgenant (LAPJV) algorithms guarantee optimality, but their cubic time complexity $\mathcal{O}(N^{3})$ becomes a bottleneck for large-scale instances. Recent learning-based approaches aim to replace these solvers with neural models, often sacrificing exactness or failing to scale due to memory constraints. We propose a learning-augmented framework that accelerates exact assignment solvers while maintaining optimality and worst-case guarantees. Our method predicts dual variables to warm-start a classical solver, with a fallback that prevents asymptotic runtime degradation when the learned advice is unreliable. We introduce RowDualNet, a lightweight row-independent architecture that avoids the $\mathcal{O}(N^{2})$ memory bottleneck of graph-based models, enabling neural warm-starting at large scale ($N=16{,}384$). Feasibility is ensured via a constructive mechanism based on LP duality (namely, the Min-Trick), eliminating costly iterative projection. Empirically, our approach reduces the search effort of LAPJV and achieves over $2{\times}$ speedups on challenging synthetic distributions, in addition to improving over $1.25{\times}$ and $1.5{\times}$ on real-world tracking (MOT) and transportation (LPT) datasets, respectively, while strictly maintaining full optimality, effectively yielding a robust zero-shot generalization to real-world tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种学习增强框架，通过预测对偶变量来热启动经典求解器，在保持最优性的前提下显著加速了线性分配问题（LAP）的求解。
AI.motivation: 经典的线性分配问题精确求解器（如匈牙利算法和LAPJV）虽然保证最优性，但其立方时间复杂度在大规模问题上成为瓶颈。现有学习型方法往往牺牲最优性或受限于内存约束无法扩展。
AI.method: 提出RowDualNet轻量级行独立架构，预测对偶变量热启动经典求解器；引入基于线性规划对偶的Min-Trick构造机制确保可行性；设计回退机制防止学习建议不可靠时的渐近运行时退化。
AI.result: 方法避免了$\mathcal{O}(N^{2})$内存瓶颈，可扩展至$N=16,384$规模；在挑战性合成分布上实现超过$2\times$加速；在真实世界追踪（MOT）数据集上提升超过$1.25\times$，在交通（LPT）数据集上提升$1.5\times$。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在严格保持最优性的同时实现了显著加速，并对真实世界任务展现出鲁棒的零样本泛化能力，有效解决了大规模线性分配问题的效率瓶颈。

title: D2ACE: Multi-Label Batch Selection Guided by Dual Dynamics and Adaptive Correlation Enhancement
summary: Batch selection is crucial for improving both training efficiency and predictive performance in deep multi-label classification (MLC). Existing batch selection methods typically rely on a single metric to assess instance importance and use static label weights to distinguish label significance, neglecting the dynamic evolution of metric utility and label significance during training. In addition, the method that explicitly exploits label correlations is largely affected by abundant irrelevant labels and insensitive to local label distributions. To address these issues, we propose D2ACE, a novel multi-label batch selection method guided by Dual Dynamics and Adaptive Correlation Enhancement. D2ACE explicitly captures metric and label-level training dynamics by combining stage-wise Bernoulli mixture sampling, which balances uncertainty and noise-resistant hardness, with dynamic label weighting to recalibrate label priorities at each epoch based on current metric statistics. Furthermore, D2ACE introduces a local context-aware correlation enhancement to focus on relevant labels with instance-adaptive dependencies. Extensive experiments on tabular and image benchmarks demonstrate that D2ACE outperforms existing batch selection approaches across various deep MLC models, achieving stronger predictive performance and more efficient correlation modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了D2ACE方法，通过双动态机制和自适应相关性增强来解决多标签分类中批选择存在的度量单一、标签权重静态和标签相关性建模不足的问题，在多个基准数据集上取得了优于现有方法的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度多标签分类批选择方法存在三个主要局限性：(1)依赖单一度量评估实例重要性，忽略了度量效用和标签重要性在训练过程中的动态演化；(2)使用静态标签权重区分标签显著性，无法适应训练动态；(3)显式利用标签相关性的方法受大量不相关标签影响，且对局部标签分布不敏感。
AI.method: 提出D2ACE方法，包含两个核心组件：首先，通过阶段性伯努利混合采样结合动态标签加权，显式捕获度量和标签级别的训练动态，平衡不确定性与抗噪声难度，并在每个epoch根据当前度量统计量重新校准标签优先级；其次，引入局部上下文感知的相关性增强机制，专注于具有实例自适应依赖性的相关标签。
AI.result: 在表格和图像基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，D2ACE在各种深度多标签分类模型上均优于现有批选择方法，实现了更强的预测性能和更高效的相关性建模。
AI.conclusion: D2ACE通过双动态机制和自适应相关性增强有效解决了多标签批选择中的关键问题，为深度多标签分类提供了更高效的训练策略和更好的预测性能。

title: Sparsity Moves Computation: How FFN Architecture Reshapes Attention in Small Transformers
summary: Architectural choices inside the Transformer feedforward network (FFN) block do not merely affect the block itself; they reshape the computations learned by the rest of the model. We study this effect in one-layer Transformers trained on digit addition with carry, modular arithmetic, and histogram counting. Comparing dense FFNs, gated linear units (GLUs), mixture-of-experts (MoE), and MoE-GLUs, we find that sparse MoE routing can shift computation from FFN to attention, with the strongest ablation-visible effect on carry-based addition. We decompose this redistribution into reduced per-token FFN capacity and sparse partitioning across experts. Critically, frozen random routing nearly matches learned routing, suggesting that redistribution is driven largely by architectural sparsity rather than router-learned specialization. As a secondary finding, GLU-style multiplicative gating rotates task-relevant Fourier structure out of the per-neuron basis and into distributed subspaces, making neuron-level interpretability less informative while preserving structured computation. We validate these conclusions with random-routing, narrow-FFN, and top-2 MoE controls, plus parameter-matching, activation-function, and width-scaling analyses. Together, these results show that local FFN design choices can have nonlocal consequences for Transformer computation.

AI.tldr: 通过研究单层Transformer在算术任务上的表现，发现FFN块的结构选择（特别是稀疏MoE路由）会将计算从FFN转移到注意力层，且这种重分配主要由架构稀疏性而非路由器学习驱动。
AI.motivation: 探究Transformer前馈网络（FFN）块的架构选择如何影响模型其他部分的计算，揭示局部设计选择对整体计算模式的非局部影响。
AI.method: 在单层Transformer上训练数字进位加法、模运算和直方图计数任务，对比密集FFN、门控线性单元（GLU）、专家混合（MoE）和MoE-GLU等架构；采用随机路由、窄FFN、参数匹配和宽度缩放等多种对照实验进行验证。
AI.result: 稀疏MoE路由将计算从FFN转移到注意力层，在进位加法任务上效果最显著；冻结随机路由性能接近学习路由，表明重分配主要由架构稀疏性驱动；GLU门控机制将任务相关傅里叶结构从单神经元基旋转至分布式子空间。
AI.conclusion: FFN块的局部设计选择（如稀疏性、门控机制）会对Transformer的计算分布产生非局部影响，架构稀疏性比路由器学习的专业化更关键，这对理解和设计Transformer架构具有重要启示。

title: Let the Target Select for Itself: Data Selection via Target-Aligned Paths
summary: Targeted data selection aims to identify training samples from a large candidate pool that improve performance on a specific downstream task. Many recent methods estimate candidate utility by aggregating local attribution scores along a trajectory induced by the candidate pool. When the pool is heterogeneous, however, this reference trajectory may be misaligned with the dynamics of a target-aligned selected subset, creating what we call reference path bias. We propose an alternative reference path: a validation-induced flow obtained from a short, capacity-limited warmup on the available target validation proxy. Along this path, candidates are scored by a normalized endpoint loss drop, yielding a simple zero-order selection rule that requires no candidate gradients or Hessian approximations. Across controlled logistic, vision, and instruction-tuning experiments, this score is competitive with strong dynamic attribution baselines while substantially reducing warmup and storage cost. Moreover, since the reference trajectory is decoupled from any specific candidate pool, the same compact warmup can be reused across additional pools without recomputing the trajectory.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于验证集引导流的参考路径，通过归一化终点损失下降来评分候选样本，解决了现有方法中的参考路径偏差问题，在降低计算成本的同时保持了竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有的目标导向数据选择方法在估计候选样本效用时，通过聚合候选池诱导轨迹上的局部归因分数。当候选池具有异质性时，这种参考轨迹可能与目标对齐的选定子集动态不一致，产生所谓的“参考路径偏差”。
AI.method: 提出一种替代参考路径：通过对可用的目标验证代理进行短时间、容量受限的预热，获得验证诱导流。在此路径上，使用归一化终点损失下降对候选样本进行评分，形成一种简单的零阶选择规则，无需候选梯度或Hessian近似。
AI.result: 在受控的逻辑回归、视觉任务和指令调优实验中，该方法与强动态归因基线具有竞争力，同时大幅降低了预热和存储成本。由于参考轨迹与特定候选池解耦，相同的紧凑预热可在不同池间复用，无需重新计算轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了参考路径偏差问题，提供了一种高效、可复用的数据选择方案，在多个任务上验证了其有效性和实用性。

title: GravityGraphSAGE: Link Prediction in Directed Attributed Graphs
summary: Link prediction (inferring missing or future connections between nodes in a graph) is a fundamental problem in network science with widespread applications in, e.g., biological systems, recommender systems, finance and cybersecurity. The ability to accurately predict links has significant real-world applications, such as detecting fraudulent financial transactions or identifying drug-target interactions in biomedicine. Despite a rich literature, link prediction is still challenging, especially for graphs enriched with information on edges (direction) and nodes (attributes). In fact, research on link prediction, especially the one based on Graph Deep Learning (GDL), has mostly focused on undirected graphs, without fully leveraging node attributes. Here, we fill this gap by proposing Gravity-GraphSAGE (GG-SAGE), a modified version of GraphSAGE, a GDL model for node embeddings, composed of a gravity-inspired decoder. This implementation is the first example in the literature of a GraphSAGE backbone adopted for directed link prediction. Using the benchmark datasets Cora, Citeseer, PubMed and 16 real-world graphs from the online Netzschleuder repository, we show that our proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art GDL link prediction techniques. Using further experimental evidence, we relate the quality of the output of our model with various characteristics of the graph, suggesting that our framework scales well when applied to data of increasing complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出了Gravity-GraphSAGE (GG-SAGE)模型，这是首个基于GraphSAGE骨干网络的有向图链接预测方法，通过融合重力机制解码器，在有向图和节点属性的链接预测任务上超越了现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的图深度学习链接预测研究主要集中于无向图，未能充分利用节点属性信息。然而，现实中的许多网络（如金融交易、生物网络）本质上是有向的且包含丰富的节点属性。如何有效处理有向图并充分利用节点属性进行精准的链接预测，是当前研究的重要缺口。
AI.method: 提出了Gravity-GraphSAGE (GG-SAGE)模型，这是GraphSAGE的改进版本。该模型创新性地引入了受重力机制启发的解码器（gravity-inspired decoder），使其能够处理有向图的链接预测问题。这是文献中首个将GraphSAGE骨干网络用于有向链接预测的实现。
AI.result: 在Cora、Citeseer、PubMed基准数据集以及Netzschleuder仓库的16个真实世界图数据上进行了广泛实验。结果表明，GG-SAGE在链接预测任务上优于当前最先进的图深度学习技术。进一步分析显示，模型性能与图的多种特征相关，且在面对复杂度增加的数据时表现出良好的扩展性。
AI.conclusion: GG-SAGE成功填补了有向图链接预测的研究空白，证明了将重力机制融入图神经网络的有效性。该模型不仅性能优越，还具有良好的可扩展性，为生物系统、推荐系统、金融和网络安全等领域的链接预测应用提供了新的解决方案。

title: A Controlled Diagnostic Study of Hardware-Induced Distortions in Hardware-Aware Training
summary: Hardware-aware training (HAT) is widely used to improve the robustness of neural networks on non-ideal AI accelerators, such as analog in-memory computing (IMC) systems. However, not all hardware-induced distortions are equally compensable by training. This paper presents a diagnostic framework that models hardware non-idealities as structured perturbations of the forward operator and evaluates their compatibility with gradient-based optimization. We analyze six representative perturbation classes--read noise, variability, drift, stuck-at faults, IR-drop, and ADC discretization--and identify three key diagnostics: gradient expectation consistency, bounded gradient variance, and non-degenerate sensitivity. Our results show a clear separation between perturbations that can be compensated by HAT and those that consistently break optimization. This provides practical guidance for hardware-software co-design, clarifying which non-idealities can be addressed at the training level and which require circuit-, architecture-, or calibration-level mitigation. This study should be interpreted as a controlled empirical analysis under vanilla forward-perturbation HAT, rather than as a universal theory of hardware-aware training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个诊断框架，用于分析六种硬件非理想特性（读噪声、变异性、漂移、固定故障、IR压降和ADC离散化）在硬件感知训练中的可补偿性，明确了哪些可以通过训练解决，哪些需要硬件层面的缓解。
AI.motivation: 尽管硬件感知训练（HAT）被广泛用于提高神经网络在非理想AI加速器（如模拟存内计算系统）上的鲁棒性，但并非所有硬件引起的失真都能通过训练得到同等程度的补偿。目前缺乏对哪些非理想特性可以被训练补偿的系统性理解。
AI.method: 提出了一个诊断框架，将硬件非理想性建模为前向算子的结构化扰动，并评估其与基于梯度的优化的兼容性。针对六种代表性扰动类别（读噪声、变异性、漂移、固定故障、IR压降和ADC离散化），分析了三个关键诊断指标：梯度期望一致性、有界梯度方差和非退化敏感性。
AI.result: 实验结果清楚地分离了可以通过HAT补偿的扰动与那些会持续破坏优化的扰动。研究建立了扰动可补偿性的判别标准，为硬件-软件协同设计提供了实用指导。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为硬件感知训练提供了受控的经验分析框架，明确了哪些非理想特性可以在训练层面解决，哪些需要在电路、架构或校准层面进行缓解，从而指导硬件-软件协同设计的决策。研究范围限定在普通前向扰动HAT场景下。

title: Tabular Foundation Model for Generative Modelling
summary: Generative modelling is a demanding test of foundation models, because it requires robust, holistic representation learning for a given data modality, rather than optimisation for a supervised prediction target alone. While recent work on tabular foundation models has achieved remarkable progress in predictive modelling, generative tabular foundation models remain underexplored. Existing tabular foundation generators, in particular, have not yet consistently matched strong dataset-specific generators in synthetic data quality. A key reason is their misalignment with the distinctive causal structural prior of heterogeneous tabular data. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing a novel tabular foundation model, \textbf{TabFORGE}, built on pretrained \textbf{Tab}ular \textbf{FO}undational \textbf{R}epresentations for \textbf{GE}neration. TabFORGE is designed to utilise the implicitly learned causal information underlying diverse tabular datasets in a unified latent space induced by a pretrained causality-aware feature encoder. It further decouples latent modelling from decoding through a two-stage design: we first pretrain a score-based diffusion transformer, and then pretrain a denoising-aligned decoder using the denoised latent embeddings. This design elegantly mitigates the distribution shifts in latent embeddings that typically arise between training and inference. We evaluate TabFORGE comprehensively against 22 benchmark methods on 45 real-world datasets. Our results show that TabFORGE effectively learns and leverages generalisable tabular representations, enabling efficient generation of high-quality synthetic tabular data, particularly with strong structural fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TabFORGE，这是首个基于预训练基础表征的表格数据生成基础模型，通过因果感知的特征编码器和两阶段解耦设计，在45个真实数据集上显著优于22个基线方法，生成的合成表格数据具有高结构保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型在预测任务上表现优异，但在生成任务上仍落后于针对特定数据集训练的生成器。主要原因是现有方法未能很好处理异构表格数据独特的因果结构先验，且生成过程中存在训练-推理分布偏移问题。
AI.method: 提出TabFORGE模型，包含两个核心设计：(1) 使用预训练的因果感知特征编码器学习统一潜在空间，利用隐式学习的因果信息；(2) 两阶段解耦架构——首先预训练基于分数的扩散Transformer，然后使用去噪后的潜在嵌入预训练去噪对齐解码器，有效缓解训练和推理间的潜在嵌入分布偏移。
AI.result: 在45个真实世界数据集上与22个基准方法进行全面对比评估，TabFORGE在合成表格数据质量方面显著优于现有方法，特别是在结构保真度方面表现突出，证明了其有效学习和利用可泛化表格表示的能力。
AI.conclusion: TabFORGE成功填补了表格基础生成模型的空白，通过结合预训练因果感知表征和创新的解耦生成架构，实现了高质量合成表格数据的高效生成，为表格数据的生成式建模提供了新的解决方案。

title: FedCIGAR: A Personalized Reconstruction Approach for Federated Graph-level Anomaly Detection
summary: Graph-level anomaly detection (GLAD) is crucial for ensuring the reliability of graph-driven applications by identifying abnormal graphs that deviate from the majority. Considering the privacy concerns in distributed scenarios, federated graph-level anomaly detection (FedGLAD) has emerged as a promising solution to enable collaborative detection without sharing raw data. However, existing methods suffer from poor generalization due to the reliance on unrealistic synthetic anomalies and insufficient personalization capabilities under data heterogeneity. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Federated graph-level anomaly detection approach with Cluster-adaptIve GAted Reconstruction (FedCIGAR). Specifically, we design a reconstruction-based paradigm trained on normal graphs to avoid synthetic data. Furthermore, we introduce a client-side node contribution gating mechanism and a server-side sliding window-based clustering strategy to tackle data heterogeneity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedCIGAR achieves superior performance and robustness in contrast to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FedCIGAR方法，通过基于重构的范式避免合成数据依赖，并引入客户端节点贡献门控机制和服务器端滑动窗口聚类策略来解决数据异构性问题，在联邦图级异常检测中取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦图级异常检测方法存在两个关键问题：1）依赖不切实际的合成异常数据导致泛化能力差；2）在数据异构场景下个性化能力不足。这些缺陷限制了模型在实际分布式场景中的应用效果。
AI.method: 提出FedCIGAR方法，包含两个核心组件：1）设计基于重构的范式，仅使用正常图进行训练，避免依赖合成异常数据；2）引入客户端节点贡献门控机制处理局部数据特性，以及服务器端基于滑动窗口的聚类策略应对数据异构性，实现个性化适配。
AI.result: 通过大量实验验证，FedCIGAR相比现有最先进方法在检测性能和鲁棒性方面均表现优异，有效解决了泛化能力差和数据异构性挑战。
AI.conclusion: FedCIGAR成功解决了联邦图级异常检测中的关键挑战，为隐私保护的分布式图异常检测提供了有效解决方案，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: fmxcoders: Factorized Masked Crosscoders for Cross-Layer Feature Discovery
summary: Many features in pretrained Transformers span multiple layers: they emerge through stages of inference, persist in the residual stream, or are built jointly by parallel MLPs. Crosscoders (namely, sparse dictionaries trained jointly across layers) aim to recover these cross-layer features in a single shared latent space. We show that standard crosscoders largely fail at this purpose. Although their decoder weight norms spread evenly across layers, a functional coherence metric we introduce reveals that each latent's activation is effectively driven by only one or two layers on average. While functionally coherent latents act as human-interpretable concept detectors (e.g., US states and cities), the layer-localized latents that crosscoders predominantly learn collapse onto surface-level patterns such as digit detectors. We trace this failure to two structural limitations: unconstrained cross-layer parameterization and unregularized cross-layer dependence. We address both by introducing fmxcoders, which (i) replace the encoder and decoder with low-rank tensor factorizations that draw every latent's per-layer weights from a shared cross-layer basis, and (ii) apply stochastic layer masking, a denoising regularizer along the layer axis that penalizes latents whose contribution collapses when a single layer is masked. Across GPT2-Small, Pythia-410M, Pythia-1.4B, and Gemma2-2B, fmxcoders lift mean probing F1 by 10-30 points, surpassing per-layer SAE baselines that standard crosscoders fail to reach, reduce reconstruction MSE by 25-50%, and roughly double mean functional coherence. An LLM-as-a-judge evaluation further shows that fmxcoders recover 3-13$\times$ more semantically coherent latents than standard crosscoders across all four base LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文指出标准跨层编码器无法有效捕获跨层特征，并提出FMXcoders，通过低秩张量分解和随机层掩码，在多项指标上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 预训练Transformer中的许多特征跨越多个层，但标准的跨层编码器（Crosscoders）未能有效恢复这些跨层特征。研究发现，尽管其解码器权重范数在各层间分布均匀，但实际上每个潜在维度的激活仅由一两个层驱动，导致学习到的特征多为浅层模式。因此，需要新的方法来真正捕获跨层特征。
AI.method: 提出FMXcoders方法，包含两个关键改进：（1）用低秩张量分解替代编码器和解码器，使每个潜在维度的层级权重从共享的跨层基中提取；（2）引入随机层掩码作为去噪正则化器，惩罚那些在单层被掩码后贡献度急剧下降的潜在维度，强制其学习真正的跨层依赖。
AI.result: 在GPT2-Small、Pythia-410M、Pythia-1.4B和Gemma2-2B四个模型上，FMXcoders相比标准跨层编码器：平均探测F1分数提升10-30分（超越每层SAE基线）；重建MSE降低25-50%；功能连贯性均值翻倍；LLM-as-a-judge评估显示恢复的语义连贯潜在维度数量是标准方法的3-13倍。
AI.conclusion: FMXcoders通过结构化参数化和跨层正则化，成功解决了标准跨层编码器的两个结构性缺陷，能够有效学习真正的跨层特征，显著提升了模型解释性和特征质量。

title: Inverse Design for Conditional Distribution Matching
summary: Generative models are powerful tools for sampling from a learned distribution $\mathcal{P}(Y \mid X)$, and inverse-design methods invert this map to find an input $x$ that produces a desired point output $y^*$. However, many design goals are naturally distributional rather than pointwise, incorporating the inherent uncertainty of $Y$ and targeting a specific form for it, a task not addressed by standard inverse design. To address this issue we introduce Conditional Distribution Matching (CDM), a new inverse-design problem class in generative modeling: given a joint distribution $\mathcal{P}(X, Y)$ and a target distribution $\mathcal{G}(Y)$, find an input $x^*$ whose induced conditional distribution $\mathcal{P}(Y \mid X = x^*)$ matches $\mathcal{G}$. We formally define two variants: Conditional Distribution Matching Sampling (CDMS) and Conditional Distribution Matching Optimization (CDMO). To solve these problems, we propose MLGD-F (Matching-Loss Guided Diffusion with a Fast inner sampler), a plug-and-play inference-time algorithm that combines a pretrained score-based diffusion model with a pretrained fast conditional sampler, requiring no additional training or fine-tuning. By leveraging single-step conditional sampling, MLGD-F enables tractable gradient computation, making the estimation of $\mathcal{P}(Y \mid X)$ both memory-efficient and computationally lightweight. We validate MLGD-F on synthetic benchmarks, structured image transformations, and generative editing optimization, demonstrating reliable recovery of inputs whose conditional distributions match diverse user-specified targets, including discrete mixtures and continuous low-rank supports.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了条件分布匹配（CDM）这一新的逆向设计问题框架，旨在寻找输入使其诱导的条件分布匹配目标分布，并开发了无需额外训练的推理时算法MLGD-F来高效求解该问题。
AI.motivation: 传统的逆向设计方法关注点对点映射，即寻找输入x以产生特定输出y*。然而，许多实际设计目标本质上是分布式的，需要考虑输出的固有不确定性并匹配特定的目标分布形式，这一任务在现有方法中未被解决。
AI.method: 提出条件分布匹配（CDM）问题，包括两个变体：条件分布匹配采样（CDMS）和条件分布匹配优化（CDMO）。开发了MLGD-F算法，将预训练的基于分数的扩散模型与预训练的快速条件采样器结合，利用单步条件采样实现可处理的梯度计算，无需额外训练或微调。
AI.result: 在合成基准、结构化图像变换和生成式编辑优化任务上验证了MLGD-F的有效性，成功恢复了条件分布匹配多样化用户指定目标（包括离散混合和连续低秩支撑）的输入。方法在内存效率和计算开销方面表现良好。
AI.conclusion: CDM框架填补了生成模型逆向设计中分布级目标匹配的空白，MLGD-F作为一种即插即用的推理时算法，为条件分布匹配问题提供了高效、无需训练的解决方案，具有广泛的应用潜力。

title: Learning to Bid with Unknown Private Values in Budget-Constrained First-Price Auctions
summary: The transition to First-Price Auctions (FPA) in digital advertising has spurred significant research, yet existing work typically assumes access to a valuation oracle, ignoring the reality that values must be inferred from censored data. While Linear Treatment Effect (LTE) models address this by learning value uplift, they have not been adapted to realistic settings with hard Budget constraints or Return-on-Spend (RoS) targets requiring regret and violation control. In this work, we propose a unified primal-dual framework for constrained FPAs that jointly learns the latent LTE valuation parameters and the competitor's bid distribution. This simultaneous learning introduces a critical technical challenge: the estimation error is dynamically scaled by the Lagrangian multiplier, potentially leading to unbounded regret. We resolve this by leveraging a strong Slater condition and a novel adaptive burn-in procedure to stabilize the dual variables. Our approach achieves near-optimal regret guarantees, providing the first theoretically grounded solution for constrained bidding with latent valuations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的原始-对偶框架，用于解决存在预算约束和投资回报率目标的一价拍卖中的潜在估值学习问题，实现了近最优的遗憾保证。
AI.motivation: 现有关于数字广告一价拍卖的研究通常假设能直接获取估值，忽略了现实中估值需从截断数据推断的事实。虽然线性处理效应（LTE）模型能学习价值提升，但尚未适配具有硬性预算约束或支出回报率目标的现实场景，缺乏对遗憾和约束违背的控制。
AI.method: 提出了一个统一的原始-对偶框架，联合学习潜在LTE估值参数和竞争对手的出价分布。针对估计误差被拉格朗日乘子动态缩放可能导致遗憾无界的关键技术挑战，利用强Slater条件和新颖的自适应启动过程来稳定对偶变量。
AI.result: 成功解决了同时学习带来的估计误差动态缩放问题，实现了近最优的遗憾保证。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个针对潜在估值约束竞价问题的理论性解决方案，为具有潜在估值的约束竞价提供了理论保证。

title: RAwR: Role-Aware Rewiring via Approximate Equitable Partition
summary: While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have demonstrated significant efficacy in node classification tasks, where predictions rely on local neighborhood information, the performance of GNNs often drops when prediction tasks depend on long-range interactions. These limitations are attributed to phenomena such as oversquashing, where structural bottlenecks restrict signal propagation across the network topology. To address this challenge, we introduce RAwR, a computationally efficient rewiring framework that augments the input graph with a quotient graph derived from equitable partitions. This approach facilitates accelerated communication between nodes that share identical structural roles, as identified by the Weisfeiler-Leman graph coloring, and thereby reduces the total effective resistance of the system. Furthermore, by employing an approximate definition of the equitable partition, RAwR enables a controllable reduction of the quotient graph, which, in its most condensed state, recovers the conventional Master Node rewiring technique. Empirical evaluations across a diverse suite of benchmarks -- including homophilic, heterophilic, and synthetic long-range datasets -- demonstrate that RAwR achieves state-of-the-art results. Our contribution is further supported by an analytical investigation using a teacher-student model of linear GNNs, which elucidates the theoretical foundations of role-based rewiring. This analysis leads to the formulation of Spectral Role Lift (SRL), a metric designed to identify the optimal approximate equitable partition for maximizing predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RAwR框架，通过引入基于等价划分的商图来增强输入图，解决图神经网络中的过压缩现象，从而显著提升长程依赖任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络在节点分类任务中表现优异，但当预测任务依赖于长程交互时，性能往往下降。这种现象归因于“过压缩”问题，即结构瓶颈限制了信号在网络拓扑中的传播。
AI.method: 引入RAwR重布线框架，通过Weisfeiler-Leman图着色识别具有相同结构角色的节点，构建商图以加速节点间的通信。采用近似的等价划分定义，实现商图的可控缩减，并可退化为传统的Master Node重布线技术。同时提出光谱角色提升（SRL）指标以识别最优的近似等价划分。
AI.result: 在包括同配、异配和合成长程数据集在内的多种基准测试中，RAwR均达到了最先进的性能水平。使用线性GNN的师生模型进行的理论分析阐明了基于角色的重布线机制。
AI.conclusion: RAwR框架有效解决了图神经网络的长程依赖问题，通过基于结构角色的重布线策略，在保持计算效率的同时显著提升了模型性能，为图神经网络的长程信息传播提供了理论支持和实践方案。

title: Positional LSH: Binary Block Matrix Approximation for Attention with Linear Biases
summary: Positional encoding in transformers is commonly implemented through positional embeddings, attention masks, or bias terms, but formal connections between these mechanisms remain limited. We study attention with positional bias through the lens of locality-sensitive hashing (LSH), focusing on Attention with Linear Biases (ALiBi). We show that the ALiBi bias matrix is the expectation of contiguous block-diagonal binary masks induced by a ``positional LSH'' scheme. The empirical mean of masks sampled from this scheme yields spectral norm and max-norm approximation guarantees with bounded block sizes with high probability. This structural theorem implies a uniform approximation theorem for ALiBi-biased attention: with high probability over the sampled masks, the approximate attention output is accurate simultaneously for all query-key-value inputs and can be computed in near-linear time in the context length, reducing long-context ALiBi to a collection of randomized short-context regular (positionally unbiased) attention operations. Conceptually, this connects positional bias, masks, and positional embeddings in a single formal framework and suggests an approach to efficient ALiBi-biased attention. Experiments on large language models validate our theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 本文从局部敏感哈希（LSH）的角度分析ALiBi位置编码，证明了ALiBi偏置矩阵是位置LSH方案诱导的连续块对角掩码的期望，从而实现了一种具有理论保证的高效近似注意力计算方法。
AI.motivation: Transformer中的位置编码通常通过位置嵌入、注意力掩码或偏置项实现，但这些机制之间的形式化联系仍然有限。研究旨在建立位置偏置（特别是ALiBi）与其他位置编码机制之间的理论桥梁。
AI.method: 通过局部敏感哈希（LSH）的视角研究带有位置偏置的注意力机制，特别是ALiBi。证明了ALiBi偏置矩阵是由"位置LSH"方案诱导的连续块对角二进制掩码的期望，并基于此推导出谱范数和最大范数近似保证。
AI.result: 证明了ALiBi偏置注意力的均匀近似定理：以高概率保证采样掩码的近似注意力输出对所有查询-键-值输入同时准确，且可以在上下文长度的近线性时间内计算。这将长上下文ALiBi简化为一系列随机短上下文常规（位置无偏）注意力操作。
AI.conclusion: 该研究在单一形式化框架中建立了位置偏置、掩码和位置嵌入之间的联系，提出了一种高效的ALiBi偏置注意力方法，并在大语言模型实验中验证了理论发现。

title: SEMASIA: A Large-Scale Dataset of Semantically Structured Latent Representations
summary: Latent representations learned by neural networks often exhibit semantic structure, where concept similarity is reflected by geometric proximity in embedding space. However, comparing such spaces across models remains difficult: changes in architecture, pretraining data, objective, or random seed can yield embeddings with similar content but incompatible geometry. This latent space alignment problem is central to interpretability, transfer and multimodal learning, federated systems, and semantic communication; however, progress remains limited by the lack of large-scale, model-diverse, and metadata-rich benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce SEMASIA, a large-scale collection of latent representations extracted from approximately 1,700 pretrained vision models across eight standard image-classification benchmarks. SEMASIA pairs embeddings with structured metadata describing architectures, training regimes, pretraining sources, and model scale. We demonstrate three applications of the resource. First, we analyze the conceptual organization of individual latent spaces, showing consistent prototype-like clustering and hierarchical semantic neighborhoods across models and datasets. Second, we benchmark supervised alignment mappings between latent spaces using reconstruction error and downstream task performance. Third, we perform a large-scale regression analysis of how pretraining-data complexity, specialization, transfer learning, augmentation, and model scale relate to geometric and probing properties of embeddings. By coupling representational scale with standardized metadata, SEMASIA provides a reproducible foundation for studying latent geometry, evaluating alignment methods, and developing next-generation heterogeneous and interoperable AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SEMASIA，一个包含约1700个预训练视觉模型潜在表征的大规模数据集，配以丰富的元数据，旨在解决潜在空间对齐问题，并展示了其在语义结构分析、对齐方法基准测试及影响因素回归分析中的三种应用。
AI.motivation: 神经网络学习到的潜在表征通常具有语义结构，但由于架构、预训练数据、目标函数或随机种子不同，不同模型的嵌入空间在几何结构上往往不兼容。这种潜在空间对齐问题对可解释性、迁移学习、多模态学习、联邦系统和语义通信至关重要，然而现有研究受限于缺乏大规模、模型多样且元数据丰富的基准数据集。
AI.method: 作者构建了SEMASIA数据集，从大约1700个预训练视觉模型中提取潜在表征，覆盖八个标准图像分类基准。该数据集将嵌入向量与描述模型架构、训练机制、预训练来源和模型规模的标准化元数据配对。在此基础上，演示了三个应用：分析单个潜在空间的语义组织；基准测试潜在空间间的监督对齐映射；大规模回归分析预训练数据复杂性、专业化、迁移学习、数据增强和模型规模对嵌入几何性质的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现各模型和数据集的潜在空间普遍存在一致的“原型式”聚类和层级语义邻域结构。建立了基于重构误差和下游任务性能的有监督对齐映射基准。通过大规模回归分析，揭示了预训练数据复杂性、模型专业化、迁移学习、数据增强及模型规模与嵌入几何性质和探测性质之间的定量关系。
AI.conclusion: SEMASIA通过将大规模表征数据与标准化元数据相结合，为研究潜在几何结构、评估对齐方法以及开发下一代异构、可互操作AI系统提供了可复现的基础，推动了潜在空间对齐问题的研究进展。

title: CTQWformer: A CTQW-based Transformer for Graph Classification
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNN) and Transformer-based architectures have achieved remarkable progress in graph learning, yet they still struggle to capture both global structural dependencies and model the dynamic information propagation. In this paper, we propose CTQWformer, a hybrid graph learning framework that integrates continuous-time quantum walks (CTQW) with GNN. CTQWformer employs a trainable Hamiltonian that fuses graph topology and node features, enabling physically grounded modeling of quantum walk dynamics that captures rich and intricate graph structure information. The extracted CTQW-based representations are incorporated into two complementary modules:(i) a Graph Transformer module that embeds final-time propagation probabilities as structural biases in the self-attention mechanism, and (ii) a Graph Recurrent Module that captures temporal evolution patterns with bidirectional recurrent networks. Extensive experiments on benchmark graph classification datasets demonstrate that CTQWformer outperforms graph kernel and GNN-based methods, demonstrating the potential of integrating quantum dynamics into trainable deep learning frameworks for graph representation learning. To the best of our knowledge, CTQWformer is the first hybrid CTQW-based Transformer, integrating CTQW-derived structural bias with temporal evolution modeling to advance graph learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CTQWformer，这是首个融合连续时间量子行走（CTQW）与图神经网络的混合图学习框架，通过引入量子动力学建模全局结构依赖与动态信息传播，在图分类任务上超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的图神经网络（GNN）和基于Transformer的架构在捕获全局结构依赖和建模动态信息传播方面仍存在局限性，难以充分表达复杂的图结构信息。
AI.method: 提出CTQWformer框架，核心包括：1）使用可训练哈密顿量融合图拓扑与节点特征，进行基于物理原理的连续时间量子行走建模；2）图Transformer模块，将最终时刻传播概率作为结构偏差嵌入自注意力机制；3）图循环模块，利用双向循环网络捕获时间演化模式。
AI.result: 在基准图分类数据集上的大量实验表明，CTQWformer优于图核方法和基于GNN的方法，证明了将量子动力学整合到可训练深度学习框架中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CTQWformer首次成功实现了混合CTQW-based Transformer，通过融合CTQW衍生的结构偏差与时间演化建模，为图表示学习提供了新的思路，展示了量子动力学在深度学习中的潜力。

title: Kintsugi: Learning Policies by Repairing Executable Knowledge Bases
summary: Modern embodied agents achieve impressive performance, but their task knowledge is often stored in neural weights, latent state, or prompt-bound memory, making individual policy knowledge difficult to inspect, validate, recombine, and reuse. We introduce \textbf{Kintsugi}, a white-box policy-learning framework that treats embodied policy improvement as verifier-gated construction of a typed executable Knowledge Base (KB). Kintsugi represents task-level policy knowledge as composable typed entries -- predicates, operators, policy schemas, monitors, recovery rules, experience records, and goals -- and improves this artifact through localized typed edits induced from rollout evidence, rather than relying on test-time language-model reasoning. Between rollouts, a tool-constrained agentic editing loop diagnoses trajectory failures, localizes them to editable KB layers, and proposes candidate edits. A deterministic verification gate admits an edit only when the candidate type-checks, the resulting KB executes, and focused validation success or trajectory-health metrics improve without violating protected-regression checks. At inference, the accepted KB is executed by a deterministic symbolic executor with zero LLM calls. Across long-horizon text-agent benchmarks and representative object-centric manipulation settings, Kintsugi achieves strong endpoint performance while preserving inspectability, local editability, and verifier-gated deployment. These results suggest that embodied policy improvement can be organized around executable task knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出了Kintsugi框架，通过验证器把关的可执行知识库构建过程，将具身策略改进转化为可组合、可检查、可重用的类型化知识条目的迭代编辑。
AI.motivation: 现代具身智能体的任务知识通常存储在神经权重、潜在状态或提示绑定的记忆中，导致单个策略知识难以检查、验证、重组和重用。
AI.method: 将任务级策略知识表示为可组合的类型化条目（谓词、操作符、策略模式、监控器、恢复规则等），通过工具约束的智能体编辑循环从轨迹证据中诱导局部类型化编辑，并使用确定性验证门对编辑进行类型检查、执行验证和回归检查，最终通过确定性符号执行器执行知识库。
AI.result: 在长视界文本智能体基准测试和代表性以物体为中心的操作场景中，Kintsugi实现了强大的端点性能，同时保持了可检查性、局部可编辑性和验证器把关部署。
AI.conclusion: 具身策略改进可以围绕可执行任务知识进行组织，证明了将策略知识显式化为可操作知识库的可行性和有效性。

title: Spectral Transformer Neural Processes
summary: Time series, spatial data, and images are natural applications of Neural Processes. However, when such data exhibit strong periodicity and quasi-periodicity, existing methods often suffer from underfitting and generalise poorly beyond the training distribution. In this work, we propose Spectral Transformer Neural Processes (STNPs), a frequency-aware extension of Transformer Neural Processes (TNPs). STNPs introduce a Spectral Aggregator that estimates an empirical context spectrum, compresses it into a spectral mixture, samples task-adaptive spectral features, and concatenates them with time-domain embeddings, thereby injecting a spectral-mixture-kernel bias into TNPs. This design reshapes the similarity geometry, allowing inputs that are distant in Euclidean space to remain close in an induced periodic manifold while enhancing time-frequency interactions. Extensive experiments on synthetic regression tasks, real-world time-series datasets, and an image dataset demonstrate that STNPs consistently improve predictive performance over existing baselines, extending Neural Processes beyond translation equivariance towards effective modelling of periodicity and quasi-periodicity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出频谱Transformer神经过程（STNPs），通过引入频谱聚合器注入频谱混合核偏置，有效解决了现有神经过程在处理周期性和准周期性数据时的欠拟合问题。
AI.motivation: 神经过程（NPs）在处理时间序列、空间数据和图像时表现出色，但当数据呈现强周期性和准周期性时，现有方法常出现欠拟合现象，且在训练分布之外泛化能力差。针对这一局限性，本文旨在增强模型对周期性模式的捕捉能力。
AI.method: 提出频谱Transformer神经过程（STNPs），在Transformer神经过程基础上引入频谱聚合器（Spectral Aggregator）。该聚合器估计经验上下文频谱，将其压缩为频谱混合，采样任务自适应的频谱特征，并与时域嵌入拼接，从而将频谱混合核偏置注入模型，重塑相似性几何结构。
AI.result: 在合成回归任务、真实世界时间序列数据集和图像数据集上的广泛实验表明，STNPs在预测性能上始终优于现有基线方法。该模型成功将输入在欧氏空间中的距离映射到诱导周期流形上的邻近性，并增强了时频交互。
AI.conclusion: STNPs有效扩展了神经过程的能力，使其超越平移等变性，能够有效建模周期性和准周期性，为处理具有此类特性的复杂数据提供了一种有效的解决方案。

title: Doubly Robust Proxy Causal Learning with Neural Mean Embeddings
summary: Unobserved confounding prevents standard covariate adjustment from identifying causal response functions in observational studies. Proxy causal learning addresses this problem through bridge equations involving treatment- and outcome-inducing proxies, avoiding direct recovery of the latent confounder. Existing doubly robust proxy estimators combine outcome and treatment bridges, but typically rely on fixed kernels, sieves, or low-dimensional semiparametric models; existing neural proxy methods are more flexible, but are largely single-bridge estimators. We develop a neural doubly robust framework for proxy causal learning with continuous and structured treatments. Our method introduces a neural mean-embedding estimator for the treatment bridge, combines it with a neural outcome bridge, and estimates the doubly robust correction through a final regression stage. The framework covers population, heterogeneous, and conditional dose-response functions, yielding full response-curve estimators rather than binary-treatment effects. The algorithms use two stages for each bridge and history-aware updates of the final linear layers to stabilize stochastic multi-stage training. We prove consistency of the algorithms showing that the doubly robust error is controlled by the final averaging and regression errors together with the smaller of the outcome- and treatment-side weak-norm bridge errors. Across synthetic and image-valued benchmarks, the proposed estimators outperform existing baselines and single-bridge neural estimators, showing the benefit of combining learned outcome and treatment bridges in a doubly robust construction. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/BariscanBozkurt/DRPCL-Neural-Mean-Embedding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于连续和结构化处理的神经双重稳健代理因果学习框架，通过结合神经均值嵌入处理桥和神经结果桥，在合成和图像数据上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 在观察性研究中，未观测的混淆因素阻碍了标准协变量调整识别因果响应函数。现有的双重稳健代理估计器通常依赖于固定核、筛或低维半参数模型，而现有的神经代理方法虽然更灵活，但大多是单桥估计器，缺乏结合两种桥优势的双重稳健方法。
AI.method: 开发了一个神经双重稳健框架，引入神经均值嵌入估计器用于处理桥，将其与神经结果桥结合，并通过最终的回归阶段估计双重稳健校正。算法对每个桥使用两个阶段，并采用历史感知的最终线性层更新来稳定随机多阶段训练。框架涵盖了总体、异质性和条件剂量响应函数。
AI.result: 证明了算法的一致性，表明双重稳健误差由最终平均和回归误差以及结果侧和处理侧弱范数桥误差中较小者共同控制。在合成和图像值基准测试中，所提出的估计器优于现有基线和单桥神经估计器，展示了在学习的结果和处理桥结合的双重稳健构造中的优势。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功扩展了代理因果学习方法，能够处理连续和结构化处理，提供完整的响应曲线估计器而非二元处理效果，并通过双重稳健构造提高了估计的准确性和鲁棒性，为处理未观测混淆因素提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Mixture of Layers with Hybrid Attention
summary: Standard Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers route tokens to expert subnetworks within each layer, but the layer structure itself remains monolithic. We introduce Mixture of Layers (MoL), which replaces full-width transformer blocks (d_model) with K parallel thin blocks at reduced dimensionality (d_thin << d_model), connected via learned down/up projections and composed via top-k block routing. Scaling sparse block routing to many blocks creates an attention coverage problem, as each block sees fewer tokens. We address this by introducing hybrid attention, which pairs one shared softmax block for global context with Gated DeltaNet linear attention in routed blocks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoL架构，用K个并行的低维“瘦”模块替代标准MoE的单层宽模块，并引入混合注意力机制解决稀疏路由带来的注意力覆盖问题。
AI.motivation: 标准MoE Transformer仅在子网络层面进行稀疏路由，其层结构本身仍是单一且宽维度的，缺乏在层结构层面的灵活性与稀疏性。
AI.method: 提出Mixture of Layers (MoL)，将全宽Transformer块替换为K个并行的低维薄块（d_thin << d_model），通过学习的下/上投影连接，并采用top-k块路由进行组合；针对稀疏路由导致各块可见token减少的注意力覆盖问题，引入混合注意力，结合一个共享的softmax块提供全局上下文与Gated DeltaNet线性注意力用于路由块。
AI.result: 成功构建了在层结构层面具有稀疏路由能力的架构，并通过混合注意力机制有效缓解了多块稀疏路由带来的注意力覆盖不足问题。
AI.conclusion: MoL架构扩展了MoE的稀疏性理念至层结构层面，配合混合注意力机制，为构建更灵活、高效的Transformer模型提供了新思路。

title: LLM-Driven Performance-Space Augmentation for Meta-Learning-Based Algorithm Selection
summary: Meta-learning for algorithm selection relies on a meta-dataset in which each row corresponds to a supervised learning dataset described by meta-features and labelled with a target value that is associated with algorithm choice (typically, some function of algorithm performance). A persistent limitation is that the number of curated real-world datasets is small, resulting in sparse meta-datasets that constrain meta-learner generalisation. In this paper, we address this problem by augmenting the meta-dataset with synthetic regression datasets produced via a large language model (LLM), with generation steered toward target regions of a low-dimensionality performance space. In our experiments, we adopt a two-dimensional geometric setting defined by the cross-validated $R^2$ scores of two anchor algorithms, known as landmarkers. We compare two augmentation strategies: (1) uniform sampling, which distributes synthetic datasets across the performance space; and (2) margin-based sampling, which concentrates them near the decision boundary where landmarker preference is most ambiguous. Across 42 real-world UCI regression datasets and 730 synthetic datasets, both strategies substantially improve meta-learner performance over the unaugmented baseline under regression and multi-label evaluation formulations. However, uniform augmentation consistently outperforms margin-based augmentation, achieving a 17.47% relative reduction in Hamming loss, a 100.41% relative improvement in subset accuracy, and a +6.09% relative gain in pooled out-of-fold $R^2$. These results lead us to postulate a central thesis: the performance of algorithms resides on a low-dimensional performance manifold, whose reconstruction bias may be minimised by user-guided LLMs that seek to maximise uniform $ε$-cover, and consequently, lead to improved meta-learning for algorithm selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用大语言模型(LLM)生成合成回归数据集来扩充元数据集，以解决算法选择中真实数据集稀缺导致的元学习泛化受限问题。实验表明，均匀采样策略优于基于边界的采样策略，显著提升了元学习器性能。
AI.motivation: 元学习用于算法选择时，依赖包含元特征和算法性能标签的元数据集。然而，现有的精心策划的真实世界数据集数量有限，导致元数据集稀疏，严重制约了元学习器的泛化能力。这一局限性是本文旨在解决的核心问题。
AI.method: 作者提出使用大语言模型(LLM)生成合成回归数据集来扩充元数据集，生成过程受低维性能空间中的目标区域引导。具体采用由两个锚点算法（landmarkers）的交叉验证$R^2$分数定义的二维几何设置。研究比较了两种数据增强策略：(1)均匀采样——在性能空间中均匀分布合成数据集；(2)基于边界的采样——将合成数据集集中在决策边界附近，即landmarker偏好最模糊的区域。
AI.result: 在42个真实UCI回归数据集和730个合成数据集上的实验表明，两种增强策略均显著优于未增强的基线。然而，均匀增强策略始终优于基于边界的增强策略，实现了Hamming损失相对降低17.47%，子集准确率相对提升100.41%，以及池化袋外$R^2$相对增益+6.09%。
AI.conclusion: 基于实验结果，作者提出了一个中心论点：算法的性能位于一个低维性能流形上，其重构偏差可以通过用户引导的LLM最小化，这些LLM寻求最大化均匀ε覆盖，从而改进算法选择的元学习效果。

title: HS-FNO: History-Space Fourier Neural Operator for Non-Markovian Partial Differential Equations
comment: 29 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Under review. Code at https://github.com/lennonshikhman/hs-fno/
summary: Neural operators provide fast surrogate models for time-dependent partial differential equations, but their standard autoregressive use usually assumes that the instantaneous field $u(t,\cdot)$ is a complete state. This assumption fails for delay equations, distributed-memory systems, and other non-Markovian dynamics: two trajectories may agree at time $t$ and nevertheless have different futures because their histories differ. We introduce the History-Space Fourier Neural Operator (HS-FNO), a neural operator for delay and memory-driven PDEs formulated on the lifted state $u_t(θ,x)=u(t+θ,x)$, $θ\in[-τ,0]$. The key computational step is to decompose one history-state update into a learned predictor for the newly exposed future slice and an exact shift-append transport for the portion of the history window already known from the previous state. This avoids learning deterministic history coordinates, reduces the learned output dimension, and enforces the natural discrete history update. We test HS-FNO on five benchmark families covering delayed reaction--diffusion, spatial epidemiology, nonlocal neural-field dynamics, delayed waves, and distributed-memory closures. Across ten random seeds, HS-FNO attains the lowest aggregate one-step, history-space, and rollout errors among the principal baselines. The largest gain occurs in autoregressive prediction, where aggregate rollout error decreases from $0.241$, $0.188$, and $0.185$ for current-state, lag-stack, and unconstrained history-to-history operators, respectively, to $0.094$. The same model uses fewer parameters than unconstrained history prediction. These results indicate that enforcing the discrete shift structure of history-state evolution is an effective inductive bias for non-Markovian PDE surrogate modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出了历史空间傅里叶神经算子(HS-FNO)用于建模非马尔可夫动力系统，通过强制离散历史更新结构，将自回归预测的累积误差从约0.19-0.24降低至0.094。
AI.motivation: 标准神经算子在自回归使用时假设瞬时场是完备状态，但延迟方程、分布记忆系统等非马尔可夫动力系统不满足此假设：两条轨迹在时刻t可能相同却因历史不同而演化向不同未来。
AI.method: 在提升状态$u_t(θ,x)=u(t+θ,x)$上构建HS-FNO，将一次历史状态更新分解为：对新暴露未来切片的习得预测器，以及对历史窗口已知部分的精确移位-追加传输。该方法避免学习确定性历史坐标、减少学习输出维度，并强制自然的离散历史更新结构。
AI.result: 在五个基准族（延迟反应扩散、空间流行病学、非局部神经场动力学、延迟波动、分布记忆闭包）上测试，HS-FNO在十个随机种子下均取得最低的聚合一步误差、历史空间误差和展开误差。自回归预测的聚合展开误差从当前状态方法的0.241、滞后堆叠方法的0.188、无约束历史到历史算子的0.185降至0.094，且参数量更少。
AI.conclusion: 强制历史状态演化的离散移位结构是非马尔可夫PDE代理建模的有效归纳偏置，在保证物理约束的同时显著提升了预测精度和参数效率。

title: When Adaptation Fails: A Gradient-Based Diagnosis of Collapsed Gating in Vision-Language Prompt Learning
summary: Adaptive prompting mechanisms have been proposed to enhance vision-language models by dynamically tailoring prompts to inputs. However, in frozen few-shot prompt learning with CLIP-style backbones, we systematically observe that adaptive gates and prompt-selection modules often collapse: they produce nearly constant outputs, contribute negligible gradient signals, and frequently fail to outperform fixed prompts. To further explore this issue, we present a systematic diagnostic study to uncover the underlying causes and conditions of adaptation failure. Through controlled experiments across datasets and multiple prompt learning architectures, we identify two recurring failure modes: gradient magnitude imbalance and gate degradation. Our findings invite a re-examination of indiscriminately adding architectural complexity in parameter-efficient learning and clarify when prompt-level adaptive gating is, and is not, effective in this regime.

AI.tldr: 在CLIP风格的冻结少样本提示学习中，自适应提示机制（如门控和选择模块）经常失效，表现不如固定提示。研究发现梯度幅度不平衡和门控退化是两个主要失效原因，提示在参数高效学习中应谨慎增加架构复杂度。
AI.motivation: 尽管自适应提示机制被提出以动态调整输入提示来增强视觉-语言模型，但在冻结少样本提示学习场景下，作者系统性地观察到自适应门控和提示选择模块经常发生崩溃：输出近乎恒定、梯度信号微弱且性能往往不如固定提示。为了探究这一现象，作者开展了系统的诊断研究以揭示自适应失效的根本原因和条件。
AI.method: 通过在多个数据集和多种提示学习架构上进行受控实验，作者进行了系统的诊断分析。研究设计了对照实验来追踪和识别失效模式，重点分析了梯度流动、模块输出变化以及性能对比等关键指标，从而定位问题根源。
AI.result: 研究识别出两个反复出现的失效模式：梯度幅度不平衡和门控退化。这些失效模式导致自适应模块输出近乎恒定，贡献的梯度信号可忽略不计，最终使得自适应提示方法在冻结少样本学习场景下经常无法超越简单的固定提示基线。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论呼吁重新审视在参数高效学习中不加区分地增加架构复杂性的做法，明确了在冻结少样本学习场景下，提示级自适应门控何时有效、何时无效，为未来提示学习架构设计提供了重要指导。

title: Online Set Learning from Precision and Recall Feedback
summary:
We consider the problem of learning an unknown subset $N_\text{target}$ of a domain in an online setting. In each round $t$, the learner predicts a set of items ${N}_t$ and receives one of two types of feedback, each with equal probability: precision feedback, in which a randomly chosen item from the predicted set $N_t$ is revealed and the learner is told whether it belongs to $N_\text{target}$ (incurring a reward if it does), or recall feedback, in which a randomly chosen item from the target set $N_\text{target}$ is revealed and the learner is told whether it belongs to $N_t$ (incurring a reward if it does). The goal is to maximize the cumulative reward over time. This simple online set learning problem abstracts a variety of learning scenarios with precision- and recall-type feedback.
  We show that a hypothesis class (a family of subsets of the domain) is learnable in this setting if and only if it has finite Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) dimension, mirroring the classical PAC characterization. However, the resulting algorithmic structure is markedly more intricate: in contrast to standard Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning -- where the algorithmic landscape is governed by the simple principle of Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) -- our partial feedback model can invalidate ERM and even all proper learning rules. We develop algorithms to address the dependencies induced by the feedback, obtaining regret guarantees in both the realizable and agnostic settings. Our results provide a qualitative characterization of learnability in this model, addressing its most basic question, while pointing to a range of natural and intriguing open questions, including the determination of optimal regret rates.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在线集学习问题，证明了在该反馈模型下假设类可学习的充要条件是具有有限VC维，但部分反馈机制使得传统的经验风险最小化（ERM）失效，需要设计更复杂的算法来处理反馈依赖性并获得遗憾保证。
AI.motivation: 研究一个简单的在线集学习问题，旨在抽象和统一多种具有精确率和召回率类型反馈的学习场景，从而为这些实际问题提供理论基础。
AI.method: 分析并证明了假设类可学习的充要条件是具有有限VC维；揭示了部分反馈机制会使得经验风险最小化（ERM）甚至所有正常学习规则失效；开发了新的算法来处理由反馈引起的依赖性，并在可实现和不可知设定下分析性能。
AI.result: 得出了该学习模型的可学习性定性刻画（有限VC维），为该模型回答了最基本的可学习性问题，并在可实现和不可知设定下获得了遗憾保证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在线集学习模型提供了可学习性的理论表征，并指出了包括确定最优遗憾率在内的一系列自然且有趣的开放问题。

title: End-to-End Keyword Spotting on FPGA Using Graph Neural Networks with a Neuromorphic Auditory Sensor
summary: With the rapid growth of mobile robotics and embedded intelligence, there is an increasing demand for efficient on-device data processing on edge platforms. A promising research direction is the use of neuromorphic sensors inspired by human sensory systems, which generate sparse, event-based data encoding changes in the environment. In this work, we present the first end-to-end FPGA implementation of a keyword spotting system that integrates a Neuromorphic Auditory Sensor (NAS) and a graph neural network (GNN) on a single FPGA device, enabling real-time processing of raw audio data. The proposed architecture eliminates conventional signal preprocessing and operates directly on event-based audio streams. Leveraging a compute-near-memory network architecture, the system achieves efficient inference with low latency and low power consumption. Experimental results demonstrate an accuracy of 87.43% after quantization on the Google Speech Commands v2 dataset processed through the neuromorphic sensor, with end-to-end latency below 35 us and average power consumption of 1.12 W. The processed datasets, software models, and hardware modules are available at https://github.com/vision-agh/NAS-GNN-KWS.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在单块FPGA上实现了集成神经形态听觉传感器(NAS)和图神经网络(GNN)的关键词检测系统，实现了对原始音频数据的实时处理，准确率达87.43%，端到端延迟低于35μs，功耗仅1.12W。
AI.motivation: 随着移动机器人和嵌入式智能的快速发展，边缘平台对高效的设备端数据处理需求日益增长。受人类感官系统启发的神经形态传感器能够生成稀疏的、基于事件的数据来编码环境变化，为解决这一需求提供了有前景的研究方向。
AI.method: 提出首个端到端FPGA实现方案，将神经形态听觉传感器(NAS)和图神经网络(GNN)集成在单个FPGA设备上。该架构消除了传统的信号预处理，直接对基于事件的音频流进行操作，并利用近存计算网络架构实现高效推理。
AI.result: 在Google Speech Commands v2数据集上，经过量化后准确率达到87.43%，端到端延迟低于35μs，平均功耗为1.12W。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功展示了基于神经形态传感器和图神经网络的端到端FPGA关键词检测系统的可行性，实现了低延迟、低功耗的实时音频处理，为边缘设备上的高效神经形态计算提供了有效解决方案。

title: Biosignal Fingerprinting: A Cross-Modal PPG-ECG Foundation Model
summary: Cardiovascular disease remains the leading cause of global mortality, yet scalable cardiac monitoring is hindered by the gap between diagnostic-rich ECG and ubiquitous wearable PPG. Bridging this gap requires representations that are compact, transferable across modalities and devices, and deployable without task-specific retraining. Here we introduce biosignal fingerprints: compact latent representations of cardiovascular state derived from a cross-modal foundation model, the Multi-modal Masked Autoencoder (M2AE), trained on over 3.4 million paired ECG and PPG signals. M2AE integrates modality-specific encoders with a shared bottleneck and dual decoders, jointly optimized using reconstruction and cross-modal contrastive objectives, yielding generalizable fingerprints that retain intra- and inter-modality features. Like a biometric fingerprint, these representations uniquely encode an individual's cardiovascular state in a modality-agnostic, privacy-preserving form reusable across clinical tasks without exposing raw waveform data or requiring model retraining. Across 7 downstream tasks, spanning cross-modal reconstruction, cardiovascular disease classification, hypertension detection, mortality prediction, and demographic inference, biosignal fingerprints achieve competitive or superior performance compared to leading domain-specialist foundation models in frozen settings, including an AUROC of 0.974 for five-class CVD classification and 0.877 for hypertension detection, with a maximum improvement of 27.7% in AUROC across 5 classification tasks. Critically, strong performance is maintained with only a single modality, enabling deployment in resource-constrained, single-sensor environments typical of real-world wearable monitoring, with direct implications for continuous cardiovascular monitoring across clinical and consumer health settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“生物信号指纹”，一种基于多模态掩码自编码器（M2AE）学习的紧凑潜在表示，可在无需任务特定重训练的情况下实现跨模态、跨设备的心血管状态表征，在7项下游任务中达到或超越领域专用基础模型性能，并支持单模态部署。
AI.motivation: 心血管疾病是全球首要死因，但可扩展的心脏监测受限于诊断信息丰富的ECG与普及的可穿戴PPG之间的鸿沟。现有方法缺乏紧凑、跨模态跨设备可迁移、且无需任务特定重训练即可部署的表示。
AI.method: 在超过340万对ECG-PPG信号上训练跨模态基础模型——多模态掩码自编码器（M2AE）。该模型集成模态特定编码器、共享瓶颈与双解码器，通过重建损失和跨模态对比损失联合优化，生成“生物信号指纹”——一种紧凑、模态无关、隐私保护的可复用潜在表示。
AI.result: 在7项下游任务（跨模态重建、心血管疾病分类、高血压检测、死亡预测、人口统计推断等）中，生物信号指纹在冻结设置下达到或超越领先领域专用基础模型：五类CVD分类AUROC 0.974，高血压检测AUROC 0.877，5项分类任务中AUROC最大提升27.7%。关键在于仅用单一模态即可保持强性能。
AI.conclusion: 生物信号指纹成功弥合了ECG与PPG间的模态鸿沟，实现了紧凑、跨模态可迁移且无需重训练的心血管状态表示，支持资源受限的单传感器环境部署，为临床与消费健康场景的持续心血管监测提供了可扩展解决方案。

title: Geometry Conflict: Explaining and Controlling Forgetting in LLM Continual Post-Training
summary: Continual post-training aims to extend large language models (LLMs) with new knowledge, skills, and behaviors, yet it remains unclear when sequential updates enable capability transfer and when they cause catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods mitigate forgetting through sequential fine-tuning, replay, regularization, or model merging, but offer limited criteria for determining when incorporating new updates is beneficial or harmful. In this work, we study LLM continual post-training through three questions: What drives forgetting? When do sequentially acquired capabilities transfer or interfere? How can compatibility be used to control update integration? We address these questions through task geometry: we represent each post-training task by its parameter update and study the covariance geometry induced by the update. Our central finding is that: forgetting can be considered as a state-relative update-integration failure, it arises when the covariance geometries induced by tasks misalign with the geometry of the evolving model state. Sequential updates transfer when they remain compatible with the model state shaped by previous updates, and interfere when state-relative geometry conflict becomes high. Motivated by this finding, we propose Geometry-Conflict Wasserstein Merging (GCWM), a data-free update-integration method that constructs a shared Wasserstein metric via Gaussian Wasserstein barycenters and uses geometry conflict to gate geometry-aware correction. Across Qwen3 0.6B--14B on domain-continual and capability-continual settings, GCWM consistently outperforms data-free baselines, improving retention and final performance without replay data. These results identify geometry conflict as both an explanatory signal for forgetting and a practical control signal for LLM continual post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出几何冲突视角解释大语言模型持续后训练中的遗忘现象，并基于此开发了无需数据的GCWM方法，在多规模模型上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 持续后训练中，现有方法缺乏明确标准判断何时纳入新更新有益或有害。核心问题包括：遗忘的驱动因素是什么？顺序获得的能力何时迁移或干扰？如何利用兼容性控制更新集成？
AI.method: 提出任务几何框架，将每个后训练任务表示为其参数更新，研究更新诱导的协方差几何。基于此发现，提出几何冲突Wasserstein合并方法(GCWM)：通过高斯Wasserstein重心构建共享Wasserstein度量，利用几何冲突门控几何感知校正，实现无需数据的更新集成。
AI.result: 在Qwen3 0.6B-14B模型上进行域持续和能力持续实验，GCWM一致优于无数据基线方法，在无需回放数据的情况下提升了知识保留和最终性能。
AI.conclusion: 几何冲突既是解释遗忘的信号，也是LLM持续后训练的实用控制信号。当任务诱导的协方差几何与演化模型状态的几何不对齐时产生遗忘；顺序更新与先前更新塑造的模型状态保持兼容时实现迁移，状态相对几何冲突高时产生干扰。

title: Minimal Filling Architectures of Polynomial Neural Networks: Counterexamples, Frontier Search, and Defects
summary: We provide a counterexample to the minimal unimodal conjecture for polynomial neural networks (PNNs) with power activation functions. Fixing the input and output widths, the conjecture states that any minimal filling architecture has unimodal widths for the hidden layers. We found a counterexample via a frontier search and certified it using recursive dimension bounds and symbolic computation. Notably, several subarchitectures of this example exhibit large defect, in contrast with the predominantly small-defect behavior observed in prior examples.

AI.tldr: 本文通过反例推翻了多项式神经网络的最小单峰猜想，发现存在非单峰宽度的最小填充架构，且其子架构表现出较大缺陷。
AI.motivation: 针对多项式神经网络(PNNs)的“最小单峰猜想”进行验证。该猜想声称：在固定输入和输出宽度的情况下，任何最小填充架构的隐藏层宽度都应呈现单峰形态。作者试图检验这一猜想的普适性。
AI.method: 采用前沿搜索方法寻找反例，并通过递归维数界限和符号计算对该反例进行严格验证和认证。
AI.result: 成功找到一个反例，证明了并非所有最小填充架构都具有单峰隐藏层宽度。此外，该反例的多个子架构表现出较大的缺陷(defect)，这与先前观察到的以小缺陷为主的行为形成鲜明对比。
AI.conclusion: 最小单峰猜想在多项式神经网络中不成立，揭示了神经网络架构复杂性的新特征，为理解网络宽度分布与架构最小性之间的关系提供了新视角。

title: Plan2Cleanse: Test-Time Backdoor Defense via Monte-Carlo Planning in Deep Reinforcement Learning
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Ensuring the security of reinforcement learning (RL) models is critical, particularly when they are trained by third parties and deployed in real-world systems. Attackers can implant backdoors into these models, causing them to behave normally under typical conditions, but execute malicious behaviors when specific triggers are activated. In this work, we propose Plan2Cleanse, a test-time detection and mitigation framework that adapts Monte Carlo Tree Search to efficiently identify and neutralize RL backdoor attacks without requiring model retraining. Our approach recasts backdoor detection as a planning problem, enabling systematic exploration of temporally extended trigger sequences while maintaining black-box access to the target policy. By leveraging the detection results, Plan2Cleanse can further achieve efficient mitigation through tree-search preventive replanning. We evaluated our method in competitive MuJoCo environments, simulated O-RAN wireless networks, and Atari games. Plan2Cleanse achieves substantial improvements, increasing trigger detection success rates by more than 61.4 percentage points in stealthy O-RAN scenarios and improving win rates from 35\% to 53\% in competitive Humanoid environments. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our test-time defense approach and highlight the importance of proactive defenses against backdoor threats in RL deployments. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/rl-bandits-lab/RL-Backdoor.

AI.tldr: 提出Plan2Cleanse框架，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索在测试阶段检测并缓解强化学习模型中的后门攻击，无需模型重训练，在多个环境中显著提升了触发器检测成功率和策略表现。
AI.motivation: 强化学习模型常由第三方训练并部署，容易遭受后门攻击，攻击者可在特定触发条件下激活恶意行为，而模型在正常条件下表现正常。现有的防御方法通常需要重新训练模型，成本高且不灵活，因此需要一种能够在测试阶段高效检测并缓解后门攻击的方法。
AI.method: 提出Plan2Cleanse框架，将后门检测问题转化为规划问题，利用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）系统地探索时序扩展的触发序列，并在黑盒访问目标策略的条件下实现高效的触发器检测；基于检测结果，通过树搜索预防性重规划实现后门缓解，无需重新训练模型。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo竞争环境、模拟O-RAN无线网络和Atari游戏中进行实验评估。Plan2Cleanse在隐秘O-RAN场景中将触发器检测成功率提升超过61.4个百分点，在竞争性Humanoid环境中将胜率从35%提升至53%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了测试阶段防御方法的有效性，突显了在强化学习部署中对后门威胁进行主动防御的重要性，为实际应用中的RL安全提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Make Each Token Count: Towards Improving Long-Context Performance with KV Cache Eviction
comment: A learnable KV eviction method for large language models
summary: The key-value (KV) cache is a major bottleneck in long-context inference, where memory and computation grow with sequence length. Existing KV eviction methods reduce this cost but typically degrade performance relative to full-cache inference. Our key insight is that full-cache attention is not always optimal: in long contexts, irrelevant tokens can dilute attention away from useful evidence, so selective, learnable eviction can improve generation rather than merely approximate the full cache. We introduce a global retention-based KV eviction method that learns each token's future utility under a unified memory budget. Lightweight retention gates assign utility scores to cached KV entries, and a shared final scoring projection calibrates these scores across all layers and heads. This enables a single global eviction policy in which tokens from different layers, heads, and modalities compete directly for cache capacity. We further provide theoretical analysis showing that preferentially retaining useful tokens reduces attention dilution, and we justify geometric retention as a query-agnostic proxy for future utility. Across diverse long-context language and vision-language reasoning, and multi-turn dialogue benchmarks, our method substantially reduces KV memory while matching or surpassing full-cache inference. These results suggest that learned, globally calibrated KV eviction is not only a compression technique, but also a mechanism for improving long-context reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于全局保留的KV缓存淘汰方法，通过学习token的未来效用进行选择性淘汰，在降低内存占用的同时匹配或超越全缓存推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存淘汰方法虽然降低了长上下文推理的成本，但通常相比全缓存推理会降低性能。然而作者发现全缓存注意力并非总是最优：在长上下文中，无关token会稀释注意力，使其偏离有用证据，因此选择性的、可学习的淘汰反而可以改进生成质量，而不仅仅是近似全缓存。
AI.method: 提出全局保留式KV淘汰方法：(1)轻量级保留门为缓存的KV条目分配效用分数；(2)共享的最终评分投影跨所有层和头校准这些分数；(3)实现单一全局淘汰策略，使不同层、头和模态的token直接竞争缓存容量。理论分析表明优先保留有用token可减少注意力稀释，并证明几何保留可作为未来效用的查询无关代理。
AI.result: 在多种长上下文语言推理、视觉-语言推理和多轮对话基准测试中，该方法在大幅减少KV内存的同时，匹配或超越全缓存推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 学习的、全局校准的KV淘汰不仅是压缩技术，更是改进长上下文推理的机制，表明选择性淘汰可以提升而非损害模型性能。

title: Causal Parametric Drift Simulation: A Digital Twin Framework for Classifier Robustness Evaluation
summary:
Machine learning classifiers in dynamic environments face concept drift -- changes in the data-generating process that degrade performance. Conventional evaluation via static test sets or noise perturbations fails to preserve causal dependencies in tabular data, often producing causally invalid assessments. Post-hoc tools like SHAP and LIME offer correlational insights that may not reflect the causal mechanisms driving model failure.
  We propose a framework that complements existing drift detection by leveraging Structural Causal Models as "Digital Twins" of data-generating processes, enabling precise causal interventions while preserving structural dependencies. Our technique, Causal Parametric Drift Simulation, stress-tests classifiers to identify vulnerabilities before deployment. Experiments on the Open Sourcing Mental Illness (OSMH) dataset demonstrate that this approach exposes latent vulnerabilities invisible to standard statistical monitors.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个基于结构因果模型（SCM）的框架——因果参数漂移模拟，通过构建数据生成过程的"数字孪生"来模拟概念漂移，从而在部署前识别机器学习分类器的潜在脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中的机器学习分类器面临概念漂移问题，导致性能退化。传统评估方法（静态测试集或噪声扰动）无法保持表格数据中的因果依赖关系，评估结果缺乏因果有效性；事后解释工具（SHAP、LIME）仅提供相关性洞察，无法反映导致模型失败的因果机制。
AI.method: 提出利用结构因果模型（SCM）作为数据生成过程的"数字孪生"的框架，通过因果参数漂移模拟技术，在保持结构依赖关系的同时实现精确的因果干预，对分类器进行压力测试以识别部署前的脆弱性。
AI.result: 在Open Sourcing Mental Illness（OSMH）数据集上的实验表明，该方法能够暴露标准统计监测器无法发现的潜在脆弱性，补充了现有的漂移检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于SCM的因果干预框架能够有效评估分类器在动态环境中的鲁棒性，为概念漂移下的模型可靠性评估提供了因果有效的解决方案，具有实际部署价值。

title: Learning Multi-Indicator Weights for Data Selection: A Joint Task-Model Adaptation Framework with Efficient Proxies
comment: This work has been accepted at IJCAI 2026
summary: Data selection is a key component of efficient instruction tuning for large language models, as recent work has shown that data quality often matters more than data quantity. Accordingly, prior studies have introduced various multi-dimensional heuristics to evaluate and filter instruction data. However, most existing methods rely on static task-agnostic and model-agnostic weighting schemes, which overlook the varying requirements of specific downstream tasks and the differing pre-existing capabilities of models. In this paper, we propose a framework for learning multi-indicator weights that jointly adapts data selection to both the downstream task and the specific model.
