Our method identifies optimal weight configurations without full-scale fine-tuning by utilizing in-context learning (ICL) signals on compact tiny-validation sets. These signals serve as efficient performance proxies that ensure high-fidelity evaluation at minimal computational cost. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and model families, including Mistral, Qwen, and Llama, show that the approach achieves performance comparable to or exceeding full-dataset tuning while using only 30\% of the training samples on GSM8K. Furthermore, our analysis reveals a trade-off between semantic diversity and logical complexity in reasoning tasks, highlighting the necessity of joint task-model adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种学习多指标权重的方法，用于联合适应下游任务和特定模型的数据选择，仅需30%的训练样本即可达到或超越全量数据微调的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的指令数据选择方法主要依赖静态的任务无关和模型无关的权重方案，忽略了特定下游任务的不同需求以及模型之间预先存在的能力差异，这限制了数据选择的效果。
AI.method: 提出了一个学习多指标权重的框架，利用紧凑的微型验证集上的上下文学习（ICL）信号作为高效性能代理，在无需全规模微调的情况下识别最优权重配置，从而联合适应下游任务和特定模型。
AI.result: 在GSM8K等多个基准测试和Mistral、Qwen、Llama等多个模型家族上的实验表明，该方法仅使用30%的训练样本即可达到与全数据集微调相当或更优的性能；同时发现推理任务中存在语义多样性与逻辑复杂性之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明了联合适应任务和模型的数据选择的重要性，能够在保持高性能的同时显著降低训练成本，为高效指令微调提供了新的思路。

title: ChaosNetBench: Benchmarking Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks on Chaotic Lattice Dynamics
summary: Spatio-temporal graph neural networks (STGNNs) are widely used for short-term forecasting in dynamic physical systems such as traffic and weather. However, the prevailing evaluation practice uses real world benchmark data sets in a single domain with a single fixed holdout splits, making it difficult to compare architectures across different dynamical regimes. We introduce ChaosNetBench (CNB), a synthetic benchmark dataset and evaluation framework for studying STGNN performance under controlled multidimensional chaotic dynamics. CNB is built on a lattice of coupled standard maps with independently tunable local chaos ($K$), coupling strength ($\varepsilon$), and system size ($N$), providing known topology and known dynamics across 96 system instances and 9{,}600 trajectories. We introduce chaos indicators, evaluation metrics and a protocol to analyze and compare the capacity of STGNN architectures to deal with different levels of local and global chaos. We illustrate the usage of the framework by analyzing 13 architectures (5 STGNNs and 8 non-graph baselines). The results reveal a regime dependent transition in which non-graph baselines (TCN, N-BEATS, iTransformer) remain competitive when there is low local chaos, while STGNNs (e.g., Graph WaveNet, D2STGNN, STAEformer) are generally more resilient to higher levels of local and global chaos. CNB provides a practical, reusable testbed for systematically comparing and analyzing the capacity of STGNN architectures to handle different levels of local and global chaos.

AI.tldr: 提出了ChaosNetBench (CNB)，一个基于耦合标准映射的合成基准数据集和评估框架，用于研究时空图神经网络(STGNN)在不同混沌动力学水平下的性能表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的STGNN评估实践使用单一领域的真实世界基准数据集和固定的划分方式，难以在不同动力学机制下比较架构性能。缺乏一个可控的、能够系统性评估STGNN处理不同混沌水平能力的基准平台。
AI.method: 构建基于耦合标准映射晶格的合成基准数据集CNB，包含96个系统实例和9,600条轨迹。系统具有可独立调节的局部混沌参数(K)、耦合强度(ε)和系统规模(N)，提供已知的拓扑结构和动力学特性。引入混沌指标、评估指标和分析协议，对13种架构（5种STGNN和8种非图基线）进行系统性比较分析。
AI.result: 发现了依赖于动力学机制的转变现象：在低局部混沌水平下，非图基线模型(TCN, N-BEATS, iTransformer)保持竞争力；而在更高的局部和全局混沌水平下，STGNN架构(Graph WaveNet, D2STGNN, STAEformer)表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CNB提供了一个实用、可复用的测试平台，能够系统地比较和分析STGNN架构处理不同水平局部和全局混沌的能力，为时空图神经网络的评估提供了新的标准化框架。

title: Learning Unified Representations of Normalcy for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: The core challenge in unsupervised anomaly detection is identifying abnormal patterns without prior knowledge of their characteristics. While existing methods have addressed aspects of this problem, they often struggle to learn a robust representation of the normal data distribution that is distinct from anomalous patterns. In this paper, we present a novel framework, Unified Unsupervised Anomaly Detection ($\text{U}^2\text{AD}$), that comprehensively addresses anomaly detection in multivariate time series. Our approach learns the underlying data distribution of normal samples by utilizing score-based generative modeling. We introduce a novel time-dependent score network and a unified training objective that together delineate the manifold of normal data while considering both local and global temporal contexts. Reconstruction is then performed via a deterministic sampling process using an ordinary differential equation solver. Our extensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that $\text{U}^2\text{AD}$ not only outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in detection accuracy but also identifies anomalies at significantly earlier stages of their occurrence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了U²AD框架，利用基于分数的生成模型学习正常样本分布，在多变量时间序列异常检测中实现了超越SOTA的准确性和更早的异常识别能力。
AI.motivation: 无监督异常检测的核心挑战在于缺乏异常模式的先验知识。现有方法难以学习到与异常模式明显区分的鲁棒正常数据分布表示，这限制了检测性能。
AI.method: 提出统一无监督异常检测(U²AD)框架。采用基于分数的生成建模学习正常样本的底层数据分布。设计了新颖的时间依赖分数网络和统一训练目标，共同刻画正常数据的流形，同时考虑局部和全局时间上下文。通过常微分方程求解器进行确定性采样过程完成重构。
AI.result: 在多变量时间序列异常检测任务上，U²AD不仅检测准确率超越了当前最先进方法，而且能够在异常发生的更早阶段识别出异常。
AI.conclusion: U²AD框架通过分数生成模型有效学习了正常数据分布，为无监督异常检测提供了一种高效解决方案，在准确性和早期检测能力上都展现出显著优势。

title: Quantum Circuit Simulation of Compartmental Drug Dynamics: Leveraging Variational Algorithms for Nonlinear Mixed-Effects Population Pharmacokinetics
summary: Population pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) modeling traditionally relies on classical ordinary differential equations to simulate drug dynamics. In this work, we reformulate a compartmental PK/PD model as an open quantum system and implement it using quantum circuits developed in PennyLane. Four pharmacological compartments (central, peripheral, effect-site, and response) are encoded using twelve qubits, with inter-compartmental transitions represented through controlled quantum operations that emulate stochastic dynamics. The framework is evaluated on Phase 1 clinical data using a quantum-enhanced stochastic approximation expectation-maximization (SAEM) approach. Compared with the classical implementation, the quantum model achieves substantially improved log-likelihood values, indicating stronger statistical fit while preserving identical parameter estimates, thereby validating numerical consistency and model interpretability. The quantum-based optimization converges faster in terms of iterations, although total runtime is increased due to current simulation overhead. The study demonstrates stable large-scale simulation performance and establishes a hybrid quantum-classical approach that maintains biological fidelity while improving statistical modeling capacity. The dataset and problem statement originate from the Quantum Innovation Challenge 2025, and additional details are provided via the associated link.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次将群体药代动力学/药效学（PK/PD）模型重构为开放量子系统，并在PennyLane中实现量子电路，相比经典方法获得了更好的统计拟合效果和更快的收敛速度，验证了量子方法在药物动力学建模中的可行性。
AI.motivation: 传统的群体PK/PD建模依赖常微分方程模拟药物动力学，本研究旨在探索量子计算在药理学建模中的潜力，通过量子系统表述来增强统计建模能力。
AI.method: 将四室PK/PD模型（中央室、外周室、效应室和响应室）重构为开放量子系统，使用12个量子比特编码，通过受控量子操作模拟室间转换的随机动力学。采用量子增强的随机近似期望最大化（SAEM）方法，在PennyLane平台上实现量子电路，并在I期临床数据上进行评估。
AI.result: 相比经典实现，量子模型实现了显著改善的对数似然值，表明更强的统计拟合能力，同时保持相同的参数估计值，验证了数值一致性和模型可解释性。量子优化在迭代次数上收敛更快，但由于当前模拟开销，总运行时间增加。研究展示了稳定的大规模模拟性能。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功建立了保持生物学保真度同时改善统计建模能力的混合量子-经典方法，验证了量子计算在药物动力学建模中的可行性和优势，为未来量子计算在药理学领域的应用奠定了基础。

title: Discovery of Nonlinear Dynamics with Automated Basis Function Generation
comment: 53 pages, 17 figures. Code available at https://github.com/mabasiri95/AutoSINDy
summary: Discovering governing equations from observational data remains a fundamental challenge in scientific modeling, particularly when the underlying mathematical structure is unknown. Traditional sparse identification methods like SINDy excel at discovering parsimonious models but require researchers to specify candidate basis functions a priori, a limitation that often leads to model failure when critical terms are omitted or when systems exhibit unconventional dynamics. Purely symbolic regression approaches offer unlimited flexibility but struggle with noise sensitivity and frequently produce overly complex, unstable equations. We present AutoSINDy, a hybrid Discovery-then-Solve framework that combines the exploratory power of symbolic regression with the robust sparsity-promoting capabilities of SINDy. Our method operates in three stages: (1) PySR-based symbolic regression discovers candidate functional forms from bootstrapped data chunks; (2) a curation pipeline decomposes, expands, and filters these expressions using collinearity analysis to construct a minimal yet comprehensive library; and (3) SINDy identifies sparse governing equations from this custom-tailored library. Extensive experiments across canonical nonlinear systems demonstrate that AutoSINDy consistently recovers ground-truth equations even under high observational noise, achieving a ground-truth recovery rate of 92.8% across all trials. Compared with standard SINDy using enriched libraries and standalone symbolic regression, AutoSINDy achieves higher predictive accuracy, superior generalization to unseen trajectories, and substantially lower symbolic complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoSINDy混合框架，结合符号回归与SINDy的优势，自动发现候选函数并构建定制化库，在高噪声条件下实现了92.8%的真实方程恢复率。
AI.motivation: 传统稀疏识别方法（如SINDy）需要预先指定候选基函数，若遗漏关键项或系统具有非传统动态特性则会导致模型失效；而纯符号回归方法虽然灵活性高，但对噪声敏感且易产生过于复杂、不稳定的方程。
AI.method: 提出Discovery-then-Solve三阶段框架：(1)利用PySR符号回归从自助采样数据块中发现候选函数形式；(2)通过筛选流程对表达式进行分解、扩展和过滤，利用共线性分析构建最小且全面的基函数库；(3)SINDy从该定制化库中识别稀疏控制方程。
AI.result: 在典型非线性系统上的广泛实验表明，AutoSINDy在高观测噪声下仍能稳定恢复真实方程，所有试验中的真实方程恢复率达92.8%。与使用扩展库的标准SINDy和独立符号回归相比，AutoSINDy实现了更高的预测精度、更优的未见轨迹泛化能力以及显著更低的符号复杂度。
AI.conclusion: AutoSINDy成功融合了符号回归的探索能力与SINDy的稀疏促进鲁棒性，有效解决了基函数预设限制问题，在发现简洁、准确且泛化能力强的控制方程方面显著优于现有方法。

title: Adaptive Data Harvesting for Efficient Neural Network Learning with Universal Constraints
summary: Training neural networks to satisfy universal constraints over continuous domains poses unique challenges. Common examples include Lyapunov Neural Networks (Lyapunov NNs) and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), where analytical solutions are generally either unavailable or overly restrictive. Sample-based methods are therefore commonly used to enforce these constraints, and the choice of samples has a substantial impact on convergence speed, stability, and solution quality. Most existing methods rely on fixed heuristics or handcrafted rules, and are suboptimal in practice. In this paper, we aim to improve upon them by learning, from data and experience, how to dynamically and iteratively adjust the samples in response to the model's evolving learning performance. Trained by reinforcement learning, the learned policy improves empirical constraint satisfaction on test problems while significantly improving efficiency. We validate the approach on both Lyapunov NNs and PINNs, and demonstrate its broader applicability to domains where adaptive input selection is essential for effective training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的方法，用于动态调整神经网络训练中的采样策略，以更好地满足连续域上的通用约束条件。该方法在Lyapunov神经网络和物理信息神经网络上的实验表明，能够提高约束满足度并显著提升训练效率。
AI.motivation: 在训练需要满足连续域上通用约束的神经网络（如Lyapunov神经网络和物理信息神经网络）时，解析解通常不可用或限制性过强，因此常用基于样本的方法来强制执行约束。然而，现有方法多依赖固定启发式规则或手工设计的策略，样本选择对收敛速度、稳定性和解的质量影响显著，但现有方法在实际应用中往往次优。
AI.method: 提出一种基于强化学习的方法，从数据和经验中学习如何根据模型不断演化的学习表现，动态且迭代地调整训练样本。通过强化学习训练得到的策略能够自适应地进行输入选择，从而改进约束满足效果。
AI.result: 在Lyapunov神经网络和物理信息神经网络的测试问题上进行了验证，学习到的策略在提高经验约束满足度的同时显著提升了训练效率。证明了该方法在需要自适应输入选择以实现有效训练的领域具有更广泛的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功展示了利用强化学习动态调整样本选择策略的有效性，为连续域约束满足问题提供了一种自动化、数据驱动的解决方案。该方法具有通用性，可推广至其他需要自适应输入选择的关键训练场景。

title: Benchmarking Transformer and xLSTM for Time-Series Forecasting of Heat Consumption
comment: Submitted version of the paper submitted to IEEE SusTech, 2026
summary: Obtaining an accurate short-term forecasting for heat demand is an essential part of operating district heating networks cost-efficient and reliable. Heat consumption time series at the building level are highly dependent on exogenous variables such as outdoor temperature and individual usage patterns, making forecasting in this context a challenging task. Thus, this paper benchmarks novel Transformer-based and xLSTM architectures for short-term heat-demand forecasting. Using hourly data from 25 German buildings (2017-2025), we compare three-hour and 24-hour forecasting horizons relevant for intraday control and day-ahead scheduling. We establish a multi-building benchmark that tests whether models trained on pooled, heterogeneous building data are able to generalize across diverse building stock. The results show that the xLSTM achieves the lowest RMSE (19.88 kWh for three-hour, 21.47 kWh for 24-hour forecasts), while the Temporal Fusion Transformer attains the best MAE (9.16 kWh for three-hour forecasts). As xLSTMs and Transformers require long training times and have a huge number of trainable parameters, their sustainability remains questionable. Therefore, this paper further investigates the trade-off between predictive accuracy and computational resource demand of the evaluated forecasting models. The findings indicate that also low-parameter models like a traditional fully-connected network achieve good predictive results, highlighting that marginal accuracy gains of the novel prediction models come at substantial resource expense for this use case.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了基于Transformer和xLSTM的新型架构在建筑级短期热负荷预测中的表现。结果显示xLSTM具有最低的RMSE，Temporal Fusion Transformer在MAE上表现最佳，但传统低参数模型也能取得较好的预测效果，新模型的边际精度提升伴随着巨大的计算资源开销。
AI.motivation: 区域供热网络的成本高效和可靠运行需要准确的热负荷短期预测。然而，建筑层面的热消耗时间序列高度依赖于室外温度等外生变量和个体使用模式，使得预测具有挑战性。同时，新型深度学习模型（如Transformer和xLSTM）虽然性能强大，但参数量大、训练时间长，其可持续性受到质疑。因此，需要探究预测精度与计算资源需求之间的权衡。
AI.method: 使用2017-2025年来自25栋德国建筑的逐时数据，对基于Transformer和xLSTM的新型架构进行基准测试。比较了与日内控制和日前调度相关的3小时和24小时预测范围。建立了多建筑基准测试，评估在混合建筑数据池上训练的模型是否能够跨不同建筑类型进行泛化。同时对比分析了包括传统全连接网络在内的多种模型的预测精度与计算资源需求。
AI.result: xLSTM取得了最低的均方根误差（RMSE）（3小时预测为19.88 kWh，24小时预测为21.47 kWh），而Temporal Fusion Transformer在3小时预测中取得了最佳的平均绝对误差（MAE，9.16 kWh）。研究发现，传统的低参数模型（如全连接网络）也能实现良好的预测结果，表明新型预测模型的边际精度提升是以大量计算资源消耗为代价的。
AI.conclusion: 在建筑级短期热负荷预测任务中，虽然xLSTM和Transformer等新型架构在精度上略有优势，但传统低参数模型也能达到令人满意的预测效果。考虑到新型模型巨大的参数量和训练成本，在实际应用中应权衡预测精度与计算资源需求，不应盲目追求复杂的深度学习架构。

title: Model Capacity Determines Grokking through Competing Memorisation and Generalisation Speeds
summary: Existing accounts of grokking explain the phenomena in terms of mechanistic frameworks such as circuit efficiency or lazy-to-rich transitions. However, despite a known dependence between grokking and model size, how model capacity shapes grokking remains an open question. We give an information-theoretic account of this relationship on the task of modular arithmetic, showing that grokking does not immediately occur when a model becomes large enough to memorise the training set, but rather emerges as the outcome of a competition between two measurable timescales: a memorisation speed $T_{\text{mem}}(P)$ and a generalisation speed $T_{\text{gen}}(P)$, both of which are functions of model parameter count $P$. Adapting the information capacity framework of Morris et al. (2025), we estimate $T_{\text{mem}}(P)$ on random-label data of equivalent complexity and $T_{\text{gen}}(P)$ on the modular task itself, and show that grokking emerges close to the parameter scale where these timescales intersect. The framework also suggests an empirical model for predicting memorisation speed given model capacity and dataset complexity, recovering the previously reported empirical observation that larger models memorise faster. Overall, we motivate the formalisation of different learning timescales as important abstractions to study when explaining how model capacity shapes grokking on algorithmic tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文从信息论视角解释了模型容量与顿悟现象的关系，提出顿悟发生在记忆速度与泛化速度这两个时间尺度相互竞争并接近交汇的参数规模处。
AI.motivation: 现有的顿悟现象解释多基于电路效率或惰性到丰富转换等机制框架，尽管已知顿悟与模型规模存在依赖关系，但模型容量如何塑造顿悟仍是一个未解之谜。
AI.method: 基于Morris等人(2025)的信息容量框架，在模运算任务上定义并估计了两个可测量的时间尺度：记忆速度$T_{\text{mem}}(P)$（在等复杂度的随机标签数据上估计）和泛化速度$T_{\text{gen}}(P)$（在模运算任务本身上估计），两者均为模型参数量$P$的函数。
AI.result: 发现顿悟现象并非在模型大到足以记忆训练集时立即发生，而是作为两个时间尺度竞争的结果出现；顿悟涌现于这两个时间尺度接近交汇的参数规模附近；框架还提出了一个预测记忆速度的经验模型，能够复现“更大模型记忆更快”这一先前观察。
AI.conclusion: 证明了将不同学习时间尺度形式化作为重要抽象概念的价值，为理解模型容量如何在算法任务上塑造顿悟现象提供了新的信息论视角。

title: One for All: A Non-Linear Transformer can Enable Cross-Domain Generalization for In-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: A central challenge in reinforcement learning (RL) is to learn models that generalize beyond the tasks on which they are trained, a goal traditionally pursued through multi-task and meta RL. Recently, transformer architectures have emerged as a promising approach, enabling adaptation to new tasks via in-context learning without explicit parameter updates. From a functional perspective, a transformer can be viewed as a functional operator that maps a context to a task-specific function. It is thus fundamental to understand and design this operator to support stronger generalization in RL. In this work, we address this resulting question of generalization from a kernel-based perspective by establishing a connection between non-linear transformers and kernel-based temporal difference learning. By interpreting the transformer as performing regression in a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS), we show that value functions from different domains can be represented using a shared set of weights, provided they lie within the same RKHS. Experiments on multiple MetaWorld domains support this interpretation, demonstrating convergence of the temporal-difference objective.

AI.tldr: 本文从核方法视角揭示了非线性Transformer在强化学习中的泛化机制，建立了其与核时序差分学习的理论联系，证明同RKHS内的价值函数可共享权重表示。
AI.motivation: 强化学习的一个核心挑战是训练出能够超越训练任务集进行泛化的模型。尽管基于Transformer的架构通过上下文学习展现出了适应新任务的潜力，但从功能视角看，如何理解和设计Transformer作为将上下文映射到特定任务函数的算子，以支持更强的泛化能力，仍是一个根本性问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种基于核的视角，建立了非线性Transformer与核时序差分学习之间的理论联系。通过将Transformer解释为在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中进行回归操作，作者证明了只要价值函数位于同一RKHS内，来自不同领域的价值函数就可以使用一组共享权重进行表示。
AI.result: 在多个MetaWorld领域的实验结果支持了这一理论解释，证明了时序差分目标能够收敛，验证了基于RKHS的共享权重表示方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为理解Transformer在强化学习中的泛化能力提供了新的理论框架，表明通过核方法的视角可以设计和优化Transformer算子，实现跨领域价值函数的有效表示和泛化。

title: RubricRefine: Improving Tool-Use Agent Reliability with Training-Free Pre-Execution Refinement
summary: Iterative self-refinement is a popular inference-time reliability technique, but its effectiveness in code-mode tool use depends heavily on the structure of the feedback signal: unstructured critique helps inconsistently across models, and even revision with real execution feedback improves only modestly ($0.75$ vs. $0.65$ baseline). The dominant failures are inter-tool contract violations - wrong output shape, incorrect tool routing, broken argument provenance - that run to completion without raising errors, making runtime feedback insufficient. We introduce RubricRefine, a training-free pre-execution reliability layer that generates task- and registry-specific rubrics, scores candidate code against explicit contract checks, and iteratively repairs failures before any execution occurs. With zero execution attempts, RubricRefine reaches $0.86$ on M3ToolEval averaged across seven models-improving over prior inference-time baselines on every model tested on this benchmark, at $2.6X$ lower latency than the strongest non-iterative alternative - and remains flat on the predominantly single-step API-Bank, consistent with the method's reliance on inter-tool contract structure. A rubric-category ablation and calibration analysis further characterize when and why the method works.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RubricRefine，一种无需训练的预执行可靠性方法，通过生成任务和工具注册特定的评分标准，在执行前检测并修复代码中的跨工具契约违规，在M3ToolEval上达到0.86平均性能，优于所有基线且延迟降低2.6倍。
AI.motivation: 迭代自我细化在代码模式工具使用中的效果严重依赖反馈信号结构：非结构化批评在不同模型间效果不一致，即使使用真实执行反馈进行修订也仅能适度改进（0.75 vs 0.65基线）。主要失败原因是跨工具契约违规——错误的输出形状、不正确的工具路由、破坏的参数来源——这些问题会完整执行而不引发错误，使运行时反馈不足。
AI.method: 提出RubricRefine，一种无需训练的预执行可靠性层，包含三个核心步骤：(1) 生成任务和工具注册特定的评分标准；(2) 根据显式契约检查对候选代码进行评分；(3) 在任何执行发生前迭代修复失败项。该方法专注于在执行前捕获跨工具契约违规。
AI.result: 在M3ToolEval基准上，RubricRefine在零执行尝试的情况下，七个模型平均达到0.86的性能，超越该基准上所有先前的推理时基线。相比最强的非迭代替代方案，延迟降低2.6倍。在主要包含单步任务的API-Bank上性能保持平坦，与方法对跨工具契约结构的依赖一致。评分标准类别消融研究和校准分析进一步阐明了该方法何时以及为何有效。
AI.conclusion: RubricRefine证明了预执行契约检查的有效性，通过在执行前显式建模跨工具契约约束，能够显著提升代码模式工具使用的可靠性，同时大幅降低延迟。该方法在多步骤工具组合任务中表现优异，但在单步任务上效果有限，揭示了其适用边界。

title: CALYREX: Cross-Attention LaYeR EXtended Transformers for System Prompt Anchoring
summary: Modern large language models (LLMs) rely on system prompts to establish behavioral constraints and safety rules. Standard causal self-attention treats privileged instructions and untrusted user content with equal structural priority -- a mismatch that leaves models vulnerable to prompt injection and instruction erosion over extended contexts. We propose CALYREX (Cross-Attention LaYeR EXtended transformers), which utilizes cross-attention between input and system prompt to structurally isolate and anchor the rule. A placement ablation on a 1.5B backbone identifies insertion at the final eighth of layers as optimal, confirmed by mechanistic activation analysis showing behavioral constraints are naturally concentrated there. At 8B scale, controlling for training data, backbone, and parameter budget, CALYREX yields $+7.4\%$ on instruction-following (IFEval) and $+16.3\%$ on multi-turn instruction adherence, while reducing many-shot jailbreaking attack success rate by $13\%$. This advantage appears to widen with model scale, consistent with larger models more effectively utilizing the dedicated routing pathway.

AI.tldr: 提出CALYREX架构，通过交叉注意力机制结构化隔离系统提示，显著提升指令遵循能力并降低越狱攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现代大语言模型中，标准因果自注意力机制赋予系统提示（特权指令）与用户内容同等的结构优先级，导致模型容易受到提示注入攻击，且在长上下文中指令约束会被侵蚀。
AI.method: 提出CALYREX（Cross-Attention LaYeR EXtended transformers），在输入与系统提示之间引入交叉注意力机制，实现规则的结构化隔离与锚定；通过消融实验确定最优插入位置为最后1/8层，并发现行为约束天然集中在该层。
AI.result: 在8B规模模型上（控制训练数据、骨干网络和参数预算），CALYREX在指令遵循任务（IFEval）上提升7.4%，在多轮指令遵守上提升16.3%，同时将多样本越狱攻击成功率降低13%；该优势随模型规模扩大而增强。
AI.conclusion: CALYREX通过专用路由路径有效解决了系统提示与用户内容结构优先级不匹配的问题，且更大模型能更有效地利用该机制，为LLM的安全对齐提供了新的架构方案。

title: TIDES: Implicit Time-Awareness in Selective State Space Models
summary: Selective state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, achieve strong per-token expressivity by making the time discretization step $\TildeΔ$ a learned function of the input. However, in doing so, $\TildeΔ$ ceases to represent a physical sampling interval, limiting its irregular time series modeling capability. Continuous-time SSMs, such as S5, preserve the physical meaning of $\TildeΔ$ and handle irregular timestamps natively ($\TildeΔ\equivΔ)$, but their dynamics remain linear time-invariant (LTI), limiting per-token expressivity. We propose \textbf{TIDES}, a selective SSM variant that reconciles selective and continuous architectures by moving input-dependence off the step size and onto the diagonal state matrix. As a result, $\TildeΔ$ retains its physical meaning, tied to the state discretization, allowing the model to handle irregular timestamps natively without sacrificing the per-token expressivity that makes selective SSMs effective. We show this on a novel \emph{Fading Flash} experimental benchmark, a compact controlled diagnostic for sequence models that jointly tests input-dependence and extrapolation to out-of-distribution $Δ$ values, and isolates the distinct failure modes of current state-of-the-art architectures that TIDES avoids by construction. On large-scale benchmarks, TIDES sets the new state-of-the-art average rank on UEA time-series classification and the Physiome-ODE regression benchmark. Code available at: https://github.com/TaylanSoydan/TIDES.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TIDES，一种选择性状态空间模型，通过将对输入的依赖性从步长转移到对角状态矩阵上，实现了在不规则时间序列建模中同时保持选择性机制的表达能力和物理意义。
AI.motivation: 现有的选择性状态空间模型（如Mamba）虽然具有强大的逐token表达能力，但其时间离散化步长作为输入的学习函数，丧失了物理采样间隔的意义，限制了对不规则时间序列的建模能力；而连续时间SSM（如S5）虽然保留了物理意义但动态特性是线性时不变的，限制了表达能力。这两种架构存在权衡矛盾。
AI.method: 提出TIDES模型，将对输入的依赖性从步长转移到对角状态矩阵上，使时间离散化步长保持其物理意义并与状态离散化绑定，从而在不牺牲选择性SSM有效的逐token表达能力的前提下，原生处理不规则时间戳。
AI.result: 在新的Fading Flash实验基准上展示了TIDES避免了现有最先进架构的失效模式；在大规模基准测试中，TIDES在UEA时间序列分类和Physiome-ODE回归基准上取得了新的最先进平均排名。
AI.conclusion: TIDES成功地将选择性架构和连续架构统一起来，在不规则时间序列建模任务中实现了最先进的性能，证明了将输入依赖性转移至对角状态矩阵的方法的有效性。

title: Entropy-informed Decoding: Adaptive Information-Driven Branching
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable generative performance, yet their output quality is dependent on the decoding strategy. While sampling-based methods (e.g., top-k, nucleus) and search-and-select based methods (e.g., beam search, best-of-n, majority voting) can improve upon greedy decoding, both approaches suffer from limitations: sampling generally commits to a single path, while search often expends excessive computation regardless of task complexity. To address these, we introduce Entropy-informed decoding (EDEN), a plug-and-play, model-agnostic decoding framework that adaptively allocates computation based on the model's own uncertainty, approximating higher-width beam search with fewer expansions. At each generation step, EDEN estimates the entropy of the output token distribution and adjusts the branching factor monotonically with the entropy, expanding more candidates in high-entropy regions and following a greedier path in low-entropy regions, improving token efficiency. Experiments across complex tasks, including mathematical reasoning, code generation, and scientific questions, demonstrate that EDEN consistently improves output quality over existing decoding strategies, achieving better accuracy-expansion trade-offs than fixed-width beam search. By treating next-token selection as a noisy maximisation problem, we prove that branching factors monotone in entropy are guaranteed to find better (i.e. more probable) continuations than any fixed branching factor within the same total expansion budget, and derive explicit regret rates characterising the benefit of the adaptive allocation.

AI.tldr: 提出EDEN：一种基于模型输出熵的自适应解码框架，通过在不确定区域增加分支、在确定区域贪婪选择，实现比固定宽度束搜索更好的精度-计算权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM解码策略存在局限：采样方法通常沿单一路径生成；搜索方法（如束搜索）无论任务复杂度如何都消耗大量计算。缺乏一种能够根据模型不确定性自适应分配计算资源的解码方法。
AI.method: 提出Entropy-informed decoding (EDEN)：一种即插即用、模型无关的解码框架。在每个生成步骤估计输出token分布的熵，并根据熵单调调整分支因子：在高熵（不确定）区域扩展更多候选，在低熵（确定）区域采用更贪婪的路径。将下一词元选择建模为噪声最大化问题，理论证明了与熵单调的分支因子在相同总扩展预算下优于任何固定分支因子。
AI.result: 在数学推理、代码生成和科学问答等复杂任务上的实验表明，EDEN持续优于现有解码策略，相比固定宽度束搜索实现了更好的精度-扩展权衡，并推导出刻画自适应分配收益的显式遗憾率。
AI.conclusion: EDEN通过基于模型自身不确定性的自适应计算分配，有效平衡了生成质量与计算效率，为LLM解码提供了一个理论有保证且实用的解决方案。

title: Sequential Feature Selection for Efficient Landslide Segmentation from Multi-Spectral Data
comment: In Process of Submission to Frontiers in Remote Sensing. Keywords: landslide segmentation, multispectral remote sensing, feature selection, explainability, Landslide4Sense
summary: Landslide detection from satellite imagery has advanced through deep learning, yet most models rely on large, highly correlated spectral-topographic inputs whose contributions remain poorly understood. The question of which channels are actually necessary has received surprisingly little attention. This matters: redundant or correlated inputs obscure physical interpretability, inflate computational overhead, and can actively degrade model performance through the Hughes Phenomenon. We present a systematic, explainable channel-selection framework for the Landslide4Sense benchmark, combining Sentinel-2 multispectral and ALOS PALSAR terrain data with 16 engineered spectral and structural indices. Rather than relying on conventional single-band drop tests, which evaluate channels in isolation and miss interaction effects, we apply Sequential Forward Floating Selection (SFFS) to iteratively build and prune a candidate feature pool using a lightweight U-Net++ proxy model. Beyond identifying a compact 8-channel subset that matches or exceeds the segmentation F1 of configurations using up to 30 channels, we use the selection process itself to interrogate which spectral and topographic features landslide models genuinely rely on, and what this reveals about the physical cues driving their predictions. We argue that SFFS represents a principled feature selection approach to input design in Earth observation, in contrast to the prevailing practice of appending every available band and hoping the model learns what to ignore.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于SFFS的特征选择框架，从多达30个通道中筛选出8个关键通道，在保持或提升滑坡检测性能的同时，揭示了模型依赖的物理线索。
AI.motivation: 现有滑坡检测模型依赖大量高度相关的光谱-地形输入，其贡献尚不明确；冗余输入不仅模糊了物理可解释性、增加计算开销，还可能因Hughes现象降低模型性能。
AI.method: 针对Landslide4Sense基准，结合Sentinel-2多光谱、ALOS PALSAR地形数据及16个工程指数，采用序列前向浮动选择（SFFS）算法，配合轻量级U-Net++代理模型，迭代构建并剪枝候选特征池。
AI.result: 筛选出的紧凑8通道子集在分割F1分数上匹配或超越使用多达30通道的配置，同时揭示了滑坡模型真正依赖的光谱与地形特征。
AI.conclusion: SFFS为地球观测中的输入设计提供了有原则的特征选择方法，相比盲目堆砌所有可用波段的常规做法更具优势。

title: On Uniform Error Bounds for Kernel Regression under Non-Gaussian Noise
comment: This paper has been accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
summary: Providing non-conservative uncertainty quantification for function estimates derived from noisy observations remains a fundamental challenge in statistical machine learning, particularly for applications in safety-critical domains. In this work, we propose novel non-asymptotic probabilistic uniform error bounds for kernel-based regression. Compared to related bounds in the literature that are restricted to (conditionally) independent sub-Gaussian noise, our bounds allow to consider a broad class of non-Gaussian distributions, such as sub-Gaussian, bounded, sub-exponential, and variance/moment-bounded noise. Moreover, our results apply to correlated and uncorrelated noise. We compare our proposed error bounds with existing results in terms of the induced uncertainty region and their performance in safe control, demonstrating the tightness of the proposed bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对核回归的非渐近概率一致误差界，支持非高斯分布和相关性噪声，为安全关键领域提供了更紧的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 在统计机器学习中，为从噪声观测中获得的函数估计提供非保守的不确定性量化是一个根本性挑战，这在安全关键领域应用中尤为重要。现有文献中的界限通常局限于（条件）独立的次高斯噪声，限制了更广泛噪声场景下的应用。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的非渐近概率一致误差界用于核回归。与现有文献中仅限于（条件）独立次高斯噪声的界限不同，该方法允许考虑广泛的非高斯分布类别（如次高斯、有界、次指数以及方差/矩有界噪声），并且结果适用于相关和非相关噪声场景。
AI.result: 通过与现有结果在诱导不确定性区域和安全控制中的性能进行比较，证明了所提出的界限具有紧致性。所提出的误差界限能够适应更广泛的噪声分布类型和相关性结构。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功扩展了核回归误差界的适用范围，突破了传统次高斯独立噪声的限制，为安全关键系统提供了更紧、更实用的不确定性量化方法，具有重要的理论和应用价值。

title: WISTERIA: Learning Clinical Representations from Noisy Supervision via Multi-View Consistency in Electronic Health Records
summary: Representation learning in electronic health records (EHR) has largely followed paradigms inherited from natural language processing, relying on sequence modeling and reconstruction based objectives that treat clinical labels as ground truth. However, real world clinical supervision is inherently weak, arising from heterogeneous, noisy, and institution specific labeling processes such as billing codes, heuristic phenotypes, and incomplete annotations. In this work, we propose WISTERIA, a weakly supervised representation learning framework that models labels as stochastic observations of an underlying latent clinical state. Instead of optimizing against a single supervision signal, WISTERIA constructs multiple weak supervision operators and learns representations by enforcing consistency across their induced label distributions. This multi view formulation induces an implicit denoising mechanism, allowing the model to recover clinically meaningful structure by reconciling disagreement between noisy labelers. We further incorporate ontology aware regularization in the label space to impose semantic structure over supervision signals. Empirically, WISTERIA improves predictive performance across standard EHR benchmarks, demonstrates strong robustness to label noise, and exhibits superior cross institutional generalization compared to sequence based pretraining objectives. These results suggest that explicitly modeling the supervision process rather than treating labels as fixed targets provides a more appropriate inductive bias for learning robust and clinically meaningful representations from EHR data.

AI.tldr: 提出了WISTERIA框架，通过将临床标签建模为潜在临床状态的随机观测，并利用多视图一致性学习来处理EHR数据中固有的弱监督和标签噪声问题，从而学习到更鲁棒且具有临床意义的表征。
AI.motivation: 现有的EHR表征学习方法大多沿袭自然语言处理范式，将临床标签视为绝对真值。然而，现实世界的临床监督本质上是弱监督，来源于异构、噪声大且具有机构特异性的标注过程（如计费代码、启发式表型和不完整注释），这导致了标签质量的不确定性。
AI.method: 提出WISTERIA弱监督表征学习框架。核心方法包括：1) 将标签建模为潜在临床状态的随机观测，而非固定目标；2) 构建多个弱监督算子，通过强制其诱导的标签分布之间的一致性来学习表征；3) 这种多视图公式引入了隐式去噪机制，通过协调噪声标注者之间的分歧来恢复临床有意义的结构；4) 在标签空间引入本体感知正则化，对监督信号施加语义结构约束。
AI.result: 在标准EHR基准测试中，WISTERIA提升了预测性能；对标签噪声表现出强大的鲁棒性；与基于序列的预训练目标相比，展现了更优越的跨机构泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 显式地对监督过程进行建模，而非将标签视为固定目标，为从EHR数据中学习鲁棒且具有临床意义的表征提供了更合适的归纳偏置。这表明在医疗领域应重视标签生成过程的不确定性。

title: Bayesian Optimization with Structured Measurements: A Vector-Valued RKHS Framework
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is an efficient framework for optimizing expensive black-box functions. However, it is typically formulated as learning an end-to-end mapping from inputs to scalar objectives, thereby discarding the potentially rich information whenever a structured system output is available. In this work, we study Bayesian optimization over a vector-valued operator with structured measurements, where each measurement observes multidimensional or functional outputs, e.g., trajectories or spatial fields, rather than a single scalar value. The objective is then defined as a linear functional of these measurements. This allows each observation to reveal substantially richer information about the underlying system compared to scalar observations. Assuming the unknown operator lies in a vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS), we derive high-probability concentration bounds for the kernel ridge regression (KRR) estimator directly in the measurement space, characterizing uncertainty in a general Hilbert space. Building on these results, we propose an algorithm based on the upper confidence bound (UCB) acquisition function with regret guarantees under mild assumptions, recovering sublinear rates for common kernels. Empirically, we demonstrate that leveraging structured measurements leads to improved sample efficiency by enabling efficient transfer of information across objectives and adaptation to time-varying settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用多维结构化测量（如轨迹或空间场）替代标量观测的贝叶斯优化方法，通过核岭回归在希尔伯特空间中进行不确定性量化，实现了更高的采样效率和信息传递能力。
AI.motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化将问题建模为从输入到标量目标的端到端映射，忽略了结构化系统输出中可能蕴含的丰富信息。当系统输出为多维或函数型数据时，标量观测会造成信息损失，因此需要一种能够直接利用结构化测量的方法来提升优化效率。
AI.method: 将优化目标定义为结构化测量的线性泛函，假设未知算子位于向量值再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中。通过核岭回归（KRR）估计器在测量空间直接推导高概率集中界，实现希尔伯特空间中的不确定性量化。基于此，提出使用上置信界（UCB）采集函数的优化算法。
AI.result: 在温和假设下证明了算法具有次线性遗憾界，并恢复了常用核函数的次线性收敛速率。实验表明，利用结构化测量能够通过在目标间高效传递信息以及适应时变设置，显著提升采样效率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的框架成功将贝叶斯优化扩展至向量值算子场景，证明了利用结构化测量相比传统标量观测具有显著优势，为涉及多维或函数型输出的昂贵黑盒优化问题提供了理论保证和实用算法。

title: Nectar: Neural Estimation of Cached-Token Attention via Regression
summary: Evaluating softmax attention over a fixed long context requires reading every cached key-value pair for each new query token. For a given context (a book, a manual, a legal corpus) the attention output is a deterministic function of the query. We propose Nectar, which fits a compact neural network to this function for queries drawn from a task-relevant distribution. Nectar fits two networks per layer and KV-head: a target network that predicts the attention output and a score network that predicts the log-normalizer. The pair plugs into the standard masked self-attention at inference time, replacing the $O(n)$ attention over the cache with a forward pass whose cost does not depend on $n$. Each module carries on the order of $|θ|$ parameters per layer and KV-head, typically much smaller than the $2nd$ KV-cache footprint at the same granularity. We report experiments on models from 1.7B to 8B parameters across five long-context datasets. The approximation error tracks the next-token accuracy gap to full attention, and allocating capacity non-uniformly across layers reduces that gap in our ablation. Beyond this analysis of metrics, we check that the text generations (following a question prompt) of a model equipped with a Nectar module match in semantic content those obtained by giving the same model access to the full cache.

AI.tldr: 提出Nectar方法，用紧凑神经网络近似softmax注意力函数，将推理时的O(n)复杂度降为与序列长度无关的前向传播，实现长文本高效推理。
AI.motivation: 标准softmax注意力在固定长上下文推理时，每个新查询token需读取缓存中所有键值对，计算复杂度为O(n)。对于给定上下文（书籍、手册、法律语料库），注意力输出是查询的确定性函数，这为用神经网络拟合该函数提供了可能。
AI.method: Nectar为每层和每个KV头拟合两个神经网络：目标网络预测注意力输出，分数网络预测log归一化因子。这两个网络在推理时直接替代标准掩码自注意力，用一次前向传播取代对缓存的O(n)遍历。每个模块参数量约为|θ|，通常远小于同粒度下2nd的KV缓存占用。在1.7B到8B参数模型上，跨五个长文本数据集进行实验。采用非均匀容量分配策略进行消融研究。
AI.result: 近似误差与相对完整注意力的下一词预测精度差距呈正相关关系。非均匀容量分配策略能有效降低精度差距。在问答提示场景下，配备Nectar模块的模型生成的文本在语义内容上与使用完整缓存的模型相匹配。
AI.conclusion: Nectar成功将长上下文注意力推理的计算复杂度从O(n)降至常数级别，在保持生成语义质量的同时大幅提升效率，为长文本处理提供了一种有效的近似注意力方案。

title: LEAD: Length-Efficient Adaptive and Dynamic Reasoning for Large Language Models
summary: Large reasoning models, such as OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek-R1, tend to become increasingly verbose as their reasoning capabilities improve. These inflated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectories often exceed what the underlying problems require, wasting compute, latency, and context budgets. While introducing length-based efficiency rewards during reinforcement learning offers a natural remedy, existing methods struggle with two fundamental challenges: the optimal balance between correctness and efficiency is non-stationary throughout training, and intrinsic reasoning budgets vary drastically across problems. Relying on static reward weights and global length constraints inevitably forces a compromise between degraded accuracy and unrealized compression. To overcome these limitations, we propose LEAD (Length-Efficient Adaptive and Dynamic reasoning), a method that replaces static heuristics with online, self-adaptive mechanisms. LEAD dynamically calibrates the correctness-efficiency trade-off at each step using a Potential-Scaled Instability, directing optimization capacity to the most informative learning signal. Furthermore, it estimates an adaptive per-problem target length online based on the model's own correct rollouts, applying a symmetric efficiency reward that penalizes both overthinking and over-compression. Evaluated on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, LEAD achieves the highest accuracy and Accuracy-Efficiency Score among RL-trained efficient-reasoning methods while producing substantially shorter outputs than the base model.

AI.tldr: 提出LEAD方法，通过在线自适应机制动态调整正确性与效率的平衡，在保持最高准确率的同时显著缩短推理输出长度。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（如OpenAI o1、DeepSeek-R1）能力提升时常伴随推理链过度冗长的问题，造成计算、延迟和上下文预算浪费。现有基于长度效率奖励的方法难以应对两大核心挑战：训练过程中正确性与效率的最优平衡具有非平稳性，且不同问题的内在推理长度预算差异巨大。依赖静态奖励权重和全局长度约束必然导致精度下降与压缩不足之间的妥协。
AI.method: 提出LEAD（Length-Efficient Adaptive and Dynamic reasoning）方法，用在线自适应机制替代静态启发式策略。该方法包含两个核心组件：(1) 利用Potential-Scaled Instability在每个训练步骤动态校准正确性-效率权衡，将优化能力导向最具信息量的学习信号；(2) 基于模型自身正确输出的在线估计，为每个问题计算自适应目标长度，并应用对称效率奖励同时惩罚过度思考和过度压缩。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准测试上，LEAD在所有基于强化学习训练的高效推理方法中取得了最高的准确率和准确率-效率得分，同时生成的输出比基础模型显著更短。
AI.conclusion: LEAD成功解决了现有方法中静态权重和全局约束的局限性，通过在线动态自适应机制实现了正确性与效率的帕累托最优，为大型推理模型的高效部署提供了有效解决方案。

title: Learning to Compress Time-to-Control: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Chronic Disease Management
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) in healthcare has had mixed results, with reward sparsity, unreliable off-policy evaluation, and deployment-simulation gap as recurring failure modes. We argue that chronic disease management is structurally a more tractable RL setting than the acute-care problems the field has primarily studied, but only if the problem is formalized to exploit chronic care's properties. We propose such a formalization. The agent's objective is to compress time-to-control (TTC) under a tiered reward calibrated to the CMS ACCESS Model. Two quantities from our companion preference-learning paper [Singh et al. 2026] enter as load-bearing structural elements: the execution intensity εbounds action availability under a constrained Markov Decision Process, and the clinician capability κweights offline-data transitions during RL training. Together they couple preference learning and RL into a two-loop architecture. We present simulation results on synthetic state machines for hypertension and type 2 diabetes. Capability-weighted offline RL outperforms uniform-weighted offline RL and the behavior policy by 15 percentage points on T2D TTC; the uniform-weighted formulation (the standard in existing healthcare RL) underperforms even the heterogeneous behavior policy. \Epsilon-aware policies generalize across deployment regimes while ε-naive policies do not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对慢性病管理的强化学习新框架，通过引入执行强度ε和临床医生能力κ，实现了偏好学习与强化学习的耦合，在高血压和2型糖尿病的模拟实验中显著优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 医疗强化学习领域存在奖励稀疏、离策略评估不可靠和部署-模拟差距等反复出现的失败模式。作者认为慢性病管理在结构上比目前主要研究的急性护理问题更适合强化学习，但需要利用慢性护理的特性来形式化问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的形式化方法：代理目标是在基于CMS ACCESS模型校准的分层奖励下压缩控制时间(TTC)；引入了两个核心结构元素：(1)执行强度ε，在受限马尔可夫决策过程下约束动作可用性；(2)临床医生能力κ，在强化学习训练期间对离线数据转换进行加权；将偏好学习和强化学习耦合为双环架构。
AI.result: 在高血压和2型糖尿病的合成状态机模拟中，能力加权离线强化学习在T2D TTC上比均匀加权离线强化学习和行为策略分别高出15个百分点；均匀加权公式（现有医疗强化学习的标准）甚至表现不如异质性行为策略；ε感知策略能够跨部署机制泛化，而ε朴素策略则不能。
AI.conclusion: 慢性病管理的结构化形式化方法能够有效解决医疗强化学习的关键挑战，能力加权和ε感知策略相比传统方法有显著提升，为医疗强化学习的实际应用提供了新方向。

title: Dystruct: Dynamically Structured Diffusion Language Model Decoding via Bayesian Inference
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models, primarily due to their ability to enable parallel decoding. Despite this advantage, most existing DLMs rely on a fixed generation length specified prior to decoding, which restricts their flexibility in real-world applications. While a few recent works attempt to support flexible-length generation, they typically suffer from notable limitations: some require costly retraining to accommodate variable-length outputs, while others depend solely on local confidence signals during decoding. Such local criteria fail to capture the evolving structure of the sequence, often resulting in suboptimal generation quality. In this paper, we propose a training-free, Bayesian structured decoding framework that formulates flexible-length generation as a dynamic structural inference problem. Our approach formulates flexible-length generation as a dynamic structural inference problem, jointly computing the expansion length, the block boundaries, and the decoding schedule. At each window expansion step, the method integrates local uncertainty with structural signals via a unified mechanism that supports dynamic structured generation, including both flexible block expansion and block organization, while maintaining coherence. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly improves generation quality and flexibility over existing fixed-length and flexible-length baselines. These results highlight the advantage of Bayesian structured decoding for diffusion language model, providing a principled and efficient solution for structured text generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种免训练的贝叶斯结构化解码框架，通过将变长生成建模为动态结构推断问题，联合计算扩展长度、块边界和解码调度，从而解决了现有扩散语言模型在变长生成上的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散语言模型虽然支持并行解码，但大多依赖固定的生成长度，限制了实际应用中的灵活性。少数支持变长生成的方法要么需要昂贵的重训练，要么仅依赖局部置信度信号，无法捕捉序列的演化结构，导致生成质量欠佳。
AI.method: 提出一种免训练的贝叶斯结构化解码框架，将变长生成形式化为动态结构推断问题。该方法联合计算扩展长度、块边界和解码调度，在每个窗口扩展步骤中，通过统一机制将局部不确定性与结构信号相结合，支持动态结构化生成（包括灵活的块扩展和块组织），同时保持文本连贯性。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，该方法在生成质量和灵活性方面显著优于现有的固定长度和变长基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯结构化解码为扩散语言模型提供了一种原理性强且高效的结构化文本生成解决方案，有效提升了生成质量和灵活性。

title: Pretraining large language models with MXFP4
summary: Why does full-pipeline FP4 training of large language models often diverge, even when forward activations and activation gradients remain stable? We address this question through a controlled study of MXFP4 quantization in transformer training, progressively enabling FP4 across forward propagation (Fprop), activation gradients (Dgrad), and weight gradients (Wgrad) while holding all other factors fixed. In full pretraining of Llama 3.1-8B on the C4 dataset, we observe that quantizing Wgrad is the primary driver of convergence degradation, whereas FP4 in Fprop and Dgrad alone introduces only modest additional token requirements. To interpret this behavior, we evaluate both structured and stochastic interventions under a controlled experimental setting. We find that stochastic rounding and randomized Hadamard rotations fail to stabilize training once Wgrad is quantized, whereas deterministic Hadamard rotations consistently restore stable optimization. These results suggest that FP4 training instability is driven by structured micro-scaling errors along sensitive gradient paths, rather than by insufficient stochasticity. We run experiments with native MXFP4 support on AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, enabling controlled investigation of these effects without reliance on software emulation.

AI.tldr: FP4训练不稳定的主要原因是权重梯度（Wgrad）量化产生的结构化误差，确定性Hadamard旋转可有效恢复训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型全流程FP4训练容易发散的根本原因，特别是当前向激活和激活梯度保持稳定时，为何训练仍会失败。
AI.method: 在Llama 3.1-8B模型和C4数据集上，逐步启用MXFP4量化（分别作用于前向传播、激活梯度、权重梯度），并在受控环境下评估结构化干预（确定性Hadamard旋转）与随机干预（随机舍入、随机Hadamard旋转）的效果。实验在原生支持MXFP4的AMD Instinct MI355X GPU上进行。
AI.result: 权重梯度量化是导致收敛退化的主要因素；仅对Fprop和Dgrad进行FP4量化影响较小；随机舍入和随机Hadamard旋转无法稳定Wgrad量化后的训练；确定性Hadamard旋转能够持续恢复优化稳定性。
AI.conclusion: FP4训练的不稳定性源于敏感梯度路径上的结构化微缩放误差，而非随机性不足；确定性Hadamard旋转可作为有效的稳定化手段。

title: Modeling Atomic Conformational Ensembles of Proteins via Test-Time Supervision of Boltz-2 on Cryo-EM Density Maps
summary: Knowledge of a protein's atomic conformational ensemble is critical to determining its function, yet state-of-the-art ensemble prediction models are limited by lack of high-quality conformational data from simulation or experiment. Recent advances in heterogeneous reconstruction for cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) have enabled scientists to visualize ensembles of density maps for larger proteins and complexes not typically accessible through simulation, but building atomic models into these maps remains a challenge. Traditionally, ensemble prediction models are trained via a two-stage process: experimental density maps are converted into atomic structural ensembles through model building, after which these structures are used to train sequence-to-atomic ensemble predictors. In this work, we propose a new principle for fine-tuning pre-trained static structure prediction models such as Boltz-2 directly on raw cryo-EM maps, bypassing the two-stage process. We apply this technique to the problem of atomic model building by fine-tuning Boltz-2 to generate atomic conformations from an input ensemble of cryo-EM maps, achieving superior model building accuracy compared to prior work. Beyond overfitting to individual map ensembles, our method, CryoSampler, also shows preliminary evidence of in-domain generalization after fine-tuning, sampling diverse atomic conformations for an unseen sequences within the same protein family without requiring cryo-EM data. These capabilities indicate that CryoSampler holds the potential to train next-generation atomic ensemble prediction models directly on raw cryo-EM measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CryoSampler方法，通过直接在原始冷冻电镜密度图上微调预训练的静态结构预测模型Boltz-2，绕过传统的两阶段训练流程，实现了更高的原子模型构建精度，并展现出在同源蛋白家族内的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质原子构象集合对其功能至关重要，但现有预测模型受限于高质量构象数据的匮乏。虽然冷冻电镜异构重建技术能够可视化大蛋白的密度图集合，但从中构建原子模型仍具挑战。传统两阶段训练流程（密度图→原子结构→训练预测器）存在局限性，需要改进。
AI.method: 提出一种新原则：直接在原始冷冻电镜密度图上微调预训练的静态结构预测模型（如Boltz-2），绕过传统两阶段流程。开发了CryoSampler方法，通过微调Boltz-2使其能够从输入的冷冻电镜密度图集合中生成原子构象。
AI.result: 在原子模型构建任务上，相比先前工作实现了更高的构建精度。方法不仅避免了过拟合单个密度图集合，还展示了领域内泛化能力的初步证据：在不需要冷冻电镜数据的情况下，能够为同一蛋白家族中未见过的序列采样多样化的原子构象。
AI.conclusion: CryoSampler证明了直接在原始冷冻电镜测量数据上训练下一代原子构象集合预测模型的可行性，为利用冷冻电镜数据发展蛋白质构象预测方法开辟了新途径。

title: Free Energy Manifold: Score-Based Inference for Hybrid Bayesian Networks
summary:
We introduce the Free Energy Manifold (FEM), a score-trained conditional energy model specialized for inference in hybrid Bayesian networks with discrete and continuous variables. FEM represents each conditional factor as an energy landscape over learned discrete-parent embeddings and continuous observations, enabling posterior evaluation, generative sampling, and compositional inference across multiple continuous leaves by energy addition under conditional independence.
  A central finding is the mode-bridge artifact: standard conditional energy models can create low-energy ridges between separated modes of the same class, producing overconfident posteriors at off-data interior points. We analyze this failure and propose valley regularization, an off-data calibration term that restores near-uniform posteriors in such regions while preserving in-data fit.
  Across synthetic multimodal hybrid-BN benchmarks, FEM substantially reduces KL divergence relative to classical baselines and a vanilla conditional EBM, including large gains at mode-bridge midpoint queries and in multi-leaf evidence composition. We also evaluate high-cardinality discrete-parent settings and a UCI Breast Cancer sanity check, showing that FEM is most useful when multimodal or compositional Bayesian-network inference is required, while discriminative classifiers remain preferable for closed-world classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出自由能流形(FEM)模型解决混合贝叶斯网络推理问题，发现并解决了条件能量模型中的模态桥接伪影问题，在多模态和组合推理任务上显著降低KL散度。
AI.motivation: 混合贝叶斯网络（包含离散和连续变量）的推理是一个重要但具挑战性的问题。传统方法难以处理多模态分布和组合推理场景，而标准条件能量模型存在模态桥接伪影问题，即在同类分离模态之间产生低能量脊，导致对非数据区域的过度自信推断。
AI.method: 提出Free Energy Manifold (FEM)，一种基于分数训练的条件能量模型。该方法将每个条件因子表示为学习到的离散父节点嵌入和连续观测值上的能量景观，通过能量叠加实现多连续叶节点的组合推理。针对模态桥接问题，提出谷值正则化方法，通过添加离数据校准项，在保持数据拟合的同时恢复非数据区域的近似均匀后验。
AI.result: 在合成多模态混合贝叶斯网络基准测试中，FEM相比经典基线和普通条件EBM显著降低KL散度，在模态桥接中点查询和多叶节点证据组合任务上取得大幅提升。在高基数离散父节点设置和UCI乳腺癌数据集上的实验表明，FEM在多模态或组合贝叶斯网络推理场景下最有价值，而对于封闭世界分类任务，判别式分类器仍然是更优选择。
AI.conclusion: FEM为混合贝叶斯网络推理提供了一种有效解决方案，特别适用于多模态和组合推理场景。谷值正则化成功解决了条件能量模型的模态桥接伪影问题。然而，该方法的适用性有明确边界：在需要概率推理和组合性的场景中表现优异，但在传统分类任务中判别式方法仍有优势。

title: Sub-Footprint Effect Correction in FW-LiDAR Point Clouds via Intra-Footprint Target Unmixing
summary: Sub-footprint target mixing within a laser footprint significantly increases LiDAR intensity uncertainty, especially in complex environments where heterogeneous materials inside one footprint cause nonlinear distortions that impair intensity-based applications. However, the forward mixing inherent to the single-pixel detection mode of LiDAR systems blurs sub-footprint contributions, making sub-footprint effects difficult to address effectively in existing studies. To address this issue, we introduce a novel, physics-based framework that explicitly resolves sub-footprint intensity correction in full-waveform LiDAR (FW-LiDAR) point clouds. The key innovation is to make the otherwise implicit intra-footprint mixing process explicit: we first develop a spatiotemporal laser-beam distribution model to physically characterize within-footprint forward mixing of multi-target returns. Building on this formulation, we incorporate ancillary information including waveform parameters and surface geometry as constraints to pose a well-defined inverse unmixing problem and decompose each footprint into fractional contributions from multiple sub-targets. We then recover sub-footprint-corrected intensities by inverting the observed mixtures through a unified combination of parametric and model-driven approaches. To the best of our knowledge, few prior studies explicitly establish sub-footprint inversion and correction within a single laser footprint, and our framework offers a principled, physics-grounded solution. Experiments on both controlled and real-world LiDAR datasets demonstrate that the proposed method significantly enhances semantic separability across heterogeneous targets and intensity consistency across homogeneous targets.

AI.tldr: 针对激光雷达光脚印内多目标混合导致强度值失真的问题，提出了一种基于物理模型的全波形LiDAR光脚印内强度校正框架，通过求解逆问题恢复亚光脚印尺度的校正强度，显著提升了语义可分性和强度一致性。
AI.motivation: 在复杂环境中，单一激光光脚印内常包含异质性材料，导致亚光脚印目标混合，引起非线性失真，严重增加了LiDAR强度数据的不确定性，限制了基于强度的应用效果。然而，现有单像素探测模式固有的前向混合特性使得亚光脚印效应难以被显式处理和有效校正。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于物理原理的框架。首先，建立时空激光束分布模型以物理表征光脚印内多目标回波的前向混合过程；其次，结合波形参数和表面几何等辅助信息构建约束，将问题表述为一个定义明确的逆解混问题，将每个光脚印分解为多个子目标的分数量贡献；最后，通过参数化与模型驱动相结合的方法反演观测混合信号，恢复经亚光脚印校正的强度值。
AI.result: 在受控实验和真实世界LiDAR数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著增强了异质目标间的语义可分性，并提高了同质目标间的强度一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了在单一激光光脚印内进行显式亚光脚印反演与校正的空白，提供了一个有原则、基于物理的解决方案，有效解决了光脚印内目标混合引起的强度失真问题，对提升LiDAR强度数据质量及其应用潜力具有重要意义。

title: Efficient Neural Architectures for Real-Time ECG Interpretation on Limited Hardware
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Published in: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (BigData), pp. 3275-3284. DOI: 10.1109/BIGDATA66926.2025.11402097
summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation is essential for diagnosing a wide range of cardiac abnormalities. While deep learning has shown strong potential for automating ECG classification, many existing models rely on large, computationally intensive architectures that hinder practical deployment. In this paper, we present an empirical study of convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures, exploring tradeoffs between diagnostic accuracy and computational efficiency. We benchmark two established baselines: AttiaNet, a compact model composed of sequential temporal and spatial blocks, and DeepResidualCNN, the winning architecture of the 2021 PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge. Building on these, we propose three lightweight models: (i) ParallelCNN, which employs dual temporal and spatial branches for parallel pattern extraction; (ii) ParallelCNNew, a variant with symmetric weight initialization for balanced feature learning; and (iii) SimpleNet, a streamlined architecture that jointly processes temporal and spatial dimensions. Our experiments span three publicly available 12-lead ECG datasets from Germany, China, and the United States, covering binary, multiclass, and multilabel classification tasks across diverse patient populations. We further evaluate the impact of integrating low-cost demographic metadata (age and sex) to improve performance with minimal overhead. To ensure fair comparison, we introduce a unified Efficiency Score that integrates model size, inference speed, memory usage, and AUC performance. By balancing diagnostic performance and efficiency, our models offer a scalable and viable foundation for next-generation AI systems in cardiovascular care.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了三种轻量级ECG分类CNN模型，在保持诊断准确性的同时显著提升计算效率，并引入统一效率评分实现性能与资源的公平权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的ECG自动分类深度学习模型通常依赖大型计算密集型架构，这阻碍了模型在实际临床环境中的部署应用，因此需要探索诊断准确性与计算效率之间的平衡。
AI.method: 基于AttiaNet和DeepResidualCNN两个基准架构，提出三种轻量级模型：(i) 采用双时空分支并行特征提取的ParallelCNN；(ii) 具有对称权重初始化的ParallelCNNew；(iii) 联合处理时空维度的SimpleNet。实验涵盖德国、中国和美国的三个公开12导联ECG数据集，涉及二分类、多分类和多标签任务，并评估了融合人口统计元数据的影响，同时引入统一效率评分整合模型大小、推理速度、内存使用和AUC性能。
AI.result: 所提出的轻量级模型在三个公开ECG数据集上实现了诊断准确性与计算效率的良好平衡，融合低成本人口统计元数据能以最小开销提升性能，统一的效率评分为模型比较提供了公平的量化指标。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的轻量级CNN架构为下一代心血管AI系统提供了可扩展且实用的基础，证明了在保证诊断性能的前提下实现模型轻量化和高效部署的可行性。

title: Exploration-Driven Optimization for Test-Time Large Language Model Reasoning
summary: Post-training techniques combined with inference-time scaling significantly enhance the reasoning and alignment capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, a fundamental tension arises: inference-time methods benefit from diverse sampling from a relatively flattened probability distribution, whereas reinforcement learning (RL)-based post-training inherently sharpens these distributions. To address this, we propose Exploration-Driven Optimization (EDO), which extends reward-biasing style exploration objectives to iterative post-training and integrates them into standard RL objectives, encouraging greater diversity in sampled solutions while facilitating more effective inference-time computation. We incorporate EDO into iterative Direct Preference Optimization (iDPO) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), resulting in two variants: ED-iDPO and ED-GRPO. Extensive experiments demonstrate that both ED-iDPO and ED-GRPO exhibit greater solution diversity and improved reasoning abilities, particularly when combined with test-time computation techniques like self-consistency. Across three in-distribution reasoning benchmarks, EDO achieves a 1.0-1.3\% improvement over the strongest baselines, and delivers an additional 1.5\% average gain on five out-of-distribution tasks. Beyond accuracy, EDO preserves model entropy and stabilizes RL training dynamics, highlighting its effectiveness in preventing over-optimization collapse. Taken together, these results establish EDO as a practical framework for balancing exploration and exploitation in LLM reasoning, especially in settings that rely on test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出探索驱动优化（EDO），缓解RL后训练使分布锐化与推理时采样需多样性之间的矛盾。将EDO集成到iDPO和GRPO得到ED-iDPO和ED-GRPO，在多个推理基准上超越强基线，提升多样性、准确性和训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 推理时扩展方法依赖于从较平坦概率分布中多样采样，而基于RL的后训练会天然锐化分布，导致二者存在根本性张力。需要在后训练中引入探索机制以保持多样性。
AI.method: 提出探索驱动优化（EDO），将奖励偏置式探索目标扩展到迭代式后训练并融入标准RL目标，鼓励采样解的更大多样性。将其集成到iDPO和GRPO中，分别得到ED-iDPO和ED-GRPO两种变体。
AI.result: 在三个分布内推理基准上相对最强基线提升1.0-1.3%，在五个分布外任务上额外获得平均1.5%增益。结合自洽性等测试时计算技术效果尤佳。同时保持模型熵并稳定RL训练动态，有效防止过优化崩溃。
AI.conclusion: EDO为LLM推理中平衡探索与利用提供了实用框架，特别适用于依赖测试时扩展的场景，在提升性能的同时保持训练稳定性。

title: Concordia: Self-Improving Synthetic Tables for Federated LLMs
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables training large language models (LLMs) without sharing raw data, but adapting LLMs under strict data isolation and non-IID client distributions remains challenging in practice. Synthetic data offers a natural privacy-preserving surrogate for local training, yet existing federated pipelines typically treat synthetic generation as static or loosely coupled with downstream optimization, leading to rapidly diminishing utility under heterogeneous clients. We study federated adaptation of LLMs on tabular tasks where raw records and validation data cannot be shared, and local training must rely entirely on synthetic tables. We propose Concordia, a tri-level optimization framework that aligns synthetic data generation with federated validation utility despite these constraints. At the client level, models are adapted via parameter-efficient LoRA training on synthetic tables. Clients additionally learn lightweight utility scorers from private validation feedback to reweight synthetic samples during local training. At the outer level, each client refines its own synthetic table generator using group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), guided by an ensemble of heterogeneous scorers shared across clients, without aggregating generator parameters or exposing validation data. Experiments on privacy-sensitive tabular benchmarks from finance and healthcare demonstrate that Concordia consistently improves federated performance, cross-client stability, and robustness to distribution shift compared to static and decoupled synthetic-data baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Concordia框架，通过三层优化机制对齐联邦学习中的合成数据生成与验证效用，解决了在严格数据隔离和非IID分布下LLM的联邦适配问题。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在训练大语言模型时面临严格数据隔离和非IID客户端分布的挑战，现有方法将合成数据生成视为静态或与下游优化松耦合，导致在异构客户端下效用快速下降。
AI.method: 提出Concordia三层优化框架：客户端层面使用LoRA在合成表上进行参数高效训练，并从私有验证反馈学习轻量级效用评分器来重新加权合成样本；外层使用组相对策略优化(GRPO)细化合成表生成器，由跨客户端共享的异构评分器集成指导，无需聚合生成器参数或暴露验证数据。
AI.result: 在金融和医疗隐私敏感表格基准测试上，Concordia相比静态和解耦合成数据基线，持续提升了联邦性能、跨客户端稳定性和分布偏移鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Concordia框架通过将合成数据生成与联邦验证效用对齐，有效解决了表格任务中LLM的联邦适配问题，在保持隐私约束的同时显著提升了模型性能和鲁棒性。

title: Flag Varieties: A Geometric Framework for Deep Network Alignment
summary: Alignment, the tendency of adjacent weight matrices in deep networks to develop compatible subspace orientations, underlies gradient flow, Neural Collapse, and representation similarity across architectures. Despite extensive empirical documentation, these phenomena have resisted unified theoretical treatment: existing explanations are post-hoc, each fitted to a specific observation with whatever mathematics is at hand. We reverse this direction by deriving the mathematical structure that layerwise alignment inherently demands. Using geometric invariant theory, we prove that alignment geometry has a canonical closed, polystable stratum given by a flag variety, and that subspace intersection dimension is its unique reparameterization-invariant observable, establishing that subspace metrics are not empirical conventions but mathematical necessities. This unified framework yields two dynamical consequences: ridge regularization drives subspace alignment at an exponential rate set by weight decay, whereas nonlinear activations induce a commutator obstruction to exact basis alignment, generically present in nonlinear networks and absent in linear ones. Together these give a geometric explanation of the Level-2/3 hierarchy in Neural Collapse from first principles rather than post-hoc analysis. The commutator magnitude and head subspace overlap further serve as weight-space windows into internal alignment structure, requiring no forward passes. Experiments on multilayer perceptrons, residual networks, and pretrained language models support the proposed diagnostics and delineate their scope.

AI.tldr: 本文利用几何不变量理论，首次建立了层间对齐的统一几何框架，证明了子空间交集维数是其唯一的重参数化不变可观测量，揭示了权重衰减和非线性激活在对齐动力学中的根本作用。
AI.motivation: 尽管层间对齐（相邻权重矩阵发展出相容子空间取向的趋势）在梯度流、神经坍缩和跨架构表示相似性中普遍存在，但现有解释多为针对特定观察现象的事后分析，缺乏统一的理论处理。本文旨在推导层间对齐内在要求的数学结构。
AI.method: 采用几何不变量理论，证明对齐几何具有由旗簇给出的规范闭多项稳定层，且子空间交集维数是其唯一的重参数化不变可观测量。以此为基础，分析岭正则化和非线性激活对子空间对齐动力学的影响。
AI.result: 1) 岭正则化以权重衰减设定的指数速率驱动子空间对齐；2) 非线性激活引入对易子障碍，阻碍精确基对齐（线性网络中不存在）；3) 该框架从第一性原理几何解释了神经坍缩中的Level-2/3层级结构；4) 对易子幅度和头子空间重叠可作为无需前向传播的对齐结构诊断量。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了层间对齐的统一几何理论框架，揭示了子空间度量的数学必然性，为理解深度网络的表示结构和训练动力学提供了新的理论基础和实用诊断工具。

title: UFO: A Unified Flow-Oriented Framework for Robust Continual Graph Learning
summary: Graph learning research has increasingly shifted toward continual graph learning (CGL), which better reflects real-world scenarios where graphs evolve over time. However, existing CGL methods largely assume clean supervision and overlook a critical challenge: the newly arriving portions of the graph are often noisy, due to annotation errors or adversarial corruption. This mismatch limits their applicability in practice. In this work, we study robust continual graph learning, where models must simultaneously handle catastrophic forgetting and noisy supervision in evolving graph data. We show that label noise introduces a new failure mode, catastrophic remembering, where models persistently reinforce corrupted knowledge across tasks. To address these challenges, we propose a Unified Flow-Oriented framework (UFO). First, UFO models conditional feature distributions via flow-based generative modeling and produces replay representations, mitigating forgetting without storing historical data. Second, UFO estimates instance-level reliability scores to distinguish clean from noisy nodes, reducing the impact of corrupted supervision and alleviating catastrophic remembering. Extensive experiments on four benchmark graph datasets under varying noise ratios demonstrate that UFO consistently outperforms existing methods in both accuracy and forgetting metrics. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UFO.

AI.tldr: 本文针对持续图学习中存在的噪声标签问题，提出了统一流导向框架（UFO），通过基于流的生成建模缓解灾难性遗忘，同时利用实例级可靠性评分过滤噪声节点，有效解决了噪声导致的“灾难性记忆”问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的持续图学习方法通常假设新到达的图数据具有干净的真实标签，但在现实场景中，由于标注错误或对抗性攻击，新图数据往往包含噪声标签。这种噪声会导致一种新的失效模式——灾难性记忆，即模型在多个任务中持续强化错误的知识。现有方法无法同时处理灾难性遗忘和噪声监督问题，限制了其实际应用价值。
AI.method: 提出了统一流导向框架：1）利用基于流的生成建模对条件特征分布进行建模，生成重放表示以缓解灾难性遗忘，且无需存储历史数据；2）估计实例级的可靠性评分来区分干净节点和噪声节点，从而降低噪声监督的影响并缓解灾难性记忆问题。
AI.result: 在四个基准图数据集上进行了广泛实验，在不同噪声比例设置下，UFO在准确率和遗忘指标上均持续优于现有方法。实验结果表明该方法能够同时有效处理灾难性遗忘和噪声监督问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统研究了鲁棒持续图学习问题，揭示了噪声标签会导致灾难性记忆这一新现象。提出的UFO框架成功解决了灾难性遗忘和噪声监督的双重挑战，为实际应用中的演化图学习提供了有效解决方案。

title: Continuous Latent Contexts Enable Efficient Online Learning in Transformers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit a strong capacity for in-context learning: Given labeled examples, they can generate good predictions without parameter updates. However, many interactive settings go beyond static prediction to online decision-making, in which effective behavior demands adaptation over long multi-turn horizons in response to feedback, and efficient algorithms in these domains must use compact representations of what they have learned. Recently, continuous transformer architectures with latent chain of thought have shown promise for offline iterative tasks such as directed graph-reachability. Motivated by this, we study whether continuous latent context tokens equip transformers to more effectively realize online learning. We give explicit constructions of constant-depth transformers that implement two foundational online decision-making procedures -- the weighted majority algorithm and $Q$-learning -- by storing their algorithmic state as linear combinations of feature embeddings, using a small number of latent context tokens. We further train a small GPT-2-style transformer with latent contexts using a multi-curriculum objective that does not directly supervise the latent states. On long synthetic online prediction sequences, this model outperforms larger and more complex LLMs, including Qwen-3-14B and DeepSeek-V3. Our results suggest that continuous latent contexts provide a simple and effective persistent state for transformers to implement online learning algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了连续潜在上下文标记（continuous latent context tokens）是否能增强Transformer实现在线学习的能力。作者构造了常数深度的Transformer来实现加权多数算法和Q学习，并训练了一个小型GPT-2风格的模型。实验表明，该模型在长序列在线预测任务上优于Qwen-3-14B和DeepSeek-V3等大型模型。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）虽然在上下文学习方面表现出色，但在需要长期多轮适应和反馈响应的在线决策制定场景中，有效行为需要更高效的算法和紧凑的表示。虽然最近具有潜在思维链的连续Transformer架构在离线迭代任务中显示出潜力，但其是否能有效实现在线学习仍待探索。
AI.method:
1) 构造常数深度Transformer，通过将算法状态存储为特征嵌入的线性组合，实现加权多数算法和Q学习两种基础在线决策过程；
2) 使用少量潜在上下文标记存储状态；
3) 训练小型GPT-2风格Transformer，采用多课程目标函数，不对潜在状态进行直接监督。
AI.result: 在长合成在线预测序列任务上，该小型模型（具有潜在上下文）的表现优于更大更复杂的LLMs，包括Qwen-3-14B和DeepSeek-V3。这表明连续潜在上下文为Transformer提供了一个简单有效的持久状态机制来实现在线学习算法。
AI.conclusion: 连续潜在上下文为Transformer提供了一种简单且有效的持久状态机制，使其能够实现在线学习算法。这一发现为将LLMs扩展到需要长期适应的交互式在线决策场景提供了新的技术路径。

title: Intervention-Based Time Series Causal Discovery via Simulator-Generated Interventional Distributions
summary: We propose SVAR-FM (Structural VAR with Flow Matching), a framework for time series causal discovery that treats a physics-based simulator as a mechanical realization of Pearl's do operator. Clamping a variable inside the simulator physically severs confounding paths, producing interventional data by construction. Conditional Flow Matching then learns the nonlinear interventional conditionals. Theoretically, we prove that the full structural VAR becomes identifiable under a coverage condition on the simulator-clampable variables, and derive an end-to-end error bound that decomposes into Monte Carlo, simulator fidelity, and Flow Matching terms. A sign-flip corollary predicts that when simulator accuracy falls below a threshold, the estimated causal effect reverses sign. Empirically, a benchmark across four scientific domains confirms that SVAR-FM recovers the correct causal sign where observational methods produce sign-reversed estimates due to confounding. A case study in ultrafast laser physics verifies the sign-flip prediction by physically varying the accuracy level of a first-principles quantum solver: the low-accuracy setting reverses the causal sign, while the high-accuracy setting recovers the correct direction (R-squared = 0.983, zero bias).

AI.tldr: 提出了SVAR-FM框架，利用物理模拟器实现因果干预，解决了时间序列因果发现中的混淆变量问题，并在理论和实验上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统观测数据的因果发现方法容易受到混淆变量的影响，导致因果效应估计出现偏差甚至符号反转。为了获得可靠的因果结论，需要一种能够有效消除混淆并识别非线性动态因果结构的方法。
AI.method: 提出SVAR-FM框架，将基于物理的模拟器视为Pearl do算子的物理实现。通过在模拟器中“钳制”变量，物理上切断混淆路径，从而构造干预数据；随后利用条件Flow Matching学习非线性的干预条件分布。理论上在模拟器可钳制变量的覆盖条件下，证明结构VAR的完全可识别性，并推导了包含蒙特卡洛、模拟器保真度和Flow Matching误差项的端到端误差界。
AI.result: 在四个科学领域的基准测试中，SVAR-FM成功恢复了正确的因果符号，而观测方法因混淆产生了符号反转的估计。在超快激光物理的案例研究中，通过调整量子求解器的精度验证了符号翻转推论：低精度设置导致因果符号反转，高精度设置恢复正确方向（R²=0.983，零偏差）。
AI.conclusion: SVAR-FM为时间序列因果发现提供了一种有效的新范式，证明了物理模拟器可以作为因果干预的物理实现工具，并且提供了理论上的可识别性保证和误差界限。当模拟器精度足够高时，该方法能够准确恢复因果效应的方向和大小。

title: Key-Value Means
summary: We present Key-Value Means ("KVM"), a novel block-recurrence for attention that can accommodate either fixed-size or growing state. Equipping a strong transformer baseline with fixed-size KVM attention layers yields a strong $O(N)$ chunked RNN, while adding only an insignificant number of new parameters. We train a transformer with a growable KVM cache and show it performs competitively on long-context tests with only subquadratic prefill time and sublinear state growth. KVM is implementable with standard operations and without custom kernels, and supports chunk-wise parallelizable training and prefill. It provides many of the benefits of both traditional transformers (expandable context memory, chunk-wise parallelizable training and prefill) and linear RNNs in a single unified package. It can be used on every layer, saving KV-cache memory, and allowing a continuous range of choices of prefill time complexity between $O(N)$ and $O(N^2)$. It can also be implemented in a hybrid solution in tandem with LRNN layers in place of traditional attention, to supplement the LRNN with improved sublinear memory growth context length usage and long context decoding. We release our code at https://github.com/recursal/KVM-paper and trained models at https://huggingface.co/collections/recursal/key-value-means under the Apache 2.0 license.

AI.tldr: 提出KVM（Key-Value Means），一种新颖的注意力块递归机制，兼具Transformer的可扩展上下文记忆和线性RNN的效率优势，实现了固定或增长状态的支持，并在长上下文任务中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决传统Transformer在长上下文处理中的二次方复杂度和KV-cache内存占用问题，同时保留其可扩展上下文记忆和并行化训练的优势。动机是融合传统Transformer和线性RNN的优点，提供一种既能高效处理长序列又能灵活调整预填充时间复杂度的统一方案。
AI.method: 提出Key-Value Means（KVM）机制，这是一种新颖的注意力块递归方法。它使用标准运算实现，无需自定义内核，支持分块并行训练和预填充。KVM可以配置为固定大小状态（形成分块RNN，复杂度O(N)）或可增长状态（支持次二次方预填充和次线性状态增长）。可应用于每一层以节省KV-cache内存，或与LRNN层混合使用以增强长上下文解码能力。
AI.result: 固定大小KVM层仅需增加极少量参数即可形成强大的分块RNN；可增长KVM缓存在长上下文测试中表现优异，预填充时间为次二次方，状态增长为次线性；实现了预填充时间复杂度在O(N)和O(N²)之间的连续调节；混合方案有效提升了LRNN的上下文利用率和解码性能。
AI.conclusion: KVM成功统一了传统Transformer和线性RNN的优势，提供了高效的长上下文处理能力，在内存效率和计算复杂度之间实现了灵活权衡，并通过开源代码和模型促进了社区应用。

title: The Geometric Wall: Manifold Structure Predicts Layerwise Sparse Autoencoder Scaling Laws
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) operationalise the linear representation hypothesis: they reconstruct model activations as sparse linear combinations of interpretable dictionary atoms, on the implicit assumption that activation space is well approximated by a globally linear structure. Their reconstruction error varies sharply across layers in ways that existing scaling laws, fitted at single layers, do not explain. We argue that this variation is the empirical trace of a geometric mismatch: where the activation manifold is curved and its intrinsic dimension varies across layers, no sparse linear dictionary can match it uniformly, and the SAE's width-sparsity scaling becomes a layer-dependent function of manifold structure rather than a single universal law. We conduct the first cross-layer SAE scaling study, fitting and regressing on 844 residual-stream Gemma Scope SAE checkpoints across 68 layers of Gemma 2 2B and 9B. Stage 1 fits a per-layer scaling-law surface; Stage 2 regresses the fitted parameters and the derived per-layer width exponents on four layerwise geometric summaries. We find that manifold geometry predicts the per-layer width exponent in both models, and that the same regression coefficients learnt on one model predict the other model's per-layer exponents under cross-model transfer, indicating a transferable geometric law. At the showcase layers where richer width grids permit identification of the asymptotic floor, we find that the fitted floor tracks the layerwise geometric ordering: higher curvature and intrinsic dimension correspond to higher floor, consistent with the irreducible second-order residual that any sparse linear approximation of a curved manifold must leave behind. SAEs thus encounter not a finite-resource ceiling but a geometry-dependent wall, set by the manifold they are trying to reconstruct.

AI.tldr: 本文通过跨层分析发现，SAE的重建误差随层数变化源于激活流形的几何结构（曲率、内蕴维度）差异，而非单纯资源限制；流形几何特征能够预测并解释每层的宽度-稀疏性缩放指数，且该规律在不同模型间可迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有SAE缩放律仅在单层拟合，无法解释重建误差在不同层间的剧烈变化。作者假设这种变化是几何失配的经验证据：当激活流形弯曲且内蕴维度随层变化时，稀疏线性字典无法均匀匹配，导致缩放律呈现层依赖性而非普适规律。
AI.method: 首次进行跨层SAE缩放研究：1）在Gemma 2 2B和9B的68层上收集844个残差流SAE检查点；2）阶段一拟合每层的缩放律曲面；3）阶段二将拟合参数和宽度指数对四个层级几何摘要（曲率、内蕴维度等）进行回归分析；4）验证跨模型迁移性。
AI.result: 1）流形几何特征成功预测两个模型中每层的宽度指数；2）在一个模型上学习的回归系数可迁移预测另一模型的指数；3）在宽网格层，拟合的渐近下界遵循层级几何排序：高曲率和高内蕴维度对应更高的误差下界，符合弯曲流形的稀疏线性逼近必然留下二阶残差的理论预期。
AI.conclusion: SAE面临的不是有限资源上限，而是由其试图重建的流形几何结构决定的"几何墙"。这揭示了激活空间的弯曲性和结构复杂性从根本上约束了稀疏线性表示的能力，为理解和改进SAE提供了几何视角的理论框架。

title: Rethinking Random Transformers as Adaptive Sequence Smoothers for Sleep Staging
summary: Automatic sleep staging commonly adopts Transformers under the assumption that they learn complex long-range dependencies. We challenge this view by revealing a neglected property of sleep sequences: strong local temporal continuity. We show that a randomly initialized Transformer, without any training, substantially improves sleep staging performance and consistently outperforms heuristic smoothing. We formalize this effect via a Random Attention Prior Kernel (RAPK), showing that random self-attention acts as an adaptive smoother by balancing global averaging and content-based similarity while preserving stage transitions. Using two metrics, the Local Smoothness Influence Index (LSII) and the Weighted Transition Entropy (WTE), we provide evidence that most performance gains in Transformer-based sleep staging arise from architectural inductive bias rather than parameter learning. Our results suggest that sleep staging can be effectively addressed with structure-driven smoothing mechanisms rather than complex dependency modeling, enabling more efficient and edge-deployable healthcare systems for large-scale physiological monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了睡眠分期中常被忽视的局部时间连续性，发现随机初始化的Transformer无需训练即可显著提升性能，证明其效果主要源于架构归纳偏置而非复杂依赖建模。
AI.motivation: 当前自动睡眠分期普遍采用Transformer，假设其能学习复杂的长期依赖关系。作者对此提出质疑，旨在探究睡眠序列中被忽视的强局部时间连续性特性，并验证Transformer的性能增益究竟源于参数学习还是架构本身的归纳偏置。
AI.method: 通过提出随机注意力先验核（RAPK）形式化分析随机自注意力机制，将其建模为一种平衡全局平均与内容相似性的自适应平滑器。同时引入局部平滑性影响指数（LSII）和加权转移熵（WTE）两个指标，量化分析架构归纳偏置与参数学习对性能的贡献。
AI.result: 随机初始化且未经训练的Transformer在睡眠分期任务上表现显著优于启发式平滑方法；基于RAPK的分析表明随机自注意力能有效保持阶段转换的同时实现自适应平滑；大多数性能增益归因于架构的归纳偏置而非参数学习。
AI.conclusion: 睡眠分期任务可以通过结构驱动的平滑机制有效解决，无需复杂的依赖建模。这一发现为大规模生理监测设计更高效、可边缘部署的医疗系统提供了新方向。

title: Voice Biomarkers for Depression and Anxiety
summary: Current approaches to detecting depression and anxiety from speech primarily rely on machine learning techniques that utilize hand-engineered paralinguistic features and related acoustic descriptors derived from time- and frequency-domain representations of speech signals. Applying deep learning methods directly to raw speech signals has the potential to produce biomarker representations with substantially greater predictive power. However, these approaches typically require large volumes of carefully annotated data to learn robust and clinically meaningful representations of the underlying biomarkers. In this paper, we describe our efforts toward developing a deep learning model trained on a large-scale proprietary dataset comprising ~65,000 utterances collected from more than 23,000 subjects representative of relevant United States demographics. We present the techniques employed and analyze their impact on model performance. Our results demonstrate that the proposed models can extract content-agnostic biomarker information, which, when combined with lexical features extracted from audio, yields improved predictive performance in production settings. Our models are evaluated on ~5000 unique subjects and achieve performance of 71% in terms of sensitivity and specificity. To foster further research in mental health assessment from speech, we release the best-performing model described in this paper on HuggingFace.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于大规模数据集（约65,000条语音，23,000多名受试者）的深度学习模型，用于从原始语音信号中检测抑郁和焦虑，模型在敏感性和特异性上均达到71%，并已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有从语音检测抑郁和焦虑的方法主要依赖手工设计的副语言特征，预测能力有限。深度学习方法直接应用于原始语音信号有望提取更具预测能力的生物标志物表示，但通常需要大量标注数据。因此，本文旨在利用大规模数据集开发深度学习模型来解决这一挑战。
AI.method: 在一个包含约65,000条语音、来自23,000多名代表美国相关人口统计特征的受试者的大规模专有数据集上训练深度学习模型。模型直接从原始语音信号中提取内容无关的生物标志物信息，并将其与从音频中提取的词汇特征相结合。在约5,000名独立受试者上进行评估。
AI.result: 提出的模型能够提取内容无关的生物标志物信息，与词汇特征结合后，在实际应用环境中提高了预测性能。在约5,000名独立受试者的评估中，模型在敏感性和特异性方面均达到了71%的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功开发了一个基于大规模数据的深度学习模型，能够有效从语音中检测抑郁和焦虑，性能表现良好。为促进基于语音的心理健康评估研究，作者将最佳性能模型在HuggingFace上开源发布。

title: NaiAD: Initiate Data-Driven Research for LLM Advertising
summary: Reconciling platform revenue with user experience in LLM advertising motivates a data-centric foundation. We introduce NaiAD, the first comprehensive dataset for LLM-native advertising comprising 58,999 carefully constructed ad-embedded responses paired with user queries. NaiAD is organized around theoretically grounded evaluation metrics that separately and comprehensively capture user and commercial utility. To mitigate the dimensional collinearity of aligned LLMs, we propose a decoupled generation pipeline that produces structurally diverse samples, ranging from responses that explicitly disentangle stakeholder utilities to responses that are uniformly strong or weak across dimensions. We further provide score labels calibrated by a Variance-Calibrated Prediction-Powered Inference (VC-PPI) framework, aligning automated scoring with human annotations. Mechanistic analyses reveal that successful ad integration relies on reasoning paths that cluster into four distinct semantic strategies. Models leveraging NaiAD internalize these strategies to simultaneously improve user and commercial utility, while enabling independent control over these distinct objectives via in-context learning. Together, these results position NaiAD as a foundational infrastructure for developing future LLM-native ad systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NaiAD，首个用于LLM原生广告的综合数据集，包含58,999个精心构建的广告嵌入回复，通过理论驱动的评估指标分离用户效用和商业效用，为LLM广告系统提供了基础设施工具。
AI.motivation: 在LLM广告中，平台收益与用户体验之间存在张力，需要协调这两个目标。当前缺乏专门用于LLM原生广告的数据集和评估框架，无法有效分离和衡量用户效用与商业效用，这阻碍了LLM广告系统的发展。
AI.method: 1) 构建NaiAD数据集：包含58,999个广告嵌入回复及用户查询对；2) 提出解耦生成管道，通过产生结构多样化样本来缓解对齐LLM的维度共线性问题；3) 引入方差校准预测驱动推断(VC-PPI)框架，提供与人类标注对齐的分数标签；4) 基于理论驱动的评估指标分别捕获用户效用和商业效用。
AI.result: 成功识别出广告整合依赖于四种不同语义策略的推理路径聚类。基于NaiAD训练的模型能够内化这些策略，同时提升用户效用和商业效用，并通过上下文学习实现对这两个独立目标的独立控制。
AI.conclusion: NaiAD作为首个LLM原生广告综合数据集，为未来LLM原生广告系统的开发奠定了基础设施工具，使模型能够在保持用户体验的同时实现商业价值，推动了LLM广告领域的研究进展。

title: Verifier-Free RL for LLMs via Intrinsic Gradient-Norm Reward
summary: While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has recently emerged as a promising post-training paradigm for Large Language Models (LLMs), its dependency on the gold label or domain-specific verifiers limits its scalability to new tasks and domains. In this work, we propose Verifier-free Intrinsic Gradient-Norm Reward (VIGOR), a simple reward that uses only the policy model itself. Given a prompt, VIGOR samples a group of completions and assigns higher within-group rewards to outputs that induce smaller $\ell_2$ norms of the teacher-forced negative log-likelihood gradients under the current parameters. Intuitively, lower gradient norms suggest the completion aligns better with the current policy, serving as an intrinsic preference signal for policy optimization. To make this intrinsic signal practical for RL, we correct the systematic length bias of averaged token-level gradients with a $\sqrt{T}$ scaling, and apply group-wise rank shaping to stabilize reward scales across prompts. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks, VIGOR outperforms the state-of-the-art Reinforcement Learning from Internal Feedback (RLIF) baseline, and it also exhibits cross-domain transfer to code benchmarks when trained only on math data. For instance, on Qwen2.5-7B-Base post-trained on MATH, VIGOR improves the average math accuracy by +3.31% and the average code accuracy by +1.91% over this baseline, while exhibiting more stable training dynamics. The code is available at https://github.com/ZJUSCL/VIGOR.

AI.tldr: 提出VIGOR方法，利用策略模型自身的梯度范数作为内在奖励信号，无需外部验证器即可实现大语言模型的有效强化学习训练，在数学推理任务上超越现有RLIF基线并展现出跨领域迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）方法依赖于黄金标签或特定领域验证器，限制了其在新任务和新领域的可扩展性。因此需要开发一种不依赖外部验证器的奖励信号，以提高方法的通用性和可扩展性。
