AI.method: 提出VIGOR（Verifier-free Intrinsic Gradient-Norm Reward）方法：给定提示，采样一组补全，对在当前参数下teacher-forced负对数似然梯度诱导较小ℓ2范数的输出赋予更高的组内奖励。通过√T缩放校正token级平均梯度的系统性长度偏差，并应用组级排名整形来稳定跨提示的奖励尺度。较低的梯度范数表明补全与当前策略更好地对齐，可作为策略优化的内在偏好信号。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准测试上，VIGOR优于最先进的内部反馈强化学习（RLIF）基线；仅在数学数据上训练时，VIGOR在代码基准测试上展现出跨领域迁移能力。具体而言，在MATH上后训练的Qwen2.5-7B-Base上，VIGOR相比基线在平均数学准确率上提升+3.31%，在平均代码准确率上提升+1.91%，同时表现出更稳定的训练动态。
AI.conclusion: VIGOR成功地将梯度范数转化为实用的内在奖励信号，证明了仅使用策略模型自身即可实现有效的强化学习训练，无需外部验证器。该方法不仅在同领域任务上取得显著提升，还展现出良好的跨领域泛化能力和训练稳定性，为LLM后训练提供了新的可扩展范式。

title: TeleResilienceBench: Quantifying Resilience for LLM Reasoning in Telecommunications
summary: Deploying large language models in telecommunications requires more than task accuracy. In realistic workflows, a model may inherit partially completed reasoning from a prior step, an upstream agent, or its own earlier generation, and must continue that reasoning even when it is already going wrong. We introduce TeleResilienceBench, a benchmark that quantifies this capability, which we term reasoning resilience, across seven telecom sub-domains drawn from the GSMA Open-Telco LLM suite. Instances are constructed by collecting failures from a weak generator model, truncating the flawed reasoning trace at its midpoint, and asking a target model to continue and correct it. We propose the Correct Flip Rate (CFR) as a direct measure of successful recovery and evaluate eight models spanning the Qwen3.5, Gemma4, and Nemotron-3 families. Our results show that even the strongest model achieves a macro-average CFR of only 29.1%, and scale does not reliably improve resilience within families. Nemotron-3-nano 4b outperforms all Qwen3.5 variants including the 27b model and leads the auxiliary TeleMath numerical evaluation at 23.4% CR%, offering the best resilience-to-cost ratio in the set. A difficulty-stratified analysis further reveals that existing telecom benchmark difficulty labels reflect factual specificity rather than reasoning depth, suggesting that current evaluations measure knowledge coverage more than reasoning ability.

AI.tldr: 提出了TeleResilienceBench基准，用于评估大模型在电信领域的推理韧性（修正错误推理的能力）。实验表明最强模型平均修正率仅为29.1%，Nemotron-3-nano 4b性价比最优，且现有难度标签反映知识覆盖而非推理深度。
AI.motivation: 在电信领域的实际部署中，大模型常需接续上游或自身的推理过程，即使该推理已出现错误。现有评估关注任务准确性，缺乏对模型在错误起点上修正推理能力（推理韧性）的量化研究。
AI.method: 构建TeleResilienceBench基准：从弱生成模型收集失败样本，截断错误推理轨迹至中点，要求目标模型接续并修正。提出Correct Flip Rate (CFR)作为核心指标，覆盖GSMA Open-Telco LLM套件的七个电信子领域，评估Qwen3.5、Gemma4和Nemotron-3三个模型家族的八个模型。
AI.result: 最强模型宏观平均CFR仅为29.1%，模型规模扩大并不必然提升韧性。Nemotron-3-nano 4b超越所有Qwen3.5变体（包括27b模型），在TeleMath数值评估中达23.4% CR%，性价比最高。分层分析显示现有电信基准的难度标签反映事实特异性而非推理深度。
AI.conclusion: 当前电信LLM评估主要测量知识覆盖而非推理能力，推理韧性应作为独立维度纳入评估。小型模型在韧性方面可超越大型模型，为电信领域模型选择提供了成本效益新视角。

title: Selection of the Best Policy under Fairness Constraints for Subpopulations
summary: Many high-stakes decisions in health care, public policy, and clinical development require committing to a single policy that will be applied uniformly across a heterogeneous population. Regulatory and fairness standards sometime requires that the chosen policy performs adequately in every pre-specified subpopulation, not only on average. We formalize this as a Selection of the Best with Fairness Constraints (SBFC) problem, in order to identify the policy with the highest average performance among those policies that meet a minimum per-subpopulation threshold. We establish an instance-specific lower bound on sample complexity of the SBFC problem. We then develop a Track-and-Stop with Constraints on Subpopulation (T-a-S-CS) algorithm that achieves the lower bound asymptotically. We extend the framework to general closed-set and penalty-based fairness specifications with matching guarantees. Numerical experiments and a case study using the International Stroke Trial demonstrate substantial efficiency gains over policy-level allocation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何在满足各子群最低表现阈值的公平性约束下，选择平均性能最优的策略，提出了达到样本复杂度下界的渐进最优算法。
AI.motivation: 在医疗、公共政策等高风险决策场景中，常需选择单一策略应用于异质人群。监管与公平标准要求所选策略在各预定义子群中均表现良好，而不仅仅关注平均性能。现有方法难以兼顾整体最优与子群公平约束。
AI.method: 形式化为带公平约束的最佳选择问题（SBFC）；推导实例特定的样本复杂度下界；提出Track-and-Stop with Constraints on Subpopulation（T-a-S-CS）算法；将框架扩展至一般闭集约束和基于惩罚的公平规范。
AI.result: 建立了SBFC问题的样本复杂度下界；T-a-S-CS算法被证明渐进达到该下界；在一般化公平规范设置下获得匹配的理论保证；数值实验与国际中风试验案例研究显示，相较策略级分配基线方法有显著的效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在保障各子群公平性的前提下，能够高效识别最优策略，为高风险领域兼顾公平与效率的决策提供了理论支撑与实用工具。

title: From Syntax to Semantics: Unveiling the Emergence of Chirality in SMILES Translation Models
summary: Understanding how chemical language models (CLMs) learn chemical meaning from molecular string representations, rather than only surface-level string patterns, is an important question in chemical representation learning and machine learning for chemistry. Chirality provides a demanding test case: enantiomers can differ greatly in pharmacological activity and toxicity, yet CLMs often struggle to distinguish chiral configurations reliably. Here we present Pan-CORE (Pan-Chemical Omniscale Representation Engine), a family of autoregressive Transformer-based encoder-decoder models for SMILES translation, and use high-temporal-resolution checkpoint analysis to investigate how chiral information is learned during training. Across all tested Pan-CORE variants, we observe a reproducible jump-up in which chiral-token accuracy rises abruptly after a long plateau, suggesting that chiral learning stagnation is not explained by model capacity alone and instead reflects the complexity of chiral constraints. Analyses of attention dynamics, residual-stream trajectories, and latent-space geometry support an encoder-centered mechanism in which chiral-token representations undergo transient destabilization and reconstruction, seen as a V-shaped drop and recovery in vector norm and directional stability, together with a clear reorganization of chiral molecular representations in the latent space. Encoder-decoder cross-evaluation further supports the encoder-centered nature of the transition, and targeted attention-head ablation identifies a small set of chiral-sensitive heads whose removal selectively reduces chiral-token accuracy even in the fully trained model. These findings show that SMILES translation can serve as a useful experimental system for mechanistic analysis of semantic emergence in CLMs, with implications for interpretable chemical representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pan-CORE模型用于SMILES翻译，通过检查点分析揭示手性信息学习存在“跳跃式”突变，且该过程由编码器主导。
AI.motivation: 化学语言模型（CLMs）是否真正从分子串表示中学习化学意义而非仅学习表层字符串模式，是化学表示学习领域的重要问题。手性是一个理想的测试案例：对映异构体在药理活性和毒性上差异巨大，但CLMs往往难以可靠地区分手性构型。理解CLMs如何学习手性信息对提升模型化学理解能力具有重要意义。
AI.method: 研究提出Pan-CORE（全化学全尺度表示引擎），这是一系列基于Transformer的自回归编码器-解码器模型，用于SMILES翻译任务。采用高时间分辨率检查点分析方法，追踪训练过程中手性信息的学习动态。通过注意力动力学分析、残差流轨迹分析和潜在空间几何分析研究学习机制，并进行编码器-解码器交叉评估和针对性的注意力头消融实验。
AI.result: 在所有测试的Pan-CORE变体中，观察到可复现的突变现象：手性token准确率在长期停滞平台期后突然上升，表明手性学习停滞不仅仅由模型容量解释，而是反映了手性约束的复杂性。研究发现了一种以编码器为中心的机制：手性token表示经历瞬态失稳和重建过程，表现为向量范数和方向稳定性的V形下降和恢复，同时潜在空间中手性分子表示发生明显重组。编码器-解码器交叉评估进一步支持该转变的编码器中心性质。注意力头消融实验识别出一小部分手性敏感头，其移除会选择性降低已完全训练模型的手性token准确率。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明SMILES翻译可作为研究CLMs中语义涌现机制分析的有用实验系统，为可解释化学表示学习提供了新的视角和方法论，对理解和改进化学语言模型的化学语义学习具有启示意义。

title: Novel GPU Boruta algorithms for feature selection from high-dimensional data
comment: This paper has been submitted to the journal Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, and a preprint is available for the authors' records
summary: Most feature selection algorithms, especially wrapper methods, run inefficiently on CPU based platforms because of their high computational complexity. This inefficiency makes them unsuitable for processing large scale datasets. To address this challenge, the present study proposed two GPU accelerated versions of the Boruta feature selection procedure, in which Boruta-Permut relies on permutation based feature importance and Boruta-TreeImp employs importance based on impurity reduction. To evaluate these methods we conducted experiments on both a self constructed dataset and several publicly available datasets. The experimental results show that the proposed GPU accelerated algorithms greatly improve computational efficiency while preserving feature selection accuracy comparable to the original Boruta algorithm. In our analysis we also observe that the impurity reduction based version can overestimate the importance of some features. Overall these findings suggest that performing Boruta feature selection on GPUs offers an effective and cost efficient solution for large scale data analysis, which is a good deal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种GPU加速的Boruta特征选择算法版本，在保持与原始算法相当的准确性的同时，大幅提升了计算效率，为大规模数据分析提供了有效的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 传统的特征选择算法（尤其是封装式方法）在CPU平台上因计算复杂度高而运行效率低下，无法有效处理大规模数据集。
AI.method: 提出了两种GPU加速版本的Boruta特征选择过程：1）Boruta-Permut，基于置换的特征重要性；2）Boruta-TreeImp，基于不纯度减少的重要性。在自构建数据集和多个公开数据集上进行了实验验证。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，提出的GPU加速算法在保持与原始Boruta算法相当的特征选择准确性的同时，极大地提高了计算效率。此外，分析发现基于不纯度减少的版本可能会高估某些特征的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 在GPU上执行Boruta特征选择为大规模数据分析提供了一种有效且具有成本效益的解决方案。

title: Generating synthetic electronic health record data using agent-based models to evaluate machine learning robustness under mass casualty incidents
summary: ML models in healthcare are typically evaluated using curated real-world EHR data. A key limitation of such evaluations is that they may fail to assess the robustness of ML models to changes in the data at deployment, which is a common issue because EHR data used for ML model development cannot capture all such changes. Mass casualty incidents (MCIs) caused by disasters are critical instances where this will be an issue, as they induce rare, uncertain, and novel changes to routine system conditions. Because real-world EHR data from MCIs are often limited or unavailable, assessing ML robustness under such conditions before deployment remains challenging. Here, we propose an agent-based modelling approach for generating synthetic EHR data to evaluate the robustness of ML models under MCI scenarios. We use real-world EHR data to develop and calibrate an agent-based model (ABM) of an emergency department (ED) that explicitly models patient arrivals, resource capacity, and clinical workflow. By changing these system conditions to reflect plausible MCI scenarios, the ED model generates synthetic versions of the real-world EHR data that exhibit shifts in system behaviour. Using these synthetic data, we test ML models for predicting length of stay. We observed consistent declines in recall under MCI conditions relative to baseline system conditions, resulting in an increase in the number of patients with prolonged length of stay that were missed by the ML models. These results highlight the impact of changes in system conditions on patient outcomes, EHR data, and ML model performance. Our work establishes ABM-based synthetic EHR data generation as a proactive and systematic approach for evaluating the robustness of ML models under MCI or other system conditions not captured in real-world EHR data, supporting the safer and more effective deployment of ML models in healthcare systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于智能体模型（ABM）的合成电子健康档案（EHR）数据生成方法，用于评估机器学习模型在群体性伤亡事件（MCI）等极端场景下的鲁棒性。研究发现，在MCI条件下，预测住院时长的ML模型召回率持续下降，导致更多延长住院的患者被漏判。该方法为在缺乏真实极端场景数据的情况下系统性评估ML模型鲁棒性提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: 医疗领域的机器学习模型通常基于真实世界的EHR数据进行评估，但这种评估方式存在关键局限：无法充分评估模型在部署时面对数据变化的鲁棒性。群体性伤亡事件（MCI）正是此类问题的典型案例，因为它会导致罕见、不确定且新颖的系统条件变化。然而，真实MCI场景下的EHR数据往往有限或不可获取，使得在部署前评估ML模型在此类极端条件下的鲁棒性面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 研究提出了一种基于智能体建模（ABM）的方法来生成合成EHR数据。具体而言，作者利用真实EHR数据开发并校准了一个急诊科（ED）的智能体模型，显式建模患者到达、资源容量和临床工作流程。通过修改这些系统条件以反映合理的MCI场景，该ED模型生成能够展现系统行为变化的合成EHR数据。随后，利用这些合成数据测试预测住院时长（LOS）的机器学习模型性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与基准系统条件相比，在MCI条件下ML模型的召回率呈现一致性下降，导致被模型漏判的延长住院患者数量增加。这一结果揭示了系统条件变化对患者预后、EHR数据特征以及ML模型性能的显著影响，证明了MCI等极端场景会严重削弱ML模型的预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了基于ABM的合成EHR数据生成方法，作为一种主动且系统性的方法，用于评估ML模型在真实EHR数据未涵盖的MCI或其他系统条件下的鲁棒性。该方法能够支持医疗系统中ML模型更安全、更有效的部署，为在缺乏极端场景真实数据情况下的模型验证提供了可行的解决方案。

title: G-Zero: Self-Play for Open-Ended Generation from Zero Data
summary: Self-evolving LLMs excel in verifiable domains but struggle in open-ended tasks, where reliance on proxy LLM judges introduces capability bottlenecks and reward hacking. To overcome this, we introduce G-Zero, a verifier-free, co-evolutionary framework for autonomous self-improvement. Our core innovation is Hint-$δ$, an intrinsic reward that quantifies the predictive shift between a Generator model's unassisted response and its response conditioned on a self-generated hint. Using this signal, a Proposer model is trained via GRPO to continuously target the Generator's blind spots by synthesizing challenging queries and informative hints. The Generator is concurrently optimized via DPO to internalize these hint-guided improvements. Theoretically, we prove a best-iterate suboptimality guarantee for an idealized standard-DPO version of G-Zero, provided that the Proposer induces sufficient exploration coverage and the data filteration keeps pseudo-label score noise low. By deriving supervision entirely from internal distributional dynamics, G-Zero bypasses the capability ceilings of external judges, providing a scalable, robust pathway for continuous LLM self-evolution across unverifiable domains.

AI.tldr: 提出了G-Zero框架，一种无需外部验证器的LLM自我进化方法，通过测量模型在有无提示下的预测差异作为内在奖励信号，实现了在开放性任务中的自主改进。
AI.motivation: 现有自我进化的LLM在可验证领域表现优异，但在开放性任务中依赖代理LLM评判器会引入能力瓶颈和奖励黑客问题，限制了模型的持续改进。
AI.method: 提出Hint-δ内在奖励，量化生成器模型独立响应与基于自生成提示响应之间的预测偏移；使用GRPO训练提议者模型针对生成器的盲点合成挑战性查询和提示；同时通过DPO优化生成器以内化提示引导的改进。理论证明在提议者充分探索且数据过滤保持伪标签噪声较低时，标准DPO版本的G-Zero具有最佳迭代次优性保证。
AI.result: G-Zero完全从内部分布动态中导出监督信号，绕过了外部评判器的能力上限，为不可验证领域的LLM持续自我进化提供了可扩展、稳健的路径。
AI.conclusion: G-Zero框架通过共进化的方式实现了LLM在开放性任务中的自主自我改进，摆脱了对外部验证器的依赖，为LLM的持续进化提供了新的解决方案。

title: Tensor Product Representation Probes Reveal Shared Structure Across Linear Directions
summary: While researchers are finding concepts represented as linear directions in language models, a bag of linear directions fails to capture relational structure. To better understand this dichotomy, we study a model with known linear representations, but trained in a highly structured domain -- the board game Othello. While the model's internal board-state representation is linearly decodable, we find additional structure in the form of tensor product representations (TPRs). We train TPR probes to recover shared structure amongst the linear probes, yielding a factorization into square-embeddings, color-embeddings, and a binding matrix that composes them to construct the model's board-state representation. We find geometric signatures within the weights of our TPR probe that align with the structure of the board, but perhaps more importantly, that the linear probes can be recovered directly from the parameters of our TPR probe. Our findings suggest that directional representations may be projections of more structured underlying representations.

AI.tldr: 研究发现语言模型中的线性方向表示可能是更结构化的张量积表示(TPR)的投影，通过奥赛罗棋盘游戏模型验证了这一假设。
AI.motivation: 研究者发现语言模型中概念通常表示为线性方向，但这种线性方向的集合无法捕捉关系结构。为了理解这种二分法，需要研究一个具有已知线性表示但在高度结构化域中训练的模型。
AI.method: 使用奥赛罗棋盘游戏作为研究模型，该模型具有已知线性表示且在高度结构化域中训练。训练张量积表示(TPR)探针来恢复线性探针之间的共享结构，将其分解为方块嵌入、颜色嵌入和组合它们的绑定矩阵。
AI.result: 成功发现模型内部棋盘状态表示虽然是线性可解码的，但还存在额外的张量积表示结构。TPR探针权重中存在与棋盘结构对齐的几何特征，更重要的是，线性探针可以直接从TPR探针的参数中恢复出来。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明方向性表示可能是更结构化的潜在表示的投影，这为理解语言模型中的概念表示提供了新的视角。

title: Consolidation-Expansion Operator Mechanics:A Unified Framework for Adaptive Learning
summary:
Every adaptive learning system must alternate between two operations: consolidating what it already knows and expanding into new evidence. We propose \emph{Consolidation-Expansion Operator Mechanics} (OpMech), a framework that makes this structure precise. The central object is the \emph{order-gap} $\Ogap(θ; e)$, the degree to which a consolidation operator~$Q$ and an expansion operator~$P_e$ fail to commute at a given knowledge state. Because the order-gap is computable from the system's own trajectory, it serves as a real-time control signal: large values indicate that the system is still sensitive to the ordering of consolidation and expansion; once the order-gap falls and stays small, further processing is unlikely to change the outcome.
  Three results give the signal precise meaning: the order-gap decays along convergent trajectories; a persistently large order-gap implies the system is far from its settled state; and an order-gap-based stopping rule terminates with provable guarantees in both noiseless and bounded-noise settings. The framework applies across five domains: bandits, reinforcement learning, stochastic optimization, continual learning, and recursive language models. We give conditions under which the order-gap reliably tracks convergence in three representative cases. We develop the recursive language model application in detail, showing how OpMech replaces heuristic stopping rules and fixed recursion budgets with principled, evidence-driven alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出了Consolidation-Expansion Operator Mechanics (OpMech)框架，通过计算巩固算子与扩展算子之间的order-gap来实时监控自适应学习系统的收敛状态，为停止决策提供理论保证。
AI.motivation: 自适应学习系统需要在巩固已有知识和扩展新证据两个操作之间交替进行，但缺乏明确的理论框架来描述这一结构，也缺乏基于理论原则的实时停止规则，通常依赖启发式方法或固定预算。
AI.method: 引入order-gap概念量化巩固算子Q与扩展算子P_e在给定知识状态下的非对易程度；该指标可从系统自身轨迹实时计算；证明了三个理论结果：order-gap沿收敛轨迹衰减、持续大的order-gap意味着系统远离稳定状态、基于order-gap的停止规则在无噪声和有界噪声设置下具有可证明的保证。
AI.result: 框架成功应用于五个领域（多臂老虎机、强化学习、随机优化、持续学习、递归语言模型）；给出了三种代表性情况下order-gap可靠跟踪收敛的条件；在递归语言模型应用中详细展示了OpMech如何用有原则的、证据驱动的替代方案取代启发式停止规则和固定递归预算。
AI.conclusion: OpMech为自适应学习系统提供了一个通用的理论框架，使巩固与扩展的结构得以精确化；order-gap作为实时控制信号，能够可靠地指示系统收敛状态，为停止决策提供理论保证，在多个学习领域具有广泛适用性。

title: The Truth Lies Somewhere in the Middle (of the Generated Tokens)
summary: How should hidden states generated autoregressively be collapsed into a representation that reflects a language model's internal state? Despite tokens being generated under causal masking, we find that mean pooling across their hidden states yields more semantic representations than any individual token alone. We quantify this through kernel alignment to reference spaces in language, vision, and protein domains. The improvement through mean pooling is consistent with information being distributed across generated tokens rather than localized to a single position. Furthermore, representations derived from generated tokens outperform those from prompt tokens, and alignment across generation reveals interpretable dynamics in model behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，对自回归生成的隐藏状态进行平均池化能获得比单个token更具语义的表示，且生成token的表示优于提示token的表示。
AI.motivation: 探究如何将自回归生成的隐藏状态有效地聚合为能够反映语言模型内部状态的表示，以解决因果掩码下信息表示的优化问题。
AI.method: 通过将隐藏状态在生成的token上进行平均池化来聚合信息，并使用核对齐方法，在语言、视觉和蛋白质三个领域的参考空间中量化评估表示的语义质量。
AI.result: 实验表明，平均池化生成的表示比任何单个token的表示语义性更强，证明信息分布在整个生成序列中；此外，基于生成token的表示优于基于提示token的表示，且生成过程中的对齐变化揭示了模型行为的可解释动态。
AI.conclusion: 自回归语言模型的信息分布在整个生成序列中，通过平均池化聚合生成的隐藏状态是获取高质量语义表示的有效方法。

title: Chebyshev Center-Based Direction Selection for Multi-Objective Optimization and Training PINNs
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are a promising approach for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). Their training, however, is often difficult because multiple loss terms induced by PDE residuals and boundary or initial conditions must be optimized simultaneously. To address this difficulty, existing approaches often construct update directions by explicitly enforcing particular desirable properties, such as scale robustness and simultaneous descent. While effective in many cases, such property-by-property designs can make it unclear which conditions are essential, what geometric principle determines the selected update direction, and how different methods are structurally related. In this work, we formulate update-direction selection for PINN training as a Chebyshev-center problem in the dual cone. The proposed formulation selects a normalized direction that maximizes the minimum distance to the cone facets. The resulting formulation admits an efficient dual problem in a much lower-dimensional space and yields a convergence guarantee in the nonconvex setting. It also recovers the key desirable properties targeted by existing approaches without imposing them separately; rather, they follow from the single geometric criterion underlying the formulation. This makes the selected direction interpretable through a single geometric rule and provides a unified basis for systematically comparing related direction-selection methods. Experiments on several PINN benchmarks further demonstrate strong empirical performance of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于对偶锥中Chebyshev中心问题的PINN训练更新方向选择方法，通过单一几何准则统一了现有方法的多种期望性质，并提供了收敛性保证和优异的实证表现。
AI.motivation: PINNs在求解偏微分方程方面具有潜力，但其训练过程面临多损失项（PDE残差、边界/初始条件）同时优化的困难。现有方法通过显式强制特定性质（如尺度鲁棒性、同时下降）来构造更新方向，但这种逐性质设计的方式难以明确哪些条件是本质的、何种几何原则决定了所选方向、以及不同方法之间的结构关系。
AI.method: 将PINN训练的更新方向选择问题建模为对偶锥中的Chebyshev中心问题。该方法选择一个归一化方向，使其到锥面的最小距离最大化。该公式可转化为低维空间中的高效对偶问题，并在非凸设置下提供收敛保证。
AI.result: 所提方法无需单独施加，自然恢复了现有方法所针对的关键期望性质。实验表明，在多个PINN基准测试中，该方法具有强劲的实证性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过单一几何准则，实现了更新方向的可解释性，并为系统比较相关方向选择方法提供了统一基础，为PINN训练难题提供了理论清晰且实用的解决方案。

title: Attention Drift: What Autoregressive Speculative Decoding Models Learn
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting future tokens with a small model, but drafter models degrade sharply under template perturbation and long-context inputs. We identify a previously-unreported phenomenon we call \textbf{attention drift}: as the drafter generates successive tokens within a speculation chain, attention progressively moves from the prompt onto its own recently-generated tokens. We observe this across both \emph{EAGLE3} drafters and \emph{MTP heads}, suggesting drift is a property of drafter designs. We trace this to the un-normalized residual path between chain steps: the drafter's hidden state magnitude grows monotonically with chain depth, which exhibits dynamics consistent with additional pre-norm transformer layers stacked on the target rather than as a standalone autoregressive predictor. In order to limit the growth, we propose two architectural changes: Post-norm on the drafter hidden states and per-hidden-state RMSNorm after capturing target hidden states. Our interventions improve acceptance length over the current leading model, pre-norm EAGLE3, by up to $2\times$ under template perturbation, $1.18\times$ on long-context tasks, and $1.10\times$ on seven standard benchmarks spanning multi-turn chat, math, and coding. Our changes also allow shorter train-time-test depths to generalize over longer drafting sequences.

AI.tldr: 发现并解决了推测解码中Draft模型的“注意力漂移”问题，通过归一化改进显著提升了在模板扰动和长上下文场景下的性能。
AI.motivation: 推测解码中的Draft模型在面临模板扰动和长上下文输入时性能急剧下降。作者旨在探究其根本原因并解决这一鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 识别出“注意力漂移”现象及其根源（非归一化残差路径导致隐藏状态单调增长），并提出两种架构改进：在Draft模型隐藏状态上应用Post-norm，以及在捕获目标隐藏状态后应用逐隐藏状态RMSNorm。
AI.result: 相比当前领先的Pre-norm EAGLE3，新方法将模板扰动下的接受长度提升高达2倍，长上下文任务提升1.18倍，多轮对话、数学和编程等七个基准测试提升1.10倍，并提升了训练深度对更长推理序列的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Draft模型设计固有的隐藏状态增长导致了注意力漂移，通过引入归一化约束可以有效抑制该现象，显著提升推测解码在各种场景下的鲁棒性和效率。

title: Learning Graph Foundation Models on Riemannian Graph-of-Graphs
comment: This paper has been accepted by ICML 2026
summary: Graph foundation models (GFMs), pretrained on massive graph data, have transformed graph machine learning by supporting general-purpose reasoning across diverse graph tasks and domains. Existing GFMs pretrained with fixed-hop subgraph sampling impose a fixed receptive field, causing scale mismatch on diverse tasks, which often require heterogeneous and unknown structural contexts beyond a fixed sampling scale. We propose R-GFM, a Riemannian Graph-of-Graphs (GoG) based foundation model, that treats structural scale as a first-class citizen in modeling. R-GFM constructs a multi-scale GoG over-sampled subgraphs at different hop distances and learns geometry-adaptive representations from Riemannian manifolds. Theoretical analysis shows that R-GFM reduces structural domain generalization error compared to fixed-scale GFMs. Experiments on various datasets demonstrate that R-GFM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with up to a 49% relative improvement on downstream tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/USTC-DataDarknessLab/R-GFM.

AI.tldr: 提出了R-GFM，一种基于黎曼图之图的基础模型，通过多尺度采样和几何自适应表示学习解决了现有图基础模型因固定感受野导致的尺度不匹配问题，在下游任务中实现了最高49%的相对性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的图基础模型（GFMs）在预训练时采用固定跳数子图采样，导致感受野固定，在面对需要不同结构上下文的多样化任务时产生尺度不匹配问题，限制了模型在不同任务和域上的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出R-GFM模型，构建图之图（GoG）结构，对不同跳距离的子图进行多尺度采样，并在黎曼流形上学习几何自适应的表示，将结构尺度作为建模的一等公民。
AI.result: 理论分析证明R-GFM相比固定尺度GFMs降低了结构域泛化误差；在多个数据集上的实验表明，R-GFM达到了最先进性能，在下游任务上实现了高达49%的相对性能提升。
AI.conclusion: R-GFM成功解决了图基础模型中的尺度不匹配问题，通过多尺度建模和黎曼几何方法显著提升了模型性能，为图基础模型的发展提供了新的方向。

title: Continual Harness: Online Adaptation for Self-Improving Foundation Agents
summary: Coding harnesses such as Claude Code and OpenHands wrap foundation models with tools, memory, and planning, but no equivalent exists for embodied agents' long-horizon partial-observability decision-making. We first report our Gemini Plays Pokemon (GPP) experiments. With iterative human-in-the-loop harness refinement, GPP became the first AI system to complete Pokemon Blue, Yellow Legacy on hard mode, and Crystal without a lost battle. In the hardest stages, the agent itself began iterating on its strategy through long-context memory, surfacing emergent self-improvement signals alongside human-in-the-loop refinement. Continual Harness removes the human fully from this loop: a reset-free self-improving harness for embodied agents that formalizes and automates what we observed. Starting from only a minimal environment interface, the agent alternates between acting and refining its own prompt, sub-agents, skills, and memory, drawing on any past trajectory data. Prompt-optimization methods require episode resets; Continual Harness adapts online within a single run. On Pokemon Red and Emerald across frontier models, Continual Harness starting from scratch substantially reduces button-press cost relative to the minimalist baseline and recovers a majority of the gap to a hand-engineered expert harness, with capability-dependent gains, despite starting from the same raw interface with no curated knowledge, no hand-crafted tools, and no domain scaffolding. We then close the loop with the model itself: an online process-reward co-learning loop, in which an open-source agent's rollouts through the refining harness are relabeled by a frontier teacher and used to update the model, drives sustained in-game milestone progress on Pokemon Red without resetting the environment between training iterations.

AI.tldr: 提出Continual Harness框架，实现具身智能体无需环境重置的自我改进闭环，在Pokemon游戏中显著降低操作成本，并开源模型通过前沿教师模型的在线协同学习实现持续进步。
AI.motivation: 现有编码框架（如Claude Code）为基础模型提供了工具、记忆和规划能力，但针对具身智能体在长视距、部分可观测环境下的决策制定缺乏等效框架。
AI.method: 提出Continual Harness：一个无重置的自我改进框架，智能体交替执行动作与优化自身的提示、子智能体、技能和记忆，利用过往轨迹数据进行在线学习。进一步引入在线过程奖励协同学习循环，用前沿模型重新标注开源智能体的轨迹来更新模型。
AI.result: 在Pokemon Red和Emerald上，Continual Harness从零开始显著降低按键成本，弥合了与手工专家框架的大部分差距；开源模型通过协同学习在Pokemon Red上实现持续的游戏里程碑进展。
AI.conclusion: Continual Harness成功实现了无需环境重置和人工干预的自我改进闭环，验证了该方法在复杂具身决策任务中的有效性，为具身智能体提供了一种可扩展的持续学习范式。

title: Anchor-guided Hypergraph Condensation with Dual-level Discrimination
comment: This paper has been accepted by ICML 2026
summary: The increasing prevalence of large-scale hypergraphs poses significant computational challenges for hypergraph neural network (HNN) training. To address this, hypergraph condensation (HGC) distills large real hypergraphs into compact yet informative synthetic ones, beyond graph condensation (GC) methods limited to pairwise relations. However, existing HGC methods rely on decoupled training architectures, where structure generators are pre-trained on the original hypergraph but not jointly optimized with condensed features during refinement, resulting in misaligned structures that degrade downstream utility. Moreover, trajectory-based optimization incurs substantial computational overhead in refinement, limiting condensation efficiency. To tackle these issues, we propose \textbf{A}nchor-guided \textbf{H}yper\textbf{G}raph \textbf{C}ondensation with \textbf{D}ual-level \textbf{D}iscrimination (\textbf{AHGCDD}), which consists of three key components: (1) a node initialization module based on Heat Kernel PageRank (HKPR) to encode structural knowledge into feature semantics; (2) an anchor-guided hyperedge synthesis strategy for joint optimization of condensed features and structure; (3) a theoretically grounded dual-level discrimination objective for utility-preserving condensation without redundant HNN training. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior effectiveness and efficiency of AHGCDD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AHGCDD方法，通过锚点引导的超边合成和双层级判别目标，实现了特征与结构的联合优化，解决了现有超图凝练方法中结构错位和计算开销大的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有超图凝练（HGC）方法采用解耦训练架构，结构生成器预训练后无法与凝练特征联合优化，导致生成的结构与特征不匹配，降低了下游任务的性能；同时，基于轨迹的优化在精炼阶段带来巨大的计算开销，限制了凝练效率。
AI.method: 提出锚点引导的超图凝练方法AHGCDD，包含三个核心组件：(1) 基于热核PageRank（HKPR）的节点初始化模块，将结构知识编码到特征语义中；(2) 锚点引导的超边合成策略，实现凝练特征与结构的联合优化；(3) 理论支撑的双层级判别目标，无需冗余的超图神经网络训练即可实现效用保持的凝练。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，AHGCDD在凝练效果和效率方面均显著优于现有方法，能够有效保留原始超图的信息并降低计算开销。
AI.conclusion: AHGCDD通过联合优化特征与结构、消除冗余训练，成功解决了现有超图凝练方法的结构错位和效率瓶颈问题，为大规模超图的高效凝练提供了新思路。

title: The Value of Mechanistic Priors in Sequential Decision Making
summary: Hybrid mechanistic models, physical priors with learned residuals, promise to reduce the data required for good decisions, but have no computable criterion to test this. We characterize the value of mechanistic priors in sequential decision-making within both asymptotic and burn-in regimes. To formalize this, we introduce the mechanistic information of a model -- the mutual information between the model's recommended policy $\hatπ$ and the true optimal policy $π^*$ -- quantified via an occupancy-weighted bias $B_μ$. In the asymptotic regime (large $N$), matched bounds reveal that Bayesian regret scales with the residual entropy $H_{\mathrm{mech}}$, delivering a theoretical sample complexity reduction of $H(μ)/H_{\mathrm{mech}}$ compared to an uninformed baseline. Furthermore, we provide a model certificate to determine empirical sample efficiency. Complementarily, in the clinically relevant burn-in regime (small $N$), we establish a lower bound on the penalty incurred by confidently wrong priors. We demonstrate both the asymptotic and burn-in bounds across 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) dosing simulations motivated by published FOLFOX pharmacokinetic data, where a hybrid prior yields large sample-efficiency gains in the burn-in regime. Finally, we contrast these grounded models with LLM priors, demonstrating that LLMs can suffer severe losses in mechanistic information, thereby motivating the exclusive use of physically-grounded priors for safety-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“机制信息”概念来量化机制先验在序列决策中的价值，证明了混合机制模型在渐进阶段可降低样本复杂度，在小样本阶段可能因错误先验产生代价，并通过5-FU剂量模拟验证，强调安全关键应用应使用物理先验而非LLM先验。
AI.motivation: 混合机制模型（物理先验+学习残差）有望减少决策所需数据量，但目前缺乏可计算的标准来验证这一优势。本文旨在量化机制先验在序列决策中的价值，为混合模型的有效性提供理论依据和实用检验方法。
AI.method: 引入“机制信息”（mechanistic information）概念，定义为模型推荐策略与真实最优策略之间的互信息，通过占用加权偏差$B_μ$量化。在渐进阶段（大$N$）推导贝叶斯遗憾与残差熵的关系；在小样本阶段（burn-in regime）建立错误先验惩罚下界；提出模型认证（model certificate）方法以实证检验样本效率。
AI.result: 渐进阶段：贝叶斯遗憾与残差熵$H_{\mathrm{mech}}$成正比，相比无信息基线可获得$H(μ)/H_{\mathrm{mech}}$的理论样本复杂度降低。小样本阶段：建立了错误先验导致惩罚的下界。在5-FU剂量模拟实验中，混合先验在小样本阶段显著提升了样本效率。对比分析表明LLM先验可能严重损失机制信息。
AI.conclusion: 机制先验可显著降低序列决策的样本复杂度，但其价值取决于机制信息的保真度。在安全关键应用（如临床剂量决策）中，应优先使用物理基础先验而非LLM先验，以确保决策可靠性和样本效率。

title: The two clocks and the innovation window: When and how generative models learn rules
comment: 48 pages, 28 figures. Earlier versions are presented in NeurIPS2025 SPIGM workshop as oral presentation https://openreview.net/forum?id=LjqX8OhPPi
summary: Generative models trained on finite data face a fundamental tension: their score-matching or next-token objective converges to the empirical training distribution rather than the population distribution we seek to learn. Using rule-valid synthetic tasks, we trace this tension across two training timescales: $τ_{\mathrm{rule}}$, the step at which generations first become rule-valid, and $τ_{\mathrm{mem}}$, the step at which models begin reproducing training samples. Focusing on parity and extending to other binary rules and combinatorial puzzles, we characterize how these two clocks, $τ_{\mathrm{rule}}$ and $τ_{\mathrm{mem}}$, depend on key aspects of the learning setup. Specifically, we show that $τ_{\mathrm{rule}}$ increases with rule complexity and decreases with model capacity, while $τ_{\mathrm{mem}}$ is approximately invariant to the rule and scales nearly linearly with dataset size $N$. We define the \emph{innovation window} as the interval $[τ_{\mathrm{rule}}, τ_{\mathrm{mem}}]$. This window widens with increasing $N$ and narrows with rule complexity, and may vanish entirely when $τ_{\mathrm{rule}} \geq τ_{\mathrm{mem}}$. The same two-clock structure arises in both diffusion (DiT) and autoregressive (GPT) models, with architecture-dependent offsets. Dissecting the learned score of DiT models reveals a corresponding evolution of the optimization landscapes, where rule-valid samples' basins expand substantially around $τ_{\mathrm{rule}}$, while training samples' basins begin to dominate around $τ_{\mathrm{mem}}$. Together, these results yield a unified and predictive account of when and how generative models exhibit genuine innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入两个训练时间尺度(τ_rule和τ_mem)来刻画生成模型的"创新窗口"，揭示了模型何时能够产生真正的创新而非简单记忆训练数据。
AI.motivation: 生成模型在有限数据上训练时面临一个根本性张力：其优化目标(分数匹配或下一词预测)收敛于经验训练分布而非我们希望学习的总体分布。作者希望理解模型何时能产生真正的创新，何时开始过拟合/记忆训练数据。
AI.method: 使用规则有效的合成任务(重点是奇偶校验，扩展到其他二进制规则和组合谜题)，追踪两个关键训练步骤：τ_rule(生成首次变得规则有效的步骤)和τ_mem(模型开始复现训练样本的步骤)。研究这两个时钟如何依赖于学习设置的关键方面，并在扩散模型(DiT)和自回归模型(GPT)中验证。通过分析DiT模型学习到的分数函数，揭示优化景观的演化。
AI.result: τ_rule随规则复杂度增加而增加，随模型容量增加而减少；τ_mem对规则近似不变，与数据集大小N近似线性缩放。"创新窗口"[τ_rule, τ_mem]随N增加而变宽，随规则复杂度增加而变窄，当τ_rule≥τ_mem时可能完全消失。两个时钟结构在DiT和GPT模型中均存在，但有架构相关的偏移。优化景观分析显示规则有效样本的吸引盆在τ_rule附近显著扩大，而训练样本的吸引盆在τ_mem附近开始占主导地位。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为生成模型何时以及如何展现真正的创新提供了统一且可预测的理论框架，揭示了创新与记忆之间的内在张力及其依赖于数据规模、规则复杂度和模型容量的系统性规律。

title: TrajDLM: Topology-Aware Block Diffusion Language Model for Trajectory Generation
summary: Generating high-fidelity synthetic GPS trajectories is increasingly important for applications in transportation, urban planning, and what-if scenario simulation, especially as privacy concerns limit access to real-world mobility data. Existing trajectory generation models face a trade-off between efficiency and faithfulness to road network topology: continuous-space methods enable fast generation but ignore the road network, while topology-aware approaches rely on search-based autoregressive decoding that limits generation speed. We propose TrajDLM, a topology-aware trajectory generation framework based on block diffusion language models that bridges this gap. TrajDLM models trajectories as sequences of discrete road segments, combining a block diffusion backbone for efficient denoising, topology-aware embeddings from a road network encoder, and topology-constrained sampling to ensure coherent and realistic trajectories. Across three city-scale datasets, TrajDLM achieves strong performance on fine-grained local similarity metrics while being up to $2.8\times$ faster than prior work, and demonstrates strong zero-shot transfer across domains, including unseen transportation modes. These results highlight the effectiveness of block-wise discrete diffusion as a scalable approach to accurate and efficient trajectory generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/TrajDLM/

AI.tldr: 提出了TrajDLM，一种基于块扩散语言模型的拓扑感知轨迹生成框架，在保证道路网络拓扑结构保真度的同时，实现了比现有方法快2.8倍的生成速度，并具备强大的零样本迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 生成高保真的合成GPS轨迹对于交通、城市规划等应用至关重要，但在隐私限制下获取真实数据困难。现有方法面临效率与道路网络拓扑保真度之间的权衡：连续空间方法生成快但忽略路网，拓扑感知方法生成质量高但速度慢。
AI.method: TrajDLM将轨迹建模为离散道路段序列，结合了三个核心组件：用于高效去噪的块扩散主干网络、从路网编码器获取的拓扑感知嵌入、以及确保轨迹连贯性和真实性的拓扑约束采样机制。
AI.result: 在三个城市规模数据集上，TrajDLM在细粒度局部相似性指标上表现优异，生成速度比先前工作快2.8倍，并在包括未见过的交通方式在内的跨领域场景中展现出强大的零样本迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 块级离散扩散是一种可扩展的方法，能够有效实现准确且高效的轨迹生成，成功弥合了生成效率与拓扑保真度之间的差距。

title: Adaptive Action Chunking via Multi-Chunk Q Value Estimation
summary: Action chunking emerged as a pivotal technique in imitation learning, enabling policies to predict cohesive action sequences rather than single actions. Recently, this approach has expanded to reinforcement learning (RL), enhancing behavioral consistency and reducing bootstrapping errors in value function estimation. However, existing methods rely on a fixed chunk length, creating a performance bottleneck as the optimal length varies across states and tasks. In this paper, we propose Adaptive Action CHunking (ACH), a novel offline-to-online RL algorithm that dynamically modulates chunk length during both training and inference. To find the optimal chunk length for a dynamically varying current state, we simultaneously estimate action-values for all candidate chunk lengths in a single forward pass, using a Transformer-based architecture. Our mechanism allows the agent to select the most effective chunk length adaptively based on the current state. Evaluated on 34 challenging tasks, ACH consistently outperforms fixed-length baselines, demonstrating superior generalization and learning efficiency in complex environments.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种自适应动作分块方法（ACH），通过动态调整块长度解决了固定块长度的性能瓶颈，在34个任务上表现优于固定长度基线。
AI.motivation: 现有一致性学习和强化学习方法依赖固定动作块长度，而最优块长度随状态和任务变化，固定长度成为性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出自适应动作分块（ACH）算法，采用基于Transformer的架构，在单次前向传播中同时估计所有候选块长度的动作价值，实现训练和推理时的动态块长度调节。
AI.result: 在34个挑战性任务上的实验表明，ACH方法持续优于固定长度基线，在复杂环境中展现出更优的泛化能力和学习效率。
AI.conclusion: 动态自适应调整动作块长度能有效提升离线到在线强化学习算法的性能，为动作分块技术提供了新的发展方向。

title: Rethinking Loss Reweighting for Imbalance Learning as an Inverse Problem: A Neural Collapse Point of View
summary: Loss reweighting is a widely used strategy for long-tailed classification, but existing reweighting strategies often rely on heuristics and rarely define a well-specified target. Inspired by Neural Collapse (NC), the ideal simplex Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF) terminal geometry suggests equal per-class average loss as a reasonable target for reweighting. Based on the ideal equal loss objective, we consider loss reweighting as an inverse problem and propose an inverse-view reweighting strategy that infers class weights dynamically to match this ideal objective. Empirically, NC metrics suggest our method can effectively reduce the loss imbalance coefficient and closer alignment with NC geometry while consistently outperforming strong long-tailed baselines on different datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于神经塌缩（Neural Collapse）理论中理想ETF几何结构的逆视角损失重加权策略，用于解决长尾分类问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的长尾分类损失重加权策略通常依赖启发式方法，缺乏明确的目标定义。受神经塌缩现象中理想单纯形等角紧框架（ETF）终端几何的启发，作者提出将每类平均损失相等作为重加权的合理目标。
AI.method: 将损失重加权视为一个逆问题，提出逆视角重加权策略，动态推断类别权重以匹配理想的等损失目标。该方法旨在使模型训练过程中的损失分布逼近神经塌缩理论预测的理想几何结构。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法能有效降低损失不平衡系数，更好地与神经塌缩几何对齐，并在多个数据集上持续优于强力的长尾分类基线方法。神经塌缩相关指标验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过建立明确的等损失目标并将重加权问题转化为逆问题，所提方法为长尾分类提供了一个理论驱动的解决方案，在实践中表现出优越的性能，证明了神经塌缩理论在指导损失重加权策略设计方面的价值。

title: Metis: Learning to Jailbreak LLMs via Self-Evolving Metacognitive Policy Optimization
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Red teaming is critical for uncovering vulnerabilities in Large Language Models (LLMs). While automated methods have improved scalability, existing approaches often rely on static heuristics or stochastic search, rendering them brittle against advanced safety alignment. To address this, we introduce Metis, a framework that reformulates jailbreaking as inference-time policy optimization within an adversarial Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP). Metis employs a self-evolving metacognitive loop to perform causal diagnosis of a target's defense logic and leverages structured feedback as a semantic gradient to refine its policy, offering enhanced interpretability through transparent reasoning traces. Extensive evaluations across 10 diverse models demonstrate that Metis achieves the strongest average Attack Success Rate (ASR) among compared methods at 89.2%, maintaining high efficacy on resilient frontier models (e.g., 76.0% on O1 and 78.0% on GPT-5-chat) where traditional baselines exhibit substantial performance degradation. By replacing redundant exploration with directed optimization, Metis reduces token costs by an average of 8.2x and up to 11.4x. Our analysis reveals that current defenses remain vulnerable to internally-steered, closed-loop reasoning trajectories under the tested settings, highlighting a critical need for next-generation defenses capable of reasoning about safety dynamically during inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Metis框架，通过将越狱攻击重构为对抗性POMDP中的推理时策略优化问题，在10个模型上实现了89.2%的平均攻击成功率，同时将token成本降低8.2倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动化红队测试方法依赖静态启发式或随机搜索，在面对高级安全对齐时表现脆弱且缺乏可扩展性，亟需一种能够动态推理、具有因果诊断能力的对抗框架。
AI.method: 提出Metis框架，将越狱攻击建模为推理时的策略优化问题；采用自进化的元认知循环对目标防御逻辑进行因果诊断；利用结构化反馈作为语义梯度来优化策略，实现闭环推理。
AI.result: 在10个多样化模型上实现89.2%的平均攻击成功率（SOTA）；在强韧性前沿模型上表现优异（O1: 76.0%, GPT-5-chat: 78.0%）；相比基线方法平均降低token成本8.2倍（最高11.4倍）。
AI.conclusion: 当前防御机制对内部引导的闭环推理轨迹仍然脆弱，这表明下一代防御系统需要具备在推理过程中动态进行安全推理的能力。

title: Unlocking air traffic flow prediction through microscopic aircraft-state modeling
summary: Short-term air traffic flow prediction in terminal airspace is essential for proactive air traffic management. Existing approaches predominantly model traffic flow as aggregated time series, despite traffic dynamics being governed by aircraft states and interactions in continuous airspace. Such aggregation obscures fine-grained information including aircraft kinematics, boundary interactions, and control intent. Here we present AeroSense, a state-to-flow modeling framework that predicts future traffic flow directly from instantaneous airspace situations represented as dynamic sets of aircraft states derived from ADS-B trajectories. By establishing an end-to-end mapping from microscopic aircraft states to future regional traffic flow, AeroSense preserves aircraft-level dynamics while naturally accommodating varying traffic density without relying on historical look-back windows. Experiments on a large-scale real-world dataset show that AeroSense consistently improves predictive accuracy over aggregation-based forecasting approaches, particularly during high-density traffic periods. These findings suggest that instantaneous airspace situations provide an effective alternative to conventional time-series-based traffic forecasting paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AeroSense框架，通过直接利用瞬时空域状态（飞机状态集合）预测未来交通流量，在预测精度上优于传统的聚合时间序列方法，特别是在高密度交通时段。
AI.motivation: 现有的短期空中交通流量预测方法主要将交通流建模为聚合的时间序列，这种聚合掩盖了飞机运动学、边界交互和控制意图等细粒度信息。由于交通动态本质上由连续空域中的飞机状态和相互作用决定，需要一种能够保留飞机级动态信息的预测方法。
AI.method: 提出AeroSense框架，这是一种状态到流（state-to-flow）的建模方法。该框架直接从ADS-B轨迹推导出的飞机状态动态集合所表示的瞬时空域情况出发，建立从微观飞机状态到未来区域交通流量的端到端映射。该方法不依赖历史回溯窗口，能够自然适应变化的交通密度。
AI.result: 在大规模真实数据集上的实验表明，AeroSense在预测精度上始终优于基于聚合的预测方法，在高密度交通时段表现尤为突出。研究证明瞬时空域情况可作为传统基于时间序列的交通预测范式的有效替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 瞬时空域情况为交通流量预测提供了一种有效的替代范式，能够克服传统时间序列方法的局限性，为主动式空中交通管理提供更准确的预测支持。

title: TopoU-Net: a U-Net architecture for topological domains
summary: Many modern datasets mix points, edges, regions, groups, objects, events, hyperedges, and relations. Yet neural architectures often force such data into grids, graphs, or sequences, obscuring higher-order structure and making encoder-decoder designs domain-specific. We view U-Net not as a grid-specific architecture, but as a hierarchical encoder-decoder principle: representation spaces, transport maps between levels, and skip connections between matched levels. Combinatorial complexes naturally supply these ingredients through cells, incidences, and ranks. We introduce TopoU-Net, a rank-path U-Net for topological domains. Given a path from an input rank to a bottleneck rank and back, the encoder lifts cochains upward along incidence maps, the decoder transports them downward, and skip connections merge features at matched ranks. Rank replaces spatial scale: choosing paths through nodes, edges, faces, hyperedges, or global cells becomes the central architectural decision. A key quantity is the bottleneck support ratio, the number of cells at the bottleneck relative to the number of cells at the input rank. This ratio is fixed by the complex and chosen path rather than by arbitrary pooling, and it clarifies when skip connections are optional, useful, or structurally important. Across node classification, graph classification, hypergraph node classification, mesh classification, and image reconstruction, TopoU-Net provides a reusable encoder-decoder template for higher-order structured data. Among the evaluated baselines, it achieves the strongest mean accuracy on six of eight node-classification datasets and four of five hypergraph datasets, with the largest gains on heterophilic graphs. Ablations show that removing skip connections is most damaging under severe bottleneck compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TopoU-Net，一种基于组合复形和秩路径的通用U-Net架构，能够统一处理包含节点、边、面、超边等多种拓扑结构的数据，在多个任务上取得了优于基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 现代数据集通常混合了点、边、区域、对象、事件、超边和关系等多种元素，但现有的神经架构往往将这类数据强制转换为网格、图或序列形式，掩盖了高阶结构信息，并使得编码器-解码器设计变得特定于具体领域。因此需要一种能够自然处理高阶结构数据的通用架构。
AI.method: 将U-Net重新解释为一种层次化编码器-解码器原则（包括表示空间、层级间的传输映射以及匹配层级间的跳跃连接），基于组合复形通过单元、关联关系和秩来自然提供这些组件。引入TopoU-Net，通过秩路径（从输入秩到瓶颈秩再返回）实现架构设计：编码器沿关联映射向上提升上链，解码器向下传输，跳跃连接在匹配秩处融合特征。秩取代空间尺度成为核心架构决策，并引入瓶颈支持比作为关键度量。
AI.result: 在节点分类、图分类、超图节点分类、网格分类和图像重建等任务上进行了验证。在8个节点分类数据集中的6个和5个超图数据集中的4个上取得了最强的平均准确率，在异配图上提升最为显著。消融实验表明，在严重的瓶颈压缩情况下，移除跳跃连接的损害最大。
AI.conclusion: TopoU-Net成功地将U-Net架构推广到拓扑域，提供了一种可复用的高阶结构数据编码器-解码器模板。瓶颈支持比这一概念明确了跳跃连接何时是可选的、有用的或结构上重要的，为高阶结构数据的架构设计提供了理论指导。

title: CFSPMNet: Cross-subject Fourier-guided Spatial-Patch Mamba Network for EEG Motor Imagery Decoding in Stroke Patients
summary: Motor imagery electroencephalography (MI-EEG) decoding offers a non-invasive route for post-stroke rehabilitation, but cross-patient use remains difficult because pathological neural reorganization changes task-related EEG dynamics, aperiodic activity, local excitability, cross-regional coordination, and trial-level brain-state context. This makes source-learned MI representations unreliable for unseen patients. To address this problem, we propose CFSPMNet, a cross-patient adaptation framework that models post-stroke MI-EEG as latent neural-state organization. CFSPMNet combines a Fourier-Reorganized State Mamba Network (FRSM) with Shared-Private Prototype Matching (SPPM). FRSM represents each trial as a latent physiological token sequence, reorganizes token states in the Fourier domain, and uses Fourier-derived trial context to guide Mamba state-space propagation. SPPM improves target pseudo-label updating by combining semantic confidence with shared-private physiological consistency, filtering confident but physiologically inconsistent target predictions. Leave-one-subject-out experiments on two stroke MI-EEG datasets show that CFSPMNet outperforms representative CNN-, Transformer-, Mamba-, and adaptation-based baselines, achieving average accuracies of 68.23% on XW-Stroke and 73.33% on 2019-Stroke, with gains of 5.63 and 8.25 percentage points over the strongest competitors. Ablation, sensitivity, feature-alignment, pseudo-label selection, and neurophysiological visualization analyses further support the roles of Fourier-domain token-state reorganization and calibrated pseudo-label updating. These results suggest that latent neural-state modeling can improve rehabilitation-oriented cross-patient BCI decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/wxk1224/CFSPMNet.

AI.tldr: 提出CFSPMNet框架解决中风患者运动想象脑电解码的跨被试迁移问题，通过傅里叶域状态重组和原型匹配实现平均准确率68.23%和73.33%，较最优基线提升5.63-8.25个百分点。
AI.motivation: 运动想象脑电解码对中风康复具有重要意义，但跨患者应用面临挑战：病理性神经重组改变了任务相关脑电动态、非周期活动、局部兴奋性、跨区域协调和试次级脑状态语境，导致源域学习到的运动想象表征在未见患者上不可靠。
AI.method: 提出CFSPMNet跨患者适应框架，将中风后运动想象脑电建模为潜在神经状态组织。包含两个核心组件：(1)傅里叶重组状态Mamba网络(FRSM)：将每个试次表示为潜在生理标记序列，在傅里叶域重组标记状态，利用傅里叶导出的试次上下文引导Mamba状态空间传播；(2)共享-私有原型匹配(SPPM)：结合语义置信度与共享-私有生理一致性改进目标伪标签更新，过滤置信但生理不一致的目标预测。
AI.result: 在两个中风运动想象脑电数据集上进行留一被试实验，CFSPMNet在XW-Stroke数据集上达到68.23%平均准确率，在2019-Stroke数据集上达到73.33%平均准确率，分别比最强竞争基线提升5.63和8.25个百分点。消融、敏感性、特征对齐、伪标签选择和神经生理可视化分析均支持傅里叶域标记状态重组和校准伪标签更新的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 潜在神经状态建模可以改善面向康复的跨患者脑机接口解码性能，CFSPMNet框架为中风后运动想象脑电的跨被试迁移提供了有效解决方案。

title: Generating Symmetric Materials using Latent Flow Matching
summary: Tackling the task of materials generation, we aim to enhance the previously proposed All-atom Diffusion Transformer (ADiT) by introducing SymADiT, a symmetry-aware variant. To do so, we use a representation of materials based on Wyckoff positions. We follow ADiT and perform generative modelling in latent space, adapted to our symmetry-aware representation. By forcing the output of the generative model to adhere to the symmetry restrictions imposed by the generated crystal's space group and each atom's Wyckoff-position, the generated materials exhibit more realistic symmetry properties. We benchmark our method against both symmetry-aware and symmetry-agnostic models for materials generation and show competitive performance, generating stable, symmetric materials with a simple Transformer architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SymADiT，一种基于Wyckoff位置表示的对称性感知全原子扩散Transformer模型，通过强制输出遵守空间群和Wyckoff位置的对称性约束，生成了具有真实对称性特性的稳定晶体材料。
AI.motivation: 先前的全原子扩散Transformer（ADiT）在材料生成任务中缺乏对称性约束，导致生成的材料可能不具备真实的对称性特性。为了生成更符合物理规律的晶体结构，需要引入对称性感知机制。
AI.method: 1. 采用基于Wyckoff位置的材料表示方法，将晶体结构的空间群和对称性信息编码到表示中；2. 在潜在空间进行生成式建模，继承ADiT架构优势；3. 通过强制生成模型的输出遵守由晶体空间群和原子Wyckoff位置施加的对称性限制，确保生成材料的对称性合理性；4. 使用简单的Transformer架构实现整体生成流程。
AI.result: 在与对称性感知和对对称性无关的材料生成模型的基准测试中表现出竞争性能，成功生成稳定且具有合理对称性特性的晶体材料。
AI.conclusion: SymADiT通过引入基于Wyckoff位置的对称性感知机制，有效提升了材料生成的物理合理性，生成的晶体材料兼具稳定性和正确的对称特性，证明了简单Transformer架构在对称性感知材料生成任务中的有效性。

title: Scaling the Memory of Balanced Adam
summary: Recent evidence suggests that Adam performs robustly when its momentum parameters are tied, $β_1=β_2$, reducing the optimizer to a single remaining parameter. However, the value of this parameter is still poorly understood. We argue that, in balanced Adam, $β$ should not be treated as a dimensionless constant: it defines a statistical memory horizon $H_β=(1-β)^{-1}$. In terms of the effective learning horizon $T_{\mathrm{ES}}$, estimated from the validation trajectory, we study the refresh count $R_β=(1-β)T_{\mathrm{ES}}$, which measures how many times Adam renews its internal statistics during the useful phase of training. Across 11 vision and language experiments, we find that choosing $β$ so that $R_β\approx1000$ selects different beta values depending on the training scale, yet improves robustness over the best fixed-beta baseline. Compared with the strongest fixed choice $β=0.94377$, the refresh rule improves worst-case robustness, reducing the global maximum validation gap by $33.4\%$, while bringing all 11 runs within $1\%$ of their validation oracle. These results suggest that the remaining hyperparameter of balanced Adam is better understood as a memory-scale variable than as a fixed constant. This provides a simple budget-aware perspective on optimizer scaling and opens a path toward treating Adam's momentum as part of the learning dynamics rather than as a static default.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平衡Adam（$β_1=β_2$）中单个动量参数$β$的设置问题，提出将$β$理解为定义统计记忆视界$H_β$的变量，并通过刷新计数$R_β≈1000$的规则自适应选择$β$值，在11个实验中将最坏情况验证差距降低33.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明平衡Adam（$β_1=β_2$）表现鲁棒，但剩余参数$β$的具体取值机理尚不清楚。作者旨在揭示$β$参数的物理意义，并提供一种基于训练规模的自适应设置方法。
AI.method: 将$β$解释为统计记忆视界$H_β=(1-β)^{-1}$的定义变量，而非无量纲常数；引入刷新计数$R_β=(1-β)T_{\mathrm{ES}}$衡量Adam在有效训练阶段内更新内部统计量的次数；提出根据有效学习视界$T_{\mathrm{ES}}$调整$β$使$R_β≈1000$的自适应规则。
AI.result: 在11个视觉和语言实验中，$R_β≈1000$规则根据训练规模选择不同$β$值，相比最优固定值$β=0.94377$，将最坏情况鲁棒性提升33.4%（全局最大验证差距降低），所有实验均在验证oracle的1%范围内。
AI.conclusion: 平衡Adam的剩余超参数$β$应被视为记忆尺度变量而非固定常数；这为优化器缩放提供了简单的预算感知视角，并将Adam动量从静态默认值转变为学习动力学的一部分。

title: Explainability of Recurrent Neural Networks for Enhancing P300-based Brain-Computer Interfaces
summary: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) based on P300 event-related potentials offer promising applications in health, education, and assistive technologies. However, challenges related to inter- and intra-subject variability and the explainability of Deep Learning (DL) models limit their practical deployment. In this work, we present the Post-Recurrent Module (PRM), an additional layer designed to improve both performance and transparency, incorporated into a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) architecture for classifying P300 signals from EEG data. Our approach enables a dual analysis of spatio-temporal signals through both global and local explainability techniques, allowing us not only to identify the most relevant brain regions and critical time intervals involved in classification, but also to interpret model decisions in terms of spatio-temporal EEG patterns consistent with well-stablished neurophysiological descriptions of the P300. Experimental results show a 9\% improvement in performance over state of the art, while also revealing the importance of inter- and intra-subject variability, in alignment with established neuroscience literature. By making model decisions transparent and efficient, we present a framework for explainable EEG-based models. This framework is not limited to more efficient P300 detection, but can be generalized to a wide range of EEG-based tasks. Its ability to identify key spatial and temporal features makes it suitable for applications such as motor imagery, steady-state visual evoked potentials, and even cognitive workload assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种后循环模块（PRM）用于RNN架构的P300信号分类，在提升9%性能的同时实现了与神经生理学描述一致的全局和局部可解释性分析。
AI.motivation: 基于P300事件相关电位的脑机接口在健康、教育和辅助技术领域具有广阔应用前景，但受试者间和受试者内的变异性问题以及深度学习模型的可解释性不足限制了其实际部署。
AI.method: 设计了后循环模块（PRM）作为附加层融入循环神经网络（RNN）架构，通过全局和局部可解释性技术实现对时空信号的双重分析，识别最相关的大脑区域和关键时间间隔。
AI.result: 相比现有技术性能提升9%，揭示了受试者间和受试者内变异性的重要性，能够识别与P300既定神经生理学描述相一致的时空脑电特征模式。
AI.conclusion: 建立了一个可解释的脑电模型框架，不仅适用于高效P300检测，还可推广至运动想象、稳态视觉诱发电位和认知负荷评估等多种脑电任务。

title: Complex-Valued Phase-Coherent Transformer
comment: 26 pages, 17 tables (no figures). Companion Lean 4 formalization of Theorems 1 and 2 at https://github.com/leohio/phase-coherent-transformer-r-d
summary:
Complex-valued Transformers have largely inherited softmax attention from real-valued architectures. However, row-normalised token competition is not necessarily aligned with phase-preserving computation. In this paper, we introduce the Phase-Coherent Transformer (PCT), which applies a real-valued, element-independent, smooth gate to L2-normalised complex query-key similarities. PCT replaces token competition with token-non-competing attention and is designed to preserve phase information across layers.
  Across mid-scale benchmarks spanning long-range memory, hierarchical long-range reasoning, positional retrieval, phase-based memory and superposition, and image classification, PCT shows strong generalisation across task categories. Under parameter-fair comparison, PCT consistently outperforms both the standard softmax Transformer and its direct complex-valued counterpart. Moreover, even on tasks traditionally considered difficult for complex-valued neural networks, such as NIAH and LRA-Text, PCT remains competitive with Multiscreen, the strongest real-valued NN baseline in our comparison. Experiments introducing gates that deliberately violate the PCT conditions show that the design is not incidental: smooth gates that preserve negatively aligned phase components remain strong, whereas gates that delete such components collapse on long-range retrieval, and gates whose outputs become excessively large suffer clear performance degradation. PCT also shows no depth-related accuracy collapse across the tested depth range. These results support introducing multi-layer phase-coherent structure into attention as a promising design principle for achieving generalisation in complex-valued Transformers.

AI.tldr: 提出相位相干Transformer（PCT），用元素独立平滑门控替代传统token竞争注意力机制，在中规模基准测试中全面优于标准Transformer和复数Transformer，甚至与强实数神经网络基线竞争力相当。
AI.motivation: 复数Transformer直接继承实数架构的softmax注意力机制，但行归一化的token竞争机制与相位保持计算本质上不一致，可能破坏相位信息，限制了复数网络性能。
AI.method: 提出PCT架构，在L2归一化复数query-key相似度上应用实数值、元素独立、平滑的门控机制，用token非竞争注意力替代传统token竞争，以保持跨层相位信息。
AI.result: 在长程记忆、层次推理、位置检索、相位记忆与叠加、图像分类等任务上展现强泛化能力；在参数公平对比中持续优于softmax Transformer和复数Transformer；在NIAH和LRA-Text等复杂网络困难任务上仍与最强实数基线Multiscreen竞争力相当；消除实验证明设计原则的重要性，且无深度相关精度崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 将多层相位相干结构引入注意力是提升复数Transformer泛化能力的有效设计原则，为复数神经网络架构设计提供了新方向。

title: Per-Loss Adapters for Gradient Conflict in Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) train a single neural approximation by minimizing multiple physics- and data-derived losses, but the gradients of these losses often interfere and can stall optimization. Existing remedies typically treat this pathology either through scalar loss balancing or full-parameter-space gradient surgery, leaving it unclear which intervention is most appropriate. We show that PINN gradient conflict is not a uniform failure mode with one universal remedy. Instead, we identify distinct PINN gradient-conflict regimes, each associated with a different intervention class. Persistent directional conflict may require separate loss-indexed parameter subspaces, magnitude imbalance often favors scalar reweighting, and low or transient conflict may require no extra mitigation. To select between scalar reweighting and a lightweight architectural intervention, we propose a diagnostic-first framework. It profiles a 1000-step unmodified PINN run and, when intervention is warranted, uses one low-rank adapter per loss to create explicit loss-indexed parameter subspaces attached to a shared PINN trunk, providing each loss with a direct gradient pathway. Across more than 60 PDE configurations, including forward, inverse, multi-physics, parameter-varying, and high-dimensional problems up to 50D, persistent directional conflict dominates standard forward $K=3$ benchmarks and a natural $K=4$ thermoelastic system, where adapters combined with reweighting yield significant improvements. In contrast, $K=3$ inverse problems and natural $K=5$ and $K=6$ multi-physics systems are largely magnitude-dominated and often favor reweighting alone, while full-parameter-space gradient surgery can fail on heterogeneous parameter spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了PINN梯度冲突并非单一模式，而是存在不同类型，据此提出了诊断优先框架来选择合适的干预策略（标量重加权或轻量级架构适配器），在60多个PDE配置上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: PINN训练中多个损失函数的梯度经常相互干扰导致优化停滞，现有补救措施（标量损失平衡或全参数空间梯度手术）的选择标准不明确，需要明确不同干预措施的适用场景。
AI.method: 提出诊断优先框架：首先对未修改的PINN进行1000步分析，识别梯度冲突类型（持续性方向冲突、幅度不平衡或低/瞬态冲突）。针对持续性方向冲突，使用每个损失一个低秩适配器创建显式的损失索引参数子空间，连接到共享的PINN主干网络，为每个损失提供直接的梯度路径；幅度不平衡则采用标量重加权。
AI.result: 在60多个PDE配置（包括正向、逆向、多物理场、参数变化和高达50维的高维问题）上验证发现：标准K=3正向基准和K=4热弹性系统中持续性方向冲突占主导，适配器结合重加权显著改进；K=3逆向问题和K=5、K=6多物理场系统主要是幅度主导，通常仅需重加权；全参数空间梯度手术在异构参数空间上可能失败。
AI.conclusion: PINN梯度冲突不是单一失效模式，不同冲突类型需要不同干预策略。所提诊断优先框架能够有效识别冲突类型并选择合适的干预措施，避免了不必要或不当的干预，在广泛的问题配置上实现了改进。

title: Learning to Sparsify Stochastic Linear Bandits
comment: Include all the omitted details and proofs from the conference paper accepted to IJCAI 2026
summary: This paper addresses the problem of learning to sparsify stochastic linear bandits, where a decision-maker sequentially selects actions from a high-dimensional space subject to a sparsity constraint on the number of nonzero elements in the action vector. The key challenge lies in minimizing cumulative regret while tackling the potential NP-hardness of finding optimal sparse actions due to the inherent combinatorial structure of the problem. We propose an adaptively phased exploration and exploitation algorithmic framework, utilizing ordinary least squares for parameter learning and specialized subroutines for sparse action selection. When the action set is a Euclidean ball, optimal sparse actions can be efficiently computed, enabling us to establish a $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{T})$ regret, where $d$ is the dimension of the action vector and $T$ is the time horizon length. For general convex and compact action sets where finding optimal sparse actions is intractable, we employ a greedy subroutine. For general strongly convex action sets, we derive a $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d \sqrt{T})$ $α$-regret; for general compact sets lacking strong convexity, we establish a $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d T^{2/3})$ $α$-regret, where $α$ pertains to the approximation ratio of the greedy algorithm. Finally, we validate the performance of our algorithms using extensive experiments including an application to recommendation system.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高维稀疏随机线性Bandit问题，提出自适应分阶段探索利用算法框架，在欧氏球动作集上达到$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{T})$的遗憾界，在一般凸紧集上分别获得$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d \sqrt{T})$和$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d T^{2/3})$的α-遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 在决策向量需要满足稀疏约束（非零元素个数受限）的高维场景中，寻找最优稀疏动作具有内在的组合结构，可能导致NP难问题。核心挑战在于如何在解决组合优化难题的同时，最小化累积遗憾。
AI.method: 提出自适应分阶段探索与利用算法框架。采用普通最小二乘法进行参数学习；针对不同动作集设计专门的稀疏动作选择子程序：欧氏球情形可高效计算最优稀疏动作，一般凸紧集情形采用贪心近似算法。
AI.result: 欧氏球动作集上达到$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{T})$遗憾界；一般强凸动作集上获得$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d \sqrt{T})$的α-遗憾界；一般非强凸紧集上建立$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d T^{2/3})$的α-遗憾界，其中α为贪心算法的近似比。
AI.conclusion: 所提算法有效解决了高维稀疏线性Bandit问题中的组合优化挑战，在不同类型的动作集上取得了接近最优的遗憾界，并通过实验验证了算法性能，包括推荐系统应用场景。

title: Stable Long-Horizon PDE Forecasting via Latent Structured Spectral Propagators
summary: Long-horizon forecasting of time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs) is critical for characterizing the sustained evolution of physical systems. While neural operators have emerged as efficient surrogates, they typically learn implicit finite-time transitions from discrete observations. When deployed autoregressively, such propagators often suffer from rapid error accumulation and dynamic drift. To address this, we propose a neural forecasting framework that reformulates PDE rollout as learning a Structured Spectral Propagator (SSP) in a propagation-oriented latent space. Following an analysis-propagation-synthesis design, our framework: (i) maps physical states into a shared, time-consistent spatial representation; (ii) projects this space into a compact propagation state to isolate recurrent dynamics from fine-grained spatial details, thereby decoupling reconstruction fidelity from rollout regularity; and (iii) evolves retained spectral modes using a frequency-conditioned linear backbone complemented by a nonlinear spectral closure to account for truncated interactions. This explicit structuring endows the propagator with a strong inductive bias for coherent modal evolution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SSP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing relative $L_2$ errors by up to 48.9% and exhibiting improved stability in temporal extrapolation beyond the supervised horizon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为结构化谱传播器（SSP）的神经预测框架，用于解决长时间跨度偏微分方程预测中的误差累积问题。通过分析-传播-合成的设计，将物理状态映射到传播导向的潜在空间，并在谱域中显式演化关键模式。实验表明，SSP显著优于现有方法，相对L2误差降低高达48.9%，且在监督时间范围外具有更好的稳定性。
AI.motivation: 在长时间跨度偏微分方程（PDE）预测中，现有的神经算子方法通常学习隐式的有限时间转移。当以自回归方式部署时，这类传播器往往面临快速误差累积和动态漂移的问题，导致长期预测性能显著下降。因此，需要一种新的框架来解决长时预测中的误差累积和稳定性问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种基于分析-传播-合成设计的神经预测框架——结构化谱传播器（SSP）。该方法包含三个关键步骤：（i）将物理状态映射到共享的时间一致空间表示；（ii）将此空间投影到紧凑的传播状态，以分离循环动态与细粒度空间细节，从而解耦重建保真度与传播规律性；（iii）使用频率条件化的线性主干配合非线性谱闭合来演化保留的谱模式，以考虑截断的相互作用。这种显式结构化为传播器赋予了关于连贯模态演化的强归纳偏置。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，SSP显著优于最先进的基线方法。在相对L2误差方面，SSP实现了高达48.9%的降低。更重要的是，SSP在监督时间范围外的时间外推中展现出更好的稳定性，能够有效抑制误差累积和动态漂移问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过将PDE传播重构为在传播导向的潜在空间中学习结构化谱传播器，本文成功解决了神经算子在长时预测中的误差累积问题。该方法的关键在于显式结构化设计，通过分离循环动态与空间细节，并在谱域中引入强归纳偏置，实现了更稳定、更准确的长时预测，为物理系统的持续演化表征提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Unsupervised Process Reward Models
summary: Process Reward Models (PRMs) are a powerful mechanism for steering large language model reasoning by providing fine-grained, step-level supervision. However, this effectiveness comes at a significant cost: PRMs require expert annotations for every reasoning step, making them costly and difficult to scale. Here, we propose a method for training unsupervised PRMs (uPRM) that requires no human supervision, neither at the level of step-by-step annotations nor through ground-truth verification of final answers. The key idea behind our approach is to define a scoring function, derived from LLM next-token probabilities, that jointly assesses candidate positions of first erroneous steps across a batch of reasoning trajectories. We demonstrate the effectiveness of uPRM across diverse scenarios: (i) uPRM achieves up to 15% absolute accuracy improvements over the LLM-as-a-Judge in identifying first erroneous steps on the ProcessBench dataset; (ii) as a verifier for test-time scaling, uPRM performs comparably to supervised PRMs and outperforms the majority voting baseline by up to 6.9%, and (iii) when used as a reward signal in reinforcement learning, uPRM enables more robust policy optimization throughout training compared to a supervised PRM trained using ground-truth labels. Overall, our results open a path toward scalable reward modeling for complex reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需人工监督的无监督过程奖励模型（uPRM），通过利用LLM下一词元概率联合评估推理轨迹中的首批错误步骤，在错误识别、测试时扩展和强化学习中均表现出色，为复杂推理任务的可扩展奖励建模开辟了新路径。
AI.motivation: 现有的过程奖励模型虽然能有效引导大语言模型推理，但需要专家对每一步推理进行精细标注，成本高昂且难以扩展，这是当前面临的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出无监督过程奖励模型（uPRM），定义了一个基于LLM下一词元概率的评分函数，通过联合评估一批推理轨迹中首批错误步骤的候选位置，实现无需人工标注或最终答案真值验证的训练。
AI.result: 在ProcessBench数据集上，首批错误步骤识别准确率比LLM-as-a-Judge最高提升15%；作为测试时扩展的验证器，性能与有监督PRM相当且优于多数投票基线最高6.9%；作为强化学习奖励信号，训练过程中策略优化更加稳健。
AI.conclusion: uPRM在多种场景下展现出卓越效果，无需人工监督即可实现高性能，为复杂推理任务的可扩展奖励建模提供了有效解决方案。

title: jNO: A JAX Library for Neural Operator and Foundation Model Training
summary: jNO (jax Neural Operators) is a JAX-native library for neural operators and foundation models with unified support for both data-driven and physics-informed training. Its core design is a tracing system in which domains, model calls, residuals, supervised losses, and diagnostics are written in one symbolic language and compiled into one optimization pipeline. This allows users to move between operator regression, mesh-aware residual evaluation, and PDE-constrained training without restructuring the surrounding code. jNO also supports multi-model compositions, fine-grained control at parameter level (model, optimizer, and learning rate), hyperparameter tuning, and JAX-native workflows for translated PDE foundation-model families. The source repository is available at https://github.com/FhG-IISB/jNO.

AI.tldr: jNO是一个JAX原生的神经算子和基础模型库，通过统一的符号语言追踪系统，实现数据驱动和物理信息训练的无缝切换。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经算子框架在处理数据驱动和物理信息训练时往往需要重构代码，缺乏统一的接口来支持算子回归、残差评估和PDE约束训练之间的灵活转换。
AI.method: 提出了一种追踪系统（tracing system），将域、模型调用、残差、监督损失和诊断信息用统一的符号语言编写，并编译成一个优化管道；支持多模型组合、参数级精细控制、超参数调优以及JAX原生工作流。
AI.result: 开发完成了jNO库，实现了在算子回归、网格感知残差评估和PDE约束训练之间的无缝切换，无需重构外围代码，并已开源发布。
AI.conclusion: jNO为神经算子和PDE基础模型提供了一个统一、灵活且高效的JAX原生开发框架，降低了不同训练范式之间的切换成本。

title: OUIDecay: Adaptive Layer-wise Weight Decay for CNNs Using Online Activation Patterns
summary: Weight decay remains one of the most widely used regularization mechanisms for training convolutional neural networks, yet it is still commonly applied as a fixed coefficient shared by all layers throughout training. This uniform treatment ignores that different layers may follow different structural dynamics and therefore may require different regularization strengths. In this work, we propose OUIDecay, an adaptive layer-wise and time-dependent weight decay scheduler for CNNs driven by the Overfitting-Underfitting Indicator (OUI), an activation-based metric previously shown to provide early information about regularization quality. OUIDecay uses a lightweight batch-based formulation of OUI to monitor the structural behavior of each layer online and periodically rescales its weight decay relative to the other layers in the network. Unlike gradient-based adaptive decay methods, our approach relies on functional information extracted from activation patterns and does not require validation data. Experiments on EfficientNet-B0 with Stanford Cars, ResNet50 with Food101, DenseNet121 with CIFAR100, and MobileNetV2 with CIFAR10 show that OUIDecay achieves the best mean best-validation-loss in 7 out of 8 evaluated settings. These results indicate that activation-driven weight decay adaptation is a practical and effective alternative to fixed decay and gradient-based adaptive decay, while keeping the method lightweight and suitable for online use.

AI.tldr: 提出OUIDecay方法，一种基于激活模式的自适应分层权重衰减调度器，在8个实验设置中的7个取得了最佳验证损失。
AI.motivation: 传统权重衰减在训练卷积神经网络时对所有层使用统一的固定系数，这种均匀处理忽略了不同层可能遵循不同的结构动态，因而需要不同的正则化强度。
AI.method: 提出OUIDecay，一种基于过拟合-欠拟合指示器（OUI）的自适应分层且时变的权重衰减调度器。该方法利用轻量级的批量OUI公式在线监控每层的结构行为，并周期性地相对于网络中其他层重新调整其权重衰减。与基于梯度的自适应衰减方法不同，该方法依赖于从激活模式中提取的功能信息，不需要验证数据。
AI.result: 在EfficientNet-B0+Stanford Cars、ResNet50+Food101、DenseNet121+CIFAR100和MobileNetV2+CIFAR10上的实验表明，OUIDecay在8个评估设置中的7个取得了最佳的平均最佳验证损失。
AI.conclusion: 激活驱动的权重衰减自适应是固定衰减和基于梯度的自适应衰减的实用且有效的替代方案，同时保持了方法的轻量级特性并适用于在线使用。

title: Hyperparameter Transfer for Dense Associative Memories
summary: Dense Associative Memory (DenseAM) is a promising family of AI architectures that is represented by a neural network performing temporal dynamics on an energy landscape. While hyperparameter transfer methods are well-studied for feed-forward networks, these methods have not been developed for settings in which weights are shared across layers and within the layer, which is common in DenseAMs. Additionally, DenseAMs utilize rapidly peaking activation functions that are rarely used in feed-forward architectures. The confluence of these aspects makes DenseAM a challenging framework for using existing methods for hyperparameter transfer. Our work initiates the development of hyperparameter transfer methods for this class of models. We derive explicit prescriptions for how the hyperparameters tuned on small models can be transferred to models trained at scale. We demonstrate excellent agreement between these theoretical findings and empirical results.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为密集联想记忆（DenseAM）模型开发了超参数迁移方法，推导了从小模型到大模型的超参数缩放规则，并验证了理论预测与实验结果的高度一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的超参数迁移方法主要针对前馈神经网络，无法直接应用于具有层间和层内权重共享特性以及使用快速峰值激活函数的DenseAM模型，因此迫切需要为这一新型AI架构开发专门的超参数迁移理论。
AI.method: 推导了DenseAM模型的超参数迁移显式公式，建立了从小规模模型调整的超参数迁移到大规模训练模型的数学关系，并在理论上分析了权重共享和特殊激活函数对超参数缩放的影响。
AI.result: 理论推导的超参数迁移规则与实验结果表现出高度一致，验证了所提方法在DenseAM模型规模扩展过程中的有效性和准确性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功填补了DenseAM模型在超参数迁移领域的空白，为该类模型的规模化训练提供了理论指导，为后续DenseAM的实际应用奠定了重要基础。

title: Balancing Efficiency and Fairness in Traffic Light Control through Deep Reinforcement Learning
comment: Paper accepted to the 2026 IFAC World Congress, held in Busan (KOR), August 23rd-28th, 2026
summary: Urban traffic congestion presents a significant challenge for modern cities, which impacts mobility and sustainability. Traditional traffic light control systems often fail to adapt to dynamic conditions, leading to inefficiencies. This paper proposes a novel deep reinforcement learning agent for traffic light control that addresses this limitation by explicitly integrating fairness considerations for both vehicular and pedestrian traffic. Unlike prior work, our approach dynamically balances these flows based on real-time demand, moving beyond systems focused solely on vehicles. Experimental results demonstrate that our agent effectively reduces congestion while ensuring equitable service for both the categories of road users. This research contributes to a practical and adaptable solution for intelligent traffic management within the framework of smart cities, paving the way for more efficient and inclusive urban mobility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的深度强化学习智能体用于交通灯控制，通过显式整合车辆与行人的公平性考量，有效缓解了拥堵并确保了两类道路使用者的服务公平性。
AI.motivation: 现有的传统交通灯控制系统难以适应动态变化的道路条件，往往导致效率低下；且先前的研究主要关注车辆交通，忽视了行人的需求，缺乏对不同道路使用者的公平性考量。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于深度强化学习的交通灯控制智能体，该方法创新地将公平性显式整合进算法中，能够根据实时需求动态平衡车辆与行人的交通流。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该智能体在有效减少交通拥堵的同时，成功确保了车辆与行人两类道路用户获得公平的服务。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为智慧城市框架下的智能交通管理提供了一种实用且适应性强的解决方案，为实现更高效、更具包容性的城市交通铺平了道路。

title: One-Step Graph-Structured Neural Flows for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Classification
summary: Neural Flows efficiently model irregular multivariate time series by directly learning ODE solution trajectories with neural networks, bypassing step-by-step numerical solvers. Despite their efficiency, many existing approaches treat variables independently, leaving inter-variable interactions underexplored. Moreover, their one-step mapping makes interaction modeling inherently challenging, as it removes the iterative refinement of interactions during learning. To address this challenge, we propose one-step Graph-Structured Neural Flows (GSNF), which introduce two auxiliary-trajectory self-supervision strategies to strengthen interaction learning: (i) interaction-aware trajectory generation via re-initialization, which induces trajectory divergence to expose graph-induced interactions, with a theoretically derived lower bound on divergence; and (ii) reverse-time trajectory generation, which enforces forward-backward consistency to regularize graph learning, enabled by flow invertibility. Experiments on five real-world datasets show that GSNF achieves state-of-the-art classification performance with highly competitive training time and memory usage.

AI.tldr: 提出GSNF模型，通过辅助轨迹自监督策略增强图结构神经流中的变量交互学习，实现了不规则多变量时间序列的最先进分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有神经流方法通常独立处理变量，忽略了变量间交互；且其单步映射特性缺乏迭代细化过程，使得交互建模存在固有挑战。
AI.method: 提出一步图结构神经流（GSNF），引入两种辅助轨迹自监督策略：(i) 通过重初始化的交互感知轨迹生成，诱导轨迹发散以暴露图诱导的交互，并给出发散下界的理论推导；(ii) 利用流可逆性的反向时间轨迹生成，强制前向-后向一致性以正则化图学习。
AI.result: 在五个真实世界数据集上，GSNF实现了最先进的分类性能，同时保持了极具竞争力的训练时间和内存使用。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入辅助轨迹自监督策略，GSNF在不牺牲效率的前提下有效解决了神经流中交互建模的难题，为不规则多变量时间序列分析提供了一种高效且强大的解决方案。

title: Fix the Loss, Not the Radius: Rethinking the Adversarial Perturbation of Sharpness-Aware Minimization
summary: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) improves generalization by minimizing the worst-case loss within a fixed parameter-space radius neighborhood. SAM and its variants mainly rely on a first-order linearized surrogate, while flat minima are inherently a second-order (curvature) notion.We revisit this mismatch and propose Loss-Equated SAM (LE-SAM), which inverts the traditional SAM mechanism that fixed perturbation radius with a fixed loss-space budget,effectively removing gradient-norm-dominated learning signals and shifting optimization toward curvature-dominated terms. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and tasks demonstrate the strong generalization ability of LESAM that consistently outperforms SAM and even its variants, achieving the state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出LE-SAM，通过固定损失空间预算替代传统SAM的固定参数扰动半径，消除梯度主导信号并转向曲率主导优化，显著提升泛化性能。
AI.motivation: SAM及其变体主要依赖一阶线性化代理来寻找平坦极小值，但平坦极小值本质上是一个二阶（曲率）概念，存在方法与目标之间的不匹配问题。
AI.method: 提出Loss-Equated SAM (LE-SAM)，反转传统SAM机制：不再固定参数空间的扰动半径，而是固定损失空间的预算。这种设计有效消除了梯度范数主导的学习信号，将优化过程转向曲率主导的项。
AI.result: 在多种基准测试和任务上进行了广泛实验，LE-SAM展现出强大的泛化能力，持续优于SAM及其变体，达到了最先进的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: LE-SAM通过解决SAM中一阶近似与二阶目标的不匹配问题，成功改进了寻找平坦极小值的方法，为提升模型泛化能力提供了新的有效途径。

title: ProteinOPD: Towards Effective and Efficient Preference Alignment for Protein Design
summary: Designing proteins with desired functions or properties represents a core goal in synthetic biology and drug discovery. Recent advances in protein language models (PLMs) have enabled the generation of highly designable protein sequences, while preference alignment provides a promising way to steer designs toward desired functions and properties. Nevertheless, they often trigger catastrophic forgetting of pretrained knowledge, degrading basic designability and failing to balance multiple competing objectives. To address these issues, we draw inspiration from On-Policy Distillation (OPD), an advanced post-training method renowned for mitigating catastrophic forgetting through its mode-seeking nature. In this work, we propose ProteinOPD, a multi-objective preference alignment framework that can effectively balance multiple preference objectives while maintaining the inherent designability of PLMs. ProteinOPD adapts a pretrained PLM into preference-specific teachers and distills their knowledge into a shared student via token-level OPD on the student's own trajectories. During this process, the student is aligned to a unique normalized geometric consensus of weighted teachers while ensuring bounded optimization under conflicts. This bridges the gap for OPD in multi-objective/teacher alignment. Extensive experiments show that ProteinOPD achieves substantial gains on target preference objectives without compromising the designability, with an 8x training speedup over RL-based alignment competitors.

AI.tldr: 提出ProteinOPD框架，通过在线策略蒸馏实现多目标偏好对齐，在保持蛋白质语言模型设计能力的同时显著提升目标属性。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质语言模型在偏好对齐过程中存在灾难性遗忘问题，导致基本设计能力下降且难以平衡多个竞争目标，亟需能够在多目标优化中保持预训练知识的方法。
AI.method: 提出ProteinOPD多目标偏好对齐框架：1) 将预训练PLM适配为偏好特定的教师模型；2) 通过token级别的在线策略蒸馏在学生模型自身轨迹上蒸馏知识；3) 学生模型对齐到加权教师的归一化几何共识，在冲突情况下保证有界优化。
AI.result: 在目标偏好属性上获得显著提升，同时不损害设计能力；相比基于强化学习的对齐方法实现8倍训练加速。
AI.conclusion: ProteinOPD成功解决了蛋白质语言模型多目标偏好对齐中的灾难性遗忘问题，为合成生物学和药物发现中的蛋白质设计提供了高效可靠的方法。

title: Breaking the Reward Barrier: Accelerating Tree-of-Thought Reasoning via Speculative Exploration
summary:
Tree-of-Thought (ToT) reasoning structures Large Language Model (LLM) inference as a tree-based search, demonstrating strong potential for solving complex mathematical and programming tasks. However, its efficiency is constrained by the reward dependency barrier -- a synchronization bottleneck caused by sequential reward-guided exploration that limits search parallelism and introduces substantial latency. Prior system optimizations, mainly designed for linear Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, cannot address these challenges, leaving the efficiency of ToT underexplored.
  To enhance ToT reasoning efficiency, we observe that the reasoning paths can be explored speculatively to break the reward synchronization barrier. Therefore, in this paper, we propose SPEX and introduce three key techniques: (i) intra-query speculative path selection to predict and expand high-potential branches of ToT, (ii) inter-query budget allocation to balance speculative resource allocation across queries dynamically, and (iii) adaptive early termination to prune deep and redundant branches for a skewed search tree.
  We implement SPEX on top of the SGLang framework and evaluate it across diverse ToT algorithms and LLMs. Extensive experiments show that SPEX achieves $1.2 \sim 3 \times$ speedup for different ToT reasoning algorithms. Moreover, SPEX synergizes with token-level speculative decoding, achieving cumulative speedups of up to $4.1\times$. Ablation studies further confirm the contributions of each technique. Overall, SPEX represents a significant step toward efficient and scalable ToT reasoning, unlocking the parallelism required for high-performance inference-time scaling for LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPEX系统，通过推测性路径选择、动态预算分配和自适应提前终止三种技术打破Tree-of-Thought推理中的奖励依赖障碍，实现了1.2~3倍加速，与token级推测解码结合可达4.1倍加速。
AI.motivation: Tree-of-Thought (ToT) 推理在解决复杂数学和编程任务方面潜力巨大，但其效率受到"奖励依赖障碍"的限制——这是一种由顺序奖励引导探索引起的同步瓶颈，限制了搜索并行性并引入大量延迟。现有的主要针对线性Chain-of-Thought推理设计的系统优化无法解决这些挑战。
AI.method: 提出SPEX系统，引入三项关键技术：(i) 查询内推测性路径选择，预测并扩展ToT的高潜力分支；(ii) 查询间预算分配，动态平衡跨查询的推测性资源分配；(iii) 自适应提前终止，针对倾斜搜索树剪除深层和冗余分支。在SGLang框架上实现。
AI.result: 在多种ToT算法和大语言模型上的广泛实验表明：SPEX为不同ToT推理算法实现了1.2~3倍的加速；与token级推测解码协同作用，累积加速可达4.1倍；消融研究证实了每项技术的贡献。
AI.conclusion: SPEX代表了向高效、可扩展ToT推理迈进的重要一步，解锁了大语言模型高性能推理时扩展所需的并行性。

title: Many Needles in a Haystack: Active Hit Discovery for Perturbation Experiments
comment: To be published in International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
summary: High-throughput gene perturbation experiments can test several genetic interventions in parallel, yet experimental budgets remain limited. A central goal is hit discovery: identifying as many perturbations as possible whose phenotypic effect exceeds a predefined threshold. Pure exploration strategies are statistically inefficient, wasting budget on low-value regions. Bayesian optimization methods offer a principled alternative but target a single global optimum, over-exploiting dominant modes while neglecting other high-value regions. We formalize hit discovery as a sequential experimental design problem and propose Probability-of-Hit, an acquisition function that directly targets threshold exceedance by ranking candidates according to their posterior probability of being a hit.
