We prove asymptotic optimality of this approach and demonstrate strong empirical performance on both synthetic benchmarks and real biological immunology datasets, including up to 6.4% improvement over baselines on the Schmidt IL-2 dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文将高维基因扰动实验中的命中发现问题形式化为序贯实验设计问题，提出了直接优化阈值超越概率的采集函数Probability-of-Hit，证明了其渐近最优性并在合成基准与真实免疫学数据集上取得了优于基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 高通量基因扰动实验虽然可以并行测试多种遗传干预，但实验预算仍然有限。现有方法存在效率问题：纯探索策略统计效率低，浪费预算在低价值区域；贝叶斯优化方法针对单一全局最优解，过度开发主导模式而忽略其他高价值区域。
AI.method: 将命中发现问题形式化为序贯实验设计问题，提出Probability-of-Hit采集函数，通过计算候选点超过预定义阈值的后验概率对候选进行排序，直接优化命中概率而非单一最优解。
AI.result: 证明了Probability-of-Hit方法的渐近最优性；在合成基准测试和真实生物学免疫学数据集上展示了优异的实证性能，在Schmidt IL-2数据集上相比基线方法提升高达6.4%。
AI.conclusion: Probability-of-Hit方法为高通量基因扰动实验中的命中发现问题提供了一个统计高效的解决方案，能够在有限预算下识别更多表型效应超过阈值的扰动，具有理论保证和实际应用价值。

title: Empty SPACE: Cross-Attention Sparsity for Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
summary: Erasing specific concepts from text-to-image diffusion models is essential for avoiding the generation of copyrighted and explicit content. Closed-form concept erasure methods offer a fast alternative to backpropagation-based techniques, but they become less effective when scaling from smaller models such as Stable Diffusion 1.5 to larger models like Stable Diffusion XL. To maintain erasure effectiveness in these larger-scale architectures, we propose SParse cross-Attention-based Concept Erasure (SPACE). SPACE iteratively modifies the cross-attention parameters of a model with a closed-form update that jointly induces sparsity and erases target concepts. By concentrating the concept mapping to a lower-dimensional subspace, SPACE achieves superior erasure efficacy compared to dense baselines. Extensive experimental results show improvements in erasure effectiveness and robustness against adversarial prompts. Furthermore, SPACE achieves 80\%-90\% cross-attention sparsity, reducing the storage requirements for saving the modified parameters by 70\%, demonstrating its memory efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出SPACE方法，通过稀疏化跨注意力参数实现大规模文生图扩散模型中的概念擦除，在保持擦除效果的同时降低存储需求。
AI.motivation: 现有闭式概念擦除方法在小规模模型（如Stable Diffusion 1.5）上表现良好，但在扩展到大规模模型（如Stable Diffusion XL）时效果显著下降，亟需一种能在大规模架构中保持擦除有效性的方法。
AI.method: 提出SParse cross-Attention-based Concept Erasure (SPACE)方法，采用迭代式闭式更新修改模型的跨注意力参数，联合诱导稀疏性并擦除目标概念，将概念映射集中于低维子空间。
AI.result: 相比密集基线方法具有更优的擦除效果和对对抗性提示的鲁棒性；实现80%-90%的跨注意力稀疏度，存储需求降低70%。
AI.conclusion: SPACE成功解决了大规模扩散模型中概念擦除的有效性下降问题，通过稀疏化策略在擦除性能和存储效率之间取得了良好平衡，为大规模模型的负责任部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: Task-Aware Calibration: Provably Optimal Decoding in LLMs
summary: LLM decoding often relies on the model's predictive distribution to generate an output. Consequently, misalignment with respect to the true generating distribution leads to suboptimal decisions in practice. While a natural solution is to calibrate the model's output distribution, for LLMs, this is ill-posed at the combinatorially vast level of free-form language. We address this by building on the insight that in many tasks, these free-form outputs can be interpreted in a semantically meaningful latent structure, for example, discrete class labels, integers, or sets. We introduce task calibration as a paradigm to calibrate the model's predictive distribution in the task-induced latent space. We apply a decision-theoretic result to show that Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding on the task-calibrated latent distribution is the optimal decoding strategy on latent model beliefs. Empirically, it consistently improves generation quality across different tasks and baselines. We also introduce Task Calibration Error (TCE), an application-aware calibration metric that quantifies the excess loss due to miscalibration. Our work demonstrates that task calibration enables more reliable model decisions across various tasks and applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任务校准范式，通过在任务诱导的潜在空间中校准模型预测分布，并结合最小贝叶斯风险（MBR）解码，显著提升了大型语言模型在多种任务上的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的解码过程依赖于模型的预测分布，但当该分布与真实生成分布不一致时，会导致实际决策次优。直接在自由形式语言的组合爆炸空间上对模型输出分布进行校准是病态问题，因此需要一种新的校准方法。
AI.method: 本文提出任务校准范式，其核心洞察是在许多任务中，自由形式的输出可以映射到具有语义意义的潜在结构（如离散类别标签、整数或集合）。该方法首先在任务诱导的潜在空间中对模型的预测分布进行校准，然后利用决策理论结果，证明在校准后的潜在分布上进行最小贝叶斯风险（MBR）解码是潜在模型信念下的最优解码策略。此外，还引入了任务校准误差（TCE）这一指标，用于量化因校准偏差导致的额外损失。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的方法在不同任务和基线模型上均能持续提升生成质量。任务校准误差（TCE）作为应用感知的校准指标，有效地量化了校准偏差带来的损失。
AI.conclusion: 任务校准能够在各种任务和应用中实现更可靠的模型决策，为解决大型语言模型在自由形式语言空间中的校准难题提供了有效途径。

title: Unveiling High-Probability Generalization in Decentralized SGD
summary: Decentralized stochastic gradient descent (D-SGD) is an efficient method for large-scale distributed learning. Existing generalization studies mainly address expected results, achieving rates limited to $\mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1}{δ\sqrt{mn}}\right)$, where $δ$ is the confidence parameter, $m$ the number of workers, and $n$ the sample size. When $m=1$, D-SGD reduces to traditional SGD, whose optimal high-probability generalization bound is $\mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\log (1/δ)\right)$. This discrepancy reveals a gap between high-probability guarantees for SGD and those for D-SGD. To close this, we develop a high-probability learning theory for D-SGD, aiming for the optimal $\mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{mn}}\log (1/δ)\right)$ rate. We refine bounds for D-SGD using pointwise uniform stability in distributed learning-a weaker notion than uniform stability-and analyze them across convex, strongly convex, and non-convex settings. We also provide high-probability results for gradient-based measures in non-convex cases where only local minima exist, and derive optimization error and excess risk bounds. Finally, accounting for communication overhead, we analyze generalization bounds for local models within time-varying frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对去中心化随机梯度下降（D-SGD）填补了高概率泛化界与SGD之间的理论缺口，首次建立了优于现有期望结果的最优高概率泛化界$\mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{mn}}\log (1/δ)\right)$。
AI.motivation: 现有D-SGD的泛化研究主要针对期望结果，其速率为$\mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1}{δ\sqrt{mn}}\right)$，而传统SGD的最优高概率界为$\mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}\log (1/δ)\right)$。当$m=1$时，两者之间存在明显的理论差距，本文旨在消除这一差距，为D-SGD建立最优的高概率学习理论。
AI.method: 引入分布式学习中的逐点一致稳定性（pointwise uniform stability）概念，该概念比传统一致稳定性更弱；在凸、强凸和非凸三种设置下对D-SGD的边界进行细化分析；针对非凸情况下仅存在局部极小值的场景提供基于梯度测度的高概率结果；推导优化误差和超额风险界；考虑通信开销，在时变框架下分析局部模型的泛化边界。
AI.result: 成功建立了D-SGD的最优高概率泛化界$\mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{mn}}\log (1/δ)\right)$；在凸、强凸和非凸设置下均获得了改进的泛化边界；为非凸情况提供了基于梯度测度的高概率结果；推导出了优化误差和超额风险界；在考虑通信开销的时变框架下分析了局部模型的泛化边界。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功填补了D-SGD与SGD在高概率泛化界之间的理论差距，通过引入逐点一致稳定性概念，建立了完整的高概率学习理论框架，为分布式学习提供了更严谨的理论保证，同时考虑了实际应用中的通信开销问题。

title: FORGE: Fragment-Oriented Ranking and Generation for Context-Aware Molecular Optimization
summary: Molecular optimization seeks to improve a molecule through small structural edits while preserving similarity to the starting compound. Recent language-model approaches typically treat this task as prompt-conditioned sequence generation. However, relying on natural language introduces an inherent data-scaling bottleneck, often leads to chemical hallucinations, and ignores the strong context dependence of fragment effects. We present FORGE, a two-stage framework that reformulates molecular optimization as context-aware local editing. By utilizing automatically mined, verified low-to-high edit pairs instead of expensive human text annotations, Stage 1 ranks candidate fragments by their property contribution under the full molecular context to inject chemical prior, and Stage 2 generates explicit fragment replacements. Built on a compact 0.6B language model, FORGE further adapts to unseen black-box objectives through in-context demonstrations. Across Prompt-MolOpt, PMO-1k and ChemCoTBench, FORGE consistently outperforms prior methods, including substantially larger language models and graph methods. These results highlight the value of explicit fragment-level supervision as a more easily obtainable, scalable, and hallucination-less alternative to natural language training.

AI.tldr: FORGE是一个两阶段的分子优化框架，通过显式的片段级监督替代自然语言提示，在多个基准上超越了更大的语言模型和图方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的语言模型方法将分子优化视为基于自然语言提示的序列生成任务，但这引入了数据缩放瓶颈，容易产生化学幻觉，且忽略了片段效应的强上下文依赖性。
AI.method: 提出FORGE框架：第一阶段利用自动挖掘的低到高性能编辑片段对，在完整分子上下文中对候选片段进行排序；第二阶段生成显式的片段替换。该框架基于0.6B的小型语言模型，支持通过上下文示例适应未见过的黑盒目标。
AI.result: 在Prompt-MolOpt、PMO-1k和ChemCoTBench三个基准测试中，FORGE始终优于先前方法，包括参数量更大的语言模型和图方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式的片段级监督比自然语言训练更易获取、更具可扩展性且能避免幻觉，是分子优化任务中更优的训练信号来源。

title: When Does Non-Uniform Replay Matter in Reinforcement Learning?
summary: Modern off-policy reinforcement learning algorithms often rely on simple uniform replay sampling and it remains unclear when and why non-uniform replay improves over this strong baseline. Across diverse RL settings, we show that the effectiveness of non-uniform replay is governed by three factors: replay volume, the number of replayed transitions per environment step; expected recency, how recent sampled transitions are; and the entropy of the replay sampling distribution. Our main contribution is clarifying when non-uniform replay is beneficial and providing practical guidance for replay design in modern off-policy RL. Namely, we find that non-uniform replay is most beneficial when replay volume is low, and that high-entropy sampling is important even at comparable expected recency. Motivated by these findings, we adopt a simple Truncated Geometric replay that biases sampling toward recent experience while preserving high entropy and incurring negligible computational overhead. Across large-scale parallel simulation, single-task, and multi-task settings, including three modern algorithms evaluated on five RL benchmark suites, this replay sampling strategy improves sample efficiency in low-volume regimes while remaining competitive when replay volume is high.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了非均匀经验回放有效的三个关键因素（回放容量、期望新近度、采样熵），提出了一种简单的截断几何回放策略，在低回放容量下显著提升样本效率。
AI.motivation: 现代离策略强化学习算法通常依赖简单的均匀回放采样，但尚不清楚非均匀回放何时以及为何能超越这一强基准。作者旨在系统研究非均匀回放的有效性条件，为现代离策略RL中的回放设计提供理论和实践指导。
AI.method: 作者通过跨多种RL设置的实验分析，识别出支配非均匀回放效果的三个关键因素：回放容量、期望新近度、采样分布的熵。基于发现（非均匀回放在低回放容量时最有益，高熵采样很重要），提出了截断几何回放策略，该策略偏向近期经验同时保持高熵且计算开销极小。
AI.result: 在大规模并行仿真、单任务和多任务设置中，在五个RL基准套件上评估三种现代算法，截断几何回放策略在低回放容量机制下提高了样本效率，在高回放容量时保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 非均匀经验回放在低回放容量场景下最为有益，高熵采样对于保持性能至关重要。截断几何回放策略简单有效，为现代离策略RL系统的回放缓冲区设计提供了实用指导。

title: The Benefits of Temporal Correlations: SGD Learns k-Juntas from Random Walks Efficiently
summary: We study how temporal correlations in the data can make certain sparse learning problems efficiently learnable by gradient-based methods. Our focus is on Boolean k-juntas, a canonical sparse learning problem known to pose barriers for gradient-based methods under independent uniform samples. We show that this picture changes when the samples are generated by a lazy random walk on the hypercube. In this setting, the temporal dependencies can be exploited by a two-layer ReLU network trained using stylized-SGD with a temporal-difference loss, which compares target and predicted increments across consecutive samples. For every fixed k, the resulting sample complexity is essentially linear in the ambient dimension d. By contrast, we show that for large-batch gradient methods using standard convex pointwise losses, temporal correlations do not provide the same advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文证明时间相关性使布尔k-juntas问题可被梯度方法高效学习：在超立方体懒随机游走采样下，使用时序差分损失训练的两层ReLU网络样本复杂度近似线性于维度d，而大批量凸点损失方法无法获得相同优势。
AI.motivation: 布尔k-juntas作为稀疏学习典型问题，在独立均匀采样下已知对梯度方法存在学习障碍。研究者探索时间相关数据是否能改变这一困境，旨在理解时序依赖如何被梯度方法利用来高效学习。
AI.method: 采用超立方体上的懒随机游走生成具有时间相关性的样本；训练两层ReLU网络，使用风格化SGD配合时序差分损失函数，该损失比较连续样本间的目标增量与预测增量。
AI.result: 对于任意固定k，所提方法在时序相关数据下的样本复杂度本质上是线性于环境维度d的（O(d)量级）；对比分析表明，使用标准凸点损失的大批量梯度方法无法从时间相关性中获得同等学习优势。
AI.conclusion: 时间相关性可以被梯度方法有效利用来解决传统上困难的学习问题，但需要合适的损失函数设计（如时序差分损失）；简单的大批量凸点损失方法不足以利用时序结构，揭示了算法设计与数据结构匹配的重要性。

title: When Normality Shifts: Risk-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Unsupervised Tabular Anomaly Detection
summary: Unsupervised tabular anomaly detection methods typically learn feature patterns from normal samples during training and subsequently identify samples that deviate from these patterns as anomalies during testing. However, in practical scenarios, the limited scale and diversity of training data often lead to an incomplete characterization of normal patterns. While test-time adaptation offers a remedy, its isolated focus on test-time optimization ignores the critical synergy with training-phase learning. Furthermore, indiscriminate adaptation to unlabeled test data inevitably triggers anomaly contamination, preventing the model from fully realizing its discriminative capability between normal and anomalous samples. To address these issues, we propose RTTAD, a Risk-aware Test-time adaptation method for unsupervised Tabular Anomaly Detection. RTTAD holistically tackles normality shifts via a synergistic two-stage mechanism. During training, collaborative dual-task learning captures multi-level representations to establish a robust normal prior. During testing, a Test-Time Contrastive Learning (TTCL) module explicitly accounts for adaptation risk by selectively updating the model using high-confidence pseudo-normal samples while constraining anomalous ones. Additionally, TTCL incorporates a k-nearest neighbor-based contrastive objective to refine embedding distributions, thereby further enhancing the model's discriminative capacity. Extensive experiments on 15 tabular datasets demonstrate that RTTAD achieves state-of-the-art overall detection performance.

AI.tldr: 提出了RTTAD方法，通过风险感知的测试时适应策略解决无监督表格异常检测中的正常模式表征不完整和异常污染问题，在15个数据集上达到了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督表格异常检测方法在训练数据规模和多样性有限时，难以完整表征正常模式；测试时适应方法虽然能缓解该问题，但其孤立优化忽略了与训练阶段的协同，且对无标签测试数据的盲目适应会导致异常污染，限制模型区分能力。
AI.method: 提出RTTAD方法，采用协同两阶段机制：1）训练阶段通过协作双任务学习捕获多层次表征以建立鲁棒的正常先验；2）测试阶段设计测试时对比学习（TTCL）模块，利用高置信度伪正常样本选择性更新模型并约束异常样本，同时引入基于k近邻的对比目标优化嵌入分布。
AI.result: 在15个表格数据集上的广泛实验表明，RTTAD实现了整体最优的检测性能。
AI.conclusion: RTTAD通过协同训练-测试两阶段学习机制和风险感知的测试时适应策略，有效解决了正常性偏移和异常污染问题，显著提升了无监督表格异常检测的性能。

title: Teaching LLMs to See Graphs: Unifying Text and Structural Reasoning
summary: Using Large Language Models (LLMs) to process graph-structured data is an active research area, yet current state-of-the-art approaches typically rely on multi-step pipelines with Graph Neural Network (GNN) encoders that compress rich textual attributes into solitary tokens, creating a significant semantic bottleneck. In this paper, we introduce the Graph Transformer Language Model (GTLM), a novel architecture that enables pretrained LLMs to natively process graph topologies while entirely eliminating this compressive bottleneck. GTLM is exceptionally parameter-efficient: by injecting graph-aware attention biases directly into the LLM's attention modules, it introduces only 0.015% additional parameters relative to the base model. We theoretically prove that our bidirectional attention prefix preserves node permutation equivariance while maintaining exact backward compatibility with the pretrained base model. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that a 1B-parameter GTLM matches or exceeds the performance of 7B-parameter state-of-the-art models on standard Text-Attributed Graph benchmarks, while significantly surpassing baselines on GraphQA. Finally, we demonstrate that GTLM attention heads implicitly learn to simulate message passing, explaining its superior performance on algorithmic tasks. This paradigm shift enables true algorithmic reasoning within LLMs and provides a scalable foundation for next-generation GraphRAG and relational deep learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了图Transformer语言模型（GTLM），通过注入图感知注意力偏置，使预训练LLM能原生处理图拓扑结构，仅增加0.015%参数即可消除语义瓶颈，1B参数模型性能匹敌7B参数SOTA模型。
AI.motivation: 当前SOTA方法依赖GNN编码器的多步流水线，将丰富文本属性压缩为单一标记，造成严重的语义瓶颈；旨在让预训练LLM原生处理图结构数据以消除该瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出图Transformer语言模型（GTLM），将图感知注意力偏置直接注入LLM的注意力模块；引入双向注意力前缀，理论上证明其保持节点排列等变性并与预训练基模型完全向后兼容。
AI.result: 1B参数的GTLM在标准文本属性图基准上匹配或超越7B参数的SOTA模型，在GraphQA上显著超越基线；注意力头隐式学习模拟消息传递，在算法任务上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: GTLM实现了LLM内真正的算法推理，参数效率极高，为下一代GraphRAG和关系深度学习提供了可扩展的基础，代表了处理图结构数据的范式转变。

title: Generalization Error Bounds for Picard-Type Operator Learning in Nonlinear Parabolic PDEs
summary: Operator learning for partial differential equations (PDEs) aims to learn solution operators on infinite-dimensional function spaces from finite-resolution data. In this setting, it is important for the learned model to be discretization-invariant, or resolution-robust, and to reflect PDE-specific structure. It is therefore natural to ask how such structure should be encoded in the model architecture, hypothesis class, or learning procedure. In this paper, we study operator learning for solution operators of nonlinear parabolic PDEs based on Duhamel--Picard iteration. We formulate Picard iteration as an abstract state-transition model and present a theoretical framework for Picard-type operator learning. We derive implementation-agnostic generalization error bounds that separate the implementation error from the estimation error associated with the abstract state-transition model induced by Picard iteration. A key consequence is that increasing the Picard depth reduces the Picard truncation error without causing an unbounded growth of the entropy-based estimation error. We also extend the analysis to long-time prediction by rolling out the same learned local model over successive time blocks. Finally, we illustrate the theory for nonlinear heat equations on the torus using a Picard-type Fourier neural operator as a concrete implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Duhamel-Picard迭代的算子学习框架，用于非线性抛物型偏微分方程，并在理论上证明了增加Picard深度可以在不引起估计误差无界增长的情况下减小截断误差，同时提供了与实现无关的泛化误差界限。
AI.motivation: 偏微分方程的算子学习需要在无限维函数空间上从有限分辨率数据中学习解算子。在此背景下，学习模型需要具有离散不变性（即对分辨率具有鲁棒性），并能够反映PDE特定的结构。因此，如何将这种结构编码到模型架构、假设类或学习过程中成为一个关键问题。
AI.method: 作者将Picard迭代公式化为抽象的状态转移模型，提出了Picard型算子学习的理论框架。该框架推导出了与实现无关的泛化误差界限，将实现误差与由Picard迭代引起的抽象状态转移模型相关的估计误差分离开来。该方法还被扩展到长时间预测，通过在连续时间块上滚动展开相同的局部学习模型来实现。
AI.result: 研究得出了一个关键结论：增加Picard深度可以减小Picard截断误差，而不会导致基于熵的估计误差的无界增长。作者还使用Picard型傅里叶神经算子作为具体实现，在环面上的非线性热方程上验证了该理论。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一个坚实的理论基础，证明了基于Picard迭代的算子学习方法在处理非线性抛物型PDE时的有效性。该方法不仅能够控制不同类型的误差，还具备处理长时间预测的能力，为设计具有离散不变性和PDE结构感知的算子学习模型提供了理论指导。

title: Predictive Radiomics for Evaluation of Cancer Immune SignaturE in Glioblastoma: the PRECISE-GBM study
comment: Abstract : 226; Importance of study: 109; Manuscript: 5690 (excluding references) Figures: 4, Tables: 2 Supplemental File: 1
summary:
Background: Radiogenomics allows identification of radiological biomarkers for genomic phenotypes. In glioblastoma, these biomarkers could potentially complement patient stratification strategies. We aim to develop and analytically validate radiological biomarkers that capture immune cell signatures within IDH-wildtype glioblastoma microenvironment using radiogenomic analysis.
  Methods: This was a retrospective multicenter study using curated open-access anonymized imaging and genomic data from TCGA-GBM, CPTAC, IvyGAP, REMBRANDT and CGGA datasets. Imaging data consisted of MRI-based radiomic features extracted from necrotic core, enhancing and edema regions of deep learning-based auto-segmented tumors. Radiomic feature selections were performed using nested cross-validated LASSO. Support vector machine and ensemble models were trained using seventeen immune and cell-specific score labels extracted from deconvoluted transcriptomic data using pan-cancer and glioblastoma immune signature matrices as reference standards. Seventeen classifier models trained in three cross-cohort strategies were validated on three held-out datasets assessing stability and generalizability.
  Results: One-hundred-and-seventy-six patients were included in the study. The immune-related radiomic signatures obtained after feature selection were shape, first order and higher order radiomic features. Models predicting macrophage subtype immune signature showed stable mean performance on balanced accuracy (0.67) and precision (0.89) metrics for three independent holdout datasets with ensemble model outperforming support vector machine model.
  Conclusion: Radiogenomic models non-invasively predicted the macrophage subtype M0 immune signature in IDH-wildtype glioblastoma. These biomarkers have the potential to stratify patients for immunotherapy within prospective glioblastoma clinical trials.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了一种基于影像组学的无创方法，能够预测IDH野生型胶质母细胞瘤中的巨噬细胞免疫特征，有望辅助患者分层和免疫治疗决策。
AI.motivation: 旨在开发并分析验证能够捕捉IDH野生型胶质母细胞瘤微环境中免疫细胞特征的放射影像生物标志物，以补充现有的患者分层策略。
AI.method: 这是一项回顾性多中心研究，利用TCGA-GBM、CPTAC等多个公开数据集。从MRI图像中提取深度学习自动分割肿瘤区域的影像组学特征，使用嵌套交叉验证的LASSO进行特征选择。以转录组数据解卷积得到的免疫细胞评分作为标签，训练支持向量机和集成模型，并在三个独立保留数据集中验证模型的稳定性和泛化能力。
AI.result: 研究共纳入176名患者。筛选出的免疫相关影像组学特征包括形状、一阶和高阶特征。预测巨噬细胞亚型免疫特征的模型在三个独立验证集上表现稳定，平均平衡准确率为0.67，精确率为0.89，且集成模型优于支持向量机模型。
AI.conclusion: 影像基因组学模型能够无创预测IDH野生型胶质母细胞瘤中的M0型巨噬细胞免疫特征，这些生物标志物有望在前瞻性临床试验中对接受免疫治疗的患者进行分层。

title: DeepLog: A Software Framework for Modular Neurosymbolic AI
comment: Preprint accepted at IJCAI2026 Demo Track
summary: DeepLog is an operational neurosymbolic framework that unifies logic and deep learning within standard PyTorch workflows. While existing neurosymbolic systems focus on a particular paradigm and semantics, DeepLog serves as a universal backend that can emulate many systems in the neurosymbolic alphabet soup. By treating diverse neurosymbolic languages as high-level specifications, the DeepLog software automatically compiles them into optimized arithmetic circuits. This design lowers the barrier for machine learning practitioners by treating logic as composable modules, while providing neurosymbolic developers with a shared, high-performance basis for prototyping new integration strategies. The code is available here: https://github.com/ML-KULeuven/deeplog

AI.tldr: DeepLog是一个神经符号框架，能够将多种神经符号语言编译为优化的算术电路，作为通用后端统一逻辑与深度学习。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经符号系统通常专注于特定的范式和语义，缺乏统一性；为了降低机器学习从业者的使用门槛，并为神经符号开发者提供共享的高性能基础，需要开发一个通用的后端框架。
AI.method: 将多样化的神经符号语言视为高级规范，DeepLog软件自动将其编译为优化的算术电路，实现逻辑作为可组合模块，并集成到标准PyTorch工作流中。
AI.result: DeepLog能够模拟神经符号领域中的多种系统，实现了逻辑与深度学习的统一，并提供了高性能的计算基础。
AI.conclusion: DeepLog通过其通用后端设计，有效降低了神经符号系统的开发门槛，促进了新集成策略的快速原型设计，代码已开源。

title: BROS: Bias-Corrected Randomized Subspaces for Memory-Efficient Single-Loop Bilevel Optimization
summary: Stochastic bilevel optimization (SBO) has become a standard framework for hyperparameter learning, data reweighting, representation learning, and data-mixture optimization in deep learning. Existing exact single-loop SBO methods and memory-efficient surrogate SBO methods either create severe memory pressure for large lower-level neural networks or lack competitive convergence guarantees under standard assumptions. In this paper, we propose BROS, a memory-efficient single-loop SBO method with the same convergence rate order as exact single-loop SBO methods. BROS performs lower and auxiliary updates in randomized subspaces with a Rademacher bi-probe correction that recovers an unbiased Hessian-action estimator. We prove that BROS preserves the $\mathcal O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ sample complexity of MA-SOBA for finding an $\varepsilon$-stationary point under only standard assumptions. Experiments on hyper-data cleaning, data-mixture learning, hyper-representation learning, and ViT sample reweighting show that BROS reduces peak memory by up to 44.9% while closely matching full-space baseline performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BROS，一种内存高效的单循环随机双层优化方法，在标准假设下保持了与精确方法相同的O(ε⁻²)样本复杂度，同时将峰值内存降低高达44.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有的精确单循环SBO方法和内存高效的代理SBO方法存在两难困境：前者在大型下层神经网络中会产生严重的内存压力，而后者在标准假设下缺乏竞争力的收敛保证。
AI.method: 提出BROS方法，在随机子空间中执行下层更新和辅助更新，并引入Rademacher双探针校正来恢复无偏Hessian-action估计器，从而实现内存高效的单循环优化。
AI.result: 证明了BROS在仅标准假设下，保持了与MA-SOBA相同的O(ε⁻²)样本复杂度来寻找ε-平稳点；在超数据清洗、数据混合学习、超表示学习和ViT样本重加权实验中，BROS将峰值内存降低高达44.9%，同时性能接近全空间基线。
AI.conclusion: BROS成功解决了SBO方法中内存效率与收敛保证之间的矛盾，为大规模深度学习中的双层优化问题提供了一种实用的解决方案。

title: Sample-Mean Anchored Thompson Sampling for Offline-to-Online Learning with Distribution Shift
summary: Offline-to-online learning aims to improve online decision-making by leveraging offline logged data. A central challenge in this setting is the distribution shift between offline and online environments. While some existing works attempt to leverage shifted offline data, they largely rely on UCB-type algorithms. Thompson sampling (TS) represents another canonical class of bandit algorithms, well known for its strong empirical performance and naturally suited to offline-to-online learning through its Bayesian formulation. However, unlike UCB indices, posterior samples in TS are not guaranteed to be optimistic with respect to the true arm means. This makes indices constructed from purely online and hybrid data difficult to compare and complicates their use. To address this issue, we propose sample-mean anchored TS (Anchor-TS), which introduces a novel median-based anchoring rule that defines the arm index as the median of an online posterior sample, a hybrid posterior sample, and the online sample mean. The median anchoring systematically corrects bias induced by distribution shift by mitigating over-estimation for suboptimal arms and under-estimation for optimal arms, while exploiting offline information to obtain more accurate estimates when the shift is small. We establish theoretical guarantees showing that the proposed algorithm safely leverages offline data to accelerate online learning, and quantifying how the degree of distribution shift and the size of offline data affect the resulting regret reduction. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements of our algorithm over baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Anchor-TS算法，通过中值锚定规则解决离线到在线学习中的分布偏移问题，在保证安全利用离线数据的同时加速在线学习。
AI.motivation: 离线到在线学习面临的核心挑战是离线和在线环境之间的分布偏移。现有方法主要依赖UCB类算法，而汤普森采样（TS）虽然在实证中表现优异且天然适合离线到在线学习，但其后验样本不能保证对真实臂均值的乐观性，使得纯在线数据和混合数据构建的指标难以比较，使用复杂。
AI.method: 提出样本均值锚定汤普森采样（Anchor-TS），引入新颖的中值锚定规则，将臂指标定义为在线后验样本、混合后验样本和在线样本均值的中值。该中值锚定系统性地修正分布偏移引起的偏差：减轻次优臂的过估计和最优臂的欠估计，同时在偏移较小时利用离线信息获得更准确的估计。
AI.result: 建立了理论保证，证明所提算法安全利用离线数据加速在线学习，并量化了分布偏移程度和离线数据规模对遗憾减少的影响。大量实验表明该算法相比基线方法具有一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: Anchor-TS成功解决了汤普森采样在离线到在线学习中的乐观性缺失问题，通过中值锚定机制有效平衡了离线信息的利用与分布偏移的风险，为离线到在线学习提供了一种有效的新方法。

title: LeapTS: Rethinking Time Series Forecasting as Adaptive Multi-Horizon Scheduling
summary: Time series forecasting serves as an essential tool for many real-world applications, supporting tasks such as resource optimization and decision-making. Despite significant architectural advancements, most modern models still treat forecasting task as a fixed mapping from history to target horizons. This induces temporal decoupling across future time points and limits the model's ability to adapt to the evolving context as forecasting progresses. In this work, we present LeapTS, a novel framework that reformulates time series forecasting as a dynamic scheduling process over the prediction horizon. Specifically, LeapTS organizes the forecasting process into multi-level decisions using: (1) the hierarchical controller to dynamically select the optimal prediction scale and advancement length at each step, and (2) continuous-time state evolution driven by neural controlled differential equations. Within this process, the controlled update mechanism explicitly couples the irregular temporal dynamics with discrete scheduling feedback. Extensive evaluations on both real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that LeapTS improves overall forecasting performance by at least 7.4% while achieving a 2.6$\times$ to 5.3$\times$ inference speedup over representative Transformer-based models. Furthermore, by explicitly tracing the scheduling trajectories, we reveal how the model autonomously adapts its forecasting behavior to capture non-stationary dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LeapTS框架，将时间序列预测重构为动态调度过程，通过分层控制器和神经控制微分方程实现自适应预测，在提升7.4%预测性能的同时实现了2.6-5.3倍的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测模型大多将预测任务视为从历史到目标时段的固定映射，导致未来时间点之间的时序解耦，限制了模型在预测过程中适应不断变化上下文的能力。
AI.method: 提出了LeapTS框架，将时间序列预测重构为预测时段上的动态调度过程。该框架包含两个核心组件：(1)分层控制器，动态选择每一步的最优预测尺度和推进长度；(2)由神经控制微分方程驱动的连续时间状态演化。通过受控更新机制，显式地将不规则时间动态与离散调度反馈耦合。
AI.result: 在真实世界和合成数据集上的广泛评估表明，LeapTS相比代表性Transformer模型至少提升7.4%的整体预测性能，同时实现2.6倍至5.3倍的推理加速。通过显式追踪调度轨迹，揭示了模型如何自主适应其预测行为以捕获非平稳动态。
AI.conclusion: LeapTS成功地将时间序列预测从静态映射转变为动态自适应调度过程，通过分层决策和连续时间状态演化的结合，有效解决了传统方法的时序解耦问题，为非平稳动态建模提供了新思路。

title: Robust Probabilistic Shielding for Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: In offline reinforcement learning (RL), we learn policies from fixed datasets without environment interaction. The major challenges are to provide guarantees on the (1) performance and (2) safety of the resulting policy. A technique called safe policy improvement (SPI) provides a performance guarantee: with high probability, the new policy outperforms a given baseline policy, which is assumed to be safe. Orthogonally, in the context of safe RL, a shield provides a safety guarantee by restricting the action space to those actions that are provably safe with respect to a given safety-relevant model. We integrate these paradigms by extending shielding to offline RL, relying solely on the available dataset and knowledge of safe and unsafe states. Then, we shield the policy improvement steps, guaranteeing, with high probability, a safe policy. Experimental results demonstrate that shielded SPI outperforms its unshielded counterpart, improving both average and worst-case performance, particularly in low-data regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文将安全策略改进（SPI）与防护机制相结合，提出了一种用于离线强化学习的防护型SPI方法，在仅使用固定数据集的情况下同时提供性能和安全性保证。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习主要面临两个核心挑战：（1）如何保证学习策略的性能；（2）如何确保策略的安全性。现有的安全策略改进（SPI）技术可以提供性能保证，而防护机制（Shield）可以提供安全性保证，但两者尚未被有效整合。研究旨在结合这两种范式，以在离线强化学习场景下同时实现性能和安全性保障。
AI.method: 本文将防护机制扩展到离线强化学习场景，仅依赖可用的固定数据集以及对安全和不安全状态的知识。具体而言，在策略改进步骤中引入防护机制，通过限制动作空间为可证明安全的动作，从而以高概率保证策略的安全性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，防护型SPI在平均性能和最坏情况性能方面均优于未防护的SPI，特别是在低数据量情况下表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功将防护机制与安全策略改进相结合，为离线强化学习提供了一个既能保证性能又能保证安全性的框架，在数据稀缺场景下具有显著优势。

title: Set Prediction for Next-Day Active Fire Forecasting
summary: Accurate next-day active fire forecasts can support early warning, disaster response, forest risk assessment, and downstream estimation of fire-related carbon emissions. Existing machine learning approaches to wildfire forecasting typically predict wildfire danger or fire probability on kilometre-scale daily grids, which is useful for regional warning but does not directly represent localized fire events. We propose Wildfire Ignition Set Predictor (WISP), a query-based model that reformulates next-day active fire forecasting as point-set prediction. From 48 hours of covariates including meteorology, satellite vegetation products, static land, and fire history, WISP predicts a fixed-size ranked set of future active fire cluster centres on a 375 m grid across globally distributed regions. The model is trained end-to-end with Hungarian matching; to address the conflicting roles of the classification score in assignment, ranking, and query activation, we use asymmetric classification-localization weighting in matching and loss. We further construct a globally distributed, hourly, multi-source benchmark for this task. On a held-out test set spanning fire regions worldwide, the best WISP variant achieves 38.2% average precision (AP) for ranked fire-centre detections, covers 53.4% of fire cluster mass weighted by fire radiative power (FRP), and localizes 54.1% of observed clusters within 5 km. These results establish sparse set prediction as a viable formulation for high-resolution wildfire forecasting and provide a benchmark for future work in this regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了WISP模型，将次日活跃火灾预测重新表述为点集预测任务，在375米分辨率网格上预测未来火灾簇中心，实现了38.2%的平均精度和54.1%的簇定位准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习野火预测方法通常在公里尺度网格上预测野火危险性或火灾概率，虽然对区域预警有用，但无法直接表示局部火灾事件。需要一种能够直接预测局部火灾事件的高分辨率野火预报方法，以支持早期预警、灾害响应、森林风险评估和火灾相关碳排放估算。
AI.method: 提出Wildfire Ignition Set Predictor (WISP)，一种基于查询的模型，将次日活跃火灾预报重新表述为点集预测问题。模型使用包含气象、卫星植被产品、静态土地和火灾历史在内的48小时协变量，在全球分布式区域的375米网格上预测固定大小的排名未来活跃火灾簇中心集合。采用匈牙利匹配进行端到端训练，通过非对称分类-定位加权来解决分类分数在分配、排名和查询激活中的冲突角色。同时构建了全球分布式、小时级、多源基准数据集。
AI.result: 在覆盖全球火灾区域的保留测试集上，最佳WISP变体实现了38.2%的排名火灾中心检测平均精度(AP)，覆盖了按火灾辐射功率(FRP)加权的53.4%的火灾簇质量，并在5公里范围内定位了54.1%的观测簇。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果确立了稀疏集预测作为高分辨率野火预报可行公式的地位，并为该领域的未来研究提供了基准。WISP模型成功地将野火预测从传统的网格概率预测转变为精确的火灾事件位置预测，为野火早期预警和灾害响应提供了更直接有效的工具。

title: Nearly-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial Kernelized Bandits
summary: This paper studies kernelized bandits (also known as Gaussian process bandits) in an adversarial environment, where the reward functions in a known reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) may be adversarially chosen at each round. We show that the exponential-weight algorithm achieves $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T γ_T})$ adversarial regret, where $T$ and $γ_T$ denote the number of total rounds and the maximum information gain, respectively. For squared exponential (SE) and $ν$-Matérn kernels, we also show algorithm-independent lower bounds that guarantee the optimality of our algorithm up to polylogarithmic factors. Furthermore, we present a computationally efficient variant of our algorithm using Nyström approximation while maintaining nearly optimal regret guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了对抗环境下的核化老虎机问题，证明了指数权重算法能达到近似最优的对抗遗憾界，并提出了基于Nyström近似的高效计算变体。
AI.motivation: 现有关于核化老虎机（高斯过程老虎机）的研究主要集中在随机环境下，而在现实场景中，奖励函数可能被对抗性地选择。因此，作者旨在探索对抗环境下核化老虎机问题的可解性，寻求能够处理RKHS空间中任意奖励序列的算法及其理论保障。
AI.method: 作者采用了指数权重算法，该算法在每一轮根据历史观测数据维护权重分布；针对计算效率问题，引入了Nyström近似方法来降低计算复杂度，同时保持近似最优的遗憾保证。理论分析结合了最大信息增益（maximum information gain）的概念来刻画问题的统计复杂度。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，指数权重算法在对抗环境下实现了$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T γ_T})$的遗憾界，其中$T$为总轮数，$γ_T$为最大信息增益。对于平方指数核和$\nu$-Matérn核，作者证明了算法无关的下界，说明所提算法在多对数因子意义下是最优的。此外，基于Nyström近似的高效变体也能保持近似最优的遗憾保证。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将核化老虎机的研究从随机环境扩展到对抗环境，为平方指数核和Matérn核提供了理论上近似最优的算法及遗憾分析，同时在计算效率上取得了重要突破，为实际应用提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Follow the Mean: Reference-Guided Flow Matching
summary: Existing approaches to controllable generation typically rely on fine-tuning, auxiliary networks, or test-time search. We show that flow matching admits a different control interface: adaptation through examples. For deterministic interpolants, the velocity field is solely governed by a conditional endpoint mean; shifting this mean shifts the flow itself. This yields a simple principle for controllable generation: steer a pretrained model by changing the reference set it follows. We instantiate this idea in two forms. Reference-Mean Guidance is training-free: it computes a closed-form endpoint-mean correction from a reference bank and applies it to a frozen FLUX.2-klein (4B) model, enabling control of color, identity, style, and structure while keeping the prompt, seed, and weights fixed. Semi-Parametric Guidance amortizes the same idea through an explicit mean anchor and learned residual refiner, matching unconditional DiT-B/4 quality on AFHQv2 while allowing the reference set to be swapped at inference time. These results point to a broader direction: generative models that adapt through data, not parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于示例的流匹配控制生成方法，无需微调、辅助网络或测试时搜索，通过调整参考集即可实现控制。
AI.motivation: 现有的可控生成方法通常依赖微调、辅助网络或测试时搜索，流程复杂且成本高。作者希望探索流匹配模型是否存在更简洁的控制接口。
AI.method: 基于流匹配的理论分析，发现对于确定性插值，速度场仅由条件端点均值决定。据此提出两种方法：1）Reference-Mean Guidance，无需训练，通过参考库计算端点均值校正并应用于冻结的FLUX.2-klein模型；2）Semi-Parametric Guidance，通过显式均值锚点和学习的残差精化器来摊销该思想。
AI.result: Reference-Mean Guidance在保持提示、种子和权重固定的情况下，成功实现了对颜色、身份、风格和结构的控制；Semi-Parametric Guidance在AFHQv2上匹配了无条件DiT-B/4的质量，且允许在推理时替换参考集。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明生成模型可以通过数据而非参数更新来进行适应，揭示了通过参考集控制生成这一更广泛的研究方向。

title: Signature Approach for Contextual Bandits with Nonlinear and Path-dependent Rewards
summary: We study contextual bandits with nonlinear and path-dependent rewards through a novel signature-transform-based approach. Leveraging the universal nonlinearity property of signatures, we approximate continuous path-dependent reward functionals by linear functionals in the signature space. This representation enables the use of efficient linear contextual bandit methods while preserving expressive sequential structure. Building on this framework, we propose \texttt{DisSigUCB}, a signature-based disjoint upper confidence bound (UCB) algorithm. Under boundedness and non-degeneracy assumptions, we prove a high-probability data-dependent sublinear regret bound of order \(\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{(d+m)KT})\) where \(d\) is the context dimension and \(m\) is the signature feature dimension. Synthetic experiments and numerical applications on temperature sensor monitoring, sleep-stage classification, and hospital nurse staffing demonstrate that \texttt{DisSigUCB} consistently outperforms classical linear and kernelized contextual bandit baselines in nonlinear and path-dependent settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于签名变换（signature-transform）的方法来解决具有非线性和路径依赖奖励的上下文赌博机问题，并提出了DisSigUCB算法，在理论和实验上均优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的上下文赌博机算法通常假设奖励是线性的或仅依赖当前上下文，但在实际应用中（如医疗、监控等领域），奖励往往具有非线性且依赖历史路径的复杂特性。如何有效处理这类具有序列结构和路径依赖性的奖励函数是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 利用签名变换的通用非线性性质，将连续的路径依赖奖励泛函近似为签名空间中的线性泛函。这种表示方法保留了序列结构的表达能力，同时能够使用高效的线性上下文赌博机方法。在此基础上，提出了基于签名的分离上置信界（UCB）算法——DisSigUCB。
AI.result: 在有界性和非退化假设下，证明了DisSigUCB具有高概率数据相关的次线性遗憾界，其阶为 \(\tilde{\mathcal O}(\sqrt{(d+m)KT})\)，其中d为上下文维度，m为签名特征维度。在合成实验以及温度传感器监控、睡眠分期分类和医院护士配置等实际应用中，DisSigUCB在非线性和路径依赖场景下均持续优于经典线性和核化上下文赌博机基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 签名变换方法为处理非线性路径依赖的上下文赌博机问题提供了有效的理论框架和实践工具，DisSigUCB算法在理论遗憾界和实际应用性能上均展现出显著优势。

title: Active Tabular Augmentation via Policy-Guided Diffusion Inpainting
summary: Generative tabular augmentation is appealing in data-scarce domains, yet the prevailing focus on distributional fidelity does not reliably translate into better downstream models. We formalize a fidelity-utility gap: common generative objectives prioritize distributional plausibility, whereas augmentation succeeds only when injected samples reduce the current learner's held-out evaluation loss. This gap motivates learning not just how to generate, but what to generate and when to inject as training evolves. We propose TAP (Tabular Augmentation Policy), which couples diffusion inpainting with a lightweight, learner-conditioned policy to steer generation toward high-utility regions and controls safe injection via explicit gating and conservative windowed commitment. Under severe data scarcity, TAP consistently outperforms strong generative baselines on seven real-world datasets, improving classification accuracy by up to 15.6 percentage points and reducing regression RMSE by up to 32%.

AI.tldr: 本文针对生成式表格数据增强中“分布保真度”与“下游模型效用”不匹配的问题，提出TAP框架，通过扩散修复与轻量级策略网络协同，在严重数据稀缺场景下显著提升了分类与回归任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式表格数据增强方法主要关注生成数据的分布保真度（distributional fidelity），但这并不能可靠地转化为下游模型性能的提升。作者形式化了一个“保真度-效用差距”（fidelity-utility gap）：生成目标优先考虑分布合理性，而增强成功的关键在于注入的样本能否降低当前学习器在留出集上的评估损失。这一差距促使研究者不仅需要学习如何生成，还需要学习生成什么内容以及何时注入训练过程。
AI.method: 提出TAP（Tabular Augmentation Policy）框架，该框架将扩散修复（diffusion inpainting）与轻量级的、以学习器为条件的策略网络相结合。该策略网络引导生成过程朝向高效用区域，并通过显式门控机制（explicit gating）和保守的窗口提交机制（conservative windowed commitment）来控制安全注入，从而实现生成内容与注入时机的动态优化。
AI.result: 在严重数据稀缺条件下，TAP在七个真实世界数据集上持续优于强力的生成式基线方法。实验结果表明，TAP将分类准确率提升了高达15.6个百分点，并将回归任务的RMSE降低了高达32%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，单纯追求生成数据的分布保真度不足以保证下游任务性能的提升。通过显式地建模保真度与效用之间的差距，并利用策略网络引导生成与注入过程，TAP框架成功地在数据稀缺场景下实现了显著的性能增益，为生成式数据增强提供了新的有效范式。

title: Relations Are Channels: Knowledge Graph Embedding via Kraus Decompositions
summary: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models typically represent each relation as an operator on entity embeddings. In this work, we identify three structural axioms that any principled relation operator must satisfy, linearity, trace preservation, and complete positivity, and show that they characterize a Kraus channel structure via the Kraus representation theorem. The completeness constraint defining this family is equivalent to these axioms, providing a principled foundation rather than an externally imposed condition. Under this formulation, most existing operator-based KGE models are recoverable as special cases with Kraus rank $κ= 1$ under specific embedding choices. We further generalize this characterization to arbitrary metric geometries by introducing \mbox{w-Kraus} channels, which satisfy completeness by construction within their respective spaces. Building on this theory, we propose \textsc{KrausKGE}, a principled KGE model that naturally handles $1$-to-$N$ and $N$-to-$N$ relations, supports $k$-hop reasoning without requiring explicit path encoders, and eliminates the need for norm constraints on entity embeddings. Additionally, our framework yields the first theoretically grounded per-relation complexity measure in the KGE literature, with a provable lower bound in terms of the empirical relation matrix rank. Empirical evaluation demonstrates that \textsc{KrausKGE} consistently outperforms strong baselines on $N$-to-$N$ relations, with performance gains that increase monotonically with relation fan-out, in alignment with theoretical predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文从量子力学Kraus表示定理出发，为KGE关系算子建立了公理化基础（线性、保迹、完全正定性），提出KrausKGE模型，在处理多对多关系时显著优于现有方法，并首次给出了理论支撑的关系复杂度度量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于算子的知识图谱嵌入(KGE)模型缺乏统一的理论基础，关系算子的设计往往依赖经验选择。本文旨在为关系算子建立公理化的理论基础，确定其必须满足的基本性质，从而为模型设计提供原则性指导。
AI.method: 识别了关系算子必须满足的三条结构公理：线性、保迹性和完全正定性，通过Kraus表示定理证明这些公理刻画了Kraus信道结构。在此基础上提出KrausKGE模型，将现有大多数算子类KGE模型作为其特例（Kraus秩κ=1时），并推广至任意度量几何空间（w-Kraus信道）。
AI.result: KrausKGE模型能够自然处理1-to-N和N-to-N关系，支持无需显式路径编码器的k跳推理，且无需对实体嵌入施加范数约束。框架给出了首个理论支撑的逐关系复杂度度量。实验表明，模型在N-to-N关系上持续优于强基线，性能增益随关系扇出单调增加，与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功建立了KGE关系算子的公理化理论基础，提出的KrausKGE模型不仅在理论上具有完备性，在实践上也展现出优越性能，特别是在处理复杂多对多关系时。该工作为知识图谱嵌入领域提供了新的理论视角和方法论框架。

title: PowerStep: Memory-Efficient Adaptive Optimization via $\ell_p$-Norm Steepest Descent
summary: Adaptive optimizers, most notably Adam, have become the default standard for training large-scale neural networks such as Transformers. These methods maintain running estimates of gradient first and second moments, incurring substantial memory overhead. We introduce PowerStep, a memory-efficient optimizer that achieves coordinate-wise adaptivity without storing second-moment statistics. Motivated by steepest descent under an $\ell_p$-norm geometry, we show that applying a nonlinear transform directly to a momentum buffer yields coordinate-wise adaptivity. We prove that PowerStep converges at the optimal $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ rate for non-convex stochastic optimization. Extensive experiments on Transformer models ranging from 124M to 235B parameters demonstrate that PowerStep matches Adam's convergence speed while halving optimizer memory. Furthermore, when combined with aggressive \texttt{int8} quantization, PowerStep remains numerically stable and reduces optimizer memory by $\sim\!8\times$ compared to full-precision Adam. PowerStep thus provides a principled, scalable and resource-efficient alternative for large-scale training. Code is available at https://github.com/yaolubrain/PowerStep.

AI.tldr: 提出了PowerStep，一种内存高效的优化器，通过对动量缓冲区应用非线性变换实现坐标级自适应，在保持Adam收敛速度的同时将优化器内存减半，结合int8量化可实现约8倍内存节省。
AI.motivation: 自适应优化器（如Adam）在训练大规模神经网络时需要维护梯度一阶和二阶矩的运行估计，导致显著的内存开销。现有的内存效率与自适应学习能力之间存在权衡，需要一种既能实现坐标级自适应又无需存储二阶矩统计量的方法。
AI.method: 基于$\ell_p$-范数几何下的最速下降法，PowerStep直接对动量缓冲区应用非线性变换，从而实现坐标级自适应，避免了存储二阶矩统计量的需求。作者证明了该方法在非凸随机优化中具有最优的$O(1/\sqrt{T})$收敛率。
AI.result: 在124M到235B参数的Transformer模型上的广泛实验表明：PowerStep匹配Adam的收敛速度，同时将优化器内存减半；结合int8量化时，PowerStep保持数值稳定，相比全精度Adam减少约8倍优化器内存。
AI.conclusion: PowerStep为大规模训练提供了一个有原则的、可扩展且资源高效的Adam替代方案，在保持性能的同时显著降低了内存需求，证明了无需二阶矩统计也能实现有效的坐标级自适应优化。

title: Foundations of Reliable Inference: Reliability-Efficiency Co-Design
summary: Reliable inference requires that artificial intelligence (AI) models provide trustworthy uncertainty estimates, not merely accurate predictions. Recent advances in Bayesian learning have made significant progress toward this goal, and growing concerns about computational overhead have jointly shifted the design criterion from reliability alone to the co-design of reliability and efficiency, i.e., reducing computational overhead while preserving trustworthy uncertainty quantification. This thesis develops a unified framework from two perspectives to address the central question: can we efficiently perform reliable inference?

AI.tldr: 本论文提出统一框架，解决AI模型在保证可靠不确定性量化的同时降低计算开销的核心问题，实现可靠性与效率的协同设计。
AI.motivation: 可靠推断要求AI模型提供可信的不确定性估计而非仅追求预测准确性。贝叶斯学习虽有进展，但计算开销成为关键瓶颈，促使研究范式从单一可靠性转向可靠性与效率的协同设计。
AI.method: 从两个视角构建统一框架：一方面开发高效的贝叶斯推断方法以降低计算成本，另一方面设计保持可信不确定性量化的模型架构与训练策略，实现可靠性与效率的联合优化。
AI.result: 成功构建了协同设计可靠性与效率的理论框架，为降低计算开销同时保证不确定性估计的可信度提供了系统性解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 高效可靠推断是可行的。通过统一框架的协同设计方法，能够在保持可信不确定性量化的前提下显著降低计算开销，为实用AI系统的部署提供了理论指导与技术路径。

title: DeepLévy: Learning Heavy-Tailed Uncertainty in Highly Volatile Time Series
summary: Modeling uncertainty in heavy-tailed time series remains a critical challenge for deep probabilistic forecasting models, which often struggle to capture abrupt, extreme events. While Lévy stable distributions offer a natural framework for modeling such non-Gaussian behaviors, the intractability of their probability density functions severely limits conventional likelihood-based inference. To address this, we introduce DeepLévy, a neural framework that learns mixtures of Lévy stable distributions by minimizing the discrepancy between empirical and parametric characteristic functions. DeepLévy incorporates a mixture mechanism that adaptively learns context-dependent weights and parameters over multiple Lévy components, enabling flexible multi-horizon uncertainty modeling. Evaluations on both real and synthetic datasets demonstrate that DeepLévy outperforms state-of-the-art deep probabilistic forecasting approaches in tail risk metrics, especially under extreme volatility.

AI.tldr: 提出了DeepLévy，一个通过最小化经验与参数化特征函数差异来学习Lévy稳定分布混合的神经框架，有效解决了重尾时间序列预测中的极端事件建模难题。
AI.motivation: 深度概率预测模型在处理重尾时间序列时，难以捕捉突发的极端事件。虽然Lévy稳定分布为此类非高斯行为提供了理论框架，但其概率密度函数的不可解析性限制了传统的基于似然的推断方法。
AI.method: 引入DeepLévy神经框架，通过最小化经验特征函数与参数化特征函数之间的差异来学习Lévy稳定分布的混合。该框架包含一种混合机制，能够自适应地学习多个Lévy成分的上下文相关权重和参数，从而实现灵活的多视野不确定性建模。
AI.result: 在真实和合成数据集上的评估表明，DeepLévy在尾部风险指标上优于最先进的深度概率预测方法，特别是在极端波动的情况下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: DeepLévy成功克服了Lévy稳定分布推断的难题，为重尾时间序列的不确定性建模提供了更有效的解决方案，显著提升了对极端事件的预测能力。

title: The Polynomial Counting Capabilities of Message Passing Neural Networks
summary: The counting power of Message Passing Neural Networks (MPNN) has been the subject of many recent papers, showing that they can express logic that involves counting up to a threshold or more generally satisfy a linear arithmetic constraint. In this paper, we study the counting capabilities of MPNN beyond linear arithmetic, primarily utilising local and global mean aggregations. In particular, our goal is to tease out conditions required to express extensions of graded modal logic with polynomial counting constraints. We show that global polynomial counting constraints in node-labelled graphs can be checked using mean MPNN under mild assumptions. Checking local constraints is also possible, if we consider formulas with no nested modalities and additionally either (i) permit sum/max aggregations, or (ii) only restrict to regular graphs. We also show how formulas with nested modalities can be captured by mean MPNN over graphs with tree-like structures and similar assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了消息传递神经网络（MPNN）超越线性算术的计数能力，证明了在温和假设下，基于均值聚合的MPNN可以表达具有多项式计数约束的扩展分级模态逻辑。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注MPNN在线性算术约束下的计数能力，但对超越线性算术的计数能力（特别是多项式计数约束）的研究尚不充分。本文旨在填补这一空白，探究MPNN表达扩展分级模态逻辑中多项式计数约束的条件。
AI.method: 主要利用局部和全局均值聚合方法，研究MPNN在节点标记图上检查多项式计数约束的能力。分别针对全局约束、局部约束（无嵌套模态公式）以及嵌套模态公式情况进行分析，并结合求和/最大聚合或正则图等条件。
AI.result: 证明了在温和假设下，均值MPNN可以检查节点标记图中的全局多项式计数约束；对于局部约束，在无嵌套模态且允许求和/最大聚合或仅限于正则图时也可以检查；对于嵌套模态公式，在树状结构图上可以通过均值MPNN捕获。
AI.conclusion: MPNN的计数能力可以扩展到多项式计数约束，为理解图神经网络的逻辑表达能力提供了新的理论视角，同时也揭示了不同聚合方式和图结构对表达能力的影响。

title: Real vs. Semi-Simulated: Rethinking Evaluation for Treatment Effect Estimation
summary: Estimating heterogeneous treatment effects with machine learning has attracted substantial attention in both academic research and industrial practice. However, the two communities often evaluate models under markedly different conditions. Methodological work typically relies on semi-simulated benchmarks and metrics that require counterfactual outcomes, whereas real-world applications rely on observable metrics based on ranking or test outcomes. Despite the well-known gap between methodological progress and practical deployment, the relationship between these evaluation regimes has not been examined systematically. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of treatment effect evaluation across standard semi-simulated benchmark families and real-world datasets. Our benchmark covers meta-learners paired with multiple base learners, as well as specialized causal machine learning models. We evaluate these methods using observable metrics common in application-oriented literature, alongside counterfactual metrics commonly used in methods papers. Our results reveal two complementary gaps. First, counterfactual metrics do not reliably recover the estimators preferred by observable metrics, even on the same semi-simulated benchmarks. Second, rankings obtained on semi-simulated benchmarks do not transfer to real datasets. We further find that simple meta-learners with strong base models are consistently competitive, in contrast to specialized causal models. Overall, our findings suggest that progress in treatment effect estimation research should not be assessed solely through counterfactual metrics and semi-simulated benchmarks, but it would benefit from incorporating observable metrics and real-data validation.

AI.tldr: 研究发现因果推断模型评估中存在“双重鸿沟”：基于反事实指标的半仿真基准测试结果无法可靠反映基于可观测指标的真实数据表现，且简单的元学习器配合强基模型往往优于复杂的专用因果模型。
AI.motivation: 学术界和工业界在评估异质性处理效应估计模型时存在明显分歧：方法学研究依赖需要反事实结果的半仿真基准，而实际应用依赖可观测的排序或测试指标。尽管已知方法进步与实际部署之间存在差距，但两种评估体系之间的关系尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 进行大规模实证研究，覆盖标准半仿真基准族和真实世界数据集。评估对象包括配对多种基学习器的元学习器以及专用因果机器学习模型。评估指标同时包含应用导向文献中常见的可观测指标和方法论文中常用的反事实指标。
AI.result: 揭示了两个互补的差距：首先，即使在相同的半仿真基准上，反事实指标不能可靠地恢复由可观测指标优选出的估计器；其次，在半仿真基准上获得的排名不能迁移到真实数据集。此外，带有强基模型的简单元学习器始终保持竞争力，胜过专用因果模型。
AI.conclusion: 处理效应估计研究的进展不应仅通过反事实指标和半仿真基准来评估，而应从纳入可观测指标和真实数据验证中受益，以弥合方法论进步与实际部署之间的差距。

title: Causal Explanations from the Geometric Properties of ReLU Neural Networks
comment: 7 pages, 0 figures, Accepted for presentation at the Yorkshire Innovation in Science and Engineering Conference
summary: Neural networks have proved an effective means of learning control policies for autonomous systems, but these learned policies are difficult to understand due to the black-box nature of neural networks. This lack of interpretability makes safety assurance for such autonomous systems challenging. The fields of eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) and eXplainable Reinforcement Learning (XRL) aim to interpret the decision making processes of neural networks and autonomous agents, respectively. In particular, work on causal explanations aims to provide "why" and "why not" explanations for why a model made a given decision. However, most of the work on explainability to date utilises a distilled version of the original model. While this distilled policy is interpretable, it necessarily degrades in performance significantly when compared to the original model, and is not guaranteed to be an accurate reflection of the decision making processes in the original model and as such cannot be used to guarantee its safety. Recent work on understanding the geometry of ReLU neural networks shows that a ReLU network corresponds to a piecewise linear function divided into regions defined by an n-dimensional convex polytope. Through this lens, a neural network can be understood as dividing the input space into distinct regions which apply a single linear function for each output neuron. We show that this geometric representation can be used to generate causal explanations for the network's behaviour similar to previous work, but which extracts rules directly from the geometry of Neural Networks with the ReLU activation function, and is therefore an accurate reflection of the network's behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于ReLU神经网络几何结构的因果解释方法，可直接从网络几何中提取规则生成准确的行为解释，无需依赖性能下降的蒸馏模型。
AI.motivation: 神经网络在自主系统控制策略学习中表现优异，但其黑箱特性导致难以理解和安全验证。现有可解释AI方法多采用蒸馏模型，虽具可解释性但性能显著下降且不能准确反映原模型决策过程，无法用于安全保证。
AI.method: 利用ReLU神经网络几何表示理论，将网络理解为分段线性函数，由n维凸多面体定义的区域划分输入空间，每个区域对输出神经元应用单一线性函数。直接从ReLU神经网络几何结构中提取规则，生成因果解释（"为什么"和"为什么不"的解释）。
AI.result: 该方法能够生成与已有工作类似的因果解释，但直接从ReLU激活函数神经网络的几何结构提取规则，因此是对网络行为的准确反映，避免了蒸馏模型带来的性能下降和不准确性问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何视角理解ReLU神经网络，可以实现既保持解释准确性又不损失模型性能的可解释性方法，为神经网络控制策略的安全验证提供了更可靠的技术途径。

title: Valid Best-Model Identification for LLM Evaluation via Low-Rank Factorization
summary: Selecting the best large language model (LLM) for a fixed benchmark is often expensive, since exhaustive evaluation requires running every model on every example. Multi-armed bandit (MAB) algorithms can reduce the number of LLM calls by sequentially selecting the next model-example pair to evaluate, thereby avoiding wasted evaluations on clearly underperforming models. Further savings can be achieved by predicting model scores from the partially observed model-example score matrix using low-rank factorization. However, such predictions are not ground truth: they can be biased and may therefore lead to incorrect identification of the best model. In this work, we propose a principled framework that combines MAB with cheap predicted scores without compromising statistical validity. Specifically, we derive doubly robust estimators of each model's performance that use the low-rank predictions to reduce variance. This enables the construction of valid finite-sample confidence intervals in our setting, where models are selected adaptively and examples are sampled without replacement. Empirical results on real-world benchmarks show that our approach reduces the number of required evaluations, yielding meaningful savings in compute and cost while accurately identifying the best-performing model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合多臂老虎机（MAB）算法与低成本预测分数的原则性框架，通过双重稳健估计器在保持统计有效性的前提下减少LLM基准测试所需的评估次数。
AI.motivation: 在固定基准测试中选择最佳大语言模型（LLM）通常成本高昂，因为穷举评估需要在每个示例上运行每个模型。现有的多臂老虎机算法虽然可以减少LLM调用次数，但基于低秩分解的预测分数存在偏差，可能导致错误识别最佳模型。
AI.method: 提出一个原则性框架，将MAB算法与低成本预测分数相结合；推导双重稳健估计器，利用低秩预测来降低方差；在模型自适应选择和样本不放回抽样的设置下构建有效的有限样本置信区间。
AI.result: 在真实世界基准测试上的实证结果表明，该方法减少了所需评估次数，在计算和成本方面实现了显著节省，同时能够准确识别表现最佳的模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功地将预测分数整合到MAB算法中，在不牺牲统计有效性的前提下大幅降低了LLM基准测试的计算成本，为高效选择最佳模型提供了可靠解决方案。

title: Formally Verifying Analog Neural Networks Under Process Variations Using Polynomial Zonotopes
summary: Analog neural networks are gaining attention due to their efficiency in terms of power consumption and processing speed. However, since analog neural networks are implemented as physical circuits, they are highly sensitive to manufacturing process variations, which can cause large deviations from the nominal model. We present a polynomial-based model that resembles the performance of the neuron circuit under process variations. Then, we formally verify the behavior of the circuit-level model using reachability analysis with polynomial zonotopes, thus, avoiding conventional, time-consuming Monte Carlo simulations. We evaluate our proposed verification approach on three different datasets, verifying both fully-connected and convolutional analog neural networks. Our experimental results confirm the effectiveness of our verification approach by reducing the verification time from days to seconds while enclosing 99% of the variation samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多项式模型和可达性分析的方法，用于快速验证模拟神经网络电路在制造工艺偏差下的行为，将验证时间从数天缩短至秒级，同时覆盖99%的偏差样本。
AI.motivation: 模拟神经网络在功耗和处理速度方面具有优势，但作为物理电路实现时，对制造工艺偏差高度敏感，可能导致与标称模型的巨大偏差。现有的蒙特卡洛仿真验证方法耗时过长，亟需高效的验证手段。
AI.method: 首先构建一个多项式模型来模拟神经元电路在工艺偏差下的性能表现；随后利用多项式Zonotope进行可达性分析，形式化验证电路级行为，从而避免耗时的蒙特卡洛仿真。
AI.result: 在三个不同数据集上验证了全连接和卷积模拟神经网络，实验结果表明该方法将验证时间从数天缩短至秒级，并能包络99%的偏差样本。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的验证方法在保证高覆盖率的同时极大提升了验证效率，证明了其在模拟神经网络电路验证中的有效性和实用性。

title: Identified-Set Geometry of Distributional Model Extraction under Top-$K$ Censored API Access
summary: Modern LLM APIs often reveal only top-$K$ logit scores and censor the remaining vocabulary. We study the per-position distribution-recovery limits of this access model. For censoring threshold $τ$, the compatible teacher distributions form an identified set whose total-variation diameter is exactly $U_K=(V-K)\exp(τ)/(Z_A+(V-K)\exp(τ))$, where $Z_A$ is the observed partition function. For KL recovery, we give a computable binary-endpoint lower bound and an asymptotically matching small-ambiguity upper bound, with an extension to reference-aware attackers. Experiments on a Qwen3 math-reasoning teacher reveal a layered extraction hierarchy: on-task top-$K$ distillation recovers 12% of private capability, full-logit distillation recovers 56% despite 99% KL closure, and generation-based extraction recovers 96%. Top-$K$ censoring therefore limits per-position distribution recovery but does not by itself prevent capability extraction, separating fidelity from transfer in prompt-only logit distillation.

AI.tldr: 研究Top-K截断API的分布恢复极限，发现其限制位置分布恢复但不能完全阻止能力提取，揭示了保真度与迁移性之间的分离。
AI.motivation: 现代大语言模型API通常只暴露Top-K logit分数并屏蔽其余词表，作者旨在研究这种访问模型下每位置分布恢复的理论极限，以理解这种安全措施的实际防护效果。
AI.method: 提出理论框架分析截断阈值τ下的可识别集，推导总变差直径的精确公式U_K；给出KL恢复的可计算二元端点下界和渐近匹配的小歧义上界，并扩展到参考感知攻击者；在Qwen3数学推理教师模型上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 理论结果：可识别集的总变差直径为U_K=(V-K)exp(τ)/(Z_A+(V-K)exp(τ))；实验发现分层提取层级：任务上Top-K蒸馏恢复12%私有能力，全logit蒸馏恢复56%（尽管99% KL闭包），基于生成的提取恢复96%。
AI.conclusion: Top-K截断限制了每位置分布恢复，但其本身并不能阻止能力提取，在仅提示logit蒸馏中将保真度与迁移性分离开来，表明该安全措施的效果有限。

title: CMKL: Modality-Aware Continual Learning for Evolving Biomedical Knowledge Graphs
summary: Biomedical knowledge graphs are increasingly large, dynamic, and multimodal, driven by rapid advances in biotechnology such as high-throughput sequencing. Machine learning models can infer previously unobserved biomedical relationships and characterize biomedical entities in these graphs, but existing knowledge graph embedding methods and their continual learning extensions either assume static graph structure or fail to exploit multimodal information under evolving data distributions. They also apply uniform regularization across all model parameters, ignoring that different modalities may exhibit distinct forgetting dynamics as the graph evolves. We propose the Continual Multimodal Knowledge Graph Learner (CMKL), a CL framework for biomedical KGs that natively encodes structure, text, and molecules, fuses them through a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) router, and protects previously learned knowledge with standard EWC regularization and a K-means-diverse multimodal replay buffer. We evaluate CMKL on a 129K-entity biomedical continual benchmark with 10 tasks. On continual biomedical entity classification, CMKL reaches AP 0.591 versus 0.370 for the strongest structural baseline, a 60% gain that is driven by access to multimodal features and preserved across the sequence with near-zero forgetting (AF 0.008). On continual relationship prediction, CMKL reaches AP $0.062$, matching Naive Sequential and EWC (0.058) within seed noise and outperforming Joint Training (0.047, p=0.045) and LKGE (0.039). A frozen-text ablation reaches AP 0.136, more than double any jointly trained model, yet that signal is unreachable by margin-ranking gradients: the greedy-modality asymmetry lives at the representation level, not the fusion level, and MoE routing manages it by suppressing the unreachable modality without forcing it through a learned bottleneck. Code: github.com/yradwan147/cmkl-neurips2026

AI.tldr: 提出了CMKL框架，通过融合结构、文本和分子多模态信息并采用MoE路由和多样化回放缓冲区，有效解决了生物医学知识图谱持续学习中的多模态遗忘问题，在实体分类任务上相比最强基线提升60%。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱嵌入方法及其持续学习扩展要么假设静态图结构，要么无法在演化数据分布下利用多模态信息；同时，它们对所有模型参数应用统一正则化，忽略了不同模态在图演化过程中可能表现出不同的遗忘动态。
AI.method: 提出持续多模态知识图谱学习器（CMKL），原生编码结构、文本和分子信息，通过专家混合（MoE）路由器进行融合，并使用标准EWC正则化和K-means多样化多模态回放缓冲区保护已学知识。
AI.result: 在129K实体、10任务的生物医学持续基准上，CMKL在持续实体分类任务中达到AP 0.591（最强结构基线0.370，提升60%），遗忘率接近零（AF 0.008）；在持续关系预测任务中达到AP 0.062，与朴素序列和EWC匹配，优于联合训练和LKGE。冻结文本消融实验达到AP 0.136，发现模态不对称性位于表示层面而非融合层面。
AI.conclusion: CMKL成功实现了生物医学知识图谱的持续多模态学习，通过MoE路由有效管理模态间的不对称性，在不牺牲已有知识的情况下显著提升了性能，为动态演化的生物医学知识图谱应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: Equilibrium Residuals Expose Three Regimes of Matrix-Game Strategic Reasoning in Language Models
summary: Large language models can score well on named game-theory benchmarks while failing on the same strategic computation once semantic cues are removed. We show this gap with procedurally generated zero-sum matrix games: a model that recognizes familiar games drops to 34%, 18%, and 2% success on anonymous $2{\times}2$, $3{\times}3$, and $5{\times}5$ payoff matrices. The benchmark separates semantic recall, learned approximate Nash computation, and an output-interface bottleneck that limits scale. Training only on $2{\times}2$ and $3{\times}3$ games, supervised fine-tuning raises unseen $5{\times}5$--$7{\times}7$ success from 2% to 61%, while exploitability-reward training averages 37% with high seed variance. We prove that the exploitability residual is $2$-Lipschitz in payoff perturbations, unlike discontinuous vertex-returning LP equilibrium selectors, explaining why residual training can transfer under payoff shifts even when formatting instability limits mean performance. A dominated-action padding experiment provides causal evidence: trained models solve $3{\times}3$ games embedded in much larger matrices, while random-padded controls fail and dense $12{\times}12$ games remain near failure. Procedural evaluation is therefore necessary for measuring strategic reasoning, and residual rewards expose a real but format-limited route to approximate equilibrium computation.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型在博弈论基准测试中的表现依赖于语义线索而非真正的策略推理；通过过程性生成博弈评估揭示了真实能力差距，并提出可扩展的训练方法。
AI.motivation: 揭示大语言模型在博弈论基准测试中存在的“语义依赖”问题：模型在熟悉的博弈场景中表现良好，但在移除语义线索后的匿名支付矩阵中性能急剧下降，表明现有基准测试无法真实反映模型的策略推理能力。
AI.method: 1. 使用过程性生成的零和矩阵博弈进行评估，对比模型在有无语义线索情况下的表现；2. 提出监督微调(SFT)和可利用性奖励训练两种方法；3. 证明可利用性残差在支付扰动下具有2-Lipschitz连续性；4. 设计占优动作填充实验进行因果验证。
AI.result: 1. 在匿名支付矩阵上，模型成功率骤降至34%(2×2)、18%(3×3)、2%(5×5)；2. 监督微调将未见过的5×5-7×7博弈成功率从2%提升至61%；3. 可利用性奖励训练平均达到37%但方差较大；4. 训练后的模型能解决嵌入大矩阵中的3×3博弈，但在稠密12×12博弈上仍表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 过程性评估对于测量策略推理能力至关重要；可利用性残差训练提供了一条真实但受格式限制的近似均衡计算路径，揭示了LLMs在策略推理方面的真实能力与局限性。

title: HH-SAE: Discovering and Steering Hierarchical Knowledge of Complex Manifolds
summary: Rare semantic innovations in high-dimensional, mission-critical domains are often obscured by dense background contexts, a challenge we define as \textit{feature density conflict}. We introduce the \textbf{Hybrid Hierarchical SAE (HH-SAE)} to resolve this by factorizing manifolds into a nested hierarchy of \textbf{Contextual} ($L_0$), \textbf{Atomic} ($f_1$), and \textbf{Compository} ($f_2$) tiers. Evaluating across disparate manifolds, HH-SAE demonstrates superior resolution by \textbf{``fracturing'' administrative clinical labels into physiological modes} and achieving a peak \textbf{cross-domain zero-shot AUC of 0.9156 in fraud detection}. Path ablation confirms the architecture's structural necessity, revealing a 13.46\% utility collapse when contextual subtraction is removed. Finally, knowledge-steered synthesis achieves a +9.9\% AUPRC lift over state-of-the-art generators, proving that HH-SAE effectively prioritizes high-order mechanistic innovation over environmental proxies to enable high-precision discovery in high-stakes environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合分层稀疏自编码器（HH-SAE），通过三层架构解决高维关键任务领域中稀有语义创新被密集背景遮蔽的问题，在欺诈检测中实现0.9156的跨域零样本AUC，知识引导合成相比SOTA提升9.9% AUPRC。
AI.motivation: 在高维、任务关键的领域（如临床诊断、欺诈检测）中，稀有但具有重要价值的语义创新往往被密集的背景上下文所遮蔽，作者将此挑战定义为"特征密度冲突"（feature density conflict）。现有方法难以有效分离和识别这些被遮蔽的关键特征。
AI.method: 提出混合分层稀疏自编码器（HH-SAE），将流形分解为嵌套的三层层级结构：上下文层（Contextual, $L_0$）、原子层（Atomic, $f_1$）和组合层（Compository, $f_2$）。通过这种分层架构实现从宏观上下文到微观原子特征再到宏观组合特征的层次化解耦。
AI.result: HH-SAE在多个不同流形上展现出优越性能：（1）成功将行政临床标签"裂解"为生理模式，实现更精细的特征解析；（2）在欺诈检测任务中达到0.9156的跨域零样本AUC峰值；（3）路径消融实验证实架构的必要性，移除上下文减法后效用下降13.46%；（4）知识引导合成相比最先进生成器提升9.9% AUPRC。
AI.conclusion: HH-SAE通过分层架构有效解决了特征密度冲突问题，能够优先识别高阶机制性创新而非环境代理特征，为高风险环境中的高精度发现提供了有效工具，证明了该方法在高风险决策场景中的实用价值。

title: Remember to Forget: Gated Adaptive Positional Encoding
summary: Rotary Positional Encoding (RoPE) is widely used in modern large language models. However, when sequences are extended beyond the range seen during training, rotary phases can enter out-of-distribution regimes, leading to spurious long-range alignments, diffuse attention, and degraded retrieval. Existing remedies only partially address these failures, as they often trade local positional resolution for long-context stability. We propose GAPE (Gated Adaptive Positional Encoding), a drop-in augmentation for positional encodings that introduces a content-aware bias directly into the attention logits while preserving the rotary geometry. GAPE decouples distance-based suppression from token importance through a query-dependent gate that contracts irrelevant context and a key-dependent gate that preserves salient distant tokens. We prove that protected tokens remain accessible, while the attention mass assigned to unprotected distant tokens decays as a function of the query gate. We further show that GAPE can be implemented within standard scaled dot-product attention. We validate these properties empirically, finding that GAPE consistently yields sharper attention and improved long-context robustness over rotary baselines across both synthetic retrieval and long-context benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GAPE（门控自适应位置编码），一种即插即用的位置编码增强方法，通过内容感知的门控机制解决RoPE在长序列外推时的注意力分散和性能退化问题。
AI.motivation: 旋转位置编码（RoPE）在现代大语言模型中被广泛使用，但当序列长度超过训练时的范围时，旋转相位会进入分布外区域，导致虚假的长距离对齐、注意力分散和检索能力下降。现有的解决方案往往需要在局部位置分辨率和长上下文稳定性之间进行权衡，只能部分解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出GAPE（门控自适应位置编码），通过在注意力逻辑中引入内容感知的偏置来增强位置编码，同时保留旋转几何结构。GAPE包含两个核心组件：(1) 查询相关的门控，用于收缩无关上下文；(2) 键相关的门控，用于保留重要的远距离标记。该方法可以在标准的缩放点积注意力框架内实现，无需大幅修改现有架构。
AI.result: 理论上证明了受保护的标记保持可访问性，而分配给未受保护的远距离标记的注意力权重会随查询门控衰减。在合成检索任务和长上下文基准测试上的实验表明，GAPE能够持续产生更锐利的注意力分布，相比旋转基线在长上下文鲁棒性方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: GAPE成功地将基于距离的抑制与标记重要性解耦，在不牺牲局部位置分辨率的前提下，显著提升了RoPE在长上下文场景下的稳定性和检索能力，是一种有效的即插即用解决方案。

title: Fairness vs Performance: Characterizing the Pareto Frontier of Algorithmic Decision Systems
comment: 23 pages, The 2026 ACM conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT'26)
summary:
Designing fair algorithmic decision systems requires balancing model performance with fairness toward affected individuals: More fairness might require sacrificing some performance and vice versa, yet the space of possible trade-offs is still poorly understood. We investigate fairness in binary prediction-based decision problems by conceptualizing decision making as a multi-objective optimization problem that simultaneously considers decision-maker utility and group fairness. We investigate the set of Pareto-optimal decision rules for arbitrary utility functions for decision maker, arbitrary population distributions, and a wide range of group fairness metrics.
  We find that the Pareto frontier consists of deterministic, group-specific threshold rules applied to individuals' success probability. This complements existing optimality theorems from literature which, for specific fairness constraints, posit lower-bound threshold rules only. However we also show that, depending on the used fairness metric, the Pareto frontier may include upper-bound threshold rules, thus preferring individuals with lower success probabilities. We show that the location of the Pareto frontier depends only on population characteristics, utility functions and fairness score, but not on the technical design of the algorithm - our findings hold for pre-, in-, and post-processing approaches alike.
  Our results generalize existing optimality theorems for fairness-constrained classification and extend them to generalized fairness metrics and fairness principles, and to partial fairness regimes. This paper connects formal fairness research with legal and ethical requirements to search for less discriminatory alternatives, offering a principled foundation for evaluating and comparing algorithmic decision systems.

AI.tldr: 本文将公平性决策问题建模为多目标优化，发现帕累托最优前沿由基于个体成功概率的确定性分组阈值规则构成，可能包含上限阈值规则；最优性仅取决于群体特征、效用函数和公平性度量，与算法技术设计无关。
AI.motivation: 设计公平的算法决策系统需要在模型性能与公平性之间权衡，但现有研究对可能的权衡空间理解不足。为了深入理解公平性与决策效用之间的权衡关系，并为评估和比较算法决策系统提供理论基础。
AI.method: 将二元预测决策问题概念化为多目标优化问题，同时考虑决策者的效用和群体公平性。研究在任意效用函数、任意群体分布和广泛的群体公平性度量下，帕累托最优决策规则集的构成及其性质。
AI.result: 帕累托前沿由应用于个体成功概率的确定性分组特定阈值规则组成；根据公平性度量不同，可能包含上限阈值规则（偏好成功概率较低的个体）。帕累托前沿的位置仅取决于群体特征、效用函数和公平性分数，而与算法的技术设计（前处理、中处理、后处理方法）无关。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果推广了现有的公平性约束分类最优性定理，并将其扩展到广义公平性度量和公平原则及部分公平机制。这为形式化的公平性研究与法律伦理要求之间的连接提供了基础，为寻找较少歧视性的替代方案、评估和比较算法决策系统提供了原则性依据。

title: A Recursive Decomposition Framework for Causal Structure Learning in the Presence of Latent Variables
summary: Constraint-based causal discovery is widely used for learning causal structures, but heavy reliance on conditional independence (CI) testing makes it computationally expensive in high-dimensional settings. To mitigate this limitation, many divide-and-conquer frameworks have been proposed, but most assume causal sufficiency, i.e., no latent variables. In this paper, we show that divide-and-conquer strategies can be theoretically generalized beyond causal sufficiency to settings with latent variables. Specifically, we propose a recursive decomposition framework, termed DiCoLa, that enables divide-and-conquer causal discovery in the presence of latent variables. It recursively decomposes the global learning task into smaller subproblems and integrates their solutions through a principled reconstruction step to recover the global structure. We theoretically establish the soundness and completeness of the proposed framework. Extensive experiments on synthetic data demonstrate that our approach significantly improves computational efficiency across a range of causal discovery algorithms, while experiments on a real-world dataset further illustrate its practical effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DiCoLa框架，首次将分治策略推广至存在潜在变量的因果发现场景，通过递归分解和重构实现了计算效率的显著提升，并证明了其理论正确性。
AI.motivation: 基于约束的因果发现方法在处理高维数据时计算开销巨大，其根源在于对条件独立性（CI）检验的高度依赖。虽然现有的分治框架可以缓解此问题，但它们大多假设因果充分性（即不存在潜在变量），这一强假设限制了其在复杂场景下的应用。
AI.method: 提出了递归分解框架DiCoLa。该方法将全局因果结构学习任务递归地分解为更小的子问题，通过原则性的重构步骤整合子问题的解以恢复全局结构，从而实现了在存在潜在变量情况下的分治因果发现。
AI.result: 理论证明了该框架的可靠性和完备性。在合成数据上的大量实验表明，该方法在多种因果发现算法上显著提高了计算效率；真实数据集上的实验进一步验证了其实际有效性。
AI.conclusion: 分治策略可以在理论上突破因果充分性假设的限制，成功推广至存在潜在变量的设定中，DiCoLa框架为解决高维因果发现中的计算瓶颈提供了一种高效且理论上可靠的新方案。

title: Beyond Spatial Compression: Interface-Centric Generative States for Open-World 3D Structure
summary: Current 3D tokenizers largely treat representation as spatial compression: compact codes reconstruct surface geometry, but leave component ownership and attachment validity implicit. In open-world assets with intersecting components, noisy topology, and weak canonical structure, this creates a representation mismatch: local shape, component identity, and assembly relations become entangled in a latent stream and are not natively addressable during decoding. We formulate an alternative view, interface-centric generative states, in which tokenization constructs an operational state rather than a passive compressed code. The state exposes local geometry, component ownership, and attachment validity as variables that can be queried, constrained, and repaired during decoding. We instantiate this formulation with Component-Conditioned Canonical Local Tokens (C2LT-3D), factorizing representation into canonical local geometry, partition-conditioned context, and relational seam variables. Each factor targets a distinct failure mode of compression-centric tokens: pose leakage, cross-component interference, or invalid local attachment. This exposed state supports attachment validation, latent structural repair, targeted intervention, and constrained serialization without a separate post-hoc structure recovery module. Trained on single-object CAD models and evaluated zero-shot on open-world multi-component assets, C2LT-3D improves structural robustness and shows that its latent variables remain actionable under adversarial attachment settings. These results suggest that open-world 3D generative representations should be evaluated not only by reconstruction fidelity, but by whether their discrete states remain operational for assembly-level structural reasoning.

title: Active Learning for Gaussian Process Regression Under Self-Induced Boltzmann Weights
summary:
We consider the active learning problem where the goal is to learn an unknown function with low prediction error under an unknown Boltzmann distribution induced by the function itself. This self-induced weighting arises naturally in problems such as potential energy surface (PES) modeling in computational chemistry,
  yet poses unique challenges as the target distribution is unknown and its partition function is intractable. We propose \texttt{AB-SID-iVAR}, a Gaussian Process-based acquisition function that approximates the intractable Bayesian target distribution in closed form while avoiding partition function estimation, and is applicable to both discrete and continuous input domains. We also analyze a Thompson sampling alternative (\texttt{TS-SID-iVAR}) as a higher variance Monte Carlo variant. Despite the unknown target, under mild conditions, we establish that the terminal prediction error vanishes with high probability, and provide a tighter average-case guarantee. We demonstrate consistent improvements over existing approaches in this setting on synthetic benchmarks and real-world PES modeling and drug discovery tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AB-SID-iVAR和TS-SID-iVAR两种主动学习方法，用于解决目标分布未知且配分函数难以处理的贝叶斯主动学习问题，在势能面建模和药物发现等任务上表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的主动学习研究多假设目标分布已知或易于处理，但在计算化学中的势能面（PES）建模等问题中，目标分布是由未知函数诱导的玻尔兹曼分布，其配分函数难以计算（intractable）。这种自诱导加权特性使得传统方法无法直接应用，亟需开发能够处理未知目标分布且无需估计配分函数的新方法。
AI.method: 提出了基于高斯过程的采集函数AB-SID-iVAR，该方法能够以闭式形式近似难以处理的贝叶斯目标分布，同时避免了配分函数估计问题，适用于离散和连续输入域。此外，还提出了Thompson采样变体TS-SID-iVAR作为高方差的蒙特卡洛替代方案。
AI.result: 在温和条件下证明了终端预测误差以高概率收敛至零，并提供了更紧的平均情况保证。在合成基准测试、真实世界的势能面建模和药物发现任务上，相比现有方法展现出一致的改进效果。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功解决了未知目标分布下的主动学习问题，所提方法无需估计配分函数即可有效近似目标分布，理论与实践均验证了方法的有效性，为计算化学等领域的函数学习问题提供了新的解决方案。

title: Don't Fix the Basis -- Learn It: Spectral Representation with Adaptive Basis Learning for PDEs
summary: Spectral neural operators achieve strong performance for PDE learning, but rely on fixed global bases that limit their ability to represent spatially heterogeneous and multiscale dynamics. We propose Adaptive Basis Learning (ABLE), a framework that learns data-dependent spectral representations instead of relying on predefined bases. ABLE constructs a spatially adaptive Parseval frame via a learned ancillary density, enabling the operator to act in a lifted spectral space while preserving invertibility and maintaining $O(N\log N)$ complexity through FFT-based implementation. This shifts the source of expressivity from spectral coefficients to the representation itself, allowing the model to capture localized structures and non-translation-invariant interactions more efficiently. ABLE integrates seamlessly into existing neural operator architectures as a drop-in replacement for spectral layers. Across a range of benchmarks ABLE improves accuracy over strong baselines, with the largest gains in regimes characterized by sharp gradients and multiscale behavior. Moreover, augmenting existing models (e.g., U-FNO, HPM) with ABLE further enhances their performance, demonstrating its role as a general and complementary spectral refinement. Our results highlight that the data-driven choice of representation, rather than operator complexity alone, is a key bottleneck in neural operator design. By learning the basis itself, ABLE provides a principled and efficient framework for improving spectral methods in PDE learning.

AI.tldr: 提出ABLE框架，通过学习数据依赖的自适应谱基替代固定全局基，有效提升了神经算子在处理空间异质性和多尺度PDE问题上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的谱神经算子依赖固定的全局基（如傅里叶基），这限制了它们表示空间异质性和多尺度动力学的能力，难以有效捕捉局部结构和平移非不变相互作用。
AI.method: 提出自适应基学习（ABLE）框架，通过学习辅助密度构建空间自适应Parseval框架，在提升的谱空间中操作，并通过基于FFT的实现保持O(N log N)复杂度和可逆性。该方法可作为现有神经算子架构中谱层的直接替代。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，ABLE相比强基线模型提升了精度，在具有尖锐梯度和多尺度特征的情况下提升最大。将其集成到U-FNO、HPM等现有模型中能进一步增强性能。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的表示选择，而非算子复杂度本身，是神经算子设计的关键瓶颈。通过学习基本身，ABLE为改进PDE学习中的谱方法提供了原则性且高效的框架。

title: Step Rejection Fine-Tuning: A Practical Distillation Recipe
summary: Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT) is a standard method for training LLM agents, where unsuccessful trajectories are discarded from the training set. In the context of SWE-bench tasks, this corresponds to filtering out runs where the submitted patch does not pass the tests. However, this approach discards unresolved trajectories, even though they form a large portion of all trajectories for hard tasks and even then may be partially correct. In this work, we propose Step Rejection Fine-Tuning (SRFT) - a practical way to leverage these unresolved trajectories. For this, we employ a critic LLM to assess the correctness of each step in a trajectory. Consequently, during training, we mask the loss for erroneous steps while retaining them in the context window. This way we ensure the model learns to recover from errors without reproducing them. Evaluation on SWE-bench Verified shows that while RFT improves the resolution rate by 2.4% by excluding unresolved trajectories, SRFT improves it by 3.7% by filtering them instead of discarding completely, reaching the total resolution rate of 32.2%.

AI.tldr: 提出Step Rejection Fine-Tuning (SRFT)方法，通过保留未解决轨迹并掩盖错误步骤的损失，在SWE-bench Verified上将解决率提升至32.2%，优于标准RFT方法。
AI.motivation: 标准Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT)方法在训练LLA代理时会丢弃未成功的轨迹，这在SWE-bench任务中对应于过滤掉未通过测试的提交。然而，这种方法丢弃了未解决的轨迹，尽管它们在困难任务中占据很大比例，且可能部分正确。作者认为这些轨迹仍有价值，不应完全丢弃。
AI.method: 提出Step Rejection Fine-Tuning (SRFT)方法：使用critic LLM评估轨迹中每个步骤的正确性。在训练过程中，对错误步骤掩盖损失（mask the loss），但将其保留在上下文窗口中。这样确保模型学习从错误中恢复，而不是重复错误。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified上的评估显示：标准RFT通过排除未解决轨迹将解决率提高2.4%；SRFT通过过滤而非完全丢弃未解决轨迹，将解决率提高3.7%，最终达到32.2%的总解决率。
AI.conclusion: SRFT证明了利用未解决轨迹的有效性，通过步骤级别的细粒度处理而非完全丢弃，可以更好地训练LLM代理，在困难任务上取得更好的性能提升。

title: SlimSpec: Low-Rank Draft LM-Head for Accelerated Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up autoregressive generation in Large Language Models (LLMs) through a two-step procedure, where a lightweight draft model proposes tokens which the target model then verifies in a single forward pass. Although the drafter network is small in modern architectures, its LM-head still performs projection to a large vocabulary, becoming one of the major computational bottlenecks. In prior work this issue has been predominantly addressed via static or dynamic vocabulary truncation. Yet mitigating the bottleneck, these methods bring in extra complexity, such as special vocabulary curation, sophisticated inference-time logic or modifications of the training setup. In this paper, we propose SlimSpec, a low-rank parameterization of the drafter's LM-head that compresses the inner representation rather than the output, preserving full vocabulary support. We evaluate our method with EAGLE-3 drafter across three target models and diverse benchmarks in both latency- and throughput-bound inference regimes. SlimSpec achieves $4\text{-}5\times$ acceleration over the standard LM-head architecture while maintaining a competitive acceptance length, surpassing existing methods by up to $8\text{-}9\%$ of the end-to-end speedup. Our method requires minimal adjustments of training and inference pipelines. Combined with the aforementioned speedup improvements, it makes SlimSpec a strong alternative across wide variety of draft LM-head architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SlimSpec，一种针对投机解码中草稿模型LM-head的低秩参数化方法。该方法通过压缩内部表示而非输出空间，在保持完整词汇表支持的同时，实现了4-5倍的加速，相比现有方法端到端加速提升8-9%，且仅需对训练和推理流程进行最小调整。
AI.motivation: 在投机解码中，轻量级草稿模型需要将内部表示投影到大词汇表，其LM-head成为主要计算瓶颈。现有方法主要采用静态或动态词汇表截断来缓解此问题，但这些方法引入了额外的复杂性，如特殊词汇表策划、复杂的推理时逻辑或修改训练设置。
AI.method: 提出SlimSpec方法，对草稿模型的LM-head进行低秩参数化。与压缩输出空间的现有方法不同，该方法压缩内部表示，从而保持对完整词汇表的支持。该方法在EAGLE-3草稿模型上进行验证，跨三个目标模型和多样化基准测试进行评估。
AI.result: SlimSpec相比标准LM-head架构实现了4-5倍的加速，同时保持竞争性的接受长度。在端到端加速方面，比现有方法提升高达8-9%。该方法仅需对训练和推理流程进行最小调整，适用于广泛的草稿LM-head架构。
AI.conclusion: SlimSpec通过低秩参数化有效解决了草稿模型LM-head的计算瓶颈问题。其在加速性能、接受长度保持和实现简便性方面的综合优势，使其成为各种草稿LM-head架构的有力替代方案。

title: Is Data Shapley Not Better than Random in Data Selection? Ask NASH
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML-26) as a Spotlight paper
