summary: Data selection studies the problem of identifying high-quality subsets of training data. While some existing works have considered selecting the subset of data with top-$m$ Data Shapley or other semivalues as they account for the interaction among every subset of data, other works argue that Data Shapley can sometimes perform ineffectively in practice and select subsets that are no better than random. This raises the questions: (I) Are there certain "Shapley-informative" settings where Data Shapley consistently works well? (II) Can we strategically utilize these settings to select high-quality subsets consistently and efficiently? In this paper, we propose a novel data selection framework, NASH (Non-linear Aggregation of SHapley-informative components), which (I) decomposes the target utility function (e.g., validation accuracy) into simpler, Shapley-informative component functions, and selects data by optimizing an objective that (II) aggregates these components non-linearly. We demonstrate that NASH substantially boosts the effectiveness of Shapley/semivalue-based data selection with minimal additional runtime cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NASH框架，通过将目标效用函数分解为“Shapley信息丰富”的组件并非线性聚合，显著提升了基于Shapley值的数据选择方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 数据选择旨在识别高质量的训练数据子集。现有基于Data Shapley等半值的方法考虑了数据子集间的交互，但在实践中有时表现不佳，甚至不如随机选择。这引发两个核心问题：（I）是否存在Data Shapley稳定有效的特定“Shapley信息丰富”场景？（II）能否利用这些场景来一致且高效地选择高质量子集？
AI.method: 提出NASH（Non-linear Aggregation of SHapley-informative components）框架。首先，将目标效用函数（如验证精度）分解为更简单的、具有Shapley信息丰富特性的组件函数；其次，通过优化一个非线性聚合这些组件的目标函数来选择数据。
AI.result: 实验表明，NASH在几乎不增加运行时间成本的情况下，大幅提升了基于Shapley/半值的数据选择方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: NASH框架成功解决了传统Shapley值数据选择方法的不稳定性问题，通过识别和利用“Shapley信息丰富”的组件，实现了更高效、一致的数据子集选择。

title: AxiomOcean: Forecasting the Three-Dimensional Structure of the Upper Ocean
summary: Short-term ocean forecast skill depends strongly on the three-dimensional ocean structure of the upper ocean, which governs stratification, subsurface heat storage, and the response of the ocean to atmospheric forcing. However, AI ocean forecasting models often fail to preserve this vertical structure, resulting in over-smoothed subsurface features and weak physical consistency under strong forcing. Here, we present AxiomOcean, a global AI ocean forecasting model that explicitly represents vertical hierarchy and cross-layer dependence within the water column. By combining a fully three-dimensional encoder-backbone-decoder architecture with surface atmospheric forcing, AxiomOcean jointly predicts upper-ocean temperature, salinity, and three-dimensional currents at global 1/12° resolution down to 643 m depth. In 10-day forecasts, AxiomOcean outperforms an advanced AI comparison model across variables and lead times, reducing day-1 RMSE by approximately 20 to 35% while maintaining higher anomaly correlation. The gain is not achieved through excessive smoothing: AxiomOcean better preserves eddy kinetic energy, temperature and salinity variance. Its advantage also extends through the water column and remains evident across the equatorial Pacific, Kuroshio Extension, and Southern Ocean, yielding a more realistic reconstruction of upper-ocean heat content. These results show that explicitly preserving upper-ocean three-dimensional structure can improve both forecast accuracy and physical fidelity in AI ocean prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出AxiomOcean，一个显式表征垂直层级和跨层依赖的全球AI海洋预报模型，通过保持上海洋三维结构，在10天预报中显著优于现有AI模型，RMSE降低20-35%，同时更好地保持涡动能和温盐方差。
AI.motivation: 短期海洋预报技能强烈依赖于上层海洋的三维结构，该结构控制着层结、次表层热存储以及海洋对大气强迫的响应。然而，现有AI海洋预报模型往往无法保持这种垂直结构，导致次表层特征过度平滑，在强强迫下物理一致性较弱。
AI.method: 提出AxiomOcean全球AI海洋预报模型，显式表征水体内部的垂直层级和跨层依赖。通过结合全三维编码器-主干-解码器架构与海表大气强迫，联合预测全球1/12°分辨率下至643米深度的上层海洋温度、盐度和三维海流。
AI.result: 在10天预报中，AxiomOcean在各变量和预报时效上均优于先进的AI对比模型，第1天RMSE降低约20-35%，同时保持更高的异常相关性。该优势并非通过过度平滑实现：AxiomOcean更好地保持了涡动能、温度和盐度方差。其优势贯穿整个水体，在赤道太平洋、黑潮延伸体和南大洋均表现明显，实现了更真实的上层海洋热含量重建。
AI.conclusion: 显式保持上层海洋三维结构可以在AI海洋预测中同时提高预报准确性和物理保真度。

title: QT-Net: Rethinking Evaluation of AI Models in Atomic Chemical Space
summary: Atomic properties such as partial charges or multipoles encode chemically meaningful information that can inform downstream molecular property prediction, but their evaluation as machine learning targets has been complicated by the absence of a principled out-of-distribution evaluation protocol at the atomic level. In this work, we propose a held-out evaluation protocol that clusters atomic environments by SOAP descriptors and computes metrics accounting only for cluster labels unseen during training. Following this procedure, we use 5$\times$5 cross-validation and Tukey's HSD to run a statistically rigorous comparison of E(3)-equivariant against non-equivariant, rotationally augmented models for predicting electron populations and multipoles of H, C, N, and O atoms. Building on our results, we introduce the Quantum Topological Neural Network (QT-Net), a rotationally augmented, non-equivariant graph neural network. We show that QT-Net can be used to infer properties of atoms in molecules from QM9 outside our training set, and that these inferred properties can yield improvement when used as input features for downstream molecular property prediction. To further validate the framework, molecular dipole moments computed from QT-Net's per-atom outputs recover the ground-truth values reported in QM9. We release all code and data, including a JAX implementation of QT-Net, to support the broader use of learned QTA properties as inductive biases for atomic-scale molecular machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种原子级别的分布外评估协议，开发了QT-Net模型来预测原子属性（如电子布居和多极矩），这些预测属性可作为下游分子属性预测的有效输入特征。
AI.motivation: 原子属性（如偏电荷或多极矩）包含具有化学意义的信息，可用于下游分子属性预测，但由于缺乏原子级别上原则性的分布外评估协议，其作为机器学习目标的评估一直受到限制。
AI.method: 提出一种留出评估协议，通过SOAP描述符对原子环境进行聚类，并仅针对训练中未见过的聚类标签计算指标；采用5×5交叉验证和Tukey HSD检验，对E(3)等变模型与非等变、旋转增强模型进行统计严谨的比较；在此基础上引入量子拓扑神经网络（QT-Net），一种旋转增强的非等变图神经网络。
AI.result: QT-Net能够推断QM9数据集中训练集外分子的原子属性；这些推断属性作为下游分子属性预测的输入特征可带来性能提升；从QT-Net的原子级输出计算的分子偶极矩能够恢复QM9中报告的真实值。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了原子属性预测的严谨评估框架，证明了学习到的量子拓扑原子属性可作为原子尺度分子机器学习的归纳偏置，并开源了所有代码和数据（包括QT-Net的JAX实现）以支持更广泛的应用。

title: Self-Attention as a Covariance Readout: A Unified View of In-Context Learning and Repetition
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit two striking and ostensibly unrelated behaviours: in-context learning (ICL) and repetitive generation. In both, the model behaves as though it had summarised the context into a population-level statistic and discarded token-level detail. We ask whether this ``summarisation and forgetting'' can be derived from the attention mechanism itself, and answer in the affirmative. Under stationary, ergodic and elliptical inputs, the softmax attention output converges almost surely to $Θ_VΣΘ_K^{\top}Θ_Q x_t$, where $Σ$ is the input covariance; the long-context limit is therefore a linear readout of the input's second-order statistics. Two consequences follow. (i) For in-context linear regression, a single softmax head can implement one step of population gradient descent. Stacking such heads with residual connections iterates this update and implements multiple gradient descent steps. (ii) Propagated across an $L$-layer transformer, this readout drives the terminal hidden state at the parametric $1/t$ rate to a deterministic function of the current token alone, so that autoregressive generation collapses asymptotically to a first-order Markov chain whose attracting orbits furnish a structural account of repetition and mode collapse. The two phenomena thus emerge as facets of a single covariance-readout principle.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了大型语言模型中上下文学习(ICL)和重复生成现象的共同机制：softmax注意力机制在长上下文极限下会收敛为输入二阶统计量的线性读出。单头注意力可执行一步梯度下降，多层堆叠则迭代实现多步；这种读出导致自回归生成渐近坍缩为一阶马尔可夫链，从而解释了模式坍缩和重复生成。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型表现出上下文学习(ICL)和重复生成两种看似无关的行为，但模型在两者中都表现出"总结上下文并丢弃token级细节"的特征。研究者试图探究这种"总结与遗忘"行为是否可以从注意力机制本身推导出来，从而揭示这两种现象的共同理论基础。
AI.method: 在平稳、遍历、椭圆形输入的假设下，推导softmax注意力输出的渐近行为。证明长上下文极限下注意力输出收敛到输入协方差的线性变换形式。基于此分析单头注意力在线性回归中的梯度下降实现，以及多层Transformer中的状态传播机制。
AI.result: 证明了softmax注意力输出几乎必然收敛到$\Theta_V\Sigma\Theta_K^{\top}\Theta_Q x_t$，其中$\Sigma$为输入协方差；单头注意力可实现一步群体梯度下降，堆叠多头配合残差连接可迭代实现多步梯度下降；在L层Transformer中，终端隐藏状态以$1/t$速率收敛到仅依赖当前token的确定性函数，自回归生成渐近坍缩为一阶马尔可夫链。
AI.conclusion: 上下文学习(ICL)和重复生成实际上是同一"协方差读出原理"的两个侧面。注意力机制固有的将上下文总结为二阶统计量并丢弃细节的特性，既赋予了模型上下文学习能力，同时也导致了长程依赖丧失和重复生成问题，为理解和改进LLM提供了统一的理论视角。

title: Provable Sparse Inversion and Token Relabel Enhanced One-shot Federated Learning with ViTs
summary: One-Shot Federated Learning, where a central server learns a global model in a single communication round, has emerged as a promising paradigm. However, under extremely non-IID settings, existing data-free methods often generate low-quality data that suffers from severe semantic misalignment with ground-truth labels. To overcome these issues, we propose a novel Federated Model Inversion and Token Relabel (FedMITR) framework, which trains the global model by fully exploiting all patches of synthetic images. Specifically, FedMITR employs sparse model inversion during data generation, selectively inverting semantic foregrounds while halting the inversion of uninformative backgrounds. To address semantically meaningless tokens that hinder ViT predictions, we implement a differentiated strategy: patches with high information density utilize generated pseudo-labels, while patches with low information density are relabeled via ensemble models for robust distillation. Theoretically, our analysis based on algorithmic stability reveals that Sparse Model Inversion eliminates gradient instability arising from background noise, while Token Relabel effectively reduces gradient variance, collectively guaranteeing a tighter generalization bound. Empirically, extensive experimental results demonstrate that FedMITR substantially outperforms existing baselines under various settings.

AI.tldr: 提出FedMITR框架解决单次联邦学习在非独立同分布设置下的语义错位问题，通过稀疏模型反演和令牌重标记显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 在极端非独立同分布设置下，现有无数据方法生成的数据质量低，且存在与真实标签严重的语义错位问题，阻碍了单次联邦学习的有效性。
AI.method: 提出FedMITR框架，包含两个核心组件：1)稀疏模型反演，在数据生成时选择性反转语义前景而停止无信息背景的反转；2)差异化令牌重标记策略，高信息密度补丁使用生成的伪标签，低信息密度补丁通过集成模型进行重标记以实现鲁棒蒸馏。
AI.result: 理论分析表明稀疏模型反演消除了背景噪声引起的梯度不稳定性，令牌重标记有效降低了梯度方差，共同保证了更紧的泛化界。大量实验证明FedMITR在各种设置下显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FedMITR成功解决了单次联邦学习在极端非独立同分布场景下的关键挑战，通过充分利用合成图像的所有补丁来训练全局模型，在理论和实践上都展现出优越性。

title: Can Muon Fine-tune Adam-Pretrained Models?
summary: Muon has emerged as an efficient alternative to Adam for pretraining, yet remains underused for fine-tuning. A key obstacle is that most open models are pretrained with Adam, and naively switching to Muon for fine-tuning leads to degraded performance due to an optimizer mismatch. We investigate this mismatch through controlled experiments and relate it to the distinct implicit biases of Adam and Muon. We provide evidence that the mismatch disrupts pretrained knowledge, and that this disruption scales with update strength. This leads us to hypothesize that constraining updates should mitigate the mismatch. We validate this with LoRA: across language and vision tasks, LoRA reduces the performance gap between Adam and Muon observed under full fine-tuning. Studies on LoRA rank, catastrophic forgetting, and LoRA variants further confirm that mismatch severity correlates with update strength. These results shed light on how optimizer mismatch affects fine-tuning and how it can be mitigated. Our code is available at https://github.com/XingyuQu/muon-finetune.

AI.tldr: Muon优化器在微调阶段与Adam预训练模型存在不匹配问题，通过LoRA等低秩更新方法可以有效缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: Muon作为Adam的高效替代方案在预训练中表现优异，但在微调阶段使用不足。主要障碍是大多数开源模型使用Adam预训练，直接切换到Muon进行微调会因优化器不匹配导致性能下降。
AI.method: 通过受控实验研究Adam和Muon之间的优化器不匹配问题，分析其与两种优化器不同隐式偏差的关系。提出假设：约束更新强度可以缓解不匹配问题，并通过LoRA进行验证。在语言和视觉任务上进行实验，研究LoRA秩、灾难性遗忘和LoRA变体等因素。
AI.result: 实验证明优化器不匹配会破坏预训练知识，且破坏程度与更新强度成正比。LoRA能够有效减少Adam和Muon在微调中的性能差距，降低不匹配严重性与更新强度的相关性。在语言和视觉任务上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了优化器不匹配如何影响微调过程，以及如何通过约束更新（如LoRA）来缓解这一问题。为在Adam预训练模型上使用Muon进行微调提供了理论依据和实践方案。

title: The Last Word Often Wins: A Format Confound in Chain-of-Thought Corruption Studies
comment: 34 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/Gpgabriel25/LastWordWinsCoT
summary:
Corruption studies, the primary tool for evaluating chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness, identify which chain positions are "computationally important" by measuring accuracy when steps are replaced with errors. We identify a systematic confound: for chains with explicit terminal answer statements, the dominant format in standard benchmarks, corruption studies detect where the answer text appears, not where computation occurs.
  A within-dataset format ablation provides the key evidence: on standard GSM8K chains ending with "the answer is X," removing only the answer statement, preserving all reasoning, collapses suffix sensitivity ~19x at 3B (N=300, p=0.022). Conflicting-answer experiments quantify the causal mechanism: at 7B, CC accuracy drops to near-zero (<=0.02) across five architecture families; the followed-wrong rate spans 0.63-1.00 at 3B-7B and attenuates at larger scales (0.300 at Phi-4-14B, ~0.01 at 32B). A within-stable 7B replication (9.3x attenuation, N=76, p=7.8e-3; Qwen3-8B N=299, p=0.004) provides converging evidence, and the pattern replicates on MATH (DeepSeek-R1-7B: 10.9x suffix-survival recovery). On chains without answer suffixes the same protocol identifies the prefix as load-bearing (Delta=-0.77, p<10^-12).
  Generation-time probes confirm a dissociation: the answer is not early-determined during generation (early commitment <5%), yet at consumption time model outputs systematically follow the explicit answer text. The format-determination effect persists through 14B (8.5x ratio, p=0.001) and converges toward zero at 32B. We propose a three-prerequisite protocol (question-only control, format characterization, all-position sweep) as a minimum standard for corruption-based faithfulness studies.

AI.tldr: 研究发现现有的CoT忠诚性评估方法（corruption studies）存在系统性缺陷：当思维链包含显式答案陈述时，该方法检测的是答案文本出现的位置而非实际计算发生的位置。通过格式消融实验证明，移除答案陈述会使后缀敏感度降低约19倍，揭示了显式答案文本对模型输出的决定性影响。
AI.motivation: Corruption studies是评估链式思维(CoT)忠诚性的主要工具，通过测量用错误替换步骤时的准确率变化来识别哪些位置是"计算上重要的"。然而，作者发现了一个系统性混淆因素：对于以显式答案陈述结尾的思维链（标准基准测试中的主导格式），corruption studies检测的是答案文本出现的位置，而不是计算发生的位置。这引发了对现有忠诚性评估方法有效性的质疑。
AI.method: 采用多种实验方法：(1) 数据集内格式消融实验，比较有无答案陈述的思维链；(2) 冲突答案实验，量化因果机制；(3) 生成时探测，检验答案是否早期确定；(4) 在多个模型架构和规模(3B-32B)及数据集(GSM8K, MATH)上进行验证。实验包括后缀敏感度测量、CC准确率评估、followed-wrong率统计等。
AI.result: 在GSM8K上，移除答案陈述后后缀敏感度降低约19倍(3B模型)；7B模型的CC准确率降至接近零(≤0.02)；followed-wrong率在3B-7B范围内为0.63-1.00，在更大规模上减弱(Phi-4-14B为0.300，32B约为0.01)；在无答案后缀的思维链上识别出前缀为承载部分(Delta=-0.77)；早期承诺率<5%，但模型输出系统性地跟随显式答案文本；格式决定效应持续到14B并在32B收敛至零。
AI.conclusion: 现有corruption studies方法在评估CoT忠诚性时存在根本性缺陷，混淆了文本位置与计算位置。建议采用三前提协议作为基于corruption的忠诚性研究的最低标准：仅问题控制、格式表征、全位置扫描。研究揭示了模型规模与答案跟随行为的关系，为CoT忠诚性评估提供了更严谨的方法论基础。

title: Policy Gradient Methods for Non-Markovian Reinforcement Learning
summary: We study policy gradient methods for reinforcement learning in non-Markovian decision processes (NMDPs), where observations and rewards depend on the entire interaction history. To handle this dependence, the agent maintains an internal state that is recursively updated to provide a compact summary of past observations and actions. In contrast to approaches that treat the agent state dynamics as fixed or learn it via predictive objectives, we propose a reward-centric formulation that jointly optimizes the agent state dynamics and the control policy to maximize the expected cumulative reward. To this end, we consider a class of Agent State-Markov (ASM) policies, comprising an agent state dynamics and a control policy that maps the agent state to actions. We establish a novel policy gradient theorem for ASM policies, extending the classical policy gradient results from the Markovian setting to episodic and infinite-horizon discounted NMDPs. Building on this gradient expression, we propose the Agent State-Markov Policy Gradient (ASMPG) algorithm, which leverages the recursive structure of the agent state dynamics for efficient optimization. We establish finite-time and almost sure convergence guarantees, and empirically demonstrate that, on a range of non-Markovian tasks, ASMPG outperforms baselines that learn state representations via predictive objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ASMPG算法，通过联合优化智能体状态动态和控制策略来解决非马尔可夫决策过程，并在理论和实验上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的非马尔可夫决策过程（NMDPs）方法通常将智能体状态动态视为固定或通过预测目标学习，未能直接服务于最大化累积奖励这一核心目标。为了克服这一局限，研究旨在提出一种以奖励为中心的公式，联合优化智能体状态动态和控制策略。
AI.method: 提出了一类智能体状态-马尔可夫（ASM）策略，包含智能体状态动态和将状态映射到动作的控制策略。建立了适用于ASM策略的新颖策略梯度定理，将其扩展到情景式和无限视界折扣NMDPs。基于此梯度表达式，提出了智能体状态-马尔可夫策略梯度（ASMPG）算法，利用智能体状态动态的递归结构进行高效优化。
AI.result: 建立了ASMPG算法的有限时间和几乎必然收敛性保证。在一系列非马尔可夫任务上的实验表明，ASMPG优于通过预测目标学习状态表示的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的以奖励为中心的公式和ASMPG算法为非马尔可夫决策过程提供了一种有效的解决方案，通过联合优化状态动态和控制策略，在理论和实践上均展现出优越性能。

title: SLIM: Sparse Latent Steering for Interpretable and Property-Directed LLM-Based Molecular Editing
summary: Large language models possess strong chemical reasoning capabilities, making them effective molecular editors. However, property-relevant information is implicitly entangled across their dense hidden states, providing no explicit handle for property control: a substantial fraction of edits fail to improve or even degrade target properties. To address these issues, we propose SLIM (Sparse Latent Interpretable Molecular editing), a plug-and-play framework that decomposes the editor's hidden states into sparse, property-aligned features via a Sparse Autoencoder with learnable importance gates. Steering in this sparse feature space precisely activates property-relevant dimensions, improving editing success rate without modifying model parameters. The same sparse basis further supports interpretable analysis of editing behavior. Experiments on the MolEditRL benchmark across four model architectures and eight molecular properties show consistent gains over baselines, with improvements of up to 42.4 points.

AI.tldr: 提出了SLIM框架，通过稀疏自编码器分解分子编辑模型的隐状态，实现了更精确可控且可解释的分子属性编辑，性能提升显著。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然具备化学推理能力可用于分子编辑，但属性相关信息隐式纠缠在稠密隐状态中，缺乏显式的属性控制手段，导致大量编辑失败或反而降低目标属性。
AI.method: 提出SLIM即插即用框架，利用带有可学习重要性门的稀疏自编码器，将编辑器的隐状态分解为稀疏的、与属性对齐的特征，并在该稀疏特征空间中进行引导以精确激活属性相关维度，无需修改模型参数。
AI.result: 在MolEditRL基准上，跨越四种模型架构和八种分子属性的实验表明，SLIM相比基线有一致的性能提升，提升幅度最高达42.4分。
AI.conclusion: SLIM通过稀疏特征分解与引导，有效解决了分子编辑中属性控制难的问题，显著提高了编辑成功率，并支持对编辑行为的可解释分析。

title: ConfoundingSHAP: Quantifying confounding strength in causal inference
summary: In causal inference, confounders are variables that influence both treatment decisions and outcomes. However, unlike as in randomized clinical trials, the treatment assignment mechanism in observational studies is not known, and it is thus unclear which covariates act as confounders. Here, we aim to generate insight for causal inference and answer: which of the observed covariates act as confounders? We introduce ConfoundingSHAP, a Shapley-based method for attributing confounding strength to individual covariates. Our contributions are twofold. First, we propose a Shapley game targeted to infer the confounding strength of the covariates. Our resulting Shapley values differ from the standard applications of SHAP explanations on causal targets, such as understanding treatment effect heterogeneity, which are ill-suited for our task. Second, as our task requires evaluating the value function over many adjustment sets, we provide a scalable TabPFN-based estimation that avoids exhaustive refitting. We demonstrate the practical value across various datasets, where ConfoundingSHAP provides informative explanations of which observed covariates drive confounding and thereby helps to provide more insight for causal inference in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ConfoundingSHAP方法，用于识别和量化观察性研究中各个协变量的混杂强度，为因果推断提供可解释性分析。
AI.motivation: 在观察性研究中，治疗分配机制未知，难以确定哪些协变量是混杂因子。与随机对照试验不同，观察性研究需要识别真正的混杂因子以进行有效的因果推断，这是一个关键但尚未充分解决的问题。
AI.method: 提出了ConfoundingSHAP方法：(1)设计了一种针对推断协变量混杂强度的Shapley博弈，其Shapley值与传统SHAP在因果目标（如理解处理效应异质性）上的应用不同；(2)使用基于TabPFN的可扩展估计方法，避免了对许多调整集进行穷举重拟合，从而高效地评估价值函数。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验证明，ConfoundingSHAP能够有效地识别和解释哪些观察到的协变量驱动混杂效应，提供了信息丰富的混杂因子解释。
AI.conclusion: ConfoundingSHAP方法为因果推断实践提供了重要洞察，能够帮助研究者识别关键混杂因子，从而改善观察性研究中的因果推断质量。

title: Clin-JEPA: A Multi-Phase Co-Training Framework for Joint-Embedding Predictive Pretraining on EHR Patient Trajectories
summary: We present Clin-JEPA, a multi-phase co-training framework for joint-embedding predictive (JEPA) pretraining on EHR patient trajectories. JEPA architectures have enabled latent-space planning in robotics and high-quality representation learning in vision, but extending the paradigm to EHR data -- to obtain a single backbone that simultaneously forecasts patient trajectories and serves diverse downstream risk-prediction tasks without per-task fine-tuning -- remains an open challenge. Existing JEPA frameworks either discard the predictor after pretraining (I-JEPA, V-JEPA) or train it on a frozen pretrained encoder (V-JEPA 2-AC), leaving the encoder unaware of the rollout signal that the retained predictor must use at inference; co-training the encoder and predictor under a shared JEPA prediction objective would supply this grounding, but naïve co-training is unstable, with representation collapse and online/target drift causing autoregressive rollout to diverge. Clin-JEPA's five-phase pretraining curriculum -- predictor warmup, joint refinement, EMA target alignment, hard sync, and predictor finalization -- addresses each failure mode by phase, stably co-training a Qwen3-8B-based encoder and a 92M-parameter latent trajectory predictor. On MIMIC-IV ICU data, three independent evaluations support the framework: (1) latent $\ell_1$ rollout drift uniquely converges ($-$15.7%) over 48-hour horizons while baselines and ablations diverge (+3% to +4951%); (2) the encoder learns a clinically discriminative latent geometry (deteriorating-patient cohorts displace 4.83$\times$ further than stable patients in latent space, vs $\leq$2.62$\times$ for baseline encoders); (3) a single backbone outperforms strong tabular and sequence baselines on multi-task downstream evaluation. Clin-JEPA achieves mean AUROC 0.851 on ICareFM EEP and 0.883 on 8 binary risk tasks (+0.038 and +0.041 vs baseline average).

AI.tldr: 本文提出Clin-JEPA框架，通过五阶段预训练课程解决了电子健康记录(EHR)患者轨迹上联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA)的编码器-预测器协同训练不稳定问题，实现了轨迹预测与下游任务的双重优异表现。
AI.motivation: 现有JEPA框架在EHR数据上应用存在关键局限：要么预训练后丢弃预测器(I-JEPA, V-JEPA)，要么在冻结编码器上训练预测器(V-JEPA 2-AC)，导致编码器无法感知推理时预测器所需的展开信号。虽然协同训练可提供这种基础，但简单协同训练不稳定，存在表示崩溃和在线/目标漂移导致自回归展开发散的问题。
AI.method: 提出Clin-JEPA五阶段预训练课程：(1)预测器预热；(2)联合精炼；(3)EMA目标对齐；(4)硬同步；(5)预测器定稿。该框架分阶段解决表示崩溃、漂移等失效模式，稳定地协同训练基于Qwen3-8B的编码器和92M参数的潜态轨迹预测器。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV ICU数据上：(1)48小时视野内潜态L1展开漂移独特收敛(-15.7%)，而基线和消融实验发散(+3%至+4951%)；(2)编码器学习到临床判别性潜态几何结构(恶化患者群在潜态空间中位移比稳定患者远4.83倍，基线编码器仅≤2.62倍)；(3)单一主干在多任务下游评估中优于强表格和序列基线，ICareFM EEP平均AUROC达0.851，8个二分类风险任务达0.883(比基线平均+0.038和+0.041)。
AI.conclusion: Clin-JEPA成功解决了JEPA框架在EHR轨迹数据上编码器-预测器协同训练的稳定性问题，使单一主干模型能够同时实现患者轨迹预测和多任务风险评估，无需逐任务微调，为临床决策支持提供了统一且高效的表示学习方案。

title: AssayBench: An Assay-Level Virtual Cell Benchmark for LLMs and Agents
summary: Recent advances in machine learning and large-scale biological data collections have revived the prospect of building a virtual cell, a computational model of cellular behavior that could accelerate biological discovery. One of the most compelling promises of this vision is the ability to perform in silico phenotypic screens, in which a model predicts the effects of cellular perturbations in unseen biological contexts. This task combines heterogeneous textual inputs with diverse phenotypic outputs, making it particularly well-suited to LLMs and agentic systems. Yet, no standard benchmark currently exists for this task, as existing efforts focus on narrower molecular readouts that are only indirectly aligned with the phenotypic endpoints driving many real-world drug discovery workflows. In this work, we present AssayBench, a benchmark for phenotypic screen prediction, built from 1,920 publicly available CRISPR screens spanning five broad classes of cellular phenotypes. We formulate the screen prediction task as a gene rank prediction for each screen and introduce the adjusted nDCG, a continuous metric for comparing performance across heterogeneous assays. Our extensive evaluation shows that existing methods remain far from empirically estimated performance ceilings and zero-shot generalist LLMs outperform biology-specific LLMs and trainable baselines. Optimization techniques such as fine-tuning, ensembling, and prompt optimization can further improve LLM performance on this task. Overall, AssayBench offers a practical testbed for measuring progress toward in silico phenotypic screening and, more broadly, virtual cell models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AssayBench，首个用于预测细胞表型筛选效果的标准基准，包含1,920个CRISPR筛选数据；评估发现现有方法距离性能上限较远，且零样本通用大语言模型优于生物学专用模型。
AI.motivation: 构建虚拟细胞以加速生物发现的前景日益明朗，其中计算机模拟表型筛选是一个核心能力。然而，目前缺乏针对该任务的标准基准，现有工作多关注狭窄的分子读数，而非药物发现工作流中的表型终点。为了填补这一空白，需要一个能够评估和推动表型筛选预测模型发展的标准测试平台。
AI.method: 作者构建了AssayBench基准，涵盖1,920个公开的CRISPR筛选数据，跨越五大类细胞表型。将筛选预测任务构建为针对每个筛选的基因排序预测问题，并引入了adjusted nDCG这一连续指标，用于在异质性实验间比较模型性能。作者对现有方法进行了广泛评估，并测试了微调、集成和提示优化等技术。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，现有方法的表现远低于经验估计的性能上限。令人惊讶的是，零样本通用大语言模型的表现优于生物学专用大语言模型和可训练的基线模型。通过微调、集成和提示优化等技术，可以进一步提升大语言模型在该任务上的性能。
AI.conclusion: AssayBench为衡量计算机模拟表型筛选及更广泛的虚拟细胞模型的进展提供了一个实用的测试平台，揭示了现有方法的局限性，同时展示了大语言模型在此领域的潜力和改进方向。

title: Higher Resolution, Better Generalization: Unlocking Visual Scaling in Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Pixel-based deep reinforcement learning agents are typically trained on heavily downsampled visual observations, a convention inherited from early benchmarks rather than grounded in principled design. In this work, we show that observation resolution is a critical yet overlooked variable for policy learning: higher-resolution inputs can substantially improve both performance and generalization, provided the network architecture can process them effectively. We find that the widely used Impala encoder, which flattens spatial features into a vector, suffers from quadratic parameter growth as resolution increases and fails to leverage the additional visual detail. Replacing this operation with global average pooling, as in the Impoola architecture, decouples parameter count from resolution and yields consistent improvements across resolutions and network widths - at their respective best conditions, visual scaling unlocks a 28 % performance gain for Impoola over Impala. These gains are strongest in environments that require precise perception of small or distant objects, and gradient saliency analysis confirms that the underlying mechanism is a more spatially localized visual attention of the policy at higher resolutions. Our results challenge the prevailing practice of aggressive input downsampling and position resolution-independent architectures as a simple, effective path toward scalable visual deep RL. To facilitate future research on resolution scaling in deep RL, we publicly release the open-source code for the Procgen-HD benchmark: https://github.com/raphajaner/procgen-hd.

AI.tldr: 研究发现提高观测分辨率可显著提升深度强化学习智能体的性能和泛化能力，前提是网络架构需采用分辨率无关的设计（如全局平均池化）来避免参数二次增长。
AI.motivation: 现有基于像素的深度强化学习智能体普遍沿用早期基准测试的做法，对视觉观测输入进行大幅度降采样，这一惯例缺乏理论依据。作者旨在探索观测分辨率这一被忽视的关键变量对策略学习的影响。
AI.method: 分析主流Impala编码器在高分辨率下的缺陷（展平操作导致参数二次增长），提出使用全局平均池化替代展平操作的Impoola架构，实现参数量与分辨率解耦。通过实验对比不同分辨率和网络宽度下的性能，并利用梯度显著性分析验证机制。
AI.result: 在各自最优条件下，Impoola相比Impala实现了28%的性能提升。在需要精确感知小物体或远距离物体的环境中收益最大。梯度显著性分析证实，高分辨率下策略具有更精确的空间局部化视觉注意力。作者发布了Procgen-HD基准测试以支持未来研究。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了过度降采样的主流做法，表明分辨率无关的架构是实现可扩展视觉深度强化学习的一条简单而有效的路径，为后续研究提供了新的方向和工具。

title: LoKA: Low-precision Kernel Applications for Recommendation Models At Scale
summary: Recent GPU generations deliver significantly higher FLOPs using lower-precision arithmetic, such as FP8. While successfully applied to large language models (LLMs), its adoption in large recommendation models (LRMs) has been limited. This is because LRMs are numerically sensitive, dominated by small matrix multiplications (GEMMs) followed by normalization, and trained in communication-intensive environments. Applying FP8 directly to LRMs often degrades model quality and prolongs training time. These challenges are inherent to LRM workloads and cannot be resolved merely by introducing better FP8 kernels. Instead, a system-model co-design approach is needed to successfully integrate FP8. We present LoKA (Low-precision Kernel Applications), a framework that makes FP8 practical for LRMs through three principles: profile under realistic distributions to know where low precision is safe, co-design model components with hardware to expand where it is safe, and orchestrate across kernel libraries to maximize the gains. Concretely, LoKA Probe is a statistically grounded, online benchmarking method that learns activation and weight statistics, and quantifies per-layer errors. This process pinpoints safe and unsafe, fast and slow sites for FP8 adoption. LoKA Mods is a set of reusable model adaptations that improve both numerical stability and execution efficiency with FP8. LoKA Dispatch is a runtime that leverages the statistical insights from LoKA Probe to select the fastest FP8 kernel that satisfies the accuracy requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了LoKA框架，通过系统-模型协同设计的方法，成功将FP8低精度计算应用于数值敏感的大规模推荐模型（LRMs），解决了直接应用FP8会导致模型质量下降和训练时间延长的问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管最新的GPU（如FP8）在低精度算术下能提供更高的FLOPs，并已成功应用于大语言模型（LLMs），但在大规模推荐模型（LRMs）中的应用却受到限制。LRMs具有数值敏感性、由小矩阵乘法（GEMMs）主导并伴随归一化操作、且在通信密集的环境中训练等特点。直接将FP8应用于LRMs往往会导致模型质量下降和训练时间延长，这些挑战是LRM工作负载固有的，仅通过引入更好的FP8内核无法解决，因此需要系统-模型协同设计的方法。
AI.method: 提出了LoKA（Low-precision Kernel Applications）框架，包含三个核心组件：1) LoKA Probe：一种基于统计的在线基准测试方法，学习激活和权重统计数据，量化每层误差，识别FP8采用的安全/不安全、快速/慢速站点；2) LoKA Mods：一组可重用的模型适应方法，提高FP8下的数值稳定性和执行效率；3) LoKA Dispatch：一个运行时系统，利用LoKA Probe的统计洞察，选择满足精度要求的最快FP8内核。该框架遵循三个原则：在实际分布下进行分析以了解低精度安全的位置、与硬件协同设计模型组件以扩展安全范围、跨内核库协调以最大化收益。
AI.result: LoKA框架成功实现了FP8在LRMs中的实际应用，通过系统-模型协同设计解决了直接应用FP8导致的模型质量下降和训练时间延长问题。该框架能够准确识别FP8应用的安全区域，通过模型适应提高数值稳定性，并通过智能内核选择最大化性能收益。
AI.conclusion: 通过LoKA框架的系统-模型协同设计方法，FP8低精度计算成功应用于数值敏感的大规模推荐模型，证明了仅靠改进内核不足以解决LRMs的低精度应用挑战，而需要从分析、模型适应到运行时调度的全方位协同优化。这为在类似数值敏感场景中应用低精度计算提供了新的思路和方法。

title: PhysEDA: Physics-Aware Learning Framework for Efficient EDA With Manhattan Distance Decay
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, plus appendix. Code and data to be released upon publication
summary: Electronic design automation (EDA) addresses placement, routing, timing analysis, and power-integrity verification for integrated circuits. Learning methods -- attention (Transformer) and reinforcement learning (RL) -- have recently emerged on EDA tasks, yet face two common bottlenecks: vanilla attention's quadratic complexity limits scaling, and data-scarce models overfit statistical noise and amplify weak long-range correlations against the underlying physics. We observe that EDA tasks share a physical prior -- pairwise electrical and routing interactions decay exponentially along Manhattan distance -- and integrate it as a unified inductive bias into both architecture and training. We propose PhysEDA, comprising two components Physics-Structured Linear Attention (PSLA) folds the separable Manhattan decay into the linear-attention kernel as a multiplicative bias, reducing complexity from quadratic to linear; Potential-Based Reward Shaping (PBRS) constructs a physical potential from the same kernel, providing dense reward signal under sparse RL while preserving the optimal policy via the policy-invariance theorem. Across three EDA scenarios -- decoupling-capacitor placement, macro placement, and IR-drop prediction -- PhysEDA improves zero-shot cross-scale transfer by 56.8% and achieves 14x inference speedup with 98.5% memory savings on 100x100 grids; PBRS adds another 10.8% in sparse-reward DPP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhysEDA框架，通过将曼哈顿距离指数衰减的物理先验统一融入模型架构与训练，解决了EDA任务中注意力机制复杂度高和强化学习数据稀缺的问题，在跨尺度迁移上提升56.8%，推理加速14倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于注意力机制和强化学习的EDA方法面临两大瓶颈：标准注意力机制的二次方复杂度限制了模型规模扩展；数据稀缺导致模型易过拟合统计噪声并放大违背物理规律的弱长程相关性。
AI.method: 提出PhysEDA框架，包含两个核心组件：1）物理结构化线性注意力（PSLA），将可分离的曼哈顿衰减作为乘性偏置融入线性注意力核，将复杂度从二次方降至线性；2）基于势能的奖励整形（PBRS），利用相同核构建物理势能，在稀疏强化学习中提供密集奖励信号，同时通过策略不变性定理保持最优策略不变。
AI.result: 在去耦电容布局、宏单元布局和IR压降预测三个EDA场景中，PhysEDA在零样本跨尺度迁移上提升56.8%，在100x100网格上实现14倍推理加速和98.5%内存节省；PBRS在稀疏奖励DPP任务中额外提升10.8%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功识别并利用了EDA任务共享的物理先验（配对电气和布线相互作用沿曼哈顿距离指数衰减），将其作为统一的归纳偏置整合到模型架构和训练中，有效解决了扩展性和数据稀缺问题，为EDA任务中的深度学习方法提供了新的设计范式。

title: Unmasking On-Policy Distillation: Where It Helps, Where It Hurts, and Why
summary: On-policy distillation offers dense, per-token supervision for training reasoning models; however, it remains unclear under which conditions this signal is beneficial and under which it is detrimental. Which teacher model should be used, and in the case of self-distillation, which specific context should serve as the supervisory signal? Does the optimal choice vary from one token to the next? At present, addressing these questions typically requires costly training runs whose aggregate performance metrics obscure the dynamics at the level of individual tokens. We introduce a training-free diagnostic framework that operates at the highest resolution: per token, per question, and per teacher. We derive an ideal per-node gradient defined as the parameter update that maximally increases the student's probability of success. We then develop a scalable targeted-rollout algorithm to estimate this gradient efficiently, even for long chains of intermediate thoughts. The gradient alignment score, defined as the cosine similarity between this ideal gradient and any given distillation gradient, quantifies the extent to which a particular configuration approximates the ideal signal. Across a range of self-distillation settings and external teacher models, we observe that distillation guidance exhibits substantially higher alignment with the ideal on incorrect rollouts than on correct ones, where the student already performs well and the teacher's signal tends to become noisy. Furthermore, we find that the optimal distillation context depends jointly on the student model's capacity and the target task, and that no single universally effective configuration emerges. These findings motivate the use of per-task, per-token diagnostic analyses for distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个免训练的诊断框架，通过计算梯度对齐分数来评估蒸馏信号的质量，发现蒸馏在学生模型出错的样本上更有效，且最佳蒸馏配置依赖于任务和模型容量，不存在通用最优解。
AI.motivation: 现有的策略蒸馏方法缺乏对不同条件下蒸馏信号有效性的深入理解，例如应选择何种教师模型、自蒸馏时应使用何种上下文作为监督信号，以及最优选择是否因token而异；现有方法需要昂贵的训练运行，且聚合性能指标掩盖了个体token层面的动态。
AI.method: 提出了一种免训练的诊断框架：定义了理想逐节点梯度（最大化学生成功概率的参数更新），开发了可扩展的目标展开算法来高效估计该梯度，并引入梯度对齐分数（理想梯度与蒸馏梯度之间的余弦相似度）来量化特定配置下蒸馏信号的质量。
AI.result: 实验发现：蒸馏指导在错误展开样本上与理想梯度的对齐度显著高于正确样本（学生已表现良好时教师信号变得嘈杂）；最佳蒸馏上下文联合依赖于学生模型容量和目标任务；不存在单一普遍有效的配置。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现强调了针对每个任务和每个token进行诊断分析对于蒸馏的重要性，为未来开发自适应蒸馏策略提供了理论依据和实践指导。

title: It's All Connected: Topology-Aware Structural Graph Encoding Improves Performance on Polymer Prediction
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved strong results in molecular property prediction, but polymers present distinct challenges: labeled datasets are scarce and small (typically in the order of hundreds of polymers) due to the need for expensive experimentation, and complex polymer chain distributions influence polymer properties. Established practice in polymer prediction represents polymers solely by graphs of their repeat units, discarding the chain-scale morphology that governs key properties such as the glass transition temperature ($T_g$). In this work, we propose a principled graph construction that addresses this gap. Given a polymer's molecular mass distribution (MMD), we sample representative chains from the Schulz-Zimm distribution and construct representative sets of large graphs encoding chain-scale topology directly, with atoms and bonds featurized using rich chemical descriptors. We further pretrain GNN encoders via masked graph modeling on 100,000 unlabeled PSMILES strings before fine-tuning on labeled data. On a dataset of 381 polymers (180 homopolymers and 201 copolymers), we show that graph construction and self-supervised pretraining are jointly necessary: without pretraining, the large graph method matches the repeat-unit baseline (28.40 K vs. 28.36 K RMSE); with pretraining, it achieves 24.76 K +/- 3.30 K, a 5.1% reduction in mean error over the pretrained repeat-unit baseline (26.08 K +/- 4.20 K, p < 0.001, 30 runs). An ablation removing chemical features degrades performance to 36.65 K, confirming both components are essential. Results are architecture-agnostic, holding for both GINE and GATv2 encoders.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合链尺度拓扑的图构建方法和自监督预训练策略，成功将聚合物玻璃化转变温度预测的RMSE降低了5.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有的图神经网络在分子性质预测中表现出色，但在聚合物领域面临两大挑战：由于昂贵的实验成本，标注数据集稀缺且规模小（通常仅有数百个聚合物）；复杂的聚合物链分布影响聚合物性质。现有实践仅用重复单元的图来表示聚合物，丢弃了决定玻璃化转变温度(Tg)等关键性质的链尺度形态信息。
AI.method: 提出了一种有原则的图构建方法：基于聚合物的分子量分布(MMD)，从Schulz-Zimm分布中采样代表性链，构建编码链尺度拓扑的大图，并使用丰富的化学描述符对原子和键进行特征化。进一步在100,000个未标记的PSMILES字符串上通过掩码图建模预训练GNN编码器，然后在标记数据上进行微调。
AI.result: 在包含381个聚合物（180个均聚物和201个共聚物）的数据集上验证，图构建和自监督预训练缺一不可。无预训练时，大图方法与重复单元基线RMSE相当（28.40K vs 28.36K）；有预训练时，RMSE达到24.76K±3.30K，比预训练的重复单元基线（26.08K±4.20K）平均误差降低5.1%（p<0.001，30次运行）。移除化学特征的消融实验使性能下降至36.65K，证明两个组件都至关重要。结果具有架构无关性，在GINE和GATv2编码器上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明了在聚合物性质预测中，结合链尺度拓扑信息和自监督预训练的重要性，为小数据集下的聚合物预测提供了有效解决方案，且具有良好的架构通用性。

title: DataMaster: Towards Autonomous Data Engineering for Machine Learning
summary: As model families, training recipes, and compute budgets become increasingly standardized, further gains in machine learning systems depend increasingly on data. Yet data engineering remains largely manual and ad hoc: practitioners repeatedly search for external datasets, adapt them to existing pipelines, validate candidate data through downstream training, and carry forward lessons from prior attempts. We study task-conditioned autonomous data engineering, where an autonomous agent improves a fixed learning algorithm by optimizing only the data side, including external data discovery, data selection and composition, cleaning and transformation. The goal is to obtain a stronger downstream solution while leaving the learning algorithm unchanged. To address the open-ended search space, branch-dependent refinement, and delayed validation inherent in autonomous data engineering, we propose DataMaster, a data-agent framework that integrates tree-structured search, shared candidate data, and cumulative memory. DataMaster consists of three key components: a DataTree that organizes alternative data-engineering branches, a shared Data Pool that stores discovered external data sources for reuse, and a Global Memory that records node outcomes, artifacts, and reusable findings. Together, these components allow the agent to discover candidate data, construct executable training inputs, evaluate them through downstream feedback, and carry useful evidence across branches. We evaluate DataMaster on two types of benchmarks, MLE-Bench Lite and PostTrainBench. On MLE-Bench Lite, it improves medal rate by 32.27% over the initial score; on PostTrainBench, it surpasses the instruct model on GPQA (31.02% vs 30.35%).

AI.tldr: 提出DataMaster框架，通过自主数据工程优化固定学习算法，在MLE-Bench Lite和PostTrainBench上分别提升32.27%的奖牌率和超越指令模型。
AI.motivation: 随着模型架构、训练方案和计算预算日趋标准化，机器学习系统的进一步提升越来越依赖于数据。然而，数据工程仍然主要依赖人工和临时方法：从业者反复搜索外部数据集、将其适配到现有流程、通过下游训练验证候选数据，并从先前尝试中吸取教训。
AI.method: 提出DataMaster框架，包含三个核心组件：1) DataTree：组织替代数据工程分支的树状结构；2) 共享数据池：存储发现的外部数据源以供重用；3) 全局记忆：记录节点结果、工件和可重用发现。这些组件使智能体能够发现候选数据、构建可执行训练输入、通过下游反馈评估，并在分支间传递有用证据。
AI.result: 在MLE-Bench Lite上将奖牌率提升32.27%；在PostTrainBench的GPQA任务上超越指令模型（31.02% vs 30.35%）。
AI.conclusion: DataMaster成功实现了任务条件下的自主数据工程，通过树状搜索、共享候选数据和累积记忆有效解决了开放搜索空间、分支依赖优化和延迟验证等挑战，证明了在保持学习算法不变的情况下仅优化数据侧可以获得更强的下游解决方案。

title: Online Sharp-Calibrated Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a widely used framework for optimizing expensive black-box functions, commonly based on Gaussian process (GP) surrogate models. Its effectiveness relies on uncertainty quantification that is both sharp (informative) and well-calibrated along the BO trajectory. In practice, GP kernel hyperparameters are unknown and are refit online from sequentially collected (non-i.i.d.) data, which can yield miscalibrated or overly conservative uncertainty and lies outside the fixed-kernel assumptions of standard BO regret theory. We propose Online Sharp-Calibrated Bayesian Optimization (OSCBO), a BO algorithm that adaptively balances GP sharpness and calibration by casting hyperparameter selection as a constrained online-learning problem. We also show that OSCBO preserves sublinear regret bounds by leveraging the theoretical guarantees of the underlying online learning algorithm. Empirically, OSCBO performs competitively across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, ranking among the strongest methods in final simple regret while maintaining robust cumulative-regret behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OSCBO算法，通过将高斯过程超参数选择建模为约束在线学习问题，自适应平衡不确定性的锐度与校准性，在保持次线性遗憾界的同时，显著提升了贝叶斯优化的性能。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯优化（BO）依赖高斯过程（GP）代理模型提供的置信区间，其有效性取决于不确定性量化的锐度（信息量）和校准性。然而，实际应用中GP核超参数未知且需要利用在线收集的非独立同分布数据进行拟合，这导致不确定性估计出现失准或过度保守的问题，且超出了标准BO遗憾理论中固定核假设的适用范围。
AI.method: 提出在线锐度校准贝叶斯优化（OSCBO）算法。该方法将GP超参数选择建模为一个约束在线学习问题，利用底层在线学习算法的理论保证，自适应地在不确定性估计的锐度和校准性之间寻求平衡，从而解决在线超参数拟合带来的挑战。
AI.result: 理论上证明了OSCBO算法能够保持次线性遗憾界限。实证方面，在合成和真实世界的基准测试中，OSCBO表现出极具竞争力的性能，在最终简单遗憾指标上名列前茅，同时保持了稳健的累积遗憾行为。
AI.conclusion: OSCBO为在线超参数拟合场景下的贝叶斯优化提供了一个理论可靠且高效的解决方案，成功解决了传统方法中不确定性失准的问题，在最终优化质量与搜索过程稳健性之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Variational Inference for Lévy Process-Driven SDEs via Neural Tilting
comment: The associated project page which contains the official implementation can be found in https://circle-group.github.io/research/NeuralTilting/
summary: Modelling extreme events and heavy-tailed phenomena is central to building reliable predictive systems in domains such as finance, climate science, and safety-critical AI. While Lévy processes provide a natural mathematical framework for capturing jumps and heavy tails, Bayesian inference for Lévy-driven stochastic differential equations (SDEs) remains intractable with existing methods: Monte Carlo approaches are rigorous but lack scalability, whereas neural variational inference methods are efficient but rely on Gaussian assumptions that fail to capture discontinuities. We address this tension by introducing a neural exponential tilting framework for variational inference in Lévy-driven SDEs. Our approach constructs a flexible variational family by exponentially reweighting the Lévy measure using neural networks. This parametrization preserves the jump structure of the underlying process while remaining computationally tractable. To enable efficient inference, we develop a quadratic neural parametrization that yields closed-form normalization of the tilted measure, a conditional Gaussian representation for stable processes that facilitates simulation, and symmetry-aware Monte Carlo estimators for scalable optimization. Empirically, we demonstrate that the method accurately captures jump dynamics and yields reliable posterior inference in regimes where Gaussian-based variational approaches fail, on both synthetic and real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对Lévy驱动随机微分方程的神经指数倾斜变分推断框架，解决了传统方法无法同时兼顾可扩展性和准确捕捉跳跃/重尾特性的问题。
AI.motivation: 在金融、气候科学和安全关键AI等领域，建模极端事件和重尾现象至关重要。Lévy过程是描述跳跃和重尾的自然数学框架，但现有的贝叶斯推断方法存在严重局限：蒙特卡洛方法虽严谨但缺乏可扩展性，而神经变分推断方法虽高效但依赖高斯假设，无法捕捉不连续性（跳跃）。
AI.method: 引入神经指数倾斜框架进行变分推断。该方法通过神经网络对Lévy测度进行指数重加权，构建灵活的变分族，既保留了底层过程的跳跃结构又保持计算可处理性。具体包含三个关键技术：(1) 二次神经参数化，实现倾斜测度的闭式归一化；(2) 针对稳定过程的条件高斯表示，便于模拟；(3) 对称感知蒙特卡洛估计器，实现可扩展优化。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法能够准确捕捉跳跃动力学，并在基于高斯的变分方法失效的情况下实现可靠的后验推断。
AI.conclusion: 该工作成功填补了Lévy驱动SDE贝叶斯推断的空白，提供了一种既可扩展又能准确建模跳跃和重尾特性的实用方法，为极端事件建模提供了新的技术路径。

title: Controllability in preference-conditioned multi-objective reinforcement learning
summary: Multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) allows a user to express preference over outcomes in terms of the relative importance of the objectives, but standard metrics cannot capture whether changes in preference reliably change the agent's behavior in the intended way, a property termed controllability. As a result, preference-conditioned agents can score well on standard MORL metrics while being insensitive to the preference input. If the ability to control agents cannot be reliably assessed, the symbolic interface that MORL provides between user intent and agent behavior is broken. Mainstream MORL metrics alone fail to measure the controllability of preference-conditioned agents, motivating a complementary metric specifically designed to that end. We hope the results spur discussion in the community on existing evaluation protocols to consolidate advances in preference adaptation in MORL to larger and more complex problems.

AI.tldr: 本文指出标准多目标强化学习（MORL）指标无法评估偏好条件智能体对偏好输入的敏感性（即可控性），并提出需要设计一种互补指标来专门衡量这一关键属性。
AI.motivation: 现有的标准MORL评估指标无法捕捉“可控性”这一属性，即偏好输入的变化是否能可靠地按预期改变智能体的行为。这导致偏好条件智能体可能在标准指标上得分很高，却对偏好输入不敏感，从而破坏了MORL作为连接用户意图与智能体行为之间的符号接口。
AI.method: 本文通过分析主流MORL指标的局限性，论证了其无法衡量智能体可控性的原因，并以此为基础提出了设计一种专门用于评估可控性的互补性指标的必要性。
AI.result: 研究发现，主流MORL指标单独使用时会失效，无法有效评估偏好条件智能体的可控性，这表明现有评估协议存在缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 为了巩固MORL在偏好适应方面向更大型、更复杂问题扩展的进展，社区需要讨论并建立新的评估协议，引入专门衡量可控性的指标。

title: MulTaBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Tabular Learning with Text and Image
summary: Tabular Foundation Models have recently established the state of the art in supervised tabular learning, by leveraging pretraining to learn generalizable representations of numerical and categorical structured data. However, they lack native support for unstructured modalities such as text and image, and rely on frozen, pretrained embeddings to process them. On established Multimodal Tabular Learning benchmarks, we show that tuning the embeddings to the task improves performance. Existing benchmarks, however, often focus on the mere co-occurrence of modalities; this leads to high variance across datasets and masks the benefits of task-specific tuning. To address this gap, we introduce MulTaBench, a benchmark of 40 datasets, split equally between image-tabular and text-tabular tasks. We focus on predictive tasks where the modalities provide complementary predictive signal, and where generic embeddings lose critical information, necessitating Target-Aware Representations that are aligned with the task. Our experimental results demonstrate that the gains from target-aware representation tuning generalize across both text and image modalities, several tabular learners, encoder scales, and embedding dimensions. MulTaBench constitutes the largest image-tabular benchmarking effort to date, spanning high-impact domains such as healthcare and e-commerce. It is designed to enable the research of novel architectures which incorporate joint modeling and target-aware representations, paving the way for the development of novel Multimodal Tabular Foundation Models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MulTaBench基准，包含40个图像-表格和文本-表格数据集，证明了在多模态表格学习中，针对任务调整表示（Target-Aware Representations）能显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的表格基础模型缺乏对非结构化模态（文本、图像）的原生支持，仅依赖冻结的预训练嵌入；现有多模态表格学习基准主要关注模态共现，导致高方差且掩盖了任务特定调优的优势。
AI.method: 构建MulTaBench基准，包含40个数据集（图像-表格和文本-表格任务各20个），专注于模态提供互补预测信号且通用嵌入会丢失关键信息的预测任务，强调目标感知表示的重要性。
AI.result: 实验证明目标感知表示调优在文本和图像模态、多种表格学习器、编码器规模和嵌入维度上均能带来性能提升；MulTaBench是迄今规模最大的图像-表格基准测试。
AI.conclusion: MulTaBench为联合建模和目标感知表示的新型架构研究提供了平台，为开发新型多模态表格基础模型铺平了道路，涵盖医疗和电子商务等高影响力领域。

title: Hierarchical End-to-End Taylor Bounds for Complete Neural Network Verification

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HiTaB框架，通过利用二阶Hessian及其Lipschitz常数，首次系统性地利用高阶信息改进了平滑神经网络的可达性分析，获得了更紧的安全证书。
AI.motivation: 现有的平滑神经网络可达性分析方法最多仅利用二阶信息，缺乏对更高阶信息的系统利用，导致过近似不够紧致。为了提供更紧、更具信息量的安全证书，需要开发能够利用曲率Lipschitz连续性的新方法。
AI.method: 提出了HiTaB验证框架，利用二阶Hessian及其Lipschitz常数（$L_{\nabla^2 f}$）来利用二阶平滑性；开发了零阶、一阶和二阶边界的统一层次结构，并给出了高阶近似能够得到可证明改进的精确条件；提出了组合过程，通过逐层传播曲率边界来高效地约束深层神经网络中的$L_{\nabla^2 f}$；将框架扩展到$\ell_2$和$\ell_\infty$约束输入集，并集成到分支定界验证流程中。
AI.result: 建立了零阶、一阶和二阶边界的统一层次，并证明了在特定条件下高阶近似能提供更紧的边界；开发了高效的逐层曲率边界传播算法；成功将框架应用于$\ell_2$和$\ell_\infty$输入约束，并集成到分支定界方法中。
AI.conclusion: HiTaB是首个系统利用曲率Lipschitz连续性的平滑神经网络实用可达性分析框架，能够产生更紧且更具信息量的安全证书，为学习使能物理系统的安全性和鲁棒性认证提供了新的技术途径。

title: Composing diffusion priors with explicit physical context via generative Gibbs sampling
summary: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful learned priors, but in scientific sampling the target distribution often depends on physical context that is not fully represented by one generative model. We introduce Generative Gibbs for Physics-Aware Sampling (GG-PA), a training-free framework that formulates the composition of learned partial priors and explicit physical context as inference over a joint target distribution in an augmented state space. We derive a Gibbs sampler for this joint target, show that it is asymptotically exact as the diffusion time approaches zero, and prove that in settings with quadratic interactions it remains exact at finite diffusion times. We further introduce replica exchange over diffusion time to accelerate mixing. Experiments on a double-well system, a $φ^4$ lattice model, and atomistic peptide systems show that GG-PA recovers context-induced distribution shifts and emergent collective behavior in interacting systems using partial priors without retraining. These results demonstrate GG-PA as a practical approach for combining pretrained generative priors with explicit physical context.

AI.tldr: 提出了GG-PA框架，无需重新训练即可将预训练扩散模型与物理上下文结合，实现了物理感知的科学采样。
AI.motivation: 预训练扩散模型提供了强大的学习先验，但在科学采样任务中，目标分布通常依赖于无法被单一生成模型完全表示的物理上下文。现有方法难以将部分先验知识与显式物理约束有效结合。
AI.method: 提出物理感知生成式Gibbs采样框架(GG-PA)，将学习到的部分先验与显式物理上下文的组合形式化为增强状态空间中联合目标分布的推断问题；推导出针对该联合目标的Gibbs采样器；引入扩散时间上的副本交换以加速混合。
AI.result: 证明了该Gibbs采样器在扩散时间趋近零时渐近精确，在二次相互作用设置下有限扩散时间仍保持精确；在双势阱系统、φ^4晶格模型和原子肽系统实验中，成功恢复了上下文诱导的分布偏移和相互作用系统中的涌现集体行为。
AI.conclusion: GG-PA是结合预训练生成先验与显式物理上下文的实用方法，能够使用部分先验而无需重训练，为科学采样领域提供了新的解决方案。

title: A Random-Matrix Criterion for Initializing Gated Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: Proper weight initialization prior to training has historically been one of the key factors that helped kick off the deep learning revolution. Initialization is even more crucial in "reservoir computing", where the weights of a readout layer are learned linearly while the reservoir weights are fixed and largely determine the richness, stability and memory of the resulting dynamics. In the infinite-width limit it has been shown that meaningful initializations are those sitting at an effective critical point of the randomly initialized model. The phase transition is controlled by the weight variance $g^2$ and separates an ordered phase from a chaotic one where information progressively degrades. Here we derive a simple criterion to estimate the critical $g_c$ for a broad class of recurrent architectures and we show that it closely tracks the gain at which a gated-RNN reservoir achieves peak performance on a chaotic forecasting task. Finally, we argue that our criterion can serve as a design principle for future initialization schemes.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了一个简单准则来估计循环神经网络的临界权重方差，该准则能准确预测储备池计算中 gated-RNN 在混沌预测任务上达到最佳性能的参数点。
AI.motivation: 在储备池计算中，储备层的权重是固定的并在很大程度上决定了系统动力学的丰富性、稳定性和记忆能力。有意义初始化对应于随机初始化模型的有效临界点，该相变由权重方差$g^2$控制，分离了有序相位和混沌相位。因此，如何确定临界值$g_c$成为一个关键问题。
AI.method: 针对广泛的循环神经网络架构，推导出一个简单的准则来估计临界权重方差$g_c$，该临界点控制着有序相位与混沌相位之间的相变。
AI.result: 所提出的临界值估计准则能够紧密追踪 gated-RNN 储备池在混沌预测任务中达到峰值性能时的增益参数，验证了该准则的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该准则可以作为未来初始化方案的设计原则，为储备池计算中的权重初始化提供理论指导。

title: BCJR-QAT: A Differentiable Relaxation of Trellis-Coded Weight Quantization
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Code at https://github.com/Venugopalan2610/quant-2bit. Model weights and trajectory snapshots at https://huggingface.co/Venugopalan2610/BCJR-QAT-Llama-3.2-1B-2bit
summary: Trellis-coded quantization sets the current 2-bit post-training frontier for LLMs (QTIP), but pushing below the PTQ ceiling requires quantization-aware training, and QAT on a trellis is obstructed by the non-differentiable Viterbi argmax. We introduce BCJR-QAT, a relaxation that replaces the argmax with the BCJR forward-backward sum-product algorithm at temperature $T$, producing a soft codeword equal to the Boltzmann expectation over trellis paths, exactly differentiable, recovering the hard QTIP code as $T \to 0$, and mathematically identical to the transfer-matrix computation for a 1D Ising-like spin chain. We contribute (i) a fused Triton kernel making BCJR tractable on a single consumer GPU ($6.57\times$ speedup, fp32 parity); (ii) a quantitative drift-budget theory of when BCJR-QAT can escape the QTIP-PTQ Voronoi basin, verified across four experiments; and (iii) a positive empirical result on Llama-3.2-1B at 2 bpw under end-to-end forward-KL distillation: with the right schedule (skip the high-$T$ phase to avoid an overshoot we diagnose), single-layer BCJR-QAT beats QTIP-PTQ by $\mathbf{-0.084}$ PPL on WikiText-2, and multi-layer compounding is super-additive.

AI.tldr: 提出BCJR-QAT方法，通过BCJR算法软化Viterbi argmax实现网格编码量化的可微训练，在Llama-3.2-1B上2比特/权重时超越当前最优PTQ方法QTIP。
AI.motivation: 当前的2比特后训练量化(PTQ)前沿方法QTIP使用网格编码量化，但突破PTQ天花板需要量化感知训练(QAT)。然而，由于Viterbi argmax的不可微性，在网格结构上进行QAT受阻。
AI.method: 提出BCJR-QAT松弛方法：(1)用温度T下的BCJR前向-后向和积算法替换argmax，产生软码字等于网格路径上的玻尔兹曼期望；(2)实现融合Triton内核使BCJR在单个消费级GPU上可行(6.57×加速，fp32精度持平)；(3)建立漂移预算理论指导何时能逃离QTIP-PTQ的Voronoi盆地；(4)设计正确的温度调度策略（跳过高T阶段避免过冲）。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2-1B模型上2 bpw设置下进行端到端前向KL蒸馏实验：(1)单层BCJR-QAT在WikiText-2上比QTIP-PTQ降低0.084困惑度；(2)多层复合效果呈超可加性；(3)在四个实验中验证了漂移预算理论的准确性。
AI.conclusion: BCJR-QAT成功实现了网格编码量化的可微训练，数学上等价于1D伊辛自旋链的转移矩阵计算，为突破PTQ天花板提供了有效路径。通过合适的温度调度策略，在2比特/权重量化下取得了超越当前最优PTQ方法的性能。

title: Why Zeroth-Order Adaptation May Forget Less: A Randomized Shaping Theory
summary: Continual learning requires new-task adaptation without damaging previously acquired capabilities. Recent forward-pass and zeroth-order (ZO) results show that low-query adaptation may retain better than first-order (FO) descent, but the usual view of ZO as noisy FO estimation does not explain why. We give a local randomized gradient-shaping analysis: finite differences expose a raw shape that is mean-aligned with FO, while the norm-matched comparator fixes the expected squared adaptation norm. Under this controlled comparison, forgetting depends on how the adaptation shape exposes retention curvature. For norm-matched ZO, the expected shaped retention curvature obeys an exact identity that preserves the isotropic retention floor while contracting only the anisotropic component. Projecting this identity onto the incoming gradient yields the observable FO--ZO quadratic forgetting gap: ZO improves mean forgetting precisely when the FO direction has above-average retention curvature, by a query-dependent fraction of that curvature excess. A practical finite-query accounting separates the mean mechanism from one-batch sampling and smoothing perturbations. As an algorithmic transfer, RISE applies the calibrated ZO shape to exact FO gradients inside parameter blocks. Its target is a stability--plasticity tradeoff: randomized shaping may reduce the retention exposure paid by FO, exact gradients remove finite-smoothing bias from finite-difference ZO, and blockwise sampling supplies many local shaping directions after one gradient computation. The blockwise analysis separates mean-step damage from centered random exposure, showing how block-diagonal curvature, cross-block coupling, and local shaping diagnostics specify where this exact-gradient transfer is most likely to be visible.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过局部随机梯度整形理论解释了零阶(ZO)优化相比一阶(FO)在持续学习中具有更好抗遗忘性的根本原因，并提出RISE算法将ZO的整形特性应用于精确FO梯度以实现稳定性-可塑性权衡。
AI.motivation: 持续学习中新任务适应往往会损害已获得能力。近期研究发现零阶(ZO)优化在低查询设置下相比一阶(FO)下降能更好地保持已学知识，但传统将ZO视为FO的噪声估计的观点无法解释这一现象。论文旨在揭示ZO在持续学习中优势的理论机制。
AI.method: 提出局部随机梯度整形分析框架：(1)有限差分暴露与FO均值对齐的原始形状，使用范数匹配比较器控制期望平方适应范数；(2)推导ZO的保留曲率精确恒等式，表明其保持各向同性保留下界；(3)提出RISE算法将校准的ZO形状应用于参数块内的精确FO梯度；(4)进行块级分析分离均值步骤损害与中心随机暴露。
AI.result: (1)发现ZO与FO的二次遗忘差距：当FO方向具有高于平均的保留曲率时，ZO以查询依赖的比例改善平均遗忘；(2)ZO通过保持各向同性保留下界同时仅收缩各向异性成分来降低遗忘；(3)RISE算法结合了ZO形状的稳定性优势与FO梯度的精确性。
AI.conclusion: ZO优化的抗遗忘优势源于随机整形特性，其在保留空间中具有独特的曲率处理方式。RISE算法成功将这一机制转移到精确梯度计算中，为稳定性-可塑性权衡提供了新的理论指导。块对角曲率、跨块耦合和局部整形诊断指明了精确梯度转移最可能显现的条件。

title: A Spectral Framework for Closed-Form Relative Density Estimation
summary: We propose a closed-form spectral framework for relative log-density estimation in linearly parameterized probabilistic models, including unnormalized and conditional models. This is achieved by representing the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence as an integral of weighted chi-squared divergences, converting KL estimation into a family of least-squares problems. We derive an explicit spectral formula based only on first- and second-order feature moments, yielding closed-form estimators of both divergences and log-density potentials for fixed features. The framework extends to a broad class of f-divergences and can be combined with kernelization or feature learning with neural networks. We prove convergence guarantees for the resulting estimators and empirically compare them on synthetic data with optimization-based variational formulations, including logistic and softmax regression for normalized conditional models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个闭式谱框架，用于线性参数化概率模型（含非归一化和条件模型）的相对对数密度估计，将KL散度估计转化为最小二乘问题族，仅需一阶和二阶特征矩即可获得显式解。
AI.motivation: 传统的概率模型密度估计通常涉及归一化常数的计算，这在许多模型中是难以处理的。现有的变分方法需要迭代优化，计算成本高且缺乏理论保证。本文旨在开发一个闭式、无需优化的框架，直接从特征矩估计相对对数密度，从而避免归一化常数问题。
AI.method: 核心方法是将KL散度表示为加权卡方散度的积分，从而将KL估计转化为一族最小二乘问题。基于此，推导出一个仅需一阶和二阶特征矩的显式谱公式，得到散度和对数密度势能的闭式估计器。该方法可扩展到更广泛的f-散度类，并可与核方法或神经网络特征学习结合。
AI.result: 理论上证明了所提估计器的收敛性保证。在合成数据上，将该闭式方法与基于优化的变分方法（包括用于归一化条件模型的逻辑回归和softmax回归）进行了实证比较，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个统一的理论框架，为相对对数密度估计提供了闭式解，具有坚实的理论保证和良好的可扩展性，为概率推断提供了一个无需迭代优化的高效替代方案。

title: Natural Policy Gradient as Doubly Smoothed Policy Iteration: A Bellman-Operator Framework
summary: In this work, we show that natural policy gradient, a core algorithm in reinforcement learning, admits an exact formulation as a smoothed and averaged form of policy iteration. Specifically, we introduce doubly smoothed policy iteration (DSPI), a Bellman-operator framework in which each policy is obtained by applying a regularized greedy step to a weighted average of past $Q$-functions. DSPI includes policy iteration, dual-averaged policy iteration, natural policy gradient, and more general policy dual averaging methods as special cases. Using only monotonicity and contraction of smoothed Bellman operators, we prove distribution-free global geometric convergence of DSPI. Consequently, standard natural policy gradient and policy dual averaging achieve an iteration complexity of $\mathcal{O}((1-γ)^{-1}\log((1-γ)^{-1}ε^{-1}))$ for computing an $ε$-optimal policy, without modifying the MDP, adding regularization beyond the mirror map inherent in the update, or using adaptive, trajectory-dependent stepsizes. For the unregularized greedy case, corresponding to dual-averaged policy iteration, we also prove finite termination. The same Bellman-operator framework further extends to discounted MDPs with linear function approximation and stochastic shortest path problems.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了强化学习中的自然策略梯度算法等价于一种双重平滑策略迭代形式，并基于此提出了统一的理论框架，证明了包括自然策略梯度在内的多类算法具有无需额外正则化或自适应步长的全局几何收敛速率。
AI.motivation: 尽管自然策略梯度（NPG）是强化学习中的核心算法，但其理论性质，尤其是收敛性分析，往往依赖于特定的修改（如修改MDP、额外正则化或自适应步长）或复杂的证明技巧。本文旨在建立一个简洁、统一的Bellman算子框架，从原理上揭示NPG的内在结构，并提供无需额外假设的全局收敛保证。
AI.method: 作者提出了双重平滑策略迭代（DSPI）框架。该框架将每次策略更新视为对过去Q函数加权平均后进行正则化贪婪步骤。DSPI统一了策略迭代、对偶平均策略迭代、自然策略梯度以及更一般的策略对偶平均方法。理论证明主要依赖于平滑Bellman算子的单调性和收缩性质。
AI.result: 证明了DSPI具有分布无关的全局几何收敛性。推导出标准自然策略梯度和策略对偶平均算法在计算ε-最优策略时，迭代复杂度为$\mathcal{O}((1-γ)^{-1}\log((1-γ)^{-1}ε^{-1}))$，且无需修改MDP、引入额外正则化（镜像映射固有的除外）或使用自适应步长。对于无正则化贪婪情形（对应对偶平均策略迭代），证明了其有限步终止性。该框架还扩展到了具有线性函数逼近的折扣MDP和随机最短路径问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过DSPI框架成功地将自然策略梯度阐释为一种精确的双重平滑策略迭代形式，为理解其收敛机制提供了直观且强有力的理论工具，显著简化并推广了相关算法的收敛性分析。

title: Compander-Aligned Query Geometry for Quantized Zeroth-Order Optimization
summary: Low-bit forward evaluation is an attractive route to memory-efficient zeroth-order (ZO) adaptation: the optimizer needs only scalar losses, and the model can be queried near deployment precision. The obstacle is that a quantized ZO query is not a continuous finite difference followed by harmless storage rounding. The query chooses endpoints, the low-precision engine rounds them, and the loss difference is measured along the rounded chord. For nonuniform companding quantizers, this makes the codebook insufficient to predict ZO behavior: a fixed weight-space radius can collapse in dense cells, over-span sparse cells, or assign a rounded chord to an unrounded update direction. We identify the missing object as query geometry and model scalar nonuniform quantization as $Q = φ^{-1} \circ U \circ φ$. CAQ-ZO (Compander-Aligned Queries for Zeroth-Order Optimization) forms one-grid-step Rademacher stencils $z \pm Δr$ in $z = φ(x)$, maps endpoints back through $φ^{-1}$, and updates in $z$. Our theory proves the grid-span mismatch, decomposes endpoint-rounding estimator residuals, and gives stationarity bounds in which generic off-grid queries retain a $Δ^2/μ^2$ residual channel while CAQ-ZO makes the query-time residual exactly zero. Synthetic experiments isolate this channel, and matched NF4 Qwen/Llama fine-tuning shows that CAQ-ZO improves the trained NF4 baseline under the same quantizer and evaluation budget.

AI.tldr: 提出CAQ-ZO方法，通过在压缩空间中对齐查询几何结构，解决了非均匀量化下零阶优化的网格不匹配问题，显著提升了NF4量化模型微调效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的低比特零阶优化方法在非均匀量化器下存在根本缺陷：量化后的查询不再是连续的有限差分，查询选择端点后被低精度引擎舍入，导致固定权重空间半径在密集单元坍塌、稀疏单元过度跨越或舍入弦方向错误。码本本身不足以预测ZO行为，缺少对查询几何的显式建模。
AI.method: 将标量非均匀量化建模为Q = φ⁻¹ ∘ U ∘ φ，提出CAQ-ZO（压缩器对齐查询）：在压缩空间z = φ(x)中形成单网格步长Rademacher模板z ± Δr，通过φ⁻¹映射回端点并在z空间更新，确保查询与量化网格对齐。理论证明了网格跨度不匹配，分解了端点舍入估计器残差。
AI.result: 理论证明：通用离网格查询存在Δ²/μ²残差通道，而CAQ-ZO使查询时残差精确为零。合成实验分离出该残差通道，NF4量化的Qwen/Llama微调实验表明，在相同量化器和评估预算下CAQ-ZO优于NF4训练基线。
AI.conclusion: 查询几何是非均匀量化零阶优化的关键缺失对象；通过在压缩空间对齐查询，CAQ-ZO消除了残差通道，为低比特前向评估的内存高效ZO适应提供了理论和实践支撑。

title: Exact Unlearning from Proxies Induces Closeness Guarantees on Approximate Unlearning
summary: This paper proposes a paradigm shift linking machine unlearning directly to the structure of the data distributions rather than a mere update of the neural network parameters. We show that inferring these distributions with precision enables distilling the exact unlearning signal induced by the modeling. Theoretical bounds on the Kullback-Leibler divergence from the ideal retrained model to our unlearned model, under verifiable admissibility criterion, reveal the soundness of our framework. This method is experimentally validated over three forgetting scenarios as reaching the closest classifier to the ideal retrained model when compared to competitors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于数据分布结构的机器遗忘新范式，通过精确推断分布来提取遗忘信号，理论上保证了与理想重训练模型的接近度。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器遗忘方法主要关注神经网络参数的更新，而忽略了数据分布结构在遗忘过程中的关键作用。本文旨在通过直接利用数据分布结构来提取精确的遗忘信号，填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于数据分布结构的机器遗忘框架，通过精确推断数据分布来提取由建模过程诱导的精确遗忘信号，并在可验证的容许性准则下，建立了遗忘模型与理想重训练模型之间KL散度的理论上界。
AI.result: 在三种遗忘场景下进行了实验验证，结果表明，该方法生成的分类器与理想重训练模型最为接近，性能优于其他竞争方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在理论和实验上均证明了其有效性，为机器遗忘领域提供了一种新的、基于数据分布结构的范式，推动了该领域的发展。

title: The finite expression method for turbulent dynamics with high-order moment recovery
summary: Turbulent dynamical systems are characterized by nonlinear interactions and stochastic effects that generate coupled statistical quantities, such as non-zero higher-order moments, which are difficult to capture from data with accuracy. We propose a two-stage data-driven modeling framework that combines symbolic regression with generative models to jointly identify the governing dynamics and predict their key statistical quantities. In Stage I of the framework, the Finite Expression Method (FEX) is adopted to discover closed-form expressions of the deterministic dynamics, recovering nonlinear interaction terms and external forcing without predefined libraries. In Stage II, generative models are introduced to learn the residual stochastic components as a refined correction to the model error from the Stage I approximation, enabling accurate characterization of higher-order statistics. Theoretical analysis establishes the consistency of the symbolic estimator and quantifies the estimation error in terms of data size and numerical discretization. The model performance is verified through detailed numerical experiments on the stochastic triad models across multiple regimes, demonstrating that the framework successfully recovers interaction terms and forcing expressions, and accurately predicts statistical moments up to order five. These results highlight the potential of integrating interpretable symbolic discovery with data-driven stochastic modeling for complex turbulent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个两阶段数据驱动建模框架，结合符号回归与生成模型，用于联合识别湍流动力系统的控制方程并准确预测高阶统计量。
AI.motivation: 湍流动力系统具有非线性相互作用和随机效应，会产生耦合的统计量（如非零高阶矩），这些统计量难以从数据中准确捕捉，因此需要一种能够同时识别动力学方程并精确预测关键统计量的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一个两阶段框架：第一阶段采用有限表达式方法（FEX）发现确定性动力学的闭式表达式，在无预定义库的情况下恢复非线性相互作用项和外强迫；第二阶段引入生成模型学习残差随机分量，作为对第一阶段近似误差的精细修正，从而实现对高阶统计特征的准确表征。
AI.result: 理论分析证明了符号估计器的一致性，并量化了关于数据大小和数值离散化的估计误差；在多种状态下的随机三波模型数值实验表明，该框架成功恢复了相互作用项和强迫表达式，并准确预测了高达五阶的统计矩。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果突显了将可解释的符号发现与数据驱动的随机建模相结合在复杂湍流系统建模中的潜力。

title: DANCE: Detect and Classify Events in EEG
summary: Event identification in continuous neural recordings is a critical task in neuroscience. Decoding in EEG is dominated by classifying windows aligned to known event onsets. However, while available in controlled experiments, such onsets are absent in continuous real-world monitoring. Here, we introduce DANCE, a deep learning pipeline that frames neural decoding as a set-prediction problem and jointly detects and classifies events directly from raw, unaligned signals. Evaluated separately on ten datasets curated from the literature with a wide variety of event types (ranging from milliseconds to minutes in duration), our model outperforms existing methods on a broad range of cognitive, clinical and BCI tasks. This single architecture establishes a new state of the art in the competitive task of seizure monitoring and matches the accuracy of onset-informed models for BCI tasks. Overall, our method marks a step towards end-to-end asynchronous neural decoding models

AI.tldr: 提出了DANCE，一种将神经解码构建为集合预测问题的深度学习流水线，能够直接从原始、未对齐的连续神经信号中联合检测和分类事件。该方法在十个数据集上表现优异，在癫痫监测任务中达到SOTA，在BCI任务中媲美依赖事件起始信息的模型。
AI.motivation: 传统的EEG解码依赖于对齐到已知事件起始点的窗口分类方法，但在现实世界的连续监测场景中，事件起始信息通常是未知的。这一局限性促使研究者开发能够在原始、未对齐信号中直接识别和分类事件的端到端方法。
AI.method: 提出DANCE深度学习流水线，将神经解码任务重构为集合预测问题。该架构无需事件起始时间先验信息，能够直接处理原始连续神经信号，联合实现事件的检测与分类，是一种端到端的异步神经解码方案。
AI.result: 在涵盖多种事件类型（时长从毫秒到分钟不等）的十个数据集上进行评估，DANCE在认知、临床和BCI等广泛任务中均优于现有方法。其在竞争激烈的癫痫监测任务中建立了新的SOTA，在BCI任务中达到了与依赖起始信息的模型相当的准确率。
AI.conclusion: DANCE方法成功实现了从依赖事件起始信息的传统解码向异步、端到端神经解码的转变，在广泛的神经科学应用中展现了优越性能，标志着向实用化的连续神经信号监测迈出了重要一步。

title: RelFlexformer: Efficient Attention 3D-Transformers for Integrable Relative Positional Encodings
summary: We present a new class of efficient attention mechanisms applying universal 3D Relative Positional Encoding (RPE) methods given by arbitrary integrable modulation functions $f$. They lead to the new class of 3D-Transformer models, called \textit{RelFlexformers}, flexibly integrating those RPEs, and characterized by the $O(L \log L)$ time complexity of the attention computation for the $L$-length input sequences. RelFlexformers builds on the theory of the Non-Uniform Fourier Transform (NU-FFT), naturally generalizing several existing efficient RPE-attention methods from structured settings with tokens homogeneously embedded in unweighted grids into general non-structured heterogeneous scenarios, where tokens' positions are arbitrarily distributed in the corresponding 3D spaces. As such, RelFlexformers can be applied in particular to model point clouds. Our extensive empirical evaluation on a large portfolio of 3D datasets confirms quality improvements provided by the NU-FFT-driven attention modulation techniques in the RelFlexformers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为RelFlexformers的新型3D-Transformer模型，通过通用3D相对位置编码（RPE）和非均匀傅里叶变换（NU-FFT）理论，实现了对非结构化三维数据（如点云）的高效注意力计算，时间复杂度为O(L log L)。
AI.motivation: 现有的高效相对位置编码注意力方法主要针对结构化场景（即令牌均匀嵌入在加权网格中），难以有效处理非结构化异构场景（如令牌位置在三维空间中任意分布的点云数据）。本文旨在解决这一局限性，提出一种能够灵活应用于任意三维分布数据的通用高效注意力机制。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于任意可积调制函数f的通用3D相对位置编码（RPE）方法；构建了名为RelFlexformers的新型3D-Transformer模型；利用非均匀傅里叶变换（NU-FFT）理论，将现有的结构化场景方法自然推广到非结构化异构场景，实现了注意力计算的O(L log L)时间复杂度。
AI.result: 在大量3D数据集上进行的广泛实证评估表明，RelFlexformers中基于NU-FFT驱动的注意力调制技术能够有效提升模型质量，验证了该方法在处理非结构化三维数据（如点云）时的优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功将高效RPE-注意力方法从结构化场景推广到非结构化异构场景，为点云等非结构化三维数据的建模提供了一种高效且高质量的解决方案。

title: What should post-training optimize? A test-time scaling law perspective
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed with test-time strategies: sample $N$ responses, score them with a reward model or verifier, and return the best. This deployment rule exposes a mismatch in post-training: standard objectives optimize the mean reward of a single response, whereas best-of-$N$ performance is governed by the upper tail of the reward distribution. Recent test-time-aware objectives partly address this mismatch, but typically assume that training can use the same per-prompt rollout budget as deployment, which is impractical when post-training must cover many prompts while deployment can allocate much larger per-prompt test-time compute. We study this budget-mismatch regime, where only $m\ll N$ per-prompt rollouts are available during training but the target objective is best-of-$N$ deployment. Under structural assumptions on the reward tails, we show that the policy gradient of the best-of-$N$ objective can be approximated from a much smaller rollout group by extrapolating upper-tail statistics. This yields a family of Tail-Extrapolated estimators for best-of-$N$-oriented post-training: a simple direct estimator, Tail-Extrapolated Advantage (TEA), and a fixed-order debiased Prefix-TEA estimator based on moment cancellation. Experiments on instruction-following tasks show that TEA and Prefix-TEA improve best-of-$N$ performance across different language models, reward models and datasets under various training and test-time budget settings.

AI.tldr: 提出TEA和Prefix-TEA估计器，通过外推上尾统计量，在训练时每提示仅使用m≪N个 rollout 的情况下，有效优化大语言模型的Best-of-N部署性能。
AI.motivation: 当前后训练目标优化单响应的平均奖励，而实际部署采用Best-of-N策略（选N个响应中最佳），由奖励分布的上尾决定性能，两者存在目标不匹配。现有方法假设训练时可使用与部署相同的每提示rollout预算，但在训练需覆盖大量提示而部署可分配大得多的每提示计算量时，该假设不切实际，形成预算不匹配问题。
AI.method: 研究预算不匹配机制（训练每提示m≪N个rollout，目标是Best-of-N部署）。在奖励尾部的结构假设下，证明Best-of-N目标的策略梯度可通过从更小的rollout组外推上尾统计量来近似。据此提出Tail-Extrapolated估计器族：(1)直接估计器Tail-Extrapolated Advantage (TEA)；(2)基于矩消除的固定阶去偏Prefix-TEA估计器。
AI.result: 在指令遵循任务上的实验表明，在不同语言模型、奖励模型和数据集以及各种训练与测试时预算设置下，TEA和Prefix-TEA均能提升Best-of-N性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法成功解决了训练与部署间的预算不匹配问题，为Best-of-N导向的后训练提供了实用且高效的梯度估计方案，显著提升了大语言模型的测试时部署性能。

title: Heteroscedastic Diffusion for Multi-Agent Trajectory Modeling
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI). Extended version of arXiv:2503.18589 (CVPR 2025)
summary: Multi-agent trajectory modeling traditionally focuses on forecasting, often neglecting more general tasks like trajectory completion, which is essential for real-world applications such as correcting tracking data. Existing methods also generally predict agents' states without offering any state-wise measure of heteroscedastic uncertainty. Moreover, popular multi-modal sampling methods lack error probability estimates for each generated scene under the same prior observations, which makes it difficult to rank the predictions at inference time. We introduce U2Diffine, a unified diffusion model built to perform trajectory completion while simultaneously offering state-wise heteroscedastic uncertainty estimates. This is achieved by augmenting the standard denoising loss with the negative log-likelihood of the predicted noise, and then propagating the latent space uncertainty to the real state space using a first-order Taylor approximation. We also propose U2Diff, a faster baseline that avoids gradient computation during sampling. This approach significantly increases inference speed, making it as efficient as a standard generative-only diffusion model. For post-processing, we integrate a Rank Neural Network (RankNN) that enables error probability estimation for each generated mode, demonstrating strong correlation with ground truth errors. Our method outperforms state-of-the-art solutions in both trajectory completion and forecasting across four challenging sports datasets (NBA, Basketball-U, Football-U, Soccer-U), underscoring the effectiveness of our uncertainty and error probability estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了U2Diffine统一扩散模型，实现了轨迹补全任务并同时提供状态级异方差不确定性估计，通过RankNN后处理模块实现预测结果排序，在四个体育数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹建模方法主要关注预测任务而忽视轨迹补全（对于校正跟踪数据等实际应用至关重要）；现有方法预测智能体状态时缺乏状态级异方差不确定性度量；流行的多模态采样方法无法估计同一先验观测下各生成场景的误差概率，导致推理时难以对预测结果排序。
AI.method: 提出U2Diffine统一扩散模型：通过在标准去噪损失中增加预测噪声的负对数似然来估计不确定性，并利用一阶泰勒近似将潜在空间不确定性传播到真实状态空间；提出U2Diff快速基线方法，避免采样时的梯度计算以显著提升推理速度；集成Rank Neural Network (RankNN)进行后处理，实现对每个生成模态的误差概率估计。
AI.result: 在四个具有挑战性的体育数据集（NBA、Basketball-U、Football-U、Soccer-U）上，该方法在轨迹补全和预测任务中均优于最先进的解决方案；不确定性估计和误差概率估计与真实误差表现出强相关性。
AI.conclusion: U2Diffine成功将轨迹补全与状态级异方差不确定性估计统一在同一扩散模型框架中，所提出的不确定性和误差概率估计方法有效，为多智能体轨迹建模提供了更完善的解决方案。

title: On Improving Graph Neural Networks for QSAR by Pre-training on Extended-Connectivity Fingerprints
summary: Molecular Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are increasingly common in drug discovery, particularly for Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship (QSAR) studies; yet, their superiority compared to classical molecular featurisation approaches is disputed. We report a general strategy for improving GNNs for QSAR by pre-training to predict Extended-Connectivity Fingerprints (ECFP). We validate our approach with statistical tests and challenging out-of-distribution (OOD) splits. Across five out of six Biogen benchmarks, we observed a statistically significant improvement in standard performance metrics over all evaluated baselines when using ECFP pre-trained GNNs. However, for more heterogeneous datasets and more complex endpoints, such as binding affinity prediction, pre-trained GNNs underperformed in OOD settings. Importantly, we investigated the impact of substructure-level data leakage during pre-training on downstream performance. While we identified scenarios where pre-training on ECFPs was less effective, our findings show that ECFP-based pre-training can enhance downstream OOD performance on a diverse set of practically relevant QSAR tasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出通过预训练图神经网络预测扩展连接指纹来提升QSAR任务性能，在多数基准测试中取得显著改进，但在异质性数据集和复杂任务（如结合亲和力预测）的分布外场景中表现欠佳。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络在药物发现QSAR研究中日益普及，但其相对于经典分子特征化方法的优势存在争议，亟需有效策略提升GNN在该领域的性能和可靠性。
AI.method: 提出一种通用策略：通过预训练GNN来预测扩展连接指纹，采用统计检验和具有挑战性的分布外划分进行验证，并系统研究预训练过程中子结构级数据泄露对下游性能的影响。
AI.result: 在Biogen六个基准测试中的五个上，ECFP预训练的GNN在标准性能指标上相对所有评估基线取得统计显著改进；但在更异质的数据集和更复杂的终点（如结合亲和力预测）的分布外设置中，预训练GNN表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明ECFP预训练可提升多种实用QSAR任务的下游分布外性能，但存在特定场景使其效果减弱；该方法为提升分子图神经网络在QSAR研究中的应用提供了有效途径。

title: Kernel-Gradient Drifting Models
summary: We propose kernel-gradient drifting, a one-step generative modeling framework that replaces the fixed Euclidean displacement direction in drifting models with directions induced by the kernel itself. Standard drifting is attractive because it enables fast, high-quality generation without distilling a large pretrained diffusion model, but its theory is currently understood mainly for Gaussian kernels, where the drift coincides with smoothed score matching and is identifiable. Our gradient-based reformulation exposes this score-based structure for general kernels: the resulting drift is the score difference between kernel-smoothed data and model distributions, yielding identifiability for characteristic kernels and a smoothed-KL descent interpretation of the drifting dynamics. Since kernel gradients are intrinsic tangent vectors, the same construction extends naturally to Riemannian manifolds and to discrete data via the Fisher-Rao geometry of the probability simplex. Across spherical geospatial data, promoter DNA and molecule generation, kernel-gradient drifting enables state-of-the-art one-step generation beyond the Euclidean setting without distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出核梯度漂移（kernel-gradient drifting）一步生成框架，通过使用核本身诱导的梯度方向替代固定欧几里得位移方向，实现了在欧氏空间、黎曼流形和离散数据上的最先进一步生成。
AI.motivation: 标准漂移模型虽然无需蒸馏大型预训练扩散模型即可实现快速高质量生成，但其理论目前主要局限于高斯核的理解。本文旨在通过基于梯度的重构，将漂移模型扩展到一般核函数，并揭示其与分数匹配的本质联系，从而扩展到更广泛的数据类型（黎曼流形、离散数据）。
AI.method: 提出了核梯度漂移框架：1）将固定欧几里得位移方向替换为核本身诱导的梯度方向；2）通过基于梯度的重构，揭示漂移是核平滑数据分布与模型分布之间的分数差；3）利用核梯度作为内在切向量，自然扩展到黎曼流形和离散数据（通过概率单纯形的Fisher-Rao几何）。
AI.result: 对于特征核，证明了漂移模型的可辨识性；提供了漂移动力学的平滑KL下降解释；在球面地理空间数据、启动子DNA和分子生成任务上，实现了超越欧氏环境的最先进一步生成性能，且无需蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: 核梯度漂移成功将一步生成模型从欧氏空间扩展到黎曼流形和离散数据，为生成模型提供了统一的几何视角，在多个实际应用中取得了最先进的性能，为非欧数据的生成建模开辟了新路径。

title: XQCfD: Accelerating Fast Actor-Critic Algorithms with Prior Data and Prior Policies
summary: For reinforcement learning in the real world online exploration is expensive A common practice in robotic reinforcement learning is to incorporate additional data to improve sample efficiency Expert demonstration data is often crucial for solving hard exploration tasks with sparse rewards While prior data is used to augment experience and pretrain models we show that the design of existing algorithms fails to achieve the sample efficiency that is possible in this setting due to a failure to use pretrained policies effectively We propose XQCfD which extends the sample-efficient XQC actor-critic to learn from demonstrations using augmented replay buffers pretrained policies and stationary policy architectures designed to avoid rapidly unlearning the strong initial policy like prior works We show our stationary network architecture enables policy improvement out-of-distribution better than standard network architectures due to its higher entropy predictions XQCfD achieves state of the art performance across a range of complex manipulation tasks with sparse rewards from the popular Adroit Robomimic and MimicGen benchmarks -- notably with a low update-to-data ratio and no ensemble networks

AI.tldr: 提出了XQCfD算法，通过改进预训练策略的使用方式、采用平稳网络架构，在稀疏奖励的复杂操作任务中实现了最先进的样本效率和性能。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中强化学习的在线探索成本高昂，现有的结合专家示范数据的算法未能有效利用预训练策略，导致样本效率低下，无法达到理论上的最优水平。
AI.method: 提出XQCfD算法，将样本高效的XQC actor-critic扩展为从示范中学习。该方法包含三个核心组件：增强回放缓冲区、预训练策略，以及为避免像先前工作那样快速“遗忘”强初始策略而设计的平稳策略网络架构。该平稳架构能产生更高的熵预测，从而实现更好的分布外策略改进。
AI.result: XQCfD在Adroit、Robomimic和MimicGen基准测试中一系列具有稀疏奖励的复杂操作任务上取得了最先进的性能。值得注意的是，该方法在低更新数据比（update-to-data ratio）且不使用集成网络的情况下实现了这一成果。
AI.conclusion: 通过设计平稳网络架构并有效结合预训练策略与回放缓冲区，XQCfD显著提升了从示范中学习的样本效率，证明了正确利用预训练策略对于解决稀疏奖励硬探索任务的重要性。

title: AdaPaD: Adaptive Parallel Deflation for PEFT with Self-Correcting Rank Discovery
summary: Fine-tuning large language models with LoRA requires choosing a rank r before training starts. Existing approaches either extract rank-1 components sequentially, freezing each component's error permanently into every subsequent residual, or optimize the full low-rank factorization jointly with guarantees that describe only the joint update, not individual rank-1 directions. We present AdaPaD (Adaptive Parallel Deflation), which trains all rank-1 components simultaneously: each worker refines its component against a deflation target built from the latest estimates of all predecessors, and as those estimates improve, the targets improve too. We call this property self-correction: deflation errors converge to zero over rounds rather than persisting as fixed residuals. On top of this backbone, AdaPaD adds advance learning (private pre-training before activation) and per-module dynamic rank discovery (importance-based growth until a shared budget is exhausted), making the rank distribution an output rather than an input. We prove that every component's error decays exponentially after a warm-up period, with a generalization bound that splits into a vanishing algorithmic term and an irreducible statistical floor. Empirically, AdaPaD is competitive with adaptive-rank LoRA baselines on GLUE with DeBERTaV3-base at matched parameter budgets, and competitive with fixed-rank LoRA on Qwen3-0.6B SQuAD/SQuAD v2 while deploying an adapter that is on average 30.7% smaller.
