AI.tldr: 提出了AdaPaD方法，通过自适应并行压缩机制实现LoRA微调中的动态秩发现，在保持性能的同时平均减少30.7%的适配器参数量。
AI.motivation: 现有LoRA微调方法需要在训练前预先固定秩r，且现有方法存在缺陷：顺序提取秩-1组件会将误差永久冻结到后续残差中，或联合优化时只能保证整体更新而无法描述单个秩-1方向的特性。需要一种能够自适应发现最优秩分布且避免误差累积的方法。
AI.method: 提出AdaPaD（自适应并行压缩）方法：1）所有秩-1组件并行训练，每个组件基于所有前驱组件的最新估计构建压缩目标；2）引入自校正特性，压缩误差随轮次收敛至零而非持久残留；3）添加预学习机制（激活前的私有预训练）；4）实现逐模块动态秩发现（基于重要性的增长机制直到共享预算耗尽），使秩分布成为输出而非输入。
AI.result: 理论上证明了每个组件的误差在预热期后呈指数衰减，泛化误差界可分解为可消失的算法项和不可约的统计下界。实验上：在GLUE基准上使用DeBERTaV3-base，在匹配参数预算下与自适应秩LoRA基线具有竞争力；在Qwen3-0.6B SQuAD/SQuAD v2上与固定秩LoRA竞争，同时适配器平均小30.7%。
AI.conclusion: AdaPaD成功解决了LoRA秩选择问题，通过并行自校正机制实现动态秩发现，在理论保证和实际性能上均表现优异，为大型语言模型的高效微调提供了新的解决方案。

title: Reinforce Adjoint Matching: Scaling RL Post-Training of Diffusion and Flow-Matching Models
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching models scale because pretraining is supervised regression: a clean sample is noised analytically, and a model regresses against a closed-form target. RL post-training aligns the model with a reward. In image generation, this makes samples compose objects correctly, render text legibly, and match human preferences. Existing methods rely on costly SDE rollouts, reward gradients, or surrogate losses, sacrificing pretraining's regression structure. We show that the structure extends to RL post-training. Under KL-regularized reward maximization, the optimal generative process tilts the clean-endpoint distribution towards samples with higher reward and leaves the noising law unchanged. Combining this with the adjoint-matching optimality condition and a REINFORCE identity, we derive Reinforce Adjoint Matching (RAM): a consistency loss that corrects the pretraining target with the reward. At each step, we draw a clean endpoint from the current model, evaluate its reward, noise it as in pretraining, and regress. No SDE rollouts, backward adjoint sweeps, or reward gradients are required. Like the pretraining objective, RAM is simple and scales. On Stable Diffusion 3.5M, RAM achieves the highest reward on composability, text rendering, and human preference, reaching Flow-GRPO's peak reward in up to $50\times$ fewer training steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Reinforce Adjoint Matching (RAM)方法，通过一致性损失将奖励信号融入预训练目标，无需SDE展开或奖励梯度，在Stable Diffusion 3.5M上以最高50倍训练步数效率提升达到最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型和流匹配模型的强化学习后训练方法依赖昂贵的SDE展开、奖励梯度或代理损失，牺牲了预训练的回归结构。作者希望将预训练的简单回归结构扩展到RL后训练阶段，以保持方法的简洁性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 在KL正则化奖励最大化框架下，理论证明最优生成过程将清洁端点分布向高奖励样本倾斜，而噪声化法则保持不变。结合伴随匹配最优性条件和REINFORCE恒等式，推导出RAM方法：从当前模型采样清洁端点，评估奖励，按预训练方式噪声化，然后回归。该方法无需SDE展开、反向伴随扫描或奖励梯度。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion 3.5M上的实验表明，RAM在组合性、文本渲染和人类偏好方面达到最高奖励，并以最高50倍更少的训练步数达到Flow-GRPO的峰值奖励。
AI.conclusion: RAM成功将预训练的回归结构扩展到RL后训练，保持了预训练目标式的简洁性和可扩展性，同时实现了显著的计算效率提升和性能改进，证明了保持预训练结构优势的重要性。

title: DynaMiCS: Fine-tuning LLMs with Performance Constraints using Dynamic Mixtures
summary: Multi-domain fine-tuning of large language models requires improving performance on target domains while preserving performance on constrained domains, such as general knowledge, instruction following, or safety evaluations. Existing data mixing strategies rely on fixed heuristics or adaptive rules that cannot explicitly enforce preservation of such capabilities. We propose DynaMiCS, a dynamic mixture optimizer that casts multi-domain fine-tuning as a constrained optimization problem. At each update, DynaMiCS performs short domain-specific probing runs to estimate a slope matrix of local cross-domain effects, capturing how training on each fine-tuning dataset affects each evaluation domain. These estimates are then used to compute mixture weights through optimization over the probability simplex, with the objective of improving target-domain performance while keeping constrained-domain losses below reference levels. Across multi-domain fine-tuning scenarios with varying numbers of target and constrained domains, DynaMiCS achieves stronger target-domain improvements and higher constraint satisfaction than fixed-mixture baselines, at lower computational cost and without reference models, per-example scoring, or manually tuned mixture weights.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DynaMiCS，一种动态混合优化器，将多领域微调建模为约束优化问题，通过估计局部跨领域影响来动态调整混合权重，在提升目标领域性能的同时满足约束领域的性能保持要求。
AI.motivation: 现有的多领域微调数据混合策略依赖于固定启发式或自适应规则，无法显式地保证对通用知识、指令遵循或安全性评估等约束领域能力的保持，因此需要一种能够明确强制执行约束的方法。
AI.method: DynaMiCS将多领域微调建模为约束优化问题。在每次更新时，执行短期领域特定探测运行来估计局部跨领域影响的斜率矩阵，捕捉每个微调数据集的训练如何影响每个评估领域。然后通过在概率单纯形上的优化来计算混合权重，目标是在保持约束领域损失低于参考水平的同时提升目标领域性能。
AI.result: 在不同数量的目标领域和约束领域的多领域微调场景中，DynaMiCS相比固定混合基线实现了更强的目标领域提升和更高的约束满足度，且计算成本更低，无需参考模型、逐样本评分或手动调整混合权重。
AI.conclusion: DynaMiCS为多领域大语言模型微调提供了一种高效的动态混合优化方案，通过约束优化显式保证了约束领域的性能保持，在效果和效率上均优于传统方法。

title: Locking Pretrained Weights via Deep Low-Rank Residual Distillation
summary: The quality of open-weight language models has dramatically improved in recent years. Sharing weights greatly facilitates model adoption by enabling their use across diverse hardware and software platforms. They also allow for more open research and testing, to the extent that users can use them as checkpoints, fine-tune them according to their needs, and potentially redistribute them. In some cases, however, concerns on modifying these weights towards unauthorized uses may outweigh the pros of giving users such a freedom. Defending against such adaptation is non-trivial: since an adaptive attacker can observe all weights and architectures by definition, they can reverse simple structural defenses, and use optimization to defeat the simplest locking mechanisms. In this work, we exploit the inference-training asymmetry of automatic differentiation as a novel defense axis. We propose DLR-Lock, a method where the purveyor of the model purposely replaces each pretrained MLP in their model with a deep low-rank residual network (DLR-Net) of comparable parameter count, forcing activation memory that grows linearly with depth during backpropagation. DLR-Nets are efficiently trained via module-wise distillation. We show that, beyond this memory overhead, DLR-Lock results in architectural mismatches that complicate the optimization landscape of standard fine-tuning, and a backward pass that incurs disproportionately more overhead than the forward pass. Our defense succeeds in withstanding adaptive attackers with full knowledge of the defense strategy while preserving the original model's capabilities. Experiments on LLM validate these claims.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DLR-Lock方法，通过将模型中的MLP替换为深度低秩残差网络（DLR-Net），利用自动微分的推理-训练不对称性来防御对开源语言模型权重的未授权修改，在保持模型能力的同时有效抵御自适应攻击。
AI.motivation: 开源语言模型权重共享虽然促进了模型应用和研究，但也带来了被未授权修改和滥用的风险。由于攻击者可以完全观测权重和架构，简单的防御机制（如结构防御）容易被逆向工程或优化攻击破解，因此需要开发更鲁棒的防御方法。
AI.method: 提出DLR-Lock防御方法，将模型中预训练的MLP模块替换为参数量相当的深度低秩残差网络（DLR-Net）。该方法利用自动微分的推理-训练不对称性：在反向传播过程中强制激活内存随深度线性增长，并通过模块级蒸馏高效训练DLR-Net。
AI.result: DLR-Lock引入了显著的内存开销，并造成架构不匹配，使得标准微调的优化景观变得复杂；反向传播的计算开销相比前向传播不成比例地增加。在完全了解防御策略的自适应攻击者面前，该方法仍能有效防御，同时保持原始模型的能力。实验验证了这些效果。
AI.conclusion: DLR-Lock成功利用推理-训练不对称性构建了一种有效的防御机制，能够在保持模型性能的前提下抵御自适应攻击，为开源模型权重保护提供了一种新思路。

title: Rebellious Student: Reversing Teacher Signals for Reasoning Exploration with Self-Distilled RLVR
summary: Self-distillation has emerged as a powerful framework for post-training LLMs, where a teacher conditioned on extra information guides a student without it, both from the same model. While this guidance is useful when the student has failed, on successful rollouts, the same mechanism instead overwrites the student's choices and suppresses it's own reasoning. Therefore, we propose reading the original self-distillation signal in reverse: when the student succeeds along a path the teacher would not have predicted, these tokens reflect its self-driven reasoning. Building on this, we propose RLRT (RLVR with Reversed Teacher), which augments GRPO by reinforcing these tokens on correct rollouts. We interpret this as a new form of exploration in RLVR: not uniform diversity, but valuable exploration grounded in the student's own success. Across base, instruction-tuned, and thinking-tuned Qwen3 checkpoints, RLRT substantially outperforms self-distillation and exploration-based baselines, establishing information asymmetry as a new, principled design axis for RLVR.

AI.tldr: 提出RLRT方法，通过反转自蒸馏信号，在学生模型成功时强化其自身推理，而非被教师模型覆盖，在多个Qwen3模型上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有自蒸馏框架在学生模型成功时，教师模型的指导会覆盖学生自身的推理选择，抑制其自主推理能力，存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出RLRT（RLVR with Reversed Teacher）方法，反转自蒸馏信号：当学生模型在教师模型未预测的路径上成功时，强化这些反映自主推理的token。这是一种基于学生自身成功的有价值探索形式，而非传统的均匀多样性探索。
AI.result: 在基础版、指令调优版和思维调优版的Qwen3检查点上，RLRT显著优于自蒸馏和基于探索的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 确立了信息不对称作为RLVR的一个新的、有原则的设计轴，为强化学习框架提供了新的设计思路。

title: MASS-DPO: Multi-negative Active Sample Selection for Direct Policy Optimization
summary: Multi-negative preference optimization under the Plackett--Luce (PL) model extends Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) by leveraging comparative signals across one preferred and multiple rejected responses. However, optimizing over large negative pools is costly, and many candidates contribute redundant gradients due to their similar effects on policy updates. We introduce MASS-DPO, a multi-negative active sample selection method that derives a PL-specific Fisher-information objective for selecting compact, informative negative subsets within each prompt. The resulting log-determinant objective selects negatives that contribute complementary information for policy updates, yielding compact subsets that retain the full pool's information while reducing redundancy. In practice, this favors negatives whose gradients cover different update directions, reducing redundant signal from near-duplicate candidates while preserving the most useful training information. Across four benchmarks spanning recommendation and multiple-choice QA and three model families, MASS-DPO consistently exceeds or matches existing methods in accuracy, improves Recall/NDCG and margin-based optimization dynamics, and delivers stronger alignment with substantially fewer negatives.

AI.tldr: 提出MASS-DPO方法，通过基于PL模型特定Fisher信息的对数行列式目标主动选择负样本子集，在减少冗余负样本的同时保持训练信息，实现了更高效的偏好优化。
AI.motivation: 在多负样本偏好优化中，大规模负样本池导致优化成本高昂，且许多候选样本因对策略更新影响相似而产生冗余梯度，造成计算资源浪费。
AI.method: 提出MASS-DPO（多负样本主动采样选择）方法，针对Plackett-Luce模型推导特定的Fisher信息目标，通过log-determinant目标函数选择紧凑且信息丰富的负样本子集，优先选择梯度覆盖不同更新方向的负样本以减少冗余信号。
AI.result: 在推荐和多选问答的四个基准测试及三个模型家族上的实验表明，MASS-DPO在准确率上持续超越或匹配现有方法，在Recall/NDCG和边际优化动态方面有所改善，使用更少负样本即可实现更强的对齐效果。
AI.conclusion: MASS-DPO成功解决了多负样本偏好优化中的冗余问题，通过主动选择互补信息的负样本子集，在保持性能的同时显著降低了计算成本，为大规模偏好学习提供了高效解决方案。

title: Elucidating Representation Degradation Problem in Diffusion Model Training
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success, yet their training remains inefficient due to a severe optimization bottleneck, which we term Representation Degradation. As noise levels increase, the outputs of the trained model exhibit progressive structural distortion, which can destabilize training and impair generation quality. Our analysis suggests that this instability is driven by mismatched target recoverability, which is associated with Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) spectral weakening and effective low-rank behavior. To address this, we propose Elucidated Representation Diffusion (ERD), a plug-and-play framework that dynamically reallocates optimization effort according to effective recoverability. By stabilizing representation learning without external supervision, ERD accelerates convergence and achieves strong empirical performance across diffusion backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ERD框架，通过解决扩散模型中的表示退化问题来加速训练并提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型训练存在严重的优化瓶颈：随着噪声水平增加，模型输出出现渐进式结构失真（表示退化），导致训练不稳定并损害生成质量。分析表明这种不稳定性源于目标可恢复性不匹配，与神经正切核（NTK）谱弱化和有效低秩行为相关。
AI.method: 提出Elucidated Representation Diffusion (ERD)框架，这是一种即插即用的方法，根据有效可恢复性动态重新分配优化资源，在不依赖外部监督的情况下稳定表示学习过程。
AI.result: ERD加速了收敛速度，并在多种扩散骨干网络上实现了强大的实证性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态调整优化努力来应对表示退化问题，ERD框架有效改善了扩散模型的训练效率和生成质量。

title: ConQuR: Corner Aligned Activation Quantization via Optimized Rotations for LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are costly to deploy due to their large memory footprint and high inference cost. Weight-activation quantization can reduce these costs, but low-bit activation quantization remains difficult because activation outliers induce large quantization error. Recent rotation-based methods address this by applying orthogonal transformations that redistribute activation magnitude across dimensions, but existing approaches either require expensive end-to-end rotation training or rely on stored activation corpora, introducing significant compute or storage overhead. We propose a lightweight post-training rotation calibration method for LLM activation quantization. Our method learns orthogonal rotations that align normalized activations with the corners of an inscribed hypercube, encouraging activation energy to be distributed more evenly across dimensions. This objective admits an efficient closed-form update via the orthogonal Procrustes problem, avoiding gradient-based optimization over the orthogonal group. We further introduce an online calibration procedure that updates rotations as calibration samples are processed, eliminating the need to store activations on disk and allowing rotations to adapt to quantized activation distributions during calibration. Experiments on Llama-2 and Llama-3 models from 3B to 70B parameters show that our method achieves competitive or improved performance across perplexity benchmarks and common sense reasoning tasks while avoiding both costly end-to-end training and large offline activation storage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级的后训练旋转校准方法，用于大语言模型的激活量化。该方法通过学习正交旋转将归一化激活与超立方体顶角对齐，实现了无需端到端训练和离线激活存储的高效低比特量化。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型部署成本高昂，现有的权重-激活量化方法在低比特激活量化时面临激活异常值导致的量化误差问题。现有的旋转方法要么需要昂贵的端到端旋转训练，要么依赖存储的激活语料库，带来了显著的算力或存储开销。
AI.method: 提出了一种轻量级后训练旋转校准方法。该方法学习正交旋转，将归一化激活与内接超立方体的角点对齐，促使激活能量在维度间更均匀分布。通过正交普氏问题（Orthogonal Procrustes Problem）实现高效的闭式更新，避免了在正交群上的梯度优化。同时引入在线校准程序，在校准样本处理过程中更新旋转，无需磁盘存储激活，并允许旋转在校准期间适应量化后的激活分布。
AI.result: 在Llama-2和Llama-3模型（3B至70B参数）上的实验表明，该方法在困惑度基准和常识推理任务中取得了竞争性或更优的性能，同时避免了昂贵的端到端训练和大规模离线激活存储。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功实现了无需高昂训练成本和存储开销的有效激活量化，为大语言模型的高效部署提供了一种轻量级且性能优异的解决方案。

title: Muown: Row-Norm Control for Muon Optimization
summary: Muon has emerged as a strong competitor to AdamW for language model pre-training, yet its behavior at scale is sensitive to weight decay. Recent work has observed that, for Muon without decoupled weight decay, the spectral norm of weight matrices drifts upward over training. Through a decomposition of the spectral norm into a row-magnitude factor and a row-coherence factor, we identify the former as the empirical driver of this drift under Muon, while the latter remains well-behaved along the trajectory. Motivated by this diagnosis, we introduce Muown, a drop-in replacement for Muon that treats the row-magnitude vector as an explicit optimizer variable, updating it under the $\ell_\infty$ geometry induced by the decomposition, while applying Muon unchanged to the remaining direction component. We prove that Muown attains the optimal non-convex rates in both deterministic and stochastic regimes under a dual norm aligned with the underlying geometries and with a stochastic noise coefficient that empirically remains below that of Muon throughout training. Across GPT-style pre-training on FineWeb-Edu with model sizes from 124M up to 2.7B parameters, Muown improves perplexity over Muon, SOAP, AdamW, and Lion. It also widens the plateau of near-optimal learning rates across model scales, reduces sensitivity to weight decay, and avoids the spectral norm drift at negligible step-time overhead when appropriately sharded.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Muown优化器，作为Muon的改进版本，通过显式处理行幅值向量解决了Muon在大规模训练中的谱范数漂移问题，在GPT预训练中显著提升了性能并降低了对权重衰减的敏感性。
AI.motivation: Muon已成为AdamW的有力竞争者，但在大规模训练中对权重衰减敏感。现有研究发现，不带解耦权重衰减的Muon会导致权重矩阵的谱范数在训练过程中向上漂移。本文旨在理解和解决这一问题。
AI.method: 首先将谱范数分解为行幅值因子和行相干因子，识别出行幅值因子是导致漂移的主要原因。基于此诊断，提出Muown优化器：将行幅值向量视为显式优化变量，在分解诱导的ℓ∞几何下更新，同时对剩余方向分量应用原始Muon优化。
AI.result: 在FineWeb-Edu数据集上进行了124M到2.7B参数规模的GPT预训练实验。Muown相比Muon、SOAP、AdamW和Lion均降低了困惑度。同时扩大了近最优学习率的平台区域，降低了对权重衰减的敏感性，并在分片处理时以可忽略的时间开销避免了谱范数漂移。
AI.conclusion: Muown成功解决了Muon的谱范数漂移问题，在理论和实践上都表现出色。理论证明其在确定性和随机机制下均能达到最优非凸收敛率，实证结果验证了其在大规模语言模型预训练中的有效性和鲁棒性。

title: Mistake-Bounded Language Generation
summary: We investigate the learning task of language generation in the limit, but shift focus from the traditional time-of-last-mistake metric of a generator's success to a new notion of "mistake-bounded generation." While existing results for language generation in the limit focus on guaranteeing eventual consistency, they are blind to the cumulative error incurred during the learning process. We address this by shifting the goal to minimizing the total number of invalid elements output by a generation algorithm. We establish a formal reduction to the Learning from Correct Demonstrations framework of Joshi et al. (2025), enabling a general recipe for deriving mistake bounds via weighted update rules. For finite classes, we provide an algorithm that simultaneously achieves an optimal last-mistake time of $\mathsf{Cdim}(L)$ and a mistake bound of $\lfloor \log_2 |L| \rfloor$, whereas for the non-uniform setting of countably infinite streams of languages, we prove a fundamental trade-off: achieving logarithmic mistakes $O(\log i)$ necessarily precludes convergence guarantees established in prior work. Finally, we show that our framework can be extended to accommodate noisy adversaries and guarantee mistake bounds that scale with the adversary's suboptimality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“有界错误生成”新范式，关注学习过程中累积错误总数而非仅保证最终一致性。通过归约至“正确示范学习”框架，为有限类给出同时最优的末次错误时间和错误界算法，揭示可数无限语言流中对数错误界与收敛保证间的内在权衡，并将理论扩展至对抗噪声场景。
AI.motivation: 传统的极限语言生成研究聚焦于“末次错误时间”指标，仅保证最终一致性，却忽视了学习过程中累积产生的无效输出总量。为弥补这一盲点，研究旨在最小化生成算法输出的无效元素总数，从而量化并控制学习过程中的错误代价。
AI.method: 建立到Joshi等人（2025）“正确示范学习”框架的形式归约，利用加权更新规则推导错误界。针对有限语言类设计具体算法；对可数无限语言流进行理论分析；将框架扩展以容纳噪声对抗者。
AI.result: 有限类：算法同时实现最优末次错误时间Cdim(L)与错误界⌊log₂|L|⌋。可数无限流：证明基本权衡——实现O(log i)对数错误必然无法满足先前工作建立的收敛保证。扩展结果：在噪声对抗设定下，错误界随对抗者的次优性成比例扩展。
AI.conclusion: 将语言生成的评估从“最终一致性”推进至“累积错误控制”，建立了系统的理论框架与算法工具，揭示了有限与无限设定下的能力边界与权衡，为后续生成式学习算法的设计提供了新的理论指导。

title: Likelihood scoring for continuations of mathematical text: a self-supervised benchmark with tests for shortcut vulnerabilities
summary: We introduce an automatically generated benchmark for predicting hidden text in technical papers. A paper supplies visible context $X$ and a hidden continuation $Y$; the evaluated model writes an auxiliary forecast string $Z$, and a separate scorer assigns next-token probability to $Y$ both with and without conditioning on $Z$. This gives a label-free test of whether $Z$ transmits information about the continuation, compared against controls where $Z$ is recent context rather than a forecast. Our main testbed is equation-suffix prediction: the predictor sees context and the first part of a displayed equation, then forecasts the rest. The task mixes surface-level arXiv/TeX text modeling with reasoning-sensitive inference; the suffix is one of many roughly equivalent continuations, so the benchmark is read statistically rather than item-by-item. On 1363 equation continuations from 138 recent physics and mathematics papers, forecasts from GPT-5.5, Opus 4.7, and GPT-5.4 nano all improve clipped likelihood over the context control under both Qwen3-8B and Kimi K2.6 scorers, distinguishing model families and reasoning-effort settings without human labels. To emulate shortcuts where $Z$ further primes the scorer rather than making a useful forecast, we also fine-tune the scorer on context-only prompts and apply it to held-out papers as a stronger control. GPT-5.5 forecasts still beat this fine-tuned control; GPT-5.4 nano forecasts do not. Longer prose/TeX continuations show positive but noisier lift over controls, concentrated near the beginning of the target. These results support cross-model likelihood scoring as a static benchmark and as a setup for probing shortcut vulnerabilities before reinforcement learning or model-selection optimization is applied.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个自动生成的基准测试，用于评估模型预测技术论文隐藏文本的能力，通过跨模型似然评分区分不同模型家族和推理努力设置。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试依赖人工标注，成本高且难以规模化。作者希望开发一种无需人工标签的自动化评估方法，用于测试模型在技术论文语境下的推理和预测能力，特别是针对隐藏文本的预测。
AI.method: 构建方程后缀预测任务作为主要测试平台。模型可见上下文X和方程前半部分，生成辅助预测字符串Z。使用独立的评分器分别计算有Z条件和无条件下的下一token概率，判断Z是否传递了关于隐藏续写Y的信息。控制组使用近期上下文而非预测作为基线。为防止捷径攻击，还对评分器进行仅上下文提示的微调作为更强控制。
AI.result: 在来自138篇近期物理和数学论文的1363个方程续写上，GPT-5.5、Opus 4.7和GPT-5.4 nano的预测均改善了相对于上下文控制的裁剪似然（使用Qwen3-8B和Kimi K2.6评分器）。GPT-5.5预测击败微调控制，而GPT-5.4 nano未能做到。更长文本续写显示正向但噪声较大的提升，集中在目标开头附近。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型似然评分可作为静态基准测试，有效区分模型家族和推理努力设置，无需人工标签。该方法还可用于在强化学习或模型选择优化之前探测捷径漏洞，为自动化评估提供了可行路径。

title: On periodic distributed representations using Fourier embeddings
summary: Periodic signals are critical for representing physical and perceptual phenomena. Scalar, real angular measures, e.g., radians and degrees, result in difficulty processing and distinguishing nearby angles, especially when their absolute difference exceeds pi. We can avoid this problem by using real-valued, periodic embeddings in high-dimensional space. These representations also allow us to control the nature of their dot product similarities, allowing us to construct a variety of different kernel shapes. In this work, we aim of highlight how these representations can be constructed and focus on the formalization of Dirichlet and periodic Gaussian kernels using the neurally-plausible representation scheme of Spatial Semantic Pointers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用高维实值周期性嵌入（特别是Spatial Semantic Pointers）来表示角度等周期信号，解决了传统标量角度表示在处理相近角度时的区分困难问题，并形式化了Dirichlet和周期性高斯核。
AI.motivation: 传统的标量实数角度表示（如弧度和度数）在处理周期信号时存在困难，特别是当两个相近角度的绝对差值超过π时难以区分。这种局限性促使研究者寻找更好的周期信号表示方法。
AI.method: 采用高维空间中的实值周期性嵌入来表示角度，使用Spatial Semantic Pointers这种神经可解释的表示方案，通过控制点积相似度来构建不同形状的核函数，重点形式化Dirichlet核和周期性高斯核。
AI.result: 成功展示了如何构建高维周期性嵌入表示，并形式化了基于Spatial Semantic Pointers的Dirichlet核和周期性高斯核，这些表示方法避免了传统角度表示的区分困难问题，同时提供了可控的相似度核形状。
AI.conclusion: 高维实值周期性嵌入为周期信号处理提供了有效解决方案，Spatial Semantic Pointers表示方案能够自然地实现Dirichlet和周期性高斯核，为周期性物理和感知现象的建模提供了新途径。

title: Benchmarking Sensor-Fault Robustness in Forecasting
summary: Cyber-physical system (CPS) forecasting models depend on sensor streams with noisy, biased, missing, or temporally misaligned readings, yet standard forecasting evaluation often selects models by nominal error without showing whether they remain robust under such faults. We introduce SensorFault-Bench, a shared CPS-grounded sensor-fault stress-test protocol for evaluating forecasting architectures and robustness-improvement methods, and an operational taxonomy organizing the method comparison. Across four real-world datasets and eight scored scenarios governed by a standardized severity model, it reports worst-scenario degradation, clean mean squared error (MSE), and worst-scenario fault-time MSE, separating relative robustness from absolute error. A disjoint fault-transfer split lets explicit fault-training methods train on adjacent fault families while evaluation uses separate benchmark scenarios. Empirically, forecasting architectures favored by clean MSE can degrade sharply under faults, and clean-MSE rankings can disagree with worst-scenario fault-time error rankings. Chronos-2, the evaluated zero-shot foundation-model representative, matches or trails the last-value naive forecaster in clean MSE on the two single-target datasets and has the largest worst-scenario degradation on ETTh1 and Traffic, where all channels are forecast targets. For the evaluated robustness-improvement method set, paired deltas show selective degradation reductions: projected gradient descent adversarial training and randomized training lead where value faults dominate observed degradation, while fault augmentation leads where availability faults dominate. SensorFault-Bench provides open-source code, documented data access, and reproduction and extension guides, so new datasets, architectures, and robustness-improvement methods can be evaluated under the same CPS sensor-fault robustness protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出了SensorFault-Bench，一种用于评估信息物理系统(CPS)预测模型在传感器故障下鲁棒性的标准化基准测试协议，发现仅依赖清洁数据上的MSE指标可能误导模型选择。
AI.motivation: 现有的CPS预测模型评估通常仅基于名义误差选择模型，而未验证其在传感器故障（噪声、偏差、缺失、时间错位）条件下的鲁棒性，导致可能选择了在故障下性能急剧下降的模型。
AI.method: 引入SensorFault-Bench基准测试协议，包含：一个操作化分类法组织方法比较；在四个真实数据集和八个评分场景上进行测试；采用标准化的严重性模型；使用不相交的故障迁移分割，让显式故障训练方法在相邻故障族上训练；报告最坏场景退化、清洁MSE和最坏场景故障时间MSE等指标。
AI.result: 实验发现：清洁MSE优选的预测架构在故障下可能急剧退化，清洁MSE排名与最坏场景故障时间误差排名可能不一致；零样本基础模型Chronos-2在单目标数据集上清洁MSE与朴素预测器相当，但在多目标数据集上有最大退化；不同鲁棒性改进方法在不同故障类型下效果不同：PGDG对抗训练和随机训练在数值故障主导时领先，故障增强在可用性故障主导时领先。
AI.conclusion: SensorFault-Bench为CPS传感器故障鲁棒性评估提供了标准化的开源基准，能够区分相对鲁棒性与绝对误差，帮助研究者在相同协议下评价新数据集、架构和鲁棒性改进方法，避免仅依赖清洁数据指标导致的模型选择风险。

title: NoRIN: Backbone-Adaptive Reversible Normalization for Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Reversible instance normalization (RevIN) and its successors (Dish-TS, SAN, FAN) have become the de facto plug-in for time-series forecasting, yet the map they apply to each data point is strictly affine, $x \mapsto ax+b$, so they cannot reshape the underlying distribution -- heavy tails remain heavy and skewness remains uncorrected. We propose NoRIN, a non-linear reversible normalization based on the arcsinh-form Johnson $S_U$ transform with two shape parameters $(δ,\varepsilon)$ that control tailedness and skewness; the linear $Z$-score used by RevIN is recovered only in the limit $δ\to \infty$. Training $(δ,\varepsilon)$ jointly with the backbone via gradient descent reliably pushes them toward this linear limit within a few epochs -- a phenomenon we name the degeneration problem: the forecasting loss is locally indifferent to shape, and the high-capacity backbone compensates for any monotone reparameterization of its input. NoRIN escapes the degeneration by decoupling shape selection from gradient training: $(δ,\varepsilon)$ are initialized by a closed-form Slifker-Shapiro quantile fit and refined by Bayesian optimization on the validation objective, while the inner training loop is identical to standard RevIN-style training. Across six representative backbones x five real-world datasets x three prediction horizons (90 configurations), decoupled shape optimization recovers $(δ^\star,\varepsilon^\star)$ that sit systematically far from the linear limit, with values that vary in a backbone-dependent way. This empirically supports the central thesis: different backbones genuinely require different normalization parameters to reach their best performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NoRIN，一种基于Johnson $S_U$变换的非线性可逆归一化方法，通过解耦形状参数优化解决了RevIN等线性归一化方法无法调整分布形状的限制及其训练中的退化问题，证明了不同骨干网络需要不同的归一化参数。
AI.motivation: 现有的可逆实例归一化方法（RevIN及其后续方法Dish-TS、SAN、FAN）仅应用仿射变换$x \mapsto ax+b$，无法改变数据分布的根本形状——重尾仍然保持重尾，偏度无法修正。此外，当通过梯度下降联合训练形状参数时，会快速退化为线性极限（退化问题），因为预测损失对形状局部不敏感，高容量骨干网络会补偿任何单调重参数化。
AI.method: 提出NoRIN方法：基于arcsinh形式的Johnson $S_U$变换，引入两个形状参数$(\delta,\varepsilon)$分别控制尾部特性与偏度。核心创新是将形状选择与梯度训练解耦：$(\delta,\varepsilon)$通过Slifker-Shapiro分位数拟合进行闭式初始化，然后在验证目标上通过贝叶斯优化进行精炼，而内部训练循环与标准RevIN训练相同。
AI.result: 在6个代表性骨干网络×5个真实数据集×3个预测时长（共90个配置）的实验中，解耦形状优化得到的$(\delta^\star,\varepsilon^\star)$系统性地远离线性极限，且取值以骨干网络相关的方式变化。实证结果表明不同骨干网络确实需要不同的归一化参数以达到最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 本工作建立了核心论点：不同骨干网络真正需要不同的归一化参数。NoRIN通过非线性变换成功扩展了可逆归一化的能力，使其能够重塑数据分布的尾部特性和偏度，而非仅限于线性缩放。解耦优化策略有效避免了梯度训练中的退化问题，为时间序列预测中的归一化方法提供了新思路。

title: Conditional anomaly detection methods for patient-management alert systems
comment: Published at Workshop on Machine Learning in Health Care Applications ICML-2008 - MLHealth
summary: Anomaly detection methods can be very useful in identifying unusual or interesting patterns in data. A recently proposed conditional anomaly detection framework extends anomaly detection to the problem of identifying anomalous patterns on a subset of attributes in the data. The anomaly always depends (is conditioned) on the value of remaining attributes. The work presented in this paper focuses on instance-based methods for detecting conditional anomalies. The methods rely on the distance metric to identify examples in the dataset that are most critical for detecting the anomaly. We investigate various metrics and metric learning methods to optimize the performance of the instance-based anomaly detection methods. We show the benefits of the instance-based methods on two real-world detection problems: detection of unusual admission decisions for patients with the community-acquired pneumonia and detection of unusual orders of an HPF4 test that is used to confirm Heparin induced thrombocytopenia - a life-threatening condition caused by the Heparin therapy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于实例的条件异常检测方法，通过优化距离度量，在两个医疗实际问题中验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的条件异常检测框架旨在识别数据子集属性上的异常模式，其异常判定依赖于剩余属性的值。为了提高条件异常检测的性能，本文专注于基于实例的检测方法，并研究如何通过优化距离度量来提升检测效果。
AI.method: 提出基于实例的条件异常检测方法，该方法依赖于距离度量来识别数据集中对异常检测最关键的样本。研究了多种度量标准和度量学习方法，以优化基于实例的异常检测方法的性能。
AI.result: 在两个实际医疗检测问题上验证了方法的有效性：社区获得性肺炎患者的异常入院决策检测，以及用于确诊肝素诱导的血小板减少症（HIT）的HPF4检测异常指令检测。实验结果表明优化后的距离度量能显著提升检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于实例的条件异常检测方法配合适当的度量学习方法，能够有效识别医疗数据中的条件异常模式，对临床决策支持具有重要价值。该研究为医疗领域的异常检测提供了实用且可靠的解决方案。

title: Compute Where it Counts: Self Optimizing Language Models
summary:
Efficient LLM inference research has largely focused on reducing the cost of each decoding step (e.g., using quantization, pruning, or sparse attention), typically applying a uniform computation budget to every generated token. In practice, token difficulty varies widely, so static compression can over-compute on easy steps and under-compute on hard ones. We study dynamic budget allocation for autoregressive decoding: learning how much computation to spend per token from within a single model.
  Self-Optimizing Language Models (SOL) pair a frozen LLM with a lightweight policy network that reads the LLM hidden state and selects a discrete efficiency action at each decode step. Actions can jointly control (i) token-level attention sparsity, (ii) structured activation pruning in the MLP, and (iii) activation quantization bit-width, while leaving the base model weights unchanged. We train the policy with group-relative policy optimization on teacher-forced episodes: the token sequence is fixed, while we sample multiple compute schedules (i.e., "counterfactual" schedules that vary only the efficiency actions for the same token path) and compare their likelihoods under the same supervision. Our reward trades off language-model quality against soft penalties that encourage episode-average budget usage to match a requested target. Across model variants and compute regimes, SOL improves quality at matched budget over static allocation and strong random schedule search, offering a complementary axis for inference-efficiency optimization. SOL discovers a better quality-efficiency pareto-front across all our experiments and improves MMLU accuracy by up to 7.3% over uniform budget allocation strategies.

AI.tldr: 提出自优化语言模型(SOL)，通过轻量级策略网络动态分配每个解码步骤的计算预算（控制注意力稀疏性、MLP剪枝和量化位宽），在相同预算下相比静态分配策略提升MMLU准确率高达7.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理效率研究通常对每个生成token应用统一的计算预算，但token难度差异很大，静态压缩容易在简单步骤上过度计算，在困难步骤上计算不足。因此需要研究自回归解码的动态预算分配机制。
AI.method: 提出自优化语言模型(SOL)，将冻结的LLM与轻量级策略网络配对，策略网络读取LLM隐藏状态并在每个解码步骤选择离散效率动作。动作可联合控制：(i) token级注意力稀疏性，(ii) MLP中的结构化激活剪枝，(iii) 激活量化位宽。使用群体相对策略优化在教师强制轮次上训练策略，奖励函数平衡语言模型质量与鼓励满足目标预算的软惩罚。
AI.result: 在所有模型变体和计算机制下，SOL在匹配预算时相比静态分配和强随机调度搜索提升了质量。SOL在所有实验中发现了更好的质量-效率帕累托前沿，相比统一预算分配策略MMLU准确率提升高达7.3%。
AI.conclusion: SOL为推理效率优化提供了一个互补的研究方向，证明了学习动态计算预算分配的有效性，能够在不改变基础模型权重的情况下实现更好的质量-效率权衡。

title: Neural Weight Norm = Kolmogorov Complexity
summary: Why does weight decay work? We prove that, in any fixed-precision regime, the smallest weight norm of a looped neural network outputting a binary string equals the Kolmogorov complexity of that string, up to a logarithmic factor. This implies that weight decay induces a prior matching Solomonoff's universal prior, the optimal prior over computable functions, up to a polynomial factor. The result is norm-agnostic: in fixed precision, every weight norm collapses to the non-zero parameter count up to constants, so the same sandwich bound holds for any norm used as a regulariser. The proof has two short reductions: any program for a universal Turing machine can be encoded into neural weights at unit cost per program bit, and any fixed-precision network can be described by enumerating its non-zero parameters with logarithmic addressing overhead. Both bounds are tight up to constants, with the logarithmic factor realised by permutation encodings: a network whose parameters encode a permutation produces a string whose Kolmogorov complexity is the non-zero parameter count times its logarithm. The fixed-precision assumption is essential: with infinite precision, neural networks can encode non-computable functions and the weight norm loses its relevance.

AI.tldr: 该论文从计算理论角度揭示了权重衰减的本质：它使神经网络获得了一个近似所罗门诺夫通用先验的归纳偏置，从而偏好更简单的函数。
AI.motivation: 解释权重衰减（即L2正则化）为何在实践中有效。传统观点认为其限制模型容量，但缺乏理论解释。本文旨在建立权重衰减与算法信息论（Kolmogorov复杂度）之间的严格理论联系，揭示其通过最小化权重范数实现对简单函数偏好的内在机制。
AI.method: 在固定精度设定下，通过两个归约步骤证明：1）任何通用图灵机程序可编码到神经网络权重中，单位成本为每程序比特；2）任何固定精度网络可通过枚举非零参数描述，仅需对数级地址开销。证明得出最小权重范数与输出字符串的Kolmogorov复杂度在仅差一个对数因子的意义上相等。此外，证明了在固定精度下任何权重范数均坍缩为非零参数计数（仅差常数因子）。
AI.result: 证明了在固定精度情况下，输出二进制字符串的循环神经网络的最小权重范数等于该字符串的Kolmogorov复杂度（仅差一个对数因子）。这意味着权重衰减诱导的先验在多项式因子内匹配所罗门诺夫通用先验。该结果具有范数无关性，适用于任何作为正则化器的范数。同时发现了置换编码实例，表明对数因子是紧的。在无限精度下，神经网络可编码不可计算函数，权重范数失去相关性。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了权重衰减与Kolmogorov复杂度之间的严格理论联系，证明了权重衰减通过最小化权重范数实现了对简单函数的偏好，其诱导的先验近似于最优的所罗门诺夫通用先验。固定精度假设至关重要，它保证了神经网络只能编码可计算函数，使得权重范数成为模型复杂度的有效度量。这一理论不仅解释了权重衰减的有效性，还揭示了神经网络与算法信息论之间的深刻联系。

title: V4FinBench: Benchmarking Tabular Foundation Models, LLMs, and Standard Methods on Corporate Bankruptcy Prediction
summary: Corporate bankruptcy prediction is a high-stakes financial task characterized by severe class imbalance and multi-horizon forecasting demands. Public datasets supporting it remain scarce and small: widely used free benchmarks contain between 6,000 and 80,000 company-year observations, while larger resources are behind subscription paywalls. To address this gap, we introduce V4FinBench, a benchmark of over one million company-year records from the Visegràd Group (V4) economies (2006-2021), with 131 financial and non-financial features, six prediction horizons, and a composite distress criterion jointly capturing solvency, profitability, and liquidity deterioration. V4FinBench is designed to support the evaluation of tabular and foundation-model methods under realistic class imbalance, with positive rates between 0.19% and 0.36%. We provide reference evaluations of standard tabular baselines, finetuned TabPFN, and QLoRA-finetuned Llama-3-8B. With imbalance-aware finetuning, TabPFN matches or exceeds gradient boosting at longer time horizons on both $F_1$-score and ROC-AUC. In contrast, Llama-3-8B trails gradient boosting on ROC-AUC at every horizon and is generally weaker on $F_1$-score, with the gap widening sharply beyond the immediate horizon. In an external evaluation on the American Bankruptcy Dataset, the V4FinBench-finetuned TabPFN checkpoint improves over vanilla TabPFN, suggesting that adaptation captures transferable financial-distress structure rather than only V4-specific patterns. V4FinBench is publicly released to support further evaluation and development of prediction methods on realistic financial data.

AI.tldr: 发布了V4FinBench，一个包含超过100万条公司年度记录的企业破产预测基准数据集，支持表格数据和基础模型在不平衡类别下的评估。实验表明，经过不平衡感知微调的TabPFN在长期预测中匹配或超越梯度提升，而Llama-3-8B表现较差。
AI.motivation: 企业破产预测是一个高 stakes 的金融任务，面临严重的类别不平衡和多时域预测需求。现有公开数据集稀缺且规模小（6,000-80,000条记录），大规模数据集则被订阅付费墙限制，亟需一个大规模、公开的基准数据集来推动该领域研究。
AI.method: 构建了V4FinBench基准数据集，包含维谢格拉德集团四国经济体2006-2021年间超过100万条公司年度记录，具有131个财务和非财务特征、六个预测时域，以及综合偿付能力、盈利能力和流动性恶化的复合困境标准。数据集设计支持在现实类别不平衡（正样本率0.19%-0.36%）下评估表格方法和基础模型。提供了标准表格基线、微调TabPFN和QLoRA微调Llama-3-8B的参考评估。
AI.result: 在不平衡感知微调下，TabPFN在较长时间域的F1分数和ROC-AUC上匹配或超越梯度提升。相比之下，Llama-3-8B在每个时域的ROC-AUC上都落后于梯度提升，F1分数普遍较弱，且差距在即时域之外急剧扩大。在美国破产数据集的外部评估中，V4FinBench微调的TabPFN检查点优于原始TabPFN，表明适应过程捕获了可迁移的财务困境结构而非仅V4特定模式。
AI.conclusion: V4FinBench填补了大规模公开企业破产预测数据集的空白，为评估表格数据和基础模型方法提供了现实的不平衡金融数据。TabPFN在适当微调后展现出强大的迁移能力，而大型语言模型在此任务上表现不佳。该数据集已公开发布以支持预测方法的进一步评估和开发。

title: Beyond Red-Teaming: Formal Guarantees of LLM Guardrail Classifiers
summary: Guardrail Classifiers defend production language models against harmful behavior, but although results seem promising in testing, they provide no formal guarantees. Providing formal guarantees for such models is hard because "harmful behavior" has no natural specification in a discrete input space: and the standard epsilon-ball properties used in other domains do not carry semantic meaning. We close this gap by shifting verification from the discrete input space to the classifier's pre-activation space, where we define a harmful region as a convex shape enclosing the representations of known harmful prompts. Because the sigmoid classification head is monotonic, certifying the worst-case point is sufficient to certify the entire region, yielding a closed-form soundness proof without approximation in O(d) time. To formally evaluate these classifiers, we propose two constructions of such regions: SVD-aligned hyper-rectangles, which yield exact SAT/UNSAT certificates, and Gaussian Mixture Models, which yield probabilistic certificates over semantically coherent clusters. Applying this framework to three author-trained Guardrail Classifiers on the toxicity domain, every hyper-rectangle configuration returns SAT, exposing verifiable safety holes across all classifiers, despite seemingly high empirical metrics. Probabilistic GMM certificates also expose a divergent structural stability in how these models represent harm. While GPT-2 and Llama-3.1-8B maintain robust coverage of 90% and 80% across varying boundaries, BERT's safety guarantees prove uniquely volatile. This 'coverage collapse' to 55% at the optimal threshold reveals a sparsely populated safety margin in BERT, which only achieves full coverage by adopting an extremely conservative pessimistic threshold. These approaches combined, provide new insights on how effective Guardrail Classifiers really are, beyond traditional red-teaming.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对Guardrail Classifiers的形式化验证框架，通过在预激活空间定义有害区域，发现了现有分类器在看似高性能指标下实际存在可验证的安全漏洞。
AI.motivation: 现有的Guardrail Classifiers虽然测试表现良好，但缺乏形式化保证。为“有害行为”在离散输入空间提供形式化验证极其困难，因为传统的epsilon-ball性质在此不具备语义意义，导致安全验证存在空白。
AI.method: 提出将验证从离散输入空间转移到分类器的预激活空间。在预激活空间中，将有害区域定义为包围已知有害提示表示的凸形状。利用sigmoid分类头的单调性，通过认证最坏情况点即可认证整个区域，实现O(d)时间的闭式可靠性证明。提出两种区域构造方法：产生精确SAT/UNSAT证书的SVD对齐超矩形，以及在语义连贯簇上产生概率证书的高斯混合模型（GMM）。
AI.result: 在三个毒性领域的Guardrail Classifiers上应用该框架，所有超矩形配置均返回SAT，暴露了所有分类器中存在的可验证安全漏洞。概率GMM证书揭示了模型表示有害内容的结构性稳定性差异：GPT-2和Llama-3.1-8B在不同边界下保持90%和80%的鲁棒覆盖率，而BERT的安全保证表现出独特的波动性——在最优质阈值处“覆盖率崩塌”至55%，揭示了BERT中稀疏的安全边际。
AI.conclusion: 该方法超越了传统的红队测试，为评估Guardrail Classifiers的真实有效性提供了新见解，揭示了现有分类器在经验指标看似良好背后隐藏的形式化安全缺陷，并指出不同模型架构在安全边界稳定性上存在显著差异。

title: Revisiting Policy Gradients for Restricted Policy Classes: Escaping Myopic Local Optima with $k$-step Policy Gradients
summary: This work revisits standard policy gradient methods used on restricted policy classes, which are known to get stuck in suboptimal critical points. We identify an important cause for this phenomenon to be that the policy gradient is itself fundamentally myopic, i.e. it only improves the policy based on the one-step $Q$-function. In this work, we propose a generalized $k$-step policy gradient method that couples the randomness within a $k$-step time window and can escape the myopic local optima in MDPs with restricted policy classes. We show this new method is theoretically guaranteed to converge to a solution that is exponentially close in performance to the optimal deterministic policy with respect to $k$. Further, we show projected gradient descent and mirror descent with this $k$-step policy gradient can achieve this exponential guarantee in $O(\frac{1}{T})$ iterations, despite only assuming smoothness and differentiability of the value function. This will provide near optimal solutions to previously elusive applications like state aggregation and partially observable cooperative multi-agent settings. Moreover, our bounds avoid the ubiquitous distribution mismatch factors $||d_μ^{π^*} / d_μ^π||_\infty$ and $||d_μ^{π^*} / μ||_\infty$ enabling the $k$-step policy gradient method to escape suboptimal critical points that emerge from poor exploration in fully observable settings.

AI.tldr: 针对受限策略类中策略梯度方法易陷入次优临界点的问题，本文提出了一种广义的$k$步策略梯度方法，该方法能在仅假设价值函数平滑可微的条件下，以$O(1/T)$的收敛速度找到性能指数接近最优确定性策略的解，并避免了常见的分布不匹配因子。
AI.motivation: 标准的策略梯度方法在受限策略类中容易陷入次优临界点。作者识别出这一现象的重要成因在于策略梯度本质上具有短视性（myopic），即它仅基于单步Q函数来改进策略。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种广义的$k$步策略梯度方法。该方法耦合了$k$步时间窗口内的随机性，从而能够逃离马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中受限策略类下的短视局部最优解。
AI.result: 理论上证明了新方法保证收敛到一个性能相对于$k$指数接近最优确定性策略的解。在仅假设价值函数平滑和可微的条件下，证明了使用该$k$步策略梯度的投影梯度下降和镜像下降可以在$O(1/T)$次迭代中实现这一指数保证。此外，该界限避免了普遍存在的分布不匹配因子。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为先前难以解决的应用（如状态聚合和部分可观测合作多智能体设置）提供了近似最优解，并使得算法能够逃离在完全可观测设置中因探索不足而产生的次优临界点。

title: Dynamic Skill Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
comment: Implementation code is available at https://github.com/ejhshen/SLIM
summary: Large language model agents increasingly rely on external skills to solve complex tasks, where skills act as modular units that extend their capabilities beyond what parametric memory alone supports. Existing methods assume external skills either accumulate as persistent guidance or internalized into the policy, eventually leading to zero-skill inference. We argue this assumption is overly restrictive, since with limited parametric capacity and uneven marginal contribution across skills, the optimal active skill set is non-monotonic, task- and stage-dependent. In this work, we propose SLIM, a framework of dynamic Skill LIfecycle Management for agentic reinforcement learning (RL), which treats the active external skill set as a dynamic optimization variable jointly updated with policy learning. Specifically, SLIM estimates each active skill's marginal external contribution through leave-one-skill-out validation, then applies three lifecycle operations: retaining high-value skills, retiring skills whose contribution becomes negligible after sufficient exposure, and expanding the skill bank when persistent failures reveal missing capability coverage. Experiments show that SLIM outperforms the best baselines by an average of 7.1% points across ALFWorld and SearchQA. Results further indicate that policy learning and external skill retention are not mutually exclusive: some skills are absorbed into the policy, while others continue to provide external value, supporting SLIM as a more general paradigm for skill-based agentic RL.

AI.tldr: 提出了SLIM框架，通过动态管理智能体的外部技能集（保留、退役、扩展）来优化基于技能的智能体强化学习，在ALFWorld和SearchQA上平均超越基线7.1个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有方法假设外部技能要么作为持久指导累积，要么被内化到策略中，最终导致零技能推理。然而，由于有限的参数容量和技能间不均衡的边际贡献，最优的活跃技能集应当是非单调的、依赖于任务和阶段的，现有假设过于严格。
AI.method: 提出SLIM（动态技能生命周期管理）框架，将活跃外部技能集视为与策略学习联合更新的动态优化变量。具体包括：1）通过留一技能验证估算每个活跃技能的边际外部贡献；2）执行三种生命周期操作：保留高价值技能、退役贡献可忽略的技能、以及在发现能力缺失时扩展技能库。
AI.result: SLIM在ALFWorld和SearchQA任务上平均超越最佳基线7.1个百分点。实验结果进一步表明策略学习与外部技能保留并非互斥：部分技能被策略吸收，而其他技能持续提供外部价值。
AI.conclusion: SLIM为基于技能的智能体RL提供了更通用的范式，证明了动态管理技能集优于静态或全内化方案，策略内化与外部技能保留可以共存。

title: DECO: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts with Dense-Comparable Performance on End-Side Devices
summary: While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales model capacity without proportionally increasing computation, its massive total parameter footprint creates significant storage and memory-access bottlenecks, which hinder efficient end-side deployment that simultaneously requires high performance, low computational cost, and small storage overhead. To achieve these properties, we present DECO, a sparse MoE architecture designed to match the performance of dense Transformers under identical total parameter budgets and training tokens. DECO utilizes the differentiable and flexible ReLU-based routing enhanced by learnable expert-wise scaling, which adaptively balances the contributions of routed and shared experts. Furthermore, we introduce NormSiLU, an activation function that normalizes inputs prior to SiLU operators, producing a more stable trend of routed-expert activation ratio and a higher intrinsic sparsity level. We also identify an empirical advantage in using non-gated MLP experts with ReLU-based routing, indicating the possibility of MoE architecture simplification. Experiments demonstrate that DECO, activating only 20% of experts, matches dense performance and outperforms established MoE baselines. Our specialized acceleration kernel delivers a 3.00$\times$ speedup on real hardware compared with dense inference. Codes and checkpoints will be released.

AI.tldr: DECO是一种稀疏MoE架构，通过ReLU路由、可学习专家缩放和NormSiLU激活函数，在相同参数预算下实现了与稠密Transformer相匹配的性能，同时仅激活20%的专家，并在真实硬件上实现了3倍加速。
AI.motivation: 尽管混合专家模型(MoE)可以在不按比例增加计算量的情况下扩展模型容量，但其巨大的总参数占用造成了显著的存储和内存访问瓶颈，这阻碍了同时需要高性能、低计算成本和小存储开销的高效端侧部署。
AI.method: 1. 采用基于ReLU的可微分灵活路由，并引入可学习的专家级缩放，自适应地平衡路由专家和共享专家的贡献；\n2. 提出NormSiLU激活函数，在SiLU操作前对输入进行归一化，产生更稳定的路由专家激活比例趋势和更高的内在稀疏水平；\n3. 使用非门控MLP专家配合基于ReLU的路由，简化MoE架构。
AI.result: 实验表明，DECO仅激活20%的专家即可匹配稠密模型的性能并优于现有MoE基线；专用加速内核在真实硬件上相比稠密推理实现了3.00倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: DECO成功解决了MoE模型的存储和内存访问瓶颈问题，证明了在保持高性能的同时实现低计算成本和小存储开销的可行性，并通过架构简化和专用优化实现了显著的效率提升。
